<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/client_commands.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="310" bytes="10777" original_lines="310" original_bytes="10777" minified="false" sha256="dd02a62b51a37139e77fbbb29648e5501d596d33378d627e3320ca93be60f4f9">>>
//! Shared typed command parsing and dispatch for terminal and graphical clients.
//!
//! [`parse_command`] accepts the union of the terminal and F1 console commands.
//! A startup registry is the source for help, aliases, and completion. Execution
//! queues protocol messages directly and reports UI/process work as a typed
//! [`FrontendAction`], leaving each front end in control of its own event loop.

use crate::{options::ThreadLane, session::QueueError};
use minimium_commands::{
    CommandRegistry as SharedCommandRegistry, CommandSpec as SharedCommandSpec,
};
use minimium_protocol::ClientMessage;
use minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

mod connection;
mod environment;
mod gameplay;
mod interface;
mod movement;
mod weather;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum ClientCommand {
    AtmosphereDebug(minimium_renderer::atmosphere_debug::AtmosphereDebug),
    AtmosphereStatus,
    TerrainDebug(minimium_renderer::terrain_debug::TerrainDebug),
    TerrainStatus,
    Movement(movement::Setting),
    SetAltitude(f32),
    Help,
    Print(String),
    HostLocal(Option<ThreadLane>),
    Connect(String),
    Disconnect,
    FpsShow,
    NetStats,
    Ping,
    Move([f32; 2]),
    Jump,
    UsePortal,
    MapTeleport,
    Fire,
    Chat(String),
    SetName(String),
    State,
    Clear,
    Quit,
    SkyQuality(SkyQuality),
    SkyInfo,
    SkyBodies,
    SkyDemo(bool),
    Fov(Option<f32>),
    ShowCelestialNames(bool),
    TimeStatus,
    TimeScale(String),
    SetTime { minute: u16, local: bool },
    WeatherStatus,
    WeatherDebug(minimium_environment::weather::CloudDebug),
    WeatherDetail(u8),
}

pub(crate) type CommandSpec = SharedCommandSpec<ClientCommand, ParseError>;
pub(super) type CommandRegistry = SharedCommandRegistry<ClientCommand, ParseError>;

static REGISTRY: OnceLock<CommandRegistry> = OnceLock::new();

pub(crate) fn initialize_registry() {
    let _ = registry();
}

fn registry() -> &'static CommandRegistry {
    REGISTRY.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut registry = CommandRegistry::default();
        interface::register(&mut registry);
        connection::register(&mut registry);
        gameplay::register(&mut registry);
        movement::register(&mut registry);
        environment::register(&mut registry);
        weather::register(&mut registry);
        registry
    })
}

pub(crate) fn help_lines() -> impl Iterator<Item = &'static str> {
    registry().commands().iter().map(|command| command.usage)
}

pub(crate) fn command_specs() -> &'static [CommandSpec] {
    registry().commands()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum ParseError {
    MissingChat,
    InvalidLane,
    HostUsage,
    ConnectUsage,
    MoveUsage,
    NameUsage,
    InvalidCoordinate,
    NonFiniteCoordinate,
    SkyQualityUsage,
    FovUsage,
    CelestialNamesUsage,
    TimeScaleUsage,
    SetTimeUsage,
    UnknownCommand,
    Usage(&'static str),
}

pub(crate) fn parse_command(input: &str) -> Result<Option<ClientCommand>, ParseError> {
    let trimmed = input.trim();
    if trimmed.is_empty() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let words = trimmed.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let group: Vec<_> = command_specs()
        .iter()
        .filter(|spec| spec.name.starts_with(&format!("{trimmed} ")))
        .map(|spec| spec.usage)
        .collect();
    if !group.is_empty() {
        return Ok(Some(ClientCommand::Print(group.join("\n"))));
    }
    registry()
        .parse(trimmed, &words)
        .map(|result| result.map_err(|(usage, _)| ParseError::Usage(usage)))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
            let domain = words[0];
            let choices: Vec<_> = command_specs()
                .iter()
                .filter(|spec| spec.name.split_whitespace().next() == Some(domain))
                .map(|spec| spec.usage)
                .collect();
            Ok(ClientCommand::Print(format!(
                "Unknown command. Available usage:\n{}",
                if choices.is_empty() {
                    help_lines().collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")
                } else {
                    choices.join("\n")
                }
            )))
        })
        .map(Some)
}

pub(crate) struct CommandContext<'a> {
    pub connection: &'a mut minimium_client_runtime::ConnectionController,
    /// Direction used for `fire`; terminal callers pass [1, 0, 0].
    pub fire_direction: [f32; 3],
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum FrontendAction {
    AtmosphereDebug(minimium_renderer::atmosphere_debug::AtmosphereDebug),
    AtmosphereStatus,
    TerrainDebug(minimium_renderer::terrain_debug::TerrainDebug),
    TerrainStatus,
    Help,
    Print(String),
    Connect(String),
    HostLocal(Option<ThreadLane>),
    Disconnect,
    FpsShow,
    NetStats,
    State,
    MapTeleport,
    Clear,
    Quit,
    SkyQuality(SkyQuality),
    SkyInfo,
    SkyBodies,
    SkyDemo(bool),
    Fov(Option<f32>),
    ShowCelestialNames(bool),
    TimeStatus,
    TimeScale(String),
    SetTime { minute: u16, local: bool },
    WeatherStatus,
    WeatherDebug(minimium_environment::weather::CloudDebug),
    WeatherDetail(u8),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum CommandResult {
    Sent,
    QueueError(QueueError),
    Action(FrontendAction),
}

pub(crate) fn execute(command: ClientCommand, context: &mut CommandContext<'_>) -> CommandResult {
    let message = match command {
        ClientCommand::AtmosphereDebug(mode) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::AtmosphereDebug(mode))
        }
        ClientCommand::AtmosphereStatus => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::AtmosphereStatus)
        }
        ClientCommand::SetAltitude(km) => {
            if !context.connection.movement.fly {
                return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Print(
                    "set_altitude requires fly on".into(),
                ));
            }
            ClientMessage::SetAltitude { km }
        }
        ClientCommand::Movement(setting) => return movement::execute(setting, context),
        ClientCommand::Print(text) => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Print(text)),
        ClientCommand::WeatherStatus => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::WeatherStatus)
        }
        ClientCommand::TerrainStatus => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::TerrainStatus)
        }
        ClientCommand::TerrainDebug(mode) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::TerrainDebug(mode))
        }
        ClientCommand::WeatherDebug(mode) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::WeatherDebug(mode))
        }
        ClientCommand::WeatherDetail(level) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::WeatherDetail(level))
        }
        ClientCommand::Ping => ClientMessage::Ping,
        ClientCommand::Move(direction) => {
            ClientMessage::Motion(minimium_simulation::CharacterInput {
                direction,
                movement: context.connection.movement,
                ..Default::default()
            })
        }
        ClientCommand::Jump => ClientMessage::Motion(minimium_simulation::CharacterInput {
            jump: true,
            vertical: 1.0,
            movement: context.connection.movement,
            ..Default::default()
        }),
        ClientCommand::UsePortal => ClientMessage::UsePortal,
        ClientCommand::MapTeleport => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::MapTeleport),
        ClientCommand::Fire => ClientMessage::Fire {
            direction: context.fire_direction,
        },
        ClientCommand::Chat(text) => ClientMessage::Chat(text),
        ClientCommand::SetName(name) => ClientMessage::SetName(name),
        ClientCommand::Help => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Help),
        ClientCommand::Connect(address) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Connect(address))
        }
        ClientCommand::HostLocal(lane) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::HostLocal(lane))
        }
        ClientCommand::Disconnect => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Disconnect),
        ClientCommand::FpsShow => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::FpsShow),
        ClientCommand::NetStats => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::NetStats),
        ClientCommand::State => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::State),
        ClientCommand::Clear => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Clear),
        ClientCommand::Quit => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Quit),
        ClientCommand::SkyQuality(quality) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::SkyQuality(quality))
        }
        ClientCommand::SkyInfo => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::SkyInfo),
        ClientCommand::SkyBodies => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::SkyBodies),
        ClientCommand::SkyDemo(enabled) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::SkyDemo(enabled))
        }
        ClientCommand::Fov(degrees) => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::Fov(degrees)),
        ClientCommand::ShowCelestialNames(enabled) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::ShowCelestialNames(enabled))
        }
        ClientCommand::SetTime { minute, local } => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::SetTime { minute, local })
        }
        ClientCommand::TimeStatus => return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::TimeStatus),
        ClientCommand::TimeScale(value) => {
            return CommandResult::Action(FrontendAction::TimeScale(value))
        }
    };
    match context.connection.queue(&message) {
        Ok(()) => CommandResult::Sent,
        Err(error) => CommandResult::QueueError(error),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{command_specs, parse_command, ClientCommand, ParseError};

    #[test]
    fn portal_is_available_to_the_text_console_and_completion() {
        assert_eq!(parse_command("portal"), Ok(Some(ClientCommand::UsePortal)));
        assert!(command_specs().iter().any(|spec| spec.name == "portal"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn aliases_resolve_through_registered_parsers_and_admin_mutation_is_not_a_client_command() {
        assert_eq!(
            parse_command("chat hello"),
            Ok(Some(ClientCommand::Chat("hello".into())))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_command("timescale 1"),
            Ok(Some(ClientCommand::TimeScale("1".into())))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_command("time mode real_time"),
            Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand)
        );
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/client_commands/connection.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="52" bytes="1856" original_lines="52" original_bytes="1856" minified="false" sha256="9293c8e4bb65161808c0bae04c97a950406fb9a9081c2a23d1e2cc2328ce4d1a">>>
use super::{ClientCommand, CommandRegistry, CommandSpec, ParseError};
use crate::options::ThreadLane;

const COMMANDS: &[CommandSpec] = &[
    CommandSpec {
        name: "network host local",
        alias: Some("host local"),
        usage: "network host local [--threads 1|2|auto]",
        parser: parse,
    },
    CommandSpec {
        name: "network connect",
        alias: Some("connect"),
        usage: "network connect HOST:PORT",
        parser: parse,
    },
    CommandSpec {
        name: "network disconnect",
        alias: Some("disconnect"),
        usage: "network disconnect",
        parser: parse,
    },
    CommandSpec {
        name: "network ping",
        alias: Some("ping"),
        usage: "network ping",
        parser: parse,
    },
];

pub(super) fn register(registry: &mut CommandRegistry) {
    registry.register(COMMANDS);
}

fn parse(words: &[&str]) -> Result<ClientCommand, ParseError> {
    let [command, raw_arguments] = words else {
        return Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand);
    };
    let arguments = raw_arguments.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
    match (*command, arguments.as_slice()) {
        ("network host local", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::HostLocal(None)),
        ("network host local", ["--threads", lane]) => Ok(ClientCommand::HostLocal(Some(
            ThreadLane::parse(lane).map_err(|_| ParseError::InvalidLane)?,
        ))),
        ("network host local", _) => Err(ParseError::HostUsage),
        ("network connect", [address]) => Ok(ClientCommand::Connect((*address).to_owned())),
        ("network connect", _) => Err(ParseError::ConnectUsage),
        ("network disconnect", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::Disconnect),
        ("network ping", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::Ping),
        _ => Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand),
    }
}

fn parse(words: &[&str]) -> Result<ClientCommand, ParseError> {
    let [command, raw_arguments] = words else {
        return Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand);
    };
    let arguments = raw_arguments.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
    match (*command, arguments.as_slice()) {
        ("sky quality", [value]) => Ok(ClientCommand::SkyQuality(
            SkyQuality::parse(value).map_err(|_| ParseError::SkyQualityUsage)?,
        )),
        ("sky quality", _) => Err(ParseError::SkyQualityUsage),
        ("sky info", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::SkyInfo),
        ("sky bodies", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::SkyBodies),
        ("sky demo", ["on"]) => Ok(ClientCommand::SkyDemo(true)),
        ("sky demo", ["off"]) => Ok(ClientCommand::SkyDemo(false)),
        ("camera fov", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::Fov(None)),
        ("camera fov", [value]) => {
            let degrees = value.parse::<f32>().map_err(|_| ParseError::FovUsage)?;

                return Err(ParseError::FovUsage);

        ("sky names", _) => Err(ParseError::CelestialNamesUsage),

                minute,
                local: name == "set_time_local",
            })
        }
        ("set_time" | "set_time_local", _) => Err(ParseError::SetTimeUsage),
        ("time status", []) => Ok(ClientCommand::TimeStatus),

use super::{ClientCommand, CommandRegistry, CommandSpec, ParseError};

const COMMANDS: &[CommandSpec] = &[
    CommandSpec { name: "set_altitude", alias: None,
        usage: "set_altitude <0..10000 km> - height above local ground; requires fly on", parser: parse },
    CommandSpec { name: "movement fly", alias: Some("fly"),
        usage: "movement fly [on|off] - noclip; Space up, Ctrl down; inherits walk speed and accel", parser: parse },
    CommandSpec { name: "movement speed", alias: None,
        usage: "movement speed [0..10000] - maximum walk/fly speed in m/s; no argument shows current value", parser: parse },
    CommandSpec { name: "movement accel", alias: None,
        usage: "movement accel [0..10000] - walk/fly acceleration and braking in m/s²; no argument shows current value", parser: parse },
];

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum Setting {
    Fly(Option<bool>),
    Speed(Option<f32>),
    Accel(Option<f32>),
}

pub(super) fn register(registry: &mut CommandRegistry) {
    registry.register(COMMANDS);
}

fn parse(words: &[&str]) -> Result<ClientCommand, ParseError> {
    let args: Vec<_> = words[1].split_whitespace().collect();
    if words[0] == "set_altitude" {
        return match args.as_slice() {
            [value] => value
                .parse::<f32>()
                .ok()
                .filter(|v| v.is_finite() && (0.0..=10000.0).contains(v))
                .map(ClientCommand::SetAltitude)
                .ok_or(ParseError::UnknownCommand),
            _ => Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand),
        };
    }
    let setting = match words[0] {
        "movement fly" => Setting::Fly(match args.as_slice() {
            [] => None,
            ["on"] => Some(true),
            ["off"] => Some(false),
            _ => return Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand),
        }),
        command => {
            let value = match args.as_slice() {
                [] => None,
                [value] => Some(
                    value
                        .parse::<f32>()
                        .ok()
                        .filter(|v| {
                            v.is_finite() && (0.0..=minimium_simulation::MOVEMENT_LIMIT).contains(v)
                        })
                        .ok_or(ParseError::UnknownCommand)?,
                ),
                _ => return Err(ParseError::UnknownCommand),
            };
            if command == "movement speed" {
                Setting::Speed(value)
            } else {
                Setting::Accel(value)
            }
        }
    };
    Ok(ClientCommand::Movement(setting))
}

pub(super) fn execute(
    setting: Setting,
    context: &mut super::CommandContext<'_>,
) -> super::CommandResult {
    let mut settings = context.connection.movement;
    let change = match setting {
        Setting::Fly(value) => {
            if let Some(v) = value {
                settings.fly = v;
            }
            value.is_some()
        }
        Setting::Speed(value) => {
            if let Some(v) = value {
                settings.speed = v;
            }
            value.is_some()
        }
        Setting::Accel(value) => {
            if let Some(v) = value {
                settings.accel = v;
            }
            value.is_some()
        }
    };
    if change {
        let input = minimium_simulation::CharacterInput {
            movement: settings,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        if let Err(error) = context
            .connection
            .queue(&minimium_protocol::ClientMessage::Motion(input))
        {
            return super::CommandResult::QueueError(error);
        }
        context.connection.movement = settings;
    }
    super::CommandResult::Action(super::FrontendAction::Print(format!(
        "movement: fly={} (noclip), speed={} m/s, accel={} m/s² (shared by walk and fly; range 0..10000)",
        settings.fly, settings.speed, settings.accel)))
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/console/editor.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="262" bytes="7267" original_lines="262" original_bytes="7267" minified="false" sha256="27a256f6e7ae0a03550ff5da8b61806249c21f852384e5697e4b753f86756e9c">>>
use super::theme::MAX_INPUT;
use std::ops::Range;
use std::time::Instant;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Snapshot {
    text: String,
    cursor: usize,
    anchor: usize,
}

pub(crate) struct Editor {
    pub text: String,
    pub cursor: usize,
    pub anchor: usize,
    pub scroll: usize,
    pub dragging: bool,
    pub changed_at: Instant,
    undo: Vec<Snapshot>,
    redo: Vec<Snapshot>,
}

impl Editor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            text: String::with_capacity(MAX_INPUT),
            cursor: 0,
            anchor: 0,
            scroll: 0,
            dragging: false,
            changed_at: Instant::now(),
            undo: Vec::new(),
            redo: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn selection(&self) -> Range<usize> {
        self.cursor.min(self.anchor)..self.cursor.max(self.anchor)
    }

    pub fn selected_text(&self) -> &str {
        &self.text[self.selection()]
    }

    fn snapshot(&self) -> Snapshot {
        Snapshot {
            text: self.text.clone(),
            cursor: self.cursor,
            anchor: self.anchor,
        }
    }

    fn record(&mut self) {
        if self.undo.len() == 128 {
            self.undo.remove(0);
        }
        self.undo.push(self.snapshot());
        self.redo.clear();
    }

    pub fn set_text(&mut self, text: &str) {
        self.undo.clear();
        self.redo.clear();
        self.text.clear();
        self.text.push_str(text);
        self.cursor = self.text.len();
        self.anchor = self.cursor;
        self.scroll = 0;
        self.changed_at = Instant::now();
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) -> String {
        self.undo.clear();
        self.redo.clear();
        self.scroll = 0;
        self.cursor = 0;
        self.anchor = 0;
        std::mem::take(&mut self.text)
    }

    pub fn replace_selection(&mut self, input: &str) {
        let range = self.selection();
        let capacity = MAX_INPUT - (self.text.len() - range.len());
        let mut clean = String::new();
        for ch in input.chars().filter(|ch| !ch.is_control()) {
            if clean.len() + ch.len_utf8() > capacity {
                break;
            }
            clean.push(ch);
        }
        if range.is_empty() && clean.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.record();
        self.text.replace_range(range.clone(), &clean);
        self.cursor = range.start + clean.len();
        self.anchor = self.cursor;
        self.changed_at = Instant::now();
    }

    pub fn replace_range(&mut self, range: Range<usize>, replacement: &str) {
        if self.text.len() - range.len() + replacement.len() > MAX_INPUT {
            return;
        }
        self.record();
        self.text.replace_range(range.clone(), replacement);
        self.cursor = range.start + replacement.len();
        self.anchor = self.cursor;
        self.changed_at = Instant::now();
    }

    pub fn move_to(&mut self, target: usize, select: bool) {
        self.cursor = target.min(self.text.len());
        if !select {
            self.anchor = self.cursor;
        }
        self.changed_at = Instant::now();
    }

    pub fn left(&mut self, select: bool, word: bool) {
        if !select && !self.selection().is_empty() {
            self.move_to(self.selection().start, false);
        } else {
            self.move_to(
                if word {
                    self.word_left()
                } else {
                    self.previous()
                },
                select,
            );
        }
    }

    pub fn right(&mut self, select: bool, word: bool) {
        if !select && !self.selection().is_empty() {
            self.move_to(self.selection().end, false);
        } else {
            self.move_to(if word { self.word_right() } else { self.next() }, select);
        }
    }

    fn previous(&self) -> usize {
        self.text[..self.cursor]
            .char_indices()
            .last()
            .map_or(0, |(at, _)| at)
    }

    fn next(&self) -> usize {
        self.cursor
            + self.text[self.cursor..]
                .chars()
                .next()
                .map_or(0, char::len_utf8)
    }

    fn word_left(&self) -> usize {
        let mut pos = self.cursor;
        while pos > 0 {
            let ch = self.text[..pos].chars().next_back().unwrap();
            if !ch.is_whitespace() {
                break;
            }
            pos -= ch.len_utf8();
        }
        while pos > 0 {
            let ch = self.text[..pos].chars().next_back().unwrap();
            if ch.is_whitespace() {
                break;
            }
            pos -= ch.len_utf8();
        }
        pos
    }

    fn word_right(&self) -> usize {
        let mut pos = self.cursor;
        while pos < self.text.len() {
            let ch = self.text[pos..].chars().next().unwrap();
            if ch.is_whitespace() {
                break;
            }
            pos += ch.len_utf8();
        }
        while pos < self.text.len() {
            let ch = self.text[pos..].chars().next().unwrap();
            if !ch.is_whitespace() {
                break;
            }
            pos += ch.len_utf8();
        }
        pos
    }

    pub fn delete(&mut self, backward: bool, word: bool) {
        let range = self.selection();
        if !range.is_empty() {
            self.replace_selection("");
            return;
        }
        let target = if backward {
            if word {
                self.word_left()
            } else {
                self.previous()
            }
        } else if word {
            self.word_right()
        } else {
            self.next()
        };
        if target != self.cursor {
            self.anchor = target;
            self.replace_selection("");
        }
    }

    pub fn select_all(&mut self) {
        self.anchor = 0;
        self.cursor = self.text.len();
        self.changed_at = Instant::now();
    }

    pub fn undo(&mut self) {
        if let Some(snapshot) = self.undo.pop() {
            self.redo.push(self.snapshot());
            self.restore(snapshot);
        }
    }

    pub fn redo(&mut self) {
        if let Some(snapshot) = self.redo.pop() {
            self.undo.push(self.snapshot());
            self.restore(snapshot);
        }
    }

    fn restore(&mut self, snapshot: Snapshot) {
        self.text = snapshot.text;
        self.cursor = snapshot.cursor;
        self.anchor = snapshot.anchor;
        self.changed_at = Instant::now();
    }

    pub fn ensure_visible(&mut self, columns: usize) {
        let cursor = self.text[..self.cursor].chars().count();
        if cursor < self.scroll {
            self.scroll = cursor;
        }
        if cursor >= self.scroll + columns {
            self.scroll = cursor + 1 - columns;
        }
        self.scroll = self.scroll.min(
            self.text
                .chars()
                .count()
                .saturating_add(1)
                .saturating_sub(columns),
        );
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/console/history.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="50" bytes="1644" original_lines="50" original_bytes="1644" minified="false" sha256="e6395cba09fe624709b41fb0a1cdf508b934a38078ca7bd8376969a77aaa2f12">>>
use super::state::Console;
use super::theme::{ECHO_TEXT, MAX_LINES};

pub(super) fn take_input(console: &mut Console) -> String {
    let input = console.editor.clear();
    console.history_cursor = None;
    console.history_draft.clear();
    console.suggestions.edited(&console.editor);
    if !input.trim().is_empty() {
        console.scroll_to_latest();
        if console.history.last() != Some(&input) {
            if console.history.len() == MAX_LINES {
                console.history.remove(0);
            }
            console.history.push(input.clone());
        }
        console.push_colored(&format!("> {input}"), ECHO_TEXT);
    }
    input
}

pub(super) fn history_up(console: &mut Console) {
    if console.history.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    if console.history_cursor.is_none() {
        console.history_draft = console.editor.text.clone();
    }
    let index = console
        .history_cursor
        .unwrap_or(console.history.len())
        .saturating_sub(1);
    console.history_cursor = Some(index);
    console.editor.set_text(&console.history[index]);
    console.suggestions.edited(&console.editor);
}

pub(super) fn history_down(console: &mut Console) {
    let Some(index) = console.history_cursor else {
        return;
    };
    if index + 1 >= console.history.len() {
        console.history_cursor = None;
        console.editor.set_text(&console.history_draft);
    } else {
        console.history_cursor = Some(index + 1);
        console.editor.set_text(&console.history[index + 1]);
    }

pub(super) fn append_hud(vertices: &mut Vec<UiVertex>, context: DrawContext, state: HudState) {
    let health_ratio = state.health.min(100) as f32 / 100.0;
    let health_color = if health_ratio > 0.5 {
        [0.20, 0.85, 0.38]
    } else if health_ratio > 0.25 {
        [0.96, 0.72, 0.20]
    } else {
        [0.95, 0.24, 0.20]
    };
    let mut health_label = *b"HP 000/100";
    let health_digits = state.health.min(100);
    if health_digits == 100 {
        health_label[3..6].copy_from_slice(b"100");
    } else if health_digits >= 10 {
        health_label[4] = b'0' + (health_digits / 10) as u8;
        health_label[5] = b'0' + (health_digits % 10) as u8;
    } else {
        health_label[4] = b' ';
        health_label[5] = b'0' + health_digits as u8;
    }
    text::append_text(
        vertices,
        context,
        TextDraw {
            x: 16.0,
            y: context.height - 58.0,
            text: std::str::from_utf8(&health_label).unwrap_or("HP"),
            color: [0.90, 0.95, 0.98],
            max_chars: 12,
            scale: 1.0,
        },
    );
    text::append_quad(
        vertices,
        context,
        QuadDraw::solid(
            16.0,
            context.height - 34.0,
            164.0,
            10.0,
            [0.025, 0.035, 0.050],
        ),
    );

        text::append_quad(
            vertices,
            context,
            QuadDraw::solid(
                18.0,
                context.height - 32.0,
                160.0 * health_ratio,
                6.0,
                health_color,
            ),
        );
    }

    if state.show_crosshair {
        let center_x = context.width * 0.5;
        let center_y = context.height * 0.5;
        let color = if state.hit_feedback {
            [1.0, 0.36, 0.18]
        } else {
            [0.90, 0.95, 0.98]
        };
        let uv = white_uv();
        for (x, y, width, height) in [
            (center_x - 8.0, center_y - 1.0, 6.0, 2.0),
            (center_x + 2.0, center_y - 1.0, 6.0, 2.0),
            (center_x - 1.0, center_y - 8.0, 2.0, 6.0),
            (center_x - 1.0, center_y + 2.0, 2.0, 6.0),

                context,
                QuadDraw {
                    x,
                    y,
                    width,
                    height,
                    color,
                    uv_min: uv,
                    uv_max: uv,
                },
            );
        }
    }
}

use super::editor::Editor;
use super::suggestions::Suggestions;
use super::text::{self, DrawContext, QuadDraw, TextDraw, UiVertex};
use super::theme::{GLYPH_ADVANCE, INPUT_TEXT};
use std::time::Instant;

const X: f32 = 46.0;

pub(super) fn draw(
    vertices: &mut Vec<UiVertex>,
    context: DrawContext,
    editor: &mut Editor,
    suggestions: &Suggestions,
) {
    let columns = ((context.width - X - 28.0) / GLYPH_ADVANCE).max(1.0) as usize;
    editor.ensure_visible(columns);
    let y = context.height - 42.0;
    text::append_text(
        vertices,
        context,
        TextDraw {
            x: 22.0,
            y,
            text: "> ",
            color: INPUT_TEXT,
            max_chars: 2,
            scale: 1.0,
        },
    );
    let chars: Vec<char> = editor.text.chars().collect();
    let range = editor.selection();
    let mut byte = 0;
    for (index, ch) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
        if index >= editor.scroll
            && index < editor.scroll + columns
            && byte >= range.start
            && byte < range.end
        {
            text::append_quad(
                vertices,
                context,
                QuadDraw::solid(
                    X + (index - editor.scroll) as f32 * GLYPH_ADVANCE,
                    y - 2.0,
                    GLYPH_ADVANCE,
                    24.0,
                    [0.22, 0.37, 0.52],
                ),
            );
        }
        byte += ch.len_utf8();
    }
    let visible: String = chars.iter().skip(editor.scroll).take(columns).collect();
    text::append_text(
        vertices,
        context,
        TextDraw {
            x: X,
            y,
            text: &visible,
            color: INPUT_TEXT,
            max_chars: columns,
            scale: 1.0,
        },
    );
    let cursor = editor.text[..editor.cursor].chars().count();
    if Instant::now().duration_since(editor.changed_at).as_millis() % 1000 < 550 {
        text::append_quad(
            vertices,
            context,
            QuadDraw::solid(
                X + (cursor - editor.scroll) as f32 * GLYPH_ADVANCE,
                y - 1.0,
                2.0,
                22.0,
                [0.96, 0.98, 1.0],
            ),
        );
    }
    for (row, hint) in suggestions.lines().enumerate() {
        text::append_text(
            vertices,
            context,
            TextDraw {
                x: 22.0,
                y: context.height - 66.0 - (row as f32 * 20.0),
                text: hint,
                color: [0.45, 0.53, 0.60],
                max_chars: ((context.width - 44.0) / GLYPH_ADVANCE) as usize,
                scale: 1.0,
            },
        );
    }
}

pub(super) fn hit(
    editor: &mut Editor,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    select: bool,
) -> bool {
    if !select
        && (y < height as f64 - 48.0
            || y > height as f64 - 18.0
            || x < 16.0
            || x > width as f64 - 16.0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    let columns = ((width as f32 - X - 28.0) / GLYPH_ADVANCE).max(1.0) as usize;
    editor.ensure_visible(columns);
    let column = ((x as f32 - X) / GLYPH_ADVANCE).round().max(0.0) as usize + editor.scroll;
    let byte = editor
        .text
        .char_indices()
        .nth(column)
        .map_or(editor.text.len(), |(at, _)| at);
    editor.move_to(byte, select);
    true
}

    pub fn push_line(&mut self, text: impl AsRef<str>) {
        self.push_colored(text.as_ref(), CONSOLE_TEXT);
    }

    pub fn push_error(&mut self, text: impl AsRef<str>) {
        self.push_colored(text.as_ref(), ERROR_TEXT);
    }

    pub(super) fn push_colored(&mut self, text: &str, color: [f32; 3]) {
        self.push_cleaned(clean_line(text), color);
    }

    fn push_cleaned(&mut self, text: String, color: [f32; 3]) {
        if self.lines.len() == MAX_LINES {
            self.lines.pop_front();
        }
        self.lines.push_back(ConsoleLine { text, color });
        if self.scroll_offset > 0 {
            self.scroll_offset = (self.scroll_offset + 1).min(self.lines.len());
        }
    }

    pub fn push_chat_line(&mut self, text: &str) {
        let clean = clean_line(text);
        self.push_cleaned(clean.clone(), CHAT_TEXT);
        if self.chat_lines.len() == MAX_CHAT_LINES {
            self.chat_lines.pop_front();
        }
        self.chat_lines.push_back(ChatLine {
            text: clean,
            received_at: Instant::now(),
        });
    }

    pub fn append_text(&mut self, text: &str) {
        self.editor.replace_selection(text);
        self.history_cursor = None;
        self.suggestions.edited(&self.editor);
    }

    pub fn backspace(&mut self) {
        self.editor.delete(true, false);
        self.history_cursor = None;
        self.suggestions.edited(&self.editor);
    }

    pub fn take_input(&mut self) -> String {
        history::take_input(self)
    }

    pub fn history_up(&mut self) {
        history::history_up(self);
    }

    pub fn history_down(&mut self) {
        history::history_down(self);
    }

    pub fn complete_input(&mut self, reverse: bool) {
        self.suggestions.cycle(&mut self.editor, reverse);
    }

    pub fn edit_changed(&mut self) {
        self.history_cursor = None;
        self.suggestions.edited(&self.editor);

    }

        self.scroll_offset = self.scroll_offset.min(self.lines.len());
    }

    pub fn build_vertices(
        &mut self,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        health: u16,
        show_crosshair: bool,
        hit_feedback: bool,
        overlay: Overlay<'_>,
    ) -> &[UiVertex] {
        self.vertices.clear();
        if width < 120 || height < 100 {
            return &self.vertices;
        }
        let context = DrawContext::new(width as f32, height as f32);
        hud::append_hud(

                show_crosshair,
                hit_feedback,

            hud::append_status(&mut self.vertices, context, status);
        }
        if let Some(zoom) = overlay.overview_zoom {
            zoom::draw(&mut self.vertices, context, zoom);
        }
        if !self.open {
            for label in overlay.celestial_labels {

                        y: label.y,

                        color: [0.92, 0.93, 0.82],
                        max_chars: 30,
                        scale: 0.75,
                    },
                );
            }
        }
        if !self.open {
            self.append_chat(context);
            return &self.vertices;
        }
        self.append_console(context);
        &self.vertices
    }

    pub fn take_vertices(&mut self) -> Vec<UiVertex> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.vertices)
    }

    pub fn restore_vertices(&mut self, vertices: Vec<UiVertex>) {
        self.vertices = vertices;
    }

    fn append_chat(&mut self, context: DrawContext) {
        let now = Instant::now();
        while self
            .chat_lines
            .front()
            .is_some_and(|line| now.duration_since(line.received_at) >= CHAT_VISIBLE_DURATION)
        {
            self.chat_lines.pop_front();
        }
        let visible_lines = self.chat_lines.len().min(4);
        let first_line = self.chat_lines.len().saturating_sub(visible_lines);
        let max_chars = ((context.width - 32.0) / GLYPH_ADVANCE) as usize;
        for (row, line) in self.chat_lines.iter().skip(first_line).enumerate() {
            text::append_text(
                &mut self.vertices,
                context,
                TextDraw {
                    x: 16.0,
                    y: context.height - 82.0 - (visible_lines - row - 1) as f32 * 20.0,
                    text: &line.text,
                    color: CHAT_TEXT,
                    max_chars,
                    scale: 1.0,
                },
            );
        }
    }

    fn append_console(&mut self, context: DrawContext) {
        let panel_height = 500.0f32.min(context.height - 20.0);
        let panel_top = context.height - panel_height - 10.0;
        text::append_quad(
            &mut self.vertices,
            context,
            text::QuadDraw::solid(
                10.0,
                panel_top,
                context.width - 20.0,
                panel_height,
                [0.025, 0.035, 0.050],
            ),
        );
        text::append_quad(
            &mut self.vertices,
            context,
            text::QuadDraw::solid(
                16.0,
                context.height - 48.0,
                context.width - 32.0,
                30.0,
                [0.07, 0.10, 0.13],
            ),
        );
        let scale = 1.0;
        let line_height = 22.0;
        let max_chars = ((context.width - 44.0) / GLYPH_ADVANCE) as usize;
        let hint_space = self.suggestions.lines().count() as f32 * 20.0;
        let visible_lines = ((panel_height - 70.0 - hint_space) / line_height).max(0.0) as usize;
        let first_line = self
            .lines
            .len()
            .saturating_sub(visible_lines + self.scroll_offset);
        for (row, line) in self
            .lines
            .iter()
            .skip(first_line)
            .take(visible_lines)
            .enumerate()
        {
            text::append_text(
                &mut self.vertices,
                context,
                TextDraw {
                    x: 22.0,
                    y: panel_top + 13.0 + row as f32 * line_height,
                    text: &line.text,
                    color: line.color,
                    max_chars,
                    scale,
                },
            );
        }
        input_draw::draw(
            &mut self.vertices,
            context,
            &mut self.editor,
            &self.suggestions,
        );
    }
}

fn clean_line(text: &str) -> String {
    let mut clean = String::with_capacity(text.len().min(192));
    for character in text.chars().take(192) {
        clean.push(if character.is_control() {
            ' '
        } else {
            character
        });
    }
    clean
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/console/suggestions.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="102" bytes="3127" original_lines="102" original_bytes="3127" minified="false" sha256="6875fada838ec474acc918eafb37ee39abc8b6c9681d49e8a028a23cf5ed7cb3">>>
use super::editor::Editor;
use crate::client_commands::{command_specs, CommandSpec};

pub(super) struct Suggestions {
    choices: Vec<&'static str>,
    index: Option<usize>,
    suffix: String,
    start: usize,
    usage: Option<&'static str>,
}

impl Suggestions {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            choices: Vec::new(),
            index: None,
            suffix: String::new(),
            start: 0,
            usage: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn refresh(&mut self, editor: &Editor) {
        if self.index.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        self.choices.clear();
        self.usage = None;
        let prefix = &editor.text[..editor.cursor];
        let start = prefix.len() - prefix.trim_start().len();
        let query = &prefix[start..];
        if query.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let specs = command_specs();
        self.usage = specs
            .iter()
            .find(|spec| matches_arguments(query, spec))
            .map(|spec| spec.usage);
        if self.usage.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        for spec in specs {
            if spec.name.starts_with(query) {
                self.choices.push(spec.name);
            }
            if let Some(alias) = spec.alias {
                if alias.starts_with(query) {
                    self.choices.push(alias);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn lines(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'static str> + '_ {
        self.usage
            .into_iter()
            .chain(self.choices.iter().copied().take(5))
    }

    pub fn cycle(&mut self, editor: &mut Editor, reverse: bool) {
        if self.index.is_none() {
            self.refresh(editor);
            if self.choices.is_empty() {
                return;
            }
            self.start = editor.cursor - editor.text[..editor.cursor].trim_start().len();
            self.suffix = editor.text[editor.cursor..].to_owned();
        }
        let count = self.choices.len();
        let next = match self.index {
            Some(index) if reverse => (index + count - 1) % count,
            Some(index) => (index + 1) % count,
            None if reverse => count - 1,
            None => 0,
        };
        let replacement = self.choices[next];
        let old_end = editor.text.len() - self.suffix.len();
        if editor.text.len() - (old_end - self.start) + replacement.len() > super::theme::MAX_INPUT
        {
            return;
        }
        editor.replace_range(self.start..old_end, replacement);
        self.index = Some(next);
    }

    pub fn edited(&mut self, editor: &Editor) {
        self.index = None;
        self.refresh(editor);
    }
}

fn matches_arguments(input: &str, spec: &CommandSpec) -> bool {
    [Some(spec.name), spec.alias]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .any(|name| {
            input
                .strip_prefix(name)
                .is_some_and(|rest| rest.is_empty() || rest.starts_with(char::is_whitespace))
        })
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/console/text.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="126" bytes="3886" original_lines="126" original_bytes="3886" minified="false" sha256="10b278badd698c22355d4ff6fc4a2913935429c0f1094d145b788f234e566c9b">>>
pub use minimium_renderer::UiVertex;

use super::theme::{
    ASCII_GLYPHS, ATLAS_HEIGHT, ATLAS_WIDTH, CELL, COLUMNS, GLYPH_ADVANCE, MAX_VERTICES,
    POLISH_GLYPHS,
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct DrawContext {
    pub(super) width: f32,
    pub(super) height: f32,
}

impl DrawContext {
    pub(super) fn new(width: f32, height: f32) -> Self {
        Self { width, height }
    }
}

pub(super) struct TextDraw<'a> {
    pub(super) x: f32,
    pub(super) y: f32,
    pub(super) text: &'a str,
    pub(super) color: [f32; 3],
    pub(super) max_chars: usize,
    pub(super) scale: f32,
}

pub(super) struct QuadDraw {
    pub(super) x: f32,
    pub(super) y: f32,
    pub(super) width: f32,
    pub(super) height: f32,
    pub(super) color: [f32; 3],
    pub(super) uv_min: [f32; 2],
    pub(super) uv_max: [f32; 2],
}

impl QuadDraw {
    pub(super) fn solid(x: f32, y: f32, width: f32, height: f32, color: [f32; 3]) -> Self {
        let uv = super::theme::white_uv();
        Self {
            x,
            y,
            width,
            height,
            color,
            uv_min: uv,
            uv_max: uv,
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn append_text(vertices: &mut Vec<UiVertex>, context: DrawContext, draw: TextDraw<'_>) {
    for (column, character) in draw.text.chars().take(draw.max_chars).enumerate() {
        if vertices.len() + 6 > MAX_VERTICES {
            return;
        }
        let code = glyph_index(character);
        let cell_x = (code % COLUMNS) * CELL;
        let cell_y = (code / COLUMNS) * CELL;
        let uv_min = [
            (cell_x as f32 + 0.5) / ATLAS_WIDTH as f32,
            (cell_y as f32 + 0.5) / ATLAS_HEIGHT as f32,
        ];
        let uv_max = [
            (cell_x as f32 + CELL as f32 - 0.5) / ATLAS_WIDTH as f32,
            (cell_y as f32 + CELL as f32 - 0.5) / ATLAS_HEIGHT as f32,
        ];
        let left = draw.x + column as f32 * GLYPH_ADVANCE * draw.scale;
        append_quad(
            vertices,
            context,
            QuadDraw {
                x: left,
                y: draw.y,
                width: CELL as f32 * draw.scale,
                height: CELL as f32 * draw.scale,
                color: draw.color,
                uv_min,
                uv_max,
            },
        );
    }
}

fn glyph_index(character: char) -> usize {
    if character.is_ascii() && (character as usize) < ASCII_GLYPHS {
        character as usize
    } else {
        POLISH_GLYPHS
            .iter()
            .position(|&glyph| glyph == character)
            .map_or('?' as usize, |index| ASCII_GLYPHS + index)
    }
}

pub(super) fn append_quad(vertices: &mut Vec<UiVertex>, context: DrawContext, draw: QuadDraw) {
    if vertices.len() + 6 > MAX_VERTICES {
        return;
    }
    let top_left = screen_position(draw.x, draw.y, context);
    let top_right = screen_position(draw.x + draw.width, draw.y, context);
    let bottom_left = screen_position(draw.x, draw.y + draw.height, context);
    let bottom_right = screen_position(draw.x + draw.width, draw.y + draw.height, context);
    let make = |position, uv| UiVertex {
        position,
        uv,
        color: draw.color,
    };
    vertices.extend_from_slice(&[
        make(top_left, [draw.uv_min[0], draw.uv_min[1]]),
        make(bottom_left, [draw.uv_min[0], draw.uv_max[1]]),
        make(bottom_right, [draw.uv_max[0], draw.uv_max[1]]),
        make(top_left, [draw.uv_min[0], draw.uv_min[1]]),
        make(bottom_right, [draw.uv_max[0], draw.uv_max[1]]),
        make(top_right, [draw.uv_max[0], draw.uv_min[1]]),
    ]);
}

fn screen_position(x: f32, y: f32, context: DrawContext) -> [f32; 2] {
    [
        x / context.width * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - y / context.height * 2.0,
    ]
}

use super::text::{self, DrawContext, QuadDraw, TextDraw, UiVertex};

// overview_zoom is the camera distance in planet radii: smaller means closer.
pub(crate) const MIN_ZOOM: f32 = 1.02;
pub(crate) const MAX_ZOOM: f32 = 8.0;

fn geometry(width: f32, height: f32) -> (f32, f32, f32) {
    let length = (height * 0.45).clamp(100.0, 320.0);
    (width - 38.0, (height - length) * 0.5, length)
}

fn fraction(zoom: f32) -> f32 {
    (MAX_ZOOM / zoom.clamp(MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM)).ln() / (MAX_ZOOM / MIN_ZOOM).ln()
}

pub(crate) fn slider_value_at_y(height: u32, y: f64) -> f32 {
    let (_, top, length) = geometry(0.0, height as f32);
    let fraction = ((top + length - y as f32) / length).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    MAX_ZOOM * (MIN_ZOOM / MAX_ZOOM).powf(fraction)
}

pub(crate) fn slider_hit(width: u32, height: u32, x: f64, y: f64) -> bool {
    if width < 120 || height < 180 {
        return false;
    }
    let (center, top, length) = geometry(width as f32, height as f32);
    (x as f32 - center).abs() <= 22.0 && (top - 18.0..=top + length + 18.0).contains(&(y as f32))
}

pub(super) fn draw(vertices: &mut Vec<UiVertex>, context: DrawContext, zoom: f32) {
    let (center, top, length) = geometry(context.width, context.height);
    text::append_quad(
        vertices,
        context,
        QuadDraw::solid(
            center - 19.0,
            top - 38.0,
            38.0,
            length + 76.0,
            [0.025, 0.035, 0.05],
        ),
    );
    text::append_quad(
        vertices,
        context,
        QuadDraw::solid(center - 2.0, top, 4.0, length, [0.35, 0.43, 0.49]),
    );
    let thumb_y = top + length * (1.0 - fraction(zoom));
    text::append_quad(
        vertices,
        context,
        QuadDraw::solid(center - 12.0, thumb_y - 5.0, 24.0, 10.0, [0.92, 0.95, 0.98]),
    );
    let magnification = (1.08 - 1.0) / (zoom - 1.0);
    let label = format!("{magnification:.2}x");
    text::append_text(
        vertices,
        context,
        TextDraw {
            x: center - 18.0,
            y: top + length + 16.0,
            text: &label,
            color: [0.92, 0.95, 0.98],
            max_chars: 6,
            scale: 0.75,
        },
    );
}

impl LocalDemoEnvironment {
    pub(crate) fn new() -> Option<Self> {
        let utc_ms = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .ok()?
            .as_millis();
        let utc_ms = i64::try_from(utc_ms).ok()?;
        let world_time = WorldTimeMs::new(utc_ms).ok()?;
        let anchor = ClockAnchor::initial(
            ClockMode::RealTime,
            world_time,
            MonotonicMs::new(0),
            TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
            OfflinePolicy::Pause,
        )
        .ok()?;
        Some(Self {
            anchor,
            started_at: Instant::now(),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn frame(
        &self,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        context: Option<minimium_protocol::WorldContext>,
    ) -> EnvironmentFrameInput {
        let elapsed_ms = self.started_at.elapsed().as_millis();
        let monotonic_ms = match u64::try_from(elapsed_ms) {
            Ok(value) => MonotonicMs::new(value),
            Err(_) => return EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable(),
        };
        let world_time = match evaluate_clock(self.anchor, monotonic_ms) {
            Ok(value) => value.get(),
            Err(_) => return EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable(),
        };
        let profile = match manifest.topology() {
            WorldTopology::Dungeon => EnvironmentProfile::Interior,
            WorldTopology::Planet if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1) => {
                EnvironmentProfile::Earth
            }
            WorldTopology::Planet => EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike,
        };
        let identity = minimium_assets::embedded_sky_catalog_identity();
        if minimium_assets::embedded_sky_catalog().is_err()
            || identity.catalogue_id != CatalogueId::CURRENT.get()
        {
            return EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
        }
        let descriptor = EnvironmentDescriptor::new(
            self.anchor.clock_id(),
            profile,
            AstronomyModelRevision::CURRENT,
            CatalogueId::CURRENT,
            CatalogueSha256::new(identity.sha256),
        );
        EnvironmentFrameInput {
            estimated_world_utc_ms: Some(world_time),
            render_world_utc_ms: Some(world_time),
            descriptor: Some(descriptor),
            context,
            revision: Some(self.anchor.revision().get()),
            rate_ppm: Some(self.anchor.rate_ppm().get()),
            quality: SynchronizationQuality::LocalDemo,
            clock_diagnostics: Some(ClockDiagnostics {
                source: ClockSource::Demo,
                clock_id: Some(self.anchor.clock_id()),
                mode: Some(self.anchor.mode()),
                offline_policy: Some(self.anchor.offline_policy()),
                sample_age_real_ms: None,
                clock_offset_ms: None,
                probe_rtt_ms: None,
                samples_accepted: Some(0),
                samples_rejected: Some(0),
            }),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot {

impl SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot {
    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            version: SKY_DIAGNOSTICS_VERSION,
            fields: Vec::with_capacity(64),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn push(&mut self, key: &'static str, value: impl ToString) {
        self.fields.push((key, value.to_string()));
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_optional<T: ToString>(&mut self, key: &'static str, value: Option<T>) {
        self.push(
            key,
            value.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| value.to_string()),
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn lines(self) -> impl Iterator<Item = String> {
        let mut lines = Vec::with_capacity(self.fields.len().div_ceil(2) + 1);
        lines.push(format!("sky_diagnostics_version={}", self.version));
        for chunk in self.fields.chunks(2) {
            let line = chunk
                .iter()
                .map(|(key, value)| format!("{key}={value}"))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(" ");
            lines.push(line);
        }
        lines.into_iter()
    }
}

pub(crate) fn clock_status_line(
    clock: Option<ClockDiagnostics>,
    quality: SynchronizationQuality,
    revision: Option<u64>,
    utc_ms: Option<i64>,
    rate_ppm: Option<u64>,
) -> String {
    let clock = clock.unwrap_or_else(|| ClockDiagnostics::unavailable(ClockSource::Server));
    format!(
        "clock_source={} clock_id={} clock_revision={} clock_mode={} world_utc={} rate_ppm={} rate={} offline_policy={} sample_age_real_ms={} clock_offset_ms={} probe_rtt_ms={} clock_samples_accepted={} clock_samples_rejected={} clock_sync_state={}",
        clock.source.label(),
        display(clock.clock_id.map(|id| id.get())),
        display(revision),
        display(clock.mode.map(clock_mode_label)),
        utc_ms.map(format_utc_millis).unwrap_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned()),
        display(rate_ppm),
        rate_ppm.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |ppm| format!("{:.6}x", ppm as f64 / 1_000_000.0)),
        display(clock.offline_policy.map(offline_policy_label)),
        display(clock.sample_age_real_ms),
        clock.clock_offset_ms.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| format!("{value:.3}")),
        display(clock.probe_rtt_ms),
        display(clock.samples_accepted),
        display(clock.samples_rejected),
        quality.label(),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn format_utc_millis(timestamp_ms: i64) -> String {
    let seconds = timestamp_ms.div_euclid(1_000);
    let millis = timestamp_ms.rem_euclid(1_000);
    let days = seconds.div_euclid(86_400);
    let day_seconds = seconds.rem_euclid(86_400);
    let shifted = days + 719_468;
    let era = shifted.div_euclid(146_097);
    let day_of_era = shifted - era * 146_097;
    let year_of_era =
        (day_of_era - day_of_era / 1_460 + day_of_era / 36_524 - day_of_era / 146_096) / 365;
    let mut year = year_of_era + era * 400;
    let day_of_year = day_of_era - (365 * year_of_era + year_of_era / 4 - year_of_era / 100);
    let month_prime = (5 * day_of_year + 2) / 153;
    let day = day_of_year - (153 * month_prime + 2) / 5 + 1;
    let month = month_prime + if month_prime < 10 { 3 } else { -9 };
    year += i64::from(month <= 2);
    let hour = day_seconds / 3_600;
    let minute = day_seconds % 3_600 / 60;
    let second = day_seconds % 60;
    format!("{year:04}-{month:02}-{day:02}T{hour:02}:{minute:02}:{second:02}.{millis:03}Z")
}

fn display<T: ToString>(value: Option<T>) -> String {
    value.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| value.to_string())
}

fn clock_mode_label(mode: ClockMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        ClockMode::RealTime => "real_time",
        ClockMode::TimeScale => "time_scale",
    }
}

fn offline_policy_label(policy: OfflinePolicy) -> &'static str {
    match policy {
        OfflinePolicy::Pause => "pause",
        OfflinePolicy::Advance => "advance",
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/environment/lakes.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="83" bytes="3039" original_lines="83" original_bytes="3039" minified="false" sha256="b69dc8271fc2f4fb4dc5a8514a4a03eafaa8f3b6588885004e4382ffe4b31eb2">>>
//! Shared offline Natural Earth polygons, used by weather and the globe.
use std::sync::OnceLock;

struct Polygon {
    bounds: [f64; 4],
    rings: Vec<Vec<[f64; 2]>>,
}

struct Lakes {
    polygons: Vec<Polygon>,
    cells: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
}

fn cell(lat: f64, lon: f64) -> usize {
    let x = ((lon + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0).floor() as usize).min(359);
    let y = ((lat + 90.0).floor() as usize).min(179);
    y * 360 + x
}

impl Lakes {
    fn load() -> Self {
        let bytes = include_bytes!("../../../../assets/earth/lakes.bin");
        assert_eq!(&bytes[..8], b"MMLAKE01");
        let mut cursor = 8;
        let mut read = || {
            let value = i32::from_le_bytes(bytes[cursor..cursor + 4].try_into().unwrap());
            cursor += 4;
            value
        };
        let mut polygons = Vec::new();
        let mut cells = vec![Vec::new(); 360 * 180];
        for _ in 0..read() {
            let mut rings = Vec::new();
            let mut bounds = [180.0_f64, 90.0_f64, -180.0_f64, -90.0_f64];
            for _ in 0..read() {
                let mut ring = Vec::new();
                for _ in 0..read() {
                    let p = [f64::from(read()) / 100000.0, f64::from(read()) / 100000.0];
                    bounds[0] = bounds[0].min(p[0]);
                    bounds[1] = bounds[1].min(p[1]);
                    bounds[2] = bounds[2].max(p[0]);
                    bounds[3] = bounds[3].max(p[1]);
                    ring.push(p);
                }
                rings.push(ring);
            }
            let id = polygons.len();
            for lat in bounds[1].floor() as i32..=bounds[3].floor() as i32 {
                for lon in bounds[0].floor() as i32..=bounds[2].floor() as i32 {
                    cells[cell(f64::from(lat), f64::from(lon))].push(id);
                }
            }
            polygons.push(Polygon { bounds, rings });
        }
        Self { polygons, cells }
    }
}

/// Degrees, geodetic coordinates. Does not infer lakes from below-sea-level terrain.
pub(crate) fn contains(latitude: f64, longitude: f64) -> bool {
    static LAKES: OnceLock<Lakes> = OnceLock::new();
    let lakes = LAKES.get_or_init(Lakes::load);
    let lon = (longitude + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0;
    lakes.cells[cell(latitude, lon)].iter().any(|id| {
        let polygon = &lakes.polygons[*id];
        let [west, south, east, north] = polygon.bounds;
        if lon < west || lon > east || latitude < south || latitude > north {
            return false;
        }
        let mut inside = false;
        for ring in &polygon.rings {
            for edge in ring.windows(2) {
                let [a, b] = [edge[0], edge[1]];
                if (a[1] > latitude) != (b[1] > latitude)
                    && lon < (b[0] - a[0]) * (latitude - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]) + a[0]
                {
                    inside = !inside;
                }
            }
        }
        inside
    })
}

use messages::ClientText as Text;
pub(crate) const SAMPLE_MAP: &str = minimium_game_sample::SAMPLE_MAP;
use std::{
    io::{self, BufRead},
    sync::mpsc,
    thread,
};

const MAX_CONSOLE_LINE_BYTES: usize = 512;

fn queue_console_input(sender: &mpsc::SyncSender<String>, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    let line = String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).into_owned();
    match sender.try_send(line) {
        Ok(()) => true,
        Err(mpsc::TrySendError::Full(_)) => {
            eprintln!("{}", Text::ConsoleInputQueueFull);
            true
        }
        Err(mpsc::TrySendError::Disconnected(_)) => false,
    }
}

fn spawn_console_input_reader(sender: mpsc::SyncSender<String>) {
    thread::spawn(move || {
        let stdin = io::stdin();
        let mut stdin = stdin.lock();
        let mut line = Vec::with_capacity(MAX_CONSOLE_LINE_BYTES);
        let mut overlong = false;

        loop {
            let mut consumed = 0;
            let mut complete = false;
            let mut eof = false;
            {
                let available = match stdin.fill_buf() {
                    Ok(available) => available,
                    Err(error) => {
                        eprintln!("{}", Text::ConsoleInputReadFailed(error.to_string()));
                        break;
                    }
                };
                if available.is_empty() {
                    eof = true;
                } else {
                    let newline = available.iter().position(|byte| *byte == b'\n');
                    consumed = newline.map_or(available.len(), |index| index + 1);
                    let content_bytes = newline.unwrap_or(consumed);
                    if !overlong {
                        if line.len().saturating_add(content_bytes) <= MAX_CONSOLE_LINE_BYTES {
                            line.extend_from_slice(&available[..content_bytes]);
                        } else {
                            overlong = true;
                            line.clear();
                        }
                    }
                    complete = newline.is_some();
                }
            }

            if eof {
                break;
            }
            stdin.consume(consumed);
            if complete {
                if overlong {
                    eprintln!(
                        "{}",
                        Text::ConsoleInputTooLong {
                            max_bytes: MAX_CONSOLE_LINE_BYTES,
                        }
                    );
                } else {
                    if line.last() == Some(&b'\r') {
                        line.pop();
                    }
                    if !queue_console_input(&sender, &line) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                line.clear();
                overlong = false;
            }
        }

        if overlong {
            eprintln!(
                "{}",
                Text::ConsoleInputTooLong {
                    max_bytes: MAX_CONSOLE_LINE_BYTES,
                }
            );
        } else if !line.is_empty() {
            if line.last() == Some(&b'\r') {
                line.pop();
            }
            let _ = queue_console_input(&sender, &line);
        }
    });
}

fn main() {
    let result = (|| {
        let options = options::ClientOptions::parse(std::env::args().skip(1))?;
        if options.help {
            println!("{}", Text::CommandLineHelp);
            return Ok(());
        }
        client_commands::initialize_registry();
        if options.console {
            terminal_client::run(options)
        } else {
            #[cfg(feature = "desktop")]
            {
                renderer::run(options)
            }
            #[cfg(not(feature = "desktop"))]
            {
                Err("desktop support was not compiled; use --console".into())
            }
        }
    })();
    if let Err(error) = result {
        eprintln!("{}", Text::ClientError(error.to_string()));
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

/// Display-safe categories for session queue failures.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum QueueProblem {
    Disconnected,
    AwaitingWelcome,
    IdentifyReserved,
    StaleWorldContext,
    BufferFull,
    Protocol(ProtocolError),
}

impl From<QueueError> for QueueProblem {
    fn from(error: QueueError) -> Self {
        match error {
            QueueError::Disconnected => Self::Disconnected,
            QueueError::AwaitingWelcome => Self::AwaitingWelcome,
            QueueError::IdentifyReserved => Self::IdentifyReserved,
            QueueError::StaleWorldContext => Self::StaleWorldContext,
            QueueError::BufferFull => Self::BufferFull,
            QueueError::Protocol(error) => Self::Protocol(error),
        }
    }
}

impl From<DisconnectReason> for ClientText {
    fn from(reason: DisconnectReason) -> Self {
        match reason {
            DisconnectReason::WelcomeTimeout => Self::WelcomeTimeout,
            DisconnectReason::HeartbeatTimeout => Self::HeartbeatTimeout,
            DisconnectReason::Rejected(code) => Self::Rejected { code },
            DisconnectReason::MapMismatch { expected, actual } => {
                Self::MapMismatch { expected, actual }
            }
            DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch => Self::ConnectionLost(
                "server environment model or star catalogue is incompatible".to_owned(),
            ),
            DisconnectReason::PeerClosed => Self::PeerDisconnected,
            DisconnectReason::ServerClosed => Self::ServerClosed,
            DisconnectReason::EarthPackage(error) | DisconnectReason::Materials(error) => {
                Self::ConnectionLost(error)
            }
            other => Self::ConnectionLost(format!("{other:?}")),
        }
    }
}

fn server_error_text(code: ServerErrorCode) -> &'static str {
    match code {
        ServerErrorCode::Protocol => "server rejected the protocol handshake",
        ServerErrorCode::Busy => "server is busy; this can include a duplicate active profile",
        ServerErrorCode::ServerFull => "server is full",
        ServerErrorCode::RateLimit => "request was rate-limited",
        _ => "server rejected the request",
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for QueueProblem {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        f.write_str(match self {
            Self::Disconnected => "not connected",
            Self::AwaitingWelcome => "waiting for server welcome",
            Self::IdentifyReserved => "identify is reserved for connection setup",
            Self::StaleWorldContext => "world changed; reconnect or retry the command",
            Self::BufferFull => "outgoing queue is full",
            Self::Protocol(error) => return write!(f, "message could not be encoded: {error}"),
        })
    }
}

pub(crate) use minimium_client_runtime::ThreadLane;
use minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality;
use std::path::PathBuf;

const DEFAULT_LOCAL_DATA_DIR: &str = ".minimium-local";

/// Command-line options shared by the desktop and text clients.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ClientOptions {
    pub connect: Option<String>,
    pub map_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub world_definition_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub demo: bool,
    pub require_earth: bool,
    pub console: bool,
    pub windowed: bool,
    pub help: bool,
    pub threads: ThreadLane,
    pub sky_quality: SkyQuality,
    pub profile_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub server_data_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
}

impl ClientOptions {
    /// Parse client arguments, excluding the executable name.
    pub fn parse(args: impl IntoIterator<Item = String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let mut options = Self {
            connect: None,
            map_path: None,
            world_definition_path: None,
            demo: false,
            require_earth: false,
            console: !cfg!(feature = "desktop"),
            windowed: false,
            help: false,
            threads: ThreadLane::One,
            sky_quality: SkyQuality::Standard,
            profile_dir: None,
            server_data_dir: None,
        };
        let mut seen_connect = false;
        let mut seen_map = false;
        let mut seen_world_definition = false;
        let mut seen_demo = false;
        let mut seen_require_earth = false;
        let mut seen_console = false;
        let mut seen_windowed = false;
        let mut seen_help = false;
        let mut seen_threads = false;
        let mut seen_sky_quality = false;
        let mut seen_profile_dir = false;
        let mut seen_server_data_dir = false;
        let mut args = args.into_iter().peekable();

        while let Some(arg) = args.next() {
            match arg.as_str() {
                "--connect" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_connect, "--connect")?;
                    options.connect = Some(required_value(&mut args, "--connect")?);
                }
                "--map" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_map, "--map")?;
                    options.map_path = Some(PathBuf::from(required_value(&mut args, "--map")?));
                }
                "--world-definition" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_world_definition, "--world-definition")?;
                    options.world_definition_path = Some(PathBuf::from(required_value(
                        &mut args,
                        "--world-definition",
                    )?));
                }
                "--profile-dir" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_profile_dir, "--profile-dir")?;
                    options.profile_dir =
                        Some(PathBuf::from(required_value(&mut args, "--profile-dir")?));
                }
                "--server-data-dir" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_server_data_dir, "--server-data-dir")?;
                    options.server_data_dir = Some(PathBuf::from(required_value(
                        &mut args,
                        "--server-data-dir",
                    )?));
                }
                "--threads" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_threads, "--threads")?;
                    let value = required_value(&mut args, "--threads")?;
                    options.threads = ThreadLane::parse(&value)?;
                }
                "--sky-quality" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_sky_quality, "--sky-quality")?;
                    let value = required_value(&mut args, "--sky-quality")?;
                    options.sky_quality = SkyQuality::parse(&value)
                        .map_err(|_| "--sky-quality must be low or standard".to_owned())?;
                }
                "--demo" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_demo, "--demo")?;
                    options.demo = true;
                }
                "--require-earth" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_require_earth, "--require-earth")?;
                    options.require_earth = true;
                }
                "--windowed" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_windowed, "--windowed")?;
                    options.windowed = true;
                }
                "--console" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_console, "--console")?;
                    options.console = true;
                }
                "--help" | "-h" => {
                    reject_duplicate(&mut seen_help, "--help")?;
                    options.help = true;
                }
                _ => return Err(format!("unknown client option `{arg}` (try --help)")),
            }
        }

        if options.demo && options.connect.is_some() {
            return Err("--demo cannot be used with --connect".to_owned());
        }
        if options.demo && options.console {
            return Err("--demo cannot be used with --console".to_owned());
        }
        if options.require_earth && options.demo {
            return Err("--require-earth cannot be used with --demo".to_owned());
        }
        if options.require_earth && options.console {
            return Err("--require-earth requires the desktop client".to_owned());
        }
        if options.map_path.is_some() && options.world_definition_path.is_some() {
            return Err("--map and --world-definition cannot be used together".to_owned());
        }

        Ok(options)
    }

    /// Resolve independent profile and server storage directories.
    pub fn paths(&self, map_fingerprint: u64) -> (PathBuf, PathBuf) {
        let default_dir = if self.map_path.is_some() || self.world_definition_path.is_some() {
            PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_LOCAL_DATA_DIR).join(format!("map-{map_fingerprint:016x}"))
        } else {
            PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_LOCAL_DATA_DIR)
        };
        (
            self.profile_dir
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| default_dir.clone()),
            self.server_data_dir.clone().unwrap_or(default_dir),
        )
    }
}

fn required_value(args: &mut impl Iterator<Item = String>, option: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    match args.next() {
        Some(value) if !value.starts_with("--") && value != "-h" => Ok(value),
        _ => Err(format!("{option} requires a value")),
    }
}

fn reject_duplicate(seen: &mut bool, option: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    if *seen {
        Err(format!("{option} may only be specified once"))
    } else {
        *seen = true;
        Ok(())
    }
}

    manifest: minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,

        .map_err(|error| std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))

fn legacy_manifest(id: u128, map: &WorldMap) -> minimium_world::world::WorldManifest {
    use minimium_world::world::{
        GenerationRevision, GenerationSpec, GeneratorDigest, WorldContentRevision,
        WorldDefinitionId, WorldManifest, WorldSeed, WorldTopology,
    };
    let generation = GenerationSpec::new(
        WorldSeed::new(0),
        GenerationRevision::new(1).expect("legacy generator revision is nonzero"),
        1,
    )
    .expect("legacy position quantum is nonzero");
    WorldManifest::new(
        WorldDefinitionId::new(id).expect("legacy definition ID is nonzero"),
        WorldTopology::Dungeon,
        generation,
        WorldContentRevision::new(1).expect("legacy content revision is nonzero"),
        GeneratorDigest::legacy_map_fingerprint(map.fingerprint()),
    )
}

struct GpuResources {

    frame_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
