<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/camera.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="393" bytes="16288" original_lines="393" original_bytes="16288" minified="false" sha256="966d2a3b830f6e97dbbc8b74fba815a146042549fd709bfd1d039dcb8a91c6b3">>>
use super::*;
use crate::messages::ClientText as Text;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn update(&mut self) -> environment::PreparedEnvironmentFrame {
        if self.overview_open && self.overview_instance != Some(self.game.current_instance) {
            self.overview_open = false;
            self.gpu.overview_active = false;
        }
        self.gpu.world_geometry.begin_frame();
        let now = Instant::now();
        let dt = now
            .duration_since(self.metrics.last_frame)
            .as_secs_f32()
            .min(minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS);
        self.metrics.last_frame = now;
        let direction = if (self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready || self.connection.movement.fly)
            && !self.overview_open
        {
            self.input.movement(
                self.ui.console.open,
                self.game.gameplay.prediction.character,
                self.is_earth_world(),
            )
        } else {
            [0.0; 2]
        };
        self.game.accumulate_prediction_time(dt);
        let manifest = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .copied();
        while let Some(predicted) = self.game.predict_next(
            direction,
            if self.ui.console.open || self.overview_open {
                0.0
            } else {
                u8::from(self.input.keys.contains(&KeyCode::Space)) as f32
                    - u8::from(
                        self.input.keys.contains(&KeyCode::ControlLeft)
                            || self.input.keys.contains(&KeyCode::ControlRight),
                    ) as f32
            },
            self.connection.movement,
            self.input.jump_pending,
            (self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready || self.connection.movement.fly)
                && !self.overview_open,
            manifest,
            self.connection
                .session()
                .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
        ) {
            let mut input = predicted.input;
            self.input.jump_pending = false;
            if !self.refresh_active_sector_scene() && !self.connection.movement.fly {
                self.game.gameplay.prediction.character = predicted.previous_state;
                self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm = predicted.previous_mm;
                input = CharacterInput::default();
            }
            self.input.input_keepalive += minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS;
            let moving = input.direction != [0.0, 0.0];
            let input_changed = input.direction != self.input.last_sent_direction;
            if self
                .connection
                .session()
                .is_some_and(|session| session.state() == SessionState::Connected)
                && (self.input.input_keepalive
                    >= 2.0 * minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS
                    || input.jump
                    || input_changed
                    || (moving
                        && self.input.input_keepalive
                            >= 2.0 * minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS))
            {
                if let Some(session) = self.connection.session_mut() {
                    let result = session.queue(&ClientMessage::Motion(input));
                    if let Err(error) = result {
                        self.fail_connection(Text::CouldNotQueueMovement(error.into()).to_string());
                    } else {
                        self.input.last_sent_direction = input.direction;
                        self.input.input_keepalive = 0.0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let origin = if self.overview_open {
            self.gpu.render_origin
        } else if self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .is_some_and(|manifest| manifest.planet().is_some())
        {
            let position = self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position;
            if position
                .iter()
                .zip(self.gpu.render_origin)
                .any(|(p, o)| (p - o).abs() > 4096.0)
            {
                position.map(|coordinate| (coordinate / 4096.0).round() * 4096.0)
            } else {
                self.gpu.render_origin
            }
        } else {
            [0.0; 3]
        };
        if self.gpu.set_render_origin(origin) {
            self.last_render_position = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
            self.game.gameplay.remote_geometry_dirty = true;
        }
        self.poll_connector();
        self.poll_session();
        if self.refresh_active_sector_scene()
            && self.teleport_loading
            && self.last_render_position.iter().all(|p| p.is_finite())
        {
            self.teleport_loading = false;
            self.gpu.scene_visible = true;
            self.connection_status = "Earth: przeniesiono".into();
        }
        self.advance_pending_transitions();
        self.update_environment_frame();
        self.update_remote_player_rendering(Instant::now());

        let (view, far) = if self.overview_open {
            let (view, far) = self.overview_camera();
            (
                view * glam::Mat4::from_translation(glam::Vec3::from_array(self.gpu.render_origin)),
                far,
            )
        } else {
            let direction = camera_direction(
                self.game.gameplay.prediction.character,
                self.input.yaw,
                self.input.pitch,
            )
            .normalize();
            let up = glam::Vec3::from_array(
                character_frame(
                    self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.gravity,
                    self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position,
                )
                .0,
            );
            let camera_position =
                glam::Vec3::from_array(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position) + up * 1.7;
            let far = if self
                .game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .is_some_and(|manifest| manifest.topology() == WorldTopology::Planet)
            {
                let radius = self
                    .game
                    .world_manifests
                    .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                    .map(|manifest| {
                        minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(*manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0
                    })
                    .unwrap_or(10_000.0);
                (camera_position.length_squared() - radius * radius)
                    .max(0.0)
                    .sqrt()
                    .max(220.0)
                    + 10.0
            } else {
                200.0
            };
            let local_camera = if let Some(position_mm) = self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm
            {
                glam::Vec3::from_array(std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                    (position_mm.0[axis] as f64 / 1000.0 - f64::from(self.gpu.render_origin[axis]))
                        as f32
                })) + up * 1.7
            } else {
                camera_position - glam::Vec3::from_array(self.gpu.render_origin)
            };
            (glam::Mat4::look_to_rh(local_camera, direction, up), far)
        };
        let camera_eye_local = view.inverse().transform_point3(glam::Vec3::ZERO);
        let render_origin = glam::Vec3::from_array(self.gpu.render_origin);
        let camera_eye_world = (camera_eye_local + render_origin).as_dvec3().to_array();
        // The overview camera is millions of metres from the globe. A 5 cm
        // near plane rounds its depth to 1.0 in f32 and hides the surface.
        let near = if self.overview_open
            && self
                .game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .is_some_and(|manifest| manifest.topology() == WorldTopology::Planet)
        {
            let radius = self
                .game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .map(|manifest| {
                    minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(*manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0
                })
                .unwrap_or(10_000.0);
            radius * ((self.overview_zoom - 1.0) * 0.08).max(0.001)
        } else {
            let terrain_near = self.gpu.world_geometry.surface_near(
                self.game.current_instance,
                &self.gpu.active_sector_keys,
                camera_eye_world,
            );
            self.game
                .gameplay
                .reconciliation
                .tracks()
                .iter()
                .flatten()
                .map(|track| {
                    let distance = (0..3)
                        .map(|axis| {
                            (camera_eye_world[axis]
                                - track.displayed_position_mm[axis] as f64 / 1000.0)
                                .powi(2)
                        })
                        .sum::<f64>()
                        .sqrt();
                    ((distance - 2.0).max(0.0) * 0.01).max(0.05) as f32
                })
                .fold(terrain_near, f32::min)
        };
        let view = if self.is_earth_world() {
            glam::Mat4::from_scale(glam::Vec3::new(-1.0, 1.0, 1.0)) * view
        } else {
            view
        };
        let projection = glam::Mat4::perspective_rh(
            self.fov_degrees.to_radians(),
            self.gpu.size.width as f32 / self.gpu.size.height as f32,
            near,
            far,
        );
        let game_planet_radius_m = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .filter(|manifest| manifest.topology() == WorldTopology::Planet)
            .map(|manifest| {
                manifest
                    .planet()
                    .map(|definition| definition.radius_mm)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(*manifest).radius_mm())
                    as f64
                    / 1000.0
            })
            .unwrap_or(0.0);
        let render_origin_m = self.gpu.render_origin.map(f64::from);
        let render_view = RenderViewFrame::from_camera(RenderViewInput {
            view,
            projection,
            viewport: [self.gpu.size.width, self.gpu.size.height],
            render_origin_m,
            camera_eye_world_m: camera_eye_world,
            game_planet_radius_m,
            kind: if self.overview_open {
                environment::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview
            } else {
                environment::EnvironmentViewKind::Surface
            },
            srgb_surface: matches!(
                self.gpu.config.format,
                wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb | wgpu::TextureFormat::Bgra8UnormSrgb
            ),
        });
        let prepared_environment = match render_view {
            Some(view) => self.update_render_environment(view),
            None => {
                self.render_environment_frame =
                    EnvironmentFrame::unavailable(RenderViewFrame::default());
                environment::PreparedEnvironmentFrame::new(
                    self.render_environment_frame.clone(),
                    None,
                )
            }
        };

        self.update_weather(&prepared_environment.frame);
        let earth = prepared_environment
            .frame
            .descriptor
            .is_some_and(|descriptor| {
                descriptor.profile() == minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile::Earth
            });
        self.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.upload(
            &self.gpu.device,
            &self.gpu.queue,
            prepared_environment.frame.render_view,
            if earth {
                game_planet_radius_m
                    + self
                        .game
                        .world_manifests
                        .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                        .and_then(|m| m.planet())
                        .map_or(0.0, |p| p.sea_level_mm as f64 / 1000.0)
            } else {
                0.0
            },
            self.game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .and_then(|m| m.planet())
                .filter(|p| p.mode == 1)
                .map_or(1.0, |p| p.height_scale_permille as f64 / 1000.0),
            self.sky_quality.effective == minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality::Standard,
            self.environment_frame
                .render_world_utc_ms
                .map_or(0.0, |t| t as f64 / 1000.0),
        );

        let celestial_labels = if self.show_celestial_names {
            celestial_labels::prepare(&prepared_environment.frame, self.sky_catalogue.as_ref())
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        };
        self.ui.console.build_vertices(
            self.gpu.size.width,
            self.gpu.size.height,
            self.game.gameplay.health,
            self.input.cursor_locked && !self.ui.console.open,
            self.game
                .gameplay
                .hit_confirmation_until
                .is_some_and(|until| Instant::now() < until),
            crate::console::Overlay {
                status: self
                    .settings
                    .require_earth
                    .then_some(self.connection_status.as_str()),
                overview_zoom: self.overview_uses_zoom().then_some(self.overview_zoom),
                celestial_labels: &celestial_labels,
            },
        );
        let ui_vertices = self.ui.console.take_vertices();
        prepared_environment.with_ui_vertices(ui_vertices)
    }
}

impl InputState {
    fn movement(
        &self,
        console_open: bool,
        character: CharacterState,
        mirror_earth: bool,
    ) -> [f32; 2] {
        let (up, base_right, base_forward) = character_frame(character.gravity, character.position);
        let base_right = glam::Vec3::from_array(base_right);
        let base_forward = glam::Vec3::from_array(base_forward);
        let _up = glam::Vec3::from_array(up);
        let forward = base_forward * self.yaw.cos() + base_right * self.yaw.sin();
        let right = (base_right * self.yaw.cos() - base_forward * self.yaw.sin())
            * if mirror_earth { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
        let mut movement = glam::Vec3::ZERO;
        if !console_open {
            if self.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyW) {
                movement += forward;
            }
            if self.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyS) {
                movement -= forward;
            }
            if self.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyD) {
                movement += right;
            }
            if self.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyA) {
                movement -= right;
            }
        }
        if movement.length_squared() > 1.0 {
            movement = movement.normalize();
        }
        if matches!(character.gravity, CharacterGravity::Radial { .. }) {
            [movement.dot(base_right), movement.dot(base_forward)]
        } else {
            [movement.x, movement.z]
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn camera_direction(character: CharacterState, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) -> glam::Vec3 {
    let (up, right, forward) = character_frame(character.gravity, character.position);
    glam::Vec3::from_array(forward) * (yaw.cos() * pitch.cos())
        + glam::Vec3::from_array(right) * (yaw.sin() * pitch.cos())
        + glam::Vec3::from_array(up) * pitch.sin()
}

pub(super) fn gravity_for_manifest(manifest: WorldManifest) -> CharacterGravity {
    minimium_world::world::GravityPolicy::for_manifest(manifest).character_gravity()
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/celestial_labels.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="132" bytes="4238" original_lines="132" original_bytes="4238" minified="false" sha256="5547a49f9db55b97a05b7c879ef1ea0f6504cbadac88cf615c50a80ec27ec2d9">>>
use super::environment::{EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentFrameStatus};
use crate::console::CelestialLabel;
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3, Vec4};
use minimium_astronomy::{SKY_MOON_ID, SKY_SUN_ID};
use minimium_environment::universe::BodyKind;
use minimium_renderer::stars::StarCatalogueAdapter;

const MAX_STAR_LABELS: usize = 32;
const MAX_STAR_CANDIDATES: usize = 160;

pub(super) fn prepare(
    frame: &EnvironmentFrame,
    catalogue: Option<&StarCatalogueAdapter>,
) -> Vec<CelestialLabel> {
    if frame.status != EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut labels = Vec::with_capacity(MAX_STAR_LABELS + 8);
    let Some(sky) = frame.sky else {
        return labels;
    };
    add_label(
        &mut labels,
        frame,
        sky.sun.apparent_direction_world,
        "Sun".into(),
    );
    add_label(
        &mut labels,
        frame,
        sky.moon.body.apparent_direction_world,
        "Moon".into(),
    );
    for body in &frame.observed_bodies {
        if !body.visible || body.id == SKY_SUN_ID || body.id == SKY_MOON_ID {
            continue;
        }
        let name = match body.id.get() {
            1001 => "Demo star".to_owned(),
            1002 => "Demo planet".to_owned(),
            1003 => "Demo moon".to_owned(),
            id => format!("{} {id}", body_kind_name(body.kind)),
        };
        add_label(&mut labels, frame, body.direction_world, name);
    }
    let Some(catalogue) = catalogue else {
        return labels;
    };
    if frame.render_view.kind == super::environment::EnvironmentViewKind::Surface
        && frame.environment_uniform.sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility[3] < 0.08
    {
        return labels;
    }
    let eqj_to_world = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&frame.environment_uniform.eqj_to_world);
    let mut stars_added = 0;
    for (record, name) in catalogue
        .records()
        .iter()
        .zip(catalogue.labels())
        .take(MAX_STAR_CANDIDATES)
    {
        if stars_added == MAX_STAR_LABELS {
            break;
        }
        let direction = Vec3::from_array(record.position_eqj_pc.map(|v| v as f32));
        if !direction.is_finite() || direction.length_squared() < 1.0e-20 {
            continue;
        }
        let world = eqj_to_world
            .transform_vector3(direction.normalize())
            .normalize();
        if add_label(
            &mut labels,
            frame,
            world.as_dvec3().to_array(),
            (*name).to_owned(),
        ) {
            stars_added += 1;
        }
    }
    labels
}

fn body_kind_name(kind: BodyKind) -> &'static str {
    match kind {
        BodyKind::Star => "Star",
        BodyKind::Planet => "Planet",
        BodyKind::Moon => "Moon",
        BodyKind::MinorBody => "Body",
    }
}

fn add_label(
    labels: &mut Vec<CelestialLabel>,
    frame: &EnvironmentFrame,
    direction: [f64; 3],
    text: String,
) -> bool {
    let world = Vec3::from_array(direction.map(|v| v as f32));
    if !world.is_finite() || world.length_squared() < 1.0e-20 {
        return false;
    }
    let world = world.normalize();
    let horizon = frame.environment_uniform.observer_up_horizon_cos;
    if frame.render_view.kind == super::environment::EnvironmentViewKind::Surface
        && world.dot(Vec3::from_array([horizon[0], horizon[1], horizon[2]])) <= horizon[3] + 0.01
    {
        return false;
    }
    let matrix = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&frame.render_view.sky_view_projection);
    let clip = matrix * Vec4::new(world.x, world.y, world.z, 0.0);
    if !clip.is_finite() || clip.w <= 0.0 {
        return false;
    }
    let ndc = clip.truncate() / clip.w;
    if ndc.x.abs() >= 0.95 || ndc.y.abs() >= 0.91 {
        return false;
    }
    let width = frame.render_view.viewport[0] as f32;
    let height = frame.render_view.viewport[1] as f32;
    let x = (ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * width + 9.0;
    let y = (0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5) * height - 12.0;
    let text_width = text.len().min(30) as f32 * 8.0;
    if labels.iter().any(|label| {
        (x - label.x).abs() < text_width.max(label.text.len() as f32 * 8.0)
            && (y - label.y).abs() < 18.0
    }) {
        return false;
    }
    labels.push(CelestialLabel { x, y, text });
    true
}

/// Client-owned simulation and logical world/session state, independent of wgpu.
pub(super) struct ClientGameState {

    pub(super) current_instance: WorldInstanceId,
    pub(super) world_manifests: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest>,

impl ClientGameState {
    pub(super) fn view(&self) -> minimium_client_runtime::ClientView<'_> {

            self.current_instance,
            self.world_manifests.get(&self.current_instance).copied(),
            self.gameplay.prediction.character,
            self.gameplay.prediction.position_mm,
            self.gameplay.health,
            &self.gameplay.remote_positions_mm,
            self.gameplay.sectors_ready,
        )
    }

    pub(super) fn accumulate_prediction_time(&mut self, delta_seconds: f32) {
        self.gameplay.prediction.accumulate_time(delta_seconds);
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(super) fn predict_next(
        &mut self,
        direction: [f32; 2],
        vertical: f32,
        movement: minimium_simulation::MovementSettings,
        jump_pending: bool,
        movement_enabled: bool,
        manifest: Option<WorldManifest>,
        geography: Option<std::sync::Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
    ) -> Option<PredictedStep> {
        let gameplay = &mut self.gameplay;
        gameplay.prediction.predict_next(
            &gameplay.collision_index,
            &mut gameplay.collision_query,
            direction,
            vertical,
            movement,
            jump_pending,
            movement_enabled,
            manifest,
            geography,
        )
    }
}

impl GameplayView {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(super) fn apply_snapshot(
        &mut self,
        server_time_ms: u64,
        full_snapshot: bool,
        self_position: [f32; 3],
        self_position_mm: minimium_world::world::Position3Mm,
        self_velocity: [f32; 3],
        self_grounded: bool,
        players: &minimium_protocol::RemotePlayers,
        removed_players: &minimium_protocol::RemotePlayerIds,
    ) -> bool {
        if !self.reconciliation.apply_remote_snapshot(
            server_time_ms,
            full_snapshot,
            players,
            removed_players,
        ) {
            return false;
        }
        let precise_position = self
            .prediction
            .position_mm
            .is_some()
            .then_some(self_position_mm);
        self.prediction.reconcile_server(
            self_position,
            precise_position,
            self_velocity,
            self_grounded,
        );
        self.remote_geometry_dirty = true;
        true
    }

    pub(super) fn clear_remote_players(&mut self) {
        self.reconciliation.clear();
        self.last_shot_sent_at = None;
        self.remote_vertices.clear();
        self.remote_shadow_vertices.clear();
        self.remote_geometry_dirty = false;
    }

    pub(super) fn update_remote_vertices(&mut self, now: Instant, origin: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
        let moved = self.reconciliation.interpolate_positions(
            now,
            REMOTE_INTERPOLATION_DELAY,
            &mut self.remote_positions_mm,
        );
        if !moved && !self.remote_geometry_dirty {
            return false;
        }
        self.remote_vertices.clear();
        for position_mm in &self.remote_positions_mm {
            let position: [f32; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                (position_mm[axis] as f64 / 1000.0 - f64::from(origin[axis])) as f32
            });
            cube(
                &mut self.remote_vertices,
                [position[0], position[1] + 0.85, position[2]],
                [0.6, 1.7, 0.6],
                [0.82, 0.16, 0.12],
            );
        }
        self.remote_geometry_dirty = false;
        true
    }

    pub(super) fn update_remote_shadow_vertices(
        &mut self,
        center: [f64; 3],
        origin: [f32; 3],
    ) -> bool {
        let mut shadow_vertices = Vec::with_capacity(self.reconciliation.player_count() * 36);
        for track in self.reconciliation.tracks().iter().flatten() {
            let feet = track
                .displayed_position_mm
                .map(|value| value as f64 / 1000.0);
            let shape_center = [feet[0], feet[1] + 0.85, feet[2]];
            let half = [0.3, 0.85, 0.3];
            let distance_squared = (0..3)
                .map(|axis| {
                    let delta = (center[axis] - shape_center[axis]).abs() - half[axis];
                    delta.max(0.0).powi(2)
                })
                .sum::<f64>();
            if distance_squared > 256.0_f64.powi(2) {
                continue;
            }
            let relative: [f32; 3] =
                std::array::from_fn(|axis| (feet[axis] - f64::from(origin[axis])) as f32);
            cube(
                &mut shadow_vertices,
                [relative[0], relative[1] + 0.85, relative[2]],
                [0.6, 1.7, 0.6],
                [0.82, 0.16, 0.12],
            );
        }
        let changed = bytemuck::cast_slice::<Vertex, u8>(&shadow_vertices)
            != bytemuck::cast_slice::<Vertex, u8>(&self.remote_shadow_vertices);
        if changed {
            self.remote_shadow_vertices = shadow_vertices;
        }
        changed
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/clouds/cache.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="204" bytes="7765" original_lines="204" original_bytes="7765" minified="false" sha256="a2f666c9a7285a7d3e531684b4dd2278c549765b745f9a3e334248d95222d670">>>
//! Bounded temporal mesh cache; unchanged cloud windows need no density work.
use super::{Face, MAX_FACES};
use minimium_environment::weather::{CloudSnapshot, DensityField};
use minimium_renderer::cloud_voxels::Voxels;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

const MAX_SAMPLES: usize = 8_000_000;
const MAX_CACHE_FACES: usize = MAX_FACES;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub(super) struct Morph {
    pub start: f64,
    pub step: f64,
    pub level: u8,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct MeshStats {
    pub samples: usize,
    pub bricks: usize,
    pub cached: usize,
    pub simplified: usize,
    pub levels: [usize; 7],
    pub cache_bytes: usize,
}

struct Entry {
    window: i64,
    level: u8,
    budget: usize,
    faces: Vec<Face>,
    bricks: usize,
    simplified: bool,
    render_level: u8,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct MeshCache {
    entries: HashMap<u64, Entry>,
}

pub(super) struct MeshOutput {
    pub faces: Vec<Face>,
    pub morphs: Vec<Morph>,
    pub stats: MeshStats,
}

impl MeshCache {
    pub fn build(
        &mut self,
        snapshot: &CloudSnapshot,
        detail: u8,
        cancelled: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Option<MeshOutput> {
        let live: HashSet<_> = snapshot.clouds.iter().map(|c| c.id).collect();
        self.entries.retain(|id, _| live.contains(id));
        let mut cached_faces: usize = self.entries.values().map(|e| e.faces.capacity()).sum();
        let mut result = MeshOutput {
            faces: Vec::with_capacity(MAX_FACES),
            morphs: Vec::with_capacity(snapshot.clouds.len()),
            stats: MeshStats::default(),
        };
        let priorities: Vec<_> = snapshot
            .clouds
            .iter()
            .map(|c| {
                let distance = c
                    .direction_at(snapshot.utc)
                    .dot(snapshot.observer)
                    .clamp(-1.0, 1.0)
                    .acos();
                if distance < 0.006 {
                    (6, 16)
                } else if distance < 0.018 {
                    (5, 4)
                } else {
                    (4, 1)
                }
            })
            .collect();
        let weight: usize = priorities.iter().map(|(_, w)| w).sum();
        let available = MAX_FACES - snapshot.clouds.len() * 6;
        for (index, cloud) in snapshot.clouds.iter().copied().enumerate() {
            if cancelled() {
                return None;
            }
            let (wanted, priority) = priorities[index];
            let share = 6 + available * priority / weight.max(1);
            // Stable buckets prevent a birth/death changing every mesh budget by
            // one face and invalidating the entire otherwise reusable cache.
            let budget = (1_usize << share.ilog2()).max(6);
            let mut level = wanted.min(detail).clamp(cloud.min_level, cloud.max_level);
            let allowance = MAX_SAMPLES / snapshot.clouds.len().max(1);
            let cost = |n| {
                cloud.grid(n).0.iter().product::<usize>() * if n == cloud.min_level { 8 } else { 2 }
            };
            while level > cloud.min_level && cost(level) > allowance {
                level -= 1;
            }
            let (window, start, step) = cloud.morph_window(snapshot.utc);
            let reuse = self
                .entries
                .get(&cloud.id)
                .is_some_and(|e| e.window == window && e.level == level && e.budget == budget);
            if reuse {
                result.stats.cached += 1;
            } else {
                if let Some(old) = self.entries.remove(&cloud.id) {
                    cached_faces -= old.faces.capacity();
                }
                let mut bricks = 0;
                let mut render_level = level;
                let (faces, simplified) = if cost(level) <= allowance {
                    let mut cells = Voxels::build(cloud, level, start, step);
                    result.stats.samples += cost(level);
                    bricks = cells.bricks;
                    let mut faces = minimium_renderer::cloud_mesh::build(cloud, &cells, budget);
                    let simplified = faces.is_none();
                    for stride in [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64] {
                        if faces.is_some() {
                            break;
                        }
                        cells.simplify(stride);
                        render_level = level.saturating_sub(stride.ilog2() as u8);
                        faces = minimium_renderer::cloud_mesh::build(cloud, &cells, budget);
                    }
                    if faces.as_ref().is_some_and(Vec::is_empty)
                        && cells.mean.iter().any(|v| *v > 0.0)
                    {
                        faces = None;
                        render_level = 0;
                    }
                    (
                        faces.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                            minimium_renderer::cloud_mesh::envelope(cloud, cells.mean)
                        }),
                        simplified,
                    )
                } else {
                    render_level = 0;
                    // Fixed stratified integral when even the minimum grid exceeds work budget.
                    let fields = [
                        DensityField::new(cloud, start),
                        DensityField::new(cloud, start + step),
                    ];
                    let mut mean = [0.0; 2];
                    for z in 0..4 {
                        for y in 0..4 {
                            for x in 0..4 {
                                let p = glam::DVec3::new(
                                    (x as f64 + 0.5) / 4.0 - 0.5,
                                    (y as f64 + 0.5) / 4.0,
                                    (z as f64 + 0.5) / 4.0 - 0.5,
                                ) * cloud.size_m;
                                for t in 0..2 {
                                    mean[t] += fields[t].sample(p) as f32 / 64.0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    result.stats.samples += 128;
                    (minimium_renderer::cloud_mesh::envelope(cloud, mean), true)
                };
                let faces = faces.into_boxed_slice().into_vec();
                self.entries.insert(
                    cloud.id,
                    Entry {
                        window,
                        level,
                        budget,
                        faces,
                        bricks,
                        simplified,
                        render_level,
                    },
                );
            }
            let entry = &self.entries[&cloud.id];
            result.stats.bricks += entry.bricks;
            result.stats.simplified += usize::from(entry.simplified);
            result.stats.levels[entry.render_level as usize] += 1;
            result.morphs.push(Morph {
                start,
                step,
                level: entry.render_level,
            });
            for mut face in entry.faces.iter().copied() {
                face.center[3] = index as f32;
                result.faces.push(face);
            }
            if !reuse {
                let capacity = entry.faces.capacity();
                if cached_faces + capacity <= MAX_CACHE_FACES {
                    cached_faces += capacity;
                } else {
                    self.entries.remove(&cloud.id);
                }
            }
        }
        result.stats.cache_bytes = cached_faces * std::mem::size_of::<Face>()
            + self.entries.capacity() * (std::mem::size_of::<Entry>() + 16);
        Some(result)
    }
}

//! Bounded cube meshes, worker publication and GPU transparency.

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/clouds/runtime.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="309" bytes="13622" original_lines="309" original_bytes="13622" minified="false" sha256="3597764a712645ea238286a5c0e160aa9fd9d80053bbd0a7a1d9bb71ffbf592c">>>
use super::{worker::CloudWorker, Publication, Request, Stamp};
use crate::renderer::{
    environment::{EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentViewKind},
    Renderer,
};
use glam::{DVec3, Mat4};
use minimium_environment::weather::{self, CloudDebug};
use minimium_renderer::{CloudRecord, CloudUniform};
use std::{
    sync::Arc,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

pub(in crate::renderer) struct WeatherState {
    worker: CloudWorker,
    stamp: Option<Stamp>,
    published: Option<Arc<Publication>>,
    last_request: Option<Instant>,
    sequence: u64,
    detail: u8,
    pub(in crate::renderer) debug: CloudDebug,
}

impl WeatherState {
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            worker: CloudWorker::new(),
            stamp: None,
            published: None,
            last_request: None,
            sequence: 0,
            detail: 6,
            debug: CloudDebug::Off,
        }
    }

    pub(in crate::renderer) fn set_detail(&mut self, level: u8) {
        self.detail = level;
        self.last_request = None;
        self.worker.clear();
    }
}

impl Renderer {
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn update_weather(&mut self, frame: &EnvironmentFrame) {
        // The inexpensive seasonal fallback is available even before cloud publication.
        if let (Some(manifest), Some(utc)) = (
            self.game.world_manifests.get(&self.game.current_instance),
            self.environment_frame.render_world_utc_ms,
        ) {
            let utc = utc as f64 / 1000.0;
            let seed = manifest.generation().seed().get();
            self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug[1] = seed as u32 ^ (seed >> 64) as u32;
            self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug[2] = (seed >> 32) as u32 ^ (seed >> 96) as u32;
            let direction =
                DVec3::from_array(frame.render_view.camera_eye_world_m).normalize_or_zero();
            let scenario = self
                .connection
                .session()
                .map(|s| s.climate_scenario())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let offset = scenario.offset(direction, utc);
            self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.climate = [
                minimium_environment::climate::seasonality(DVec3::Y, utc) as f32,
                offset.temperature_c as f32,
                offset.moisture as f32,
                scenario.relief_influence as f32,
            ];
        }
        let inputs = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .copied()
            .zip(self.environment_frame.context)
            .zip(self.environment_frame.revision)
            .zip(self.environment_frame.render_world_utc_ms);
        let Some((((manifest, context), clock_revision), utc)) =
            inputs.filter(|(((m, _), _), _)| {
                m.topology() == minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet
                    && self.gpu.scene_visible
                    && frame.status
                        == crate::renderer::environment::EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
            })
        else {
            self.weather.stamp = None;
            self.weather.published = None;
            self.weather.last_request = None;
            self.weather.worker.clear();
            self.gpu.cloud_gpu.count = 0;
            self.gpu.cloud_gpu.debug = false;
            self.gpu.terrain_gpu.clear_cover();
            self.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.clear_weather();
            return;
        };
        let stamp = Stamp {
            manifest,
            context,
            clock_revision,
        };
        let utc = utc as f64 / 1000.0;
        let position = DVec3::from_array(frame.render_view.camera_eye_world_m);
        let observer = position.normalize_or_zero();
        if self.weather.stamp != Some(stamp) {
            self.gpu.terrain_gpu.clear_cover();
            self.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.clear_weather();
            self.weather.stamp = Some(stamp);
            self.weather.published = None;
            self.weather.last_request = None;
            self.weather.worker.clear();
            self.gpu.cloud_gpu.count = 0;
        }
        if let Some((cover_stamp, cover)) = self.weather.worker.take_cover() {
            if cover_stamp == stamp {
                self.gpu.terrain_gpu.upload_cover(&self.gpu.queue, &cover);
                self.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.set_weather(&self.gpu.queue, &cover);
            }
        }
        self.gpu.terrain_gpu.set_cover_time(utc);
        if let Some(result) = self.weather.worker.take() {
            if result.request.stamp == stamp && result.request.detail == self.weather.detail {
                self.weather.published = Some(result);
            }
        }
        let now = Instant::now();
        if self
            .weather
            .last_request
            .is_none_or(|t| now.duration_since(t) >= Duration::from_millis(500))
        {
            self.weather.sequence += 1;
            self.weather.worker.submit(Request {
                climate: self
                    .connection
                    .session()
                    .map(|s| s.climate_scenario())
                    .unwrap_or_default(),
                stamp,
                utc,
                observer,
                eye: DVec3::from_array(frame.render_view.camera_eye_world_m),
                sort: !self.gpu.cloud_gpu.oit,
                revision: self.weather.sequence,
                detail: self.weather.detail,
                started: now,
                geography: self
                    .connection
                    .session()
                    .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
            });
            self.weather.last_request = Some(now);
        }
        let Some(publication) = &self.weather.published else {
            self.gpu.cloud_gpu.debug = false;
            return;
        };
        let gpu = &mut self.gpu.cloud_gpu;
        gpu.update_faces(
            &self.gpu.queue,
            &publication.faces,
            publication.snapshot.revision,
        );
        let view = frame.render_view;
        let origin = DVec3::from_array(view.render_origin_m);
        let radius = view.game_planet_radius_m
            + manifest
                .planet()
                .map_or(0.0, |p| p.sea_level_mm as f64 / 1000.0);
        let records: Vec<_> = publication
            .snapshot
            .clouds
            .iter()
            .zip(&publication.morphs)
            .map(|(cloud, morph)| {
                // Absolute UTC in f64; pausing, skipped frames and view changes do not integrate error.
                let up = cloud.direction_at(utc);
                let east = DVec3::new(-up.z, 0.0, up.x).normalize_or_zero();
                let center = up * (radius + cloud.base_m) - origin;
                CloudRecord {
                    center_age: center
                        .as_vec3()
                        .extend((utc - cloud.birth_utc) as f32)
                        .to_array(),
                    east_opacity: east.as_vec3().extend(cloud.opacity).to_array(),
                    up_layer: up.as_vec3().extend(cloud.layer as f32).to_array(),
                    north_region: up
                        .cross(east)
                        .as_vec3()
                        .extend(weather::region::address(cloud.source) as f32)
                        .to_array(),
                    morph: [
                        morph.start as f32,
                        morph.step as f32,
                        cloud.kind as u8 as f32,
                        f32::from(morph.level),
                    ],
                }
            })
            .collect();
        let mut projection = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&view.projection);
        if view.kind == EnvironmentViewKind::Surface {
            let near = 0.05;
            let far = (radius as f32 * 0.2).max(1000.0);
            projection.z_axis.z = far / (near - far);
            projection.w_axis.z = near * far / (near - far);
        }
        let projection = projection * Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&view.view);
        let target_size = gpu.targets.as_ref().map_or(view.viewport, |t| t.size);
        let uniform = CloudUniform {
            projection: projection.to_cols_array_2d(),
            scene_projection: view.view_projection,
            inverse_projection: projection.inverse().to_cols_array_2d(),
            origin_radius: origin.as_vec3().extend(radius as f32).to_array(),
            eye: (DVec3::from_array(view.camera_eye_world_m) - origin)
                .as_vec3()
                .extend(weather::CORE_ANGLE as f32)
                .to_array(),
            observer: observer
                .as_vec3()
                .extend(weather::OUTER_ANGLE as f32)
                .to_array(),
            config: [self.weather.debug as u32, target_size[0], target_size[1], 0],
        };
        gpu.upload_frame(&self.gpu.queue, &records, &uniform);
        gpu.debug = self.weather.debug != CloudDebug::Off;
    }

    pub(in crate::renderer) fn weather_status(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let Some(p) = &self.weather.published else {
            return vec![
                "weather unavailable / preparing regional snapshot".into(),
                format!(
                    "terrain cover={} seasonal_phase={:.2} materials={:.1}MiB",
                    if self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.cover_center[3] > 0.0 {
                        "history-grid"
                    } else {
                        "analytic-fallback"
                    },
                    self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.climate[0],
                    self.gpu.terrain_gpu.bytes as f64 / 1048576.0
                ),
            ];
        };
        let s = &p.snapshot;
        let c = s.conditions;
        let utc = self
            .environment_frame
            .render_world_utc_ms
            .map_or(s.utc, |t| t as f64 / 1000.0);
        let gpu = &self.gpu.cloud_gpu;
        let wind_scale = self
            .render_environment_frame
            .render_view
            .game_planet_radius_m
            / weather::EARTH_RADIUS
            * ((1.0 - s.observer.y.powi(2)).sqrt() / 0.03).min(1.0);
        let active: Vec<_> = c
            .layers
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, l)| l.coverage > 0.01)
            .map(|(i, l)| {
                format!(
                    "{}:{:.0}% base={:.1}m thickness={:.1}m",
                    ["low", "mid", "high"][i],
                    l.coverage * 100.0,
                    l.base_m,
                    l.thickness_m
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let kinds = weather::CloudKind::ALL
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|kind| {
                let matching: Vec<_> = s
                    .clouds
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|cloud| cloud.kind == *kind)
                    .collect();
                let base = matching
                    .iter()
                    .map(|c| c.base_m)
                    .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
                let top = matching
                    .iter()
                    .map(|c| c.base_m + c.size_m.y)
                    .fold(0.0, f64::max);
                (!matching.is_empty())
                    .then(|| format!("{}={} [{base:.1}..{top:.1}m]", kind.name(), matching.len()))
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(" ");
        let stalled = s
            .clouds
            .iter()
            .zip(&p.morphs)
            .filter(|(cloud, morph)| utc - cloud.birth_utc > morph.start + morph.step)
            .count();
        vec![
            format!("terrain cover={} materials={:.1}MiB", if self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.cover_center[3] > 0.0 { "history-grid" } else { "analytic-fallback" }, self.gpu.terrain_gpu.bytes as f64/1048576.0),
            format!("weather Seasonal region={:?} T={:.1}C humidity={:.0}% water={:.0}% uplift={:.2}", s.region, c.temperature_c, c.humidity * 100.0, c.water_supply * 100.0, c.uplift),
            format!("layers [{}] wind W->E reference=5/10/20 m/s world={:.3}/{:.3}/{:.3} m/s", active.join(" | "), 5.0 * wind_scale, 10.0 * wind_scale, 20.0 * wind_scale),
            format!("clouds={} faces={} regions={} rev={} limited={} mode={} GPU={:.1}MiB mesh={:.1}MiB", s.clouds.len(), p.faces.len(), s.regions.len(), s.revision, s.limited || p.limited, if gpu.oit { "weighted_blended_oit" } else { "sorted_face_alpha" }, gpu.bytes() as f64 / 1048576.0, (p.faces.capacity() * std::mem::size_of::<super::Face>()) as f64 / 1048576.0),
            format!("publication age={:.2}s world_lag={:.2}s build={:.1}ms player_offset={:.4}rad debug={:?}", p.request.started.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), utc - s.utc, p.build_ms, s.observer.dot(DVec3::from_array(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position.map(f64::from)).normalize()).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).acos(), self.weather.debug),
            format!("families (world altitude bounds) [{kinds}]"),
            format!("voxels N0..6={:?} bricks={} density_samples={} cache_hits={} cache={:.2}MiB simplified={} morph_stalled={}", p.stats.levels, p.stats.bricks, p.stats.samples, p.stats.cached, p.stats.cache_bytes as f64 / 1048576.0, p.stats.simplified, stalled),
        ]
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/clouds/worker.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="293" bytes="11026" original_lines="293" original_bytes="11026" minified="false" sha256="da17dbd2d40a71e18abc7feef139b13b173b4da624a05df06b24cce2958c7bd8">>>
use super::{cache::MeshCache, Publication, Request};
use glam::DVec3;
use minimium_environment::weather::{SeasonalProfile, TerrainSampler, WeatherModel};
use minimium_procgen::PlanetTerrain;
use std::sync::{Arc, Condvar, Mutex};

struct ClientTerrain {
    terrain: PlanetTerrain,
    radius_m: f64,
    relief_m: f64,
}

impl TerrainSampler for ClientTerrain {
    fn source_elevation_m(&self, direction: DVec3) -> Option<f64> {
        self.terrain.source_elevation_m(direction.to_array())
    }

    fn sample(&self, direction: DVec3) -> (f64, bool) {
        let point = self
            .terrain
            .sample(minimium_environment::weather::surface_key(direction));
        (
            point.height_mm as f64 / 1000.0
                - self.radius_m
                - self.terrain.sea_level_mm() as f64 / 1000.0,
            point.ocean,
        )
    }

    fn contains_lake(&self, latitude_degrees: f64, longitude_degrees: f64) -> bool {
        crate::environment::lakes::contains(latitude_degrees, longitude_degrees)
    }

    fn earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(&self, direction: DVec3, angle: f64) -> Option<f64> {
        self.terrain
            .earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(direction.to_array(), angle)
            .ok()
    }

    fn relief_bound_m(&self) -> f64 {
        self.relief_m
    }
}

fn create_weather_model(
    manifest: minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    profile: SeasonalProfile,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> Option<WeatherModel<ClientTerrain>> {
    let surface = minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(manifest);
    let mut terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(manifest.generation(), surface)?;
    if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet() {
        terrain = terrain.with_definition(definition);
    }
    if let Some(geography) = geography {
        terrain = terrain.with_geography(geography);
    } else if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1) {
        return None;
    }
    let radius_m = manifest
        .planet()
        .map_or(surface.radius_mm(), |planet| planet.radius_mm) as f64
        / 1000.0;
    let is_earth = manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1);
    WeatherModel::new(
        manifest,
        profile,
        radius_m,
        is_earth,
        ClientTerrain {
            terrain,
            radius_m,
            relief_m: surface.relief_mm() as f64 / 1000.0,
        },
    )
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Mailbox {
    cover: Option<(
        super::Stamp,
        Arc<minimium_renderer::surface_cover::CoverGrid>,
    )>,
    pending: Option<Request>,
    completed: Option<Arc<Publication>>,
    stop: bool,
}

pub(super) struct CloudWorker {
    mailbox: Arc<(Mutex<Mailbox>, Condvar)>,
    thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl CloudWorker {
    pub(super) fn new() -> Self {
        let mailbox = Arc::new((Mutex::new(Mailbox::default()), Condvar::new()));
        let shared = Arc::clone(&mailbox);
        let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("regional-cloud-mesh".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let mut model: Option<WeatherModel<ClientTerrain>> = None;
                let mut meshes = MeshCache::default();
                let mut stamp = None;
                let mut cover_stamp = None;
                let mut atlas = None;
                let mut atlas_stamp = None;
                loop {
                    let request = {
                        let (lock, wake) = &*shared;
                        let mut state = lock.lock().unwrap();
                        while state.pending.is_none() && !state.stop {
                            state = wake.wait(state).unwrap();
                        }
                        if state.stop {
                            break;
                        }
                        state.pending.take().unwrap()
                    };
                    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
                    if stamp != Some(request.stamp) {
                        meshes = MeshCache::default();
                        stamp = Some(request.stamp);
                    }
                    if model
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_none_or(|m| m.manifest != request.stamp.manifest)
                    {
                        model = create_weather_model(
                            request.stamp.manifest,
                            SeasonalProfile::Seasonal,
                            request.geography.clone(),
                        );
                    }
                    let Some(model) = &mut model else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    if model.set_scenario((*request.climate).clone()).is_err() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let next_cover_stamp = (
                        request.stamp,
                        (request.utc / 3600.0).floor() as i64,
                        (request.observer * 1000.0)
                            .round()
                            .to_array()
                            .map(|v| v as i64),
                    );
                    let next_atlas_stamp = (
                        request.stamp,
                        next_cover_stamp.1,
                        (*request.climate).clone(),
                    );
                    if atlas_stamp.as_ref() != Some(&next_atlas_stamp) {
                        let built = minimium_renderer::surface_atlas::SurfaceAtlas::build(
                            model,
                            request.utc,
                            || {
                                let state = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                                state.stop
                                    || state
                                        .pending
                                        .as_ref()
                                        .is_some_and(|next| next.stamp != request.stamp)
                            },
                        );
                        let Some(built) = built else {
                            continue;
                        };
                        atlas = Some(Arc::new(built));
                        atlas_stamp = Some(next_atlas_stamp);
                        cover_stamp = None;
                    }
                    if cover_stamp != Some(next_cover_stamp) {
                        let mut cover = minimium_renderer::surface_cover::CoverGrid::build(
                            model,
                            request.observer,
                            request.utc,
                        );
                        cover.atlas = atlas.clone();
                        let cover = Arc::new(cover);
                        cover_stamp = Some(next_cover_stamp);
                        // Publish cover before cloud meshing, which can be cancelled or slow.
                        let mut state = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                        if !state.stop
                            && state
                                .pending
                                .as_ref()
                                .is_none_or(|next| next.stamp == request.stamp)
                        {
                            state.cover = Some((request.stamp, cover));
                        }
                    }
                    let snapshot = model.query(request.observer, request.utc, request.revision);
                    let mesh = meshes.build(&snapshot, request.detail, || {
                        let state = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                        state.stop
                            || state.pending.as_ref().is_some_and(|next| {
                                next.stamp != request.stamp || next.detail != request.detail
                            })
                    });
                    let Some(mesh) = mesh else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    let mut publication = Publication {
                        request,
                        snapshot,
                        faces: mesh.faces,
                        morphs: mesh.morphs,
                        limited: mesh.stats.simplified > 0,
                        stats: mesh.stats,
                        build_ms: started.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * 1000.0,
                    };
                    if publication.request.sort {
                        sort(&mut publication, model.radius);
                    }
                    publication.build_ms = started.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * 1000.0;
                    let mut state = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                    if state.stop {
                        break;
                    }
                    // A request for a different clock/world invalidates in-flight work.
                    if state
                        .pending
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_none_or(|next| next.stamp == publication.request.stamp)
                    {
                        state.completed = Some(Arc::new(publication));
                    }
                }
            })
            .expect("cloud worker thread");
        Self {
            mailbox,
            thread: Some(thread),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn submit(&self, request: Request) {
        self.mailbox.0.lock().unwrap().pending = Some(request);
        self.mailbox.1.notify_one();
    }

    pub(super) fn take(&self) -> Option<Arc<Publication>> {
        self.mailbox.0.lock().unwrap().completed.take()
    }

    pub(super) fn take_cover(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<(
        super::Stamp,
        Arc<minimium_renderer::surface_cover::CoverGrid>,
    )> {
        self.mailbox.0.lock().unwrap().cover.take()
    }

    pub(super) fn clear(&self) {
        let mut state = self.mailbox.0.lock().unwrap();
        state.pending = None;
        state.completed = None;
        state.cover = None;
    }
}

impl Drop for CloudWorker {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.mailbox.0.lock().unwrap().stop = true;
        self.mailbox.1.notify_one();
        if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
            let _ = thread.join();
        }
    }
}

fn sort(publication: &mut Publication, radius: f64) {
    let transforms: Vec<_> = publication
        .snapshot
        .clouds
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            let up = c.direction_at(publication.snapshot.utc);
            let east = glam::DVec3::new(-up.z, 0.0, up.x).normalize_or_zero();
            (up * (radius + c.base_m), up, east, up.cross(east))
        })
        .collect();
    publication.faces.sort_by_cached_key(|face| {
        let (center, up, east, north) = transforms[face.center[3] as usize];
        let p = center
            + east * f64::from(face.center[0])
            + up * f64::from(face.center[1])
            + north * f64::from(face.center[2]);
        std::cmp::Reverse((p - publication.request.eye).length_squared().to_bits())
    });
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/collision_worker.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="98" bytes="3113" original_lines="98" original_bytes="3113" minified="false" sha256="4e70410aaecd03dda9efcef5d13405a9e8b8a96e89a0fb85a172a5f32285d3d5">>>
//! Bounded sector materialization. SectorManager installation stays on the UI lane.
use minimium_procgen::{PreparedGeography, SectorGeometry};
use minimium_sectors::SectorTicket;
use minimium_world::world::{WorldManifest, WorldMap};
use std::{
    collections::VecDeque,
    sync::{Arc, Condvar, Mutex},
    thread::JoinHandle,
};
struct Job {
    ticket: SectorTicket,
    map: WorldMap,
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn PreparedGeography>>,
}
#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    pending: VecDeque<Job>,
    completed: Vec<(SectorTicket, Arc<SectorGeometry>)>,
    busy: bool,
    stop: bool,
}
pub(super) struct CollisionWorker {
    state: Arc<(Mutex<State>, Condvar)>,
    thread: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
}
impl CollisionWorker {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let state = Arc::new((Mutex::new(State::default()), Condvar::new()));
        let shared = state.clone();
        let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("sector-materialization".into())
            .spawn(move || loop {
                let job = {
                    let mut state = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                    while state.pending.is_empty() && !state.stop {
                        state = shared.1.wait(state).unwrap();
                    }
                    if state.stop {
                        break;
                    }
                    state.busy = true;
                    state.pending.pop_front().unwrap()
                };
                let geometry = Arc::new(minimium_procgen::materialize_world_sector_with_geography(
                    &job.map,
                    job.manifest,
                    job.ticket.key(),
                    job.geography,
                ));
                let mut state = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                state.busy = false;
                if !state.stop {
                    state.completed.push((job.ticket, geometry));
                }
            })
            .expect("sector materialization worker");
        Self {
            state,
            thread: Some(thread),
        }
    }
    pub fn has_capacity(&self) -> bool {
        let s = self.state.0.lock().unwrap();
        s.pending.len() + s.completed.len() + usize::from(s.busy) < 32
    }
    pub fn submit(
        &self,
        ticket: SectorTicket,
        map: WorldMap,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        geography: Option<Arc<dyn PreparedGeography>>,
    ) {
        self.state.0.lock().unwrap().pending.push_back(Job {
            ticket,
            map,
            manifest,
            geography,
        });
        self.state.1.notify_one();
    }
    pub fn poll(&self) -> Vec<(SectorTicket, Arc<SectorGeometry>)> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.state.0.lock().unwrap().completed)
    }
}
impl Drop for CollisionWorker {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        {
            let mut s = self.state.0.lock().unwrap();
            s.stop = true;
            s.pending.clear();
            self.state.1.notify_one();
        }
        if let Some(t) = self.thread.take() {
            let _ = t.join();
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/console_events.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="98" bytes="3433" original_lines="98" original_bytes="3433" minified="false" sha256="dbd1dfd6a1330989ca22e27b82b8cddde25bead58381b7ecedb465275dbabd37">>>
use crate::console::Console;
use winit::keyboard::{KeyCode, ModifiersState};

pub(super) fn key(
    console: &mut Console,
    code: KeyCode,
    text: Option<&str>,
    modifiers: ModifiersState,
) {
    let shift = modifiers.shift_key();
    let ctrl = modifiers.control_key() && !modifiers.alt_key();
    if ctrl {
        let editor = &mut console.editor;
        match code {
            KeyCode::KeyA => editor.select_all(),
            KeyCode::KeyC => clipboard_write(console, false),
            KeyCode::KeyX => clipboard_write(console, true),
            KeyCode::KeyV => match arboard::Clipboard::new().and_then(|mut board| board.get_text())
            {
                Ok(value) => console.append_text(&value),
                Err(error) => console.push_error(format!("Schowek niedostępny: {error}")),
            },
            KeyCode::KeyZ if shift => {
                editor.redo();
                console.edit_changed();
            }
            KeyCode::KeyZ => {
                editor.undo();
                console.edit_changed();
            }
            KeyCode::KeyY => {
                editor.redo();
                console.edit_changed();
            }
            KeyCode::ArrowLeft => editor.left(shift, true),
            KeyCode::ArrowRight => editor.right(shift, true),
            KeyCode::Backspace => {
                editor.delete(true, true);
                console.edit_changed();
            }
            KeyCode::Delete => {
                editor.delete(false, true);
                console.edit_changed();
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        if matches!(
            code,
            KeyCode::ArrowLeft | KeyCode::ArrowRight | KeyCode::KeyA
        ) {
            console.refresh_suggestions();
        }
        return;
    }
    match code {
        KeyCode::ArrowLeft => console.editor.left(shift, false),
        KeyCode::ArrowRight => console.editor.right(shift, false),
        KeyCode::Home => console.editor.move_to(0, shift),
        KeyCode::End => console.editor.move_to(console.editor.text.len(), shift),
        KeyCode::Backspace => console.backspace(),
        KeyCode::Delete => {
            console.editor.delete(false, false);
            console.edit_changed();
        }
        KeyCode::ArrowUp => console.history_up(),
        KeyCode::ArrowDown => console.history_down(),
        KeyCode::PageUp => console.scroll_lines(10),
        KeyCode::PageDown => console.scroll_lines(-10),
        KeyCode::Tab => console.complete_input(shift),
        _ => {
            if let Some(value) = text {
                console.append_text(value);
            }
        }
    }
    if matches!(
        code,
        KeyCode::ArrowLeft | KeyCode::ArrowRight | KeyCode::Home | KeyCode::End
    ) {
        console.refresh_suggestions();
    }
}

fn clipboard_write(console: &mut Console, cut: bool) {
    let selected = console.editor.selected_text().to_owned();
    if selected.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    match arboard::Clipboard::new().and_then(|mut board| board.set_text(selected)) {
        Ok(()) => {
            if cut {
                console.editor.replace_selection("");
                console.edit_changed();
            }
        }
        Err(error) => console.push_error(format!("Schowek niedostępny: {error}")),
    }
}
