<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/controller.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="269" bytes="10528" original_lines="269" original_bytes="10528" minified="false" sha256="e5ae1b3bc8a9978db50dd948c027db6f3a37e414369c569151a342fe53fe9cc0">>>
use super::*;
use crate::messages::ClientText as Text;

pub(super) fn execute_console_input(renderer: &mut Renderer) -> bool {
    let input = renderer.ui.console.take_input();
    let command = match client_commands::parse_command(&input) {
        Ok(Some(command)) => command,
        Ok(None) => return false,
        Err(error) => {
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_error(Text::CommandParseError(error).to_string());
            return false;
        }
    };
    let direction = super::camera::camera_direction(
        renderer.game.gameplay.prediction.character,
        renderer.input.yaw,
        renderer.input.pitch,
    )
    .normalize()
    .to_array();
    let result = client_commands::execute(
        command,
        &mut CommandContext {
            connection: &mut renderer.connection,
            fire_direction: direction,
        },
    );
    let action = match result {
        CommandResult::Sent => {
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(Text::CommandQueued.to_string());
            return false;
        }
        CommandResult::QueueError(error) => {
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_error(Text::CouldNotQueueCommand(error.into()).to_string());
            return false;
        }
        CommandResult::Action(action) => action,
    };
    match action {
        FrontendAction::AtmosphereDebug(mode) => {
            renderer.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug[0] = 0;
            renderer.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.debug = mode as u32;
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(format!("atmosphere debug {mode:?}"));
        }
        FrontendAction::AtmosphereStatus => {
            for line in renderer.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.status() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line(line);
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::WeatherStatus => {
            for line in renderer.weather_status() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line(line);
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::TerrainStatus => {
            for line in renderer.terrain_status() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line(line);
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::TerrainDebug(mode) => {
            renderer.gpu.atmosphere_gpu.debug = 0;
            renderer.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug[0] = mode as u32;
            renderer.gpu.terrain_gpu.update(&renderer.gpu.queue);
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(format!("terrain debug {mode:?}"));
        }
        FrontendAction::WeatherDebug(mode) => {
            renderer.weather.debug = mode;
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(format!("weather clouds debug {mode:?}"));
        }
        FrontendAction::WeatherDetail(level) => {
            renderer.weather.set_detail(level);
            renderer.ui.console.push_line(format!(
                "weather clouds detail N={level} (thin-layer minimum retained)"
            ));
        }
        FrontendAction::Print(text) => {
            for line in text.lines() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line(line);
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::Help => {
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line("Commands (PageUp/PageDown to scroll):");
            for line in client_commands::help_lines() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line(line);
            }
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(Text::ConsoleHistoryHelp.to_string());
        }
        FrontendAction::Connect(address) => {
            if renderer.connection.busy() {
                renderer
                    .ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::DisconnectOrWait.to_string());
            } else {
                renderer.start_remote_attempt(&address);
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::HostLocal(lane) => {
            if renderer.connection.busy() {
                renderer
                    .ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::DisconnectOrWait.to_string());
            } else {
                renderer.start_local_attempt(lane.unwrap_or(renderer.settings.threads));
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::Disconnect => {
            renderer.connection.cancel();
            renderer.clear_connection();
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(Text::Disconnected.to_string());
        }
        FrontendAction::FpsShow => renderer
            .ui
            .console
            .push_line(renderer.metrics.frame_stats.summary()),
        FrontendAction::NetStats => {
            let metrics = renderer
                .connection
                .session()
                .map(ClientSession::metrics)
                .unwrap_or_default();
            renderer.ui.console.push_line(format!(
                "{}",
                Text::NetworkStats {
                    bytes_sent: renderer
                        .metrics
                        .previous_bytes_sent
                        .saturating_add(metrics.bytes_sent),
                    bytes_received: renderer
                        .metrics
                        .previous_bytes_received
                        .saturating_add(metrics.bytes_received),
                    ping_milliseconds: metrics.ping_round_trip.map(|duration| duration.as_millis()),
                    nearby_players: Some(renderer.game.gameplay.reconciliation.player_count()),
                }
            ));
        }
        FrontendAction::State => renderer.ui.console.push_line(
            Text::PlayerState {
                position: renderer.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position,
                health: renderer.game.gameplay.health,
                nearby_players: renderer.game.gameplay.reconciliation.player_count(),
            }
            .to_string(),
        ),
        FrontendAction::MapTeleport => renderer.arm_map_teleport(),
        FrontendAction::Clear => renderer.ui.console.clear_lines(),
        FrontendAction::SkyQuality(quality) => {
            let status = renderer.set_sky_quality(quality);
            renderer.ui.console.push_line(status);
        }
        FrontendAction::SkyInfo => {
            for line in renderer.sky_info_lines() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line(line);
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::SkyBodies => {
            let frame = &renderer.render_environment_frame;
            if frame.observed_bodies.is_empty() {
                renderer.ui.console.push_line("sky bodies unavailable");
            } else {
                for body in frame
                    .observed_bodies
                    .iter()
                    .take(minimium_environment::universe::MAX_CELESTIAL_BODIES + 2)
                {
                    let flux: f64 = if body.id == minimium_astronomy::SKY_SUN_ID {
                        frame.local_sun.map_or(0.0, |local| {
                            f64::from(local.effective_linear_rgb.iter().sum::<f32>())
                        })
                    } else if body.id == minimium_astronomy::SKY_MOON_ID {
                        frame.local_moon.map_or(0.0, |local| {
                            f64::from(local.effective_linear_rgb.iter().sum::<f32>())
                        })
                    } else {
                        body.emitted_linear_rgb
                            .iter()
                            .chain(body.reflected_linear_rgb.iter())
                            .chain(body.scattered_linear_rgb.iter())
                            .sum()
                    };
                    renderer.ui.console.push_line(format!(
                        "body {} {:?} flux={flux:.4e} visible={}",
                        body.id.get(),
                        body.kind,
                        body.visible
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::SkyDemo(enabled) => {
            renderer.demo_universe_enabled = enabled;
            renderer.ui.console.push_line(if enabled {
                "local sky demo enabled"
            } else {
                "local sky demo disabled"
            });
        }
        FrontendAction::Fov(degrees) => {
            if let Some(degrees) = degrees {
                renderer.fov_degrees = degrees;
            }
            renderer
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(format!("vertical FOV: {:.1}°", renderer.fov_degrees));
        }
        FrontendAction::ShowCelestialNames(enabled) => {
            renderer.show_celestial_names = enabled;
            renderer.ui.console.push_line(if enabled {
                "celestial names enabled"
            } else {
                "celestial names disabled"
            });
        }
        FrontendAction::SetTime { minute, local } => {
            let [x, _, z] = renderer.game.view().player_position_m;
            let result = if local && (!renderer.is_earth_world() || x.hypot(z) < 1.0e-6) {
                Err("local solar time requires an Earth observer away from the poles".into())
            } else {
                renderer
                    .connection
                    .request_set_time(minute, if local { z.atan2(x) } else { 0.0 })
            };
            match result {
                Ok(()) => renderer.ui.console.push_line("time change request sent"),
                Err(error) => renderer.ui.console.push_error(error),
            }
        }
        FrontendAction::TimeStatus => renderer
            .ui
            .console
            .push_line(renderer.environment_frame.time_status_line()),
        FrontendAction::TimeScale(value) => match renderer.connection.request_time_scale(value) {
            Ok(()) => renderer.ui.console.push_line("time scale request sent"),
            Err(error) => renderer.ui.console.push_error(error),
        },
        FrontendAction::Quit => return true,
    }
    false
}
<<<END_FILE>>>

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/diagnostics.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="429" bytes="14830" original_lines="429" original_bytes="14830" minified="false" sha256="2b34b25ae2a09e60346303e3c7d3a99b2e584e547ecd401370adb08884a3c7ae">>>
use super::Renderer;
use crate::environment::{diagnostics::format_utc_millis, SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot};

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn sky_info_lines(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let frame = &self.render_environment_frame;
        let input = self.environment_frame;
        let mut snapshot = SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot::new();
        snapshot.push(
            "profile",
            frame
                .descriptor
                .map_or("n/a", |value| profile_label(value.profile())),
        );
        snapshot.push("requested_quality", self.sky_quality.requested.label());
        snapshot.push("effective_quality", self.sky_quality.effective.label());
        snapshot.push(
            "fallback_reason",
            self.sky_quality.fallback_reason.unwrap_or("none"),
        );
        snapshot.push_optional(
            "astronomy_model_revision",
            frame
                .descriptor
                .map(|value| value.astronomy_model_revision().get()),
        );
        snapshot.push_optional(
            "catalogue_id",
            frame.descriptor.map(|value| value.catalogue_id().get()),
        );
        snapshot.push(
            "catalogue_sha256",
            self.sky_catalogue
                .as_ref()
                .map(|catalogue| sha256_hex(catalogue.identity().sha256))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned()),
        );
        snapshot.push_optional(
            "catalogue_count",
            self.sky_catalogue
                .as_ref()
                .map(|catalogue| catalogue.records().len()),
        );
        push_clock_fields(&mut snapshot, input);
        push_observer_fields(&mut snapshot, frame);
        push_body_fields(&mut snapshot, frame);
        push_counter_fields(
            &mut snapshot,
            self.metrics.frame_stats.environment_snapshot(),
        );
        push_shadow_fields(&mut snapshot, self);
        push_gpu_fields(&mut snapshot, self);
        push_milky_way_fields(&mut snapshot, self);
        snapshot.lines().collect()
    }
}

fn push_milky_way_fields(snapshot: &mut SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot, renderer: &Renderer) {
    let frame = &renderer.render_environment_frame;
    let overview = frame.render_view.kind == super::environment::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview;
    let u = &frame.environment_uniform;
    let moon_flux = u.moon_disk_radiance[3].max(0.0) * u.local_moon_rgb_visibility[3];
    let visibility = if overview {
        1.0
    } else {
        u.sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility[3] / (1.0 + 8.0 * moon_flux)
    };
    let drawn = renderer.gpu.environment_draw_calls.sky > 0;
    snapshot.push(
        "milky_way_state",
        if !drawn {
            "sky_not_drawn"
        } else if visibility <= 0.0 {
            "daylight_suppressed"
        } else if overview {
            "orbital_background"
        } else {
            "night_background"
        },
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "milky_way_visibility_before_extinction_and_clouds",
        visibility,
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "milky_way_texture_bytes",
        minimium_renderer::MilkyWayGpu::BYTES,
    );
    snapshot.push("scene_linear_HDR", renderer.gpu.hdr_enabled);
}

fn push_clock_fields(
    snapshot: &mut SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot,
    input: crate::environment::EnvironmentFrameInput,
) {
    let clock = input.clock_diagnostics;
    snapshot.push(
        "clock_source",
        clock.map_or("n/a", |value| value.source.label()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "clock_mode",
        clock.and_then(|value| value.mode).map(clock_mode_label),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "clock_id",
        clock
            .and_then(|value| value.clock_id)
            .map(|value| value.get()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional("clock_revision", input.revision);
    snapshot.push(
        "world_utc",
        input
            .render_world_utc_ms
            .map(format_utc_millis)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional("rate_ppm", input.rate_ppm);
    snapshot.push(
        "rate",
        input.rate_ppm.map_or_else(
            || "n/a".to_owned(),
            |ppm| format!("{:.6}x", ppm as f64 / 1_000_000.0),
        ),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "offline_policy",
        clock
            .and_then(|value| value.offline_policy)
            .map(offline_policy_label),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "sample_age_real_ms",
        clock.and_then(|value| value.sample_age_real_ms),
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "clock_offset_ms",
        clock
            .and_then(|value| value.clock_offset_ms)
            .map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| format!("{value:.3}")),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional("probe_rtt_ms", clock.and_then(|value| value.probe_rtt_ms));
    snapshot.push("clock_sync_state", input.quality.label());
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "clock_samples_accepted",
        clock.and_then(|value| value.samples_accepted),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "clock_samples_rejected",
        clock.and_then(|value| value.samples_rejected),
    );
}

fn push_observer_fields(
    snapshot: &mut SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot,
    frame: &super::environment::EnvironmentFrame,
) {
    let observer = frame.observer;
    snapshot.push(
        "observer_lat_deg",
        observer.map_or_else(
            || "n/a".to_owned(),
            |value| format!("{:.6}", value.geographic.latitude_rad().to_degrees()),
        ),
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "observer_lon_deg",
        observer.map_or_else(
            || "n/a".to_owned(),
            |value| format!("{:.6}", value.geographic.longitude_rad().to_degrees()),
        ),
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "observer_height_m",
        observer.map_or_else(
            || "n/a".to_owned(),
            |value| format!("{:.2}", value.geographic.height_m()),
        ),
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "observer_height_policy",
        observer.map_or("n/a", |value| match value.model {
            minimium_environment::sky::SkyModel::EarthGeoreferencedV1 => "EarthHeightReferenceV1",
            minimium_environment::sky::SkyModel::MappedEarthSkyV1 => "MappedGameHeightV1",
            minimium_environment::sky::SkyModel::None => "n/a",
        }),
    );
}

fn push_body_fields(
    snapshot: &mut SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot,
    frame: &super::environment::EnvironmentFrame,
) {
    let sky = frame.sky;
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "sun_alt_deg",
        sky.map(|value| value.sun.geometric_altitude_rad.to_degrees()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "sun_apparent_alt_deg",
        sky.map(|value| value.sun.apparent_altitude_rad.to_degrees()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "sun_azimuth_deg",
        sky.map(|value| value.sun.azimuth_rad.to_degrees().rem_euclid(360.0)),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "moon_alt_deg",
        sky.map(|value| value.moon.body.geometric_altitude_rad.to_degrees()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "moon_apparent_alt_deg",
        sky.map(|value| value.moon.body.apparent_altitude_rad.to_degrees()),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "moon_azimuth_deg",
        sky.map(|value| value.moon.body.azimuth_rad.to_degrees().rem_euclid(360.0)),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "moon_illuminated_fraction",
        sky.map(|value| value.moon.illuminated_fraction),
    );
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "moon_angular_radius_rad",
        sky.map(|value| value.moon.body.angular_radius_rad),
    );
}

fn push_shadow_fields(snapshot: &mut SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot, renderer: &Renderer) {
    let gpu = &renderer.gpu;
    let enabled = gpu.shadow_gpu.settings.enabled;
    let valid = enabled && gpu.shadow_state.valid;
    snapshot.push(
        "shadow_source",
        if valid {
            gpu.shadow_state
                .source
                .map_or("none", |source| source.label())
        } else {
            "none"
        },
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "shadow_size",
        format!(
            "{}x{}",
            gpu.shadow_gpu.settings.resolution, gpu.shadow_gpu.settings.resolution
        ),
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "shadow_range_m",
        if enabled {
            gpu.shadow_state.receiver_radius_m.to_string()
        } else {
            "n/a".to_owned()
        },
    );
    snapshot.push_optional("shadow_texel_m", valid.then_some(gpu.shadow_state.texel_m));
    let caster_count = usize::from(gpu.shadow_gpu.map_casters().is_some())
        + usize::from(gpu.shadow_gpu.player_casters().is_some())
        + gpu.shadow_state.caster_keys.len();
    snapshot.push_optional("shadow_caster_count", enabled.then_some(caster_count));
    snapshot.push_optional(
        "shadow_coverage_complete",
        enabled.then_some(
            gpu.shadow_state.valid && (gpu.overview_active || gpu.shadow_remote_complete),
        ),
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "shadow_incomplete_reason",
        if valid {
            "none"
        } else {
            gpu.shadow_state
                .invalid_reason
                .map_or("not_rendered", |reason| reason.label())
        },
    );
}

fn push_gpu_fields(snapshot: &mut SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot, renderer: &Renderer) {
    let gpu = &renderer.gpu;
    let star_bytes = gpu.stars.buffer.size();
    let uniform_bytes = gpu.environment_buffer.size()
        + gpu.camera_buffer.size()
        + gpu.shadow_gpu.uniform_buffer.size();
    let shadow_texture_bytes = gpu.shadow_gpu.texture_bytes();
    let map_caster_bytes = gpu.shadow_gpu.map_caster_buffer_bytes();
    let player_caster_bytes = gpu.shadow_gpu.player_caster_buffer_bytes();
    snapshot.push(
        "environment_GPU_estimate_bytes",
        star_bytes + uniform_bytes + shadow_texture_bytes + map_caster_bytes + player_caster_bytes,
    );
    snapshot.push("environment_GPU_star_instance_buffer_bytes", star_bytes);
    snapshot.push("environment_GPU_uniform_bytes", uniform_bytes);
    snapshot.push("environment_GPU_shadow_texture_bytes", shadow_texture_bytes);
    snapshot.push("environment_GPU_map_caster_buffer_bytes", map_caster_bytes);
    snapshot.push(
        "environment_GPU_player_caster_buffer_bytes",
        player_caster_bytes,
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "environment_GPU_shared_sector_buffers",
        "included_in_total_engine_estimate",
    );
    snapshot.push(
        "environment_GPU_measurement",
        "engine_estimate_not_driver_VRAM",
    );
}

fn profile_label(profile: minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile) -> &'static str {
    match profile {
        minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile::Interior => "Interior",
        minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile::Earth => "Earth",
        minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike => "EarthLike",
    }
}

fn clock_mode_label(mode: minimium_environment::time::ClockMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        minimium_environment::time::ClockMode::RealTime => "real_time",
        minimium_environment::time::ClockMode::TimeScale => "time_scale",
    }
}

fn offline_policy_label(policy: minimium_environment::time::OfflinePolicy) -> &'static str {
    match policy {
        minimium_environment::time::OfflinePolicy::Pause => "pause",
        minimium_environment::time::OfflinePolicy::Advance => "advance",
    }
}

fn format_optional<T: ToString>(value: Option<T>) -> String {
    value.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| value.to_string())
}

fn format_optional_float(value: Option<f64>) -> String {
    value.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| format!("{value:.2}"))
}

fn sha256_hex(bytes: [u8; 32]) -> String {
    bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect()
}

    pub(crate) fn interior(
        context: WorldContext,
        clock_revision: ClockRevision,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
        render_view: RenderViewFrame,
    ) -> Result<Self, EnvironmentFrameError> {
        adapter::interior(context, clock_revision, descriptor, render_view)
    }

    pub(crate) fn unavailable(render_view: RenderViewFrame) -> Self {
        adapter::unavailable(render_view)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn body_frame(
    body: CelestialBodyState,
    color: [f32; 3],
    scale: f32,
    visible_fraction: f32,
) -> LocalBodyFrame {
    LocalBodyFrame {
        geometric_direction_world: body.geometric_direction_world,
        apparent_direction_world: body.apparent_direction_world,
        geometric_altitude_rad: body.geometric_altitude_rad,
        apparent_altitude_rad: body.apparent_altitude_rad,
        angular_radius_rad: body.angular_radius_rad,
        distance_m: body.distance_m,
        visible_fraction,
        effective_linear_rgb: color.map(|channel| channel * scale * visible_fraction),
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/environment/adapter.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="499" bytes="17899" original_lines="499" original_bytes="17899" minified="false" sha256="0e1b7db0efe60b7d9d10c90d85bcdb6bfe622df2faff316fb30add9c0093d90b">>>
use super::{
    EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentFrameDiagnostics, EnvironmentFrameStatus, EnvironmentSettings,
    GlobalSunFrame, RenderViewFrame, SkyFrameInput,
};
use bytemuck::Zeroable;
use minimium_astronomy::{SkyState, ASTRONOMY_MODEL_REVISION};
use minimium_environment::sky::SkyModel;
use minimium_environment::{
    time::{ClockId, ClockRevision},
    {EnvironmentDescriptor, EnvironmentProfile},
};
use minimium_protocol::WorldContext;
use minimium_renderer::gpu_frame::camera_uniform;
use minimium_renderer::gpu_frame::EnvironmentUniform;
use std::{error::Error, f64::consts::PI, fmt};

// Presentation scale for sky disks; physical angular radii still drive lighting and visibility.
const SKY_DISK_DISPLAY_SCALE: f64 = 1.8;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum EnvironmentFrameError {
    DescriptorMismatch,
    SkyStateInvalid,
    ObserverMismatch,
    SettingsInvalid,
}

impl fmt::Display for EnvironmentFrameError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let message = match self {
            Self::DescriptorMismatch => "environment descriptor is incompatible with the sky",
            Self::SkyStateInvalid => "astronomy returned an invalid sky state",
            Self::ObserverMismatch => "observer and sky model revisions differ",
            Self::SettingsInvalid => "environment settings contain an invalid value",
        };
        formatter.write_str(message)
    }
}

impl Error for EnvironmentFrameError {}

pub(super) fn from_sky_state(
    sky: &SkyState,
    input: SkyFrameInput,
) -> Result<EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let SkyFrameInput {
        observer,
        context,
        clock_revision,
        descriptor,
        render_view,
        observed_bodies,
        settings,
    } = input;
    if descriptor.profile() == EnvironmentProfile::Interior
        || descriptor.astronomy_model_revision().get() != ASTRONOMY_MODEL_REVISION
        || descriptor.validate_clock(ClockId::MVP).is_err()
    {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::DescriptorMismatch);
    }
    let profile_matches_model = matches!(
        (descriptor.profile(), observer.model),
        (EnvironmentProfile::Earth, SkyModel::EarthGeoreferencedV1)
            | (EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike, SkyModel::MappedEarthSkyV1)
    );
    if !profile_matches_model || sky.observer_model_revision != observer.height_reference_revision {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::ObserverMismatch);
    }
    if !render_view.is_finite()
        || settings.validate().is_err()
        || !valid_body(sky.sun)
        || !valid_body(sky.moon.body)
        || !sky.moon.illuminated_fraction.is_finite()
        || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&sky.moon.illuminated_fraction)
        || !sky.moon.apparent_v_magnitude.is_finite()
        || !sky.moon.phase_angle_rad.is_finite()
        || !valid_vector(sky.moon.moon_to_sun_world)
        || !valid_vector(sky.moon.pole_world)
        || !valid_vector(sky.geocentric_sun_direction_world)
        || !valid_vector(sky.geocentric_moon_position_world_m)
        || !valid_vector(sky.sun.geometric_direction_world)
        || !valid_vector(sky.sun.apparent_direction_world)
        || !valid_vector(sky.moon.body.geometric_direction_world)
        || !valid_vector(sky.moon.body.apparent_direction_world)
        || !sky
            .catalog_epoch_to_world
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .all(|value| value.is_finite())
    {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid);
    }

    let (observer_up, horizon_cos, below_radius) = view_horizon(render_view);
    let horizon_altitude = horizon_cos.asin();
    let sun_visible = super::halo::visible_disk_fraction(
        sky.sun.apparent_altitude_rad,
        sky.sun.angular_radius_rad,
        horizon_altitude,
    );
    let moon_visible = super::halo::visible_disk_fraction(
        sky.moon.body.apparent_altitude_rad,
        sky.moon.body.angular_radius_rad,
        horizon_altitude,
    );
    let clear_sky =
        minimium_renderer::lighting::evaluate_clear_sky_parameters(sky, &observer, &settings);
    let disk_sun = super::body_frame(
        sky.sun,
        settings.sunlight.local_rgb,
        clear_sky.direct_sun_factor,
        sun_visible,
    );
    let moon_flux =
        minimium_renderer::moon_lighting::apparent_moon_flux(sky.moon.apparent_v_magnitude)
            .ok_or(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid)?;
    let moon_scale = minimium_renderer::moon_lighting::lunar_irradiance_at_observer(
        moon_flux,
        sky.moon.body.apparent_altitude_rad,
        sky.moon.body.angular_radius_rad,
        observer.geographic.height_m(),
        settings.moonlight.full_phase_strength,
    )
    .ok_or(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid)?;
    let disk_moon = super::body_frame(
        sky.moon.body,
        settings.moonlight.local_rgb,
        moon_scale,
        moon_visible,
    );
    let moon_to_sun = rotate_shortest_arc(
        sky.moon.body.geometric_direction_world,
        sky.moon.body.apparent_direction_world,
        sky.moon.moon_to_sun_world,
    )
    .ok_or(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid)?;
    let moon_pole = rotate_shortest_arc(
        sky.moon.body.geometric_direction_world,
        sky.moon.body.apparent_direction_world,
        sky.moon.pole_world,
    )
    .ok_or(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid)?;
    let global_sun = GlobalSunFrame {
        direction_world: sky.geocentric_sun_direction_world,
        linear_rgb: settings.sunlight.global_rgb,
        strength: settings.sunlight.global_strength,
    };
    let (halo_sources, halo_count, moon_orbit_world) = super::halo::prepare_halos(
        sky,
        render_view,
        disk_sun,
        disk_moon,
        moon_to_sun,
        &observed_bodies,
        settings,
    )?;
    let environment_uniform = EnvironmentUniform {
        sun_geometric_world: direction_altitude(
            sky.sun.geometric_direction_world,
            sky.sun.geometric_altitude_rad,
        )?,
        sun_apparent_world: direction_radius(
            sky.sun.apparent_direction_world,
            sky.sun.angular_radius_rad * SKY_DISK_DISPLAY_SCALE,
        )?,
        moon_geometric_world: direction_altitude(
            sky.moon.body.geometric_direction_world,
            sky.moon.body.geometric_altitude_rad,
        )?,
        moon_apparent_world: direction_radius(
            sky.moon.body.apparent_direction_world,
            sky.moon.body.angular_radius_rad * SKY_DISK_DISPLAY_SCALE,
        )?,
        moon_light_world_phase: direction_fraction(moon_to_sun, sky.moon.illuminated_fraction)?,
        moon_pole_world: direction_zero(moon_pole)?,
        local_sun_rgb_visibility: color_fraction(
            disk_sun.effective_linear_rgb,
            disk_sun.visible_fraction,
        )?,
        local_moon_rgb_visibility: color_fraction(
            disk_moon.effective_linear_rgb,
            disk_moon.visible_fraction,
        )?,
        global_sun_direction: direction_zero(sky.geocentric_sun_direction_world)?,
        global_sun_rgb: color_zero(
            settings
                .sunlight
                .global_rgb
                .map(|channel| channel * settings.sunlight.global_strength),
        )?,
        ambient_rgb_exposure: color_exposure(
            clear_sky.ambient_rgb,
            if render_view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
                // Orbit exposure belongs to the view, not the player's hemisphere.
                settings.exposure
            } else {
                clear_sky.exposure
            },
        )?,
        sky_zenith_rgb_sun_altitude: color_altitude(
            clear_sky.zenith_rgb,
            sky.sun.apparent_altitude_rad,
        )?,
        sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility: color_visibility(
            clear_sky.horizon_rgb,
            clear_sky.star_visibility,
        )?,
        observer_up_horizon_cos: direction_fraction(observer_up, horizon_cos)?,
        flags: [
            descriptor.profile() as u32,
            render_view.kind as u32,
            1,
            transfer_route(render_view),
        ],
        eqj_to_world: matrix4(sky.catalog_epoch_to_world)?,
        moon_disk_radiance: minimium_renderer::moon_lighting::moon_disk_radiance(moon_flux),
        star_animation: [0.0; 4],
        moon_orbit_world,
        halo_count: [halo_count, 0, 0, 0],
        halo_sources,
    };
    Ok(EnvironmentFrame {
        context: Some(context),
        descriptor: Some(descriptor),
        clock_revision: Some(clock_revision),
        sky: Some(*sky),
        observed_bodies,
        halo_sources,
        halo_count,
        observer: Some(observer),
        render_view,
        global_sun: Some(global_sun),
        local_sun: Some(disk_sun),
        local_moon: Some(disk_moon),
        diagnostics: EnvironmentFrameDiagnostics {
            eye_below_planet_radius: below_radius,
            clear_sky_model_revision: minimium_renderer::lighting::CLEAR_SKY_MODEL_REVISION,
            star_frame: None,
        },
        status: EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available,
        camera_uniform: camera_uniform(render_view),
        environment_uniform,
    })
}

pub(super) fn interior(
    context: WorldContext,
    clock_revision: ClockRevision,
    descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    render_view: RenderViewFrame,
) -> Result<EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentFrameError> {
    if descriptor.profile() != EnvironmentProfile::Interior {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::DescriptorMismatch);
    }
    if descriptor.validate_clock(ClockId::MVP).is_err() || !render_view.is_finite() {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::DescriptorMismatch);
    }
    let (observer_up, horizon_cos, below_radius) = view_horizon(render_view);
    let settings = EnvironmentSettings::interior();
    Ok(EnvironmentFrame {
        context: Some(context),
        descriptor: Some(descriptor),
        clock_revision: Some(clock_revision),
        sky: None,
        observed_bodies: Vec::new(),
        halo_sources: [super::HaloSource::zeroed(); super::MAX_HALO_BODIES],
        halo_count: 0,
        observer: None,
        render_view,
        global_sun: None,
        local_sun: None,
        local_moon: None,
        diagnostics: EnvironmentFrameDiagnostics {
            eye_below_planet_radius: below_radius,
            clear_sky_model_revision: 0,
            star_frame: None,
        },
        status: EnvironmentFrameStatus::Interior,
        camera_uniform: camera_uniform(render_view),
        environment_uniform: EnvironmentUniform {
            ambient_rgb_exposure: color_exposure(settings.ambient, settings.exposure)?,
            observer_up_horizon_cos: direction_fraction(observer_up, horizon_cos)?,
            flags: [
                EnvironmentProfile::Interior as u32,
                render_view.kind as u32,
                1,
                transfer_route(render_view),
            ],
            ..EnvironmentUniform::zeroed()
        },
    })
}

pub(super) fn unavailable(render_view: RenderViewFrame) -> EnvironmentFrame {
    EnvironmentFrame {
        context: None,
        descriptor: None,
        clock_revision: None,
        sky: None,
        observed_bodies: Vec::new(),
        halo_sources: [super::HaloSource::zeroed(); super::MAX_HALO_BODIES],
        halo_count: 0,
        observer: None,
        render_view,
        global_sun: None,
        local_sun: None,
        local_moon: None,
        diagnostics: EnvironmentFrameDiagnostics::default(),
        status: EnvironmentFrameStatus::Unavailable,
        camera_uniform: camera_uniform(render_view),
        environment_uniform: EnvironmentUniform {
            ambient_rgb_exposure: [0.08, 0.09, 0.12, 1.0],
            flags: [0, render_view.kind as u32, 0, transfer_route(render_view)],
            ..EnvironmentUniform::zeroed()
        },
    }
}

fn view_horizon(view: RenderViewFrame) -> ([f64; 3], f64, bool) {
    let radius = view.game_planet_radius_m;
    let eye = view.camera_eye_world_m;
    let eye_radius = length(eye);
    if radius <= 0.0 || !eye_radius.is_finite() || eye_radius <= 0.0 {
        return ([0.0, 1.0, 0.0], 0.0, false);
    }
    let up = eye.map(|value| value / eye_radius);
    if eye_radius < radius {
        return (up, 0.0, true);
    }
    let ratio = (radius / eye_radius).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let horizon_cos = -(1.0 - ratio * ratio).max(0.0).sqrt();
    (up, horizon_cos, false)
}

fn rotate_shortest_arc(from: [f64; 3], to: [f64; 3], vector: [f64; 3]) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let from = normalize(from)?;
    let to = normalize(to)?;
    let vector = normalize(vector)?;
    let cosine = dot(from, to).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
    if cosine < -1.0 + 1.0e-10 {
        let basis = if from[0].abs() < from[1].abs() && from[0].abs() < from[2].abs() {
            [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        } else if from[1].abs() < from[2].abs() {
            [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
        } else {
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        };
        let axis = normalize(cross(from, basis))?;
        return normalize(add(
            scale(axis, 2.0 * dot(axis, vector)),
            scale(vector, -1.0),
        ));
    }
    let axis = cross(from, to);
    let first = cross(axis, vector);
    let second = cross(axis, first);
    normalize(add(add(vector, first), scale(second, 1.0 / (1.0 + cosine))))
}

fn valid_body(body: minimium_astronomy::CelestialBodyState) -> bool {
    valid_vector(body.geometric_direction_world)
        && valid_vector(body.apparent_direction_world)
        && body.geometric_altitude_rad.is_finite()
        && body.apparent_altitude_rad.is_finite()
        && body.distance_m.is_finite()
        && body.distance_m > 0.0
        && body.angular_radius_rad.is_finite()
        && (0.0..=PI / 2.0).contains(&body.angular_radius_rad)
}

fn direction_altitude(
    direction: [f64; 3],
    altitude: f64,
) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let mut output = direction_zero(direction)?;
    output[3] = finite_f32(altitude)?;
    Ok(output)
}

fn direction_radius(direction: [f64; 3], radius: f64) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let mut output = direction_zero(direction)?;
    output[3] = finite_f32(radius)?;
    Ok(output)
}

fn direction_zero(direction: [f64; 3]) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let normalized = normalize(direction).ok_or(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid)?;
    Ok([
        finite_f32(normalized[0])?,
        finite_f32(normalized[1])?,
        finite_f32(normalized[2])?,
        0.0,
    ])
}

fn direction_fraction(
    direction: [f64; 3],
    fraction: f64,
) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let mut output = direction_zero(direction)?;
    output[3] = finite_f32(fraction)?;
    Ok(output)
}

fn color_zero(color: [f32; 3]) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    if !color.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite() && *value >= 0.0) {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SettingsInvalid);
    }
    Ok([color[0], color[1], color[2], 0.0])
}

fn color_fraction(color: [f32; 3], fraction: f32) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let mut output = color_zero(color)?;
    output[3] = fraction.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    Ok(output)
}

fn color_exposure(color: [f32; 3], exposure: f32) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    if !exposure.is_finite() || exposure <= 0.0 {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SettingsInvalid);
    }
    let mut output = color_zero(color)?;
    output[3] = exposure;
    Ok(output)
}

fn color_altitude(color: [f32; 3], altitude: f64) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let mut output = color_zero(color)?;
    output[3] = finite_f32(altitude)?;
    Ok(output)
}

fn color_visibility(color: [f32; 3], visibility: f32) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    if !visibility.is_finite() {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid);
    }
    let mut output = color_zero(color)?;
    output[3] = visibility.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    Ok(output)
}

fn matrix4(matrix: [[f64; 3]; 3]) -> Result<[[f32; 4]; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    if !matrix.iter().flatten().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid);
    }
    let columns: [[f64; 4]; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|column| {
        [matrix[0][column], matrix[1][column], matrix[2][column], 0.0]
    });
    let output = [columns[0], columns[1], columns[2], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]];
    output
        .iter()
        .flatten()
        .all(|value| value.is_finite() && value.abs() <= f32::MAX as f64)
        .then(|| output.map(|column| column.map(|value| value as f32)))
        .ok_or(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid)
}

fn transfer_route(view: RenderViewFrame) -> u32 {
    u32::from(!view.srgb_surface)
}

fn finite_f32(value: f64) -> Result<f32, EnvironmentFrameError> {
    if !value.is_finite() || value.abs() > f32::MAX as f64 {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid);
    }
    Ok(value as f32)
}

fn valid_vector(values: impl IntoIterator<Item = f64>) -> bool {
    values.into_iter().all(f64::is_finite)
}

fn normalize(vector: [f64; 3]) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let length = length(vector);
    (length.is_finite() && length > 1.0e-15).then(|| vector.map(|value| value / length))
}

fn length(vector: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    vector.iter().map(|value| value * value).sum::<f64>().sqrt()
}

fn dot(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    (0..3).map(|axis| a[axis] * b[axis]).sum()
}

fn cross(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [
        a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
        a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
        a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
    ]
}

fn scale(vector: [f64; 3], factor: f64) -> [f64; 3] {
    vector.map(|value| value * factor)
}
fn add(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|axis| a[axis] + b[axis])
}

use super::super::Renderer;
use crate::{environment::EnvironmentFrameInput, session::SessionState};
use minimium_protocol::WorldContext;
use minimium_world::world::MembershipEpoch;

impl Renderer {
    /// Publish one immutable clock/context tuple for every consumer this frame.
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn update_environment_frame(&mut self) {
        if let Some(session) = self
            .connection
            .session()
            .filter(|session| session.state() == SessionState::Connected)
        {
            let frame = session.environment_frame();
            let context_matches = frame.context.is_some_and(|context| {
                Some(context) == self.game.session_context
                    && context.instance() == self.game.current_instance
                    && self
                        .game
                        .world_manifests
                        .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                        .is_some_and(|manifest| {
                            context.content_revision() == manifest.content_revision()
                        })
            });
            self.environment_frame = if context_matches {
                frame
            } else {
                EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable()
            };
            return;
        }

        if self.settings.demo {
            let manifest = self
                .game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .copied();
            self.environment_frame = match (self.demo_environment.as_ref(), manifest) {
                (Some(demo), Some(manifest)) => demo.frame(
                    manifest,
                    Some(WorldContext::new(
                        self.game.current_instance,
                        manifest.content_revision(),
                        MembershipEpoch::new(1).expect("local demo membership epoch is nonzero"),
                    )),
                ),
                _ => EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable(),
            };
        } else {
            self.environment_frame = EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/environment/halo.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="335" bytes="11106" original_lines="335" original_bytes="11106" minified="false" sha256="1913372329ce2c7c0d697b72c424d1b38d6748ba07811066b9dd6f1f7e188a21">>>
use super::{EnvironmentSettings, HaloSource, LocalBodyFrame, RenderViewFrame, MAX_HALO_BODIES};
use bytemuck::Zeroable;
use minimium_astronomy::{ObservedBody, SKY_MOON_ID, SKY_SUN_ID};
use std::f64::consts::PI;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u32)]
enum HaloShape {
    Sun = 0,
    Moon = 1,
    Emission = 2,
    Reflection = 3,
    Atmosphere = 4,
}

type HaloPreparation = ([HaloSource; MAX_HALO_BODIES], u32, [f32; 4]);

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct HaloContext {
    view: RenderViewFrame,
    sun: LocalBodyFrame,
    moon: LocalBodyFrame,
    overview_sun_direction: [f64; 3],
    overview_moon_direction: [f64; 3],
    moon_source: [f64; 3],
    profile: EnvironmentSettings,
}

pub(super) fn prepare_halos(
    sky: &minimium_astronomy::SkyState,
    view: RenderViewFrame,
    sun: LocalBodyFrame,
    moon: LocalBodyFrame,
    moon_source: [f64; 3],
    bodies: &[ObservedBody],
    profile: EnvironmentSettings,
) -> Result<HaloPreparation, super::EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let moon_orbit_world = super::orbit::moon_orbit_world(sky, view)?;
    let overview_moon_direction = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
        f64::from(moon_orbit_world[axis]) - view.camera_eye_world_m[axis]
    });
    let context = HaloContext {
        view,
        sun,
        moon,
        overview_sun_direction: sky.geocentric_sun_direction_world,
        overview_moon_direction,
        moon_source,
        profile,
    };
    let (sources, count) = build_halos(bodies, context);
    Ok((sources, count, moon_orbit_world))
}

fn build_halos(
    bodies: &[ObservedBody],
    context: HaloContext,
) -> ([HaloSource; MAX_HALO_BODIES], u32) {
    let mut candidates = bodies
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|body| source_for(*body, context))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| {
        right
            .1
            .total_cmp(&left.1)
            .then_with(|| left.0.cmp(&right.0))
    });

    let count = candidates.len().min(MAX_HALO_BODIES);
    let mut sources = [HaloSource::zeroed(); MAX_HALO_BODIES];
    for (slot, (_, _, source)) in candidates.into_iter().take(count).enumerate() {
        sources[slot] = source;
    }
    (sources, count as u32)
}

fn source_for(body: ObservedBody, context: HaloContext) -> Option<(u64, f32, HaloSource)> {
    let HaloContext {
        view,
        sun,
        moon,
        overview_sun_direction,
        overview_moon_direction,
        moon_source,
        profile,
    } = context;
    let is_sun = body.id == SKY_SUN_ID;
    let is_moon = body.id == SKY_MOON_ID;
    let (direction, visibility, source_direction, shape, phase, color, extent) = if is_sun {
        (
            if view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
                overview_sun_direction
            } else {
                sun.apparent_direction_world
            },
            if view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
                1.0
            } else {
                sun.visible_fraction
            },
            [0.0; 3],
            HaloShape::Sun,
            1.0,
            profile.halos.sun_rgb,
            profile.halos.sun_extent_rad,
        )
    } else if is_moon {
        (
            if view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
                overview_moon_direction
            } else {
                moon.apparent_direction_world
            },
            if view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
                1.0
            } else {
                moon.visible_fraction
            },
            moon_source,
            HaloShape::Moon,
            body.phase.clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32,
            profile.halos.moon_rgb,
            profile.halos.moon_extent_rad,
        )
    } else {
        if !body.visible || !body.phase.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        let emission = body.emitted_linear_rgb;
        let reflection = body.reflected_linear_rgb.map(|value| value * body.phase);
        let scattering = body.scattered_linear_rgb;
        let (color, shape) = dominant_profile(emission, reflection, scattering, profile)?;
        let up = normalize(view.camera_eye_world_m)?;
        let direction = normalize(body.direction_world)?;
        let altitude = dot(direction, up).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
        let horizon = if view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
            0.0
        } else {
            view_horizon_altitude(view)
        };
        let visibility = if view.kind == super::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
            1.0
        } else {
            visible_disk_fraction(altitude, body.angular_radius_rad, horizon)
        };
        let extent = (body.angular_radius_rad * profile.halos.body_extent_scale).clamp(
            profile.halos.min_body_extent_rad,
            profile.halos.max_body_extent_rad,
        );
        let source_direction = if shape == HaloShape::Reflection || shape == HaloShape::Atmosphere {
            overview_sun_direction
        } else {
            [0.0; 3]
        };
        (
            direction,
            visibility,
            source_direction,
            shape,
            body.phase.clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32,
            color,
            extent,
        )
    };
    if !body.visible && !is_sun && !is_moon {
        return None;
    }
    let direction = normalize(direction)?;
    let source_direction = normalize_or_zero(source_direction);
    if !visibility.is_finite() || visibility <= 0.0 {
        return None;
    }
    let visibility = visibility.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let importance = if is_sun {
        profile.halos.sun_importance
    } else if is_moon {
        profile.halos.moon_importance * visibility
    } else {
        color.into_iter().fold(0.0_f32, f32::max) * visibility
    };
    let source = HaloSource {
        direction_extent: [
            to_f32(direction[0])?,
            to_f32(direction[1])?,
            to_f32(direction[2])?,
            extent as f32,
        ],
        linear_rgb_visibility: [color[0], color[1], color[2], visibility],
        source_direction: [
            source_direction[0] as f32,
            source_direction[1] as f32,
            source_direction[2] as f32,
            0.0,
        ],
        parameters: [shape as u32 as f32, phase, 0.0, 0.0],
    };
    Some((body.id.get(), importance, source))
}

fn dominant_profile(
    emission: [f64; 3],
    reflection: [f64; 3],
    scattering: [f64; 3],
    profile: EnvironmentSettings,
) -> Option<([f32; 3], HaloShape)> {
    let candidates = [
        (
            emission,
            profile.halo_thresholds.emission,
            HaloShape::Emission,
        ),
        (
            reflection,
            profile.halo_thresholds.reflection,
            HaloShape::Reflection,
        ),
        (
            scattering,
            profile.halo_thresholds.atmosphere,
            HaloShape::Atmosphere,
        ),
    ];
    candidates
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(rgb, threshold, shape)| {
            let rgb = rgb.map(|value| value.max(0.0));
            let brightness = max_component(rgb);
            (brightness > threshold && brightness.is_finite()).then_some((rgb, shape, brightness))
        })
        .max_by(|a, b| a.2.total_cmp(&b.2))
        .and_then(|(rgb, shape, _)| {
            let color = rgb.map(|value| value.min(profile.halos.max_body_radiance) as f32);
            color
                .iter()
                .all(|value| value.is_finite())
                .then_some((color, shape))
        })
}

pub(super) fn visible_disk_fraction(altitude: f64, radius: f64, horizon: f64) -> f32 {
    if !altitude.is_finite() || !radius.is_finite() || radius <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let elevation = altitude - horizon;
    if elevation <= -radius {
        return 0.0;
    }
    if elevation >= radius {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let x = (elevation / radius).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
    (0.5 + (x.asin() + x * (1.0 - x * x).max(0.0).sqrt()) / PI) as f32
}

fn view_horizon_altitude(view: RenderViewFrame) -> f64 {
    let radius = view.game_planet_radius_m;
    let eye_radius = length(view.camera_eye_world_m);
    if radius <= 0.0 || eye_radius <= 0.0 || !eye_radius.is_finite() || eye_radius < radius {
        return 0.0;
    }
    -((1.0 - (radius / eye_radius).powi(2)).max(0.0).sqrt()).asin()
}

fn normalize(vector: [f64; 3]) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let length = length(vector);
    (length.is_finite() && length > 1.0e-15).then(|| vector.map(|value| value / length))
}

fn normalize_or_zero(vector: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    normalize(vector).unwrap_or([0.0; 3])
}

fn length(vector: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    vector.iter().map(|value| value * value).sum::<f64>().sqrt()
}

fn dot(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    (0..3).map(|axis| a[axis] * b[axis]).sum()
}

fn max_component(rgb: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    rgb.into_iter().fold(0.0_f64, f64::max)
}

fn to_f32(value: f64) -> Option<f32> {
    (value.is_finite() && value.abs() <= f64::from(f32::MAX)).then_some(value as f32)
}

// Protocol E004-04/05 will provide the server descriptor and context to this adapter.
use minimium_environment::sky::{
    resolve_sky_model, try_observer_frame, ObserverError, ObserverFrame, ObserverInput, SkyModel,
};
use minimium_environment::EnvironmentDescriptor;
use minimium_protocol::WorldContext;
use minimium_world::world::{Position3Mm, WorldManifest, WorldTopology};

#[allow(dead_code)]
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ObserverAdapter {
    scope: Option<ObserverScope>,
    frame: Option<ObserverFrame>,
}

/// Render-only reference for the bounded astronomy API. The optical model keeps
/// the actual uncapped camera separately, including its game-to-physical scale.
pub(super) fn camera_reference(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    view: minimium_renderer::RenderViewFrame,
    geography: Option<&dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>,
) -> Result<Position3Mm, ObserverError> {
    let eye = glam::DVec3::from_array(view.camera_eye_world_m);
    if !eye.is_finite() || eye.length() < 1.0 {
        return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
    }
    let radius = view.game_planet_radius_m;
    let actual = Position3Mm(eye.to_array().map(|v| (v * 1000.0).round() as i64));
    let offset = if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet().filter(|p| p.mode == 1) {
        let reference = minimium_procgen::earth_height_reference(actual, definition, geography)?;
        let scale = definition.height_scale_permille as f64 / 1000.0;
        let physical_height = if definition.peak_relief.enabled() {
            reference.physical_anchor_m
                + (eye.length() - radius - reference.baseline_game_mm as f64 / 1000.0) / scale
        } else {
            (eye.length() - radius) / scale
        }
        .clamp(-1000.0, 80000.0);
        reference.baseline_game_mm as f64 / 1000.0 + physical_height - reference.physical_anchor_m
    } else {
        (eye.length() - radius).clamp(-1000.0, 80000.0)
    };
    Ok(Position3Mm(
        (eye.normalize() * (radius + offset))
            .to_array()
            .map(|v| (v * 1000.0).round() as i64),
    ))
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
struct ObserverScope {
    context: WorldContext,
    manifest: WorldManifest,
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
impl ObserverAdapter {
    /// Builds an observer from a precise supplied position. Render callers may
    /// supply a camera reference; authoritative player observations stay separate.
    pub fn update(
        &mut self,
        context: WorldContext,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
        feet_position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
        eye_height_mm: u32,
        geography: Option<&dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>,
    ) -> Result<Option<ObserverFrame>, ObserverError> {
        let scope = ObserverScope { context, manifest };
        if self.scope != Some(scope) {
            self.frame = None;
        }
        self.scope = Some(scope);
        if context.content_revision() != manifest.content_revision() {
            self.frame = None;
            return Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch);
        }
        let result = self.build_frame(
            manifest,
            descriptor,
            feet_position_mm,
            eye_height_mm,
            geography,
        );
        match result {
            Ok(frame) => {
                self.frame = frame;
                Ok(frame)
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.frame = None;
                Err(error)
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn frame(&self) -> Option<ObserverFrame> {
        self.frame
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.scope = None;
        self.frame = None;
    }

    fn build_frame(
        &self,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
        feet_position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
        eye_height_mm: u32,
        geography: Option<&dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>,
    ) -> Result<Option<ObserverFrame>, ObserverError> {
        if manifest.topology() != WorldTopology::Planet
            && descriptor.profile() != minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile::Interior
        {
            return Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch);
        }
        let model = resolve_sky_model(manifest, descriptor)?;
        if model == SkyModel::None {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let feet_position_mm = feet_position_mm.ok_or(ObserverError::MissingPrecisePosition)?;
        let definition = manifest.planet();
        let game_radius_mm = if let Some(definition) = definition {
            if !definition.is_valid() {
                return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
            }
            definition.radius_mm
        } else {
            if manifest.topology() != WorldTopology::Planet {
                return Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch);
            }
            minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(manifest).radius_mm()
        };
        let height_reference = if model == SkyModel::EarthGeoreferencedV1 {
            let definition = definition.ok_or(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet)?;
            Some(minimium_procgen::earth_height_reference(
                feet_position_mm,
                definition,
                geography,
            )?)
        } else {
            None
        };
        try_observer_frame(ObserverInput {
            feet_position_mm,
            eye_height_mm,
            model,
            game_radius_mm,
            planet_definition: definition,
            height_reference,
        })
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/environment/orbit.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="24" bytes="933" original_lines="24" original_bytes="933" minified="false" sha256="27b760add5607ccd2f0053d582b27ddd79f06fda4142ccd753cb8bfcee0d31ff">>>
use super::{adapter::EnvironmentFrameError, RenderViewFrame};
use minimium_astronomy::{SkyState, MOON_MEAN_RADIUS_M};

const EARTH_REFERENCE_RADIUS_M: f64 = 6_371_000.0;

/// Scale both the Moon's orbital position and physical radius by the same
/// Earth-to-game radius ratio, preserving their angular relationship.
pub(super) fn moon_orbit_world(
    sky: &SkyState,
    view: RenderViewFrame,
) -> Result<[f32; 4], EnvironmentFrameError> {
    let scale = view.game_planet_radius_m / EARTH_REFERENCE_RADIUS_M;
    let position = sky.geocentric_moon_position_world_m;
    let orbit = [
        (position[0] * scale) as f32,
        (position[1] * scale) as f32,
        (position[2] * scale) as f32,
        (MOON_MEAN_RADIUS_M * scale) as f32,
    ];
    if !orbit.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) || orbit[3] <= 0.0 {
        return Err(EnvironmentFrameError::SkyStateInvalid);
    }
    Ok(orbit)
}

use super::{EnvironmentFrame, StarFrameStamp};
use crate::renderer::{environment_gpu, GpuResources};
use minimium_renderer::stars::{StarInstanceGpu, STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT};
use minimium_renderer::RenderFrame;

/// One immutable CPU result, consumed only after acquiring a surface frame.
/// A skipped frame drops this bounded batch; the unchanged GPU stamp requests
/// preparation again on the next frame instead of publishing an unuploaded epoch.
pub(in crate::renderer) struct PreparedEnvironmentFrame {
    pub(in crate::renderer) frame: EnvironmentFrame,
    pub(in crate::renderer) render_frame: RenderFrame,
    stars: Option<PreparedStarUpload>,
}

pub(in crate::renderer) struct PreparedStarUpload {
    pub(in crate::renderer) instances: Box<[StarInstanceGpu; STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT]>,
    pub(in crate::renderer) stamp: StarFrameStamp,
}

impl PreparedEnvironmentFrame {
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn new(
        frame: EnvironmentFrame,
        stars: Option<PreparedStarUpload>,
    ) -> Self {
        let uniform = environment_gpu::environment_uniform(&frame);
        let render_frame = RenderFrame::new(
            frame.render_view,
            frame.camera_uniform,
            uniform,
            frame.halo_count,
        );
        Self {
            frame,
            render_frame,
            stars,
        }
    }

    pub(in crate::renderer) fn with_ui_vertices(
        mut self,
        vertices: Vec<minimium_renderer::UiVertex>,
    ) -> Self {
        self.render_frame = self.render_frame.with_ui_vertices(vertices);
        self
    }

    /// Maps the runtime's immutable client view into this renderer-owned frame.
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn with_client_view(
        mut self,
        view: &minimium_client_runtime::ClientView<'_>,
    ) -> Self {
        self.render_frame = self.render_frame.with_client_state(
            minimium_renderer::render_frame::ClientFrameState {
                world_instance: view.world_instance,
                player_position_m: view.player_position_m,
                health: view.health,
                sectors_ready: view.sectors_ready,
            },
        );
        self
    }

    pub(in crate::renderer) fn take_ui_vertices(&mut self) -> Vec<minimium_renderer::UiVertex> {
        self.render_frame.take_ui_vertices()
    }

    /// Uploads the app-owned, epoch-stamped star batch when it matches this frame.
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn upload_stars(&self, gpu: &mut GpuResources) {
        if let Some(stars) = &self.stars {
            if self.frame.diagnostics.star_frame == Some(stars.stamp) {
                gpu.stars.upload(&gpu.queue, &stars.instances);
                gpu.uploaded_star_stamp = Some(stars.stamp);
            }
        }
    }
}

use super::super::Renderer;
use super::{
    EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentSettings, PreparedEnvironmentFrame, PreparedStarUpload,
    RenderViewFrame, SkyFrameInput, StarFrameStamp,
};
use minimium_astronomy::{SkyInvalidation, SkySampleContext};
use minimium_environment::sky::{resolve_sky_model, SkyModel, DEFAULT_OBSERVER_EYE_HEIGHT_MM};
use minimium_environment::{
    time::{ClockRevision, WorldTimeMs},
    {AstronomyModelRevision, CatalogueId},
};
use minimium_protocol::WorldContext;
use minimium_world::world::Position3Mm;

impl Renderer {
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn update_render_environment(
        &mut self,
        render_view: RenderViewFrame,
    ) -> PreparedEnvironmentFrame {
        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        let stars = self.update_render_environment_inner(render_view);
        let prepared = PreparedEnvironmentFrame::new(self.render_environment_frame.clone(), stars);
        self.metrics
            .frame_stats
            .record_environment_cpu(started.elapsed());
        let counters = self.sky_calculator.diagnostics();
        self.metrics.frame_stats.set_astronomy_counters(
            counters.ephemeris_evaluations,
            counters.ephemeris_cache_hits,
            counters.star_epoch_updates,
            counters.star_epoch_cache_hits,
        );
        prepared
    }

    fn update_render_environment_inner(
        &mut self,
        render_view: RenderViewFrame,
    ) -> Option<PreparedStarUpload> {
        if !self.gpu.scene_visible {
            self.environment_observer.clear();
            self.render_environment_frame = EnvironmentFrame::unavailable(render_view);
            self.environment_error = None;
            return None;
        }
        let input = self.environment_frame;
        let Some(descriptor) = input.descriptor else {
            self.environment_observer.clear();
            self.render_environment_frame = EnvironmentFrame::unavailable(render_view);
            self.environment_error = None;
            return None;
        };
        let Some(context) = input.context else {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "active world context is unavailable");
            return None;
        };
        let Some(utc_ms) = input
            .render_world_utc_ms
            .filter(|_| input.estimated_world_utc_ms.is_some())
        else {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "world UTC is unavailable");
            return None;
        };
        let Some(revision) = input
            .revision
            .and_then(|value| ClockRevision::new(value).ok())
        else {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "clock revision is invalid");
            return None;
        };
        let Ok(utc_ms) = WorldTimeMs::new(utc_ms) else {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "world UTC is outside the astronomy range");
            return None;
        };
        let Some(manifest) = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .copied()
        else {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "world manifest is unavailable");
            return None;
        };
        if context.instance() != self.game.current_instance
            || context.content_revision() != manifest.content_revision()
        {
            self.publish_unavailable(
                render_view,
                "world context does not match the active manifest",
            );
            return None;
        }
        if !self.descriptor_matches_catalogue(descriptor) {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "environment model or catalogue does not match");
            return None;
        }

        match resolve_sky_model(manifest, descriptor) {
            Ok(SkyModel::None) => {
                match EnvironmentFrame::interior(context, revision, descriptor, render_view) {
                    Ok(frame) => self.publish_environment(frame),
                    Err(error) => self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string()),
                }
                None
            }
            Ok(_) => self.build_planet_frame(
                context,
                descriptor,
                revision,
                utc_ms,
                manifest,
                render_view,
                self.connection
                    .session()
                    .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
            ),
            Err(error) => {
                self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                None
            }
        }
    }

    fn build_planet_frame(
        &mut self,
        context: WorldContext,
        descriptor: minimium_environment::EnvironmentDescriptor,
        revision: ClockRevision,
        utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
        manifest: minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
        render_view: RenderViewFrame,
        geography: Option<std::sync::Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
    ) -> Option<PreparedStarUpload> {
        let mut feet_position_mm = self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm.or_else(|| {
            (self.environment_frame.quality
                == crate::environment::SynchronizationQuality::LocalDemo)
                .then(|| demo_position_mm(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position))
                .flatten()
        });
        let mut eye_height = DEFAULT_OBSERVER_EYE_HEIGHT_MM;
        if manifest.planet().is_some() {
            match super::observer::camera_reference(manifest, render_view, geography.as_deref()) {
                Ok(position) => {
                    feet_position_mm = Some(position);
                    eye_height = 0;
                }
                Err(error) => {
                    self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                    return None;
                }
            }
        }
        let observer = match self.environment_observer.update(
            context,
            manifest,
            descriptor,
            feet_position_mm,
            eye_height,
            geography.as_deref(),
        ) {
            Ok(Some(observer)) => observer,
            Ok(None) => {
                self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "planet observer is unavailable");
                return None;
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                return None;
            }
        };
        let sample = SkySampleContext {
            utc_ms,
            clock_revision: revision,
            world_context_key: minimium_astronomy::AstronomyContextKey::new(
                context.instance(),
                context.content_revision(),
                context.membership_epoch(),
            ),
            observer_model_revision: observer.height_reference_revision,
        };
        let sky = match self
            .sky_calculator
            .evaluate(sample, observer, SkyInvalidation::None)
        {
            Ok(sky) => sky,
            Err(error) => {
                self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                return None;
            }
        };
        if sky.observer_model_revision != observer.height_reference_revision {
            self.publish_unavailable(
                render_view,
                "sky result does not match the observer profile",
            );
            return None;
        }
        let Some(catalogue) = self.sky_catalogue.as_ref() else {
            self.publish_unavailable(render_view, "embedded star catalog is unavailable");
            return None;
        };
        let corrected = match self
            .sky_calculator
            .update_star_epoch(utc_ms, catalogue.astrometry())
        {
            Ok(directions) => directions,
            Err(error) => {
                self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                return None;
            }
        };
        let star_stamp = StarFrameStamp {
            context,
            clock_revision: revision,
            utc_day: utc_ms.get().div_euclid(86_400_000),
            epoch_revision: corrected.star_epoch_revision,
        };
        let star_upload = if self.gpu.uploaded_star_stamp != Some(star_stamp) {
            let instances = match catalogue.prepare_gpu_instances(&corrected) {
                Ok(instances) => instances,
                Err(error) => {
                    self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                    return None;
                }
            };
            Some(PreparedStarUpload {
                instances,
                stamp: star_stamp,
            })
        } else {
            None
        };
        let demo_catalogue = self
            .demo_universe_enabled
            .then(minimium_game_sample::demo_universe_catalog);
        let catalog_observer =
            minimium_renderer::catalogue::observer_epoch_position(&sky, observer.game_eye_world_m);
        let time_seconds = utc_ms.get() as f64 / 1000.0;
        let catalog_input =
            demo_catalogue.map(|demo| (&demo.catalog, demo.system, catalog_observer, time_seconds));
        let observations = minimium_astronomy::observed_bodies(&sky, catalog_input);
        match EnvironmentFrame::from_sky_state(
            &sky,
            SkyFrameInput {
                observer,
                context,
                clock_revision: revision,
                descriptor,
                render_view,
                observed_bodies: observations,
                settings: EnvironmentSettings::planetary(),
            },
        ) {
            Ok(mut frame) => {
                frame.diagnostics.star_frame = Some(star_stamp);
                self.publish_environment(frame);
                star_upload
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.publish_unavailable(render_view, error.to_string());
                None
            }
        }
    }

    fn descriptor_matches_catalogue(
        &self,
        descriptor: minimium_environment::EnvironmentDescriptor,
    ) -> bool {
        let Some(catalogue) = self.sky_catalogue.as_ref() else {
            return false;
        };
        let identity = catalogue.identity();
        descriptor.astronomy_model_revision() == AstronomyModelRevision::CURRENT
            && descriptor.catalogue_id() == CatalogueId::CURRENT
            && identity.catalogue_id == descriptor.catalogue_id().get()
            && identity.sha256 == *descriptor.catalogue_sha256().as_bytes()
    }

    fn publish_environment(&mut self, frame: EnvironmentFrame) {
        self.render_environment_frame = frame;
        self.environment_error = None;
    }

    fn publish_unavailable(&mut self, view: RenderViewFrame, reason: impl Into<String>) {
        let reason = reason.into();
        if self.environment_error.as_deref() != Some(reason.as_str()) {
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_error(format!("Environment unavailable: {reason}"));
        }
        self.environment_error = Some(reason);
        self.render_environment_frame = EnvironmentFrame::unavailable(view);
    }
}

fn demo_position_mm(position: [f32; 3]) -> Option<Position3Mm> {
    let mut millimetres = [0_i64; 3];
    for (output, coordinate) in millimetres.iter_mut().zip(position) {
        let value = f64::from(coordinate) * 1000.0;
        if !value.is_finite() || value.abs() > i64::MAX as f64 {
            return None;
        }
        *output = value.round() as i64;
    }
    Some(Position3Mm(millimetres))
}
