<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="430" bytes="17324" original_lines="430" original_bytes="17324" minified="false" sha256="b22784d2d2590ad8dcf36595d07b0d28df9b192379775d977cad2f4c0aeeb204">>>
use super::{sector_scene::ClientSectorScene, GpuResources};
use minimium_renderer::geometry::Vertex;
use std::{error::Error, sync::Arc};
use winit::{dpi::PhysicalSize, window::Window};

impl GpuResources {
    pub(super) fn cache_sector_scene(
        &mut self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
        scene: &ClientSectorScene,
    ) -> bool {
        if scene.origin != self.render_origin {
            return false;
        }
        let result = if let Some(prepared) = &scene.prepared {
            self.world_geometry.cache_prepared(
                &self.device,
                instance,
                scene.generation,
                scene.content_revision,
                &prepared.patches,
                if self.active_world_instance == instance {
                    &self.active_sector_keys
                } else {
                    &[]
                },
            )
        } else if scene.render_sectors.is_empty() {
            return false;
        } else {
            self.world_geometry.cache_scene(
                &self.device,
                instance,
                scene.generation,
                scene.content_revision,
                &scene.render_sectors,
                self.render_origin,
                None,
            )
        };
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(result.released_bytes)
            .saturating_add(result.allocated_bytes);
        result.ready
    }

    pub(super) fn activate_sector_scene(
        &mut self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
        scene: &ClientSectorScene,
    ) -> bool {
        if scene
            .render_sectors
            .iter()
            .any(|(key, lod, _)| !self.world_geometry.contains(instance, *key, *lod))
        {
            return false;
        }
        self.active_sector_keys = scene
            .render_sectors
            .iter()
            .map(|(key, lod, _)| (*key, *lod))
            .collect();
        self.active_world_instance = instance;
        true
    }

    pub(super) fn release_world_sectors(
        &mut self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
    ) {
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(self.world_geometry.release_world(instance));
        if self.shadow_map_instance == Some(instance) {
            self.release_shadow_map_casters();
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn update_remote_vertices(&mut self, vertices: &[Vertex]) {
        self.remote_vertices.upload(&self.queue, vertices);
    }

    pub(super) fn set_render_origin(&mut self, origin: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
        if self.render_origin == origin {
            return false;
        }
        let delta = std::array::from_fn(|axis| self.render_origin[axis] - origin[axis]);
        self.render_origin = origin;
        if !self.world_geometry.rebase(&self.device, &self.queue, delta) {
            self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
                .fixed_gpu_bytes
                .saturating_sub(self.world_geometry.clear());
            self.active_sector_keys.clear();
        }
        self.shadow_gpu.clear_player_casters();
        self.shadow_remote_complete = false;
        self.shadow_remote_dirty = true;
        self.release_shadow_map_casters();
        self.shadow_state
            .invalidate(super::shadows::ShadowInvalidReason::StaleContext);
        true
    }

    pub(super) async fn new(
        window: Arc<Window>,
        vertices: &[Vertex],
        requested_quality: minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality,
    ) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn Error>> {
        let size = window.inner_size();
        let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle());
        let surface = instance.create_surface(window)?;
        let adapter = instance
            .request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
                power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::HighPerformance,
                compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
                force_fallback_adapter: false,
                apply_limit_buckets: false,
            })
            .await?;
        let adapter_info = adapter.get_info();
        eprintln!(
            "renderer_adapter name={:?} backend={:?} type={:?} preference=high_performance",
            adapter_info.name, adapter_info.backend, adapter_info.device_type
        );
        let shadow_usage =
            wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING;
        let shadow_format =
            minimium_renderer::shadow_target::supported_format(&adapter, shadow_usage)
                .ok_or("graphics adapter has no sampleable depth texture format")?;
        let shadow_limit_supported = adapter.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
            >= requested_quality.profile().shadow_resolution;
        let adapter_fallback_reason = (requested_quality.profile().shadows_enabled
            && (shadow_format != wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float || !shadow_limit_supported))
            .then_some("adapter_limit_or_depth32float_unsupported");
        let initial_quality = if adapter_fallback_reason.is_some() {
            minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality::Low
        } else {
            requested_quality
        };
        let mut required_limits = wgpu::Limits::downlevel_defaults();
        required_limits.max_color_attachment_bytes_per_sample = adapter
            .limits()
            .max_color_attachment_bytes_per_sample
            .min(32);
        required_limits.max_texture_dimension_2d =
            adapter.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d.min(4096);
        let (device, queue) = adapter
            .request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
                label: Some("minimium-device"),
                required_features: adapter.features()
                    & (wgpu::Features::TEXTURE_COMPRESSION_BC | wgpu::Features::TIMESTAMP_QUERY),
                required_limits,
                experimental_features: Default::default(),
                memory_hints: wgpu::MemoryHints::MemoryUsage,
                trace: wgpu::Trace::Off,
            })
            .await?;
        let config = surface
            .get_default_config(&adapter, size.width.max(1), size.height.max(1))
            .ok_or("graphics adapter does not support this surface")?;
        surface.configure(&device, &config);
        let hdr_format = adapter.get_texture_format_features(wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float);
        let hdr_usage = wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING;
        let hdr_enabled = adapter
            .get_downlevel_capabilities()
            .flags
            .contains(wgpu::DownlevelFlags::COMPUTE_SHADERS)
            && hdr_format.allowed_usages.contains(hdr_usage)
            && hdr_format
                .flags
                .contains(wgpu::TextureFormatFeatureFlags::BLENDABLE)
            && adapter.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d >= size.width.max(size.height);
        if !hdr_enabled {
            eprintln!(
                "renderer_hdr mode=ldr fallback_reason=rgba16float_unavailable_or_surface_limit"
            );
        }
        let scene_color_format = if hdr_enabled {
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float
        } else if !super::gpu_surface::is_srgb(config.format) {
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm
        } else {
            config.format
        };
        let output_encoder =
            (hdr_enabled || !super::gpu_surface::is_srgb(config.format)).then(|| {
                minimium_renderer::OutputEncoder::new(
                    &device,
                    [size.width, size.height],
                    config.format,
                    scene_color_format,
                    hdr_enabled,
                )
            });
        let atmosphere_resources =
            minimium_renderer::atmosphere_resources::AtmosphereResources::new(
                &device,
                &queue,
                hdr_enabled,
            );
        let frame_bindings = minimium_renderer::gpu_bindings::EnvironmentGpuBindings::create(
            &device,
            &atmosphere_resources,
        );
        let milky_way = minimium_renderer::MilkyWayGpu::new(&device, &queue);
        let environment_pipelines = minimium_renderer::EnvironmentPipelines::new(
            &device,
            &frame_bindings.layout,
            &milky_way.layout,
            scene_color_format,
        );
        let celestial_halo = minimium_renderer::CelestialHaloGpu::new(
            &device,
            &frame_bindings.layout,
            scene_color_format,
        );
        let stars =
            minimium_renderer::StarGpu::new(&device, &frame_bindings.layout, scene_color_format);
        let moon =
            minimium_renderer::MoonGpu::new(&device, &frame_bindings.layout, scene_color_format);
        let moon_sphere = minimium_renderer::MoonSphereGpu::new(
            &device,
            &frame_bindings.layout,
            scene_color_format,
        );
        let depth_view = super::gpu_surface::create_depth_view(&device, size);
        let cloud_gpu = super::clouds::CloudGpu::new(
            &device,
            &adapter,
            &frame_bindings.layout,
            scene_color_format,
            &depth_view,
            [size.width, size.height],
        );
        eprintln!(
            "weather_transparency={} buffer_limit_bytes={} target_limit_bytes={}",
            if cloud_gpu.oit {
                "weighted_blended_oit"
            } else {
                "sorted_face_alpha"
            },
            minimium_renderer::CloudGpu::BUFFER_BYTES,
            minimium_renderer::cloud_targets::MAX_TARGET_BYTES,
        );
        let atmosphere_gpu = super::atmosphere_gpu::AtmosphereGpu::new(
            &device,
            &queue,
            &frame_bindings.layout,
            scene_color_format,
            &depth_view,
            atmosphere_resources,
        );
        let mut shadow_gpu = minimium_renderer::ShadowGpu::new(
            &device,
            minimium_renderer::ShadowSettings::for_quality(initial_quality),
            shadow_format,
        )?;
        if adapter_fallback_reason.is_some() {
            shadow_gpu.fallback_reason = adapter_fallback_reason;
        }
        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("minimium-world-shadow-pipeline-layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[
                Some(&frame_bindings.layout),
                Some(&shadow_gpu.empty_layout),
                Some(&shadow_gpu.group2_layout),
            ],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let pipeline = minimium_renderer::world_pipeline::create(
            &device,
            &pipeline_layout,
            scene_color_format,
        );
        let compressed = device
            .features()
            .contains(wgpu::Features::TEXTURE_COMPRESSION_BC)
            && device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d >= 4096;
        let material_path = std::env::current_exe()?
            .parent()
            .ok_or("client executable has no directory")?
            .join("materials/sample-v1");
        let material_path = if material_path.exists() {
            material_path
        } else {
            std::path::PathBuf::from(env!("MINIMIUM_BUILT_MATERIALS"))
        };
        let package =
            minimium_asset_io::materials::MaterialPackage::open(&material_path, compressed)?;
        let terrain_gpu = minimium_renderer::terrain_gpu::TerrainGpu::new(
            &device,
            &queue,
            &frame_bindings.layout,
            &shadow_gpu.group2_layout,
            scene_color_format,
            &package.manifest,
            package.variant,
            &package.maps,
        )?;
        eprintln!(
            "terrain_materials resident_edge=2048 layers=6 gpu_mib={:.1}",
            terrain_gpu.bytes as f64 / 1048576.0
        );
        let ui = minimium_renderer::ui_pipeline::UiGpuResources::new(
            &device,
            &queue,
            scene_color_format,
            config.format,
            super::gpu_surface::is_srgb(config.format),
            hdr_enabled,
            &crate::console::font_atlas_pixels(),
            [
                crate::console::ATLAS_WIDTH as u32,
                crate::console::ATLAS_HEIGHT as u32,
            ],
            super::UI_VERTEX_CAPACITY,
        );
        let initial_world = minimium_renderer::geometry_gpu::StaticVertexBuffer::new(
            &device,
            "sample-world-geometry",
            vertices,
        );
        let remote_vertices = minimium_renderer::geometry_gpu::DynamicVertexBuffer::new(
            &device,
            "network-player-vertices",
            512 * 36,
        );
        let fixed_gpu_bytes = terrain_gpu.bytes
            + frame_bindings.camera_buffer.size()
            + frame_bindings.environment_buffer.size()
            + initial_world.size_bytes()
            + remote_vertices.size_bytes()
            + shadow_gpu.gpu_bytes()
            + ui.vertex_buffer.size()
            + stars.buffer.size()
            + minimium_renderer::MilkyWayGpu::BYTES
            + atmosphere_gpu.bytes()
            + cloud_gpu.bytes()
            + output_encoder
                .as_ref()
                .map_or(0, |output| output.size_bytes())
            + (crate::console::ATLAS_WIDTH * crate::console::ATLAS_HEIGHT) as u64;
        let world_geometry =
            minimium_renderer::world_geometry_gpu::WorldGeometryGpu::new(&device, hdr_enabled);
        Ok(Self {
            surface,
            device,
            queue,
            config,
            scene_color_format,
            hdr_enabled,
            pipeline,
            terrain_gpu,
            frame_layout: frame_bindings.layout,
            shadow_gpu,
            shadow_state: super::shadows::ShadowState::default(),
            environment_pipelines,
            milky_way,
            celestial_halo,
            stars,
            uploaded_star_stamp: None,
            moon,
            moon_sphere,
            atmosphere_gpu,
            cloud_gpu,
            ui,
            initial_world,
            remote_vertices,
            shadow_remote_complete: true,
            shadow_remote_dirty: false,
            camera_buffer: frame_bindings.camera_buffer,
            environment_buffer: frame_bindings.environment_buffer,
            camera_bind_group: frame_bindings.bind_group,
            depth_view,
            size,
            fixed_gpu_bytes,
            world_geometry,
            active_sector_keys: Vec::new(),
            active_world_instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(1)
                .expect("primary world ID is nonzero"),
            render_origin: [0.0; 3],
            shadow_map_instance: None,
            shadow_map_fingerprint: None,
            shadow_map_center: None,
            shadow_map_radius: None,
            overview_buffers: minimium_renderer::overview_gpu::OverviewGpuBuffers::default(),
            environment_draw_calls: super::sky::EnvironmentDrawCalls::default(),
            last_shadow_prepare_cpu: None,
            last_environment_upload_cpu: None,
            overview_active: false,
            overview_planet: false,
            scene_visible: true,
            output_encoder,
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn resize(&mut self, size: PhysicalSize<u32>) {
        if size.width == 0 || size.height == 0 {
            return;
        }
        self.size = size;
        self.config.width = size.width;
        self.config.height = size.height;
        self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
        self.depth_view = super::gpu_surface::create_depth_view(&self.device, size);
        let old_atmosphere_bytes = self.atmosphere_gpu.bytes();
        self.atmosphere_gpu.resize(&self.device, &self.depth_view);
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes =
            self.fixed_gpu_bytes.saturating_sub(old_atmosphere_bytes) + self.atmosphere_gpu.bytes();
        let cloud_bytes = self.cloud_gpu.bytes();
        self.cloud_gpu
            .resize(&self.device, &self.depth_view, [size.width, size.height]);
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(cloud_bytes)
            .saturating_add(self.cloud_gpu.bytes());
        if let Some(output) = &mut self.output_encoder {
            let old_size = output.size_bytes();
            output.resize(&self.device, [size.width, size.height]);
            self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
                .fixed_gpu_bytes
                .saturating_sub(old_size)
                .saturating_add(output.size_bytes());
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/init.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="230" bytes="9456" original_lines="230" original_bytes="9456" minified="false" sha256="6b1c08990ca85f3f3dc4f61c21d41205989eb80c4a4dde17c44d8e45b0f9e76c">>>
use super::*;

pub(super) struct RendererSetup {
    pub(super) window: Arc<Window>,
    pub(super) map: WorldMap,
    pub(super) world_catalog:
        std::collections::HashMap<minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId, WorldMap>,
    pub(super) world_manifests:
        std::collections::HashMap<minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest>,
    pub(super) profile_id: PlayerProfileId,
    pub(super) data_dir: PathBuf,
    pub(super) map_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub(super) world_definition_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub(super) threads: crate::options::ThreadLane,
    pub(super) sky_quality: minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality,
    pub(super) require_earth: bool,
    pub(super) demo: bool,
}

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) async fn new(setup: RendererSetup) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn Error>> {
        let RendererSetup {
            window,
            map,
            world_catalog,
            world_manifests,
            profile_id,
            data_dir,
            map_path,
            world_definition_path,
            threads,
            sky_quality,
            require_earth,
            demo,
        } = setup;
        let map_fingerprint = map.fingerprint();
        let current_instance = world_catalog
            .iter()
            .find_map(|(instance, candidate)| {
                (candidate.fingerprint() == map_fingerprint).then_some(*instance)
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(1)
                    .expect("primary world identifier is nonzero")
            });
        let current_manifest = world_manifests
            .get(&current_instance)
            .copied()
            .ok_or("initial world has no generation manifest")?;
        let mut sector_cache = sector_scene::ClientSectorCache::new();
        let initial_scene = sector_cache.ensure_scene(
            current_instance,
            current_manifest,
            map.spawn(),
            minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView::legacy(map.spawn()),
            [0.0; 3],
            &world_catalog,
            &world_manifests,
            None,
        );
        let vertices: Vec<_> = initial_scene
            .as_ref()
            .into_iter()
            .flat_map(|scene| scene.sectors.iter())
            .flat_map(|(_, geometry)| sector_geometry(geometry))
            .collect();
        let mut gpu = GpuResources::new(window, &vertices, sky_quality).await?;

use super::*;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn prepare_session_materials(&mut self) {
        let Some(session) = self
            .connection
            .session_mut()
            .filter(|s| s.content_awaiting_gpu())
        else {
            return;
        };
        self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
        self.connection_status = "Preparing terrain materials".into();
        let compressed = self
            .gpu
            .device
            .features()
            .contains(wgpu::Features::TEXTURE_COMPRESSION_BC)
            && self.gpu.device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d >= 4096;
        let package = session.take_material_package().map(Ok).unwrap_or_else(|| {
            let installed = std::env::current_exe()
                .ok()
                .and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|p| p.join("materials/sample-v1")));
            let path = installed
                .filter(|p| p.exists())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(env!("MINIMIUM_BUILT_MATERIALS")));
            minimium_asset_io::materials::MaterialPackage::open(&path, compressed)
        });
        let result = package.and_then(|package| {
            self.gpu.terrain_gpu.release_materials();
            minimium_renderer::terrain_gpu::TerrainGpu::new(
                &self.gpu.device,
                &self.gpu.queue,
                &self.gpu.frame_layout,
                &self.gpu.shadow_gpu.group2_layout,
                self.gpu.scene_color_format,
                &package.manifest,
                package.variant,
                &package.maps,
            )
        });
        match result {
            Ok(mut resources) => {
                resources.uniform.debug = self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug;
                self.gpu.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
                    .gpu
                    .fixed_gpu_bytes
                    .saturating_sub(self.gpu.terrain_gpu.bytes)
                    + resources.bytes;
                self.gpu.terrain_gpu = resources;
                if let Err(error) = session.finish_content() {
                    self.fail_connection(error.to_string());
                }
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.fail_connection(format!("Terrain materials: {error}; use connect to retry"))
            }
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/overview.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="319" bytes="12736" original_lines="319" original_bytes="12736" minified="false" sha256="d122f8d54be0238ca80c878d1598e1665b3e1ac9e6efb07dbe22551772785c8c">>>
use super::*;
use minimium_procgen::SectorGeometry;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn is_earth_world(&self) -> bool {
        self.game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .is_some_and(|manifest| manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1))
    }

    pub(super) fn toggle_overview(&mut self) {
        if self.overview_open {
            self.overview_open = false;
            self.gpu.overview_active = false;
            self.gpu.overview_planet = false;
            self.last_render_position = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
            self.overview_dragging = false;
            self.overview_slider_dragging = false;
            self.map_teleport_armed = false;
            return;
        }
        let Some(manifest) = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .copied()
        else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(map) = self.world_catalog.get(&self.game.current_instance) else {
            return;
        };
        let earth = manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1);
        self.gpu.overview_planet = manifest.topology() == WorldTopology::Planet;
        let vertices = if self.gpu.overview_planet {
            Vec::new()
        } else {
            sector_geometry(&SectorGeometry {
                boxes: map.boxes().to_vec(),
                triangles: map.triangles().to_vec(),
            })
        };
        self.last_render_position = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
        let marker_size = if manifest.topology() == WorldTopology::Planet {
            let radius = minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0;
            [radius * self.marker_scale(earth); 3]
        } else {
            [1.0; 3]
        };
        let mut marker_vertices = Vec::new();
        cube(
            &mut marker_vertices,
            (glam::Vec3::from_array(if earth {
                let radial =
                    glam::Vec3::from_array(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position)
                        .normalize_or_zero();
                let radius =
                    minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0;
                (radial * radius * (1.0 + self.marker_height())).to_array()
            } else {
                self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position
            }) - glam::Vec3::from_array(self.gpu.render_origin))
            .to_array(),
            marker_size,
            [0.95, 0.2, 0.1],
        );
        self.gpu.install_overview(&vertices);
        self.gpu.install_overview_marker(&marker_vertices);
        self.metrics.frame_stats.set_gpu_bytes(
            self.gpu.fixed_gpu_bytes
                + u64::from(self.gpu.size.width.max(1))
                    * u64::from(self.gpu.size.height.max(1))
                    * 4,
        );
        self.overview_instance = Some(self.game.current_instance);
        self.overview_open = true;
        self.gpu.overview_active = true;
    }

    fn marker_scale(&self, earth: bool) -> f32 {
        if earth {
            ((self.overview_zoom - 1.0) * 0.025).clamp(0.002, 0.035)
        } else {
            0.035
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn overview_uses_zoom(&self) -> bool {
        self.overview_open
            && self
                .game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .is_some_and(|manifest| manifest.topology() == WorldTopology::Planet)
    }

    pub(super) fn set_overview_zoom(&mut self, zoom: f32) {
        self.overview_zoom = zoom.clamp(crate::console::MIN_ZOOM, crate::console::MAX_ZOOM);
        self.refresh_earth_marker();
        self.last_render_position = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
    }

    fn marker_height(&self) -> f32 {
        ((self.overview_zoom - 1.0) * 0.25).min(0.045)
    }

    pub(super) fn refresh_earth_marker(&mut self) {
        if !self.overview_open || !self.is_earth_world() {
            return;
        }
        let Some(manifest) = self.game.world_manifests.get(&self.game.current_instance) else {
            return;
        };
        let radius = minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(*manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0;
        let radial = glam::Vec3::from_array(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position)
            .normalize_or_zero();
        let mut vertices = Vec::new();
        cube(
            &mut vertices,
            (radial * radius * (1.0 + self.marker_height())
                - glam::Vec3::from_array(self.gpu.render_origin))
            .to_array(),
            [radius * self.marker_scale(true); 3],
            [0.95, 0.2, 0.1],
        );
        self.gpu.install_overview_marker(&vertices);
        self.metrics.frame_stats.set_gpu_bytes(
            self.gpu.fixed_gpu_bytes
                + u64::from(self.gpu.size.width.max(1))
                    * u64::from(self.gpu.size.height.max(1))
                    * 4,
        );
    }

    pub(super) fn arm_map_teleport(&mut self) {
        if self.map_teleport_pending {
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_error("map_telepo: wait for the previous destination");
            return;
        }
        let earth = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .is_some_and(|manifest| manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1));
        if !earth || self.connection.session().is_none() || !self.gpu.scene_visible {
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_error("map_telepo requires a connected Earth world");
            return;
        }
        if !self.overview_open {
            self.toggle_overview();
        }
        self.ui.console.open = false;
        self.map_teleport_armed = true;
        self.connection_status = "Earth: kliknij ląd na globie (Esc anuluje)".into();
    }

    pub(super) fn click_map_teleport(&mut self) {
        if !self.map_teleport_armed {
            return;
        }
        let Some((x, y)) = self.input.last_cursor else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(manifest) = self.game.world_manifests.get(&self.game.current_instance) else {
            return;
        };
        let radius = minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(*manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0;
        let (mut view, far) = self.overview_camera();
        let width = self.gpu.size.width.max(1) as f32;
        let height = self.gpu.size.height.max(1) as f32;
        if self.is_earth_world() {
            view = glam::Mat4::from_scale(glam::Vec3::new(-1.0, 1.0, 1.0)) * view;
        }
        let near = radius * ((self.overview_zoom - 1.0) * 0.08).max(0.001);
        let projection =
            glam::Mat4::perspective_rh(self.fov_degrees.to_radians(), width / height, near, far);
        let inverse = (projection * view).inverse();
        let ndc = glam::Vec2::new(2.0 * x as f32 / width - 1.0, 1.0 - 2.0 * y as f32 / height);
        let near_point = inverse.project_point3(glam::Vec3::new(ndc.x, ndc.y, 0.0));
        let far_point = inverse.project_point3(glam::Vec3::new(ndc.x, ndc.y, 1.0));
        let ray = (far_point - near_point).normalize();
        let eye = view.inverse().transform_point3(glam::Vec3::ZERO);
        let b = eye.dot(ray);
        let discriminant = b * b - (eye.length_squared() - radius * radius);
        if discriminant < 0.0 {
            self.connection_status = "Earth: kliknij powierzchnię globu".into();
            return;
        }
        let distance = -b - discriminant.sqrt();
        if distance <= 0.0 {
            return;
        }
        let direction = (eye + ray * distance).normalize().to_array();
        match self
            .connection
            .queue(&ClientMessage::MapTeleport { direction })
        {
            Ok(()) => {
                self.map_teleport_pending = true;
                self.connection_status = "Earth: przenoszenie...".into();
                self.toggle_overview();
            }
            Err(error) => self.ui.console.push_error(format!("map_telepo: {error:?}")),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn terrain_view(&self) -> minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView {
        if self.overview_open && self.gpu.overview_planet {
            let position = self
                .overview_camera()
                .0
                .inverse()
                .transform_point3(glam::Vec3::ZERO)
                .to_array();
            return minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView::overview(
                position,
                self.fov_degrees.to_radians(),
                [self.gpu.size.width, self.gpu.size.height],
            );
        }
        minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView::new(
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position,
            self.fov_degrees.to_radians(),
            self.gpu.size.height,
        )
    }

    pub(super) fn overview_camera(&self) -> (glam::Mat4, f32) {
        let topology = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .map(|manifest| manifest.topology());
        if topology == Some(WorldTopology::Planet) {
            let radial = glam::Vec3::from_array(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position)
                .normalize_or_zero();
            let radial = if radial.length_squared() > 0.0 {
                radial
            } else {
                glam::Vec3::Y
            };
            let up = glam::Vec3::Y;
            let radius = self
                .game
                .world_manifests
                .get(&self.game.current_instance)
                .map(|manifest| {
                    minimium_procgen::planet_surface_for(*manifest).radius_mm() as f32 / 1000.0
                })
                .unwrap_or(10_000.0);
            let latitude = radial.y.asin() + self.overview_pitch;
            let longitude = radial.z.atan2(radial.x) + self.overview_yaw;
            let latitude = latitude.clamp(-1.48, 1.48);
            let direction = glam::Vec3::new(
                latitude.cos() * longitude.cos(),
                latitude.sin(),
                latitude.cos() * longitude.sin(),
            );
            (
                glam::Mat4::look_at_rh(
                    direction * radius * self.overview_zoom,
                    glam::Vec3::ZERO,
                    up,
                ),
                // The physical Moon remains about 60 Earth radii away.
                radius * 80.0,
            )
        } else {
            let Some(map) = self.world_catalog.get(&self.game.current_instance) else {
                return (glam::Mat4::IDENTITY, 1000.0);
            };
            let mut min = glam::Vec3::splat(f32::INFINITY);
            let mut max = glam::Vec3::splat(f32::NEG_INFINITY);
            for triangle in map.triangles() {
                for point in triangle.vertices {
                    let point = glam::Vec3::from_array(point);
                    min = min.min(point);
                    max = max.max(point);
                }
            }
            for map_box in map.boxes() {
                let center = glam::Vec3::from_array(map_box.center);
                let half = glam::Vec3::from_array(map_box.size) * 0.5;
                min = min.min(center - half);
                max = max.max(center + half);
            }
            let center = (min + max) * 0.5;
            let span = (max - min).max_element().max(10.0);
            let eye = center + glam::Vec3::Y * (span * 1.5 + 10.0);
            (
                glam::Mat4::look_at_rh(eye, center, glam::Vec3::Z),
                span * 4.0 + 100.0,
            )
        }
    }
}

impl GpuResources {
    fn install_overview(&mut self, vertices: &[Vertex]) {
        let (old_size, new_size) = self.overview_buffers.install_world(&self.device, vertices);
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(old_size)
            .saturating_add(new_size);
    }

    fn install_overview_marker(&mut self, vertices: &[Vertex]) {
        let (old_size, new_size) = self.overview_buffers.install_marker(&self.device, vertices);
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(old_size)
            .saturating_add(new_size);
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/quality.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="36" bytes="1459" original_lines="36" original_bytes="1459" minified="false" sha256="5bd7717afc41bb5bdfac3e5130f3bef67d948c8ea3d1c7b0a896b911cd6cdf5c">>>
use super::Renderer;
use minimium_renderer::quality::{SkyQuality, SkyQualityState};
use minimium_renderer::ShadowSettings;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn set_sky_quality(&mut self, requested: SkyQuality) -> String {
        let requested_settings = ShadowSettings::for_quality(requested);
        let mut fallback_reason = None;
        if let Err(error) = self.gpu.set_shadow_settings(requested_settings) {
            fallback_reason = Some(error);
            if requested == SkyQuality::Standard {
                let low = ShadowSettings::for_quality(SkyQuality::Low);
                if let Err(low_error) = self.gpu.set_shadow_settings(low) {
                    fallback_reason = Some(low_error);
                }
            }
        }
        let effective = if self.gpu.shadow_gpu.settings.enabled {
            SkyQuality::Standard
        } else {
            SkyQuality::Low
        };
        let previous = self.sky_quality;
        self.sky_quality = SkyQualityState::new(requested, effective, fallback_reason);
        if previous != self.sky_quality {
            self.metrics.frame_stats.reset_environment_epoch();
        }
        self.update_gpu_memory_metric();
        format!(
            "sky quality requested={} effective={} fallback_reason={}",
            self.sky_quality.requested.label(),
            self.sky_quality.effective.label(),
            self.sky_quality.fallback_reason.unwrap_or("none"),
        )
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/render.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="156" bytes="7631" original_lines="156" original_bytes="7631" minified="false" sha256="4cfef2f2ff60e2f08579a477888c6f3c44ec451b77f92c099b8a359bcc854728">>>
use super::{scene_bridge::RenderSceneSnapshot, GpuResources};

impl GpuResources {
    /// Keeps every GPU pass on the one immutable snapshot prepared for this frame.
    pub(super) fn render(
        &mut self,
        snapshot: &RenderSceneSnapshot<'_>,
    ) -> Result<u32, wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture> {
        self.environment_draw_calls = super::sky::EnvironmentDrawCalls::default();
        self.last_shadow_prepare_cpu = None;
        self.last_environment_upload_cpu = None;
        let frame = match minimium_renderer::surface_frame::acquire(
            &self.surface,
            &self.device,
            &self.config,
        ) {
            minimium_renderer::surface_frame::SurfaceAcquire::Ready(frame) => frame,
            minimium_renderer::surface_frame::SurfaceAcquire::Skipped => return Ok(0),
            minimium_renderer::surface_frame::SurfaceAcquire::Retry(error) => return Err(error),
        };
        let surface_view = &frame.view;
        let prepared = snapshot.environment;
        let environment = &prepared.frame;
        let render_frame = &prepared.render_frame;
        self.atmosphere_gpu.mark_environment(
            &render_frame
                .presentation_environment(self.hdr_enabled, self.atmosphere_gpu.is_active()),
        );
        self.terrain_gpu.uniform.eye_relative = std::array::from_fn(|i| {
            if i < 3 {
                (render_frame.view.camera_eye_world_m[i] - render_frame.view.render_origin_m[i])
                    as f32
            } else {
                0.0
            }
        });
        self.terrain_gpu.update(&self.queue);
        let client = render_frame
            .client
            .expect("application attaches ClientView before rendering");
        let upload_started = std::time::Instant::now();
        prepared.upload_stars(self);
        let ui_vertex_count = render_frame.upload(
            &self.queue,
            &self.camera_buffer,
            &self.environment_buffer,
            &self.ui.vertex_buffer,
            self.hdr_enabled,
            self.atmosphere_gpu.is_active(),
            self.output_encoder.as_ref(),
        );
        self.ui.set_vertex_count(ui_vertex_count);
        self.last_environment_upload_cpu = Some(upload_started.elapsed());
        // Includes local map caster selection/build/allocation/upload and shadow
        // uniform upload. Remote-player preparation occurs earlier in update().
        // This scope is disjoint from environment preparation and upload.
        let shadow_started = std::time::Instant::now();
        self.prepare_shadow_frame(environment, snapshot.map, client.player_position_m);
        self.last_shadow_prepare_cpu = Some(shadow_started.elapsed());
        let scene_view = self
            .output_encoder
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(surface_view, |output| output.target_view());
        let mut encoder = self
            .device
            .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
                label: Some("frame-encoder"),
            });
        let environment_flags = minimium_renderer::scene_encoder::EnvironmentDrawFlags {
            overview_sky: super::sky::should_draw_overview_sky(environment),
            overview_stars: super::sky::should_draw_overview_stars(environment),
            overview_sun: super::sky::should_draw_overview_sun(environment),
            overview_moon: super::sky::should_draw_overview_moon(environment),
            surface_sky: super::sky::should_draw_surface_sky(environment),
            surface_stars: super::sky::should_draw_stars(environment)
                || self.atmosphere_gpu.high_stars(),
            surface_sun: super::sky::should_draw_sun(environment)
                || self.atmosphere_gpu.is_active(),
            surface_moon: super::sky::should_draw_moon(environment)
                || self.atmosphere_gpu.is_active(),
        };
        let scene = minimium_renderer::scene_encoder::MainScenePass {
            color_view: scene_view,
            depth_view: &self.depth_view,
            clear_color: super::sky::clear_color(self.scene_visible, self.overview_active),
            camera: &self.camera_bind_group,
            world_pipeline: &self.pipeline,
            terrain_gpu: &self.terrain_gpu,
            terrain_catalog: self.world_geometry.terrain(),
            shadow_empty: &self.shadow_gpu.empty_bind_group,
            shadow_sampling: &self.shadow_gpu.sampling_bind_group,
            environment_pipelines: &self.environment_pipelines,
            milky_way: &self.milky_way,
            stars: &self.stars,
            celestial_halo: &self.celestial_halo,
            moon: &self.moon,
            moon_sphere: &self.moon_sphere,
            atmosphere: &self.atmosphere_gpu,
            overview_buffers: &self.overview_buffers,
            world_vertices: self.initial_world.buffer(),
            world_vertex_count: self.initial_world.vertex_count(),
            remote_vertices: self.remote_vertices.buffer(),
            remote_vertex_count: self.remote_vertices.vertex_count(),
            world_vertex_catalog: self.world_geometry.catalog(),
            instance: client.world_instance,
            sector_hints: &snapshot.sector_hints,
            scene_visible: self.scene_visible && self.terrain_gpu.valid,
            overview_active: self.overview_active,
            overview_planet: self.overview_planet,
            uploaded_stars_match: self.uploaded_star_stamp == environment.diagnostics.star_frame,
            halo_count: render_frame.halo_count,
            environment: environment_flags,
        };
        let encoded = minimium_renderer::frame_encoder::encode_frame(
            &mut encoder,
            minimium_renderer::frame_encoder::FramePasses {
                shadow: minimium_renderer::frame_encoder::ShadowPass {
                    gpu: &self.shadow_gpu,
                    enabled: self.shadow_state.valid,
                    instance: client.world_instance,
                    keys: &self.shadow_state.caster_keys,
                    world_vertices: self.world_geometry.catalog(),
                    map: self.shadow_gpu.map_casters(),
                    player: self.shadow_gpu.player_casters(),
                },
                scene,
                clouds: &self.cloud_gpu,
                final_passes: minimium_renderer::frame_encoder::FinalPasses {
                    scene_view,
                    surface_view,
                    ui_pipeline: &self.ui.pipeline,
                    ui_output_pipeline: self.ui.output_pipeline.as_ref(),
                    ui_bind_group: &self.ui.bind_group,
                    ui_vertex_buffer: &self.ui.vertex_buffer,
                    ui_vertex_count: self.ui.vertex_count(),
                    output: self.output_encoder.as_ref(),
                },
            },
        );
        self.environment_draw_calls.shadows += encoded.shadow;
        self.environment_draw_calls.sky += encoded.scene.sky;
        self.environment_draw_calls.stars += encoded.scene.stars;
        self.environment_draw_calls.halos += encoded.scene.halos;
        self.environment_draw_calls.sun += encoded.scene.sun;
        self.environment_draw_calls.moon += encoded.scene.moon;
        self.environment_draw_calls.overview_marker += encoded.scene.overview_marker;
        let draw_calls = encoded.shadow
            + encoded.scene.draws
            + encoded.atmosphere
            + encoded.clouds
            + encoded.final_passes;
        frame.submit(&self.queue, encoder);
        self.atmosphere_gpu.after_submit();
        Ok(draw_calls)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/sector_scene.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="294" bytes="11122" original_lines="294" original_bytes="11122" minified="false" sha256="5ccceb8ce848a3528f1795c8c3c5ff2ecb8a599ff353271969a4562fc027e927">>>
use super::sector_worker::{PreparedScene, SectorWorker};
use minimium_procgen::SectorGeometry;
use minimium_sectors::{InstallResult, RequestError, SectorManager, SectorTicket};
use minimium_simulation::CollisionIndex;
use minimium_world::world::{
    Aabb, GenerationRevision, MapBox, MapTriangle, SectorKey, SectorRevision, WorldContentRevision,
    WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest, WorldMap,
};
use std::{collections::HashMap, sync::Arc};

const CLIENT_SECTOR_CACHE_CAPACITY: usize = 512;
const MAX_CLIENT_INSTALLS_PER_FRAME: usize = 32;

pub(super) struct ClientSectorCache {
    manager: SectorManager<SectorGeometry>,
    collision_worker: super::collision_worker::CollisionWorker,
    interests: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, SectorInterest>,
    workers: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, SectorWorker>,
    presentations: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, Arc<PreparedScene>>,
}

struct SectorInterest {
    keys: Vec<SectorKey>,
    tickets: Vec<SectorTicket>,
    generation: GenerationRevision,
    content_revision: WorldContentRevision,
    collision: Option<CollisionIndex>,
}

pub(super) struct ClientSectorScene {
    pub(super) prepared: Option<Arc<PreparedScene>>,
    pub(super) origin: [f32; 3],
    pub(super) keys: Vec<SectorKey>,
    pub(super) sectors: Vec<(SectorKey, Arc<SectorGeometry>)>,
    pub(super) render_sectors: Vec<(SectorKey, u8, Arc<SectorGeometry>)>,
    pub(super) collision: CollisionIndex,
    pub(super) generation: GenerationRevision,
    pub(super) content_revision: WorldContentRevision,
}

impl ClientSectorCache {
    pub(super) fn presentation(&self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> Option<&PreparedScene> {
        self.presentations.get(&instance).map(AsRef::as_ref)
    }
    pub(super) fn reset(&mut self) {
        *self = Self::new();
    }
    pub(super) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            manager: SectorManager::new(CLIENT_SECTOR_CACHE_CAPACITY, CLIENT_SECTOR_CACHE_CAPACITY)
                .expect("client sector cache capacity is nonzero"),
            collision_worker: super::collision_worker::CollisionWorker::new(),
            interests: HashMap::new(),
            workers: HashMap::new(),
            presentations: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn interest_matches(
        &self,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        keys: &[SectorKey],
        manifest: WorldManifest,
    ) -> bool {
        self.interests.get(&instance).is_some_and(|interest| {
            interest.keys == keys
                && interest.tickets.len() == keys.len()
                && interest.generation == manifest.generation().revision()
                && interest.content_revision == manifest.content_revision()
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn ensure_scene(
        &mut self,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        position: [f32; 3],
        view: minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView,
        origin: [f32; 3],
        maps: &HashMap<WorldInstanceId, WorldMap>,
        manifests: &HashMap<WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest>,
        geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
    ) -> Option<ClientSectorScene> {
        if maps.get(&instance).is_none() || manifests.get(&instance) != Some(&manifest) {
            return None;
        }
        // Earth jobs must wait for the session's validated geography, including
        // bootstrap frames before Welcome. Never dispatch a job that would panic.
        if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|p| p.mode == 1) && geography.is_none() {
            return None;
        }
        let keys = minimium_procgen::sector_neighborhood_for(manifest, position);
        let same_interest = self.interest_matches(instance, &keys, manifest);
        if !same_interest {
            if let Some(previous) = self.interests.remove(&instance) {
                for ticket in previous.tickets {
                    self.manager.unpin(ticket);
                }
            }
            let mut tickets = Vec::with_capacity(keys.len());
            for key in &keys {
                let Some(ticket) = self.request(instance, *key, manifest) else {
                    continue;
                };
                if self.manager.pin(ticket) {
                    tickets.push(ticket);
                }
            }
            self.interests.insert(
                instance,
                SectorInterest {
                    keys: keys.clone(),
                    tickets,
                    generation: manifest.generation().revision(),
                    content_revision: manifest.content_revision(),
                    collision: None,
                },
            );
        }

        for (ticket, geometry) in self.collision_worker.poll() {
            let revision = SectorRevision::new(1).expect("initial revision");
            if self.manager.install_data(ticket, revision, geometry) == InstallResult::Installed {
                let _ = self.manager.install_collision(ticket);
            }
        }
        for _ in 0..MAX_CLIENT_INSTALLS_PER_FRAME {
            if !self.collision_worker.has_capacity() {
                break;
            }
            let Some(ticket) = self.manager.begin_next() else {
                break;
            };
            let Some(source_map) = maps.get(&ticket.instance()) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(source_manifest) = manifests.get(&ticket.instance()) else {
                continue;
            };
            if source_manifest.topology() == minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet {
                self.collision_worker.submit(
                    ticket,
                    source_map.clone(),
                    *source_manifest,
                    geography.clone(),
                );
                continue;
            }
            let geometry = Arc::new(minimium_procgen::materialize_world_sector_with_geography(
                source_map,
                *source_manifest,
                ticket.key(),
                geography.clone(),
            ));
            let revision = SectorRevision::new(1).expect("initial sector revision is nonzero");
            if self.manager.install_data(ticket, revision, geometry) == InstallResult::Installed {
                let _ = self.manager.install_collision(ticket);
            }
        }

        let interest = self.interests.get(&instance)?;
        if interest.keys != keys
            || interest.tickets.len() != keys.len()
            || !interest
                .tickets
                .iter()
                .all(|ticket| self.manager.collision_ready(*ticket))
        {
            return None;
        }
        let sectors: Vec<_> = interest
            .tickets
            .iter()
            .map(|ticket| Some((ticket.key(), self.manager.payload_arc(*ticket)?)))
            .collect::<Option<_>>()?;
        let interest = self.interests.get_mut(&instance)?;
        let collision = interest
            .collision
            .get_or_insert_with(|| collision_from_sectors(sectors.iter().map(|(_, g)| g.as_ref())))
            .clone();
        let mut prepared = None;
        let render_sectors = if manifest.topology() == minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet
        {
            if let Some(result) = self
                .workers
                .entry(instance)
                .or_insert_with(SectorWorker::new)
                .poll(instance, manifest, view, origin, &sectors, geography)
            {
                self.presentations.insert(instance, result);
            }
            if let Some(result) = self
                .presentations
                .get(&instance)
                .filter(|r| r.matches(instance, manifest, origin))
            {
                prepared = Some(result.clone());
                result
                    .patches
                    .iter()
                    .map(|p| (p.key, p.lod, p.geometry.clone()))
                    .collect()
            } else {
                Vec::new()
            }
        } else {
            sectors.iter().map(|(k, g)| (*k, 0, g.clone())).collect()
        };
        Some(ClientSectorScene {
            prepared,
            origin,
            keys,
            sectors,
            render_sectors,
            collision,
            generation: manifest.generation().revision(),
            content_revision: manifest.content_revision(),
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn release_interest(&mut self, instance: WorldInstanceId) {
        self.presentations.remove(&instance);
        self.workers.remove(&instance);
        if let Some(interest) = self.interests.remove(&instance) {
            for ticket in interest.tickets {
                self.manager.unpin(ticket);
            }
        }
    }

    fn request(
        &mut self,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        key: SectorKey,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
    ) -> Option<SectorTicket> {
        let generation: GenerationRevision = manifest.generation().revision();
        let content: WorldContentRevision = manifest.content_revision();
        match self.manager.request(instance, key, generation, content) {
            Ok(ticket) => Some(ticket),
            Err(RequestError::CacheFull) if self.manager.evict_oldest() => self
                .manager
                .request(instance, key, generation, content)
                .ok(),
            Err(_) => None,
        }
    }
}

fn collision_from_sectors<'a>(sectors: impl Iterator<Item = &'a SectorGeometry>) -> CollisionIndex {
    let mut colliders = Vec::new();
    let mut seen_boxes = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let mut triangles = Vec::new();
    let mut seen_triangles = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    for sector in sectors {
        for map_box in &sector.boxes {
            if map_box.solid && seen_boxes.insert(box_key(*map_box)) {
                colliders.push(Aabb::from_center_size(map_box.center, map_box.size));
            }
        }
        for triangle in &sector.triangles {
            if triangle.solid && seen_triangles.insert(triangle_key(*triangle)) {
                triangles.push(*triangle);
            }
        }
    }
    CollisionIndex::from_geometry(colliders, triangles)
}

fn box_key(map_box: MapBox) -> [u32; 6] {
    [
        map_box.center[0].to_bits(),
        map_box.center[1].to_bits(),
        map_box.center[2].to_bits(),
        map_box.size[0].to_bits(),
        map_box.size[1].to_bits(),
        map_box.size[2].to_bits(),
    ]
}

fn triangle_key(triangle: MapTriangle) -> [u32; 9] {
    let [a, b, c] = triangle.vertices;
    [
        a[0].to_bits(),
        a[1].to_bits(),
        a[2].to_bits(),
        b[0].to_bits(),
        b[1].to_bits(),
        b[2].to_bits(),
        c[0].to_bits(),
        c[1].to_bits(),
        c[2].to_bits(),
    ]
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/sector_worker.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="244" bytes="9877" original_lines="244" original_bytes="9877" minified="false" sha256="1ed8b43104e6c35ab705abe5116662736ee1ace056b4b68d45bdd50646e74aa4">>>
//! Latest-request worker with bounded geometry/prepared caches; never owns GPU handles.
use minimium_procgen::{planet_surface_for, PlanetTerrain, PreparedGeography, SectorGeometry};
use minimium_renderer::{prepared_sector::PreparedSector, render_patch_cache::RenderPatchCache};
use minimium_world::world::{SectorKey, WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    sync::{Arc, Condvar, Mutex},
    thread::JoinHandle,
};
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
struct Key {
    world: WorldInstanceId,
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    origin: [f32; 3],
    view: minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView,
}
struct Request {
    key: Key,
    collision: Vec<(SectorKey, Arc<SectorGeometry>)>,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn PreparedGeography>>,
}
pub(super) struct PreparedScene {
    key: Key,
    pub patches: Vec<Arc<PreparedSector>>,
    pub build_ms: f64,
    pub cache_bytes: usize,
}
impl PreparedScene {
    pub fn matches(
        &self,
        world: WorldInstanceId,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        origin: [f32; 3],
    ) -> bool {
        self.key.world == world && self.key.manifest == manifest && self.key.origin == origin
    }
    pub fn position(&self) -> [f32; 3] {
        self.key.view.position
    }
}
#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    pending: Option<Request>,
    requested: Option<Key>,
    completed: Option<Arc<PreparedScene>>,
    stop: bool,
}
pub(super) struct SectorWorker {
    state: Arc<(Mutex<State>, Condvar)>,
    thread: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
}
impl SectorWorker {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let state = Arc::new((Mutex::new(State::default()), Condvar::new()));
        let shared = state.clone();
        let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("terrain-presentation".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let mut geometry = RenderPatchCache::default();
                let mut edges = minimium_renderer::terrain_edges::EdgeConformance::default();
                let mut scope = None;
                let mut origin = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
                let mut prepared: HashMap<(SectorKey, u8), Arc<PreparedSector>> = HashMap::new();
                loop {
                    let request = {
                        let mut s = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                        while s.pending.is_none() && !s.stop {
                            s = shared.1.wait(s).unwrap();
                        }
                        if s.stop {
                            break;
                        }
                        s.pending.take().unwrap()
                    };
                    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let next_scope = (request.key.world, request.key.manifest);
                    if scope != Some(next_scope) {
                        geometry = RenderPatchCache::default();
                        edges = Default::default();
                        prepared.clear();
                        scope = Some(next_scope);
                    }
                    if origin != request.key.origin {
                        prepared.clear();
                        origin = request.key.origin;
                    }
                    let manifest = request.key.manifest;
                    let mut terrain =
                        PlanetTerrain::new(manifest.generation(), planet_surface_for(manifest));
                    if let Some(t) = terrain.take() {
                        let t = if let Some(d) = manifest.planet() {
                            t.with_definition(d)
                        } else {
                            t
                        };
                        let t = t
                            .with_surface_recipe(minimium_game_sample::SURFACE_RECIPE)
                            .expect("validated sample surface recipe");
                        terrain = Some(if let Some(g) = request.geography.clone() {
                            t.with_geography(g)
                        } else {
                            t
                        });
                    }
                    let meshes =
                        if manifest.topology() == minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet {
                            minimium_renderer::planet_visibility::render_patches_for_view(
                                manifest,
                                request.key.view,
                                &request.collision,
                                request.geography.clone(),
                                &mut geometry,
                                &|| {
                                    let s = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                                    s.stop
                                        || s.pending.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| {
                                            r.key.manifest != manifest
                                                || r.key.origin != request.key.origin
                                        })
                                },
                            )
                        } else {
                            request
                                .collision
                                .iter()
                                .map(|(k, g)| (*k, 0, g.clone()))
                                .collect()
                        };
                    let meshes = if let Some(terrain) = terrain.as_ref() {
                        edges.prepare(meshes, terrain)
                    } else {
                        meshes
                    };
                    let required: std::collections::HashSet<_> =
                        meshes.iter().map(|(k, l, _)| (*k, *l)).collect();
                    prepared.retain(|k, _| required.contains(k));
                    let mut patches = Vec::with_capacity(meshes.len());
                    let mut cancelled = false;
                    for (key, lod, mesh) in meshes {
                        {
                            let s = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                            if s.stop
                                || s.pending.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| {
                                    r.key.world != request.key.world
                                        || r.key.manifest != manifest
                                        || r.key.origin != request.key.origin
                                })
                            {
                                cancelled = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if prepared
                            .get(&(key, lod))
                            .is_some_and(|p| !Arc::ptr_eq(&p.geometry, &mesh))
                        {
                            prepared.remove(&(key, lod));
                        }
                        let item = prepared.entry((key, lod)).or_insert_with(|| {
                            Arc::new(PreparedSector::new(
                                key,
                                lod,
                                mesh,
                                if manifest.topology()
                                    == minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet
                                {
                                    terrain.as_ref()
                                } else {
                                    None
                                },
                                edges.ocean(key, lod),
                                request.key.origin,
                            ))
                        });
                        patches.push(item.clone());
                    }
                    if cancelled {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut s = shared.0.lock().unwrap();
                    if !s.stop
                        && s.pending.as_ref().is_none_or(|r| {
                            r.key.world == request.key.world
                                && r.key.manifest == manifest
                                && r.key.origin == request.key.origin
                        })
                    {
                        s.completed = Some(Arc::new(PreparedScene {
                            key: request.key,
                            patches,
                            build_ms: started.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * 1000.0,
                            cache_bytes: geometry.bytes(),
                        }));
                    }
                }
            })
            .expect("terrain presentation worker");
        Self {
            state,
            thread: Some(thread),
        }
    }
    pub fn poll(
        &self,
        world: WorldInstanceId,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        view: minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView,
        origin: [f32; 3],
        collision: &[(SectorKey, Arc<SectorGeometry>)],
        geography: Option<Arc<dyn PreparedGeography>>,
    ) -> Option<Arc<PreparedScene>> {
        let key = Key {
            world,
            manifest,
            view,
            origin,
        };
        let mut s = self.state.0.lock().unwrap();
        let completed = s.completed.take().filter(|r| {
            r.key.world == world && r.key.manifest == manifest && r.key.origin == origin
        });
        if s.requested != Some(key) {
            s.pending = Some(Request {
                key,
                collision: collision.to_vec(),
                geography,
            });
            s.requested = Some(key);
            self.state.1.notify_one();
        }
        completed
    }
}
impl Drop for SectorWorker {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        {
            self.state.0.lock().unwrap().stop = true;
            self.state.1.notify_one();
        }
        if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
            let _ = thread.join();
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/session.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="295" bytes="11359" original_lines="295" original_bytes="11359" minified="false" sha256="c0af5ab67276a3cbbd71df27306eafbd06328cbdddcb35d0cae6034e8d2a7d31">>>
mod message_handling;
mod sector_readiness;

use super::*;
use crate::messages::ClientText as Text;

impl Renderer {
    pub(crate) fn start_remote_attempt(&mut self, address: &str) {
        self.demo_environment = None;
        self.environment_frame = crate::environment::EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
        if self.settings.require_earth {
            self.connection_status = "Łączenie z Earth".into();
            self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
        }
        match self.connection.start_remote(address.to_owned()) {
            Ok(()) => self
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(Text::ConnectingTo(address.to_owned()).to_string()),
            Err(error) => self.report_start_error(error),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn start_local_attempt(&mut self, threads: crate::options::ThreadLane) {
        self.demo_environment = None;
        self.environment_frame = crate::environment::EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
        if self.settings.require_earth {
            self.connection_status = "Łączenie z Earth".into();
            self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
        }
        match self.connection.start_local(
            self.settings.data_dir.clone(),
            self.settings.map_path.clone(),
            self.settings.world_definition_path.clone(),
            threads,
        ) {
            Ok(()) => self
                .ui
                .console
                .push_line(Text::StartingLocalServer.to_string()),
            Err(error) => self.report_start_error(error),
        }
    }

    fn report_start_error(&mut self, error: StartError) {
        let message = match error {
            StartError::Busy { active_attempt } => Text::BusyAttempt {
                attempt_id: active_attempt.get(),
            }
            .to_string(),
            StartError::AttemptIdsExhausted => Text::AttemptIdsExhausted.to_string(),
            StartError::WorkerSpawn(error) => {
                Text::WorkerStartFailed(error.to_string()).to_string()
            }
        };
        if self.settings.require_earth {
            self.connection_status = format!("Błąd Earth: {message}");
        }
        self.ui.console.push_error(message);
    }

    pub(super) fn poll_connector(&mut self) {
        if let Some(result) = self.connection.poll_time_scale_result() {
            match result {
                Ok(response) => self.ui.console.push_line(response.trim()),
                Err(error) => self.ui.console.push_error(format!("time scale: {error}")),
            }
        }
        match self.connection.poll_connector() {
            ConnectionEvent::TimedOut => {
                self.connection_status = "Błąd połączenia: przekroczono czas".into();
                self.ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::AttemptTimedOut.to_string());
            }
            ConnectionEvent::SessionStarted => {
                self.clear_pending_sector_transitions();
                self.reset_remote_gameplay();
                self.ui.console.push_line(Text::AwaitingWelcome.to_string());
            }
            ConnectionEvent::SetupFailed(error) => {
                self.connection_status = format!("Błąd Earth: {error}");
                self.ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::ConnectionSetupFailed(error.to_string()).to_string());
            }
            ConnectionEvent::Failed(error) => {
                self.connection_status = format!("Błąd Earth: {error}");
                self.ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::ConnectFailed(error.to_string()).to_string());
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn reset_remote_gameplay(&mut self) {
        self.gpu.remote_vertices.clear();
        self.game.gameplay.remote_vertices.clear();
        self.game.gameplay.reconciliation.clear();
        self.game.gameplay.remote_geometry_dirty = false;
        self.game.gameplay.health = PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH;
        self.game.gameplay.hit_confirmation_until = None;
        self.game.gameplay.last_shot_sent_at = None;
    }

    pub(crate) fn finish_on_exit(&mut self) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
        self.clear_connection();
        self.connection.finish()?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn clear_connection(&mut self) {
        self.game.session_context = None;
        self.clear_pending_sector_transitions();
        self.map_teleport_pending = false;
        self.map_teleport_armed = false;
        self.teleport_loading = false;
        if self.settings.require_earth {
            self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
            if !self.connection_status.starts_with("Błąd") {
                self.connection_status = "Earth: rozłączono".into();
            }
        }
        if let Some(mut session) = self.connection.take_session() {
            let metrics = session.metrics();
            self.metrics.previous_bytes_sent = self
                .metrics
                .previous_bytes_sent
                .saturating_add(metrics.bytes_sent);
            self.metrics.previous_bytes_received = self
                .metrics
                .previous_bytes_received
                .saturating_add(metrics.bytes_received);
            session.close();
        }
        self.game.gameplay.last_shot_sent_at = None;
        self.gpu.remote_vertices.clear();
        self.game.gameplay.remote_vertices.clear();
        self.game.gameplay.reconciliation.clear();
        self.game.gameplay.remote_geometry_dirty = false;
        self.game.gameplay.health = PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH;
        self.game.gameplay.hit_confirmation_until = None;
    }

    pub(super) fn fail_connection(&mut self, message: impl Into<String>) {
        let message = message.into();
        self.connection_status = format!("Błąd Earth: {message}");
        if self.settings.require_earth {
            self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
        }
        eprintln!("{message}");
        self.ui.console.push_error(message);
        self.clear_connection();
    }

    pub(super) fn poll_session(&mut self) {
        if self.connection.session().is_some() {
            self.ui.session_events.clear();
            self.connection.poll_session(&mut self.ui.session_events);
            self.prepare_session_materials();
        }
        let mut events = std::mem::take(&mut self.ui.session_events);
        for event in events.drain(..) {
            match event {
                SessionEvent::PingRoundTrip(duration) => {
                    if self.ui.console.open {
                        self.ui.console.push_line(
                            Text::Ping {
                                milliseconds: duration.as_millis(),
                            }
                            .to_string(),
                        );
                    }
                }
                SessionEvent::Disconnected(reason) => {
                    if reason == DisconnectReason::ServerClosed {
                        if self.settings.require_earth {
                            self.connection_status = "Błąd Earth: serwer zamknął połączenie".into();
                        }
                        if self.ui.console.open {
                            self.ui.console.push_line(Text::ServerClosed.to_string());
                        }
                        self.clear_connection();
                        continue;
                    }
                    let message = Text::from(reason).to_string();
                    self.fail_connection(message);
                }
                SessionEvent::Message(message) => {
                    self.handle_server_message(message);
                    if self.connection.session().is_none() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if self
            .connection
            .session()
            .is_some_and(|session| session.state() == SessionState::Disconnected)
        {
            self.clear_connection();
        }
        self.ui.session_events = events;
    }

    pub(super) fn queue_fire(&mut self) {
        if !self
            .connection
            .session()
            .is_some_and(|session| session.state() == SessionState::Connected)
        {
            return;
        }
        let now = Instant::now();
        if self
            .game
            .gameplay
            .last_shot_sent_at
            .is_some_and(|last_shot| now.saturating_duration_since(last_shot) < SHOT_LOCAL_COOLDOWN)
        {
            return;
        }
        let direction = super::camera::camera_direction(
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.character,
            self.input.yaw,
            self.input.pitch,
        )
        .normalize()
        .to_array();
        if let Some(session) = self.connection.session_mut() {
            match session.queue(&ClientMessage::Fire { direction }) {
                Ok(()) => {
                    self.game.gameplay.last_shot_sent_at = Some(now);
                    if self.ui.console.open {
                        self.ui.console.push_line(Text::ShotFired.to_string());
                    }
                }
                Err(error) if self.ui.console.open => self
                    .ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::CouldNotFire(error.into()).to_string()),
                Err(_) => {}
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn queue_portal(&mut self) {
        let Some(session) = self.connection.session_mut() else {
            return;
        };
        if session.state() == SessionState::Connected {
            let _ = session.queue(&ClientMessage::UsePortal);
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn update_remote_player_rendering(&mut self, now: Instant) {
        if self.connection.session().is_none() {
            self.game.gameplay.clear_remote_players();
            self.gpu.remote_vertices.clear();
            self.gpu.update_remote_shadow_vertices(&[]);
            return;
        }
        if self
            .game
            .gameplay
            .update_remote_vertices(now, self.gpu.render_origin)
        {
            self.gpu
                .update_remote_vertices(&self.game.gameplay.remote_vertices);
        }
        let center = self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm.map_or_else(
            || {
                self.game
                    .gameplay
                    .prediction
                    .character
                    .position
                    .map(f64::from)
            },
            |position| position.0.map(|value| value as f64 / 1000.0),
        );
        let shadow_vertices_changed = self
            .game
            .gameplay
            .update_remote_shadow_vertices(center, self.gpu.render_origin);
        if self.gpu.shadow_remote_dirty || shadow_vertices_changed {
            self.gpu
                .update_remote_shadow_vertices(&self.game.gameplay.remote_shadow_vertices);
        }
    }
}

    pub(super) fn handle_server_message(&mut self, message: ServerMessage) {
        match message {
            message @ ServerMessage::Welcome { .. } => self.handle_welcome(message),
            ServerMessage::Pong if self.ui.console.open => {
                self.ui.console.push_line(Text::Pong.to_string());

            } => {

                self.ui
                    .console
                    .push_error(Text::ServerError { code }.to_string());
            }

                target_id,
                remaining_health,
                killed,
            } => {
                self.handle_shot_result(target_id, remaining_health, killed);
            }
            ServerMessage::HealthUpdate(health) => self.handle_health_update(health),
            ServerMessage::Chat {
                sender_id,
                sender_name,
                text,
            } => self.ui.console.push_chat_line(
                &Text::Chat {
                    sender_name,
                    sender_id,
                    text,
                }
                .to_string(),
            ),
            ServerMessage::Bye => {
                if self.ui.console.open {
                    self.ui.console.push_line(Text::ServerClosed.to_string());
                }
                self.clear_connection();
            }

                destination,
                manifest,

                context,
                map_fingerprint,
                destination,
                destination_mm,
                health,
                manifest,
                ..
            } => self.handle_transition_committed(
                context,
                map_fingerprint,
                destination,
                destination_mm,
                health,
                manifest,
            ),
            ServerMessage::TransitionCancelled {
                transition_id,
                context,
            } => {
                self.handle_transition_cancelled(transition_id, context);
