<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/session/message_handling/gameplay.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="127" bytes="4646" original_lines="127" original_bytes="4646" minified="false" sha256="fe6ee1806337acfdaa0f0ae166111d8e96e56f6037528e00e6d95da735e4e687">>>
use super::*;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn handle_altitude_result(
        &mut self,
        context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        position_mm: Option<minimium_world::world::Position3Mm>,
    ) {
        if Some(context) != self.game.session_context {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(position) = position_mm {
            self.apply_altitude_position(position);
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_line("set_altitude: destination reached");
        } else {
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_error("set_altitude: rejected; requires fly on, a planet and a valid height");
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn handle_map_teleport_result(
        &mut self,
        position_mm: Option<minimium_world::world::Position3Mm>,
    ) {
        self.map_teleport_pending = false;
        if let Some(position_mm) = position_mm {
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm = Some(position_mm);
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position =
                position_mm.0.map(|coordinate| coordinate as f32 / 1000.0);
            let origin = self
                .game
                .gameplay
                .prediction
                .character
                .position
                .map(|coordinate| (coordinate / 256.0).round() * 256.0);
            self.gpu.set_render_origin(origin);
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.velocity = [0.0; 3];
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.grounded = false;
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.reset_time();
            self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready = false;
            self.teleport_loading = true;
            self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
            self.last_render_position = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
            self.input.keys.clear();
            self.input.last_sent_direction = [0.0; 2];
            self.connection_status = "Earth: wczytywanie terenu...".into();
            self.ui.console.push_line("map_telepo: destination reached");
        } else {
            self.connection_status = "Earth: wybierz punkt na lądzie".into();
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_error("map_telepo: destination unavailable; choose land");
            if !self.overview_open && self.gpu.scene_visible {
                self.toggle_overview();
                self.map_teleport_armed = true;
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn handle_shot_result(
        &mut self,
        target_id: Option<minimium_core::ids::PlayerId>,
        remaining_health: Option<u16>,
        killed: bool,
    ) {
        if target_id.is_some() {
            self.game.gameplay.hit_confirmation_until =
                Some(Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(180));
        }
        if self.ui.console.open {
            match (target_id, remaining_health, killed) {
                (Some(target_id), Some(health), true) => self
                    .ui
                    .console
                    .push_line(Text::TargetRespawned { target_id, health }.to_string()),
                (Some(target_id), Some(health), false) => self
                    .ui
                    .console
                    .push_line(Text::Hit { target_id, health }.to_string()),
                _ => self.ui.console.push_line(Text::ShotMissed.to_string()),
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn handle_health_update(&mut self, health: u16) {
        self.game.gameplay.health = health;
        if self.ui.console.open {
            self.ui
                .console
                .push_line(Text::Health { health }.to_string());
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn handle_snapshot(&mut self, message: ServerMessage) {
        let ServerMessage::Snapshot {
            server_time_ms,
            full_snapshot,
            self_position,
            self_position_mm,
            self_velocity,
            self_grounded,
            players,
            removed_players,
            ..
        } = message
        else {
            return;
        };
        if !self.game.gameplay.apply_snapshot(
            server_time_ms,
            full_snapshot,
            self_position,
            self_position_mm,
            self_velocity,
            self_grounded,
            &players,
            &removed_players,
        ) {
            eprintln!("{}", Text::VisiblePlayerLimitExceeded);
            self.fail_connection(Text::VisiblePlayerLimitExceeded.to_string());
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/session/message_handling/transitions.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="88" bytes="3143" original_lines="88" original_bytes="3143" minified="false" sha256="b0863961bd52722a460ea92c8975fd5ae6b34c2fe0a686ca30df5263bfa3c43b">>>
use super::*;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn handle_transition_prepare(
        &mut self,
        transition_id: minimium_world::world::TransitionId,
        source_context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        target_context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        map_fingerprint: u64,
        destination: [f32; 3],
        manifest: WorldManifest,
    ) {
        let instance = target_context.instance();
        if !self.load_generated_catalog(instance, manifest) {
            self.fail_connection("target generation manifest is not supported");
            return;
        }
        let matches_catalog = self
            .world_catalog
            .get(&instance)
            .is_some_and(|map| map.fingerprint() == map_fingerprint)
            && self.game.world_manifests.get(&instance) == Some(&manifest);
        if !matches_catalog {
            self.fail_connection("target world content does not match the loaded manifest");
            return;
        }
        self.pending_sector_transitions.insert(
            transition_id,
            PendingSectorTransition {
                source_context,
                context: target_context,
                destination,
                manifest,
                ready_sent: false,
            },
        );
        if self.ui.console.open {
            self.ui.console.push_line("Preparing world transfer");
        }
        self.advance_pending_transitions();
    }

    pub(super) fn handle_transition_committed(
        &mut self,
        context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        map_fingerprint: u64,
        destination: [f32; 3],
        destination_mm: minimium_world::world::Position3Mm,
        health: u16,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
    ) {
        if !self.load_generated_catalog(context.instance(), manifest) {
            self.fail_connection("target generation manifest is not supported");
            return;
        }
        if !self.install_world(
            context.instance(),
            map_fingerprint,
            Some(destination),
            manifest,
        ) {
            self.fail_connection("target world geometry does not match the server");
            return;
        }
        self.game.session_context = Some(context);
        self.game.gameplay.health = health;
        self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm = manifest.planet().map(|_| destination_mm);
        if self.ui.console.open {
            self.ui.console.push_line("World transfer committed");
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn handle_transition_cancelled(
        &mut self,
        transition_id: minimium_world::world::TransitionId,
        context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
    ) {
        if let Some(pending) = self
            .pending_sector_transitions
            .get(&transition_id)
            .copied()
            .filter(|pending| pending.source_context == context)
        {
            self.pending_sector_transitions.remove(&transition_id);
            self.release_prepared_target(pending.context.instance());
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/session/sector_readiness.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="115" bytes="4253" original_lines="115" original_bytes="4253" minified="false" sha256="5f9ba2eb107de687893ca6aa3d9645eb1eb21a6e416bf5ca97ce77bcc56c2d85">>>
use super::*;

impl Renderer {
    pub(in crate::renderer) fn refresh_active_sector_scene(&mut self) -> bool {
        let Some(manifest) = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&self.game.current_instance)
            .copied()
        else {
            self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready = false;
            return false;
        };
        let view = self.terrain_view();
        let Some(scene) = self.sector_cache.ensure_scene(
            self.game.current_instance,
            manifest,
            self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position,
            view,
            self.gpu.render_origin,
            &self.world_catalog,
            &self.game.world_manifests,
            self.connection
                .session()
                .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
        ) else {
            self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready = false;
            return false;
        };
        if !self
            .gpu
            .cache_sector_scene(self.game.current_instance, &scene)
            || !self
                .gpu
                .activate_sector_scene(self.game.current_instance, &scene)
        {
            self.game.gameplay.collision_index = scene.collision;
            self.last_render_position = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
            self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready = true;
            return true;
        }
        self.game.gameplay.collision_index = scene.collision;
        self.active_sector_keys.clone_from(&scene.keys);
        self.last_render_position = scene
            .prepared
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(self.game.gameplay.prediction.character.position, |p| {
                p.position()
            });
        self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready = true;
        true
    }

    pub(in crate::renderer) fn advance_pending_transitions(&mut self) {
        let pending: Vec<_> = self
            .pending_sector_transitions
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, pending)| !pending.ready_sent)
            .map(|(id, pending)| (*id, *pending))
            .collect();
        for (transition_id, pending) in pending {
            let instance = pending.context.instance();
            let Some(scene) = self.sector_cache.ensure_scene(
                instance,
                pending.manifest,
                pending.destination,
                minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView::new(
                    pending.destination,
                    self.fov_degrees.to_radians(),
                    self.gpu.size.height,
                ),
                self.gpu.render_origin,
                &self.world_catalog,
                &self.game.world_manifests,
                self.connection
                    .session()
                    .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
            ) else {
                continue;
            };
            if !self.gpu.cache_sector_scene(instance, &scene) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(session) = self.connection.session_mut() else {
                continue;
            };
            if session
                .queue_transition_ready(transition_id, pending.context)
                .is_ok()
            {
                if let Some(pending) = self.pending_sector_transitions.get_mut(&transition_id) {
                    // Keep the target until Commit/Cancel so cancellation can
                    // release its pins and GPU buffers after Ready was queued.
                    pending.ready_sent = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub(in crate::renderer) fn clear_pending_sector_transitions(&mut self) {
        for (_, pending) in std::mem::take(&mut self.pending_sector_transitions) {
            self.release_prepared_target(pending.context.instance());
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn release_prepared_target(
        &mut self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
    ) {
        if instance != self.game.current_instance {
            self.sector_cache.release_interest(instance);
            self.gpu.release_world_sectors(instance);
        }
    }
}

use super::*;
impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn load_generated_catalog(
        &mut self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
    ) -> bool {
        if !matches!(manifest.generation().revision().get(), 2..=4)
            || !matches!(instance.get(), 1 | 2)
        {
            return true;
        }
        let seed = manifest.generation().seed().get()
            ^ if instance.get() == 2 {
                0x0030_0000_0000_0003
            } else {
                0
            };
        let generated = if let Some(planet) = manifest.planet() {
            minimium_game_sample::generate_worlds_with_planet_revision_and_geography(
                seed,
                planet,
                manifest.generation().revision().get(),
                self.connection
                    .session()
                    .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
            )
        } else {
            minimium_game_sample::generate_worlds(seed)
        };
        let Ok(worlds) = generated else {
            return false;
        };
        if worlds[instance.get() as usize - 1].manifest != manifest {
            return false;
        }
        if self.game.world_manifests.get(&instance) != Some(&manifest) {
            self.sector_cache.reset();
            for generated_instance in [1, 2] {
                self.gpu.release_world_sectors(
                    minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(generated_instance)
                        .expect("generated instance ID is nonzero"),
                );
            }
        }
        for world in worlds {
            self.game
                .world_manifests
                .insert(world.instance, world.manifest);
            self.world_catalog.insert(world.instance, world.map);
        }
        true
    }

    pub(super) fn install_world(
        &mut self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
        fingerprint: u64,
        destination: Option<[f32; 3]>,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
    ) -> bool {
        let Some(map) = self.world_catalog.get(&instance) else {
            return false;
        };
        if map.fingerprint() != fingerprint {
            return false;
        }
        if self.game.world_manifests.get(&instance) != Some(&manifest) {
            return false;
        }
        let target_position = destination.unwrap_or_else(|| map.spawn());
        let scene = self.sector_cache.ensure_scene(
            instance,
            manifest,
            target_position,
            minimium_renderer::terrain_view::TerrainView::new(
                target_position,
                self.fov_degrees.to_radians(),
                self.gpu.size.height,
            ),
            self.gpu.render_origin,
            &self.world_catalog,
            &self.game.world_manifests,
            self.connection
                .session()
                .and_then(|session| session.prepared_geography()),
        );
        let gpu_ready = scene.as_ref().is_some_and(|scene| {
            self.gpu.cache_sector_scene(instance, scene)
                && self.gpu.activate_sector_scene(instance, scene)
        });
        self.teleport_loading = !gpu_ready;
        self.gpu.scene_visible = gpu_ready;
        let previous_instance = self.game.current_instance;
        self.game.gameplay.collision_index = scene.as_ref().map_or_else(
            || minimium_simulation::CollisionIndex::from_geometry(Vec::new(), Vec::new()),
            |s| s.collision.clone(),
        );
        self.game.gameplay.prediction.character = CharacterState::at_spawn_with_gravity(
            target_position,
            super::camera::gravity_for_manifest(manifest),
        );
        self.game.gameplay.prediction.position_mm = manifest.planet().map(|_| {
            if target_position == map.spawn() {
                map.spawn_position_mm().unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(
                        target_position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                    )
                })
            } else {
                minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(
                    target_position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                )
            }
        });
        self.game.gameplay.sectors_ready = scene.is_some();
        self.active_sector_keys = scene.as_ref().map_or_else(Vec::new, |s| s.keys.clone());
        self.last_render_position = if gpu_ready {
            target_position
        } else {
            [f32::INFINITY; 3]
        };
        self.game.gameplay.prediction.reset_time();
        self.reset_remote_gameplay();
        self.input.yaw = -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
        self.input.pitch = 0.0;
        self.input.keys.clear();
        self.input.jump_pending = false;
        self.input.last_sent_direction = [0.0; 2];
        self.input.input_keepalive = 0.0;
        self.game.current_instance = instance;
        self.pending_sector_transitions
            .retain(|_, pending| pending.context.instance() != instance);
        if previous_instance != instance {
            self.sector_cache.release_interest(previous_instance);
            self.gpu.release_world_sectors(previous_instance);
        }
        self.metrics.frame_stats.set_gpu_bytes(
            self.gpu.fixed_gpu_bytes
                + u64::from(self.gpu.size.width.max(1))
                    * u64::from(self.gpu.size.height.max(1))
                    * 4,
        );
        true
    }
}

        self.teleport_loading = true;
        self.gpu.scene_visible = false;
        self.input.keys.clear();
        self.input.last_sent_direction = [0.0; 2];

    }

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/shadows.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="161" bytes="5078" original_lines="161" original_bytes="5078" minified="false" sha256="d9aab23b045ae5be88ad96935a7d32379ad79b82feb18451a1788eda2bb14bd9">>>
use super::environment::{EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentFrameStatus, LocalBodyFrame};
pub(crate) use minimium_renderer::shadow_uniform::ShadowUniform;
const SHADOW_SOURCE_SUN: u32 = 1;
const SHADOW_SOURCE_MOON: u32 = 2;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum ShadowSource {
    Sun,
    Moon,
}

impl ShadowSource {
    pub(super) const fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Sun => "sun",
            Self::Moon => "moon",
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn id(self) -> u32 {
        match self {
            Self::Sun => SHADOW_SOURCE_SUN,
            Self::Moon => SHADOW_SOURCE_MOON,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn direction(self, frame: &EnvironmentFrame, physical: bool) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
        let direction = match self {
            Self::Sun if physical => frame.global_sun?.direction_world,
            Self::Moon if physical => std::array::from_fn(|i| {
                f64::from(frame.environment_uniform.moon_orbit_world[i])
                    - frame.render_view.camera_eye_world_m[i]
            }),
            Self::Sun => frame.local_sun?.geometric_direction_world,
            Self::Moon => frame.local_moon?.geometric_direction_world,
        };
        let length = direction
            .iter()
            .map(|value| value * value)
            .sum::<f64>()
            .sqrt();
        (length.is_finite() && length > 1.0e-12).then(|| direction.map(|value| value / length))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum ShadowInvalidReason {
    Disabled,
    NoSource,
    InvalidFrame,
    IncompleteCasters,
    BudgetExceeded,
    StaleContext,
}

impl ShadowInvalidReason {
    pub(super) const fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Disabled => "disabled",
            Self::NoSource => "no_source",
            Self::InvalidFrame => "invalid_frame",
            Self::IncompleteCasters => "incomplete_casters",
            Self::BudgetExceeded => "budget_exceeded",
            Self::StaleContext => "stale_context",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct ShadowState {
    pub(super) previous_source: Option<ShadowSource>,
    pub(super) source: Option<ShadowSource>,
    pub(super) valid: bool,
    pub(super) receiver_radius_m: f32,
    pub(super) texel_m: f32,
    pub(super) invalid_reason: Option<ShadowInvalidReason>,
    pub(super) caster_keys: Vec<(minimium_world::world::SectorKey, u8)>,
}

impl ShadowState {
    pub(super) fn invalidate(&mut self, reason: ShadowInvalidReason) {
        self.valid = false;
        self.source = None;
        self.caster_keys.clear();
        self.invalid_reason = Some(reason);
    }
}

pub(super) fn select_source(
    frame: &EnvironmentFrame,
    previous: Option<ShadowSource>,
    center: [f64; 3],
    physical: bool,
) -> Option<ShadowSource> {
    if frame.status != EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available {
        return None;
    }
    let (sun, moon) = if physical {
        let mut points = minimium_renderer::shadow_view::surface_footprint(frame.render_view);
        points.push(glam::DVec3::from_array(center));
        let strength = |source: ShadowSource, rgb: [f32; 3]| -> f32 {
            let Some(direction) = source.direction(frame, true) else {
                return 0.0;
            };
            let direction = glam::DVec3::from_array(direction);
            let cosine = points
                .iter()
                .map(|point| point.normalize_or_zero().dot(direction))
                .fold(-1.0, f64::max);
            let disk = ((cosine + 0.00465) / 0.0093).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
            luminance(rgb) * disk * cosine.max(0.02) as f32
        };
        let sun_rgb = frame.environment_uniform.global_sun_rgb;
        let flux = frame.environment_uniform.moon_disk_radiance[3];
        (
            strength(ShadowSource::Sun, [sun_rgb[0], sun_rgb[1], sun_rgb[2]]),
            strength(
                ShadowSource::Moon,
                [0.25, 0.32, 0.5].map(|v| v * 2e-6 * flux),
            ),
        )
    } else {
        (
            body_strength(frame.local_sun),
            body_strength(frame.local_moon),
        )
    };
    let strongest = if sun > 0.0 || moon > 0.0 {
        Some(if sun >= moon {
            ShadowSource::Sun
        } else {
            ShadowSource::Moon
        })
    } else {
        None
    }?;
    let strongest_value = match strongest {
        ShadowSource::Sun => sun,
        ShadowSource::Moon => moon,
    };
    previous
        .filter(|source| {
            let value = match source {
                ShadowSource::Sun => sun,
                ShadowSource::Moon => moon,
            };
            value > 0.0 && value >= strongest_value * 0.95
        })
        .or(Some(strongest))
}

fn body_strength(body: Option<LocalBodyFrame>) -> f32 {
    let Some(body) = body else {
        return 0.0;
    };
    luminance(body.effective_linear_rgb)
}

fn luminance([red, green, blue]: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    (0.2126 * red + 0.7152 * green + 0.0722 * blue).max(0.0)
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/shadow_gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="228" bytes="9210" original_lines="228" original_bytes="9210" minified="false" sha256="5e2a2edce17a1d1b2048fc1435303e8b8ec00172684f2118fbfdfe17f2a0043c">>>
use super::{
    environment::{EnvironmentFrame, EnvironmentFrameStatus},
    shadows::{self, ShadowInvalidReason, ShadowUniform},
    GpuResources,
};
use bytemuck::Zeroable;
use minimium_renderer::{geometry::Vertex, ShadowSettings};

impl GpuResources {
    pub(super) fn set_shadow_settings(
        &mut self,
        settings: ShadowSettings,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        let previous_bytes = self.shadow_gpu.gpu_bytes();
        self.shadow_gpu.reconfigure(&self.device, settings)?;
        let current_bytes = self.shadow_gpu.gpu_bytes();
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(previous_bytes)
            .saturating_add(current_bytes);
        if !settings.enabled {
            self.release_shadow_map_casters();
            self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
                .fixed_gpu_bytes
                .saturating_sub(self.shadow_gpu.release_player_casters());
            self.shadow_remote_complete = false;
            self.shadow_remote_dirty = true;
            self.shadow_state.invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::Disabled);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn update_remote_shadow_vertices(&mut self, vertices: &[Vertex]) {
        if !self.shadow_gpu.settings.enabled {
            self.shadow_gpu.clear_player_casters();
            self.shadow_remote_complete = false;
            self.shadow_remote_dirty = true;
            return;
        }
        self.shadow_remote_complete = true;
        self.shadow_remote_dirty = false;
        let size = (super::MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS * 36 * std::mem::size_of::<Vertex>()) as u64;
        match self
            .shadow_gpu
            .upload_player_casters(&self.device, &self.queue, vertices, size)
        {
            Ok(allocated_bytes) => {
                self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self.fixed_gpu_bytes.saturating_add(allocated_bytes);
            }
            Err(()) => {
                self.shadow_remote_complete = false;
                self.shadow_remote_dirty = true;
                self.shadow_state
                    .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::BudgetExceeded);
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn prepare_shadow_frame(
        &mut self,
        environment: &EnvironmentFrame,
        map: Option<&minimium_world::world::WorldMap>,
        player_position_m: [f64; 3],
    ) {
        self.shadow_state.caster_keys.clear();
        self.shadow_state.valid = false;
        self.shadow_state.source = None;
        self.shadow_state.invalid_reason = None;
        if !self.shadow_gpu.settings.enabled {
            self.shadow_state.invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::Disabled);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        if environment.status != EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
            || !self.scene_visible
            || (self.overview_active && !self.overview_planet)
        {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::InvalidFrame);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        let Some(context) = environment.context else {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::StaleContext);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        };
        if context.instance() != self.active_world_instance
            || self
                .world_geometry
                .versions()
                .get(&self.active_world_instance)
                .is_none_or(|(_, revision)| *revision != context.content_revision())
        {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::StaleContext);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        let map = match map {
            Some(map) => map,
            None => {
                self.shadow_state
                    .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::StaleContext);
                self.shadow_gpu
                    .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
                return;
            }
        };
        let ground_distance = self
            .active_sector_keys
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(key, lod)| {
                self.world_geometry
                    .bounds()
                    .get(&(self.active_world_instance, *key, *lod))
            })
            .map(|bounds| bounds.distance_to(environment.render_view.camera_eye_world_m))
            .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
        let Some(region) = minimium_renderer::shadow_view::ShadowRegion::for_view(
            environment.render_view,
            player_position_m,
            ground_distance,
            self.shadow_gpu.settings,
            self.shadow_state.receiver_radius_m,
        ) else {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::IncompleteCasters);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        };
        let source = shadows::select_source(
            environment,
            self.shadow_state.previous_source,
            region.center_world,
            self.atmosphere_gpu.is_active(),
        );
        let Some(source) = source else {
            self.shadow_state.previous_source = None;
            self.shadow_state.invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::NoSource);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        };
        self.update_shadow_map_vertices(map, region.center_world, region.settings.caster_radius_m);
        if self.shadow_state.invalid_reason == Some(ShadowInvalidReason::BudgetExceeded) {
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        if !self.overview_active && !self.shadow_remote_complete {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::IncompleteCasters);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        if self.active_sector_keys.is_empty() {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::IncompleteCasters);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        let radius = f64::from(region.settings.caster_radius_m);
        for (key, lod) in &self.active_sector_keys {
            let catalog_key = (self.active_world_instance, *key, *lod);
            if !self.world_geometry.catalog().contains_key(&catalog_key) {
                self.shadow_state
                    .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::IncompleteCasters);
                self.shadow_gpu
                    .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
                return;
            }
            let Some(bounds) = self.world_geometry.bounds().get(&catalog_key) else {
                self.shadow_state
                    .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::IncompleteCasters);
                self.shadow_gpu
                    .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
                return;
            };
            if bounds.intersects_sphere(region.center_world, radius) {
                self.shadow_state.caster_keys.push((*key, *lod));
            }
        }
        if self.shadow_state.caster_keys.is_empty() {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::IncompleteCasters);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        }
        let Some(direction) = source.direction(environment, self.atmosphere_gpu.is_active()) else {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::InvalidFrame);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        };
        let Some(uniform) = minimium_renderer::shadow_uniform::prepare_at_origin(
            direction,
            region.center_world,
            self.render_origin.map(f64::from),
            region.settings,
            source.id(),
        ) else {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::InvalidFrame);
            self.shadow_gpu
                .write_uniform(&self.queue, &ShadowUniform::zeroed());
            return;
        };
        self.shadow_state.previous_source = Some(source);
        self.shadow_state.source = Some(source);
        self.shadow_state.valid = true;
        self.shadow_state.receiver_radius_m = region.settings.receiver_radius_m;
        self.shadow_state.texel_m =
            region.settings.receiver_radius_m * 2.02 / region.settings.resolution.max(1) as f32;
        self.shadow_state.invalid_reason = None;
        self.shadow_gpu.write_uniform(&self.queue, &uniform);
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/shadow_map_cache.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="70" bytes="2776" original_lines="70" original_bytes="2776" minified="false" sha256="372f15b71f49d7a6308b869d86b24995dd4b1a17d92cb095ac427a422a3f0fe1">>>
use super::{shadows::ShadowInvalidReason, GpuResources};
use minimium_renderer::geometry::Vertex;
const MAX_MAP_VERTEX_BYTES: u64 = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

impl GpuResources {
    pub(super) fn update_shadow_map_vertices(
        &mut self,
        map: &minimium_world::world::WorldMap,
        center: [f64; 3],
        radius: f32,
    ) {
        // Cache on coarse world cells with enough padding to keep coverage
        // complete between refreshes; avoid rebuilding authored geometry each frame.
        let step = (f64::from(radius) * 0.0625).max(16.0);
        let center = center.map(|v| (v / step).round() * step);
        let fingerprint = map.fingerprint();
        if self.shadow_map_instance == Some(self.active_world_instance)
            && self.shadow_map_fingerprint == Some(fingerprint)
            && self.shadow_map_center == Some(center)
            && self.shadow_map_radius == Some(radius)
        {
            return;
        }
        let geometry = minimium_renderer::shadow_geometry::local_map_geometry(
            map,
            center,
            f64::from(radius) + step,
        );
        let vertices =
            minimium_renderer::geometry::sector_geometry_relative(&geometry, self.render_origin);
        let bytes = vertices.len() as u64 * std::mem::size_of::<Vertex>() as u64;
        if bytes > MAX_MAP_VERTEX_BYTES {
            self.shadow_state
                .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::BudgetExceeded);
            self.shadow_map_center = None;
            self.shadow_gpu.clear_map_casters();
            return;
        }
        match self.shadow_gpu.upload_map_casters(
            &self.device,
            &self.queue,
            &vertices,
            MAX_MAP_VERTEX_BYTES,
        ) {
            Ok(allocated_bytes) => {
                self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self.fixed_gpu_bytes.saturating_add(allocated_bytes);
            }
            Err(()) => {
                self.shadow_state
                    .invalidate(ShadowInvalidReason::BudgetExceeded);
                self.shadow_map_center = None;
                return;
            }
        }
        self.shadow_map_instance = Some(self.active_world_instance);
        self.shadow_map_fingerprint = Some(fingerprint);
        self.shadow_map_center = Some(center);
        self.shadow_map_radius = Some(radius);
    }

    pub(super) fn release_shadow_map_casters(&mut self) {
        self.fixed_gpu_bytes = self
            .fixed_gpu_bytes
            .saturating_sub(self.shadow_gpu.release_map_casters());
        self.shadow_map_instance = None;
        self.shadow_map_fingerprint = None;
        self.shadow_map_radius = None;
        self.shadow_map_center = None;
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) struct EnvironmentDrawCalls {
    pub(super) sky: u32,
    pub(super) stars: u32,
    pub(super) sun: u32,
    pub(super) moon: u32,
    pub(super) halos: u32,
    pub(super) shadows: u32,
    pub(super) overview_marker: u32,
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_surface_sky(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    frame.status == EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
        && frame.render_view.kind == EnvironmentViewKind::Surface
        && frame.sky.is_some()
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_overview_sky(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    frame.status == EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
        && frame.render_view.kind == EnvironmentViewKind::Overview
        && frame.sky.is_some()
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_sun(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    should_draw_surface_sky(frame)
        && frame
            .local_sun
            .is_some_and(|sun| sun.visible_fraction > 0.0)
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_stars(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    should_draw_surface_sky(frame)
        && frame.diagnostics.star_frame.is_some()
        && frame.environment_uniform.sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility[3] > 0.0
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_moon(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    should_draw_surface_sky(frame)
        && frame
            .local_moon
            .is_some_and(|moon| moon.visible_fraction > 0.0)
        && frame.environment_uniform.moon_apparent_world[3] > 0.0
}

// The overview camera can see across the globe's player horizon. The planet
// itself covers disks behind it when its geometry is drawn after these passes.
pub(super) fn should_draw_overview_sun(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    frame.status == EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
        && frame.render_view.kind == EnvironmentViewKind::Overview
        && frame.sky.is_some()
        && frame.environment_uniform.sun_apparent_world[3] > 0.0
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_overview_stars(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    frame.status == EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
        && frame.render_view.kind == EnvironmentViewKind::Overview
        && frame.diagnostics.star_frame.is_some()
}

pub(super) fn should_draw_overview_moon(frame: &EnvironmentFrame) -> bool {
    frame.status == EnvironmentFrameStatus::Available
        && frame.render_view.kind == EnvironmentViewKind::Overview
        && frame.sky.is_some()
        && frame.environment_uniform.moon_apparent_world[3] > 0.0
}

pub(super) fn clear_color(scene_visible: bool, overview_active: bool) -> wgpu::Color {
    if !scene_visible {
        return wgpu::Color::BLACK;
    }
    if overview_active {
        wgpu::Color {
            r: 0.003,
            g: 0.004,
            b: 0.009,
            a: 1.0,
        }
    } else {
        wgpu::Color {
            r: 0.008,
            g: 0.010,
            b: 0.014,
            a: 1.0,
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/terrain_status.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="51" bytes="2501" original_lines="51" original_bytes="2501" minified="false" sha256="283ae35adabe9b9be6f81a2f4dacf92354851da5524c962a066a0909892bedf2">>>
//! Read-only presentation diagnostics. No sampling or GPU readback on this path.
use super::Renderer;

impl Renderer {
    pub(super) fn terrain_status(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let instance = self.game.current_instance;
        let scene = self.sector_cache.presentation(instance);
        let relief = self
            .game
            .world_manifests
            .get(&instance)
            .and_then(|m| m.planet())
            .map(|p| p.peak_relief)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let surfaces = self.gpu.world_geometry.terrain();
        let vertices: u64 = self
            .gpu
            .active_sector_keys
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(k, l)| surfaces.get(&(instance, *k, *l)))
            .map(|b| u64::from(b.surface_count))
            .sum();
        let ocean_vertices: u64 = self
            .gpu
            .active_sector_keys
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(k, l)| surfaces.get(&(instance, *k, *l)))
            .map(|b| u64::from(b.ocean_count))
            .sum();
        let buffers: u64 = surfaces
            .values()
            .map(|b| b.surface.size() + b.ocean.size() + b.objects.size())
            .sum();
        vec![
            format!("terrain view={} patches={}/{} triangles={} resident_surface_mib={:.2}",
                if self.overview_open { "overview" } else { "surface" },
                self.gpu.active_sector_keys.len(), self.terrain_view().patch_budget(),
                vertices/3, buffers as f64/1048576.0),
            format!("ocean shape=sea_level_sphere triangles={} shoreline=ground_intersection", ocean_vertices/3),
            format!("terrain peaks={:.3}x exponent={} source_range={}..{}m climate_relief_influence={:.2}",
                relief.multiplier_permille as f64/1000.0, relief.exponent, relief.start_m, relief.full_m,
                self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.climate[3]),
            format!("terrain last_prepare_ms={:.2} source_cache_mib={:.2} upload_limit=8_patches/4MiB recipe={}",
                scene.map_or(0.0,|s| s.build_ms), scene.map_or(0.0,|s| s.cache_bytes as f64/1048576.0),
                minimium_procgen::surface_habitat::SURFACE_RECIPE_REVISION),
            format!("terrain climate={} material_mib={:.2}; debug source: cyan=mapped orange=procedural",
                if self.gpu.terrain_gpu.uniform.cover[2] > 0.0 { "planet+local-history" } else { "preparing-history" },
                self.gpu.terrain_gpu.bytes as f64/1048576.0),
        ]
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/window.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="292" bytes="12910" original_lines="292" original_bytes="12910" minified="false" sha256="6109dba8536a43cbeb2ae15b425b5672a2d1bcd140e5e32e31794006f98c7b82">>>
use super::*;
use crate::messages::ClientText as Text;

struct App {
    window: Option<Arc<Window>>,
    renderer: Option<Renderer>,
    world_map: Option<WorldMap>,
    world_catalog:
        Option<std::collections::HashMap<minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId, WorldMap>>,
    world_manifests: Option<
        std::collections::HashMap<
            minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
            minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
        >,
    >,
    profile_id: PlayerProfileId,
    options: crate::options::ClientOptions,
    data_dir: PathBuf,
    startup_error: Option<String>,
    modifiers: winit::keyboard::ModifiersState,
}

impl ApplicationHandler for App {
    fn resumed(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop) {
        if self.window.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let attributes = super::window_mode::attributes(event_loop, self.options.windowed)
            .with_title(Text::WindowTitle.to_string());
        let window = match event_loop.create_window(attributes) {
            Ok(window) => Arc::new(window),
            Err(error) => {
                self.startup_error =
                    Some(Text::WindowCreationFailed(error.to_string()).to_string());
                event_loop.exit();
                return;
            }
        };
        if self.options.windowed {
            super::window_mode::fit_windowed(&window, event_loop);
        }
        let world_map = self
            .world_map
            .take()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{}", Text::RendererAlreadyInitialized));
        match pollster::block_on(Renderer::new(init::RendererSetup {
            window: Arc::clone(&window),
            map: world_map,
            world_catalog: self
                .world_catalog
                .take()
                .expect("world catalog is available before renderer startup"),
            world_manifests: self
                .world_manifests
                .take()
                .expect("world manifests are available before renderer startup"),
            profile_id: self.profile_id,
            data_dir: self.data_dir.clone(),
            map_path: self.options.map_path.clone(),
            world_definition_path: self.options.world_definition_path.clone(),
            threads: self.options.threads,
            sky_quality: self.options.sky_quality,
            require_earth: self.options.require_earth,
            demo: self.options.demo,
        })) {
            Ok(mut renderer) => {
                if !self.options.demo {
                    if let Some(address) = &self.options.connect {
                        renderer.start_remote_attempt(address);
                    } else {
                        renderer.start_local_attempt(renderer.settings.threads);
                    }
                }
                self.window = Some(window);
                self.renderer = Some(renderer);
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.startup_error =
                    Some(Text::GraphicsInitializationFailed(error.to_string()).to_string());
                event_loop.exit();
            }
        }
    }

    fn window_event(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop, _id: WindowId, event: WindowEvent) {
        let (Some(window), Some(renderer)) = (&self.window, &mut self.renderer) else {
            return;
        };
        match event {
            WindowEvent::CloseRequested => event_loop.exit(),
            WindowEvent::Resized(size) => renderer.resize(size),
            WindowEvent::ModifiersChanged(modifiers) => self.modifiers = modifiers.state(),
            WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, .. } => {
                super::window_events::keyboard(renderer, window, event_loop, event, self.modifiers)
            }
            WindowEvent::MouseInput { state, button, .. } => {
                super::window_events::mouse_input(renderer, window, state, button)
            }
            WindowEvent::MouseWheel { delta, .. } => {
                super::window_events::mouse_wheel(renderer, delta)
            }
            WindowEvent::CursorMoved { position, .. } => {
                super::window_events::cursor_moved(renderer, window, position)
            }
            WindowEvent::RedrawRequested => {
                let started = Instant::now();
                let interval = started.saturating_duration_since(renderer.metrics.last_redraw);
                renderer.metrics.last_redraw = started;
                let mut prepared_environment = renderer.update();
                let client_view = renderer.game.view();
                prepared_environment = prepared_environment.with_client_view(&client_view);
                let scene = super::scene_bridge::RenderSceneSnapshot::new(
                    &prepared_environment,
                    renderer.world_catalog.get(&client_view.world_instance),
                    renderer.gpu.active_sector_keys.clone(),
                );
                let draws = match renderer.gpu.render(&scene) {
                    Ok(draws) => draws,
                    Err(
                        wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Lost | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Outdated,
                    ) => {
                        renderer.resize(window.inner_size());
                        0
                    }
                    Err(error) => {
                        eprintln!("{}", Text::RenderFailed(format!("{error:?}")));
                        0
                    }
                };
                renderer
                    .ui
                    .console
                    .restore_vertices(prepared_environment.take_ui_vertices());
                renderer.update_gpu_memory_metric();
                renderer.record_environment_render_metrics(draws > 0);
                renderer
                    .metrics
                    .frame_stats
                    .record_frame(interval, started.elapsed(), draws);
                if draws > 0 {
                    renderer.metrics.fps_frames += 1;
                }
                let sample_time = renderer.metrics.fps_time.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
                if sample_time >= 1.0 {
                    let fps = renderer.metrics.fps_frames as f64 / sample_time;
                    renderer.metrics.fps_frames = 0;
                    renderer.metrics.fps_time = Instant::now();
                    let coordinates =
                        if renderer.settings.require_earth && renderer.gpu.scene_visible {
                            let [x, y, z] = renderer
                                .game
                                .gameplay
                                .prediction
                                .character
                                .position
                                .map(f64::from);
                            let radius = (x * x + y * y + z * z).sqrt();
                            format!(
                                " | {:.4}°N {:.4}°E",
                                (y / radius).asin().to_degrees(),
                                z.atan2(x).to_degrees()
                            )
                        } else {
                            String::new()
                        };
                    window.set_title(&format!(
                        "{} | {}{} | {}",
                        Text::WindowTitleStatus {
                            fps,
                            health: renderer.game.gameplay.health
                        },
                        renderer.connection_status,
                        coordinates,
                        renderer.environment_frame.title_suffix()
                    ));
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn device_event(
        &mut self,
        _event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop,
        _device_id: winit::event::DeviceId,
        event: DeviceEvent,
    ) {
        if let Some(renderer) = &mut self.renderer {
            super::window_events::device_event(renderer, event);
        }
    }

    fn about_to_wait(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop) {
        if let Some(window) = &self.window {
            window.request_redraw();
        }
        event_loop.set_control_flow(winit::event_loop::ControlFlow::WaitUntil(
            Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(16),
        ));
    }
}

pub fn run(options: crate::options::ClientOptions) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let map_path = options.map_path.clone();
    let world_definition_path = options.world_definition_path.clone();
    let (map, world_catalog, world_manifests) = if let Some(path) = map_path.as_deref() {
        let map = minimium_asset_io::load_map(path).map_err(|error| {
            Text::MapLoadFailed {
                path: path.display().to_string(),
                detail: error.to_string(),
            }
            .to_string()
        })?;
        let mut catalog = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        let instance = minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(1)
            .expect("legacy world instance is nonzero");
        catalog.insert(instance, map.clone());
        let manifests = std::collections::HashMap::from([(instance, legacy_manifest(1, &map))]);
        (map, catalog, manifests)
    } else if let Some(path) = world_definition_path.as_deref() {
        let definition = minimium_asset_io::load_world_definition(path).map_err(|error| {
            Text::MapLoadFailed {
                path: path.display().to_string(),
                detail: error.to_string(),
            }
            .to_string()
        })?;
        super::validate_world_manifest(definition.manifest())?;
        let map = minimium_procgen::materialize_dungeon_map(definition.dungeon())
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let instance = minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(4)
            .expect("manual world instance ID is nonzero");
        let mut catalog = std::collections::HashMap::from([(instance, map.clone())]);
        let mut manifests = std::collections::HashMap::from([(instance, definition.manifest())]);
        let legacy_map = minimium_assets::parse_map(crate::SAMPLE_MAP)
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let legacy_instance =
            minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(3).expect("legacy instance ID is nonzero");
        manifests.insert(legacy_instance, legacy_manifest(3, &legacy_map));
        catalog.insert(legacy_instance, legacy_map);
        (map, catalog, manifests)
    } else {
        let worlds = minimium_game_sample::generate_demo_worlds()
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let mut catalog = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        let mut manifests = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        for world in worlds {
            manifests.insert(world.instance, world.manifest);
            catalog.insert(world.instance, world.map);
        }
        let legacy_map = minimium_assets::parse_map(crate::SAMPLE_MAP)
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let legacy_instance =
            minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(3).expect("legacy ID is nonzero");
        manifests.insert(legacy_instance, legacy_manifest(3, &legacy_map));
        catalog.insert(legacy_instance, legacy_map);
        let map = catalog
            .get(&minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(1).expect("planet ID is nonzero"))
            .expect("demo generator always returns a planet")
            .clone();
        (map, catalog, manifests)
    };
    let (profile_dir, data_dir) = options.paths(map.fingerprint());
    let profile_id = minimium_platform::identity_store::load_or_create(&profile_dir)?;
    let event_loop = EventLoop::new()?;
    event_loop.set_control_flow(winit::event_loop::ControlFlow::WaitUntil(
        Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(16),
    ));
    let mut app = App {
        window: None,
        renderer: None,
        world_map: Some(map),
        world_catalog: Some(world_catalog),
        world_manifests: Some(world_manifests),
        profile_id,
        options,
        data_dir,
        startup_error: None,
        modifiers: winit::keyboard::ModifiersState::default(),
    };
    let event_result = event_loop.run_app(&mut app);
    let cleanup_result = app
        .renderer
        .as_mut()
        .map_or(Ok(()), Renderer::finish_on_exit);
    event_result?;
    cleanup_result?;
    if let Some(error) = app.startup_error {
        return Err(error.into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/window_events.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="228" bytes="9091" original_lines="228" original_bytes="9091" minified="false" sha256="da5902fffae8fdd85c7248bcb17256df4d32ec4ebbb149329970d7a2b678d7f0">>>
use super::*;
use winit::{
    dpi::PhysicalPosition,
    event::{KeyEvent, MouseScrollDelta},
};

pub(super) fn keyboard(
    renderer: &mut Renderer,
    window: &Window,
    event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop,
    event: KeyEvent,
    modifiers: winit::keyboard::ModifiersState,
) {
    if let PhysicalKey::Code(code) = event.physical_key {
        if code == KeyCode::F11 && event.state == ElementState::Pressed && !event.repeat {
            super::window_mode::toggle(window, event_loop);
            return;
        }
        if code == KeyCode::F1 && event.state == ElementState::Pressed && !event.repeat {
            renderer.ui.console.open = !renderer.ui.console.open;
            let reset_cursor_position = !renderer.overview_open;
            release_cursor(renderer, window, true, true, reset_cursor_position);
            return;
        }
        if renderer.ui.console.open {
            if event.state == ElementState::Pressed {
                match code {
                    KeyCode::Escape => renderer.ui.console.open = false,
                    KeyCode::Enter => {
                        if super::controller::execute_console_input(renderer) {
                            event_loop.exit();
                        }
                    }
                    _ => super::console_events::key(
                        &mut renderer.ui.console,
                        code,
                        event.text.as_ref().map(|text| text.as_str()),
                        modifiers,
                    ),
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if code == KeyCode::KeyM && event.state == ElementState::Pressed && !event.repeat {
            renderer.toggle_overview();
            release_cursor(renderer, window, true, true, true);
            return;
        }
        if renderer.overview_open {
            if code == KeyCode::Escape && event.state == ElementState::Pressed {
                renderer.toggle_overview();
            }
            return;
        }
        if code == KeyCode::Escape && event.state == ElementState::Pressed {
            renderer.connection.cancel_transition();
            release_cursor(renderer, window, false, false, true);
        } else if event.state == ElementState::Pressed {
            renderer.input.keys.insert(code);
            if code == KeyCode::Space && !event.repeat {
                renderer.input.jump_pending = true;
            }
            if code == KeyCode::KeyE && !event.repeat {
                renderer.queue_portal();
            }
        } else {
            renderer.input.keys.remove(&code);
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn mouse_input(
    renderer: &mut Renderer,
    window: &Window,
    state: ElementState,
    button: MouseButton,
) {
    match (state, button) {
        (ElementState::Pressed, MouseButton::Left) => {
            if renderer.ui.console.open {
                if let Some((x, y)) = renderer.input.last_cursor {
                    let size = window.inner_size();
                    renderer.ui.console.editor.dragging =
                        renderer
                            .ui
                            .console
                            .input_hit(size.width, size.height, x, y, false);
                }
                return;
            }
            if renderer.overview_open && !renderer.ui.console.open {
                if renderer.overview_uses_zoom() {
                    if let Some((x, y)) = renderer.input.last_cursor {
                        let size = window.inner_size();
                        if crate::console::slider_hit(size.width, size.height, x, y) {
                            renderer.overview_slider_dragging = true;
                            renderer.overview_dragged = true;
                            renderer.set_overview_zoom(crate::console::slider_value_at_y(
                                size.height,
                                y,
                            ));
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                }
                renderer.overview_dragging = true;
                renderer.overview_dragged = false;
                renderer.overview_drag_distance = 0.0;
                return;
            }
            if !renderer.ui.console.open && !renderer.overview_open {
                if renderer.input.cursor_locked {
                    renderer.queue_fire();
                } else if window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Locked).is_ok()
                    || window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Confined).is_ok()
                {
                    window.set_cursor_visible(false);
                    renderer.input.cursor_locked = true;
                    renderer.input.last_cursor = None;
                }
            }
        }
        (ElementState::Released, MouseButton::Left) => {
            renderer.ui.console.editor.dragging = false;
            let slider_dragged = std::mem::take(&mut renderer.overview_slider_dragging);
            if renderer.overview_open
                && !renderer.ui.console.open
                && !renderer.overview_dragged
                && !slider_dragged
            {
                renderer.click_map_teleport();
            }
            renderer.overview_dragging = false;
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

pub(super) fn mouse_wheel(renderer: &mut Renderer, delta: MouseScrollDelta) {
    if renderer.ui.console.open {
        let amount = scroll_amount(delta, 40.0);
        renderer.ui.console.scroll_lines(amount.round() as isize);
    } else if renderer.overview_open {
        let amount = scroll_amount(delta, 80.0);
        if renderer.overview_uses_zoom() {
            renderer.set_overview_zoom(renderer.overview_zoom * (1.0 - amount * 0.1));
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn cursor_moved(
    renderer: &mut Renderer,
    window: &Window,
    position: PhysicalPosition<f64>,
) {
    if renderer.overview_slider_dragging {
        renderer.set_overview_zoom(crate::console::slider_value_at_y(
            window.inner_size().height,
            position.y,
        ));
    }
    if renderer.ui.console.open && renderer.ui.console.editor.dragging {
        let size = window.inner_size();
        renderer
            .ui
            .console
            .input_hit(size.width, size.height, position.x, position.y, true);
    }
    if renderer.overview_open && renderer.overview_dragging && !renderer.ui.console.open {
        if let Some((x, y)) = renderer.input.last_cursor {
            renderer.overview_drag_distance +=
                ((position.x - x).powi(2) + (position.y - y).powi(2)).sqrt();
            renderer.overview_dragged |= renderer.overview_drag_distance > 5.0;
            let horizontal = if renderer.is_earth_world() { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
            renderer.overview_yaw += (position.x - x) as f32 * 0.005 * horizontal;
            renderer.overview_pitch =
                (renderer.overview_pitch + (position.y - y) as f32 * 0.005).clamp(-1.4, 1.4);
        }
    }
    if renderer.input.cursor_locked && !renderer.ui.console.open && !renderer.overview_open {
        if let Some((x, y)) = renderer.input.last_cursor {
            let horizontal = if renderer.is_earth_world() { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
            renderer.input.yaw += ((position.x - x) as f32) * 0.0025 * horizontal;
            renderer.input.pitch -= ((position.y - y) as f32) * 0.0025;
            renderer.input.pitch = renderer.input.pitch.clamp(-1.5, 1.5);
        }
    }
    renderer.input.last_cursor = Some((position.x, position.y));
}

pub(super) fn device_event(renderer: &mut Renderer, event: DeviceEvent) {
    if let DeviceEvent::MouseMotion { delta } = event {
        if renderer.input.cursor_locked && !renderer.ui.console.open && !renderer.overview_open {
            let horizontal = if renderer.is_earth_world() { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
            renderer.input.yaw += (delta.0 as f32) * 0.0025 * horizontal;
            renderer.input.pitch -= (delta.1 as f32) * 0.0025;
            renderer.input.pitch = renderer.input.pitch.clamp(-1.5, 1.5);
        }
    }
}

fn release_cursor(
    renderer: &mut Renderer,
    window: &Window,
    clear_keys: bool,
    clear_jump: bool,
    reset_cursor_position: bool,
) {
    let _ = window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::None);
    window.set_cursor_visible(true);
    renderer.input.cursor_locked = false;
    if reset_cursor_position {
        renderer.input.last_cursor = None;
    }
    if clear_keys {
        renderer.input.keys.clear();
    }
    if clear_jump {
        renderer.input.jump_pending = false;
    }
}

fn scroll_amount(delta: MouseScrollDelta, pixel_scale: f32) -> f32 {
    match delta {
        MouseScrollDelta::LineDelta(_, lines) => lines,
        MouseScrollDelta::PixelDelta(position) => position.y as f32 / pixel_scale,
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/renderer/window_mode.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="55" bytes="1940" original_lines="55" original_bytes="1940" minified="false" sha256="539176cc6251b2f8bd43d1efe637857afdf30cf924dc069bf663df643a4b9e19">>>
//! Desktop display mode policy; dimensions are physical screen pixels.
use winit::{
    dpi::{PhysicalPosition, PhysicalSize},
    event_loop::ActiveEventLoop,
    window::{Fullscreen, Window, WindowAttributes},
};
pub(super) fn attributes(event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop, windowed: bool) -> WindowAttributes {
    let monitor = event_loop
        .primary_monitor()
        .or_else(|| event_loop.available_monitors().next());
    let size = monitor
        .as_ref()
        .map_or(PhysicalSize::new(1280, 720), |m| m.size());
    WindowAttributes::default()
        .with_position(PhysicalPosition::new(0, 0))
        .with_inner_size(size)
        .with_fullscreen(if windowed {
            None
        } else {
            Some(Fullscreen::Borderless(monitor))
        })
}
pub(super) fn fit_windowed(window: &Window, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop) {
    window.set_outer_position(PhysicalPosition::new(0, 0));
    let Some(monitor) = event_loop
        .primary_monitor()
        .or_else(|| window.current_monitor())
    else {
        return;
    };
    let screen = monitor.size();
    let outer = window.outer_size();
    let inner = window.inner_size();
    // Account for the title bar and borders so the outer frame fits the screen.
    let size = PhysicalSize::new(
        screen
            .width
            .saturating_sub(outer.width.saturating_sub(inner.width))
            .max(1),
        screen
            .height
            .saturating_sub(outer.height.saturating_sub(inner.height))
            .max(1),
    );
    let _ = window.request_inner_size(size);
    window.set_outer_position(PhysicalPosition::new(0, 0));
}
pub(super) fn toggle(window: &Window, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop) {
    if window.fullscreen().is_some() {
        window.set_fullscreen(None);
        fit_windowed(window, event_loop);
    } else {
        window.set_fullscreen(Some(Fullscreen::Borderless(window.current_monitor())));
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/stats.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="154" bytes="6329" original_lines="154" original_bytes="6329" minified="false" sha256="c1b24ae4c50d19fadebc5e1661b9806b5c86ffda030b4d1fc24908309ac29313">>>
use minimium_telemetry::duration::DurationStats;
use minimium_telemetry::process::ProcessSampler;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub(crate) mod environment;

/// Fixed-storage frame histograms; periodic process sampling may allocate on
/// platforms that read process data from files.
pub struct FrameStats {
    frame_intervals: DurationStats,
    cpu_work: DurationStats,
    sample_count: u64,
    elapsed_nanoseconds: u128,
    presented_frames: u64,
    total_draw_calls: u64,
    gpu_bytes: Option<u64>,
    environment: environment::EnvironmentStats,
    process: ProcessSampler,
    process_cpu_time: Option<Duration>,
}

impl Default for FrameStats {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            frame_intervals: DurationStats::frames(),
            cpu_work: DurationStats::frames(),
            sample_count: 0,
            elapsed_nanoseconds: 0,
            presented_frames: 0,
            total_draw_calls: 0,
            gpu_bytes: None,
            environment: environment::EnvironmentStats::default(),
            process: ProcessSampler::default(),
            process_cpu_time: None,
        }
    }
}

impl FrameStats {
    /// Records one render-loop sample.
    ///
    /// `draw_calls == 0` denotes a skipped frame. Any positive value counts as
    /// a presented frame for FPS, so callers should pass zero when surface
    /// acquisition skips presentation.
    pub fn record_frame(&mut self, interval: Duration, cpu_work: Duration, draw_calls: u32) {
        self.process_cpu_time = self.process.sample(Instant::now()).cpu_time;
        self.frame_intervals.record(interval);
        self.cpu_work.record(cpu_work);
        self.sample_count = self.sample_count.saturating_add(1);
        self.elapsed_nanoseconds = self.elapsed_nanoseconds.saturating_add(interval.as_nanos());
        self.total_draw_calls = self.total_draw_calls.saturating_add(u64::from(draw_calls));
        if draw_calls > 0 {
            self.presented_frames = self.presented_frames.saturating_add(1);
        }
    }

    /// Sets the renderer's current engine-side GPU memory estimate.
    pub fn set_gpu_bytes(&mut self, bytes: u64) {
        self.gpu_bytes = Some(bytes);
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_environment_cpu(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.environment.record_cpu(duration);
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_shadow_cpu(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.environment.record_shadow_cpu(duration);
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_environment_upload_cpu(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.environment.record_upload_cpu(duration);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_astronomy_counters(
        &mut self,
        ephemeris_evaluations: u64,
        ephemeris_cache_hits: u64,
        star_epoch_updates: u64,
        star_epoch_cache_hits: u64,
    ) {
        self.environment.set_astronomy_counters(
            ephemeris_evaluations,
            ephemeris_cache_hits,
            star_epoch_updates,
            star_epoch_cache_hits,
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_environment_frame(
        &mut self,
        presented: bool,
        draws: environment::EnvironmentDrawCounts,
    ) {
        self.environment.record_frame(presented, draws);
    }

    pub(crate) fn environment_snapshot(&self) -> environment::EnvironmentStatsSnapshot {
        self.environment.snapshot()
    }

    pub(crate) fn reset_environment_epoch(&mut self) {
        self.environment.reset_epoch();
    }

    /// Formats the accumulated frame and CPU-work timing summaries.
    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        let elapsed_seconds = self.elapsed_nanoseconds as f64 / 1_000_000_000.0;
        let fps = if self.sample_count > 0 && elapsed_seconds > 0.0 {
            format!("{:.1}", self.presented_frames as f64 / elapsed_seconds)
        } else {
            "n/a".to_owned()
        };
        let draws_per_presented_frame = if self.presented_frames > 0 {
            format!(
                "{:.2}",
                self.total_draw_calls as f64 / self.presented_frames as f64
            )
        } else {
            "n/a".to_owned()
        };
        let frame_average_ms = format_duration_ms(self.frame_intervals.average_microseconds());
        let frame_p50_ms = format_duration_ms(self.frame_intervals.percentile_microseconds(50));
        let frame_p95_ms = format_duration_ms(self.frame_intervals.percentile_microseconds(95));
        let frame_p99_ms = format_duration_ms(self.frame_intervals.percentile_microseconds(99));
        let frame_max_ms = format_milliseconds(self.frame_intervals.maximum_milliseconds());
        let cpu_average_ms = format_duration_ms(self.cpu_work.average_microseconds());
        let cpu_p50_ms = format_duration_ms(self.cpu_work.percentile_microseconds(50));
        let cpu_p95_ms = format_duration_ms(self.cpu_work.percentile_microseconds(95));
        let cpu_p99_ms = format_duration_ms(self.cpu_work.percentile_microseconds(99));
        let cpu_max_ms = format_milliseconds(self.cpu_work.maximum_milliseconds());
        let gpu_estimate = self
            .gpu_bytes
            .map_or_else(|| "unavailable".to_string(), |bytes| format!("{bytes} B"));

        let process_cpu = self
            .process_cpu_time
            .map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |time| time.as_millis().to_string());
        format!(
            "frames={} presented={} presented_FPS_avg={fps} frame_ms(avg/p50/p95/p99/max)={frame_average_ms}/{frame_p50_ms}/{frame_p95_ms}/{frame_p99_ms}/{frame_max_ms} cpu_work_ms(avg/p50/p95/p99/max)={cpu_average_ms}/{cpu_p50_ms}/{cpu_p95_ms}/{cpu_p99_ms}/{cpu_max_ms} timing_samples={} draw_calls_per_presented_frame={draws_per_presented_frame} process_cpu_time_ms={process_cpu} engine_GPU_estimate={gpu_estimate}",
            self.sample_count, self.presented_frames, self.sample_count
        )
    }
}

fn format_milliseconds(milliseconds: Option<f64>) -> String {
    milliseconds.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| format!("{value:.3}"))
}

fn format_duration_ms(microseconds: Option<u64>) -> String {
    microseconds.map_or_else(
        || "n/a".to_owned(),
        |value| format!("{:.3}", value as f64 / 1_000.0),
    )
}

use std::time::Duration;

const ENVIRONMENT_BOUNDS_US: [u64; 13] = [
    1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1_000, 2_500, 5_000, 10_000,
];

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct HistogramSnapshot {
    pub(crate) samples: u64,
    pub(crate) average_us: Option<f64>,
    pub(crate) p50_us: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) p95_us: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) p99_us: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) max_us: Option<f64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
struct MicrosecondHistogram {
    samples: u64,
    total_nanoseconds: u128,
    maximum_nanoseconds: u64,
    buckets: [u64; 14],
}

impl MicrosecondHistogram {
    fn record(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        let nanos = duration.as_nanos().min(u128::from(u64::MAX)) as u64;
        let bucket = ENVIRONMENT_BOUNDS_US
            .iter()
            .position(|bound| nanos <= bound.saturating_mul(1_000))
            .unwrap_or(ENVIRONMENT_BOUNDS_US.len());
        self.samples = self.samples.saturating_add(1);
        self.total_nanoseconds = self.total_nanoseconds.saturating_add(u128::from(nanos));
        self.maximum_nanoseconds = self.maximum_nanoseconds.max(nanos);
        self.buckets[bucket] = self.buckets[bucket].saturating_add(1);
    }

    fn snapshot(self) -> HistogramSnapshot {
        if self.samples == 0 {
            return HistogramSnapshot::default();
        }
        HistogramSnapshot {
            samples: self.samples,
            average_us: Some(self.total_nanoseconds as f64 / self.samples as f64 / 1_000.0),
            p50_us: self.percentile(50),
            p95_us: self.percentile(95),
            p99_us: self.percentile(99),
            max_us: Some(self.maximum_nanoseconds as f64 / 1_000.0),
        }
    }

    fn percentile(self, percentile: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        if self.samples == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        let rank = u128::from(self.samples)
            .saturating_mul(u128::from(percentile))
            .div_ceil(100) as u64;
        let mut cumulative = 0_u64;
        for (index, count) in self.buckets.iter().enumerate() {
            cumulative = cumulative.saturating_add(*count);
            if cumulative >= rank {
                return Some(
                    ENVIRONMENT_BOUNDS_US
                        .get(index)
                        .copied()
                        .unwrap_or(self.maximum_nanoseconds / 1_000),
                );
            }
        }
        Some(self.maximum_nanoseconds / 1_000)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct EnvironmentStatsSnapshot {
    pub(crate) cpu: HistogramSnapshot,
    pub(crate) upload_cpu: HistogramSnapshot,
    pub(crate) shadow_cpu: HistogramSnapshot,
    pub(crate) ephemeris_evaluations: u64,
    pub(crate) ephemeris_cache_hits: u64,
    pub(crate) star_epoch_updates: u64,
    pub(crate) star_epoch_cache_hits: u64,
    pub(crate) sky_draw_calls: u64,
    pub(crate) star_draw_calls: u64,
    pub(crate) sun_draw_calls: u64,
    pub(crate) moon_draw_calls: u64,
    pub(crate) halo_draw_calls: u64,
    pub(crate) shadow_draw_calls: u64,
    pub(crate) frames_skipped: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct EnvironmentDrawCounts {
    pub(crate) sky: u32,
    pub(crate) stars: u32,
    pub(crate) sun: u32,
    pub(crate) moon: u32,
    pub(crate) halos: u32,
    pub(crate) shadows: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct EnvironmentStats {
    cpu: MicrosecondHistogram,
    upload_cpu: MicrosecondHistogram,
    shadow_cpu: MicrosecondHistogram,
    counters: EnvironmentStatsSnapshot,
    astronomy_latest: [u64; 4],
    astronomy_baseline: [u64; 4],
}

impl EnvironmentStats {
    pub(crate) fn record_cpu(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.cpu.record(duration);
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_shadow_cpu(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.shadow_cpu.record(duration);
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_upload_cpu(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.upload_cpu.record(duration);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_astronomy_counters(
        &mut self,
        ephemeris_evaluations: u64,
        ephemeris_cache_hits: u64,
        star_epoch_updates: u64,
        star_epoch_cache_hits: u64,
    ) {
        self.astronomy_latest = [
            ephemeris_evaluations,
            ephemeris_cache_hits,
            star_epoch_updates,
            star_epoch_cache_hits,
        ];
        self.counters.ephemeris_evaluations =
            self.astronomy_latest[0].saturating_sub(self.astronomy_baseline[0]);
        self.counters.ephemeris_cache_hits =
            self.astronomy_latest[1].saturating_sub(self.astronomy_baseline[1]);
        self.counters.star_epoch_updates =
            self.astronomy_latest[2].saturating_sub(self.astronomy_baseline[2]);
        self.counters.star_epoch_cache_hits =
            self.astronomy_latest[3].saturating_sub(self.astronomy_baseline[3]);
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_frame(&mut self, presented: bool, draws: EnvironmentDrawCounts) {
        if !presented {
            self.counters.frames_skipped = self.counters.frames_skipped.saturating_add(1);
            return;
        }
        self.counters.sky_draw_calls = self
            .counters
            .sky_draw_calls
            .saturating_add(u64::from(draws.sky));
        self.counters.star_draw_calls = self
            .counters
            .star_draw_calls
            .saturating_add(u64::from(draws.stars));
        self.counters.sun_draw_calls = self
            .counters
            .sun_draw_calls
            .saturating_add(u64::from(draws.sun));
        self.counters.moon_draw_calls = self
            .counters
            .moon_draw_calls
            .saturating_add(u64::from(draws.moon));
        self.counters.halo_draw_calls = self
            .counters
            .halo_draw_calls
            .saturating_add(u64::from(draws.halos));
        self.counters.shadow_draw_calls = self
            .counters
            .shadow_draw_calls
            .saturating_add(u64::from(draws.shadows));
    }

    pub(crate) fn snapshot(self) -> EnvironmentStatsSnapshot {
        EnvironmentStatsSnapshot {
            cpu: self.cpu.snapshot(),
            upload_cpu: self.upload_cpu.snapshot(),
            shadow_cpu: self.shadow_cpu.snapshot(),
            ..self.counters
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn reset_epoch(&mut self) {
        let astronomy_baseline = self.astronomy_latest;
        *self = Self::default();
        self.astronomy_latest = astronomy_baseline;
        self.astronomy_baseline = astronomy_baseline;
    }
}
