<<<FILE path="apps/client/src/terminal_client.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="481" bytes="21819" original_lines="481" original_bytes="21819" minified="false" sha256="b71b3ff734c78809bc83dc3f3361db4f443c407e75afa37a0d6c0ebfe5965134">>>
use crate::{
    client_commands::{
        execute, help_lines, parse_command, CommandContext, CommandResult, FrontendAction,
    },
    messages::ClientText as Text,
    options::ClientOptions,
    session::{SessionEvent, SessionState},
};
use minimium_client_runtime::{connector::StartError, ConnectionController, ConnectionEvent};
use minimium_protocol::ServerMessage;
use std::{
    error::Error,
    io::{self, Write},
    sync::mpsc,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const INPUT_QUEUE_CAPACITY: usize = 64;
const ENVIRONMENT_STATUS_REFRESH: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);

pub(crate) fn run(options: ClientOptions) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    if options.sky_quality != minimium_renderer::quality::SkyQuality::Standard {
        println!("--sky-quality is available only in the desktop renderer");
    }
    let map_path = options.map_path.clone();
    let world_definition_path = options.world_definition_path.clone();
    let (map, world_fingerprints) = if let Some(path) = map_path.as_deref() {
        let map = minimium_asset_io::load_map(path).map_err(|error| {
            Text::MapLoadFailed {
                path: path.display().to_string(),
                detail: error.to_string(),
            }
            .to_string()
        })?;
        let instance =
            minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(1).expect("legacy instance ID is nonzero");
        (
            map.clone(),
            std::collections::HashMap::from([(instance, map.fingerprint())]),
        )
    } else if let Some(path) = world_definition_path.as_deref() {
        let definition = minimium_asset_io::load_world_definition(path).map_err(|error| {
            Text::MapLoadFailed {
                path: path.display().to_string(),
                detail: error.to_string(),
            }
            .to_string()
        })?;
        minimium_procgen::validate_world_manifest(definition.manifest())
            .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))?;
        let map = minimium_procgen::materialize_dungeon_map(definition.dungeon())
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let instance = minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(4)
            .expect("manual world instance ID is nonzero");
        let legacy_map = minimium_assets::parse_map(crate::SAMPLE_MAP)
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let legacy_instance =
            minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(3).expect("legacy instance ID is nonzero");
        (
            map.clone(),
            std::collections::HashMap::from([
                (instance, map.fingerprint()),
                (legacy_instance, legacy_map.fingerprint()),
            ]),
        )
    } else {
        let worlds = minimium_game_sample::generate_demo_worlds()
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let mut fingerprints = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        for world in &worlds {
            fingerprints.insert(world.instance, world.map.fingerprint());
        }
        let legacy_map = minimium_assets::parse_map(crate::SAMPLE_MAP)
            .map_err(|error| Text::BundledMapInvalid(error).to_string())?;
        let legacy_instance =
            minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(3).expect("legacy instance ID is nonzero");
        fingerprints.insert(legacy_instance, legacy_map.fingerprint());
        (worlds[0].map.clone(), fingerprints)
    };
    let fingerprint = map.fingerprint();
    let (profile_dir, data_dir) = options.paths(fingerprint);
    let profile_id = minimium_platform::identity_store::load_or_create(&profile_dir)?;

    println!("{}", Text::TerminalIntro);
    let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel(INPUT_QUEUE_CAPACITY);
    super::spawn_console_input_reader(sender);
    let mut connection = ConnectionController::new(profile_id, fingerprint);
    connection.set_world_fingerprints(world_fingerprints);
    let mut events = Vec::with_capacity(16);
    let mut prompt_needed = true;
    let mut last_snapshot: Option<ServerMessage> = None;
    let mut last_environment_status = None;
    let mut last_environment_status_at = None;

    if let Some(address) = options.connect.as_ref() {
        start_remote(&mut connection, address);
    }

    loop {
        if let Some(result) = connection.poll_time_scale_result() {
            match result {
                Ok(response) => println!("{}", response.trim()),
                Err(error) => println!("time scale: {error}"),
            }
        }
        match connection.poll_connector() {
            ConnectionEvent::InProgress {
                waiting_for_cleanup: true,
            } => println!("{}", Text::WaitingForCancelledCleanup),
            ConnectionEvent::TimedOut => println!("{}", Text::AttemptTimedOut),
            ConnectionEvent::SessionStarted => {
                last_environment_status = None;
                last_environment_status_at = None;
                println!("{}", Text::AwaitingWelcome)
            }
            ConnectionEvent::SetupFailed(error) => {
                println!("{}", Text::ConnectionSetupFailed(error.to_string()))
            }
            ConnectionEvent::Failed(error) => {
                println!("{}", Text::ConnectFailed(error.to_string()))
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        if connection.session().is_some() {
            events.clear();
            connection.poll_session(&mut events);
            for event in events.drain(..) {
                match event {
                    SessionEvent::Message(message @ ServerMessage::Snapshot { .. }) => {
                        last_snapshot = Some(message);
                    }
                    other => print_session_event(other, false),
                }
            }
            if connection
                .session()
                .is_some_and(|current| current.state() == SessionState::Disconnected)
            {
                connection.take_session();
                last_snapshot = None;
            }
        }
        if let Some(frame) = connection
            .session()
            .filter(|session| session.state() == SessionState::Connected)
            .map(|session| session.environment_frame())
        {
            let signature = frame.status_signature();
            let changed = last_environment_status != Some(signature);
            let date_refresh_due = frame.render_world_utc_ms.is_some()
                && last_environment_status_at
                    .is_none_or(|last: Instant| last.elapsed() >= ENVIRONMENT_STATUS_REFRESH);
            if changed || date_refresh_due {
                println!("{}", frame.status_line());
                last_environment_status = Some(signature);
                last_environment_status_at = Some(Instant::now());
            }
        } else if last_environment_status.is_some() {
            let unavailable = crate::environment::EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
            let signature = unavailable.status_signature();
            if last_environment_status != Some(signature) {
                println!("{}", unavailable.status_line());
            }
            last_environment_status = Some(signature);
            last_environment_status_at = Some(Instant::now());
        }

        if prompt_needed {
            print!("{}", Text::InputPrompt);
            io::stdout().flush()?;
            prompt_needed = false;
        }
        match receiver.recv_timeout(Duration::from_millis(25)) {
            Ok(line) => {
                prompt_needed = true;
                let command = match parse_command(&line) {
                    Ok(Some(command)) => command,
                    Ok(None) => continue,
                    Err(error) => {
                        println!("{}", Text::CommandParseError(error));
                        continue;
                    }
                };
                let result = execute(
                    command,
                    &mut CommandContext {
                        connection: &mut connection,
                        fire_direction: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                    },
                );
                match result {
                    CommandResult::Sent => {}
                    CommandResult::QueueError(error) => {
                        println!("{}", Text::CouldNotQueueCommand(error.into()))
                    }
                    CommandResult::Action(action) => match action {
                        FrontendAction::Print(text) => println!("{text}"),
                        FrontendAction::Help => {
                            for line in help_lines() {
                                println!("{line}");
                            }
                            println!("{}", Text::FpsUnavailable);
                        }
                        FrontendAction::HostLocal(requested_lanes) => {
                            if connection.busy() {
                                println!("{}", Text::DisconnectOrWait);
                                continue;
                            }
                            let lanes = requested_lanes.unwrap_or(options.threads);
                            match connection.start_local(
                                data_dir.clone(),
                                map_path.clone(),
                                world_definition_path.clone(),
                                lanes,
                            ) {
                                Ok(()) => {
                                    println!("{}", Text::StartingLocalServer);
                                }
                                Err(error) => print_start_error(error),
                            }
                        }
                        FrontendAction::Connect(address) => {
                            if connection.busy() {
                                println!("{}", Text::DisconnectOrWait);
                            } else {
                                start_remote(&mut connection, &address);
                            }
                        }
                        FrontendAction::Disconnect => {
                            connection.cancel();
                            if let Some(mut current) = connection.take_session() {
                                current.close();
                            }
                            last_snapshot = None;
                            println!("{}", Text::Disconnected);
                        }
                        FrontendAction::State => {
                            if connection.session().is_none() {
                                println!("{}", Text::NotConnected);
                            } else if let Some(snapshot) = &last_snapshot {
                                print_session_event(SessionEvent::Message(snapshot.clone()), true);
                            } else {
                                println!("{}", Text::NoServerResponse);
                            }
                        }
                        FrontendAction::FpsShow => {
                            println!("{}", Text::FpsUnavailable);
                        }
                        FrontendAction::NetStats => match connection.session() {
                            Some(current) => {
                                let metrics = current.metrics();
                                println!(
                                    "{}",
                                    Text::NetworkStats {
                                        bytes_sent: metrics.bytes_sent,
                                        bytes_received: metrics.bytes_received,
                                        ping_milliseconds: metrics
                                            .ping_round_trip
                                            .map(|duration| duration.as_millis()),
                                        nearby_players: None,
                                    }
                                );
                            }
                            None => println!("{}", Text::NotConnected),
                        },
                        FrontendAction::Clear => {
                            print!("\x1B[2J\x1B[H");
                            io::stdout().flush()?;
                        }
                        FrontendAction::Quit => break,
                        FrontendAction::MapTeleport => {
                            println!("map_telepo is available in the desktop Earth overview");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::SkyQuality(quality) => {
                            println!(
                                "sky quality {} is unavailable in the text client (desktop renderer required)",
                                quality.label()
                            );
                        }
                        FrontendAction::SkyInfo => {
                            println!("sky info unavailable: desktop renderer required");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::SkyBodies => {
                            println!("sky bodies unavailable: desktop renderer required");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::SkyDemo(_) => {
                            println!("sky demo unavailable: desktop renderer required");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::Fov(_) | FrontendAction::ShowCelestialNames(_) => {
                            println!("sky display settings are available in the desktop renderer");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::WeatherStatus
                        | FrontendAction::AtmosphereDebug(_)
                        | FrontendAction::AtmosphereStatus
                        | FrontendAction::WeatherDebug(_)
                        | FrontendAction::TerrainStatus
                        | FrontendAction::TerrainDebug(_)
                        | FrontendAction::WeatherDetail(_) => {
                            println!("Regional weather diagnostics require the graphical client.");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::SetTime { minute, local } => {
                            let longitude = match &last_snapshot {
                                Some(ServerMessage::Snapshot {
                                    self_position_mm, ..
                                }) if local => {
                                    let [x, _, z] = self_position_mm.0.map(|value| value as f64);
                                    (x.hypot(z) > 0.0).then(|| z.atan2(x))
                                }
                                _ if !local => Some(0.0),
                                _ => None,
                            };
                            let result = longitude
                                .ok_or_else(|| "player longitude is unavailable".to_owned())
                                .and_then(|longitude| {
                                    connection.request_set_time(minute, longitude)
                                });
                            match result {
                                Ok(()) => println!("time change request sent"),
                                Err(error) => println!("time: {error}"),
                            }
                        }
                        FrontendAction::TimeStatus => {
                            let unavailable =
                                crate::environment::EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
                            let status = connection
                                .session()
                                .map(|session| session.environment_frame().time_status_line())
                                .unwrap_or_else(|| unavailable.time_status_line());
                            println!("{status}");
                        }
                        FrontendAction::TimeScale(value) => {
                            match connection.request_time_scale(value) {
                                Ok(()) => println!("time scale request sent"),
                                Err(error) => println!("time scale: {error}"),
                            }
                        }
                    },
                }
            }
            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => {}
            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => break,
        }
    }

    connection.finish()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn start_remote(connection: &mut ConnectionController, address: &str) {
    match connection.start_remote(address.to_owned()) {
        Ok(()) => println!("{}", Text::ConnectingTo(address.to_owned())),
        Err(error) => print_start_error(error),
    }
}

fn print_start_error(error: StartError) {
    match error {
        StartError::Busy { active_attempt } => {
            println!(
                "{}",
                Text::BusyAttempt {
                    attempt_id: active_attempt.get()
                }
            )
        }
        StartError::AttemptIdsExhausted => {
            println!("{}", Text::AttemptIdsExhausted)
        }
        StartError::WorkerSpawn(error) => {
            println!("{}", Text::WorkerStartFailed(error.to_string()))
        }
    }
}

fn print_session_event(event: SessionEvent, show_snapshot: bool) {
    match event {
        SessionEvent::PingRoundTrip(duration) => {
            println!(
                "{}",
                Text::Ping {
                    milliseconds: duration.as_millis()
                }
            );
        }
        SessionEvent::Disconnected(reason) => println!("{}", Text::from(reason)),
        SessionEvent::Message(message) => match message {
            ServerMessage::Welcome { id, health, .. } => {
                println!("{}", Text::Connected { id, health });
            }
            ServerMessage::Error(code) => {
                println!("{}", Text::ServerError { code });
            }
            ServerMessage::Bye => {
                println!("{}", Text::ServerClosed);
            }
            ServerMessage::AltitudeResult { position_mm, .. } => {
                println!(
                    "set_altitude: {}",
                    if position_mm.is_some() {
                        "destination reached"
                    } else {
                        "rejected: requires fly on, a planet and a valid height"
                    }
                );
            }
            ServerMessage::Pong => println!("{}", Text::Pong),
            ServerMessage::Accepted => println!("{}", Text::Accepted),
            ServerMessage::Chat {
                sender_id,
                sender_name,
                text,
            } => {
                println!(
                    "{}",
                    Text::Chat {
                        sender_name,
                        sender_id,
                        text,
                    }
                );
            }
            ServerMessage::HealthUpdate(health) => {
                println!("{}", Text::Health { health });
            }
            ServerMessage::ShotResult {
                target_id,
                remaining_health,
                killed,
            } => match (target_id, remaining_health, killed) {
                (Some(id), Some(health), true) => {
                    println!(
                        "{}",
                        Text::TargetRespawned {
                            target_id: id,
                            health
                        }
                    );
                }
                (Some(id), Some(health), false) => {
                    println!(
                        "{}",
                        Text::Hit {
                            target_id: id,
                            health
                        }
                    );
                }
                _ => println!("{}", Text::ShotMissed),
            },
            ServerMessage::Snapshot {
                server_time_ms,
                full_snapshot,
                self_position,
                self_velocity,
                self_grounded,
                players,
                removed_players,
                ..
            } if show_snapshot => {
                println!(
                    "{}",
                    Text::TerminalSnapshot {
                        server_time_ms,
                        full_snapshot,
                        self_position,
                        self_velocity,
                        grounded: self_grounded,
                        player_updates: players.len(),
                        player_removals: removed_players.len(),
                    }
                );
            }
            ServerMessage::Snapshot { .. } => {}
            ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare { .. } => println!("world transfer prepared"),
            ServerMessage::TransitionCommitted { .. } => println!("world transfer committed"),
            ServerMessage::TransitionCancelled { .. } => println!("world transfer cancelled"),
            ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync { .. } | ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply { .. } => {}
            ServerMessage::MapTeleportResult { .. } | ServerMessage::ContentOffer { .. } => {}
        },
    }
}

<<<FILE path="apps/ctl/src/main.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="37" bytes="1372" original_lines="37" original_bytes="1372" minified="false" sha256="7074088488c5f50ac7473d181b387218d10413ea84e7746f5a614321543a0ed6">>>
use minimium_platform::{admin_client, endpoint::ServerEndpoint};
use std::{env, path::PathBuf};

fn main() {
    if let Err(error) = run() {
        eprintln!("minimiumctl: {error}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
    if args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--help" || arg == "-h") {
        println!(
            "minimiumctl [--data-dir PATH] <help|status|players list|metrics show|world save|time ...|stop>"
        );
        return Ok(());
    }
    let mut data_dir = PathBuf::from(minimium_platform::files::DEFAULT_SERVER_DATA_DIR);
    if let Some(index) = args.iter().position(|arg| arg == "--data-dir") {
        if index + 1 >= args.len() {
            return Err("--data-dir requires a path".into());
        }
        data_dir = PathBuf::from(args.remove(index + 1));
        args.remove(index);
    }
    let command = args.join(" ");
    let endpoint = ServerEndpoint::read(&data_dir)?;
    if command.trim() == "stop" {
        admin_client::stop_and_wait(&data_dir, &endpoint)?;
        println!("server stopped cleanly");
    } else {
        let response = admin_client::request(&endpoint, &command)?;
        println!("{}", if response.is_empty() { "ok" } else { &response });
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="apps/loadtest/src/client_setup.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="418" bytes="16741" original_lines="418" original_bytes="16741" minified="false" sha256="92f7a97ffdd7b942fe6d13e5f3123bdf7b6d712a1901ea71638ab835638fe7ef">>>
use super::{scenarios::Scenario, stats::WorkerStats, worker::*};
use minimium_core::identity::{PlayerProfileId, PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES};
use minimium_protocol::{decode_server, encode_client, ClientMessage, ServerMessage};
use std::{
    io::{Read, Write},
    net::{SocketAddr, TcpStream},
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) enum SetupExpectation {
    Welcome,
    Accepted,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct SetupConfig<'a> {
    pub(super) socket: SocketAddr,
    pub(super) process_salt: [u8; 16],
    pub(super) scenario: Scenario,
    pub(super) total_clients: usize,
    pub(super) movement_frames: &'a [Vec<u8>],
    pub(super) ping_frame: &'a [u8],
}

pub(super) fn prepare_client(
    client_id: usize,
    config: &SetupConfig<'_>,
    existing_clients: &mut [LoadClient],
    stats: &mut WorkerStats,
) -> Option<LoadClient> {
    let SetupConfig {
        socket,
        process_salt,
        scenario,
        total_clients,
        movement_frames,
        ping_frame,
    } = *config;
    let connect_deadline = Instant::now() + HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT;
    let mut stream = loop {
        let now = Instant::now();
        if now >= connect_deadline {
            stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
            stats.timeouts = stats.timeouts.saturating_add(1);
            stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
            return None;
        }
        service_setup_clients(existing_clients, ping_frame, None, stats);
        match TcpStream::connect_timeout(
            &socket,
            connect_deadline
                .saturating_duration_since(now)
                .min(Duration::from_millis(100)),
        ) {
            Ok(stream) => break stream,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut => continue,
            Err(_) => {
                stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
                return None;
            }
        }
    };
    if stream.set_nonblocking(true).is_err() || stream.set_nodelay(true).is_err() {
        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
        stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
        return None;
    }

    let mut profile_id = [0u8; PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES];
    profile_id[..8].copy_from_slice(&(client_id as u64).to_le_bytes());
    profile_id[8..].copy_from_slice(&process_salt[..8]);
    let profile_id = PlayerProfileId::from_bytes(profile_id);
    let identity_frame =
        match encode_client(&ClientMessage::Presentation(None)).and_then(|mut frame| {
            frame.extend(encode_client(&ClientMessage::Identify(profile_id))?);
            Ok(frame)
        }) {
            Ok(frame) => frame,
            Err(_) => {
                stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
                return None;
            }
        };
    let mut receive_buffer = Vec::with_capacity(2048);
    let deadline = Instant::now() + HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT;
    if write_setup_frame(&mut stream, &identity_frame, deadline, stats).is_err()
        || wait_for_setup_message(
            &mut stream,
            &mut receive_buffer,
            deadline,
            SetupExpectation::Welcome,
            existing_clients,
            ping_frame,
            stats,
        )
        .is_err()
    {
        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
        stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            stats.timeouts = stats.timeouts.saturating_add(1);
        }
        return None;
    }
    stats.connected = stats.connected.saturating_add(1);

    let name_frame = match encode_client(&ClientMessage::SetName(format!("Bot{client_id}"))) {
        Ok(frame) => frame,
        Err(_) => {
            stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
            stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
            return None;
        }
    };
    let name_deadline = Instant::now() + HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT;
    if write_setup_frame(&mut stream, &name_frame, name_deadline, stats).is_err()
        || wait_for_setup_message(
            &mut stream,
            &mut receive_buffer,
            name_deadline,
            SetupExpectation::Accepted,
            existing_clients,
            ping_frame,
            stats,
        )
        .is_err()
    {
        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
        stats.handshake_failures = stats.handshake_failures.saturating_add(1);
        if Instant::now() >= name_deadline {
            stats.timeouts = stats.timeouts.saturating_add(1);
        }
        return None;
    }

    let dispersed_movement_frame = if matches!(scenario, Scenario::Dispersed) {
        let angle = std::f64::consts::TAU * client_id as f64 / total_clients as f64;
        let direction = [angle.cos() as f32, angle.sin() as f32];
        match encode_client(&ClientMessage::Move {
            direction,
            jump: false,
        }) {
            Ok(frame) => Some(frame),
            Err(_) => {
                stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                return None;
            }
        }
    } else {
        None
    };

    Some(LoadClient {
        client_id,
        stream,
        receive_buffer,
        next_ping_at: Instant::now(),
        ping_due: false,
        next_movement_at: Instant::now(),
        pending_movement_index: None,
        pending_dispersed_movement: false,
        dispersed_movement_frame,
        next_fire_at: Instant::now(),
        pending_fire_index: None,
        next_chat_at: Instant::now(),
        chat_due: false,
        pending_output: None,
        ping_sent_at: None,
        measurement_bytes_sent: 0,
        measurement_bytes_received: 0,
        movement_seed: client_id % movement_frames.len(),
        movement_sequence: 0,
        disconnected: false,
        disconnected_before_start: false,
        next_setup_ping_at: Instant::now() + PING_INTERVAL,
        setup_ping_offset: None,
    })
}

pub(super) fn write_setup_frame(
    stream: &mut TcpStream,
    frame: &[u8],
    deadline: Instant,
    stats: &mut WorkerStats,
) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut offset = 0;
    while offset < frame.len() {
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "setup write timed out",
            ));
        }
        match stream.write(&frame[offset..]) {
            Ok(0) => return Err(std::io::ErrorKind::WriteZero.into()),
            Ok(count) => {
                offset += count;
                stats.bytes_sent = stats.bytes_sent.saturating_add(count as u64);
                stats.setup_bytes_sent = stats.setup_bytes_sent.saturating_add(count as u64);
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                thread::sleep(
                    POLL_INTERVAL.min(deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now())),
                );
            }
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn wait_for_setup_message(
    stream: &mut TcpStream,
    receive_buffer: &mut Vec<u8>,
    deadline: Instant,
    expected: SetupExpectation,
    existing_clients: &mut [LoadClient],
    ping_frame: &[u8],
    stats: &mut WorkerStats,
) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
    loop {
        service_setup_clients(existing_clients, ping_frame, None, stats);
        loop {
            match decode_server(receive_buffer) {
                Ok(Some((message, frame_bytes))) => {
                    receive_buffer.drain(..frame_bytes);
                    match (expected, message) {
                        (SetupExpectation::Welcome, ServerMessage::Welcome { .. })
                        | (SetupExpectation::Accepted, ServerMessage::Accepted) => return Ok(()),
                        (_, ServerMessage::Error(_)) => {
                            return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                                std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused,
                                "server rejected load client setup",
                            ));
                        }
                        (SetupExpectation::Welcome, _) => {
                            return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                                "server sent data before Welcome",
                            ));
                        }
                        (SetupExpectation::Accepted, ServerMessage::Welcome { .. }) => {
                            return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                                "server sent duplicate Welcome",
                            ));
                        }
                        (SetupExpectation::Accepted, ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync { .. })
                        | (SetupExpectation::Accepted, ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply { .. }) => {}
                        (SetupExpectation::Accepted, _) => {}
                    }
                }
                Ok(None) => break,
                Err(error) => {
                    return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error));
                }
            }
        }
        if receive_buffer.len() > MAX_RECEIVE_BUFFER_BYTES {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                "setup response exceeds receive buffer limit",
            ));
        }
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(
                std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "setup response timed out",
            ));
        }
        match stream.read(&mut chunk) {
            Ok(0) => return Err(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof.into()),
            Ok(count) => {
                stats.bytes_received = stats.bytes_received.saturating_add(count as u64);
                stats.setup_bytes_received =
                    stats.setup_bytes_received.saturating_add(count as u64);
                receive_buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..count]);
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                thread::sleep(
                    POLL_INTERVAL.min(deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now())),
                );
            }
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn service_setup_clients(
    clients: &mut [LoadClient],
    ping_frame: &[u8],
    deadline: Option<Instant>,
    stats: &mut WorkerStats,
) {
    let now = Instant::now();
    for client in clients.iter_mut().filter(|client| !client.disconnected) {
        if deadline.is_some_and(|deadline| Instant::now() >= deadline) {
            break;
        }
        if client.setup_ping_offset.is_none() && now >= client.next_setup_ping_at {
            client.setup_ping_offset = Some(0);
            client.next_setup_ping_at = now + PING_INTERVAL;
        }
        if let Some(offset) = client.setup_ping_offset {
            match client.stream.write(&ping_frame[offset..]) {
                Ok(0) => {
                    client.disconnected = true;
                    client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                    stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                    stats.disconnects_before_start =
                        stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                    stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                    continue;
                }
                Ok(count) => {
                    stats.bytes_sent = stats.bytes_sent.saturating_add(count as u64);
                    stats.setup_bytes_sent = stats.setup_bytes_sent.saturating_add(count as u64);
                    let next_offset = offset + count;
                    client.setup_ping_offset =
                        (next_offset < ping_frame.len()).then_some(next_offset);
                }
                Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}
                Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
                Err(_) => {
                    client.disconnected = true;
                    client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                    stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                    stats.disconnects_before_start =
                        stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                    stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        drain_setup_traffic_until(client, stats, deadline);
    }
}

pub(super) fn drain_setup_traffic_until(
    client: &mut LoadClient,
    stats: &mut WorkerStats,
    deadline: Option<Instant>,
) {
    let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
    loop {
        if deadline.is_some_and(|deadline| Instant::now() >= deadline) {
            return;
        }
        match client.stream.read(&mut chunk) {
            Ok(0) => {
                client.disconnected = true;
                client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                stats.disconnects_before_start = stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                return;
            }
            Ok(count) => {
                stats.bytes_received = stats.bytes_received.saturating_add(count as u64);
                stats.setup_bytes_received =
                    stats.setup_bytes_received.saturating_add(count as u64);
                client.receive_buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..count]);
                if client.receive_buffer.len() > MAX_RECEIVE_BUFFER_BYTES {
                    client.disconnected = true;
                    client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                    stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                    stats.disconnects_before_start =
                        stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                    stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                    return;
                }
                loop {
                    match decode_server(&client.receive_buffer) {
                        Ok(Some((message, frame_bytes))) => {
                            client.receive_buffer.drain(..frame_bytes);
                            if matches!(message, ServerMessage::Error(_)) {
                                client.disconnected = true;
                                client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                                stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                                stats.disconnects_before_start =
                                    stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                                stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                        Ok(None) => break,
                        Err(_) => {
                            client.disconnected = true;
                            client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                            stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                            stats.disconnects_before_start =
                                stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                            stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => return,
            Err(_) => {
                client.disconnected = true;
                client.disconnected_before_start = true;
                stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                stats.disconnects_before_start = stats.disconnects_before_start.saturating_add(1);
                stats.ready = stats.ready.saturating_sub(1);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

use std::{env, path::PathBuf, thread};

use super::scenarios::Scenario;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) enum WorkerSelection {
    One,
    Two,
    Auto,
}

impl WorkerSelection {
    fn worker_limit(self) -> usize {
        match self {
            Self::One => 1,
            Self::Two => 2,
            Self::Auto => thread::available_parallelism()
                .map(usize::from)
                .unwrap_or(1)
                .min(2),
        }
    }

    fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::One => "1",
            Self::Two => "2",
            Self::Auto => "auto",
        }
    }
}

pub(super) struct StartupConfig {
    pub(super) address: String,
    pub(super) clients: usize,
    pub(super) seconds: u64,
    pub(super) worker_selection: WorkerSelection,
    pub(super) output_format: OutputFormat,
    pub(super) scenario: Scenario,
    pub(super) cpu_label: Option<String>,
    pub(super) cpu_mhz: Option<u32>,
    pub(super) scenario_id: Option<String>,
    pub(super) server_data_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) enum OutputFormat {
    Text,
    Json,
}

pub(super) enum ParseOutcome {
    Help,
    Config(StartupConfig),
}

impl StartupConfig {
    pub(super) fn worker_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.worker_selection.worker_limit().min(self.clients)
    }

    pub(super) fn thread_mode(&self) -> &'static str {
        self.worker_selection.as_str()
    }
}

pub(super) fn parse_env() -> Result<ParseOutcome, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    parse_args(env::args().skip(1))
}

fn parse_args(
    args: impl IntoIterator<Item = String>,
) -> Result<ParseOutcome, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let args: Vec<String> = args.into_iter().collect();
    let mut address = None;
    let mut clients = 100usize;
    let mut seconds = 10u64;
    let mut worker_selection = WorkerSelection::Auto;
    let mut output_format = OutputFormat::Text;
    let mut scenario = Scenario::Heartbeat;
    let mut cpu_label = None;
    let mut cpu_mhz = None;
    let mut scenario_id = None;
    let mut server_data_dir = None;
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let mut index = 0;
    while index < args.len() {
        if !seen.insert(args[index].clone()) {
            return Err(format!("duplicate option: {}", args[index]).into());
        }
        match args[index].as_str() {
            "--cpu-label" | "--scenario-id" | "--server-data-dir" | "--cpu-mhz" => {
                let option = &args[index];
                index += 1;
                let value = args
                    .get(index)
                    .filter(|value| !value.starts_with("--"))
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("{option} requires a value"))?;
                if value.len() > 512 {
                    return Err(format!("{option} exceeds 512 bytes").into());
                }
                match option.as_str() {
                    "--cpu-label" => cpu_label = Some(value.clone()),
                    "--scenario-id" => scenario_id = Some(value.clone()),
                    "--server-data-dir" => server_data_dir = Some(PathBuf::from(value)),
                    _ => {
                        let mhz: u32 = value.parse()?;
                        if mhz == 0 {
                            return Err("--cpu-mhz must be positive".into());
                        }
                        cpu_mhz = Some(mhz);
                    }
                }
            }
            "--address" => {
                index += 1;
                address = Some(
                    args.get(index)
                        .ok_or("--address requires HOST:PORT")?
                        .clone(),
                );
            }
            "--clients" => {
                index += 1;
                clients = args
                    .get(index)
                    .ok_or("--clients requires a number")?
                    .parse()?;
            }
            "--seconds" => {
                index += 1;
                seconds = args
                    .get(index)
                    .ok_or("--seconds requires a number")?
                    .parse()?;
            }
            "--threads" => {
                index += 1;
                worker_selection = match args
                    .get(index)
                    .ok_or("--threads requires 1, 2, or auto")?
                    .as_str()
                {
                    "1" => WorkerSelection::One,
                    "2" => WorkerSelection::Two,
                    "auto" => WorkerSelection::Auto,
                    _ => return Err("threads must be 1, 2, or auto".into()),
                };
            }
            "--format" => {
                index += 1;
                output_format = match args
                    .get(index)
                    .ok_or("--format requires text or json")?
                    .as_str()
                {
                    "text" => OutputFormat::Text,
                    "json" => OutputFormat::Json,
                    _ => return Err("format must be text or json".into()),
                };
            }
            "--scenario" => {
                index += 1;
                scenario = match args.get(index).ok_or("--scenario requires heartbeat, movement, combat, chat, clustered, or dispersed")?.as_str() {
                    "heartbeat" => Scenario::Heartbeat,
                    "movement" => Scenario::Movement,
                    "combat" => Scenario::Combat,
                    "chat" => Scenario::Chat,
                    "clustered" => Scenario::Clustered,
                    "dispersed" => Scenario::Dispersed,
                    _ => return Err("scenario must be heartbeat, movement, combat, chat, clustered, or dispersed".into()),
                };
            }
            "--help" | "-h" => return Ok(ParseOutcome::Help),
            other => return Err(format!("unknown option: {other}").into()),
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    let address = address.ok_or("--address is required")?;
    if clients == 0 || clients > 10_000 {
        return Err("clients must be between 1 and 10000".into());
    }
    if !(1..=86400).contains(&seconds) {
        return Err("seconds must be between 1 and 86400".into());
    }
    Ok(ParseOutcome::Config(StartupConfig {
        address,
        clients,
        seconds,
        worker_selection,
        output_format,
        scenario,
        cpu_label,
        cpu_mhz,
        scenario_id,
        server_data_dir,
    }))
}

mod config;
mod report;
mod scenarios;
use config::{ParseOutcome, StartupConfig};
use minimium_protocol::{encode_client, ClientMessage};

use std::{
    net::ToSocketAddrs,
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
        mpsc, Arc,
    },
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
};
mod client_setup;
mod stats;
mod worker;
use stats::{ClientMeasurement, WorkerStats};
use worker::{run_worker, WorkerConfig, MOVEMENT_DIRECTIONS, POLL_INTERVAL};

fn main() {
    if let Err(error) = run() {
        eprintln!("loadtest: {error}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let config = match config::parse_env()? {
        ParseOutcome::Help => {
            println!("{}", config::HELP);
            return Ok(());
        }
        ParseOutcome::Config(config) => config,
    };
    let worker_count = config.worker_count();
    let thread_mode = config.thread_mode();
    let StartupConfig {
        address,
        clients,
        seconds,
        scenario,
        output_format,
        cpu_label,
        cpu_mhz,
        scenario_id,
        server_data_dir,
        ..
    } = config;
    let mut metadata =
        report::ReportMetadata::new(scenario_id.unwrap_or_else(|| scenario.name().to_owned()));
    metadata.cpu_label = cpu_label;
    metadata.cpu_mhz = cpu_mhz;
    metadata.requested_seconds = seconds;
    metadata.address = address.clone();
    metadata.thread_mode = thread_mode.to_owned();
    if let Some(path) = &server_data_dir {
        match report::capture_server(path, &address) {
            Ok(sample) => metadata.server_before = Some(sample),
            Err(_) => {
                metadata.reject_server_samples();
                eprintln!("server sample before unavailable: address match or endpoint continuity could not be verified; all server samples are unavailable");
            }
        }
    }
    let socket = address.to_socket_addrs()?.next().ok_or("invalid address")?;
    let process_salt = SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)?
        .as_nanos()
        .to_le_bytes();
    let ping_frame = encode_client(&ClientMessage::Ping)?;
    let movement_frames = MOVEMENT_DIRECTIONS
        .map(|direction| {
            encode_client(&ClientMessage::Move {
                direction,
                jump: false,
            })
        })
        .into_iter()
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let fire_frames = MOVEMENT_DIRECTIONS
        .map(|direction| {
            encode_client(&ClientMessage::Fire {
                direction: [direction[0], 0.0, direction[1]],
            })
        })
        .into_iter()
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let chat_frame = encode_client(&ClientMessage::Chat(String::from("load test message")))?;
    let (ready_sender, ready_receiver) = mpsc::channel();
    let abort_setup = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let setup_started_at = Instant::now();
    let mut workers = Vec::with_capacity(worker_count);
    let mut start_senders = Vec::with_capacity(worker_count);

    for worker_id in 0..worker_count {
        let client_ids = (worker_id..clients).step_by(worker_count).collect();
        let ready_sender = ready_sender.clone();
        let abort_setup = Arc::clone(&abort_setup);
        let (start_sender, start_receiver) = mpsc::channel();
        start_senders.push(start_sender);
        let ping_frame = ping_frame.clone();
        let movement_frames = movement_frames.clone();
        let fire_frames = fire_frames.clone();
        let chat_frame = chat_frame.clone();
        workers.push(thread::spawn(move || {
            run_worker(
                client_ids,
                WorkerConfig {
                    socket,
                    process_salt,
                    seconds,
                    scenario,
                    total_clients: clients,
                    ping_frame,
                    movement_frames,
                    fire_frames,
                    chat_frame,
                    ready_sender,
                    start_receiver,
                    abort_setup,
                },
            )
        }));
    }
    drop(ready_sender);

    let mut ready_workers = 0;
    let mut setup_failed = false;
    while ready_workers < worker_count {
        match ready_receiver.recv_timeout(POLL_INTERVAL) {
            Ok(()) => ready_workers += 1,
            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => {
                if workers.iter().any(thread::JoinHandle::is_finished) {
                    setup_failed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => {
                setup_failed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if workers.iter().any(thread::JoinHandle::is_finished) {
        setup_failed = true;
    }
    if setup_failed {
        abort_setup.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        drop(start_senders);
        let mut stats = WorkerStats::default();
        for worker in workers {
            match worker.join() {
                Ok(worker_stats) => stats.merge(worker_stats),
                Err(_) => stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1),
            }
        }
        return Err(format!(
            "load worker failed during setup (ready workers: {ready_workers}/{worker_count}, handshakes: {})",
            stats.connected
        )
        .into());
    }

    if let Some(path) = &server_data_dir {
        match report::capture_server(path, &address) {
            Ok(sample) => metadata.server_measurement_start = Some(sample),
            Err(_) => {
                metadata.reject_server_samples();
                eprintln!("server sample at measurement start unavailable: address match or endpoint continuity could not be verified; all server samples are unavailable");
            }
        }
    }
    if workers.iter().any(thread::JoinHandle::is_finished) {
        abort_setup.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        drop(start_senders);
        for worker in workers {
            let _ = worker.join();
        }
        return Err("load worker exited after setup and before measurement".into());
    }
    let start = Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(100);
    metadata.setup_elapsed_seconds = Some(start.duration_since(setup_started_at).as_secs_f64());
    for sender in start_senders {
        if sender.send(start).is_err() {
            setup_failed = true;
        }
    }
    if setup_failed {
        abort_setup.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        for worker in workers {
            let _ = worker.join();
        }
        return Err("load worker exited before measurement start".into());
    }

    let mut stats = WorkerStats::default();
    for worker in workers {
        match worker.join() {
            Ok(worker_stats) => stats.merge(worker_stats),
            Err(_) => stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1),
        }
    }
    let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    if let Some(path) = &server_data_dir {
        match report::capture_server(path, &address) {
            Ok(sample) => metadata.server_after = Some(sample),
            Err(_) => {
                metadata.reject_server_samples();
                eprintln!("server sample after unavailable: address match or endpoint continuity could not be verified; all server samples are unavailable");
            }
        }
    }
    if !metadata.validate_server_identity() {
        eprintln!("server report samples unavailable: endpoint identity consistency could not be verified across samples");
    }
    report::print_report(
        output_format,
        scenario.name(),
        clients,
        worker_count,
        elapsed,
        &stats,
        &metadata,
    );
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="apps/loadtest/src/report/capture.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="141" bytes="4728" original_lines="141" original_bytes="4728" minified="false" sha256="a8f2dda3358c6b562c1cc597434d9e6b1a8e97cc28f291dc9d56a52e05d52651">>>
use minimium_platform::{admin_client, endpoint::ServerEndpoint};
use std::{
    net::{Ipv4Addr, SocketAddr},
    path::Path,
    time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
};

pub struct ServerSample {
    pub status: String,
    pub metrics: String,
    identity: EndpointIdentity,
}

#[derive(PartialEq, Eq)]
struct EndpointIdentity {
    game_port: u16,
    admin_port: u16,
    token: String,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ReportMetadata {
    pub run_id: String,
    pub scenario_id: String,
    pub requested_seconds: u64,
    pub setup_elapsed_seconds: Option<f64>,
    pub address: String,
    pub thread_mode: String,
    pub cpu_label: Option<String>,
    pub cpu_mhz: Option<u32>,
    pub server_before: Option<ServerSample>,
    pub server_measurement_start: Option<ServerSample>,
    pub server_after: Option<ServerSample>,
    server_samples_invalidated: bool,
}

impl ReportMetadata {
    pub fn new(scenario_id: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            run_id: new_run_id(),
            scenario_id: scenario_id.into(),
            ..Self::default()
        }
    }

    pub fn reject_server_samples(&mut self) {
        self.server_samples_invalidated = true;
        self.server_before = None;
        self.server_measurement_start = None;
        self.server_after = None;
    }

    pub fn validate_server_identity(&mut self) -> bool {
        if self.server_samples_invalidated {
            self.reject_server_samples();
            return false;
        }
        let changed = {
            let samples = [
                self.server_before.as_ref(),
                self.server_measurement_start.as_ref(),
                self.server_after.as_ref(),
            ];
            let mut identity: Option<&EndpointIdentity> = None;
            samples.into_iter().flatten().any(|sample| {
                if identity.is_some_and(|expected| expected != &sample.identity) {
                    true
                } else {
                    identity = Some(&sample.identity);
                    false
                }
            })
        };
        if changed {
            self.reject_server_samples();
            return false;
        }
        true
    }
}

/// Capture actual status and metrics, retaining endpoint identity privately
/// in memory for comparison. Call only at run boundaries, never per tick.
pub fn capture_server(data_dir: &Path, configured_address: &str) -> std::io::Result<ServerSample> {
    let configured = configured_address.parse::<SocketAddr>().ok();
    let Some(SocketAddr::V4(configured)) = configured.filter(
        |address| matches!(address, SocketAddr::V4(value) if *value.ip() == Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST),
    ) else {
        return Err(identity_error(
            "server samples require a literal 127.0.0.1:PORT address",
        ));
    };
    let endpoint = ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir)?;
    let status = admin_client::request(&endpoint, "status")?;
    if status.contains(&endpoint.token) {
        return Err(identity_error("server response contained endpoint token"));
    }
    let actual_address = status
        .split_whitespace()
        .find_map(|field| field.strip_prefix("game_address="))
        .and_then(|value| value.parse::<SocketAddr>().ok());
    if actual_address != Some(SocketAddr::V4(configured)) || endpoint.game_port != configured.port()
    {
        return Err(identity_error("server configured address check failed"));
    }
    let metrics = admin_client::request(&endpoint, "metrics show");
    let current = ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir)?;
    if endpoint.game_port != current.game_port
        || endpoint.admin_port != current.admin_port
        || endpoint.token != current.token
    {
        return Err(identity_error(
            "server endpoint identity consistency could not be verified during capture",
        ));
    }
    let metrics = metrics?;
    if metrics.contains(&endpoint.token) {
        return Err(identity_error("server response contained endpoint token"));
    }
    Ok(ServerSample {
        status,
        metrics,
        identity: EndpointIdentity {
            game_port: endpoint.game_port,
            admin_port: endpoint.admin_port,
            token: endpoint.token,
        },
    })
}

fn identity_error(message: &'static str) -> std::io::Error {
    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted, message)
}

fn new_run_id() -> String {
    let nanos = SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    format!("{}-{nanos}", std::process::id())
}

<<<FILE path="apps/loadtest/src/report/encoding.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="31" bytes="1086" original_lines="31" original_bytes="1086" minified="false" sha256="b2d16d7173b4a60abd3dfd692ce6267b73fe41a86326405dca4b4f59c1328135">>>
pub(super) fn json_string(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut escaped = String::with_capacity(value.len() + 2);
    escaped.push('"');
    for character in value.chars() {
        match character {
            '"' => escaped.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => escaped.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => escaped.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => escaped.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => escaped.push_str("\\t"),
            character if character <= '\u{1f}' => {
                escaped.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", character as u32));
            }
            character => escaped.push(character),
        }
    }
    escaped.push('"');
    escaped
}

pub(super) fn json_number(value: Option<f64>) -> String {
    value
        .filter(|number| number.is_finite())
        .map_or_else(|| "null".to_owned(), |number| format!("{number:.3}"))
}

pub(super) fn display_number(value: Option<f64>) -> String {
    value
        .filter(|number| number.is_finite())
        .map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |number| format!("{number:.3}"))
}

fn client_measurements(report: &ReportData<'_>) -> String {
    let mut clients = report
        .client_measurements()
        .iter()
        .take(10_000)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    clients.sort_by_key(|client| client.generator_id);
    let entries = clients
        .into_iter()
        .map(|client| {
            format!(
                "{{\"generator_id\":{},\"bytes_sent\":{},\"bytes_received\":{},\"status\":{}}}",
                client.generator_id,
                client.bytes_sent,
                client.bytes_received,
                json_string(if client.disconnected {
                    "disconnected"
                } else {
                    "connected"
                }),
            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    format!("[{}]", entries.join(","))
}

fn server_sample(sample: Option<&ServerSample>) -> String {
    match sample {
        Some(sample) => format!(
            "{{\"status\":{},\"metrics\":{}}}",
            json_string(&sample.status),
            json_string(&sample.metrics)
        ),
        None => "null".to_owned(),
    }
}

            Self::Combat => "combat",
            Self::Chat => "chat",
            Self::Clustered => "clustered",
            Self::Dispersed => "dispersed",
        }

        matches!(
            self,

        )
    }

    pub(super) fn includes_combat(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Combat)
    }

    pub(super) fn includes_chat(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Chat)
    }

        Self {
            samples: 0,
            histogram: RttDurationStats::rtt(),
        }
    }

impl RttStats {
    pub(super) fn record(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        self.histogram.record(duration);
        self.samples = self.samples.saturating_add(1);
    }

    pub(super) fn merge(&mut self, other: Self) {
        self.histogram.merge(&other.histogram);
        self.samples = self.samples.saturating_add(other.samples);
    }

    pub(super) fn average_milliseconds(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        self.histogram.average_milliseconds()
    }

    pub(super) fn percentile_milliseconds(&self, percentile: u64) -> Option<f64> {
        self.histogram.percentile_milliseconds(percentile)
    }

    pub(super) fn minimum_milliseconds(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        self.histogram.minimum_milliseconds()
    }

    pub(super) fn maximum_milliseconds(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        self.histogram.maximum_milliseconds()
    }
}

impl WorkerStats {
    pub(super) fn merge(&mut self, other: Self) {
        self.connected = self.connected.saturating_add(other.connected);
        self.ready = self.ready.saturating_add(other.ready);
        self.handshake_failures = self
            .handshake_failures
            .saturating_add(other.handshake_failures);
        self.disconnects_before_start = self
            .disconnects_before_start
            .saturating_add(other.disconnects_before_start);
        self.disconnects_during_measurement = self
            .disconnects_during_measurement
            .saturating_add(other.disconnects_during_measurement);
        self.connected_at_end = self.connected_at_end.saturating_add(other.connected_at_end);
        self.pongs = self.pongs.saturating_add(other.pongs);
        self.errors = self.errors.saturating_add(other.errors);
        self.timeouts = self.timeouts.saturating_add(other.timeouts);
        self.moves_sent = self.moves_sent.saturating_add(other.moves_sent);
        self.shots_sent = self.shots_sent.saturating_add(other.shots_sent);
        self.shots_hit = self.shots_hit.saturating_add(other.shots_hit);
        self.kills = self.kills.saturating_add(other.kills);
