pub(super) struct WorkerConfig {
    pub(super) socket: SocketAddr,
    pub(super) process_salt: [u8; 16],
    pub(super) seconds: u64,
    pub(super) scenario: Scenario,
    pub(super) total_clients: usize,
    pub(super) ping_frame: Vec<u8>,
    pub(super) movement_frames: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
    pub(super) fire_frames: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
    pub(super) chat_frame: Vec<u8>,
    pub(super) ready_sender: mpsc::Sender<()>,
    pub(super) start_receiver: mpsc::Receiver<Instant>,
    pub(super) abort_setup: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) enum OutboundKind {
    Ping,
    Movement(usize),
    DispersedMovement,
    Fire(usize),
    Chat,
}

pub(super) fn run_worker(client_ids: Vec<usize>, config: WorkerConfig) -> WorkerStats {
    let WorkerConfig {
        socket,
        process_salt,
        seconds,
        scenario,
        total_clients,
        ping_frame,
        movement_frames,
        fire_frames,
        chat_frame,
        ready_sender,
        start_receiver,
        abort_setup,
    } = config;
    let mut stats = WorkerStats::default();
    let mut clients = Vec::with_capacity(client_ids.len());
    let setup_config = SetupConfig {
        socket,
        process_salt,
        scenario,
        total_clients,
        movement_frames: &movement_frames,
        ping_frame: &ping_frame,
    };
    for client_id in client_ids {
        if abort_setup.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
            return stats;
        }
        if let Some(client) = prepare_client(client_id, &setup_config, &mut clients, &mut stats) {
            clients.push(client);
        } else {
            stats.per_client.push(ClientMeasurement {
                generator_id: client_id,
                bytes_sent: 0,
                bytes_received: 0,
                disconnected: true,
            });
        }
    }

    stats.ready = clients.iter().filter(|client| !client.disconnected).count() as u64;
    if ready_sender.send(()).is_err() {
        return stats;
    }
    let start = loop {
        match start_receiver.recv_timeout(POLL_INTERVAL) {
            Ok(start) => break start,
            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => {
                service_setup_clients(&mut clients, &ping_frame, None, &mut stats);
                if abort_setup.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                    return stats;
                }
            }
            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => return stats,
        }
    };
    let until = start + Duration::from_secs(seconds);
    while Instant::now() < start {
        service_setup_clients(&mut clients, &ping_frame, Some(start), &mut stats);
        thread::sleep(
            start
                .saturating_duration_since(Instant::now())
                .min(POLL_INTERVAL),
        );
    }
    for client in &mut clients {
        let client_id = client.client_id;
        client.next_ping_at = start;
        client.next_movement_at = start;
        client.next_fire_at = start;
        client.next_chat_at = start + Duration::from_millis(((client_id % 500) * 50) as u64);
    }
    let mut input = [0u8; 2048];
    while Instant::now() < until && !abort_setup.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        let now = Instant::now();
        for client in &mut clients {
            if client.disconnected {
                continue;
            }
            if now >= client.next_ping_at {
                client.ping_due = true;
                client.next_ping_at = now + PING_INTERVAL;
            }
            if scenario.includes_movement() && now >= client.next_movement_at {
                let direction_index = match scenario {
                    Scenario::Clustered => {
                        let outbound = (client.movement_sequence / 10) % 2 == 0;
                        Some(
                            (client.movement_seed + if outbound { 0 } else { 4 })
                                % movement_frames.len(),
                        )
                    }
                    Scenario::Dispersed => {
                        client.pending_dispersed_movement = true;
                        None
                    }
                    _ => Some(
                        (client.movement_seed + (client.movement_sequence / 60) as usize)
                            % movement_frames.len(),
                    ),
                };
                if let Some(direction_index) = direction_index {
                    client.pending_movement_index = Some(direction_index);
                }
                client.movement_sequence = client.movement_sequence.saturating_add(1);
                client.next_movement_at = now + MOVEMENT_INTERVAL;
            }
            if scenario.includes_combat() && now >= client.next_fire_at {
                let direction_index = (client.movement_seed
                    + (client.movement_sequence / 60) as usize)
                    % fire_frames.len();
                client.pending_fire_index = Some(direction_index);
                client.next_fire_at = now + FIRE_INTERVAL;
            }
            if scenario.includes_chat() && now >= client.next_chat_at {
                client.chat_due = true;
                client.next_chat_at = now + CHAT_INTERVAL;
            }
            if client.pending_output.is_none() {
                client.pending_output = if client.ping_due && client.ping_sent_at.is_none() {
                    Some(PendingOutput {
                        kind: OutboundKind::Ping,
                        offset: 0,
                    })
                } else if client.chat_due {
                    Some(PendingOutput {
                        kind: OutboundKind::Chat,
                        offset: 0,
                    })
                } else if let Some(index) = client.pending_fire_index.take() {
                    Some(PendingOutput {
                        kind: OutboundKind::Fire(index),
                        offset: 0,
                    })
                } else if client.pending_dispersed_movement {
                    client.pending_dispersed_movement = false;
                    Some(PendingOutput {
                        kind: OutboundKind::DispersedMovement,
                        offset: 0,
                    })
                } else {
                    client
                        .pending_movement_index
                        .take()
                        .map(|index| PendingOutput {
                            kind: OutboundKind::Movement(index),
                            offset: 0,
                        })
                };
            }
            if let Some(pending) = client.pending_output {
                if Instant::now() >= until {
                    continue;
                }
                let frame = match pending.kind {
                    OutboundKind::Ping => &ping_frame,
                    OutboundKind::Movement(index) => &movement_frames[index],
                    OutboundKind::DispersedMovement => client
                        .dispersed_movement_frame
                        .as_ref()
                        .expect("dispersed scenario prepared each client movement frame"),
                    OutboundKind::Fire(index) => &fire_frames[index],
                    OutboundKind::Chat => &chat_frame,
                };
                match client.stream.write(&frame[pending.offset..]) {
                    Ok(0) => {
                        client.disconnected = true;
                        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                        continue;
                    }
                    Ok(written) => {
                        stats.bytes_sent = stats.bytes_sent.saturating_add(written as u64);
                        client.measurement_bytes_sent =
                            client.measurement_bytes_sent.saturating_add(written as u64);
                        let next_offset = pending.offset + written;
                        if next_offset < frame.len() {
                            client.pending_output = Some(PendingOutput {
                                offset: next_offset,
                                ..pending
                            });
                        } else {
                            client.pending_output = None;
                            match pending.kind {
                                OutboundKind::Ping => {
                                    client.ping_due = false;
                                    client.ping_sent_at = Some(Instant::now());
                                }
                                OutboundKind::Movement(_) => {
                                    stats.moves_sent = stats.moves_sent.saturating_add(1);
                                }
                                OutboundKind::DispersedMovement => {
                                    stats.moves_sent = stats.moves_sent.saturating_add(1);
                                }
                                OutboundKind::Fire(_) => {
                                    stats.shots_sent = stats.shots_sent.saturating_add(1);
                                }
                                OutboundKind::Chat => {
                                    client.chat_due = false;
                                    stats.chat_sent = stats.chat_sent.saturating_add(1);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                    Err(_) => {
                        client.disconnected = true;
                        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }

            loop {
                if Instant::now() >= until {
                    break;
                }
                match client.stream.read(&mut input) {
                    Ok(0) => {
                        client.disconnected = true;
                        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                        break;
                    }
                    Ok(count) => {
                        stats.bytes_received = stats.bytes_received.saturating_add(count as u64);
                        client.measurement_bytes_received = client
                            .measurement_bytes_received
                            .saturating_add(count as u64);
                        client.receive_buffer.extend_from_slice(&input[..count]);
                        if client.receive_buffer.len() > MAX_RECEIVE_BUFFER_BYTES {
                            client.disconnected = true;
                            stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                            break;
                        }
                        loop {
                            match decode_server(&client.receive_buffer) {
                                Ok(Some((message, frame_bytes))) => {
                                    client.receive_buffer.drain(..frame_bytes);
                                    match message {
                                        ServerMessage::Pong => {
                                            stats.pongs = stats.pongs.saturating_add(1);
                                            if let Some(sent_at) = client.ping_sent_at.take() {
                                                stats.rtt.record(
                                                    Instant::now()
                                                        .saturating_duration_since(sent_at),
                                                );
                                            }
                                        }
                                        ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::RateLimit) => {
                                            stats.rate_limited =
                                                stats.rate_limited.saturating_add(1);
                                        }
                                        ServerMessage::Error(_) | ServerMessage::Bye => {
                                            client.disconnected = true;
                                            stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                                        }
                                        ServerMessage::Snapshot { .. } => {
                                            stats.snapshots_received =
                                                stats.snapshots_received.saturating_add(1);
                                        }
                                        ServerMessage::ShotResult {
                                            target_id, killed, ..
                                        } => {
                                            if target_id.is_some() {
                                                stats.shots_hit = stats.shots_hit.saturating_add(1);
                                            }
                                            if killed {
                                                stats.kills = stats.kills.saturating_add(1);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        ServerMessage::Chat { .. } => {
                                            stats.chat_received =
                                                stats.chat_received.saturating_add(1);
                                        }
                                        ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync { .. }
                                        | ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply { .. } => {}
                                        _ => {}
                                    }
                                }
                                Ok(None) => break,
                                Err(_) => {
                                    client.disconnected = true;
                                    stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if client.disconnected {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                    Err(_) => {
                        client.disconnected = true;
                        stats.errors = stats.errors.saturating_add(1);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if !client.disconnected
                && client.ping_sent_at.is_some_and(|sent_at| {
                    Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(sent_at) >= PING_TIMEOUT
                })
            {
                client.disconnected = true;
                stats.timeouts = stats.timeouts.saturating_add(1);
            }
        }
        thread::sleep(POLL_INTERVAL);
    }
    let finished_at = Instant::now();
    for client in &mut clients {
        if !client.disconnected
            && client.ping_sent_at.is_some_and(|sent_at| {
                finished_at.saturating_duration_since(sent_at) >= PING_TIMEOUT
            })
        {
            stats.timeouts = stats.timeouts.saturating_add(1);
        }
    }
    stats.disconnects_during_measurement = clients
        .iter()
        .filter(|client| client.disconnected && !client.disconnected_before_start)
        .count() as u64;
    stats.connected_at_end = stats
        .ready
        .saturating_sub(stats.disconnects_during_measurement);
    stats.per_client.reserve(clients.len().min(10_000));
    stats
        .per_client
        .extend(clients.iter().map(|client| ClientMeasurement {
            generator_id: client.client_id,
            bytes_sent: client.measurement_bytes_sent,
            bytes_received: client.measurement_bytes_received,
            disconnected: client.disconnected,
        }));
    stats
}

use minimium_game_sample::{
    generate_legacy_demo_worlds, generate_worlds,
    generate_worlds_with_planet_revision_and_geography, load_planet_preset, GeneratedWorld,
    PlanetMode, ResolvedPlanetConfig, DEFAULT_COMBAT_CONFIG, DEFAULT_SEED, SAMPLE_MAP,
};
use minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography;
use minimium_server_runtime::composition::{
    ServerCombatConfig, ServerComposition, WorldComposition, WorldCompositionRequest,
    WorldDefinition, WorldPortal,
};
use minimium_world::world::{
    GenerationRevision, GenerationSpec, GeneratorDigest, WorldContentRevision, WorldDefinitionId,
    WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest, WorldMap, WorldSeed, WorldTopology,
};
use std::{env, error::Error, io, path::PathBuf, sync::Arc};

pub(super) fn server_composition() -> ServerComposition {
    ServerComposition {
        world_composer: compose_world,
        combat: ServerCombatConfig {
            hitscan: DEFAULT_COMBAT_CONFIG.hitscan,
            fire_cooldown_ms: DEFAULT_COMBAT_CONFIG.fire_cooldown_ms,
        },
    }
}

fn compose_world(request: WorldCompositionRequest) -> Result<WorldComposition, Box<dyn Error>> {
    let WorldCompositionRequest {
        data_dir,
        requested_seed,
        existing_seed,
        map_path,
        world_definition_path,
        planet_config_path,
    } = request;
    let resolved_path = data_dir.join("world.planet.ron");
    let saved_planet = match std::fs::read_to_string(&resolved_path) {
        Ok(source) => Some(
            ron::from_str::<ResolvedPlanetConfig>(&source).map_err(|error| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    format!("saved planet definition: {error}"),
                )
            })?,
        ),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
        Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
    };
    if let (Some(file_seed), Some(planet)) = (existing_seed, &saved_planet) {
        if file_seed != planet.seed {
            return Err("world.seed differs from the saved planet definition".into());
        }
    }
    // Recover if the migrated snapshot was committed before world.seed.
    let snapshot_seed =
        if existing_seed.is_none() && map_path.is_none() && world_definition_path.is_none() {
            match minimium_platform::files::read_bounded_file(
                &data_dir.join("world.snapshot"),
                16 * 1024 * 1024,
            ) {
                Ok(snapshot) => {
                    let source = std::str::from_utf8(&snapshot).map_err(|_| {
                        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "snapshot is not UTF-8")
                    })?;
                    let fields: Vec<_> = source.lines().next().unwrap_or("").split('\t').collect();
                    let recognized_planet = fields.first() == Some(&"MINIMIUM_WORLD")
                        && matches!(fields.get(1).copied(), Some("6" | "7" | "8"))
                        && fields.get(3) == Some(&"1")
                        && fields.get(4) == Some(&"0")
                        && fields
                            .get(6)
                            .and_then(|value| value.parse::<u32>().ok())
                            .is_some_and(|revision| revision >= 2);
                    if recognized_planet {
                        fields.get(5).and_then(|value| value.parse::<u128>().ok())
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                }
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
                Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
            }
        } else {
            None
        };
    let legacy_snapshot = existing_seed.is_none()
        && snapshot_seed.is_none()
        && data_dir.join("world.snapshot").exists()
        && map_path.is_none()
        && world_definition_path.is_none();
    if let (Some(expected), Some(requested)) = (
        existing_seed
            .or(snapshot_seed)
            .or(saved_planet.as_ref().map(|planet| planet.seed)),
        requested_seed,
    ) {
        if expected != requested {
            return Err("--seed differs from the seed stored in this data directory".into());
        }
    }
    if legacy_snapshot && requested_seed.is_some_and(|requested| requested != DEFAULT_SEED) {
        return Err("existing demo snapshot requires its original seed during migration".into());
    }
    let seed = match existing_seed
        .or(snapshot_seed)
        .or(saved_planet.as_ref().map(|planet| planet.seed))
        .or(requested_seed)
        .or(legacy_snapshot.then_some(DEFAULT_SEED))
    {
        Some(seed) => seed,
        None => {
            let token = minimium_platform::endpoint::new_admin_token()?;
            u128::from_str_radix(&token[..32], 16)
                .expect("an admin token contains hexadecimal digits")
        }
    };
    let legacy_generated = (existing_seed.is_some() || data_dir.join("world.snapshot").exists())
        && saved_planet.is_none();
    if legacy_generated && planet_config_path.is_some() {
        return Err("existing generated world has a legacy definition; use a new data directory for a planet preset".into());
    }
    let mut planet = if map_path.is_none() && world_definition_path.is_none() && !legacy_generated {
        let requested = planet_config_path
            .as_deref()
            .map(|path| load_planet_preset(path, seed))
            .transpose()?;
        let resolved = match (saved_planet, requested) {
            (Some(saved), Some(mut requested)) => {
                requested.package_digest = saved.package_digest;
                requested.generator_revision = saved.generator_revision;
                if saved != requested {
                    return Err("planet preset differs from the immutable definition in this data directory".into());
                }
                saved
            }
            (Some(saved), _) => saved,
            (None, Some(requested)) => requested,
            (None, None) => ResolvedPlanetConfig::procedural(seed),
        };
        resolved.validate()?;
        Some(resolved)
    } else {
        None
    };

    let mut prepared_geography = None;
    let (primary_map, worlds) = if let Some(path) = world_definition_path.as_deref() {
        let definition = minimium_asset_io::load_world_definition(path).map_err(|error| {
            io::Error::new(
                error.kind(),
                format!(
                    "could not load world definition {}: {error}",
                    path.display()
                ),
            )
        })?;
        minimium_procgen::validate_world_manifest(definition.manifest())
            .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))?;
        let map = minimium_procgen::materialize_dungeon_map(definition.dungeon())
            .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))?;
        let instance = WorldInstanceId::new(4).expect("manual world instance ID is nonzero");
        let generated = WorldDefinition {
            instance,
            manifest: definition.manifest(),
            map: map.clone(),
            portal: None,
        };
        let legacy_map = parse_legacy_map()?;
        (map, Some(vec![generated, legacy_world(legacy_map)]))
    } else if let Some(path) = map_path.as_deref() {
        let map = minimium_asset_io::load_map(path).map_err(|error| {
            io::Error::new(
                error.kind(),
                format!("could not load map {}: {error}", path.display()),
            )
        })?;
        (map, None)
    } else {
        let generated = if let Some(planet) = &mut planet {
            if planet.mode == PlanetMode::Earth {
                let package = planet
                    .earth_package
                    .clone()
                    .or_else(|| env::var_os("MINIMIUM_EARTH_PACKAGE").map(PathBuf::from))
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| data_dir.join("gebco-2026"));
                if !package.join("index.ron").is_file() {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "GEBCO 2026 ice-surface package missing at {}; run import-gebco.ps1 -GridPath GEBCO_2026.nc -DataDir {}",
                        package.display(), data_dir.display()
                    ).into());
                }
                let prepared = minimium_asset_io::open_earth_package(
                    &package,
                    (planet.package_digest != [0; 32]).then_some(planet.package_digest),
                )
                .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))?;
                let digest = prepared.package_digest();
                if planet.package_digest != [0; 32] && planet.package_digest != digest {
                    return Err("GEBCO package differs from the immutable world definition".into());
                }
                planet.package_digest = digest;
                prepared_geography = Some(prepared.clone());
            }
            generate_worlds_with_planet_revision_and_geography(
                seed,
                planet.definition(),
                planet.generator_revision,
                prepared_geography.as_ref().map(|geography| {
                    geography.clone() as Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>
                }),
            )
        } else {
            generate_worlds(seed)
        };
        let mut worlds = generated
            .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))?
            .into_iter()
            .map(to_world_definition)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        worlds.push(legacy_world(parse_legacy_map()?));
        (worlds[0].map.clone(), Some(worlds))
    };

    let migration_worlds = legacy_snapshot
        .then(|| {
            generate_legacy_demo_worlds()
                .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))
                .and_then(|worlds| {
                    let mut worlds = worlds
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(to_world_definition)
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    worlds.push(legacy_world(parse_legacy_map()?));
                    Ok(worlds)
                })
        })
        .transpose()?;
    let planet_definition = planet
        .map(|planet| ron::to_string(&planet).map(String::into_bytes))
        .transpose()?;

    Ok(WorldComposition {
        seed,
        primary_map,
        worlds,
        migration_worlds,
        planet_definition,
        prepared_geography: prepared_geography
            .map(|geography| geography as Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>),
    })
}

fn to_world_definition(world: GeneratedWorld) -> WorldDefinition {
    WorldDefinition {
        instance: world.instance,
        manifest: world.manifest,
        map: world.map,
        portal: world.portal.map(|portal| WorldPortal {
            position: portal.position,
            target_instance: portal.target_instance,
            destination: portal.destination,
        }),
    }
}

fn parse_legacy_map() -> io::Result<WorldMap> {
    minimium_assets::parse_map(SAMPLE_MAP)
        .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))
}

fn legacy_world(map: WorldMap) -> WorldDefinition {
    let instance = WorldInstanceId::new(3).expect("legacy instance ID is nonzero");
    let generation = GenerationSpec::new(
        WorldSeed::new(0),
        GenerationRevision::new(1).expect("legacy generator revision is nonzero"),
        1,
    )
    .expect("legacy position quantum is nonzero");
    let manifest = WorldManifest::new(
        WorldDefinitionId::new(3).expect("legacy definition ID is nonzero"),
        WorldTopology::Dungeon,
        generation,
        WorldContentRevision::new(1).expect("legacy content revision is nonzero"),
        GeneratorDigest::legacy_map_fingerprint(map.fingerprint()),
    );
    WorldDefinition {
        instance,
        manifest,
        map,
        portal: None,
    }
}

//! Offline static asset validation, without a device, session, or game process.
fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let path = std::env::args_os()
        .nth(1)
        .ok_or("usage: validate_materials PACKAGE_DIRECTORY")?;
    for compressed in [true, false] {
        let package = minimium_asset_io::materials::MaterialPackage::open(
            std::path::Path::new(&path),
            compressed,
        )?;
        let variant = &package.manifest.variants[package.variant];
        println!(
            "{}: edge={} compressed={} files=3 verified",
            package.manifest_hash, variant.edge, variant.compressed
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/asset-io/src/geography.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="230" bytes="8151" original_lines="230" original_bytes="8151" minified="false" sha256="f6b5f1a91d459053e4c9e7934ad0d509caf930a320595564d3e21bebec6b3069">>>
//! Read-only GEBCO 2026 ice-surface package shared by server and client.
mod bounds;
use memmap2::Mmap;
use minimium_procgen::EarthSampleError;
use serde::Deserialize;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    fmt,
    fs::{self, File},
    path::Path,
    sync::{Arc, OnceLock},
};

const TILE_EDGE: usize = 21_600;
const TILE_BYTES: usize = TILE_EDGE * TILE_EDGE * 2;
const LITE_WIDTH: usize = 21_600;
const LITE_HEIGHT: usize = 10_800;
const LITE_SOURCE: &str = "https://data.source.coop/ausantarctic/gebco/GEBCO_2026.tif";

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct PackageIndex {
    version: u32,
    edition: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    source_sha256: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    source_url: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    source_etag: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    source_version: String,
    tile_sha256: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct PreparedEarthGeography {
    land_cover: Option<Mmap>,
    package_digest: [u8; 32],
    tiles: Vec<Mmap>,
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    maxima: OnceLock<Box<[std::sync::atomic::AtomicI32]>>,
}

pub fn open_earth_package(
    path: &Path,
    expected: Option<[u8; 32]>,
) -> Result<Arc<PreparedEarthGeography>, String> {
    let source = fs::read_to_string(path.join("index.ron"))
        .map_err(|error| format!("GEBCO index: {error}"))?;
    let index: PackageIndex =
        ron::from_str(&source).map_err(|error| format!("GEBCO index: {error}"))?;
    let lite = index.version == 2;
    if !(index.version == 1
        && index.edition == "GEBCO_2026_ice_surface"
        && index.tile_sha256.len() == 8
        || lite
            && index.edition == "GEBCO_2026_ice_surface_60arcsec"
            && index.tile_sha256.len() == 1
            && index.source_url == LITE_SOURCE
            && !index.source_etag.is_empty()
            && !index.source_version.is_empty())
    {
        return Err("unsupported GEBCO package index".into());
    }
    let mut package_hash = Sha256::new();
    let (width, height, tile_names) = if lite {
        package_hash.update(b"GEBCO_2026_ice_surface_60arcsec\0");
        for value in [&index.source_url, &index.source_etag, &index.source_version] {
            package_hash.update(value.as_bytes());
            package_hash.update([0]);
        }
        (LITE_WIDTH, LITE_HEIGHT, vec![String::from("elevation.bil")])
    } else {
        package_hash.update(decode_sha256(&index.source_sha256)?);
        (
            TILE_EDGE * 4,
            TILE_EDGE * 2,
            (0..2)
                .flat_map(|y| (0..4).map(move |x| format!("tile-{y}-{x}.bil")))
                .collect(),
        )
    };
    let mut tiles = Vec::with_capacity(tile_names.len());
    for (index_in_package, name) in tile_names.iter().enumerate() {
        let file =
            File::open(path.join(name)).map_err(|error| format!("GEBCO tile {name}: {error}"))?;
        let expected_bytes = if lite {
            LITE_WIDTH * LITE_HEIGHT * 2
        } else {
            TILE_BYTES
        };
        if file.metadata().map_err(|error| error.to_string())?.len() != expected_bytes as u64 {
            return Err(format!("GEBCO tile {name} has the wrong size"));
        }
        // The package is immutable while mapped. The importer checks the
        // byte order and writes a new directory before publishing it.
        let tile = unsafe { Mmap::map(&file) }.map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        let actual = Sha256::digest(&tile);
        if actual.as_slice() != decode_sha256(&index.tile_sha256[index_in_package])? {
            return Err(format!("GEBCO tile {name} checksum mismatch"));
        }
        package_hash.update(actual);
        tiles.push(tile);
    }
    let package = PreparedEarthGeography {
        land_cover: crate::land_cover::open(path)?,
        package_digest: package_hash.finalize().into(),
        tiles,
        width,
        height,
        maxima: OnceLock::new(),
    };
    let digest = package.package_digest;
    if expected.is_some_and(|expected| expected != digest) {
        return Err("GEBCO package checksum differs from world definition".into());
    }
    let _ = digest;
    Ok(Arc::new(package))
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for PreparedEarthGeography {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter
            .debug_struct("PreparedEarthGeography")
            .field("package_digest", &self.package_digest)
            .field("width", &self.width)
            .field("height", &self.height)
            .finish()
    }
}

fn decode_sha256(hex: &str) -> Result<[u8; 32], String> {
    if hex.len() != 64 || !hex.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
        return Err("invalid GEBCO SHA-256 digest".into());
    }
    let mut bytes = [0_u8; 32];
    for (byte, pair) in bytes
        .iter_mut()
        .zip(hex.as_bytes().as_chunks::<2>().0.iter())
    {
        let pair = std::str::from_utf8(pair).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        *byte = u8::from_str_radix(pair, 16).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

/// Samples unscaled, bilinearly interpolated GEBCO meters without panicking.
impl PreparedEarthGeography {
    pub fn try_earth_elevation_m(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Result<f64, EarthSampleError> {
        let length = direction
            .iter()
            .map(|value| value * value)
            .sum::<f64>()
            .sqrt();
        if !length.is_finite() || length == 0.0 || !direction.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite())
        {
            return Err(EarthSampleError::InvalidDirection);
        }
        let latitude = (direction[1] / length).asin().to_degrees();
        let longitude = direction[2].atan2(direction[0]).to_degrees();
        let samples_per_degree = self.width as f64 / 360.0;
        let grid_x =
            (((longitude + 180.0) * samples_per_degree - 0.5) * 1_000_000.0).round() / 1_000_000.0;
        let grid_y =
            (((90.0 - latitude) * samples_per_degree - 0.5) * 1_000_000.0).round() / 1_000_000.0;
        let x0 = grid_x.floor() as i64;
        let y0 = grid_y.floor() as i64;
        let fx = grid_x - x0 as f64;
        let fy = grid_y - y0 as f64;
        let h00 = f64::from(self.pixel(x0, y0));
        let h10 = f64::from(self.pixel(x0 + 1, y0));
        let h01 = f64::from(self.pixel(x0, y0 + 1));
        let h11 = f64::from(self.pixel(x0 + 1, y0 + 1));
        let height_m =
            (h00 * (1.0 - fx) + h10 * fx) * (1.0 - fy) + (h01 * (1.0 - fx) + h11 * fx) * fy;
        if height_m.is_finite() {
            Ok(height_m)
        } else {
            Err(EarthSampleError::InvalidDirection)
        }
    }

    pub fn earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(
        &self,
        direction: [f64; 3],
        angle: f64,
    ) -> Result<f64, EarthSampleError> {
        bounds::earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(self, direction, angle)
    }
}

impl PreparedEarthGeography {
    fn pixel(&self, x: i64, y: i64) -> i16 {
        let x = x.rem_euclid(self.width as i64) as usize;
        let y = y.clamp(0, self.height as i64 - 1) as usize;
        let (tile, offset) = if self.tiles.len() == 1 {
            (&self.tiles[0], (y * self.width + x) * 2)
        } else {
            (
                &self.tiles[(y / TILE_EDGE) * 4 + x / TILE_EDGE],
                ((y % TILE_EDGE) * TILE_EDGE + x % TILE_EDGE) * 2,
            )
        };
        i16::from_le_bytes([tile[offset], tile[offset + 1]])
    }
}

impl minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography for PreparedEarthGeography {
    fn land_cover(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 6]> {
        minimium_assets::land_cover::LandCover::parse(self.land_cover.as_ref()?)
            .ok()?
            .sample(direction)
    }
    fn package_digest(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
        self.package_digest
    }

    fn elevation_m(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Result<f64, EarthSampleError> {
        self.try_earth_elevation_m(direction)
    }

    fn elevation_upper_bound_m(
        &self,
        direction: [f64; 3],
        angle: f64,
    ) -> Result<f64, EarthSampleError> {
        self.earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(direction, angle)
    }
}

//! Conservative raster bounds for a spherical cap. Bilinear interpolation cannot
//! exceed its contributing pixels. One-degree maxima are filled lazily, off-thread.
use super::PreparedEarthGeography;
use minimium_procgen::EarthSampleError;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicI32, Ordering};

const CELLS: usize = 360 * 180;

pub(super) fn earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(
    package: &PreparedEarthGeography,
    direction: [f64; 3],
    angle: f64,
) -> Result<f64, EarthSampleError> {
    let length = direction.iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
    if !length.is_finite() || length <= 0.0 || !angle.is_finite() || !(0.0..=0.2).contains(&angle) {
        return Err(EarthSampleError::InvalidDirection);
    }
    let latitude = (direction[1] / length).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
    let longitude = direction[2].atan2(direction[0]).to_degrees();
    let lat_span = angle.to_degrees();
    let lon_span = if latitude.abs() + angle >= std::f64::consts::FRAC_PI_2 {
        180.0
    } else {
        (angle.sin() / latitude.cos())
            .clamp(-1.0, 1.0)
            .asin()
            .to_degrees()
    };
    let south = ((latitude.to_degrees() - lat_span).floor() as i32).clamp(-90, 89);
    let north = ((latitude.to_degrees() + lat_span).floor() as i32).clamp(-90, 89);
    let west = (longitude - lon_span).floor() as i32;
    let east = ((longitude + lon_span).floor() as i32).min(west + 359);
    let maxima = package
        .maxima
        .get_or_init(|| (0..CELLS).map(|_| AtomicI32::new(i32::MIN)).collect());
    let samples = package.width as f64 / 360.0;
    let mut bound = i32::MIN;
    for lat in south..=north {
        for raw_lon in west..=east {
            let lon = (raw_lon + 180).rem_euclid(360) - 180;
            let cell = &maxima[((lat + 90) * 360 + lon + 180) as usize];
            let mut maximum = cell.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            if maximum == i32::MIN {
                // Include all four bilinear support pixels, also at cell borders.
                let x0 = ((f64::from(lon) + 180.0) * samples - 0.5).floor() as i64;
                let x1 = ((f64::from(lon) + 181.0) * samples - 0.5).ceil() as i64;
                let y0 = ((89.0 - f64::from(lat)) * samples - 0.5).floor() as i64;
                let y1 = ((90.0 - f64::from(lat)) * samples - 0.5).ceil() as i64;
                for y in y0..=y1 {
                    for x in x0..=x1 {
                        maximum = maximum.max(i32::from(package.pixel(x, y)));
                    }
                }
                cell.store(maximum, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            bound = bound.max(maximum);
        }
    }
    Ok(f64::from(bound))
}

use memmap2::Mmap;
use std::{fs::File, path::Path};

pub(crate) fn open(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<Mmap>, String> {
    let file = match File::open(path.join("worldcover.bin")) {
        Ok(file) => file,
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
        Err(error) => return Err(error.to_string()),
    };
    if file.metadata().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.len()
        != minimium_assets::land_cover::BYTES as u64
    {
        return Err("wrong WorldCover grid size".into());
    }
    // Prepared geography is immutable while mapped, as with GEBCO tiles.
    let data = unsafe { Mmap::map(&file) }.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let hash = super::materials::read_bounded(&path.join("worldcover.sha256"), 64)?;
    if std::str::from_utf8(&hash).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        != minimium_assets::terrain_material::digest(&data)
    {
        return Err("WorldCover grid checksum mismatch".into());
    }
    minimium_assets::land_cover::LandCover::parse(&data)?;
    Ok(Some(data))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/asset-io/src/lib.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="62" bytes="2217" original_lines="62" original_bytes="2217" minified="false" sha256="a3f216dfb3e478139f6456ee957645a8e4532cf50861423b0c5cfdbbbbd5792b">>>
//! File-backed adapters for explicit, bounded asset parsing APIs.

mod geography;

pub use geography::{open_earth_package, PreparedEarthGeography};

use minimium_world::world::WorldMap;
use std::{
    fs::File,
    io::{self, Read},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

/// Opens a map and its relative mesh assets, then delegates decoding to assets.
pub fn load_map(path: &Path) -> io::Result<WorldMap> {
    let source = read_bounded(path, minimium_assets::MAX_MAP_BYTES)?;
    let base_dir = path
        .parent()
        .filter(|parent| !parent.as_os_str().is_empty())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new("."));
    let canonical_base = std::fs::canonicalize(base_dir)?;
    minimium_assets::parse_map_with_mesh_loader(&source, |asset_path, max_bytes| {
        let canonical_asset = canonical_asset_path(&canonical_base, asset_path)?;
        read_bounded(&canonical_asset, max_bytes)
            .map_err(|error| format!("cannot read mesh asset `{}`: {error}", asset_path.display()))
    })
    .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))
}

/// Opens a bounded world-definition file and delegates validation to assets.
pub fn load_world_definition(path: &Path) -> io::Result<minimium_assets::WorldDefinition> {
    let source = read_bounded(path, minimium_assets::MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES)?;
    minimium_assets::parse_world_definition(&source)
        .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))
}

fn canonical_asset_path(base: &Path, relative: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let path = std::fs::canonicalize(base.join(relative)).map_err(|error| {
        format!(
            "cannot resolve mesh asset `{}`: {error}",
            relative.display()
        )
    })?;
    if !path.starts_with(base) {
        return Err(format!(
            "mesh asset `{}` resolves outside the map directory",
            relative.display()
        ));
    }
    Ok(path)
}

fn read_bounded(path: &Path, max_bytes: usize) -> io::Result<String> {
    let mut source = String::new();
    File::open(path)?
        .take((max_bytes.saturating_add(1)) as u64)
        .read_to_string(&mut source)?;
    Ok(source)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/asset-io/src/materials.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="164" bytes="6312" original_lines="164" original_bytes="6312" minified="false" sha256="4ce11db3f9ff6c9b2398a0d85f954a03d5f35f8c1c3bf5bb925d04d54afaff15">>>
//! Hash-addressed, transactional material installation. Hosts choose transport/workers.
use minimium_assets::{ktx2, terrain_material::*};
use std::{
    fs,
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

pub struct MaterialPackage {
    pub manifest: MaterialManifest,
    pub manifest_hash: String,
    pub variant: usize,
    pub maps: [Vec<u8>; 3],
}

impl MaterialPackage {
    pub fn open(path: &Path, compressed: bool) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let source = read_bounded(&path.join("manifest.ron"), MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES as u64)?;
        let manifest = MaterialManifest::parse(&source)?;
        let variant = usize::from(!compressed);
        let mut maps = [Vec::new(), Vec::new(), Vec::new()];
        for (data, file) in maps.iter_mut().zip(&manifest.variants[variant].maps) {
            *data = read_bounded(&path.join(&file.name), file.bytes)?;
        }
        Self::from_parts(&source, compressed, maps)
    }

    pub fn from_parts(source: &[u8], compressed: bool, maps: [Vec<u8>; 3]) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let manifest = MaterialManifest::parse(source)?;
        let variant = usize::from(!compressed);
        let selected = &manifest.variants[variant];
        let mut gpu_bytes = 0;
        for (index, (data, file)) in maps.iter().zip(&selected.maps).enumerate() {
            if data.len() as u64 != file.bytes || digest(data) != file.sha256 {
                return Err(format!("material checksum mismatch: {}", file.name));
            }
            let format = if compressed {
                [132, 141, 137][index]
            } else {
                [43, 37, 37][index]
            };
            gpu_bytes += ktx2::Texture::parse(data, selected.edge, format)?.gpu_bytes;
        }
        if gpu_bytes > MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES {
            return Err("material GPU budget exceeded".into());
        }
        Ok(Self {
            manifest,
            manifest_hash: digest(source),
            variant,
            maps,
        })
    }
}

pub fn read_bounded(path: &Path, limit: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let file = fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if file.metadata().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.len() > limit {
        return Err("asset exceeds size limit".into());
    }
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    file.take(limit + 1)
        .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if bytes.len() as u64 > limit {
        return Err("asset exceeds size limit".into());
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

/// Downloads only absent hashes. Temporary files never replace a verified blob.
pub fn install(
    cache: &Path,
    manifest_bytes: &[u8],
    expected_hash: &str,
    compressed: bool,
    mut fetch: impl FnMut(&str, u64, &mut dyn Write) -> Result<(), String>,
) -> Result<MaterialPackage, String> {
    decode_hash(expected_hash)?;
    if digest(manifest_bytes) != expected_hash {
        return Err("material manifest checksum mismatch".into());
    }
    let manifest = MaterialManifest::parse(manifest_bytes)?;
    fs::create_dir_all(cache).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let variant = usize::from(!compressed);
    let mut maps = [Vec::new(), Vec::new(), Vec::new()];
    for (data, file) in maps.iter_mut().zip(&manifest.variants[variant].maps) {
        let blob = cache.join(&file.sha256);
        if let Ok(existing) = read_bounded(&blob, file.bytes) {
            if existing.len() as u64 == file.bytes && digest(&existing) == file.sha256 {
                *data = existing;
                continue;
            }
        }
        let nonce = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .as_nanos();
        let temporary = cache.join(format!(
            "{}.{}.{nonce}.part",
            file.sha256,
            std::process::id()
        ));
        let result = (|| {
            let mut output = fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .write(true)
                .create_new(true)
                .open(&temporary)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let mut writer = LimitedWriter {
                output: &mut output,
                remaining: file.bytes,
            };
            fetch(&file.name, file.bytes, &mut writer)?;
            output.sync_all().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            *data = read_bounded(&temporary, file.bytes)?;
            if data.len() as u64 != file.bytes || digest(data) != file.sha256 {
                return Err("download checksum mismatch".into());
            }
            // A corrupt existing blob is never considered installed.
            if blob.exists() {
                if let Ok(existing) = read_bounded(&blob, file.bytes) {
                    if existing.len() as u64 == file.bytes && digest(&existing) == file.sha256 {
                        fs::remove_file(&temporary).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                fs::remove_file(&blob).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            }
            fs::rename(&temporary, &blob).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
        })();
        if temporary.exists() {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(temporary);
        }
        result?;
    }
    let package = MaterialPackage::from_parts(manifest_bytes, compressed, maps)?;
    // Immutable receipt becomes visible only after every file has passed validation.
    let receipt: PathBuf = cache.join(format!("{expected_hash}-{variant}.ron"));
    if !receipt.exists() {
        let temporary = receipt.with_extension(format!("{}.part", std::process::id()));
        fs::write(&temporary, manifest_bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        fs::rename(temporary, receipt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    Ok(package)
}

struct LimitedWriter<'a> {
    output: &'a mut fs::File,
    remaining: u64,
}
impl Write for LimitedWriter<'_> {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {
        if bytes.len() as u64 > self.remaining {
            return Err(io::Error::other("material download exceeds declared size"));
        }
        let written = self.output.write(bytes)?;
        self.remaining -= written as u64;
        Ok(written)
    }
    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        self.output.flush()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/asset-io/src/material_http.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="99" bytes="3325" original_lines="99" original_bytes="3325" minified="false" sha256="6fffd4f28b168ce1bed564a06110f83922a142892041d9b96ae01a1b57acf9f3">>>
//! Bounded HTTP/1.1 asset transport, separate from game traffic.
use std::{
    io::{Read, Write},
    net::{SocketAddr, TcpStream},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

/// Endpoint is the game peer's IP with the separately advertised asset port.
pub fn fetch(
    address: SocketAddr,
    name: &str,
    limit: u64,
    output: &mut dyn Write,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    fetch_cancellable(address, name, limit, output, || false)
}

pub fn fetch_cancellable(
    address: SocketAddr,
    name: &str,
    limit: u64,
    output: &mut dyn Write,
    cancelled: impl Fn() -> bool,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(300);
    let interrupted = || cancelled() || Instant::now() >= deadline;
    if !name
        .bytes()
        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"-_.".contains(&c))
    {
        return Err("invalid material HTTP path".into());
    }
    let mut stream =
        TcpStream::connect_timeout(&address, Duration::from_secs(10)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    stream
        .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(30)))
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    stream
        .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)))
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    write!(
        stream,
        "GET /{name} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {address}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut header = Vec::new();
    while !header.ends_with(b"\r\n\r\n") {
        if interrupted() {
            return Err("material download cancelled or timed out".into());
        }
        if header.len() >= 8192 {
            return Err("HTTP header exceeds limit".into());
        }
        let mut byte = [0];
        stream.read_exact(&mut byte).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        header.push(byte[0]);
    }
    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&header).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut lines = text.lines();
    if lines.next() != Some("HTTP/1.1 200 OK") {
        return Err("material HTTP request failed".into());
    }
    let mut length = None;
    for line in lines {
        if let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once(':') {
            if key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("transfer-encoding") {
                return Err("chunked material response unsupported".into());
            }
            if key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("content-length") {
                if length.is_some() {
                    return Err("duplicate content-length".into());
                }
                length = Some(value.trim().parse::<u64>().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?);
            }
        }
    }
    let length = length
        .filter(|v| *v <= limit)
        .ok_or("invalid material content-length")?;
    let mut remaining = length;
    let mut buffer = [0_u8; 64 * 1024];
    while remaining > 0 {
        if interrupted() {
            return Err("material download cancelled or timed out".into());
        }
        let count = (remaining as usize).min(buffer.len());
        let read = stream
            .read(&mut buffer[..count])
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if read == 0 {
            return Err("material download interrupted".into());
        }
        output
            .write_all(&buffer[..read])
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        remaining -= read as u64;
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/ktx2.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="88" bytes="3019" original_lines="88" original_bytes="3019" minified="false" sha256="a4a2ba111ce3861a66b5027ea14250d9ea3d7794cea74b62b675ebad4b6eee85">>>
//! Strict KTX2 subset: six 2-D layers, complete mip chain, no supercompression.
use std::ops::Range;

pub struct Texture<'a> {
    pub bytes: &'a [u8],
    pub edge: u32,
    pub vk_format: u32,
    pub levels: Vec<Range<usize>>,
    pub gpu_bytes: u64,
}

impl<'a> Texture<'a> {
    pub fn parse(
        bytes: &'a [u8],
        expected_edge: u32,
        expected_format: u32,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let error = || "invalid or unsupported terrain KTX2".to_string();
        if bytes.len() < 80 || &bytes[..12] != b"\xABKTX 20\xBB\r\n\x1A\n" {
            return Err(error());
        }
        let u32_at = |i| u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[i..i + 4].try_into().unwrap());
        let u64_at = |i| u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[i..i + 8].try_into().unwrap());
        let edge = u32_at(20);
        let format = u32_at(12);
        if ![2048, 4096].contains(&edge)
            || edge != expected_edge
            || format != expected_format
            || u32_at(16) != 1
            || u32_at(24) != edge
            || u32_at(28) != 0
            || u32_at(32) != 6
            || u32_at(36) != 1
            || u32_at(40) != edge.ilog2() + 1
            || u32_at(44) != 0
            || u64_at(64) != 0
            || u64_at(72) != 0
        {
            return Err(error());
        }
        let count = u32_at(40) as usize;
        let index_end = 80 + count * 24;
        if bytes.len() < index_end {
            return Err(error());
        }
        let dfd_start = u32_at(48) as usize;
        let dfd_end = dfd_start
            .checked_add(u32_at(52) as usize)
            .ok_or_else(error)?;
        if dfd_start < index_end || dfd_end > bytes.len() || dfd_end - dfd_start < 28 {
            return Err(error());
        }
        let mut levels = Vec::new();
        let mut gpu_bytes = 0;
        for level in 0..count {
            let size = (edge >> level).max(1) as u64;
            let expected = match format {
                37 | 43 => size * size * 4 * 6,
                131 | 132 => size.div_ceil(4).pow(2) * 8 * 6,
                137 | 141 => size.div_ceil(4).pow(2) * 16 * 6,
                _ => return Err(error()),
            };
            let offset = u64_at(80 + level * 24);
            let length = u64_at(88 + level * 24);
            let end = offset.checked_add(length).ok_or_else(error)?;
            if length != expected
                || u64_at(96 + level * 24) != expected
                || offset < dfd_end as u64
                || offset % 8 != 0
                || end > bytes.len() as u64
                || levels
                    .iter()
                    .any(|r: &Range<usize>| offset < r.end as u64 && end > r.start as u64)
            {
                return Err(error());
            }
            levels.push(offset as usize..end as usize);
            gpu_bytes += expected;
        }
        Ok(Self {
            bytes,
            edge,
            vk_format: format,
            levels,
            gpu_bytes,
        })
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/land_cover.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="65" bytes="2529" original_lines="65" original_bytes="2529" minified="false" sha256="7076b189d7ea8ee460a8a0f3f06270a86157f6c8ee6572d5bd327663d40f9671">>>
//! Two-minute fractional ESA WorldCover grid. Missing cells retain a validity mask.
pub const WIDTH: usize = 10_800;
pub const HEIGHT: usize = 5_400;
pub const CHANNELS: usize = 7;
pub const BYTES: usize = 16 + WIDTH * HEIGHT * CHANNELS;

pub struct LandCover<'a> {
    bytes: &'a [u8],
}

impl<'a> LandCover<'a> {
    pub fn parse(bytes: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
        if bytes.len() != BYTES
            || &bytes[..8] != b"MMWC21\0\0"
            || u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[8..12].try_into().unwrap()) != WIDTH as u32
            || u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[12..16].try_into().unwrap()) != HEIGHT as u32
        {
            return Err("invalid WorldCover fractional grid");
        }
        Ok(Self { bytes })
    }

    /// Interpolate fractions across the antimeridian; return None only for no data.
    pub fn sample(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 6]> {
        let length = direction.iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
        if !length.is_finite() || length < 1e-12 {
            return None;
        }
        let latitude = (direction[1] / length).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
        let longitude = direction[2].atan2(direction[0]);
        let x = (longitude / std::f64::consts::TAU + 0.5) * WIDTH as f64 - 0.5;
        let y = (0.5 - latitude / std::f64::consts::PI) * HEIGHT as f64 - 0.5;
        let mut result = [0.0; 6];
        let mut valid = 0.0;
        for dy in 0..2 {
            for dx in 0..2 {
                let column = (x.floor() as i64 + dx).rem_euclid(WIDTH as i64) as usize;
                let row = (y.floor() as i64 + dy).clamp(0, HEIGHT as i64 - 1) as usize;
                let i = 16 + (row * WIDTH + column) * CHANNELS;
                let weight = (if dx == 0 {
                    1.0 - (x - x.floor())
                } else {
                    x - x.floor()
                }) * (if dy == 0 {
                    1.0 - (y - y.floor())
                } else {
                    y - y.floor()
                });
                let weight = weight as f32 * f32::from(self.bytes[i + 6]) / 255.0;
                valid += weight;
                for (channel, v) in result.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                    *v += f32::from(self.bytes[i + channel]) / 255.0 * weight;
                }
            }
        }
        let sum: f32 = result.iter().sum();
        if valid < 1e-6 || sum < 1e-6 {
            return None;
        }
        for value in &mut result {
            *value /= sum;
        }
        Some(result)
    }
}
