<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/map.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="202" bytes="9027" original_lines="202" original_bytes="9027" minified="false" sha256="7fb84e503eb69c9d9e0129df260b16edac6c0404d558c4cf5d165c213bded35b">>>
use crate::obj::{parse_map_vec3, parse_mesh_asset_path, parse_obj_triangles, ObjMeshOptions};
use minimium_world::world::{
    triangle_area_squared, MapBox, MapTriangle, WorldMap, MAX_MAP_BOXES, MAX_MAP_TRIANGLES,
};
use std::path::Path;

pub const MAX_MAP_MESHES: usize = 64;
pub const MAX_MAP_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_MESH_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_MAP_TOTAL_MESH_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
pub(super) const MAX_MESH_VERTICES: usize = 262_144;
pub(super) const MAX_OBJ_FACE_VERTICES: usize = 128;

pub fn parse_map(source: &str) -> Result<WorldMap, String> {
    parse_map_with_mesh_loader(source, |_path, _| {
        Err("mesh records require file-based map loading".into())
    })
}

pub fn parse_map_with_mesh_loader(
    source: &str,
    mut load_mesh: impl FnMut(&Path, usize) -> Result<String, String>,
) -> Result<WorldMap, String> {
    if source.len() > MAX_MAP_BYTES {
        return Err(format!("map exceeds {MAX_MAP_BYTES} bytes"));
    }
    let mut content_lines = source.lines().enumerate().filter_map(|(index, line)| {
        let content = line.split('#').next().unwrap_or("").trim();
        (!content.is_empty()).then_some((index + 1, content))
    });
    let Some((header_line, header)) = content_lines.next() else {
        return Err("map is empty".into());
    };
    let format_version = match header {
        "MINIMIUM_MAP 1" => 1,
        "MINIMIUM_MAP 2" => 2,
        _ => {
            return Err(format!(
                "line {header_line}: expected `MINIMIUM_MAP 1` or `MINIMIUM_MAP 2`"
            ))
        }
    };

    let mut spawn = None;
    let mut boxes = Vec::new();
    let mut triangles = Vec::new();
    let mut mesh_count = 0usize;
    let mut total_mesh_bytes = 0usize;
    for (line_number, line) in content_lines {
        let fields: Vec<_> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
        match fields.first().copied() {
            Some("spawn") if fields.len() == 4 => {
                if spawn.is_some() {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: duplicate spawn"));
                }
                spawn = Some(parse_map_vec3(&fields[1..4], line_number, "spawn")?);
            }
            Some("box") if fields.len() == 11 => {
                if boxes.len() >= MAX_MAP_BOXES {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: map exceeds {MAX_MAP_BOXES} boxes"
                    ));
                }
                let center = parse_map_vec3(&fields[1..4], line_number, "box center")?;
                let size = parse_map_vec3(&fields[4..7], line_number, "box size")?;
                let color = parse_map_vec3(&fields[7..10], line_number, "box color")?;
                if size.iter().any(|value| *value <= 0.0) {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: box sizes must be positive"));
                }
                if color.iter().any(|value| !(0.0..=1.0).contains(value)) {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: box colors must be in 0..=1"));
                }
                let solid = match fields[10] {
                    "solid" => true,
                    "visual" => false,
                    _ => return Err(format!("line {line_number}: expected `solid` or `visual`")),
                };
                boxes.push(MapBox {
                    center,
                    size,
                    color,
                    solid,
                });
            }
            Some("triangle")
                if format_version >= 2 && (fields.len() == 13 || fields.len() == 14) =>
            {
                if triangles.len() >= MAX_MAP_TRIANGLES {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: map exceeds {MAX_MAP_TRIANGLES} triangles"
                    ));
                }
                let vertices = [
                    parse_map_vec3(&fields[1..4], line_number, "triangle vertex")?,
                    parse_map_vec3(&fields[4..7], line_number, "triangle vertex")?,
                    parse_map_vec3(&fields[7..10], line_number, "triangle vertex")?,
                ];
                let color = parse_map_vec3(&fields[10..13], line_number, "triangle color")?;
                if color.iter().any(|value| !(0.0..=1.0).contains(value)) {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: triangle colors must be in 0..=1"
                    ));
                }
                let area_squared = triangle_area_squared(vertices);
                if area_squared <= 1.0e-12 {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: triangle vertices are degenerate"
                    ));
                }
                let solid = if fields.len() == 14 {
                    match fields[13] {
                        "solid" => true,
                        "visual" => false,
                        _ => {
                            return Err(format!("line {line_number}: expected `solid` or `visual`"))
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    false
                };
                triangles.push(MapTriangle {
                    vertices,
                    precise_vertices: None,
                    color,
                    solid,
                });
            }
            Some("triangle") => {
                return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: invalid `triangle` record; triangles require map version 2"
                    ));
            }
            Some("mesh") if format_version < 2 => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "line {line_number}: mesh records require map version 2"
                ));
            }
            Some("mesh") if fields.len() == 12 => {
                if mesh_count >= MAX_MAP_MESHES {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: map exceeds {MAX_MAP_MESHES} mesh assets"
                    ));
                }
                let asset_path = parse_mesh_asset_path(fields[1], line_number)?;
                let translation = parse_map_vec3(&fields[2..5], line_number, "mesh translation")?;
                let scale = parse_map_vec3(&fields[5..8], line_number, "mesh scale")?;
                let color = parse_map_vec3(&fields[8..11], line_number, "mesh color")?;
                if scale.iter().any(|value| *value <= 0.0) {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: mesh scale components must be positive"
                    ));
                }
                if color.iter().any(|value| !(0.0..=1.0).contains(value)) {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: mesh colors must be in 0..=1"));
                }
                let solid = match fields[11] {
                    "solid" => true,
                    "visual" => false,
                    _ => return Err(format!("line {line_number}: expected `solid` or `visual`")),
                };
                let remaining_mesh_bytes =
                    MAX_MAP_TOTAL_MESH_BYTES.saturating_sub(total_mesh_bytes);
                let mesh_source = load_mesh(&asset_path, MAX_MESH_BYTES.min(remaining_mesh_bytes))
                    .map_err(|error| format!("line {line_number}: {error}"))?;
                let mesh_bytes = parse_obj_triangles(
                    &mesh_source,
                    &asset_path,
                    ObjMeshOptions {
                        translation,
                        scale,
                        color,
                        solid,
                    },
                    remaining_mesh_bytes,
                    &mut triangles,
                )
                .map_err(|error| format!("line {line_number}: {error}"))?;
                total_mesh_bytes = total_mesh_bytes.saturating_add(mesh_bytes);
                mesh_count += 1;
            }
            Some("mesh") => {
                return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: invalid `mesh` record; expected `mesh PATH TX TY TZ SX SY SZ R G B solid|visual`"
                    ));
            }
            Some("spawn") | Some("box") => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "line {line_number}: invalid `{}` record",
                    fields[0]
                ));
            }
            Some(_) => return Err(format!("line {line_number}: unknown map record")),
            None => unreachable!(),
        }
    }

    let spawn = spawn.ok_or("map is missing a spawn record")?;
    if boxes.is_empty() && triangles.is_empty() {
        return Err("map must contain at least one box or triangle".into());
    }
    WorldMap::from_parts(spawn, boxes, triangles)
}
<<<END_FILE>>>

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/obj.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="397" bytes="15111" original_lines="397" original_bytes="15111" minified="false" sha256="737d99e06f348743984be703f1c0643c779489730950c6c0e86ce0775d367f4e">>>
use super::map::{
    MAX_MAP_TOTAL_MESH_BYTES, MAX_MESH_BYTES, MAX_MESH_VERTICES, MAX_OBJ_FACE_VERTICES,
};
use minimium_world::world::triangle_area_squared;
use minimium_world::world::{MapTriangle, MAX_MAP_COORDINATE, MAX_MAP_TRIANGLES};
use std::path::{Component, Path};

pub(super) fn parse_mesh_asset_path(
    value: &str,
    line_number: usize,
) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, String> {
    let path = Path::new(value);
    if value.is_empty()
        || path.is_absolute()
        || path
            .components()
            .any(|component| !matches!(component, Component::Normal(_)))
    {
        return Err(format!(
            "line {line_number}: mesh path must be relative and cannot contain `.` or `..` components"
        ));
    }
    Ok(path.to_path_buf())
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct ObjMeshOptions {
    pub translation: [f32; 3],
    pub scale: [f32; 3],
    pub color: [f32; 3],
    pub solid: bool,
}

pub fn parse_obj_triangles(
    source: &str,
    asset_path: &Path,
    options: ObjMeshOptions,
    remaining_map_bytes: usize,
    triangles: &mut Vec<MapTriangle>,
) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let ObjMeshOptions {
        translation,
        scale,
        color,
        solid,
    } = options;
    let byte_limit = MAX_MESH_BYTES.min(remaining_map_bytes);
    if byte_limit == 0 {
        return Err(format!(
            "map mesh assets exceed {MAX_MAP_TOTAL_MESH_BYTES} bytes"
        ));
    }
    if source.len() > byte_limit {
        if remaining_map_bytes < MAX_MESH_BYTES {
            return Err(format!(
                "map mesh assets exceed {MAX_MAP_TOTAL_MESH_BYTES} bytes"
            ));
        }
        return Err(format!(
            "mesh asset `{}` exceeds {MAX_MESH_BYTES} bytes",
            asset_path.display()
        ));
    }

    let mut vertices = Vec::<[f32; 3]>::with_capacity(1024);
    let mut added_triangles = 0usize;
    for (index, line) in source.lines().enumerate() {
        let line_number = index + 1;
        let content = line.split('#').next().unwrap_or("").trim();
        if content.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let fields: Vec<_> = content.split_whitespace().collect();
        match fields[0] {
            "v" if fields.len() >= 4 => {
                if vertices.len() >= MAX_MESH_VERTICES {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "mesh asset `{}` exceeds {MAX_MESH_VERTICES} vertices",
                        asset_path.display()
                    ));
                }
                let mut vertex = [0.0; 3];
                for axis in 0..3 {
                    vertex[axis] = fields[axis + 1].parse::<f32>().map_err(|_| {
                        format!(
                            "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: invalid vertex coordinate",
                            asset_path.display()
                        )
                    })?;
                    if !vertex[axis].is_finite() || vertex[axis].abs() > MAX_MAP_COORDINATE {
                        return Err(format!(
                            "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: vertex is outside supported range",
                            asset_path.display()
                        ));
                    }
                }
                vertices.push(vertex);
            }
            "v" => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: vertex requires three coordinates",
                    asset_path.display()
                ));
            }
            "f" if fields.len() >= 4 => {
                let face_vertex_count = fields.len() - 1;
                if face_vertex_count > MAX_OBJ_FACE_VERTICES {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: face exceeds {MAX_OBJ_FACE_VERTICES} vertices",
                        asset_path.display()
                    ));
                }
                let mut polygon = Vec::with_capacity(face_vertex_count);
                for field in fields.iter().skip(1) {
                    polygon.push(parse_obj_vertex_index(field, vertices.len()).map_err(|_| {
                        format!(
                            "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: invalid face vertex index",
                            asset_path.display()
                        )
                    })?);
                }
                let face_triangles =
                    triangulate_obj_face(&vertices, &polygon).map_err(|reason| {
                        format!(
                        "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: cannot triangulate face ({reason})",
                        asset_path.display()
                    )
                    })?;
                for face_triangle in face_triangles {
                    if triangles.len() >= MAX_MAP_TRIANGLES {
                        return Err(format!("map exceeds {MAX_MAP_TRIANGLES} triangles"));
                    }
                    let local_vertices = face_triangle.map(|index| vertices[index]);
                    let world_vertices = local_vertices.map(|vertex| {
                        [
                            vertex[0] * scale[0] + translation[0],
                            vertex[1] * scale[1] + translation[1],
                            vertex[2] * scale[2] + translation[2],
                        ]
                    });
                    if world_vertices
                        .iter()
                        .flatten()
                        .any(|value| !value.is_finite() || value.abs() > MAX_MAP_COORDINATE)
                    {
                        return Err(format!(
                            "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: transformed vertex is outside supported range",
                            asset_path.display()
                        ));
                    }
                    if triangle_area_squared(world_vertices) <= 1.0e-12 {
                        return Err(format!(
                            "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: face creates a degenerate triangle",
                            asset_path.display()
                        ));
                    }
                    triangles.push(MapTriangle {
                        vertices: world_vertices,
                        precise_vertices: None,
                        color,
                        solid,
                    });
                    added_triangles += 1;
                }
            }
            "f" => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: face requires at least three vertices",
                    asset_path.display()
                ));
            }
            "vt" | "vn" | "o" | "g" | "s" | "usemtl" | "mtllib" | "l" | "p" => {}
            _ => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "mesh asset `{}` line {line_number}: unsupported OBJ record `{}`",
                    asset_path.display(),
                    fields[0]
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    if added_triangles == 0 {
        return Err(format!(
            "mesh asset `{}` contains no faces",
            asset_path.display()
        ));
    }
    Ok(source.len())
}

pub(super) fn parse_obj_vertex_index(field: &str, vertex_count: usize) -> Result<usize, ()> {
    let raw = field
        .split('/')
        .next()
        .unwrap_or("")
        .parse::<i64>()
        .map_err(|_| ())?;
    if raw == 0 {
        return Err(());
    }
    let resolved = if raw > 0 {
        raw - 1
    } else {
        i64::try_from(vertex_count).map_err(|_| ())? + raw
    };
    usize::try_from(resolved)
        .ok()
        .filter(|index| *index < vertex_count)
        .ok_or(())
}

pub(super) fn triangulate_obj_face(
    vertices: &[[f32; 3]],
    face: &[usize],
) -> Result<Vec<[usize; 3]>, &'static str> {
    if face.len() < 3 {
        return Err("face has fewer than three vertices");
    }

    let mut normal = [0.0f64; 3];
    for index in 0..face.len() {
        let current = vertices[face[index]].map(f64::from);
        let next = vertices[face[(index + 1) % face.len()]].map(f64::from);
        normal[0] += (current[1] - next[1]) * (current[2] + next[2]);
        normal[1] += (current[2] - next[2]) * (current[0] + next[0]);
        normal[2] += (current[0] - next[0]) * (current[1] + next[1]);
    }
    let normal_length =
        (normal[0] * normal[0] + normal[1] * normal[1] + normal[2] * normal[2]).sqrt();
    if !normal_length.is_finite() || normal_length <= 1.0e-12 {
        return Err("face has no stable plane");
    }
    let unit_normal = normal.map(|value| value / normal_length);
    let anchor = vertices[face[0]].map(f64::from);
    let mut extent: f64 = 0.0;
    for index in face {
        let vertex = vertices[*index].map(f64::from);
        let delta = [
            vertex[0] - anchor[0],
            vertex[1] - anchor[1],
            vertex[2] - anchor[2],
        ];
        extent = extent
            .max(delta[0].abs())
            .max(delta[1].abs())
            .max(delta[2].abs());
        let distance =
            delta[0] * unit_normal[0] + delta[1] * unit_normal[1] + delta[2] * unit_normal[2];
        if distance.abs() > 1.0e-4 * extent.max(1.0) {
            return Err("face is not planar");
        }
    }

    let drop_axis = if unit_normal[0].abs() >= unit_normal[1].abs()
        && unit_normal[0].abs() >= unit_normal[2].abs()
    {
        0
    } else if unit_normal[1].abs() >= unit_normal[2].abs() {
        1
    } else {
        2
    };
    let projected: Vec<[f64; 2]> = face
        .iter()
        .map(|index| {
            let vertex = vertices[*index].map(f64::from);
            match drop_axis {
                0 => [vertex[1], vertex[2]],
                1 => [vertex[0], vertex[2]],
                _ => [vertex[0], vertex[1]],
            }
        })
        .collect();
    let scale = extent.max(1.0);
    let epsilon = scale * scale * 1.0e-12;

    for first in 0..projected.len() {
        for second in first + 1..projected.len() {
            let delta_x = projected[first][0] - projected[second][0];
            let delta_y = projected[first][1] - projected[second][1];
            if delta_x * delta_x + delta_y * delta_y <= epsilon {
                return Err("face contains duplicate vertices");
            }
        }
    }

    let signed_area: f64 = (0..projected.len())
        .map(|index| {
            let current = projected[index];
            let next = projected[(index + 1) % projected.len()];
            current[0] * next[1] - next[0] * current[1]
        })
        .sum();
    if signed_area.abs() <= epsilon {
        return Err("face has zero area");
    }
    let orientation = signed_area.signum();

    let mut active: Vec<usize> = (0..face.len()).collect();
    let mut removed_collinear = true;
    while removed_collinear && active.len() > 3 {
        removed_collinear = false;
        for cursor in 0..active.len() {
            let previous = active[(cursor + active.len() - 1) % active.len()];
            let current = active[cursor];
            let next = active[(cursor + 1) % active.len()];
            let incoming = [
                projected[current][0] - projected[previous][0],
                projected[current][1] - projected[previous][1],
            ];
            let outgoing = [
                projected[next][0] - projected[current][0],
                projected[next][1] - projected[current][1],
            ];
            let turn = incoming[0] * outgoing[1] - incoming[1] * outgoing[0];
            if turn.abs() <= epsilon {
                let direction = incoming[0] * outgoing[0] + incoming[1] * outgoing[1];
                if direction < -epsilon {
                    return Err("face boundary doubles back");
                }
                active.remove(cursor);
                removed_collinear = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    let mut result = Vec::with_capacity(active.len().saturating_sub(2));
    while active.len() > 3 {
        let mut clipped = false;
        for cursor in 0..active.len() {
            let previous = active[(cursor + active.len() - 1) % active.len()];
            let current = active[cursor];
            let next = active[(cursor + 1) % active.len()];
            let a = projected[previous];
            let b = projected[current];
            let c = projected[next];
            let turn = (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - b[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - b[0]);
            if turn * orientation <= epsilon {
                continue;
            }

            let contains_vertex = active.iter().copied().any(|candidate| {
                if candidate == previous || candidate == current || candidate == next {
                    return false;
                }
                let point = projected[candidate];
                let ab = (b[0] - a[0]) * (point[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (point[0] - a[0]);
                let bc = (c[0] - b[0]) * (point[1] - b[1]) - (c[1] - b[1]) * (point[0] - b[0]);
                let ca = (a[0] - c[0]) * (point[1] - c[1]) - (a[1] - c[1]) * (point[0] - c[0]);
                ab * orientation >= -epsilon
                    && bc * orientation >= -epsilon
                    && ca * orientation >= -epsilon
            });
            if contains_vertex {
                continue;
            }

            result.push([face[previous], face[current], face[next]]);
            active.remove(cursor);
            clipped = true;
            break;
        }
        if !clipped {
            return Err("face is self-intersecting or numerically unstable");
        }
    }
    let last = [face[active[0]], face[active[1]], face[active[2]]];
    let a = projected[active[0]];
    let b = projected[active[1]];
    let c = projected[active[2]];
    let final_turn = (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0]);
    if final_turn * orientation <= epsilon {
        return Err("remaining polygon is degenerate");
    }
    result.push(last);
    Ok(result)
}

pub(super) fn parse_map_vec3(
    fields: &[&str],
    line_number: usize,
    name: &str,
) -> Result<[f32; 3], String> {
    let mut values = [0.0; 3];
    for (index, field) in fields.iter().enumerate() {
        values[index] = field
            .parse::<f32>()
            .map_err(|_| format!("line {line_number}: invalid {name}"))?;
        if !values[index].is_finite() || values[index].abs() > MAX_MAP_COORDINATE {
            return Err(format!(
                "line {line_number}: {name} is outside supported range"
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(values)
}

mod format;
mod record;

mod identity {
    include!("sky_catalog/identity.generated.rs");

use std::{error::Error, fmt, sync::OnceLock};

pub use record::{StarCatalogue, StarRecord};

static EMBEDDED_CATALOGUE: OnceLock<Result<StarCatalogue, CatalogError>> = OnceLock::new();
static EMBEDDED_BYTES: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../data/sky/stars-v1.bin");
static EMBEDDED_LABELS: &str = include_str!("../data/sky/star-labels-v1.tsv");
static PARSED_LABELS: OnceLock<Result<Box<[&'static str]>, CatalogError>> = OnceLock::new();

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SkyCatalogIdentity {
    pub catalogue_id: u32,
    pub sha256: [u8; 32],
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CatalogError {
    Length,
    Magic,
    UnsupportedSchema,
    IdentityMismatch,
    DigestMismatch,
    InvalidRecord {
        index: u32,
        reason: InvalidRecordReason,
    },
    InvalidCount,
    InvalidLabels,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum InvalidRecordReason {
    ZeroId,
    DuplicateId,
    NonFiniteMagnitude,
    MagnitudeOrder,
    NonFiniteColor,
    NonFinitePosition,
    ZeroPosition,
    NonFiniteVelocity,
}

impl fmt::Display for CatalogError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Length => formatter.write_str("sky catalogue has an invalid length"),
            Self::Magic => formatter.write_str("sky catalogue magic is invalid"),
            Self::UnsupportedSchema => formatter.write_str("sky catalogue schema is unsupported"),
            Self::IdentityMismatch => formatter.write_str("sky catalogue identity does not match"),
            Self::DigestMismatch => formatter.write_str("sky catalogue digest does not match"),
            Self::InvalidRecord { index, reason } => {
                write!(
                    formatter,
                    "sky catalogue record {index} is invalid: {reason:?}"
                )
            }
            Self::InvalidCount => {
                formatter.write_str("sky catalogue must contain exactly 1000 records")
            }
            Self::InvalidLabels => {
                formatter.write_str("sky catalogue labels do not match its records")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Error for CatalogError {}

pub fn embedded_sky_catalog_identity() -> SkyCatalogIdentity {
    SkyCatalogIdentity {
        catalogue_id: identity::CATALOGUE_ID,
        sha256: identity::ASSET_SHA256,
    }
}

pub fn embedded_sky_catalog() -> Result<&'static StarCatalogue, CatalogError> {
    match EMBEDDED_CATALOGUE.get_or_init(|| format::decode(EMBEDDED_BYTES)) {
        Ok(catalogue) => Ok(catalogue),
        Err(error) => Err(*error),
    }
}

pub fn embedded_star_labels() -> Result<&'static [&'static str], CatalogError> {
    match PARSED_LABELS.get_or_init(|| {
        let catalogue = embedded_sky_catalog()?;
        let labels = EMBEDDED_LABELS.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if labels.len() != catalogue.records().len() {
            return Err(CatalogError::InvalidLabels);
        }
        labels
            .into_iter()
            .zip(catalogue.records())
            .map(|(line, record)| {
                let (id, label) = line.split_once('\t').ok_or(CatalogError::InvalidLabels)?;
                if id.parse::<u32>().ok() != Some(record.hyg_id) || label.is_empty() {
                    return Err(CatalogError::InvalidLabels);
                }
                Ok(label)
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .map(Vec::into_boxed_slice)
    }) {
        Ok(labels) => Ok(labels),
        Err(error) => Err(*error),
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/sky_catalog/format.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="145" bytes="5266" original_lines="145" original_bytes="5266" minified="false" sha256="38daeef39c00cf54b6153d38bc27cb5efd829a105a80e24185f3dc8dcb5f41f8">>>
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

use super::record::{StarCatalogue, StarRecord};
use super::{identity, CatalogError, InvalidRecordReason};

const HEADER_BYTES: usize = 96;
const RECORD_BYTES: usize = 64;
const RECORD_COUNT: usize = 1000;

pub(super) fn decode(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<StarCatalogue, CatalogError> {
    if bytes.len() != HEADER_BYTES + RECORD_COUNT * RECORD_BYTES {
        return Err(CatalogError::Length);
    }
    if bytes.get(0..8) != Some(b"MNSKY1K0") {
        return Err(CatalogError::Magic);
    }
    if read_u16(bytes, 8)? != 1
        || usize::from(read_u16(bytes, 10)?) != RECORD_BYTES
        || read_u32(bytes, 20)? != 0
        || read_f64(bytes, 24)? != 2000.0
    {
        return Err(CatalogError::UnsupportedSchema);
    }
    if read_u32(bytes, 12)? != identity::CATALOGUE_ID
        || bytes.get(32..64) != Some(&identity::SOURCE_CSV_SHA256)
    {
        return Err(CatalogError::IdentityMismatch);
    }
    if read_u32(bytes, 16)? != RECORD_COUNT as u32 {
        return Err(CatalogError::InvalidCount);
    }
    let payload_digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&bytes[HEADER_BYTES..]).into();
    if bytes.get(64..96) != Some(&payload_digest) {
        return Err(CatalogError::DigestMismatch);
    }
    let asset_digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(bytes).into();
    if asset_digest != identity::ASSET_SHA256 {
        return Err(CatalogError::DigestMismatch);
    }

    let mut records = Vec::with_capacity(RECORD_COUNT);
    let mut seen_ids = std::collections::HashSet::with_capacity(RECORD_COUNT);
    let mut previous_magnitude = None;
    for index in 0..RECORD_COUNT {
        let offset = HEADER_BYTES + index * RECORD_BYTES;
        let record = decode_record(bytes, offset)?;
        if record.hyg_id == 0 {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::ZeroId);
        }
        if !seen_ids.insert(record.hyg_id) {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::DuplicateId);
        }
        if !record.apparent_v_mag.is_finite() {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::NonFiniteMagnitude);
        }
        if previous_magnitude.is_some_and(|previous| record.apparent_v_mag < previous) {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::MagnitudeOrder);
        }
        previous_magnitude = Some(record.apparent_v_mag);
        if !record.color_index_bv.is_finite() {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::NonFiniteColor);
        }
        if !record.position_eqj_pc.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::NonFinitePosition);
        }
        let position_length = record.position_eqj_pc[0]
            .hypot(record.position_eqj_pc[1])
            .hypot(record.position_eqj_pc[2]);
        if position_length == 0.0 {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::ZeroPosition);
        }
        if !record
            .velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear
            .iter()
            .all(|value| value.is_finite())
        {
            return invalid(index, InvalidRecordReason::NonFiniteVelocity);
        }
        records.push(record);
    }
    Ok(StarCatalogue::new(records))
}

fn decode_record(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Result<StarRecord, CatalogError> {
    let record = bytes
        .get(offset..offset + RECORD_BYTES)
        .ok_or(CatalogError::Length)?;
    let mut position = [0.0; 3];
    let mut velocity = [0.0; 3];
    for axis in 0..3 {
        position[axis] = read_f64(record, 16 + axis * 8)?;
        velocity[axis] = read_f64(record, 40 + axis * 8)?;
    }
    Ok(StarRecord {
        hyg_id: read_u32(record, 0)?,
        hip_id: read_u32(record, 4)?,
        apparent_v_mag: read_f32(record, 8)?,
        color_index_bv: read_f32(record, 12)?,
        position_eqj_pc: position,
        velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear: velocity,
    })
}

fn invalid<T>(index: usize, reason: InvalidRecordReason) -> Result<T, CatalogError> {
    Err(CatalogError::InvalidRecord {
        index: index as u32,
        reason,
    })
}

fn read_u16(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Result<u16, CatalogError> {
    let data: [u8; 2] = bytes
        .get(offset..offset + 2)
        .ok_or(CatalogError::Length)?
        .try_into()
        .map_err(|_| CatalogError::Length)?;
    Ok(u16::from_le_bytes(data))
}

fn read_u32(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Result<u32, CatalogError> {
    let data: [u8; 4] = bytes
        .get(offset..offset + 4)
        .ok_or(CatalogError::Length)?
        .try_into()
        .map_err(|_| CatalogError::Length)?;
    Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(data))
}

fn read_f32(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Result<f32, CatalogError> {
    let data: [u8; 4] = bytes
        .get(offset..offset + 4)
        .ok_or(CatalogError::Length)?
        .try_into()
        .map_err(|_| CatalogError::Length)?;
    Ok(f32::from_le_bytes(data))
}

fn read_f64(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Result<f64, CatalogError> {
    let data: [u8; 8] = bytes
        .get(offset..offset + 8)
        .ok_or(CatalogError::Length)?
        .try_into()
        .map_err(|_| CatalogError::Length)?;
    Ok(f64::from_le_bytes(data))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/terrain_material.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="110" bytes="3836" original_lines="110" original_bytes="3836" minified="false" sha256="b43be139369c3a825cc1d898fab48090cded9c1ae994e03e913614b9e0fe241a">>>
//! Bounded data-only terrain material packages. No executable mod content.
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

pub const MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
pub const MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES: u64 = 512 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const ROLES: [&str; 6] = ["sand", "soil", "grass", "litter", "rock", "snow"];

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MaterialFile {
    pub name: String,
    pub bytes: u64,
    pub sha256: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MaterialVariant {
    pub edge: u32,
    pub compressed: bool,
    /// Six-layer arrays: sRGB albedo, tangent normal, roughness/AO/height/reflectance.
    pub maps: [MaterialFile; 3],
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct MaterialManifest {
    pub version: u32,
    pub roles: [String; 6],
    pub meters_per_tile: [f32; 6],
    pub height_blend: f32,
    pub variants: [MaterialVariant; 2],
}

impl MaterialManifest {
    pub fn parse(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, String> {
        if bytes.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES {
            return Err("material manifest too large".into());
        }
        let text = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let manifest: Self = ron::from_str(text).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        manifest.validate()?;
        Ok(manifest)
    }

    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.version != 1
            || self.roles.iter().map(String::as_str).ne(ROLES)
            || self
                .meters_per_tile
                .iter()
                .any(|v| !v.is_finite() || !(0.05..=100.0).contains(v))
            || !self.height_blend.is_finite()
            || !(0.01..=1.0).contains(&self.height_blend)
        {
            return Err("invalid material roles, version or blending parameters".into());
        }
        let mut names = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for (variant, edge) in self.variants.iter().zip([4096, 2048]) {
            if variant.edge != edge || variant.compressed != (edge == 4096) {
                return Err("expected BC 4096 and RGBA 2048 variants".into());
            }
            let mut bytes = 0_u64;
            for file in &variant.maps {
                if file.name.is_empty()
                    || file.name.len() > 128
                    || !file
                        .name
                        .bytes()
                        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"-_.".contains(&c))
                    || file.name.starts_with('.')
                    || !file.name.ends_with(".ktx2")
                    || !names.insert(file.name.as_str())
                    || file.bytes == 0
                    || file.bytes > MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES
                    || decode_hash(&file.sha256).is_err()
                {
                    return Err("invalid material file".into());
                }
                bytes = bytes
                    .checked_add(file.bytes)
                    .ok_or("material size overflow")?;
            }
            if bytes > MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES {
                return Err("material download budget exceeded".into());
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(bytes))
}

pub fn decode_hash(text: &str) -> Result<[u8; 32], String> {
    if text.len() != 64
        || !text
            .bytes()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&c))
    {
        return Err("invalid SHA-256".into());
    }
    let mut bytes = [0; 32];
    for (i, b) in bytes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        *b = u8::from_str_radix(&text[i * 2..i * 2 + 2], 16).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/tests.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="60" bytes="2102" original_lines="60" original_bytes="2102" minified="false" sha256="d0711d1c933e1f1dca3f55cf374b78c8c0d72e5c1d1db180b029186fd8352dc8">>>
use crate::parse_world_definition;
use minimium_world::world::{DungeonTile, WorldTopology};

fn definition_text() -> String {
    let digest = "00".repeat(32);
    let mut source = format!(
        "MINIMIUM_WORLD_DEFINITION 1\nmanifest 8 dungeon 99 1 10 1 {digest}\ndungeon 48 40\n"
    );
    for x in [2, 10, 18, 26, 34] {
        source.push_str(&format!("room {} {x} 2 3 3 {} 3\n", x + 1, x + 1));
    }
    for y in 0..40 {
        for x in 0..48 {
            let room = [2, 10, 18, 26, 34]
                .into_iter()
                .any(|origin| (origin..origin + 3).contains(&x) && (2..5).contains(&y));
            let corridor = y == 3 && (5..=36).contains(&x);
            let tile = match if room {
                DungeonTile::Room
            } else if corridor {
                DungeonTile::Corridor
            } else {
                DungeonTile::Void
            } {
                DungeonTile::Void => "void",
                DungeonTile::Room => "room",
                DungeonTile::Corridor => "corridor",
            };
            source.push_str(&format!("tile {x} {y} {tile}\n"));
        }
    }
    source
}

#[test]
fn authored_dungeon_round_trips_through_the_shared_blueprint_validator() {
    let definition = parse_world_definition(&definition_text()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(definition.manifest().topology(), WorldTopology::Dungeon);
    assert_eq!(definition.manifest().generation().seed().get(), 99);
    assert_eq!(definition.dungeon().dimensions(), (48, 40));
    assert_eq!(definition.dungeon().rooms().len(), 5);
    assert_ne!(
        definition.dungeon().spawn(),
        definition.dungeon().entrance()
    );
}

#[test]
fn authored_dungeon_rejects_incomplete_and_duplicate_tile_records() {
    let valid = definition_text();
    let incomplete = valid
        .lines()
        .filter(|line| !line.starts_with("tile 47 39 "))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n");
    assert!(parse_world_definition(&incomplete).is_err());

    let duplicate = format!("{valid}tile 0 0 void\n");
    assert!(parse_world_definition(&duplicate).is_err());
}

<<<FILE path="crates/assets/src/world_definition.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="226" bytes="10150" original_lines="226" original_bytes="10150" minified="false" sha256="6d31ec28a475680916c0efc653d30f9397aef11a8c5ce6119db576e2b419f510">>>
use minimium_world::world::{DungeonBlueprint, DungeonRoom, DungeonTile};
use minimium_world::world::{
    GenerationRevision, GenerationSpec, GeneratorDigest, ObjectOriginId, WorldContentRevision,
    WorldDefinitionId, WorldManifest, WorldSeed, WorldTopology,
};
pub const MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION: u16 = 128;
const MAX_DUNGEON_TILES: usize = MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION as usize * MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION as usize;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct WorldDefinition {
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    dungeon: DungeonBlueprint,
}

impl WorldDefinition {
    pub const fn manifest(&self) -> WorldManifest {
        self.manifest
    }

    pub fn dungeon(&self) -> &DungeonBlueprint {
        &self.dungeon
    }
}

/// Parses a manifest and a manually authored dungeon into the same validated
/// blueprint consumed by the procedural materializer.
pub fn parse_world_definition(source: &str) -> Result<WorldDefinition, String> {
    if source.len() > MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES {
        return Err(format!(
            "world definition exceeds {MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES} bytes"
        ));
    }
    let mut lines = source.lines().enumerate().filter_map(|(index, line)| {
        let content = line.split('#').next().unwrap_or("").trim();
        (!content.is_empty()).then_some((index + 1, content))
    });
    let Some((line_number, header)) = lines.next() else {
        return Err("world definition is empty".into());
    };
    if header != "MINIMIUM_WORLD_DEFINITION 1" {
        return Err(format!(
            "line {line_number}: expected `MINIMIUM_WORLD_DEFINITION 1`"
        ));
    }
    let Some((line_number, manifest_line)) = lines.next() else {
        return Err("world definition is missing a manifest".into());
    };
    let manifest = parse_manifest(line_number, manifest_line)?;
    let mut dimensions = None;
    let mut tiles = Vec::new();
    let mut tile_seen = Vec::new();
    let mut rooms = Vec::new();
    let mut record_count = 0usize;
    for (line_number, line) in lines {
        record_count += 1;
        if record_count > MAX_DUNGEON_TILES + 64 {
            return Err("world definition has too many records".into());
        }
        let mut fields = line.split_ascii_whitespace();
        match fields.next() {
            Some("dungeon") if dimensions.is_none() => {
                let width = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "dungeon width")?;
                let height = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "dungeon height")?;
                if fields.next().is_some()
                    || !(3..=MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION).contains(&width)
                    || !(3..=MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION).contains(&height)
                {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: invalid dungeon dimensions"));
                }
                let tile_count = usize::from(width) * usize::from(height);
                dimensions = Some((width, height));
                tiles.resize(tile_count, DungeonTile::Void);
                tile_seen.resize(tile_count, false);
            }
            Some("room") if dimensions.is_some() => {
                if rooms.len() >= 32 {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: too many dungeon rooms"));
                }
                let origin =
                    ObjectOriginId::new(parse_u128(fields.next(), line_number, "room origin ID")?)
                        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line_number}: invalid room origin ID"))?;
                let x = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "room x")?;
                let y = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "room y")?;
                let width = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "room width")?;
                let height = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "room height")?;
                let center_x = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "room center x")?;
                let center_y = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "room center y")?;
                if fields.next().is_some()
                    || rooms
                        .iter()
                        .any(|room: &DungeonRoom| room.origin_id == origin)
                {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: invalid or duplicate room record"
                    ));
                }
                rooms.push(DungeonRoom {
                    origin_id: origin,
                    x,
                    y,
                    width,
                    height,
                    center: [center_x, center_y],
                });
            }
            Some("tile") if dimensions.is_some() => {
                let (width, _) = dimensions.expect("dimension guard established the width");
                let x = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "tile x")?;
                let y = parse_u16(fields.next(), line_number, "tile y")?;
                let tile = match fields.next() {
                    Some("void") => DungeonTile::Void,
                    Some("room") => DungeonTile::Room,
                    Some("corridor") => DungeonTile::Corridor,
                    _ => return Err(format!("line {line_number}: invalid dungeon tile")),
                };
                if fields.next().is_some()
                    || x >= width
                    || usize::from(y) * usize::from(width) + usize::from(x) >= tiles.len()
                {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "line {line_number}: tile is out of bounds or malformed"
                    ));
                }
                let index = usize::from(y) * usize::from(width) + usize::from(x);
                if tile_seen[index] {
                    return Err(format!("line {line_number}: duplicate dungeon tile"));
                }
                tiles[index] = tile;
                tile_seen[index] = true;
            }
            _ => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "line {line_number}: unknown, duplicate, or out-of-order world record"
                ))
            }
        }
    }
    let (width, height) = dimensions.ok_or("world definition is missing dungeon dimensions")?;
    if tiles.len() != usize::from(width) * usize::from(height)
        || tiles.len() > MAX_DUNGEON_TILES
        || tile_seen.iter().any(|seen| !seen)
    {
        return Err("world definition must describe every dungeon tile".into());
    }
    let dungeon = DungeonBlueprint::from_parts(width, height, tiles, rooms)
        .ok_or_else(|| "dungeon rooms or walkable connectivity are invalid".to_owned())?;
    Ok(WorldDefinition { manifest, dungeon })
}

fn parse_manifest(line_number: usize, line: &str) -> Result<WorldManifest, String> {
    let mut fields = line.split_ascii_whitespace();
    if fields.next() != Some("manifest") {
        return Err(format!("line {line_number}: expected a manifest record"));
    }
    let definition =
        WorldDefinitionId::new(parse_u128(fields.next(), line_number, "definition ID")?)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line_number}: invalid definition ID"))?;
    if fields.next() != Some("dungeon") {
        return Err(format!(
            "line {line_number}: manual world topology must be `dungeon`"
        ));
    }
    let seed = parse_u128(fields.next(), line_number, "world seed")?;
    let generation_revision = parse_u32(fields.next(), line_number, "generation revision")?;
    let generation_revision = GenerationRevision::new(generation_revision)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line_number}: generation revision cannot be zero"))?;
    let quantum = parse_u32(fields.next(), line_number, "position quantum")?;
    let generation = GenerationSpec::new(WorldSeed::new(seed), generation_revision, quantum)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line_number}: invalid position quantum"))?;
    let content_revision = parse_u64(fields.next(), line_number, "content revision")?;
    let content_revision = WorldContentRevision::new(content_revision)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line_number}: content revision cannot be zero"))?;
    let digest = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line_number}: missing generator digest"))?;
    if fields.next().is_some()
        || digest.len() != 64
        || !digest.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
    {
        return Err(format!("line {line_number}: invalid manifest record"));
    }
    let mut digest_bytes = [0_u8; 32];
    for (byte, pair) in digest_bytes
        .iter_mut()
        .zip(digest.as_bytes().as_chunks::<2>().0.iter())
    {
        let pair = std::str::from_utf8(pair)
            .map_err(|_| format!("line {line_number}: invalid generator digest"))?;
        *byte = u8::from_str_radix(pair, 16)
            .map_err(|_| format!("line {line_number}: invalid generator digest"))?;
    }
    let digest = GeneratorDigest::new(digest_bytes);
    let manifest = WorldManifest::new(
        definition,
        WorldTopology::Dungeon,
        generation,
        content_revision,
        digest,
    );
    Ok(manifest)
}

fn parse_u16(value: Option<&str>, line: usize, label: &str) -> Result<u16, String> {
    value
        .and_then(|text| text.parse().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line}: invalid {label}"))
}

fn parse_u32(value: Option<&str>, line: usize, label: &str) -> Result<u32, String> {
    value
        .and_then(|text| text.parse().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line}: invalid {label}"))
}

fn parse_u64(value: Option<&str>, line: usize, label: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
    value
        .and_then(|text| text.parse().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line}: invalid {label}"))
}

fn parse_u128(value: Option<&str>, line: usize, label: &str) -> Result<u128, String> {
    value
        .and_then(|text| text.parse().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("line {line}: invalid {label}"))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/astronomy/ffi/bridge.c" plugin="c" lang="c" reason="extension:.c" lines="181" bytes="6210" original_lines="181" original_bytes="6210" minified="false" sha256="53f27bd7a508c5b47f4ffbbb2dd12c70fe5e5d5f1efeefafd3f51ffc7a5dc49c">>>
#include "bridge.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "astronomy.h"

#define BRIDGE_INVALID_TIME (-1)
#define BRIDGE_NONFINITE (-2)
#define BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT (-3)
#define AU_TO_METERS (KM_PER_AU * 1000.0)

static int32_t copy_vector_meters(const astro_vector_t *vector, double output[3])
{
    if (vector->status != ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return (int32_t)vector->status;
    if (!isfinite(vector->x) || !isfinite(vector->y) || !isfinite(vector->z))
        return BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
    output[0] = vector->x * AU_TO_METERS;
    output[1] = vector->y * AU_TO_METERS;
    output[2] = vector->z * AU_TO_METERS;
    if (!isfinite(output[0]) || !isfinite(output[1]) || !isfinite(output[2]))
        return BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
    return (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS;
}

static int32_t create_time(double ut_days, astro_time_t *time)
{
    if (!isfinite(ut_days))
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_TIME;
    *time = Astronomy_TimeFromDays(ut_days);
    if (!isfinite(time->ut) || !isfinite(time->tt))
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_TIME;
    return (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS;
}

int32_t minimium_ae_terrestrial_days(double ut_days, double *tt_days)
{
    astro_time_t time;
    int32_t status;
    if (tt_days == NULL)
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    status = create_time(ut_days, &time);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;
    *tt_days = time.tt;
    return isfinite(*tt_days) ? (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS : BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
}

int32_t minimium_ae_calculate_ephemeris(
    double ut_days,
    minimium_ae_ephemeris_t *output
)
{
    astro_time_t time;
    astro_vector_t sun;
    astro_vector_t moon;
    astro_vector_t earth;
    astro_axis_t axis;
    astro_illum_t illumination;
    astro_angle_result_t phase;
    int32_t status;

    if (output == NULL)
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(*output));
    status = create_time(ut_days, &time);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;

    sun = Astronomy_GeoVector(BODY_SUN, time, ABERRATION);
    status = copy_vector_meters(&sun, output->sun_geocentric_m);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;

    moon = Astronomy_GeoMoon(time);
    status = copy_vector_meters(&moon, output->moon_geocentric_m);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;

    earth = Astronomy_HelioVector(BODY_EARTH, time);
    status = copy_vector_meters(&earth, output->earth_heliocentric_m);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;

    axis = Astronomy_RotationAxis(BODY_MOON, &time);
    if (axis.status != ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return (int32_t)axis.status;
    if (axis.north.status != ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return (int32_t)axis.north.status;
    output->moon_north_eqj[0] = axis.north.x;
    output->moon_north_eqj[1] = axis.north.y;
    output->moon_north_eqj[2] = axis.north.z;

    illumination = Astronomy_Illumination(BODY_MOON, time);
    if (illumination.status != ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return (int32_t)illumination.status;
    output->moon_v_magnitude = illumination.mag;

    phase = Astronomy_MoonPhase(time);
    if (phase.status != ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return (int32_t)phase.status;
    output->ecliptic_phase_degrees = phase.angle;
    output->tt_days = time.tt;

    if (!isfinite(output->moon_north_eqj[0])
        || !isfinite(output->moon_north_eqj[1])
        || !isfinite(output->moon_north_eqj[2])
        || !isfinite(output->moon_v_magnitude)
        || !isfinite(output->ecliptic_phase_degrees)
        || !isfinite(output->tt_days))
        return BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
    return (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS;
}

int32_t minimium_ae_calculate_local_frame(
    double ut_days,
    double latitude_degrees,
    double longitude_degrees,
    double height_meters,
    minimium_ae_local_frame_t *output
)
{
    astro_time_t time;
    astro_observer_t observer;
    astro_vector_t position;
    astro_rotation_t rotation;
    int32_t status;
    int row;
    int column;

    if (output == NULL)
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(*output));
    if (!isfinite(latitude_degrees) || !isfinite(longitude_degrees) || !isfinite(height_meters))
        return BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
    if (latitude_degrees < -90.0 || latitude_degrees > 90.0
        || longitude_degrees < -180.0 || longitude_degrees >= 180.0
        || height_meters < -12000.0 || height_meters > 100000.0)
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    status = create_time(ut_days, &time);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;

    observer = Astronomy_MakeObserver(latitude_degrees, longitude_degrees, height_meters);
    position = Astronomy_ObserverVector(&time, observer, EQUATOR_J2000);
    status = copy_vector_meters(&position, output->observer_geocentric_eqj_m);
    if (status != (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return status;

    rotation = Astronomy_Rotation_EQJ_HOR(&time, observer);
    if (rotation.status != ASTRO_SUCCESS)
        return (int32_t)rotation.status;
    for (row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
    {
        for (column = 0; column < 3; ++column)
        {
            if (!isfinite(rotation.rot[row][column]))
                return BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
            /* Astronomy Engine indexes [input][output]; Rust uses [row][column]. */
            output->eqj_to_hor[row][column] = rotation.rot[column][row];
        }
    }
    output->tt_days = time.tt;
    return isfinite(output->tt_days) ? (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS : BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
}

int32_t minimium_ae_refraction_correction(
    double altitude_degrees,
    double *correction_degrees
)
{
    if (correction_degrees == NULL)
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!isfinite(altitude_degrees))
        return BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
    if (altitude_degrees < -90.0 || altitude_degrees > 90.0)
        return BRIDGE_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    *correction_degrees = Astronomy_Refraction(REFRACTION_NORMAL, altitude_degrees);
    return isfinite(*correction_degrees) ? (int32_t)ASTRO_SUCCESS : BRIDGE_NONFINITE;
}

use std::{marker::PhantomData, rc::Rc};

use minimium_environment::sky::ObserverFrame;
use minimium_environment::time::WorldTimeMs;

use crate::{
    ephemeris_cache::{map_status, EphemerisCache},
    ffi,
    frames::{
        body_state, hor_to_world_matrix, matrix_multiply, matrix_vector, normalize,
        validate_observer, validate_rotation, validate_vector, validate_world_transform,
    },
    lunar::{lunar_geometry, LunarGeometryInput},
    model::{
        CorrectedStarDirections, RefractionMode, SkyError, SkySampleContext, SkyState,
        StarAstrometry, EPHEMERIS_REVISION, MOON_MEAN_RADIUS_M, SUN_RADIUS_M,
    },
    stars::StarEpochCache,
    time::ut_days,
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SkyInvalidation {
    #[default]
    None,
    Reset,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
struct ContextKey {
    clock_revision: minimium_environment::time::ClockRevision,
    world_context_key: crate::model::AstronomyContextKey,
    observer_model_revision: u32,
}

pub struct SkyCalculator {
    ephemeris: EphemerisCache,
    star_epoch: StarEpochCache,
    refraction: RefractionMode,
    context: Option<ContextKey>,
    not_send_or_sync: PhantomData<Rc<()>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SkyCalculatorDiagnostics {
    pub ephemeris_evaluations: u64,
    pub ephemeris_cache_hits: u64,
    pub star_epoch_updates: u64,
    pub star_epoch_cache_hits: u64,
}

impl Default for SkyCalculator {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(RefractionMode::Standard)
    }
}

impl SkyCalculator {
    pub fn new(refraction: RefractionMode) -> Self {
        Self {
            ephemeris: EphemerisCache::default(),
            star_epoch: StarEpochCache::default(),
            refraction,
            context: None,
            not_send_or_sync: PhantomData,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate(
        &mut self,
        sample: SkySampleContext,
        observer: ObserverFrame,
        invalidation: SkyInvalidation,
    ) -> Result<SkyState, SkyError> {
        validate_observer(&observer, sample.observer_model_revision)?;
        let key = ContextKey {
            clock_revision: sample.clock_revision,
            world_context_key: sample.world_context_key,
            observer_model_revision: sample.observer_model_revision,
        };
        let reset = invalidation == SkyInvalidation::Reset || self.context != Some(key);
        if reset {
            self.ephemeris.invalidate();
            self.star_epoch.invalidate();
        }
        self.context = Some(key);

        let values = self.ephemeris.sample(sample, reset)?;
        let ut_days = ut_days(sample.utc_ms)?;
        let local = ffi::local_frame(
            ut_days,
            observer.geographic.latitude_rad().to_degrees(),
            observer.geographic.longitude_rad().to_degrees(),
            observer.geographic.height_m(),
        )
        .map_err(map_status)?;
        if !local.tt_days.is_finite() {
            return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
        }
        let eqj_to_hor = validate_rotation(local.eqj_to_hor)?;
        let hor_to_world = hor_to_world_matrix(&observer);
        let eqj_to_world = validate_world_transform(matrix_multiply(hor_to_world, eqj_to_hor))?;
        let observer_eqj = validate_vector(local.observer_geocentric_eqj_m)?;
        let sun_topocentric = subtract(values.sun_geocentric_m, observer_eqj);
        let moon_topocentric = subtract(values.moon_geocentric_m, observer_eqj);
        let sun_distance_m = crate::frames::length(sun_topocentric);
        let moon_distance_m = crate::frames::length(moon_topocentric);
        if !sun_distance_m.is_finite() || !moon_distance_m.is_finite() {
            return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
        }
        let sun = body_state(
            sun_topocentric,
            sun_distance_m,
            SUN_RADIUS_M,
            eqj_to_hor,
            eqj_to_world,
            &observer,
            self.refraction,
        )?;
        let moon_body = body_state(
            moon_topocentric,
            moon_distance_m,
            MOON_MEAN_RADIUS_M,
            eqj_to_hor,
            eqj_to_world,
            &observer,
            self.refraction,
        )?;
        let moon = lunar_geometry(LunarGeometryInput {
            moon_body,
            moon_geocentric_eqj_m: values.moon_geocentric_m,
            earth_heliocentric_eqj_m: values.earth_heliocentric_m,
            observer_geocentric_eqj_m: observer_eqj,
            moon_north_eqj: values.moon_north_eqj,
            ecliptic_phase_rad: values.ecliptic_phase_rad,
            apparent_v_magnitude: values.moon_v_magnitude,
            eqj_to_world,
        })?;
        let geocentric_sun_direction_world = normalize(matrix_vector(
            eqj_to_world,
            normalize(values.sun_geocentric_m)?,
        ))?;
        let geocentric_moon_position_world_m =
            validate_vector(matrix_vector(eqj_to_world, values.moon_geocentric_m))?;
        Ok(SkyState {
            utc_ms: sample.utc_ms,
            observer_model_revision: sample.observer_model_revision,
            sun,
            moon,
            geocentric_moon_position_world_m,
            geocentric_sun_direction_world,
            catalog_epoch_to_world: eqj_to_world,
            ephemeris_revision: EPHEMERIS_REVISION,
        })
    }

    pub fn update_star_epoch(
        &mut self,
        utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
        records: &[StarAstrometry],
    ) -> Result<CorrectedStarDirections, SkyError> {
        if !self.star_epoch.needs_update(utc_ms, records)? {
            if let Some(cached) = self.star_epoch.cached(utc_ms) {
                return Ok(cached);
            }
        }
        let terrestrial_days = ffi::terrestrial_days(ut_days(utc_ms)?).map_err(map_status)?;
        self.star_epoch.update(utc_ms, terrestrial_days, records)
    }

    pub fn diagnostics(&self) -> SkyCalculatorDiagnostics {
        let (ephemeris_evaluations, ephemeris_cache_hits) = self.ephemeris.diagnostics();
        let (star_epoch_updates, star_epoch_cache_hits) = self.star_epoch.diagnostics();
        SkyCalculatorDiagnostics {
            ephemeris_evaluations,
            ephemeris_cache_hits,
            star_epoch_updates,
            star_epoch_cache_hits,
        }
    }

    pub fn invalidate_star_epoch(&mut self) {
        self.star_epoch.invalidate();
    }
}

fn subtract(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|axis| a[axis] - b[axis])
}

<<<FILE path="crates/astronomy/src/ephemeris_cache.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="198" bytes="6784" original_lines="198" original_bytes="6784" minified="false" sha256="6847bfd4c9d3d740457b08bac5e06741503b048fcfa67ee1c4a813d986d4e246">>>
use std::f64::consts::TAU;

use minimium_environment::time::WorldTimeMs;

use crate::{
    ffi,
    frames::{normalize, validate_vector},
    model::{AstronomyContextKey, SkyError, SkySampleContext},
    time::ut_days,
};

const CACHE_STEP_MS: i64 = 300_000;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
struct CacheKey {
    clock_revision: minimium_environment::time::ClockRevision,
    world_context: AstronomyContextKey,
    observer_model_revision: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Endpoint {
    utc_ms: i64,
    values: EphemerisValues,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct EphemerisValues {
    pub sun_geocentric_m: [f64; 3],
    pub moon_geocentric_m: [f64; 3],
    pub earth_heliocentric_m: [f64; 3],
    pub moon_north_eqj: [f64; 3],
    pub moon_v_magnitude: f64,
    pub ecliptic_phase_rad: f64,
    pub tt_days: f64,
}

impl EphemerisValues {
    fn from_bridge(raw: ffi::MinimiumAeEphemeris) -> Result<Self, SkyError> {
        let sun_geocentric_m = validate_vector(raw.sun_geocentric_m)?;
        let moon_geocentric_m = validate_vector(raw.moon_geocentric_m)?;
        let earth_heliocentric_m = validate_vector(raw.earth_heliocentric_m)?;
        let moon_north_eqj = normalize(raw.moon_north_eqj)?;
        if !raw.moon_v_magnitude.is_finite()
            || !(-100.0..=100.0).contains(&raw.moon_v_magnitude)
            || !raw.ecliptic_phase_degrees.is_finite()
            || !(0.0..=360.0).contains(&raw.ecliptic_phase_degrees)
            || !raw.tt_days.is_finite()
        {
            return Err(SkyError::InvalidUpstreamValue);
        }
        let ecliptic_phase_rad = raw.ecliptic_phase_degrees.to_radians().rem_euclid(TAU);
        Ok(Self {
            sun_geocentric_m,
            moon_geocentric_m,
            earth_heliocentric_m,
            moon_north_eqj,
            moon_v_magnitude: raw.moon_v_magnitude,
            ecliptic_phase_rad,
            tt_days: raw.tt_days,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct EphemerisCache {
    key: Option<CacheKey>,
    endpoints: Option<[Endpoint; 2]>,
    evaluations: u64,
    cache_hits: u64,
}

impl EphemerisCache {
    pub fn invalidate(&mut self) {
        self.key = None;
        self.endpoints = None;
    }

    pub fn diagnostics(&self) -> (u64, u64) {
        (self.evaluations, self.cache_hits)
    }

    pub fn sample(
        &mut self,
        context: SkySampleContext,
        force_invalidation: bool,
    ) -> Result<EphemerisValues, SkyError> {
        let key = CacheKey {
            clock_revision: context.clock_revision,
            world_context: context.world_context_key,
            observer_model_revision: context.observer_model_revision,
        };
        if force_invalidation || self.key != Some(key) {
            self.endpoints = None;
        }
        self.key = Some(key);

        let current = context.utc_ms.get();
        let (lower_utc_ms, upper_utc_ms) = bracket(current)?;
        let previous = self.endpoints;
        let lower = previous.and_then(|pair| {
            pair.iter()
                .copied()
                .find(|point| point.utc_ms == lower_utc_ms)
        });
        let upper = previous.and_then(|pair| {
            pair.iter()
                .copied()
                .find(|point| point.utc_ms == upper_utc_ms)
        });
        if lower.is_some() && upper.is_some() {
            self.cache_hits = self.cache_hits.saturating_add(1);
        }
        let lower = match lower {
            Some(point) => point,
            None => {
                self.evaluations = self.evaluations.saturating_add(1);
                compute_endpoint(lower_utc_ms)?
            }
        };
        let upper = match upper {
            Some(point) => point,
            None => {
                self.evaluations = self.evaluations.saturating_add(1);
                compute_endpoint(upper_utc_ms)?
            }
        };
        self.endpoints = Some([lower, upper]);
        interpolate(lower, upper, current)
    }
}

fn bracket(utc_ms: i64) -> Result<(i64, i64), SkyError> {
    let minimum = WorldTimeMs::MIN.get();
    let maximum = WorldTimeMs::MAX_EXCLUSIVE - 1;
    let lower = (utc_ms.div_euclid(CACHE_STEP_MS) * CACHE_STEP_MS).max(minimum);
    let upper = lower
        .checked_add(CACHE_STEP_MS)
        .ok_or(SkyError::InvalidTime)?
        .min(maximum);
    if lower > utc_ms || upper < utc_ms || upper <= lower {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidTime);
    }
    Ok((lower, upper))
}

fn compute_endpoint(utc_ms: i64) -> Result<Endpoint, SkyError> {
    let time = WorldTimeMs::new(utc_ms).map_err(|_| SkyError::InvalidTime)?;
    let raw = ffi::ephemeris(ut_days(time)?).map_err(map_status)?;
    Ok(Endpoint {
        utc_ms,
        values: EphemerisValues::from_bridge(raw)?,
    })
}

fn interpolate(lower: Endpoint, upper: Endpoint, utc_ms: i64) -> Result<EphemerisValues, SkyError> {
    if lower.utc_ms == upper.utc_ms {
        return Ok(lower.values);
    }
    let alpha = (utc_ms - lower.utc_ms) as f64 / (upper.utc_ms - lower.utc_ms) as f64;
    if !alpha.is_finite() || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&alpha) {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidTime);
    }
    let a = lower.values;
    let b = upper.values;
    let phase_x = a.ecliptic_phase_rad.cos() * (1.0 - alpha) + b.ecliptic_phase_rad.cos() * alpha;
    let phase_y = a.ecliptic_phase_rad.sin() * (1.0 - alpha) + b.ecliptic_phase_rad.sin() * alpha;
    if phase_x.hypot(phase_y) <= f64::EPSILON {
        return Err(SkyError::DegenerateVector);
    }
    let ecliptic_phase_rad = phase_y.atan2(phase_x).rem_euclid(TAU);
    Ok(EphemerisValues {
        sun_geocentric_m: lerp3(a.sun_geocentric_m, b.sun_geocentric_m, alpha),
        moon_geocentric_m: lerp3(a.moon_geocentric_m, b.moon_geocentric_m, alpha),
        earth_heliocentric_m: lerp3(a.earth_heliocentric_m, b.earth_heliocentric_m, alpha),
        moon_north_eqj: normalize(lerp3(a.moon_north_eqj, b.moon_north_eqj, alpha))?,
        moon_v_magnitude: lerp(a.moon_v_magnitude, b.moon_v_magnitude, alpha),
        ecliptic_phase_rad,
        tt_days: lerp(a.tt_days, b.tt_days, alpha),
    })
}

fn lerp(a: f64, b: f64, alpha: f64) -> f64 {
    a + (b - a) * alpha
}

fn lerp3(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3], alpha: f64) -> [f64; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|index| lerp(a[index], b[index], alpha))
}

pub(crate) fn map_status(status: i32) -> SkyError {
    match status {
        -1 => SkyError::InvalidTime,
        -2 => SkyError::NonFinite,
        -3 => SkyError::InvalidObserver,
        other => SkyError::UpstreamStatus(other),
    }
}

use std::sync::{Mutex, MutexGuard};

#[path = "bindings.generated.rs"]
mod bindings;

pub(crate) use bindings::{MinimiumAeEphemeris, MinimiumAeLocalFrame};

// The pinned C backend mutates process globals, including _CalcMoonCount.
// !Send/!Sync on a calculator does not serialize independent calculators.
// Every bridge entry acquires this lock once; no locked call invokes another
// Rust FFI wrapper. The C functions neither call Rust nor retain its pointers.
static BACKEND_LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());

fn lock_backend() -> MutexGuard<'static, ()> {
    // The lock protects entry, not Rust state. C cannot unwind into Rust, and
    // no Rust callback runs inside C, so poison recovery cannot expose a
    // partially updated Rust invariant. Recovering still holds the same lock.
    BACKEND_LOCK
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner())
}

pub(crate) fn ephemeris(ut_days: f64) -> Result<MinimiumAeEphemeris, i32> {
    let mut output = MinimiumAeEphemeris::default();
    let _guard = lock_backend();
    let status = unsafe { bindings::minimium_ae_calculate_ephemeris(ut_days, &mut output) };
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(output)
    } else {
        Err(status)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn terrestrial_days(ut_days: f64) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    let mut output = 0.0;
    let _guard = lock_backend();
    let status = unsafe { bindings::minimium_ae_terrestrial_days(ut_days, &mut output) };
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(output)
    } else {
        Err(status)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn local_frame(
    ut_days: f64,
    latitude_degrees: f64,
    longitude_degrees: f64,
    height_meters: f64,
) -> Result<MinimiumAeLocalFrame, i32> {
    let mut output = MinimiumAeLocalFrame::default();
    let _guard = lock_backend();
    let status = unsafe {
        bindings::minimium_ae_calculate_local_frame(
            ut_days,
            latitude_degrees,
            longitude_degrees,
            height_meters,
            &mut output,
        )
    };
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(output)
    } else {
        Err(status)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn refraction(altitude_degrees: f64) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    let mut correction = 0.0;
    let _guard = lock_backend();
    let status =
        unsafe { bindings::minimium_ae_refraction_correction(altitude_degrees, &mut correction) };
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(correction)
    } else {
        Err(status)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/astronomy/src/frames.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="198" bytes="7017" original_lines="198" original_bytes="7017" minified="false" sha256="6647fcd9eb8a0f91872be788ca96c6db1bbdaf45c8a35f860a6fe98b6693d5bf">>>
use std::f64::consts::{FRAC_PI_2, TAU};

use minimium_environment::sky::{ObserverFrame, SkyModel};

use crate::{
    ffi,
    model::{CelestialBodyState, RefractionMode, SkyError},
};

pub(crate) type Matrix3 = [[f64; 3]; 3];

pub(crate) fn validate_observer(
    observer: &ObserverFrame,
    expected_revision: u32,
) -> Result<(), SkyError> {
    let geographic = observer.geographic;
    let latitude = geographic.latitude_rad();
    let longitude = geographic.longitude_rad();
    let height = geographic.height_m();
    if observer.model == SkyModel::None
        || observer.height_reference_revision != expected_revision
        || !latitude.is_finite()
        || !longitude.is_finite()
        || !height.is_finite()
        || !(-FRAC_PI_2..=FRAC_PI_2).contains(&latitude)
        || !(-std::f64::consts::PI..std::f64::consts::PI).contains(&longitude)
        || !(-12_000.0..=100_000.0).contains(&height)
        || !observer.game_planet_radius_m.is_finite()
        || observer.game_planet_radius_m <= 0.0
        || !observer
            .game_eye_world_m
            .iter()
            .all(|value| value.is_finite())
    {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidObserver);
    }
    validate_basis(observer)
}

fn validate_basis(observer: &ObserverFrame) -> Result<(), SkyError> {
    let north = validate_vector(observer.north_world)?;
    let east = validate_vector(observer.east_world)?;
    let up = validate_vector(observer.up_world)?;
    if (length(north) - 1.0).abs() > 1.0e-8
        || (length(east) - 1.0).abs() > 1.0e-8
        || (length(up) - 1.0).abs() > 1.0e-8
        || dot(north, east).abs() > 1.0e-8
        || dot(north, up).abs() > 1.0e-8
        || dot(east, up).abs() > 1.0e-8
        || dot(cross(north, east), up) < 0.999_999_99
    {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidObserver);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn validate_vector(vector: [f64; 3]) -> Result<[f64; 3], SkyError> {
    if !vector.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
        return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
    }
    if length(vector) <= f64::MIN_POSITIVE {
        return Err(SkyError::DegenerateVector);
    }
    Ok(vector)
}

pub(crate) fn normalize(vector: [f64; 3]) -> Result<[f64; 3], SkyError> {
    let vector = validate_vector(vector)?;
    let magnitude = length(vector);
    if !magnitude.is_finite() || magnitude <= f64::MIN_POSITIVE {
        return Err(SkyError::DegenerateVector);
    }
    Ok(vector.map(|value| value / magnitude))
}

pub(crate) fn length(vector: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    vector[0].hypot(vector[1]).hypot(vector[2])
}

pub(crate) fn dot(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]
}

pub(crate) fn cross(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [
        a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
        a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
        a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
    ]
}

pub(crate) fn matrix_vector(matrix: Matrix3, vector: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|row| dot(matrix[row], vector))
}

pub(crate) fn matrix_multiply(a: Matrix3, b: Matrix3) -> Matrix3 {
    std::array::from_fn(|row| {
        std::array::from_fn(|column| {
            a[row][0] * b[0][column] + a[row][1] * b[1][column] + a[row][2] * b[2][column]
        })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn hor_to_world_matrix(observer: &ObserverFrame) -> Matrix3 {
    let north = observer.north_world;
    let west = observer.east_world.map(|value| -value);
    let up = observer.up_world;
    [
        [north[0], west[0], up[0]],
        [north[1], west[1], up[1]],
        [north[2], west[2], up[2]],
    ]
}

pub(crate) fn validate_rotation(matrix: Matrix3) -> Result<Matrix3, SkyError> {
    validate_transform(matrix, 1.0)
}

pub(crate) fn validate_world_transform(matrix: Matrix3) -> Result<Matrix3, SkyError> {
    // The game's N/E/U frame is right-handed; Astronomy Engine HOR is N/W/U.
    // Converting between them reflects one axis, exactly once, so det = -1.
    validate_transform(matrix, -1.0)
}

fn validate_transform(matrix: Matrix3, handedness: f64) -> Result<Matrix3, SkyError> {
    if !matrix.iter().flatten().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
        return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
    }
    for row in matrix {
        if row.iter().any(|value| value.abs() > 1.000_001) || (length(row) - 1.0).abs() > 1.0e-6 {
            return Err(SkyError::InvalidUpstreamValue);
        }
    }
    if dot(matrix[0], matrix[1]).abs() > 1.0e-6
        || dot(matrix[0], matrix[2]).abs() > 1.0e-6
        || dot(matrix[1], matrix[2]).abs() > 1.0e-6
        || dot(cross(matrix[0], matrix[1]), matrix[2]) * handedness < 0.999_99
    {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidUpstreamValue);
    }
    Ok(matrix)
}

pub(crate) fn body_state(
    eqj_direction: [f64; 3],
    distance_m: f64,
    radius_m: f64,
    eqj_to_hor: Matrix3,
    eqj_to_world: Matrix3,
    observer: &ObserverFrame,
    refraction: RefractionMode,
) -> Result<CelestialBodyState, SkyError> {
    let eqj_direction = normalize(eqj_direction)?;
    if !distance_m.is_finite() || distance_m <= radius_m || radius_m <= 0.0 {
        return Err(SkyError::DegenerateVector);
    }
    let geometric_direction_world = normalize(matrix_vector(eqj_to_world, eqj_direction))?;
    let geometric_hor = normalize(matrix_vector(eqj_to_hor, eqj_direction))?;
    let geometric_altitude_rad = geometric_hor[2].clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
    let horizontal_length = geometric_hor[0].hypot(geometric_hor[1]);
    let azimuth_rad = if horizontal_length <= 1.0e-12 {
        0.0
    } else {
        (-geometric_hor[1]).atan2(geometric_hor[0]).rem_euclid(TAU)
    };
    let apparent_altitude_rad = match refraction {
        RefractionMode::None => geometric_altitude_rad,
        RefractionMode::Standard => {
            let lift = ffi::refraction(geometric_altitude_rad.to_degrees())
                .map_err(crate::ephemeris_cache::map_status)?;
            if !lift.is_finite() || !(-5.0..=5.0).contains(&lift) {
                return Err(SkyError::InvalidUpstreamValue);
            }
            (geometric_altitude_rad + lift.to_radians()).clamp(-FRAC_PI_2, FRAC_PI_2)
        }
    };
    let cos_altitude = apparent_altitude_rad.cos();
    let apparent_hor = [
        cos_altitude * azimuth_rad.cos(),
        -cos_altitude * azimuth_rad.sin(),
        apparent_altitude_rad.sin(),
    ];
    let apparent_direction_world =
        normalize(matrix_vector(hor_to_world_matrix(observer), apparent_hor))?;
    let angular_radius_rad = (radius_m / distance_m).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
    if !angular_radius_rad.is_finite() {
        return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
    }
    Ok(CelestialBodyState {
        geometric_direction_world,
        apparent_direction_world,
        geometric_altitude_rad,
        apparent_altitude_rad,
        azimuth_rad,
        distance_m,
        angular_radius_rad,
    })
}
