<<<FILE path="crates/astronomy/src/lunar.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="55" bytes="2179" original_lines="55" original_bytes="2179" minified="false" sha256="62b94cc07d24bfae5dcdb6f4065878e4178d8883e62c1dd8c003ecbacdff0c0c">>>
use std::f64::consts::{PI, TAU};

use crate::{
    frames::{dot, matrix_vector, normalize},
    model::{MoonState, SkyError},
};
pub(crate) struct LunarGeometryInput {
    pub moon_body: crate::model::CelestialBodyState,
    pub moon_geocentric_eqj_m: [f64; 3],
    pub earth_heliocentric_eqj_m: [f64; 3],
    pub observer_geocentric_eqj_m: [f64; 3],
    pub moon_north_eqj: [f64; 3],
    pub ecliptic_phase_rad: f64,
    pub apparent_v_magnitude: f64,
    pub eqj_to_world: [[f64; 3]; 3],
}

pub(crate) fn lunar_geometry(input: LunarGeometryInput) -> Result<MoonState, SkyError> {
    if !input.ecliptic_phase_rad.is_finite()
        || !(0.0..TAU).contains(&input.ecliptic_phase_rad)
        || !input.apparent_v_magnitude.is_finite()
    {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidUpstreamValue);
    }
    let moon_to_sun_eqj = normalize(std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
        -input.earth_heliocentric_eqj_m[axis] - input.moon_geocentric_eqj_m[axis]
    }))?;
    let moon_to_observer_eqj = normalize(std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
        input.observer_geocentric_eqj_m[axis] - input.moon_geocentric_eqj_m[axis]
    }))?;
    let moon_to_sun_world = normalize(matrix_vector(input.eqj_to_world, moon_to_sun_eqj))?;
    let moon_to_observer_world =
        normalize(matrix_vector(input.eqj_to_world, moon_to_observer_eqj))?;
    let pole_world = normalize(matrix_vector(
        input.eqj_to_world,
        normalize(input.moon_north_eqj)?,
    ))?;
    let cos_phase = dot(moon_to_sun_world, moon_to_observer_world).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
    let phase_angle_rad = cos_phase.acos();
    let illuminated_fraction = ((1.0 + cos_phase) / 2.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    if !phase_angle_rad.is_finite() || !illuminated_fraction.is_finite() {
        return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
    }
    Ok(MoonState {
        body: input.moon_body,
        moon_to_sun_world,
        moon_to_observer_world,
        pole_world,
        phase_angle_rad,
        illuminated_fraction,
        ecliptic_phase_rad: input.ecliptic_phase_rad,
        waxing: input.ecliptic_phase_rad < PI,
        apparent_v_magnitude: input.apparent_v_magnitude,
    })
}

use std::{error::Error, fmt, sync::Arc};

use minimium_environment::time::{ClockRevision, WorldTimeMs};
use minimium_world::world::{MembershipEpoch, WorldContentRevision, WorldInstanceId};

pub const ASTRONOMY_MODEL_REVISION: u32 = 1;
pub const MAX_STAR_RECORDS: usize = 1000;
pub const EPHEMERIS_REVISION: u32 = 1;
pub const SUN_RADIUS_M: f64 = 695_700_000.0;
pub const MOON_MEAN_RADIUS_M: f64 = 1_737_400.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RefractionMode {
    None,
    Standard,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SkyError {
    InvalidTime,
    InvalidObserver,
    UpstreamStatus(i32),
    NonFinite,
    DegenerateVector,
    InvalidUpstreamValue,
    InvalidStarData,
    ContextMismatch,
    RevisionExhausted,
}

impl fmt::Display for SkyError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::InvalidTime => formatter.write_str("UTC is outside the astronomy range"),
            Self::InvalidObserver => formatter.write_str("observer frame is invalid"),
            Self::UpstreamStatus(status) => {
                write!(formatter, "Astronomy Engine returned status {status}")
            }
            Self::NonFinite => formatter.write_str("astronomy returned a non-finite value"),
            Self::DegenerateVector => formatter.write_str("astronomy produced a zero vector"),
            Self::InvalidUpstreamValue => {
                formatter.write_str("astronomy returned an out-of-range value")
            }
            Self::InvalidStarData => formatter.write_str("star astrometry is invalid"),
            Self::ContextMismatch => formatter.write_str("sky state context does not match"),
            Self::RevisionExhausted => formatter.write_str("star epoch revision is exhausted"),
        }
    }
}

impl Error for SkyError {}

<<<FILE path="crates/astronomy/src/observations.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="116" bytes="4762" original_lines="116" original_bytes="4762" minified="false" sha256="5def48d7864a7c6f2c098dac9cbf10b81f118bbcddaba51be1586dea0350c2af">>>
use crate::SkyState;
use minimium_environment::universe::{BodyKind, CelestialBodyId, SolarSystemId, UniverseCatalog};

pub const SKY_SUN_ID: CelestialBodyId =
    CelestialBodyId::new(1).expect("reserved sky Sun ID is nonzero");
pub const SKY_MOON_ID: CelestialBodyId =
    CelestialBodyId::new(2).expect("reserved sky Moon ID is nonzero");

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ObservedBody {
    pub id: CelestialBodyId,
    pub kind: BodyKind,
    pub direction_world: [f64; 3],
    pub distance_m: f64,
    pub angular_radius_rad: f64,
    pub phase: f64,
    pub emitted_linear_rgb: [f64; 3],
    pub reflected_linear_rgb: [f64; 3],
    pub scattered_linear_rgb: [f64; 3],
    pub visible: bool,
}

/// Converts the authoritative Sun/Moon state and merges optional catalog bodies.
/// Sky bodies have reserved IDs 1 and 2; their radiometry remains owned by the
/// existing Earth lighting path. Catalog directions are rotated to world axes
/// once through the epoch-to-world matrix supplied by SkyState.
pub fn observed_bodies(
    sky: &SkyState,
    catalog: Option<(&UniverseCatalog, SolarSystemId, [f64; 3], f64)>,
) -> Vec<ObservedBody> {
    let mut bodies = vec![
        ObservedBody {
            id: SKY_SUN_ID,
            kind: BodyKind::Star,
            direction_world: sky.sun.geometric_direction_world,
            distance_m: sky.sun.distance_m,
            angular_radius_rad: sky.sun.angular_radius_rad,
            phase: 1.0,
            emitted_linear_rgb: [0.0; 3],
            reflected_linear_rgb: [0.0; 3],
            scattered_linear_rgb: [0.0; 3],
            visible: true,
        },
        ObservedBody {
            id: SKY_MOON_ID,
            kind: BodyKind::Moon,
            direction_world: sky.moon.body.geometric_direction_world,
            distance_m: sky.moon.body.distance_m,
            angular_radius_rad: sky.moon.body.angular_radius_rad,
            phase: sky.moon.illuminated_fraction,
            emitted_linear_rgb: [0.0; 3],
            reflected_linear_rgb: [0.0; 3],
            scattered_linear_rgb: [0.0; 3],
            visible: true,
        },
    ];
    if let Some((catalog, system, observer_m, time_seconds)) = catalog {
        if let Ok(observations) = catalog.observe(system, observer_m, time_seconds) {
            bodies.extend(observations.into_iter().filter_map(|observation| {
                if observation.id == SKY_SUN_ID || observation.id == SKY_MOON_ID {
                    return None;
                }
                let direction_world =
                    rotate_direction(sky.catalog_epoch_to_world, observation.direction);
                (direction_world.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite())
                    && observation.distance_m.is_finite()
                    && observation.angular_radius_rad.is_finite()
                    && observation.illuminated_fraction.is_finite()
                    && observation
                        .emitted_linear_rgb
                        .iter()
                        .all(|value| value.is_finite())
                    && observation
                        .reflected_linear_rgb
                        .iter()
                        .all(|value| value.is_finite())
                    && observation
                        .atmosphere_limb_rgb
                        .iter()
                        .all(|value| value.is_finite()))
                .then_some(ObservedBody {
                    id: observation.id,
                    kind: observation.kind,
                    direction_world,
                    distance_m: observation.distance_m,
                    angular_radius_rad: observation.angular_radius_rad,
                    phase: observation.illuminated_fraction,
                    emitted_linear_rgb: observation.emitted_linear_rgb,
                    reflected_linear_rgb: observation.reflected_linear_rgb,
                    scattered_linear_rgb: observation.atmosphere_limb_rgb,
                    visible: observation.visible,
                })
            }));
        }
    }
    bodies.sort_unstable_by_key(|body| body.id.get());
    bodies
}

fn rotate_direction(matrix: [[f64; 3]; 3], direction: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    let rotated = std::array::from_fn(|row| {
        matrix[row][0] * direction[0]
            + matrix[row][1] * direction[1]
            + matrix[row][2] * direction[2]
    });
    let length = rotated
        .iter()
        .map(|value| value * value)
        .sum::<f64>()
        .sqrt();
    if length.is_finite() && length > 0.0 {
        rotated.map(|value| value / length)
    } else {
        [0.0; 3]
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/astronomy/src/stars.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="128" bytes="4287" original_lines="128" original_bytes="4287" minified="false" sha256="3f335141e1b78a6101c0fccf071f7caa1ae57ddc5e1c68a248aae21686f4f82c">>>
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::Arc;

use minimium_environment::time::WorldTimeMs;

use crate::{
    frames::normalize,
    model::{CorrectedStarDirections, SkyError, StarAstrometry, StarDirection, MAX_STAR_RECORDS},
    time::JULIAN_YEAR_DAYS,
};

const STAR_DAY_MS: i64 = 86_400_000;

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct StarEpochCache {
    last_utc_day: Option<i64>,
    last_utc_ms: Option<i64>,
    records: Vec<StarAstrometry>,
    result: Option<CorrectedStarDirections>,
    invalidated: bool,
    updates: u64,
    cache_hits: u64,
}

impl StarEpochCache {
    pub fn diagnostics(&self) -> (u64, u64) {
        (self.updates, self.cache_hits)
    }

    pub fn invalidate(&mut self) {
        self.invalidated = true;
    }

    pub fn needs_update(
        &self,
        utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
        records: &[StarAstrometry],
    ) -> Result<bool, SkyError> {
        let records_changed = self.records.as_slice() != records;
        if records_changed || self.result.is_none() || self.invalidated {
            validate_records(records)?;
        }
        let day = utc_ms.get().div_euclid(STAR_DAY_MS);
        let discontinuity = self.last_utc_ms.is_some_and(|previous| {
            let current = utc_ms.get();
            current < previous || current.saturating_sub(previous) > STAR_DAY_MS
        });
        Ok(self.invalidated
            || self.result.is_none()
            || self.last_utc_day != Some(day)
            || discontinuity
            || records_changed)
    }

    pub fn cached(&mut self, utc_ms: WorldTimeMs) -> Option<CorrectedStarDirections> {
        if self.result.is_some() {
            self.cache_hits = self.cache_hits.saturating_add(1);
        }
        self.last_utc_day = Some(utc_ms.get().div_euclid(STAR_DAY_MS));
        self.last_utc_ms = Some(utc_ms.get());
        self.result.clone()
    }

    pub fn update(
        &mut self,
        utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
        tt_days: f64,
        records: &[StarAstrometry],
    ) -> Result<CorrectedStarDirections, SkyError> {
        validate_records(records)?;
        if !tt_days.is_finite() {
            return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
        }
        let delta_jyear = tt_days / JULIAN_YEAR_DAYS;
        if !delta_jyear.is_finite() {
            return Err(SkyError::NonFinite);
        }
        let mut directions = Vec::with_capacity(records.len());
        for star in records {
            let position = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                star.position_eqj_pc[axis] + star.velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear[axis] * delta_jyear
            });
            directions.push(StarDirection {
                id: star.id,
                direction_eqj: normalize(position)?,
            });
        }
        let revision = self.result.as_ref().map_or(Ok(1), |previous| {
            previous
                .star_epoch_revision
                .checked_add(1)
                .ok_or(SkyError::RevisionExhausted)
        })?;
        let result = CorrectedStarDirections {
            star_epoch_revision: revision,
            directions: Arc::from(directions),
        };
        self.records.clear();
        self.records.extend_from_slice(records);
        self.last_utc_day = Some(utc_ms.get().div_euclid(STAR_DAY_MS));
        self.last_utc_ms = Some(utc_ms.get());
        self.invalidated = false;
        self.result = Some(result.clone());
        self.updates = self.updates.saturating_add(1);
        Ok(result)
    }
}

fn validate_records(records: &[StarAstrometry]) -> Result<(), SkyError> {
    if records.len() > MAX_STAR_RECORDS {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidStarData);
    }
    let mut ids = HashSet::with_capacity(records.len());
    for star in records {
        if star.id == 0
            || !ids.insert(star.id)
            || !star.position_eqj_pc.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite())
            || !star
                .velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear
                .iter()
                .all(|value| value.is_finite())
        {
            return Err(SkyError::InvalidStarData);
        }
        normalize(star.position_eqj_pc).map_err(|_| SkyError::InvalidStarData)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

use minimium_environment::time::{WorldTimeMs, MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE, MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS};

use crate::model::SkyError;

pub(crate) const J2000_NOON_UTC_MS: i64 = 946_728_000_000;
pub(crate) const MILLIS_PER_DAY: i64 = 86_400_000;
pub(crate) const JULIAN_YEAR_DAYS: f64 = 365.25;

pub(crate) fn ut_days(utc_ms: WorldTimeMs) -> Result<f64, SkyError> {
    let value = utc_ms.get();
    if !(MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS..MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE).contains(&value) {
        return Err(SkyError::InvalidTime);
    }
    let delta_ms = value
        .checked_sub(J2000_NOON_UTC_MS)
        .ok_or(SkyError::InvalidTime)?;
    let days = delta_ms as f64 / MILLIS_PER_DAY as f64;
    if days.is_finite() {
        Ok(days)
    } else {
        Err(SkyError::InvalidTime)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/bootstrap.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="450" bytes="16475" original_lines="450" original_bytes="16475" minified="false" sha256="4c116990a6065d6eef55f75b8128f9197e73bbd199ad035586c58eaede37f44c">>>
use crate::options::ThreadLane;
mod diagnostics;
use diagnostics::ServerStderr;
use minimium_platform::{
    admin_client,
    endpoint::{new_admin_token, ServerEndpoint},
    server_lock,
};
use std::{
    error::Error,
    io,
    net::TcpStream,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    process::{Child, Command, ExitStatus, Stdio},
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const STARTUP_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
const CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
const CHILD_EXIT_GRACE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
const RETRY_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(25);

/// Describes whether the client attached to another server or owns a child process.
pub enum LocalServer {
    Attached,
    Owned(OwnedServer),
}

/// RAII guard for a locally started server process.
pub struct OwnedServer {
    child: Option<Child>,
    stderr: Option<ServerStderr>,
    endpoint: Option<ServerEndpoint>,
    data_dir: PathBuf,
    shutdown_attempted: bool,
}

impl LocalServer {
    /// Returns the private admin endpoint only while the owned child is alive.
    pub fn owned_admin_endpoint(&mut self) -> io::Result<Option<ServerEndpoint>> {
        match self {
            Self::Attached => Ok(None),
            Self::Owned(server) => {
                if server.is_running()? {
                    Ok(server.endpoint.clone())
                } else {
                    Ok(None)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Reports whether this guard still owns a running child process.
    pub fn is_owned_process_running(&mut self) -> io::Result<bool> {
        match self {
            Self::Attached => Ok(false),
            Self::Owned(server) => server.is_running(),
        }
    }

    /// Gracefully stops an owned server and reaps its child process.
    pub fn shutdown(&mut self) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
        match self {
            Self::Attached => Ok(()),
            Self::Owned(server) => server.shutdown().map_err(Into::into),
        }
    }
}

impl OwnedServer {
    fn is_running(&mut self) -> io::Result<bool> {
        match self.child.as_mut() {
            Some(child) => Ok(child.try_wait()?.is_none()),
            None => Ok(false),
        }
    }

    fn shutdown(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        if self.shutdown_attempted {
            if let Some(child) = self.child.as_mut() {
                terminate_and_reap(child)?;
                self.child = None;
            }
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.shutdown_attempted = true;
        let status = match self.child.as_mut().map(Child::try_wait).transpose() {
            Ok(status) => status,
            Err(error) => {
                return match self.child.as_mut() {
                    Some(child) => match terminate_and_reap(child) {
                        Ok(()) => {
                            self.child = None;
                            Err(error)
                        }
                        Err(cleanup_error) => Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                            "checking owned server failed ({error}); cleanup failed ({cleanup_error})"
                        ))),
                    },
                    None => Err(error),
                };
            }
        };
        let Some(status) = status else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        if let Some(status) = status {
            self.child = None;
            return match &self.endpoint {
                Some(endpoint) if admin_client::shutdown_completed(&self.data_dir, endpoint)? => {
                    Ok(())
                }
                _ => Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                    "owned server exited before shutdown completed: {status}"
                ))),
            };
        }
        let child = self
            .child
            .as_mut()
            .expect("child remains present until reaped");
        let graceful = match &self.endpoint {
            Some(endpoint) => admin_client::stop_and_wait(&self.data_dir, endpoint),
            None => Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::NotConnected,
                "owned server did not publish its endpoint",
            )),
        };
        if let Err(error) = graceful {
            return match terminate_and_reap(child) {
                Ok(()) => {
                    self.child = None;
                    Err(error)
                }
                Err(cleanup_error) => Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                    "graceful shutdown failed ({error}); cleanup failed ({cleanup_error})"
                ))),
            };
        }
        match wait_for_child(child, CHILD_EXIT_GRACE) {
            Ok(()) => {
                self.child = None;
                Ok(())
            }
            Err(error) => match terminate_and_reap(child) {
                Ok(()) => {
                    self.child = None;
                    Err(error)
                }
                Err(cleanup_error) => Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                    "waiting for owned server failed ({error}); cleanup failed ({cleanup_error})"
                ))),
            },
        }
    }

    fn terminate(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        self.shutdown_attempted = true;
        if let Some(child) = self.child.as_mut() {
            terminate_and_reap(child)?;
            self.child = None;
        }
        self.endpoint = None;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Drop for OwnedServer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.child.is_some() {
            if let Err(error) = self.shutdown() {
                eprintln!("owned local server shutdown failed during drop: {error}");
                if let Some(child) = self.child.as_mut() {
                    if let Err(cleanup_error) = terminate_and_reap(child) {
                        eprintln!("owned local server final cleanup failed: {cleanup_error}");
                    } else {
                        self.child = None;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Connects to a validated local server or starts and owns one.
/// The returned game stream has not sent an identity and remains blocking.
/// Starts or attaches without exceeding the caller's connection deadline.
pub fn connect_or_start_until(
    data_dir: &Path,
    map_path: Option<&Path>,
    world_definition_path: Option<&Path>,
    threads: ThreadLane,
    deadline: Instant,
) -> Result<(TcpStream, LocalServer), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let deadline = deadline.min(Instant::now() + STARTUP_TIMEOUT);

    if let Ok(endpoint) = ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
        if validate_live_endpoint(data_dir, &endpoint, deadline).unwrap_or(false) {
            validate_attachment_options()?;
            let stream = connect_game(&endpoint, remaining(deadline)?)?;
            return Ok((stream, LocalServer::Attached));
        }
    }

    remaining(deadline)?;
    let expected_token = new_admin_token()?;
    let child = start_local_server(
        data_dir,
        map_path,
        world_definition_path,
        threads,
        &expected_token,
    )?;
    // This guard is established immediately after spawn, before any fallible startup work.
    let mut owned = OwnedServer {
        child: Some(child),
        stderr: None,
        endpoint: None,
        data_dir: data_dir.to_owned(),
        shutdown_attempted: false,
    };
    owned.stderr = Some(ServerStderr::capture(
        owned.child.as_mut().expect("startup child exists"),
    )?);
    let mut child_exit_status: Option<ExitStatus> = None;
    loop {
        if child_exit_status.is_none() {
            let status = match owned.child.as_mut().map(Child::try_wait).transpose() {
                Ok(status) => status.flatten(),
                Err(error) => {
                    if let Some(child) = owned.child.as_mut() {
                        owned.shutdown_attempted = true;
                        match terminate_and_reap(child) {
                            Ok(()) => owned.child = None,
                            Err(cleanup_error) => {
                                return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                                    "checking local server startup failed ({error}); cleanup failed ({cleanup_error})"
                                )).into());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return Err(error.into());
                }
            };
            if let Some(status) = status {
                owned.child = None;
                child_exit_status = Some(status);
            }
        }

        if let Ok(endpoint) = ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
            if endpoint.token == expected_token && child_exit_status.is_none() {
                if validate_live_endpoint(data_dir, &endpoint, deadline).unwrap_or(false) {
                    let status = match owned.child.as_mut().map(Child::try_wait).transpose() {
                        Ok(status) => status.flatten(),
                        Err(error) => {
                            if let Some(child) = owned.child.as_mut() {
                                owned.shutdown_attempted = true;
                                match terminate_and_reap(child) {
                                    Ok(()) => owned.child = None,
                                    Err(cleanup_error) => {
                                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                                            "checking local server startup failed ({error}); cleanup failed ({cleanup_error})"
                                        )).into());
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            return Err(error.into());
                        }
                    };
                    if let Some(status) = status {
                        owned.child = None;
                        child_exit_status = Some(status);
                        continue;
                    }
                    owned.endpoint = Some(endpoint.clone());
                    let stream = connect_game(&endpoint, remaining(deadline)?)?;
                    return Ok((stream, LocalServer::Owned(owned)));
                }
            } else if endpoint.token != expected_token
                && validate_live_endpoint(data_dir, &endpoint, deadline).unwrap_or(false)
            {
                // Another process won the lock. Reap only the unsuccessful child we spawned.
                owned.terminate()?;
                validate_attachment_options()?;
                let stream = connect_game(&endpoint, remaining(deadline)?)?;
                return Ok((stream, LocalServer::Attached));
            }
        }
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            if let Some(status) = child_exit_status {
                let detail = owned.stderr.as_mut().and_then(ServerStderr::finish);
                return Err(match detail {
                    Some(detail) => {
                        format!("local server exited during startup ({status}): {detail}")
                    }
                    None => format!("local server exited during startup: {status}"),
                }
                .into());
            }
            // Startup never established ownership of a validated endpoint.
            // Reap only our own child and report the useful startup error rather
            // than attempting an admin shutdown against an unverified server.
            owned.terminate()?;
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "timed out waiting for a validated local server; rebuild both client and server with `cargo build --workspace` and check the server output",
            )
            .into());
        }
        thread::sleep(RETRY_INTERVAL);
    }
}

fn validate_live_endpoint(
    data_dir: &Path,
    endpoint: &ServerEndpoint,
    deadline: Instant,
) -> io::Result<bool> {
    admin_client::request_until(endpoint, "status", deadline)?;
    if !server_lock::is_locked(data_dir)? {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    match ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
        Ok(current) => Ok(same_endpoint(&current, endpoint)),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

fn validate_attachment_options() -> io::Result<()> {
    if local_env_option("MINIMIUM_LOCAL_CLIMATE_RELIEF_INFLUENCE").is_some() {
        return Err(io::Error::other("restart the local server to apply ClimateReliefInfluence; attaching would ignore this startup setting"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Launchers may leave an empty environment entry when an option is omitted.
/// Keep that equivalent to absence; an explicit numeric zero remains an override.
fn local_env_option(name: &str) -> Option<std::ffi::OsString> {
    std::env::var_os(name).filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
}

fn same_endpoint(left: &ServerEndpoint, right: &ServerEndpoint) -> bool {
    left.game_port == right.game_port
        && left.admin_port == right.admin_port
        && left.token == right.token
}

fn connect_game(endpoint: &ServerEndpoint, timeout: Duration) -> io::Result<TcpStream> {
    let address = std::net::SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], endpoint.game_port));
    TcpStream::connect_timeout(&address, timeout.min(CONNECT_TIMEOUT))
}

fn remaining(deadline: Instant) -> io::Result<Duration> {
    let duration = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
    if duration.is_zero() {
        Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
            "local server startup timed out",
        ))
    } else {
        Ok(duration)
    }
}

fn start_local_server(
    data_dir: &Path,
    map_path: Option<&Path>,
    world_definition_path: Option<&Path>,
    threads: ThreadLane,
    token: &str,
) -> io::Result<Child> {
    let current = std::env::current_exe()?;
    let executable = if cfg!(windows) {
        "minimium-server.exe"
    } else {
        "minimium-server"
    };
    let path = current.with_file_name(executable);
    if !path.exists() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::NotFound,
            format!("server executable not found at {}", path.display()),
        ));
    }
    let mut command = Command::new(path);
    command
        .arg("run")
        .arg("--headless")
        .arg("--threads")
        .arg(threads.as_str())
        .arg("--bind")
        .arg("127.0.0.1")
        .arg("--data-dir")
        .arg(data_dir)
        .env("MINIMIUM_ADMIN_TOKEN", token);
    if let Some(map_path) = map_path {
        command.arg("--map").arg(map_path);
    }
    if let Some(world_definition_path) = world_definition_path {
        command.arg("--world-definition").arg(world_definition_path);
    }
    if let Some(planet_config) = local_env_option("MINIMIUM_LOCAL_PLANET_CONFIG") {
        command.arg("--planet-config").arg(planet_config);
    }
    if let Some(influence) = local_env_option("MINIMIUM_LOCAL_CLIMATE_RELIEF_INFLUENCE") {
        command.arg("--climate-relief-influence").arg(influence);
    }
    if let Some(seed) = local_env_option("MINIMIUM_LOCAL_SEED") {
        command.arg("--seed").arg(seed);
    }
    command
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::inherit())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
}

fn wait_for_child(child: &mut Child, timeout: Duration) -> io::Result<()> {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
    loop {
        if child.try_wait()?.is_some() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "local server did not exit after graceful shutdown",
            ));
        }
        thread::sleep(RETRY_INTERVAL);
    }
}

fn terminate_and_reap(child: &mut Child) -> io::Result<()> {
    if let Err(kill_error) = child.kill() {
        // An already-exited process is still reaped. Do not wait indefinitely
        // on a live process when the OS refused the termination request.
        return match child.try_wait() {
            Ok(Some(_)) => child.wait().map(|_| ()),
            Ok(None) => Err(kill_error),
            Err(wait_error) => Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                "killing child failed ({kill_error}); checking child failed ({wait_error})"
            ))),
        };
    }
    child.wait().map(|_| ())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/bootstrap/diagnostics.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="76" bytes="2778" original_lines="76" original_bytes="2778" minified="false" sha256="91fa243656f4752e4cda5a8b0e0360dfdcc5e986c2d41b8e1defb4f6f93a03c7">>>
//! Drain child stderr continuously, preserving a bounded diagnostic tail for UI errors.
use std::{
    collections::VecDeque,
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    process::Child,
    sync::{Arc, Mutex},
    thread::JoinHandle,
};

const MAX_TAIL_BYTES: usize = 8192;
const MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS: usize = 2048;

pub(super) struct ServerStderr {
    tail: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<u8>>>,
    reader: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl ServerStderr {
    /// The caller establishes its child-process guard before starting this reader.
    pub(super) fn capture(child: &mut Child) -> io::Result<Self> {
        let mut stderr = child
            .stderr
            .take()
            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("local server stderr pipe is missing"))?;
        let tail = Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::with_capacity(MAX_TAIL_BYTES)));
        let output = tail.clone();
        let reader = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("local-server-stderr".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let mut buffer = [0; 1024];
                loop {
                    let count = match stderr.read(&mut buffer) {
                        Ok(0) => break,
                        Ok(count) => count,
                        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                        Err(_) => break,
                    };
                    if let Ok(mut tail) = output.lock() {
                        let discard = (tail.len() + count).saturating_sub(MAX_TAIL_BYTES);
                        tail.drain(..discard);
                        tail.extend(&buffer[..count]);
                    }
                    // Preserve terminal diagnostics as well as the in-game error.
                    let _ = io::stderr().write_all(&buffer[..count]);
                }
            })?;
        Ok(Self {
            tail,
            reader: Some(reader),
        })
    }

    /// Call only after the owned child has exited, so its pipe can reach EOF.
    pub(super) fn finish(&mut self) -> Option<String> {
        if let Some(reader) = self.reader.take() {
            let _ = reader.join();
        }
        let bytes: Vec<u8> = self.tail.lock().ok()?.iter().copied().collect();
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
        let lines: Vec<_> = text
            .lines()
            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
            .collect();
        let detail = lines
            .iter()
            .rev()
            .find(|line| line.starts_with("server error:"))
            .or_else(|| lines.last())?;
        let detail: String = detail
            .chars()
            .filter(|c| !c.is_control())
            .take(MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS)
            .collect();
        (!detail.is_empty()).then_some(detail)
    }
}

use crate::session::{ClientSession, QueueError, SessionEvent, SessionState};
use crate::{
    bootstrap::LocalServer,
    connector::{AttemptId, Connector, PollEvent, StartError},
    ThreadLane,
};
use minimium_core::identity::PlayerProfileId;
use minimium_platform::admin_client;
use minimium_protocol::ClientMessage;
use minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId;
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    io,
    path::PathBuf,
    thread::{self, JoinHandle},
    time::Duration,

const ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);

pub enum ConnectionEvent {
    Idle,
    InProgress { waiting_for_cleanup: bool },
    TimedOut,
    Cancelled,
    SessionStarted,
    SetupFailed(io::Error),
    Failed(io::Error),
}

/// Owns the connector, session and any local process independently of a UI.
pub struct ConnectionController {
    presentation: Option<bool>,
    pub movement: minimium_simulation::MovementSettings,
    connector: Connector,
    active: Option<AttemptId>,
    session: Option<ClientSession>,
    local_server: Option<LocalServer>,
    session_owns_server: bool,
    time_scale_request: Option<JoinHandle<io::Result<String>>>,
    cleanup: Option<JoinHandle<Result<(), String>>>,
    profile: PlayerProfileId,
    fingerprint: u64,
    world_fingerprints: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, u64>,
}

impl ConnectionController {
    pub fn new(profile: PlayerProfileId, fingerprint: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            presentation: None,
            movement: Default::default(),
            connector: Connector::default(),
            active: None,
            session: None,
            local_server: None,
            session_owns_server: false,
            time_scale_request: None,
            cleanup: None,
            profile,
            fingerprint,
            world_fingerprints: HashMap::from([(
                WorldInstanceId::new(1).expect("primary ID is nonzero"),
                fingerprint,
            )]),
        }
    }

    pub fn set_world_fingerprints(&mut self, fingerprints: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, u64>) {
        self.world_fingerprints = fingerprints;
    }

    pub fn set_presentation(&mut self, compressed: bool) {
        self.presentation = Some(compressed);
    }

    pub fn busy(&self) -> bool {
        self.session.is_some() || self.active.is_some() || self.cleanup.is_some()
    }

    pub fn session(&self) -> Option<&ClientSession> {
        self.session.as_ref()
    }

    pub fn session_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut ClientSession> {
        self.session.as_mut()
    }

    pub fn take_session(&mut self) -> Option<ClientSession> {
        self.session_owns_server = false;
        self.session.take()
    }

    /// Sends a server-authoritative time change without blocking the UI loop.
    pub fn request_time_scale(&mut self, value: String) -> Result<(), String> {
        minimium_environment::parse_scale_ppm(&value)?;
        self.request_time_command(format!("time scale {value}"))
    }

    pub fn request_set_time(&mut self, minute: u16, longitude_rad: f64) -> Result<(), String> {
        let current = self
            .session
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|session| session.environment_frame().estimated_world_utc_ms)
            .ok_or("synchronized world time is unavailable")?;
        let target =
            minimium_environment::clock_command::utc_at_time(current, minute, longitude_rad)?;
        let date = crate::environment::format_utc(target)
            .replace(" UTC", "Z")
            .replace(' ', "T");
        self.request_time_command(format!("time set {date}"))
    }

    fn request_time_command(&mut self, command: String) -> Result<(), String> {
        if !self
            .session
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|session| session.state() == SessionState::Connected)
            || !self.session_owns_server
        {
            return Err(String::from(
                "time changes require a connection to a server started by this client",
            ));
        }
        if self.time_scale_request.is_some() {
            return Err(String::from("a time scale request is already in progress"));
        }
        let endpoint = self
            .local_server
            .as_mut()
            .ok_or("owned server is unavailable")?
            .owned_admin_endpoint()
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
            .ok_or("owned server is not running")?;
        self.time_scale_request = Some(thread::spawn(move || {
            admin_client::request(&endpoint, &command)
        }));
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn poll_time_scale_result(&mut self) -> Option<Result<String, String>> {
        if !self
            .time_scale_request
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(JoinHandle::is_finished)
        {
            return None;
        }
        let worker = self.time_scale_request.take()?;
        Some(match worker.join() {
            Ok(Ok(response)) => Ok(response),
            Ok(Err(error)) => Err(error.to_string()),
            Err(_) => Err(String::from("time scale request worker panicked")),
        })
    }

    pub fn queue(&mut self, message: &ClientMessage) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
        self.session
            .as_mut()
            .ok_or(QueueError::Disconnected)?
            .queue(message)
    }

    pub fn cancel_transition(&mut self) -> bool {
        self.session
            .as_mut()
            .is_some_and(ClientSession::cancel_pending_transition)
    }

    pub fn start_remote(&mut self, address: String) -> Result<(), StartError> {
        self.active = Some(self.connector.start(address, ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT)?);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn start_local(
        &mut self,
        data_dir: PathBuf,
        map_path: Option<PathBuf>,
        world_definition_path: Option<PathBuf>,
        lanes: ThreadLane,
    ) -> Result<(), StartError> {
        self.active = Some(self.connector.start_local(
            data_dir,
            map_path,
            world_definition_path,
            lanes,
            ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT,
        )?);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn poll_connector(&mut self) -> ConnectionEvent {
        if self.cleanup.as_ref().is_some_and(JoinHandle::is_finished) {
            if let Some(handle) = self.cleanup.take() {
                match handle.join() {
                    Ok(Ok(())) => {}
                    Ok(Err(error)) => eprintln!("local server guard cleanup failed: {error}"),
                    Err(_) => eprintln!("local server cleanup worker panicked"),
                }
            }
        }
        match self.connector.poll() {
            PollEvent::Idle => {
                self.active = None;
                ConnectionEvent::Idle
            }
            PollEvent::InProgress {
                attempt_id,
                discarding_result,
            } => {
                let waiting_for_cleanup = discarding_result && self.active != Some(attempt_id);
                self.active = Some(attempt_id);
                ConnectionEvent::InProgress {
                    waiting_for_cleanup,
                }
            }
            PollEvent::TimedOut { attempt_id } if self.active == Some(attempt_id) => {
                ConnectionEvent::TimedOut
            }
            PollEvent::Cancelled { attempt_id } if self.active == Some(attempt_id) => {
                self.active = None;
                ConnectionEvent::Cancelled
            }
            PollEvent::Connected {
                attempt_id,
                stream,
                local_server,
            } if self.active == Some(attempt_id) => {
                self.active = None;
                self.session_owns_server = local_server
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|server| matches!(server, LocalServer::Owned(_)));
                if let Some(server) = local_server {
                    self.retain_local_server(server);
                }
                match ClientSession::with_presentation(
                    stream,
                    self.profile,
                    self.fingerprint,
                    self.presentation,
                ) {
                    Ok(mut session) => {
                        session.set_world_fingerprints(self.world_fingerprints.clone());
                        self.session = Some(session);
                        ConnectionEvent::SessionStarted
                    }
                    Err(error) => {
                        self.session_owns_server = false;
                        ConnectionEvent::SetupFailed(error)
                    }
                }
            }
            PollEvent::Failed { attempt_id, error } if self.active == Some(attempt_id) => {
                self.active = None;
                ConnectionEvent::Failed(error)
            }
            _ => ConnectionEvent::Idle,
        }
    }

    pub fn poll_session(&mut self, events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>) {
        if let Some(session) = self.session.as_mut() {
            session.poll(events);
        }
    }

    pub fn cancel(&mut self) {
        if let Some(id) = self.active.take() {
            self.connector.cancel(id);
        }
    }

    pub fn finish(&mut self) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        self.cancel();
        self.connector.finish_on_exit();
        if let Some(mut session) = self.session.take() {
            session.close();
        }
        let cleanup_result = self
            .cleanup
            .take()
            .map_or(Ok(()), |worker| match worker.join() {
                Ok(Ok(())) => Ok(()),
                Ok(Err(error)) => Err(io::Error::other(error)),
                Err(_) => Err(io::Error::other("local server cleanup worker panicked")),
            });
        let server_result = self
            .local_server
            .take()
            .map_or(Ok(()), |mut server| server.shutdown());
        if let Err(error) = &server_result {
            if cleanup_result.is_err() {
                eprintln!("local server shutdown also failed: {error}");
            }
        }
        cleanup_result?;
        server_result
    }

    fn retain_local_server(&mut self, new_server: LocalServer) {
        let replace = match (&mut self.local_server, &new_server) {
            (Some(server @ LocalServer::Owned(_)), LocalServer::Attached) => {
                match server.is_owned_process_running() {
                    Ok(running) => !running,
                    Err(error) => {
                        eprintln!("local server process check failed: {error}");
                        false
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => true,
        };
        if replace {
            if let Some(mut old) = self.local_server.replace(new_server) {
                if matches!(old, LocalServer::Attached) {
                    return;
                }
                // At most one cleanup can be outstanding: busy() prevents a rehost.
                debug_assert!(self.cleanup.is_none());
                self.cleanup = Some(thread::spawn(move || {
                    old.shutdown().map_err(|error| error.to_string())
                }));
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for ConnectionController {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Err(error) = self.finish() {
            eprintln!("local server guard cleanup failed: {error}");
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/connector.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="492" bytes="17460" original_lines="492" original_bytes="17460" minified="false" sha256="abbdb3571f0cd0f6adb1de43a45510144794819d89ef01c6a870223b44c166e6">>>
//! Non-blocking TCP connection attempts for UI callers.
//!
//! DNS lookup, sequential socket connections, and local server startup run on
//! one worker thread. Timing out or cancelling an attempt stops its result from
//! being delivered, but does not pretend to cancel blocking OS or startup work:
//! the connector remains busy until that worker exits.

use crate::{bootstrap, options::ThreadLane};
use std::{
    io,
    net::{SocketAddr, TcpStream, ToSocketAddrs},
    path::PathBuf,
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
        mpsc::{self, Receiver, TryRecvError},
        Arc,
    },
    thread::{self, JoinHandle},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

/// Stable, monotonically increasing identifier for a connection attempt.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct AttemptId(u64);

impl AttemptId {
    /// Returns the numeric value used to order attempts from one connector.
    pub const fn get(self) -> u64 {
        self.0
    }
}

/// Why an attempt could not be started.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum StartError {
    /// A previous worker, including timed-out or cancelled work, is still live.
    Busy { active_attempt: AttemptId },
    /// The connector exhausted its attempt identifier space.
    AttemptIdsExhausted,
    /// The operating system could not create the worker thread.
    WorkerSpawn(io::Error),
}

/// A single event from [`Connector::poll`].
pub enum PollEvent {
    /// No attempt is active.
    Idle,
    /// DNS or socket work is still in flight.
    InProgress {
        attempt_id: AttemptId,
        /// True when the result is already discarded due to timeout/cancel.
        discarding_result: bool,
    },
    /// The common deadline expired. Emitted at most once for this attempt.
    TimedOut { attempt_id: AttemptId },
    /// The matching attempt was cancelled. Emitted at most once.
    Cancelled { attempt_id: AttemptId },
    /// Connection succeeded before the deadline.
    Connected {
        attempt_id: AttemptId,
        stream: TcpStream,
        /// Present when this attempt attached to or started the local server.
        local_server: Option<bootstrap::LocalServer>,
    },
    /// DNS or all socket attempts failed.
    Failed {
        attempt_id: AttemptId,
        error: io::Error,
    },
}

struct WorkerResult {
    completed_at: Instant,
    result: io::Result<ConnectedSocket>,
}

enum WorkerFinalization {
    Accept,
    Discard(WorkerResult),
}

struct ConnectedSocket {
    stream: TcpStream,
    local_server: Option<bootstrap::LocalServer>,
}

enum WorkerOperation {
    Remote(String),
    Local {
        data_dir: PathBuf,
        map_path: Option<PathBuf>,
        world_definition_path: Option<PathBuf>,
        threads: ThreadLane,
    },
}

struct ActiveAttempt {
    id: AttemptId,
    deadline: Instant,
    receiver: Receiver<WorkerResult>,
    worker: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
    discard: Option<DiscardReason>,
    discard_reported: bool,
    abandoned: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    local: bool,
    finalize: Option<mpsc::Sender<WorkerFinalization>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DiscardReason {
    TimedOut,
    Cancelled,
}

/// Owns at most one DNS/connect worker at a time.
///
/// A timed-out or cancelled worker stays active until it actually finishes;
/// this prevents an uninterruptible resolver call from overlapping a new one.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Connector {
    next_id: u64,
    active: Option<ActiveAttempt>,
}

impl Connector {
    /// Starts resolving `address` and connecting to its resolved addresses in
    /// order. `timeout` is one common deadline covering DNS and all attempts.
    pub fn start(
        &mut self,
        address: impl Into<String>,
        timeout: Duration,
    ) -> Result<AttemptId, StartError> {
        self.start_worker(WorkerOperation::Remote(address.into()), timeout)
    }

    /// Starts or attaches to the local server away from the UI thread.
    ///
    /// `timeout` is the connector's common result deadline. The bootstrap
    /// operation itself may continue beyond it; late owned-server guards are
    /// dropped on the worker when their result is discarded.
    pub fn start_local(
        &mut self,
        data_dir: PathBuf,
        map_path: Option<PathBuf>,
        world_definition_path: Option<PathBuf>,
        threads: ThreadLane,
        timeout: Duration,
    ) -> Result<AttemptId, StartError> {
        self.start_worker(
            WorkerOperation::Local {
                data_dir,
                map_path,
                world_definition_path,
                threads,
            },
            timeout,
        )
    }

    fn start_worker(
        &mut self,
        operation: WorkerOperation,
        timeout: Duration,
    ) -> Result<AttemptId, StartError> {
        if let Some(active) = self.active.as_ref() {
            return Err(StartError::Busy {
                active_attempt: active.id,
            });
        }

        let id = self
            .next_id
            .checked_add(1)
            .map(AttemptId)
            .ok_or(StartError::AttemptIdsExhausted)?;
        let now = Instant::now();
        let deadline = now.checked_add(timeout).ok_or_else(|| {
            StartError::WorkerSpawn(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                "connection timeout is too large",
            ))
        })?;
        let local = matches!(&operation, WorkerOperation::Local { .. });
        let abandoned = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let worker_abandoned = Arc::clone(&abandoned);
        let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::channel();
        let (finalize_sender, finalize_receiver) = mpsc::channel();
        let worker = thread::Builder::new()
            .name(format!("connector-attempt-{}", id.get()))
            .spawn(move || {
                let mut result = run_operation(operation, deadline);
                let completed_at = Instant::now();
                if worker_abandoned.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
                    drop(result);
                    result = Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
                        "connection attempt was cancelled",
                    ));
                } else if completed_at > deadline {
                    drop(result);
                    result = Err(timed_out_error());
                }
                if sender
                    .send(WorkerResult {
                        completed_at,
                        result,
                    })
                    .is_ok()
                    && local
                {
                    if let Ok(WorkerFinalization::Discard(result)) = finalize_receiver.recv() {
                        drop(result);
                    }
                }
            })
            .map_err(StartError::WorkerSpawn)?;

        self.next_id = id.get();
        self.active = Some(ActiveAttempt {
            id,
            deadline,
            receiver,
            worker: Some(worker),
            discard: None,
            discard_reported: false,
            abandoned,
            local,
            finalize: local.then_some(finalize_sender),
        });
        Ok(id)
    }

    /// Requests cancellation for the current attempt.
    ///
    /// Cancellation is reported once by `poll`; it cannot interrupt a blocking
    /// system DNS resolver, so `start` remains busy until the worker completes.
    /// Returns false if `attempt_id` is not the active, undiscarded attempt.
    pub fn cancel(&mut self, attempt_id: AttemptId) -> bool {
        match self.active.as_mut() {
            Some(active) if active.id == attempt_id && active.discard.is_none() => {
                active.discard = Some(DiscardReason::Cancelled);
                active.abandoned.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// Wait for a local bootstrap worker on exit so an owned child cannot
    /// outlive this process while its cancelled result is being cleaned up.
    pub fn finish_on_exit(&mut self) {
        if let Some(mut active) = self.active.take() {
            active.abandoned.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
            if active.local {
                // The worker waits for this decision after publishing a local
                // result, so send discarded ownership back to it for cleanup.
                match active.receiver.try_recv() {
                    Ok(result) => finalize_discard(&mut active, result),
                    Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => {
                        if let Ok(result) = active.receiver.recv() {
                            finalize_discard(&mut active, result);
                        }
                    }
                    Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => {}
                }
                if let Some(worker) = active.worker.take() {
                    let _ = worker.join();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Polls without blocking. Timeout/cancel events are delivered once; while
    /// their worker is still running later calls return `InProgress` with
    /// `discarding_result: true`, then `Idle` once the worker exits.
    pub fn poll(&mut self) -> PollEvent {
        let Some(active) = self.active.as_mut() else {
            return PollEvent::Idle;
        };

        if let Some(reason) = active.discard {
            let finished = take_finished(active).is_some();
            if !active.discard_reported {
                active.discard_reported = true;
                let id = active.id;
                if finished {
                    self.active = None;
                }
                return match reason {
                    DiscardReason::TimedOut => PollEvent::TimedOut { attempt_id: id },
                    DiscardReason::Cancelled => PollEvent::Cancelled { attempt_id: id },
                };
            }
            if finished {
                self.active = None;
                return PollEvent::Idle;
            }
            return PollEvent::InProgress {
                attempt_id: active.id,
                discarding_result: true,
            };
        }

        match active.receiver.try_recv() {
            Ok(worker_result) => {
                let id = active.id;
                let on_time = worker_result.completed_at <= active.deadline;
                if !on_time {
                    if active.local {
                        active.discard = Some(DiscardReason::TimedOut);
                        active.discard_reported = true;
                        finalize_discard(active, worker_result);
                    } else {
                        drop(worker_result);
                        self.active = None;
                    }
                    return PollEvent::TimedOut { attempt_id: id };
                }
                let result = worker_result.result;
                if active.local {
                    if let Some(finalize) = active.finalize.take() {
                        let _ = finalize.send(WorkerFinalization::Accept);
                    }
                }
                self.active = None;
                match result {
                    Ok(connected) => PollEvent::Connected {
                        attempt_id: id,
                        stream: connected.stream,
                        local_server: connected.local_server,
                    },
                    Err(error) => PollEvent::Failed {
                        attempt_id: id,
                        error,
                    },
                }
            }
            Err(TryRecvError::Empty) if Instant::now() >= active.deadline => {
                active.discard = Some(DiscardReason::TimedOut);
                active.discard_reported = true;
                active.abandoned.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
                PollEvent::TimedOut {
                    attempt_id: active.id,
                }
            }
            Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => PollEvent::InProgress {
                attempt_id: active.id,
                discarding_result: false,
            },
            Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => {
                if !active.worker.as_ref().is_some_and(JoinHandle::is_finished) {
                    return PollEvent::InProgress {
                        attempt_id: active.id,
                        discarding_result: false,
                    };
                }
                let id = active.id;
                let panicked = active
                    .worker
                    .take()
                    .is_some_and(|worker| worker.join().is_err());
                self.active = None;
                PollEvent::Failed {
                    attempt_id: id,
                    error: io::Error::other(if panicked {
                        "connection worker panicked before returning a result"
                    } else {
                        "connection worker ended without returning a result"
                    }),
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn take_finished(active: &mut ActiveAttempt) -> Option<()> {
    match active.receiver.try_recv() {
        Ok(result) => {
            if active.local {
                finalize_discard(active, result);
                None
            } else {
                drop(result);
                Some(())
            }
        }
        Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected)
            if active.worker.as_ref().is_some_and(JoinHandle::is_finished) =>
        {
            if let Some(worker) = active.worker.take() {
                let _ = worker.join();
            }
            Some(())
        }
        Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => None,
        Err(TryRecvError::Empty) if active.worker.as_ref().is_some_and(JoinHandle::is_finished) => {
            if let Some(worker) = active.worker.take() {
                let _ = worker.join();
            }
            Some(())
        }
        Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => None,
    }
}

/// Returns a discarded local result to its worker so its guard is dropped
/// away from the polling thread.
fn finalize_discard(active: &mut ActiveAttempt, result: WorkerResult) {
    if let Some(finalize) = active.finalize.take() {
        let _ = finalize.send(WorkerFinalization::Discard(result));
    }
}

fn run_operation(operation: WorkerOperation, deadline: Instant) -> io::Result<ConnectedSocket> {
    if Instant::now() >= deadline {
        return Err(timed_out_error());
    }
    match operation {
        WorkerOperation::Remote(address) => Ok(ConnectedSocket {
            stream: connect_all(&address, deadline)?,
            local_server: None,
        }),
        WorkerOperation::Local {
            data_dir,
            map_path,
            world_definition_path,
            threads,
        } => {
            let (stream, local_server) = bootstrap::connect_or_start_until(
                &data_dir,
                map_path.as_deref(),
                world_definition_path.as_deref(),
                threads,
                deadline,
            )
            .map_err(|error| io::Error::other(format!("local server startup failed: {error}")))?;
            Ok(ConnectedSocket {
                stream,
                local_server: Some(local_server),
            })
        }
    }
}

fn connect_all(address: &str, deadline: Instant) -> io::Result<TcpStream> {
    if Instant::now() >= deadline {
        return Err(timed_out_error());
    }

    let addresses: Vec<SocketAddr> = address.to_socket_addrs()?.collect();
    if addresses.is_empty() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::AddrNotAvailable,
            format!("no socket addresses resolved for {address:?}"),
        ));
    }

    let mut last_error = None;
    let mut attempted = 0usize;
    for socket in addresses {
        let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        if remaining.is_zero() {
            return Err(timed_out_error());
        }
        attempted += 1;
        match TcpStream::connect_timeout(&socket, remaining) {
            Ok(stream) if Instant::now() < deadline => return Ok(stream),
            Ok(_) => return Err(timed_out_error()),
            Err(_error) if Instant::now() >= deadline => return Err(timed_out_error()),
            Err(error) => {
                last_error = Some(io::Error::new(
                    error.kind(),
                    format!("connection to {socket} failed: {error}"),
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    Err(last_error.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::AddrNotAvailable,
            format!("no socket address could be attempted for {address:?} ({attempted} tried)"),
        )
    }))
}

fn timed_out_error() -> io::Error {
    io::Error::new(
        io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
        "connection deadline expired during DNS or socket connection",
    )
}

pub(crate) fn format_utc(timestamp_ms: i64) -> String {
    let seconds = timestamp_ms.div_euclid(1_000);
    let days = seconds.div_euclid(86_400);
    let day_seconds = seconds.rem_euclid(86_400);
    let shifted = days + 719_468;
    let era = shifted.div_euclid(146_097);
    let day_of_era = shifted - era * 146_097;
    let year_of_era =
        (day_of_era - day_of_era / 1_460 + day_of_era / 36_524 - day_of_era / 146_096) / 365;
    let mut year = year_of_era + era * 400;
    let day_of_year = day_of_era - (365 * year_of_era + year_of_era / 4 - year_of_era / 100);
    let month_prime = (5 * day_of_year + 2) / 153;
    let day = day_of_year - (153 * month_prime + 2) / 5 + 1;
    let month = month_prime + if month_prime < 10 { 3 } else { -9 };
    year += if month <= 2 { 1 } else { 0 };
    let hour = day_seconds / 3_600;
    let minute = day_seconds % 3_600 / 60;
    let second = day_seconds % 60;
    format!("{year:04}-{month:02}-{day:02} {hour:02}:{minute:02}:{second:02} UTC")
}

            offline_policy: None,
            sample_age_real_ms: None,
            clock_offset_ms: None,

        }
    }

pub struct SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot {
    pub version: u32,
    fields: Vec<(&'static str, String)>,
}

impl SkyDiagnosticsSnapshot {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            version: SKY_DIAGNOSTICS_VERSION,
            fields: Vec::with_capacity(64),
        }
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, key: &'static str, value: impl ToString) {
        self.fields.push((key, value.to_string()));
    }

    pub fn push_optional<T: ToString>(&mut self, key: &'static str, value: Option<T>) {
        self.push(
            key,
            value.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| value.to_string()),
        );
    }

    pub fn lines(self) -> impl Iterator<Item = String> {
        let mut lines = Vec::with_capacity(self.fields.len().div_ceil(2) + 1);
        lines.push(format!("sky_diagnostics_version={}", self.version));
        for chunk in self.fields.chunks(2) {
            let line = chunk
                .iter()
                .map(|(key, value)| format!("{key}={value}"))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(" ");
            lines.push(line);
        }
        lines.into_iter()
    }
}

pub fn clock_status_line(
    clock: Option<ClockDiagnostics>,
    quality: SynchronizationQuality,
    revision: Option<u64>,
    utc_ms: Option<i64>,
    rate_ppm: Option<u64>,

    format!(
        "clock_source={} clock_id={} clock_revision={} clock_mode={} world_utc={} rate_ppm={} rate={} offline_policy={} sample_age_real_ms={} clock_offset_ms={} probe_rtt_ms={} clock_samples_accepted={} clock_samples_rejected={} clock_sync_state={}",
        clock.source.label(),
        display(clock.clock_id.map(|id| id.get())),
        display(revision),
        display(clock.mode.map(clock_mode_label)),
        utc_ms.map(format_utc_millis).unwrap_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned()),
        display(rate_ppm),
        rate_ppm.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |ppm| format!("{:.6}x", ppm as f64 / 1_000_000.0)),
        display(clock.offline_policy.map(offline_policy_label)),
        display(clock.sample_age_real_ms),
        clock.clock_offset_ms.map_or_else(|| "n/a".to_owned(), |value| format!("{value:.3}")),
        display(clock.probe_rtt_ms),
        display(clock.samples_accepted),
        display(clock.samples_rejected),
        quality.label(),
    )
}

    let millis = timestamp_ms.rem_euclid(1_000);

    let year_of_era =
        (day_of_era - day_of_era / 1_460 + day_of_era / 36_524 - day_of_era / 146_096) / 365;
    let mut year = year_of_era + era * 400;
    let day_of_year = day_of_era - (365 * year_of_era + year_of_era / 4 - year_of_era / 100);

//! Fixed-step local prediction around the shared simulation integrator.
use minimium_simulation::{
    CharacterInput, CharacterState, CollisionIndex, CollisionQuery, MovementSettings,
};
use minimium_world::world::{Position3Mm, WorldManifest};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct ClientPrediction {
    pub character: CharacterState,
    pub position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
    physics_accumulator: f32,
}

pub struct PredictedStep {
    pub input: CharacterInput,
    pub previous_state: CharacterState,
    pub previous_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
}

impl ClientPrediction {
    pub const fn new(character: CharacterState, position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>) -> Self {
        Self {
            character,
            position_mm,
            physics_accumulator: 0.0,
        }
    }

    pub fn accumulate_time(&mut self, delta_seconds: f32) {
        self.physics_accumulator += delta_seconds;
    }

    pub fn reset_time(&mut self) {
        self.physics_accumulator = 0.0;
    }

    pub fn reconcile_server(
        &mut self,
        server_position: [f32; 3],
        server_position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
        server_velocity: [f32; 3],
        grounded: bool,
    ) {
        if let Some(server_position_mm) = server_position_mm {
            if let Some(predicted_mm) = &mut self.position_mm {
                predicted_mm.0 = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                    (predicted_mm.0[axis] as f64 * 0.75 + server_position_mm.0[axis] as f64 * 0.25)
                        .round() as i64
                });
                self.character.position = predicted_mm.0.map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0);
            } else {
                self.position_mm = Some(server_position_mm);
                self.character.position = server_position_mm.0.map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0);
            }
        } else {
            self.character.position = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                self.character.position[axis] * 0.75 + server_position[axis] * 0.25
            });
            self.position_mm = None;
        }
        self.character.velocity = server_velocity;
        self.character.grounded = grounded;
    }

    /// Applies one fixed step and restores a non-fly character that would leave land.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn predict_next(
        &mut self,
        collision_index: &CollisionIndex,
        collision_query: &mut CollisionQuery,
        direction: [f32; 2],
        vertical: f32,
        movement: MovementSettings,
        jump_pending: bool,
        movement_enabled: bool,
        manifest: Option<WorldManifest>,
        geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
    ) -> Option<PredictedStep> {
        if self.physics_accumulator < minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS {
            return None;
        }
        let mut input = CharacterInput {
            direction: if movement_enabled {
                direction
            } else {
                [0.0; 2]
            },
            jump: jump_pending && movement_enabled,
            vertical: if movement_enabled { vertical } else { 0.0 },
            movement,
        };
        let previous_state = self.character;
        let previous_mm = self.position_mm;
        collision_query.fill_for_speed(
            collision_index,
            self.character,
            minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS,
            input.movement.speed,
        );
        if let Some(position_mm) = &mut self.position_mm {
            minimium_simulation::step_character_mm(
                &mut self.character,
                position_mm,
                input,
                collision_query.candidates(),
                collision_query.surface_candidates(),
                minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS,
            );
        } else {
            minimium_simulation::step_character(
                &mut self.character,
                input,
                collision_query.candidates(),
                collision_query.surface_candidates(),
                minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS,
            );
        }
        if !movement.fly
            && manifest.is_some_and(|manifest| {
                let position_mm = self.position_mm.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    Position3Mm(
                        self.character
                            .position
                            .map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                    )
                });
                !minimium_procgen::can_traverse_surface(manifest, position_mm, geography.as_deref())
            })
        {
            self.character = previous_state;
            self.position_mm = previous_mm;
            self.character.velocity = [0.0; 3];
            input = CharacterInput::default();
        }
        self.physics_accumulator -= minimium_simulation::SIMULATION_STEP_SECONDS;
        Some(PredictedStep {
            input,
            previous_state,
            previous_mm,
        })
    }
}
