//! Shared, nonblocking client-side protocol session for interactive clients.
//!
//! [`ClientSession`] owns the socket and bounded wire buffers, but deliberately
//! does not own a thread, event loop, or process. Call [`ClientSession::poll`]
//! from the host's loop and pass a reusable event vector to avoid allocating an
//! event collection on each frame. Events are appended; clear the vector before
//! polling if it should contain only the latest poll's events.

use minimium_core::identity::PlayerProfileId;
use minimium_environment::{time::ClockSample, EnvironmentDescriptor};
use minimium_protocol::{
    decode_server, encode_client, ClientMessage, ProtocolError, ServerMessage, WorldContext,
    MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
};
use minimium_world::world::TransitionId;
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    net::TcpStream,
    sync::Arc,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

mod clock;
mod content;
mod contextualize;
mod environment;
mod receive;

/// Maximum retained receive or pending send data.
pub const MAX_SESSION_BUFFER_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
/// Maximum amount read in a single poll, keeping UI loops responsive.
pub const MAX_SESSION_READ_BYTES_PER_POLL: usize = 16 * 1024;
pub const WELCOME_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
pub const HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
pub const HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SessionState {
    Disconnected,
    AwaitingWelcome,
    Connected,
}

/// A terminal reason for the current connection. The session is reset to
/// [`SessionState::Disconnected`] when one of these is emitted.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DisconnectReason {
    PeerClosed,
    ServerClosed,
    WelcomeTimeout,
    HeartbeatTimeout,
    Protocol(ProtocolError),
    UnexpectedMessage,
    Rejected(minimium_protocol::ServerErrorCode),
    MapMismatch { expected: u64, actual: u64 },
    GeneratorMismatch,
    EarthPackage(String),
    Materials(String),
    EnvironmentMismatch,
    Io(io::ErrorKind),
    BufferLimit,
}

/// Typed output from a session poll. Every valid server message is delivered
/// as `Message`; a matching Pong also produces `PingRoundTrip`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
// Session events are queued by value and consumed immediately after polling.
#[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)]
pub enum SessionEvent {
    Message(ServerMessage),
    PingRoundTrip(Duration),
    Disconnected(DisconnectReason),
}

/// Cumulative wire traffic metrics and the most recent measured ping RTT.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SessionMetrics {
    pub bytes_sent: u64,
    pub bytes_received: u64,
    pub ping_round_trip: Option<Duration>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum QueueError {
    Disconnected,
    AwaitingWelcome,
    IdentifyReserved,
    StaleWorldContext,
    BufferFull,
    Protocol(ProtocolError),
}

/// A single nonblocking TCP protocol session.
pub struct ClientSession {
    content: content::ContentPreparation,
    stream: Option<TcpStream>,
    state: SessionState,
    expected_map_fingerprint: u64,
    world_context: Option<WorldContext>,
    world_fingerprints: HashMap<minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId, u64>,
    pending_transition: Option<(TransitionId, WorldContext)>,
    ready_transition: Option<(TransitionId, WorldContext)>,
    clock_sample: Option<ClockSample>,
    environment_descriptor: Option<EnvironmentDescriptor>,
    pending_environment: Option<(
        TransitionId,
        WorldContext,
        ClockSample,
        EnvironmentDescriptor,
    )>,
    clock: clock::ClientClock,
    state_since: Instant,
    last_heartbeat_at: Instant,
    pending_ping_at: Option<Instant>,
    pending_ping_end: Option<usize>,
    receive_buffer: Vec<u8>,
    send_buffer: Vec<u8>,
    send_offset: usize,
    metrics: SessionMetrics,
    prepared_geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
}

impl ClientSession {
    /// Starts a fresh session, sets the supplied stream nonblocking, and queues
    /// the required Identify handshake frame. The first poll writes it.
    pub fn new(
        stream: TcpStream,
        profile_id: PlayerProfileId,
        expected_map_fingerprint: u64,
    ) -> io::Result<Self> {
        Self::with_presentation(stream, profile_id, expected_map_fingerprint, None)
    }

    pub fn with_presentation(
        stream: TcpStream,
        profile_id: PlayerProfileId,
        expected_map_fingerprint: u64,
        capability: Option<bool>,
    ) -> io::Result<Self> {
        stream.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        stream.set_nodelay(true)?;
        let now = Instant::now();
        let mut content = content::ContentPreparation::default();
        content.capability = capability;
        let mut session = Self {
            content,
            stream: Some(stream),
            state: SessionState::AwaitingWelcome,
            expected_map_fingerprint,
            world_context: None,
            world_fingerprints: HashMap::from([(
                minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(1)
                    .expect("primary world identifier is nonzero"),
                expected_map_fingerprint,
            )]),
            pending_transition: None,
            ready_transition: None,
            clock_sample: None,
            environment_descriptor: None,
            pending_environment: None,
            clock: clock::ClientClock::new(now),
            state_since: now,
            last_heartbeat_at: now,
            pending_ping_at: None,
            pending_ping_end: None,
            receive_buffer: Vec::with_capacity(MAX_SESSION_BUFFER_BYTES),
            send_buffer: Vec::with_capacity(MAX_SESSION_BUFFER_BYTES),
            send_offset: 0,
            metrics: SessionMetrics::default(),
            prepared_geography: None,
        };
        session
            .append_encoded(&ClientMessage::Presentation(capability))
            .expect("presentation frame is bounded");
        session
            .append_encoded(&ClientMessage::Identify(profile_id))
            .expect("Identify frame is within protocol limits");
        Ok(session)
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> SessionState {
        self.state
    }

    pub fn metrics(&self) -> SessionMetrics {
        self.metrics
    }

    pub fn prepared_geography(&self) -> Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>> {
        self.prepared_geography.clone()
    }

    #[allow(dead_code)] // E004-05 consumes the estimate input through this accessor.
    pub fn clock_sample(&self) -> Option<ClockSample> {
        self.clock_sample
    }

    #[allow(dead_code)] // E004-05 consumes this session identity in its clock estimator.
    pub fn environment_descriptor(&self) -> Option<EnvironmentDescriptor> {
        self.environment_descriptor
    }

    pub fn environment_frame(&self) -> crate::environment::EnvironmentFrameInput {
        self.clock.frame()
    }

    pub fn set_world_fingerprints(
        &mut self,
        fingerprints: HashMap<minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId, u64>,
    ) {
        self.world_fingerprints = fingerprints;
    }

    pub fn cancel_pending_transition(&mut self) -> bool {
        let Some((transition_id, _)) = self.pending_transition else {
            return false;
        };
        self.queue(&ClientMessage::CancelTransition(transition_id))
            .is_ok()
    }

    pub fn queue_transition_ready(
        &mut self,
        transition_id: TransitionId,
        target_context: WorldContext,
    ) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
        let transition = (transition_id, target_context);
        if self.pending_transition != Some(transition) {
            return Err(QueueError::StaleWorldContext);
        }
        if self.ready_transition == Some(transition) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.queue(&ClientMessage::TransitionReady {
            transition_id,
            target_context,
        })?;
        self.ready_transition = Some(transition);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Close the current socket and discard all buffered data.
    pub fn close(&mut self) {
        self.content = Default::default();
        self.stream = None;
        self.state = SessionState::Disconnected;
        self.pending_ping_at = None;
        self.pending_ping_end = None;
        self.world_context = None;
        self.pending_transition = None;
        self.ready_transition = None;
        self.clock_sample = None;
        self.environment_descriptor = None;
        self.pending_environment = None;
        self.clock.reset();
        self.receive_buffer.clear();
        self.send_buffer.clear();
        self.send_offset = 0;
    }

    /// Queues an application message. Identify is reserved for construction;
    /// all other messages are accepted only after Welcome. A full bounded send
    /// buffer is reported without disconnecting so the caller can retry.
    pub fn queue(&mut self, message: &ClientMessage) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
        match self.state {
            SessionState::Disconnected => return Err(QueueError::Disconnected),
            SessionState::AwaitingWelcome => return Err(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome),
            SessionState::Connected => {}
        }
        if matches!(message, ClientMessage::Identify(_)) {
            return Err(QueueError::IdentifyReserved);
        }
        let contextual = contextualize::contextualize(message, self.world_context)?;
        let frame =
            encode_client(contextual.as_ref().unwrap_or(message)).map_err(QueueError::Protocol)?;
        self.append_frame(&frame)
            .map_err(|()| QueueError::BufferFull)?;
        if matches!(message, ClientMessage::Ping)
            && self.pending_ping_at.is_none()
            && self.pending_ping_end.is_none()
        {
            self.pending_ping_end = Some(self.send_buffer.len());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn manifest_matches_generator(manifest: &minimium_world::world::WorldManifest) -> bool {
    manifest.generator_digest()
        == minimium_procgen::generator_digest(manifest.topology(), manifest.generation())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use minimium_protocol::ClientWorldInput;
    use minimium_world::world::{
        GeneratorDigest, MembershipEpoch, WorldContentRevision, WorldInstanceId,
    };

    fn context(epoch: u64) -> WorldContext {
        WorldContext::new(
            WorldInstanceId::new(1).unwrap(),
            WorldContentRevision::new(1).unwrap(),
            MembershipEpoch::new(epoch).unwrap(),
        )
    }

    fn connected_session(context: WorldContext) -> ClientSession {
        let now = Instant::now();
        ClientSession {
            content: Default::default(),
            stream: None,
            state: SessionState::Connected,
            expected_map_fingerprint: 1,
            world_context: Some(context),
            world_fingerprints: HashMap::new(),
            pending_transition: None,
            ready_transition: None,
            clock_sample: None,
            environment_descriptor: None,
            pending_environment: None,
            clock: clock::ClientClock::new(now),
            state_since: now,
            last_heartbeat_at: now,
            pending_ping_at: None,
            pending_ping_end: None,
            receive_buffer: Vec::new(),
            send_buffer: Vec::new(),
            send_offset: 0,
            metrics: SessionMetrics::default(),
            prepared_geography: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn world_inputs_from_a_previous_membership_epoch_are_rejected() {
        let current = context(8);
        let old = context(7);
        let mut session = connected_session(current);
        let input = ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: old,
            input: ClientWorldInput::UsePortal,
        };
        assert_eq!(session.queue(&input), Err(QueueError::StaleWorldContext));

        let current_input = ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current,
            input: ClientWorldInput::UsePortal,
        };
        assert_eq!(session.queue(&current_input), Ok(()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn client_rejects_a_manifest_with_an_unknown_generator_digest() {
        let generated = minimium_game_sample::generate_demo_worlds().unwrap();
        let manifest = generated[0].manifest;
        assert!(manifest_matches_generator(&manifest));
        let mismatched = minimium_world::world::WorldManifest::new(
            manifest.definition_id(),
            manifest.topology(),
            manifest.generation(),
            manifest.content_revision(),
            GeneratorDigest::new([0xff; 32]),
        );
        assert!(!manifest_matches_generator(&mismatched));
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/session/clock.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="469" bytes="17158" original_lines="469" original_bytes="17158" minified="false" sha256="990290c96abcdf5c72973de9cdfaee9f8d76340cacd97a6c6f25445a2ed26c07">>>
use super::{ClientSession, QueueError, SessionState};
use crate::environment::{EnvironmentFrameInput, SynchronizationQuality};
use diagnostics::clock_diagnostics;
use estimate::{
    estimate_key, estimate_welcome_time, estimate_world_time, rounded_time, EstimateKey,
    OffsetSample,
};
use minimium_environment::{time::ClockSample, EnvironmentDescriptor};
use minimium_protocol::ClientMessage;
use smoothing::SmoothInput;
use std::{collections::VecDeque, time::Instant};

mod diagnostics;
mod estimate;
mod smoothing;

impl ClientSession {
    pub(super) fn queue_due_time_probe(&mut self, now_ms: u64) {
        if self.state() != SessionState::Connected {
            return;
        }
        let Some(sequence) = self.clock.due_probe_sequence(now_ms) else {
            return;
        };
        // Capture t1 immediately before the probe is encoded and queued.
        let sent_at_ms = self.clock.local_monotonic_ms();
        let result = self.queue(&ClientMessage::TimeProbe {
            seq: sequence,
            client_send_monotonic_ms: sent_at_ms,
        });
        match result {
            Ok(()) => self.clock.probe_queued(sequence, sent_at_ms),
            Err(error) => self.clock.defer_probe_after_queue_error(now_ms, error),
        }
    }
}

const BOOTSTRAP_INTERVAL_MS: u64 = 1_000;
const NORMAL_INTERVAL_MS: u64 = 5_000;
const PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS: u64 = 2_000;
const MAX_FILTER_AGE_MS: u64 = 60_000;
const STALE_AGE_MS: u64 = 15_000;
const UNAVAILABLE_AGE_MS: u64 = 60_000;
const MAX_PROBE_RTT_MS: i128 = 2_000;
const MAX_OFFSET_SAMPLES: usize = 8;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct InflightProbe {
    sequence: u32,
    sent_at_ms: u64,
}

/// Owns all per-connection monotonic clock estimation and render-date smoothing.
pub(super) struct ClientClock {
    epoch: Instant,
    session_nonce: Option<minimium_environment::time::SessionNonce>,
    probe_baseline_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    sample_received_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    last_poll_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    next_probe_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    next_sequence: u32,
    inflight: Option<InflightProbe>,
    valid_probe_count: u32,
    accepted_probe_count: u64,
    rejected_probe_count: u64,
    last_valid_probe_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    offsets: VecDeque<OffsetSample>,
    previous_input: Option<EstimateKey>,
    previous_revision: Option<u64>,
    previous_frame_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    previous_render_world_ms: Option<f64>,
    smoothing_bias_ms: f64,
    smoothing_started_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    resync_stale_until_ms: Option<u64>,
    last_diagnostic_at_ms: Option<u64>,
    frame: EnvironmentFrameInput,
}

impl ClientClock {
    pub(super) fn new(epoch: Instant) -> Self {
        Self {
            epoch,
            session_nonce: None,
            probe_baseline_at_ms: None,
            sample_received_at_ms: None,
            last_poll_at_ms: None,
            next_probe_at_ms: None,
            next_sequence: 1,
            inflight: None,
            valid_probe_count: 0,
            accepted_probe_count: 0,
            rejected_probe_count: 0,
            last_valid_probe_at_ms: None,
            offsets: VecDeque::with_capacity(MAX_OFFSET_SAMPLES),
            previous_input: None,
            previous_revision: None,
            previous_frame_at_ms: None,
            previous_render_world_ms: None,
            smoothing_bias_ms: 0.0,
            smoothing_started_at_ms: None,
            resync_stale_until_ms: None,
            last_diagnostic_at_ms: None,
            frame: EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable(),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn frame(&self) -> EnvironmentFrameInput {
        self.frame
    }

    pub(super) fn local_monotonic_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        u64::try_from(self.epoch.elapsed().as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX)
    }

    pub(super) fn begin_session(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) {
        let epoch = self.epoch;
        *self = Self::new(epoch);
        let now_ms = self.local_monotonic_ms();
        self.session_nonce = Some(sample.session_nonce());
        self.probe_baseline_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
        self.sample_received_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
        self.last_poll_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
        self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
    }

    pub(super) fn note_sample(&mut self, _sample: ClockSample) {
        self.sample_received_at_ms = Some(self.local_monotonic_ms());
    }

    pub(super) fn session_nonce_matches(
        &self,
        nonce: minimium_environment::time::SessionNonce,
    ) -> bool {
        self.session_nonce == Some(nonce)
    }

    pub(super) fn observe_poll(&mut self, now_ms: u64) {
        if self
            .last_poll_at_ms
            .is_some_and(|last| now_ms.saturating_sub(last) > 10_000)
        {
            self.offsets.clear();
            self.inflight = None;
            self.valid_probe_count = 0;
            self.last_valid_probe_at_ms = None;
            self.probe_baseline_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
            self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
            self.reset_smoothing();
            self.diagnostic(now_ms, "poll_gap_reset");
        }
        self.last_poll_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
        if self
            .inflight
            .is_some_and(|probe| now_ms.saturating_sub(probe.sent_at_ms) >= PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS)
        {
            self.rejected_probe_count = self.rejected_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
            self.inflight = None;
            self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(now_ms.saturating_add(self.probe_interval_ms()));
            self.diagnostic(now_ms, "probe_timeout");
        }
        self.prune_offsets(now_ms);
    }

    pub(super) fn due_probe_sequence(&self, now_ms: u64) -> Option<u32> {
        if self.session_nonce.is_none()
            || self.inflight.is_some()
            || !self.next_probe_at_ms.is_some_and(|due| now_ms >= due)
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(self.next_sequence)
    }

    pub(super) fn probe_queued(&mut self, sequence: u32, sent_at_ms: u64) {
        self.inflight = Some(InflightProbe {
            sequence,
            sent_at_ms,
        });
        self.next_sequence = sequence.wrapping_add(1);
        self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(sent_at_ms.saturating_add(self.probe_interval_ms()));
    }

    pub(super) fn defer_probe_after_queue_error(&mut self, now_ms: u64, error: QueueError) {
        if error == QueueError::BufferFull {
            // Retry later without occupying the one in-flight slot.
            self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(now_ms.saturating_add(100));
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn accept_probe_reply(
        &mut self,
        sequence: u32,
        echoed_client_send_ms: u64,
        server_receive_ms: u64,
        server_send_ms: u64,
        received_at_ms: u64,
    ) {
        let Some(inflight) = self.inflight else {
            self.rejected_probe_count = self.rejected_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
            self.diagnostic(received_at_ms, "stale_reply_without_probe");
            return;
        };
        if sequence != inflight.sequence {
            self.rejected_probe_count = self.rejected_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
            self.diagnostic(received_at_ms, "stale_reply_sequence");
            return;
        }
        if echoed_client_send_ms != inflight.sent_at_ms {
            self.rejected_probe_count = self.rejected_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
            self.diagnostic(received_at_ms, "probe_echo_mismatch");
            return;
        }
        if received_at_ms < inflight.sent_at_ms || server_send_ms < server_receive_ms {
            self.finish_invalid_probe(received_at_ms, "invalid_probe_timestamps");
            return;
        }

        let Some(round_trip_ms) = i128::from(received_at_ms)
            .checked_sub(i128::from(inflight.sent_at_ms))
            .and_then(|outbound| {
                i128::from(server_send_ms)
                    .checked_sub(i128::from(server_receive_ms))
                    .and_then(|processing| outbound.checked_sub(processing))
            })
        else {
            self.finish_invalid_probe(received_at_ms, "probe_rtt_overflow");
            return;
        };
        if !(0..=MAX_PROBE_RTT_MS).contains(&round_trip_ms) {
            self.finish_invalid_probe(received_at_ms, "probe_rtt_out_of_range");
            return;
        }
        let Some(offset_twice_ms) = i128::from(server_receive_ms)
            .checked_sub(i128::from(inflight.sent_at_ms))
            .and_then(|first| {
                i128::from(server_send_ms)
                    .checked_sub(i128::from(received_at_ms))
                    .and_then(|second| first.checked_add(second))
            })
        else {
            self.finish_invalid_probe(received_at_ms, "probe_offset_overflow");
            return;
        };
        self.inflight = None;
        self.valid_probe_count = self.valid_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
        self.accepted_probe_count = self.accepted_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
        self.last_valid_probe_at_ms = Some(received_at_ms);
        if self.valid_probe_count == 4 {
            self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(received_at_ms.saturating_add(NORMAL_INTERVAL_MS));
        }
        self.offsets.push_back(OffsetSample {
            offset_twice_ms,
            rtt_ms: round_trip_ms as u64,
            received_at_ms,
        });
        while self.offsets.len() > MAX_OFFSET_SAMPLES {
            self.offsets.pop_front();
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn reset(&mut self) {
        *self = Self::new(Instant::now());
    }

    pub(super) fn update_frame(
        &mut self,
        sample: Option<ClockSample>,
        descriptor: Option<EnvironmentDescriptor>,
        context: Option<minimium_protocol::WorldContext>,
        now_ms: u64,
    ) {
        let (Some(sample), Some(descriptor), Some(nonce)) =
            (sample, descriptor, self.session_nonce)
        else {
            self.reset_frame_only();
            return;
        };
        if sample.session_nonce() != nonce || descriptor.clock_id() != sample.clock_id() {
            self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
            self.reset_smoothing();
            return;
        }

        self.prune_offsets(now_ms);
        let clock_diagnostics = Some(clock_diagnostics(self, sample, now_ms));
        let offset = self.best_offset();
        let mut quality = self.quality(sample, descriptor, now_ms);
        if quality == SynchronizationQuality::Unavailable {
            self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput {
                estimated_world_utc_ms: None,
                render_world_utc_ms: None,
                descriptor: Some(descriptor),
                context,
                revision: Some(sample.revision().get()),
                rate_ppm: Some(sample.rate_ppm().get()),
                quality,
                clock_diagnostics,
            };
            self.reset_smoothing();
            return;
        }
        let sample_received_at_ms = self.sample_received_at_ms.unwrap_or(now_ms);
        let (raw_world_ms, before_anchor) = if let Some(offset) = offset {
            match estimate_world_time(sample, now_ms, offset) {
                Some(estimate) => estimate,
                None => {
                    self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput {
                        estimated_world_utc_ms: None,
                        render_world_utc_ms: None,
                        descriptor: Some(descriptor),
                        context,
                        revision: Some(sample.revision().get()),
                        rate_ppm: Some(sample.rate_ppm().get()),
                        quality: SynchronizationQuality::Unavailable,
                        clock_diagnostics,
                    };
                    self.reset_smoothing();
                    return;
                }
            }
        } else if let Some(estimate) = estimate_welcome_time(sample, now_ms, sample_received_at_ms)
        {
            (estimate, false)
        } else {
            self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput {
                estimated_world_utc_ms: None,
                render_world_utc_ms: None,
                descriptor: Some(descriptor),
                context,
                revision: Some(sample.revision().get()),
                rate_ppm: Some(sample.rate_ppm().get()),
                quality: SynchronizationQuality::Unavailable,
                clock_diagnostics,
            };
            self.reset_smoothing();
            return;
        };
        if before_anchor && quality != SynchronizationQuality::Stale {
            quality = SynchronizationQuality::Initializing;
        }

        let revision = sample.revision().get();
        let key = estimate_key(sample, offset);
        let changed = self.previous_input != Some(key);
        let is_new_revision = self
            .previous_revision
            .is_some_and(|previous| revision > previous);
        if self
            .previous_revision
            .is_some_and(|previous| revision < previous)
        {
            self.diagnostic(now_ms, "stale_clock_revision");
            self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
            self.reset_smoothing();
            return;
        }
        let dt_s = self.frame_delta_seconds(now_ms);
        let rendered = self.smooth_date(SmoothInput {
            raw_world_ms,
            rate_ppm: sample.rate_ppm().get(),
            revision,
            changed,
            is_new_revision,
            before_anchor,
            now_ms,
            dt_s: if changed && !is_new_revision {
                0.0
            } else {
                dt_s
            },
        });
        if self
            .resync_stale_until_ms
            .is_some_and(|until| now_ms < until)
        {
            quality = SynchronizationQuality::Stale;
        }
        self.previous_input = Some(key);
        self.previous_revision = Some(revision);
        self.previous_frame_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
        self.previous_render_world_ms = Some(rendered);
        let (Some(estimated_world_utc_ms), Some(render_world_utc_ms)) =
            (rounded_time(raw_world_ms), rounded_time(rendered))
        else {
            self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
            self.reset_smoothing();
            return;
        };
        self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput {
            estimated_world_utc_ms: Some(estimated_world_utc_ms),
            render_world_utc_ms: Some(render_world_utc_ms),
            descriptor: Some(descriptor),
            context,
            revision: Some(revision),
            rate_ppm: Some(sample.rate_ppm().get()),
            quality,
            clock_diagnostics,
        };
    }

    fn quality(
        &self,
        sample: ClockSample,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
        now_ms: u64,
    ) -> SynchronizationQuality {
        let sample_age = now_ms.saturating_sub(self.sample_received_at_ms.unwrap_or(now_ms));
        let probe_at = self.last_valid_probe_at_ms.or(self.probe_baseline_at_ms);
        let probe_age = now_ms.saturating_sub(probe_at.unwrap_or(now_ms));
        if descriptor.clock_id() != sample.clock_id()
            || sample_age > UNAVAILABLE_AGE_MS
            || probe_age > UNAVAILABLE_AGE_MS
            || self.last_valid_probe_at_ms.is_some() && self.best_offset().is_none()
        {
            return SynchronizationQuality::Unavailable;
        }
        if sample_age > STALE_AGE_MS || probe_age > STALE_AGE_MS {
            return SynchronizationQuality::Stale;
        }
        if self.valid_probe_count >= 4 && self.best_offset().is_some() {
            SynchronizationQuality::Synchronized
        } else {
            SynchronizationQuality::Initializing
        }
    }

    fn best_offset(&self) -> Option<OffsetSample> {
        self.offsets.iter().copied().min_by(|left, right| {
            left.rtt_ms
                .cmp(&right.rtt_ms)
                .then_with(|| right.received_at_ms.cmp(&left.received_at_ms))
        })
    }

    fn prune_offsets(&mut self, now_ms: u64) {
        self.offsets
            .retain(|sample| now_ms.saturating_sub(sample.received_at_ms) <= MAX_FILTER_AGE_MS);
    }

    fn probe_interval_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        if self.valid_probe_count < 4 {
            BOOTSTRAP_INTERVAL_MS
        } else {
            NORMAL_INTERVAL_MS
        }
    }

    fn finish_invalid_probe(&mut self, now_ms: u64, reason: &'static str) {
        self.rejected_probe_count = self.rejected_probe_count.saturating_add(1);
        self.inflight = None;
        self.next_probe_at_ms = Some(now_ms.saturating_add(self.probe_interval_ms()));
        self.diagnostic(now_ms, reason);
    }

    fn diagnostic(&mut self, now_ms: u64, reason: &'static str) {
        let log_allowed = self
            .last_diagnostic_at_ms
            .is_none_or(|previous| now_ms.saturating_sub(previous) >= 1_000);
        if log_allowed {
            eprintln!("clock_probe_ignored reason={reason}");
            self.last_diagnostic_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
        }
    }

    fn reset_frame_only(&mut self) {
        self.frame = EnvironmentFrameInput::unavailable();
        self.reset_smoothing();
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/session/clock/estimate.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="89" bytes="3549" original_lines="89" original_bytes="3549" minified="false" sha256="23d27ee3ac2dd3479a6101c307273ad308f89d95c1e736ec68265d03c8f31572">>>
use super::ClockSample;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) struct EstimateKey {
    revision: u64,
    anchor_monotonic_ms: u64,
    anchor_world_utc_ms: i64,
    rate_ppm: u64,
    mode: u8,
    offline_policy: u8,
    offset_twice_ms: Option<i128>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) struct OffsetSample {
    /// Twice the offset in milliseconds, preserving half-millisecond results.
    pub(super) offset_twice_ms: i128,
    pub(super) rtt_ms: u64,
    pub(super) received_at_ms: u64,
}

pub(super) fn estimate_key(sample: ClockSample, offset: Option<OffsetSample>) -> EstimateKey {
    EstimateKey {
        revision: sample.revision().get(),
        anchor_monotonic_ms: sample.server_monotonic_ms().get(),
        anchor_world_utc_ms: sample.world_utc_ms().get(),
        rate_ppm: sample.rate_ppm().get(),
        mode: sample.mode() as u8,
        offline_policy: sample.offline_policy() as u8,
        offset_twice_ms: offset.map(|sample| sample.offset_twice_ms),
    }
}

/// Welcome and environment samples provide a bounded, latency-uncorrected anchor.
pub(super) fn estimate_welcome_time(
    sample: ClockSample,
    local_monotonic_ms: u64,
    sample_received_at_ms: u64,
) -> Option<f64> {
    let elapsed_ms = i128::from(local_monotonic_ms.saturating_sub(sample_received_at_ms));
    let scaled = elapsed_ms.checked_mul(i128::from(sample.rate_ppm().get()))?;
    let integer_delta = scaled.div_euclid(1_000_000);
    let remainder = scaled.rem_euclid(1_000_000);
    let world_integer = i128::from(sample.world_utc_ms().get()).checked_add(integer_delta)?;
    if world_integer < i128::from(minimium_environment::time::MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS)
        || world_integer >= i128::from(minimium_environment::time::MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE)
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some(world_integer as f64 + remainder as f64 / 1_000_000.0)
}

pub(super) fn estimate_world_time(
    sample: ClockSample,
    local_monotonic_ms: u64,
    offset: OffsetSample,
) -> Option<(f64, bool)> {
    let estimated_server_twice = i128::from(local_monotonic_ms)
        .checked_mul(2)?
        .checked_add(offset.offset_twice_ms)?;
    let anchor_twice = i128::from(sample.server_monotonic_ms().get()).checked_mul(2)?;
    let elapsed_twice = estimated_server_twice.checked_sub(anchor_twice)?;
    let before_anchor = elapsed_twice < 0;
    let elapsed_twice = elapsed_twice.max(0);
    let world_delta_numerator = elapsed_twice.checked_mul(i128::from(sample.rate_ppm().get()))?;
    let world_delta_integer_ms = world_delta_numerator.div_euclid(2_000_000);
    let world_remainder = world_delta_numerator.rem_euclid(2_000_000);
    let world_ms_integer =
        i128::from(sample.world_utc_ms().get()).checked_add(world_delta_integer_ms)?;
    if world_ms_integer < i128::from(minimium_environment::time::MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS)
        || world_ms_integer >= i128::from(minimium_environment::time::MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE)
    {
        return None;
    }
    let world_ms = world_ms_integer as f64 + world_remainder as f64 / 2_000_000.0;
    Some((world_ms, before_anchor))
}

pub(super) fn rounded_time(world_ms: f64) -> Option<i64> {
    let rounded = world_ms.round();
    if !rounded.is_finite()
        || rounded < minimium_environment::time::MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS as f64
        || rounded >= minimium_environment::time::MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE as f64
    {
        None
    } else {
        Some(rounded as i64)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/session/clock/smoothing.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="108" bytes="4206" original_lines="108" original_bytes="4206" minified="false" sha256="c67d29b67926431384ffc31b02bbff77ba039e660369268ca0eac38cc47aef40">>>
use super::ClientClock;

const MAX_FRAME_DELTA_S: f64 = 0.25;
const SMOOTHING_TAU_S: f64 = 2.0;
const MAX_SMOOTHING_EPISODE_MS: u64 = 30_000;

pub(super) struct SmoothInput {
    pub(super) raw_world_ms: f64,
    pub(super) rate_ppm: u64,
    pub(super) revision: u64,
    pub(super) changed: bool,
    pub(super) is_new_revision: bool,
    pub(super) before_anchor: bool,
    pub(super) now_ms: u64,
    pub(super) dt_s: f64,
}

impl ClientClock {
    pub(super) fn smooth_date(&mut self, input: SmoothInput) -> f64 {
        let SmoothInput {
            raw_world_ms,
            rate_ppm,
            revision,
            changed,
            is_new_revision,
            before_anchor,
            now_ms,
            dt_s,
        } = input;
        let rate = rate_ppm as f64 / 1_000_000.0;
        if is_new_revision || self.previous_revision.is_none() {
            self.smoothing_bias_ms = 0.0;
            self.smoothing_started_at_ms = None;
            self.resync_stale_until_ms = None;
            return raw_world_ms;
        }
        if before_anchor {
            return self.previous_render_world_ms.unwrap_or(raw_world_ms);
        }
        if changed {
            if let (Some(previous_render), Some(previous_at)) =
                (self.previous_render_world_ms, self.previous_frame_at_ms)
            {
                let elapsed_ms = now_ms.saturating_sub(previous_at) as f64;
                let predicted = previous_render + elapsed_ms * rate;
                let error = raw_world_ms - predicted;
                let threshold = 1_000.0_f64.max(2_000.0 * rate);
                if error.abs() <= threshold {
                    self.smoothing_bias_ms = predicted - raw_world_ms;
                    if self.smoothing_bias_ms.abs() > 0.5 && self.smoothing_started_at_ms.is_none()
                    {
                        self.smoothing_started_at_ms = Some(now_ms);
                    }
                } else {
                    self.smoothing_bias_ms = 0.0;
                    self.smoothing_started_at_ms = None;
                    self.resync_stale_until_ms = Some(now_ms.saturating_add(2_000));
                    eprintln!(
                        "clock_resync revision={revision} error_world_ms={:.1}",
                        error
                    );
                    return raw_world_ms;
                }
            }
        }
        if rate == 0.0 {
            self.smoothing_bias_ms = 0.0;
            self.smoothing_started_at_ms = None;
            return raw_world_ms;
        }
        if self
            .smoothing_started_at_ms
            .is_some_and(|started| now_ms.saturating_sub(started) >= MAX_SMOOTHING_EPISODE_MS)
            && self.smoothing_bias_ms.abs() > 0.5
        {
            self.smoothing_bias_ms = 0.0;
            self.smoothing_started_at_ms = None;
            self.resync_stale_until_ms = Some(now_ms.saturating_add(2_000));
            eprintln!("clock_resync revision={revision} reason=smoothing_timeout");
            return raw_world_ms;
        }
        let correction = self.smoothing_bias_ms * (1.0 - (-dt_s / SMOOTHING_TAU_S).exp());
        let maximum_step = 0.1 * rate * 1_000.0 * dt_s;
        let applied = correction.abs().min(maximum_step) * correction.signum();
        self.smoothing_bias_ms -= applied;
        if self.smoothing_bias_ms.abs() <= 0.5 {
            self.smoothing_bias_ms = 0.0;
            self.smoothing_started_at_ms = None;
        }
        raw_world_ms + self.smoothing_bias_ms
    }

    pub(super) fn frame_delta_seconds(&self, now_ms: u64) -> f64 {
        self.previous_frame_at_ms.map_or(0.0, |previous| {
            (now_ms.saturating_sub(previous) as f64 / 1_000.0).min(MAX_FRAME_DELTA_S)
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn reset_smoothing(&mut self) {
        self.previous_input = None;
        self.previous_revision = None;
        self.previous_frame_at_ms = None;
        self.previous_render_world_ms = None;
        self.smoothing_bias_ms = 0.0;
        self.smoothing_started_at_ms = None;
        self.resync_stale_until_ms = None;
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/session/content.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="144" bytes="4921" original_lines="144" original_bytes="4921" minified="false" sha256="6236c442a78bb8e98bece4c64e67de187d83824fcb052adb8527c5cdde14bd3b">>>
//! Content preparation has its own five-minute deadline, independent of Welcome.
use super::*;
use minimium_asset_io::{
    material_http,
    materials::{self, MaterialPackage},
};
use minimium_environment::climate::ClimateScenario;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::{path::PathBuf, thread::JoinHandle};

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct ContentPreparation {
    pub capability: Option<bool>,
    pub started: Option<Instant>,
    pub hash: [u8; 32],
    pub climate: Arc<ClimateScenario>,
    pub awaiting_gpu: bool,
    pub package: Option<MaterialPackage>,
    pub(super) worker: Option<JoinHandle<Result<MaterialPackage, String>>>,
    pub(super) cancel: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

impl Drop for ContentPreparation {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.cancel.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

impl ClientSession {
    pub fn climate_scenario(&self) -> Arc<ClimateScenario> {
        self.content.climate.clone()
    }
    pub fn content_awaiting_gpu(&self) -> bool {
        self.content.awaiting_gpu
    }
    pub fn take_material_package(&mut self) -> Option<MaterialPackage> {
        self.content.package.take()
    }

    /// The presentation host acknowledges only after successful GPU installation.
    pub fn finish_content(&mut self) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
        if !self.content.awaiting_gpu {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        self.append_encoded(&ClientMessage::ContentReady(self.content.hash))?;
        self.content.awaiting_gpu = false;
        self.content.started = None;
        self.state_since = Instant::now();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn begin_content(
        &mut self,
        hash: [u8; 32],
        port: u16,
        climate: ClimateScenario,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.state != SessionState::AwaitingWelcome
            || self.content.started.is_some()
            || self.content.capability.is_none()
        {
            return Err("unexpected content offer".into());
        }
        climate.validate()?;
        self.content.climate = Arc::new(climate);
        self.content.started = Some(Instant::now());
        self.content.hash = hash;
        if hash == [0; 32] {
            self.content.awaiting_gpu = true;
            return Ok(());
        }
        if port == 0 {
            return Err("required material package has no HTTP endpoint".into());
        }
        let mut endpoint = self
            .stream
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or("missing game socket")?
            .peer_addr()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        endpoint.set_port(port);
        let compressed = self.content.capability.unwrap();
        let cache = std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(".minimium-local"))
            .join("minimium/materials");
        let expected: String = hash.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
        let cancel = self.content.cancel.clone();
        self.content.worker = Some(
            std::thread::Builder::new()
                .name("material-download".into())
                .spawn(move || {
                    let mut manifest = Vec::new();
                    material_http::fetch_cancellable(
                        endpoint,
                        "manifest.ron",
                        minimium_assets::terrain_material::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES as u64,
                        &mut manifest,
                        || cancel.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
                    )?;
                    materials::install(
                        &cache,
                        &manifest,
                        &expected,
                        compressed,
                        |name, size, out| {
                            material_http::fetch_cancellable(endpoint, name, size, out, || {
                                cancel.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
                            })
                        },
                    )
                })
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn poll_content(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self
            .content
            .started
            .is_some_and(|start| start.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(300))
        {
            return Err("material preparation deadline exceeded; reconnect to retry".into());
        }
        if self
            .content
            .worker
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|worker| worker.is_finished())
        {
            let package = self
                .content
                .worker
                .take()
                .unwrap()
                .join()
                .map_err(|_| "material worker stopped")??;
            self.content.package = Some(package);
            self.content.awaiting_gpu = true;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

use super::QueueError;
use minimium_protocol::{ClientMessage, ClientWorldInput, WorldContext};

pub(super) fn contextualize(
    message: &ClientMessage,
    current_context: Option<WorldContext>,
) -> Result<Option<ClientMessage>, QueueError> {
    let contextual = match message {
        ClientMessage::Motion(input) => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::Motion(*input),
        }),
        ClientMessage::SetName(name) => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::SetName(name.clone()),
        }),
        ClientMessage::Move { direction, jump } => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::Move {
                direction: *direction,
                jump: *jump,
            },
        }),
        ClientMessage::Fire { direction } => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::Fire {
                direction: *direction,
            },
        }),
        ClientMessage::SetAltitude { km } => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::SetAltitude { km: *km },
        }),
        ClientMessage::MapTeleport { direction } => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::MapTeleport {
                direction: *direction,
            },
        }),
        ClientMessage::Chat(text) => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::Chat(text.clone()),
        }),
        ClientMessage::UsePortal => Some(ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context: current_context.ok_or(QueueError::AwaitingWelcome)?,
            input: ClientWorldInput::UsePortal,
        }),
        ClientMessage::WorldInput { context, .. } if Some(*context) != current_context => {
            return Err(QueueError::StaleWorldContext);
        }
        _ => None,
    };
    Ok(contextual)
}

use super::{ClientSession, DisconnectReason};
use minimium_environment::{
    time::{validate_sample_after, ClockSample},
    {AstronomyModelRevision, CatalogueId, EnvironmentDescriptor, EnvironmentProfile},
};
use minimium_protocol::WorldContext;
use minimium_world::world::{WorldManifest, WorldTopology};

impl ClientSession {
    pub(super) fn install_initial_environment(
        &mut self,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        sample: ClockSample,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    ) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
        validate_descriptor(manifest, sample, descriptor)?;
        self.validate_sample_progress(sample)?;
        self.clock_sample = Some(sample);
        self.environment_descriptor = Some(descriptor);
        self.pending_environment = None;
        self.clock.begin_session(sample);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn prepare_environment(
        &mut self,
        transition_id: minimium_world::world::TransitionId,
        context: WorldContext,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        sample: ClockSample,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    ) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
        validate_descriptor(manifest, sample, descriptor)?;
        self.validate_sample_progress(sample)?;
        self.pending_environment = Some((transition_id, context, sample, descriptor));
        self.clock_sample = Some(sample);
        self.clock.note_sample(sample);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn commit_environment(
        &mut self,
        transition_id: minimium_world::world::TransitionId,
        context: WorldContext,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        sample: ClockSample,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    ) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
        if !self
            .pending_environment
            .is_some_and(|(pending_id, pending_context, _, pending)| {
                pending_id == transition_id && pending_context == context && pending == descriptor
            })
        {
            return Err(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch);
        }
        validate_descriptor(manifest, sample, descriptor)?;
        self.validate_sample_progress(sample)?;
        self.clock_sample = Some(sample);
        self.environment_descriptor = Some(descriptor);
        self.pending_environment = None;
        self.clock.note_sample(sample);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn apply_environment_sync(
        &mut self,
        context: WorldContext,
        sample: ClockSample,
        descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    ) -> Result<bool, DisconnectReason> {
        if self.world_context != Some(context) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if self.environment_descriptor != Some(descriptor) {
            return Err(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch);
        }
        validate_pair(sample, descriptor)?;
        self.validate_sample_progress(sample)?;
        self.clock_sample = Some(sample);
        self.clock.note_sample(sample);
        Ok(true)
    }

    pub(super) fn validate_probe_nonce(
        &self,
        nonce: minimium_environment::time::SessionNonce,
    ) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
        if self.clock.session_nonce_matches(nonce) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch)
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn cancel_pending_environment(
        &mut self,
        transition_id: minimium_world::world::TransitionId,
    ) {
        if self
            .pending_environment
            .is_some_and(|(pending_id, _, _, _)| pending_id == transition_id)
        {
            self.pending_environment = None;
        }
    }

    fn validate_sample_progress(&self, sample: ClockSample) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
        let Some(previous) = self.clock_sample else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        if sample.session_nonce() != previous.session_nonce()
            || sample.clock_id() != previous.clock_id()
            || sample.revision() < previous.revision()
            || (sample.revision() == previous.revision()
                && (sample.mode() != previous.mode()
                    || sample.rate_ppm() != previous.rate_ppm()
                    || sample.offline_policy() != previous.offline_policy()
                    || sample.world_utc_ms() < previous.world_utc_ms()))
            || validate_sample_after(sample, previous).is_err()
        {
            return Err(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn validate_descriptor(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    sample: ClockSample,
    descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
    validate_pair(sample, descriptor)?;
    let profile = match manifest.topology() {
        WorldTopology::Dungeon => EnvironmentProfile::Interior,
        WorldTopology::Planet if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1) => {
            EnvironmentProfile::Earth
        }
        WorldTopology::Planet => EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike,
    };
    let identity = minimium_assets::embedded_sky_catalog_identity();
    if minimium_assets::embedded_sky_catalog().is_err()
        || descriptor.profile() != profile
        || descriptor.astronomy_model_revision() != AstronomyModelRevision::CURRENT
        || descriptor.catalogue_id() != CatalogueId::CURRENT
        || identity.catalogue_id != descriptor.catalogue_id().get()
        || identity.sha256 != *descriptor.catalogue_sha256().as_bytes()
    {
        return Err(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch);
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_pair(
    sample: ClockSample,
    descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
) -> Result<(), DisconnectReason> {
    if descriptor.clock_id() != sample.clock_id() {
        return Err(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch);
    }
    Ok(())
}

mod decode;

use super::*;

impl ClientSession {
    fn expected_fingerprint(
        &self,
        instance: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
        manifest: &minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    ) -> u64 {
        if matches!(manifest.generation().revision().get(), 2..=4)
            && (instance.get() == 1 || instance.get() == 2)
        {
            let seed = manifest.generation().seed().get()
                ^ if instance.get() == 2 {
                    0x0030_0000_0000_0003
                } else {
                    0
                };
            let generated = if let Some(planet) = manifest.planet() {
                minimium_game_sample::generate_worlds_with_planet_revision_and_geography(
                    seed,
                    planet,
                    manifest.generation().revision().get(),
                    self.prepared_geography(),
                )
            } else {
                minimium_game_sample::generate_worlds(seed)
            };
            if let Ok(worlds) = generated {
                let world = &worlds[instance.get() as usize - 1];
                if world.manifest == *manifest {
                    return world.map.fingerprint();
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        self.world_fingerprints
            .get(&instance)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(self.expected_map_fingerprint)
    }
    /// Performs bounded nonblocking reads, flushes queued writes (including
    /// partial writes), validates protocol state, and maintains heartbeat
    /// timers. Appends events to caller-owned storage and returns the current
    /// state. Fatal conditions append one Disconnected event and clear all
    /// buffers and connection state.
    pub fn poll(&mut self, events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>) -> SessionState {
        if let Err(error) = self.poll_content() {
            self.disconnect(
                DisconnectReason::Materials(format!("{error}; reconnect to retry")),
                events,
            );
            return self.state;
        }
        let now = Instant::now();
        self.clock.observe_poll(self.clock.local_monotonic_ms());
        if self.state == SessionState::AwaitingWelcome
            && self.content.started.is_none()
            && now.saturating_duration_since(self.state_since) >= WELCOME_TIMEOUT
        {
            self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::WelcomeTimeout, events);
            return self.state;
        }
        if self.state == SessionState::Connected
            && self
                .pending_ping_at
                .is_some_and(|sent| now.saturating_duration_since(sent) >= HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT)
        {
            self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::HeartbeatTimeout, events);
            return self.state;
        }

        self.flush_send(events);
        if self.state == SessionState::Disconnected {
            return self.state;
        }

        self.read_available(events);
        if self.state == SessionState::Disconnected {
            return self.state;
        }
        self.decode_available(events);
        if self.state == SessionState::Disconnected {
            return self.state;
        }

        let now = Instant::now();
        let now_ms = self.clock.local_monotonic_ms();
        self.queue_due_time_probe(now_ms);
        if self.state == SessionState::Connected
            && self.pending_ping_at.is_none()
            && self.pending_ping_end.is_none()
            && now.saturating_duration_since(self.last_heartbeat_at) >= HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
            && self.queue(&ClientMessage::Ping).is_ok()
        {
            self.last_heartbeat_at = now;
        }
        self.flush_send(events);
        let now_ms = self.clock.local_monotonic_ms();
        if self.state == SessionState::Connected {
            self.clock.update_frame(
                self.clock_sample,
                self.environment_descriptor,
                self.world_context,
                now_ms,
            );
        } else {
            self.clock.update_frame(None, None, None, now_ms);
        }
        self.state
    }

    pub(super) fn append_encoded(&mut self, message: &ClientMessage) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
        let frame = encode_client(message)?;
        self.append_frame(&frame)
            .map_err(|()| ProtocolError::PayloadTooLarge)
    }

    pub(super) fn append_frame(&mut self, frame: &[u8]) -> Result<(), ()> {
        if self.send_offset > 0 {
            if let Some(end) = &mut self.pending_ping_end {
                *end = end.saturating_sub(self.send_offset);
            }
            self.send_buffer.drain(..self.send_offset);
            self.send_offset = 0;
        }
        if self.send_buffer.len().saturating_add(frame.len()) > MAX_SESSION_BUFFER_BYTES {
            return Err(());
        }
        self.send_buffer.extend_from_slice(frame);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn flush_send(&mut self, events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>) {
        while self.send_offset < self.send_buffer.len() {
            let result = match self.stream.as_mut() {
                Some(stream) => stream.write(&self.send_buffer[self.send_offset..]),
                None => return,
            };
            match result {
                Ok(0) => {
                    self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::Io(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero), events);
                    return;
                }
                Ok(count) => {
                    self.send_offset += count;
                    self.metrics.bytes_sent = self.metrics.bytes_sent.saturating_add(count as u64);
                    if self
                        .pending_ping_end
                        .is_some_and(|end| self.send_offset >= end)
                    {
                        self.pending_ping_end = None;
                        self.pending_ping_at = Some(Instant::now());
                    }
                }
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                Err(error) => {
                    self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::Io(error.kind()), events);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        if self.send_offset == self.send_buffer.len() {
            self.send_buffer.clear();
            self.send_offset = 0;
        }
    }

    fn read_available(&mut self, events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>) {
        let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
        let mut total_read = 0;
        loop {
            let available = (MAX_SESSION_READ_BYTES_PER_POLL - total_read).min(chunk.len());
            if available == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let result = match self.stream.as_mut() {
                Some(stream) => stream.read(&mut chunk[..available]),
                None => return,
            };
            match result {
                Ok(0) => {
                    self.decode_available(events);
                    if self.state != SessionState::Disconnected {
                        self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::PeerClosed, events);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                Ok(count) => {
                    total_read += count;
                    self.metrics.bytes_received =
                        self.metrics.bytes_received.saturating_add(count as u64);
                    if self.receive_buffer.len().saturating_add(count) > MAX_SESSION_BUFFER_BYTES {
                        self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::BufferLimit, events);
                        return;
                    }
                    self.receive_buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..count]);
                }
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                Err(error) => {
                    self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::Io(error.kind()), events);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn disconnect(&mut self, reason: DisconnectReason, events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>) {
        self.close();
        events.push(SessionEvent::Disconnected(reason));
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/session/receive/decode.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="50" bytes="1998" original_lines="50" original_bytes="1998" minified="false" sha256="646e92e2783ec974345000495dc89d9d479e818cbe9a5377606e4d46272d4111">>>
mod dispatch;

use super::*;

impl ClientSession {
    pub(super) fn decode_available(&mut self, events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>) {
        loop {
            let (message, frame_bytes) = match decode_server(&self.receive_buffer) {
                Ok(Some(decoded)) => decoded,
                Ok(None) => {
                    if self.receive_buffer.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
                        self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::BufferLimit, events);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedEnvironment) => {
                    self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::EnvironmentMismatch, events);
                    return;
                }
                Err(error) => {
                    self.disconnect(DisconnectReason::Protocol(error), events);
                    return;
                }
            };

            self.receive_buffer.drain(..frame_bytes);
            let decoded_at_ms = self.clock.local_monotonic_ms();
            match dispatch::dispatch_message(self, &message, decoded_at_ms, events) {
                dispatch::DispatchResult::Stop => return,
                dispatch::DispatchResult::Skip => continue,
                dispatch::DispatchResult::Emit => {}
            }

            if let ServerMessage::Snapshot { context, .. } = &message {
                if Some(*context) != self.world_context {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if matches!(&message, ServerMessage::Pong) {
                if let Some(sent_at) = self.pending_ping_at.take() {
                    let rtt = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(sent_at);
                    self.metrics.ping_round_trip = Some(rtt);
                    events.push(SessionEvent::PingRoundTrip(rtt));
                    continue;
                }
            }
            events.push(SessionEvent::Message(message));
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/session/receive/decode/dispatch.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="400" bytes="13208" original_lines="400" original_bytes="13208" minified="false" sha256="468dd3193d5976d8c9db5feba5ee6be66a771dec783d3fa04535d91ea08fd23d">>>
use super::*;

pub(super) enum DispatchResult {
    Emit,
    Skip,
    Stop,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct TransitionPreparation<'a> {
    id: TransitionId,
    source: WorldContext,
    target: WorldContext,
    map_fingerprint: u64,
    manifest: &'a minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    clock_sample: ClockSample,
    environment: EnvironmentDescriptor,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct TransitionCommit<'a> {
    id: TransitionId,
    context: WorldContext,
    map_fingerprint: u64,
    manifest: &'a minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    clock_sample: ClockSample,
    environment: EnvironmentDescriptor,
}

pub(super) fn dispatch_message(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    message: &ServerMessage,
    decoded_at_ms: u64,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> DispatchResult {
    if !prepare_manifest_geography(session, message, events) {
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    match message {
        ServerMessage::ContentOffer {
            material_hash,
            http_port,
            climate,
        } => {
            if let Err(error) = session.begin_content(*material_hash, *http_port, climate.clone()) {
                session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::Materials(error), events);
                DispatchResult::Stop
            } else {
                DispatchResult::Skip
            }
        }
        ServerMessage::Welcome {
            map_fingerprint,
            context,
            manifest,
            clock_sample,
            environment,
            ..
        } => handle_welcome(
            session,
            *map_fingerprint,
            *context,
            manifest,
            *clock_sample,
            *environment,
            events,
        ),
        ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare {
            transition_id,
            source_context,
            target_context,
            map_fingerprint,
            manifest,
            clock_sample,
            environment,
            ..
        } => handle_transition_prepare(
            session,
            TransitionPreparation {
                id: *transition_id,
                source: *source_context,
                target: *target_context,
                map_fingerprint: *map_fingerprint,
                manifest,
                clock_sample: *clock_sample,
                environment: *environment,
            },
            events,
        ),
        ServerMessage::TransitionCommitted {
            transition_id,
            context,
            map_fingerprint,
            manifest,
            clock_sample,
            environment,
            ..
        } => handle_transition_committed(
            session,
            TransitionCommit {
                id: *transition_id,
                context: *context,
                map_fingerprint: *map_fingerprint,
                manifest,
                clock_sample: *clock_sample,
                environment: *environment,
            },
            events,
        ),
        ServerMessage::TransitionCancelled {
            transition_id,
            context,
        } => handle_transition_cancelled(session, *transition_id, *context),
        ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync {
            context,
            clock_sample,
            environment,
        } => handle_environment_sync(session, *context, *clock_sample, *environment, events),
        ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply { .. } => {
            handle_time_probe_reply(session, message, decoded_at_ms, events)
        }
        ServerMessage::Error(code) if session.state == SessionState::AwaitingWelcome => {
            session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::Rejected(*code), events);
            DispatchResult::Stop
        }
        ServerMessage::Bye if session.state == SessionState::Connected => {
            session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::ServerClosed, events);
            DispatchResult::Stop
        }
        _ if session.state != SessionState::Connected => {
            session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::UnexpectedMessage, events);
            DispatchResult::Stop
        }
        _ => DispatchResult::Emit,
    }
}

fn prepare_manifest_geography(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    message: &ServerMessage,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> bool {
    let planet = match message {
        ServerMessage::Welcome { manifest, .. }
        | ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare { manifest, .. }
        | ServerMessage::TransitionCommitted { manifest, .. } => {
            manifest.planet().filter(|planet| planet.mode == 1)
        }
        _ => None,
    };
    let Some(definition) = planet else {
        return true;
    };
    let package = std::env::var_os("MINIMIUM_EARTH_PACKAGE")
        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("third_party/gebco-2026"));
    let already_loaded = session
        .prepared_geography
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|geography| geography.package_digest() == definition.package_digest);
    if already_loaded {
        return true;
    }
    match minimium_asset_io::open_earth_package(&package, Some(definition.package_digest)) {
        Ok(prepared) => {
            session.prepared_geography = Some(prepared);
            true
        }
        Err(error) => {
            session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::EarthPackage(error), events);
            false
        }
    }
}

fn handle_welcome(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    map_fingerprint: u64,
    context: WorldContext,
    manifest: &minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    clock_sample: ClockSample,
    environment: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> DispatchResult {
    if session.state != SessionState::AwaitingWelcome {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::UnexpectedMessage, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    let expected_fingerprint = session.expected_fingerprint(context.instance(), manifest);
    if map_fingerprint != expected_fingerprint {
        session.disconnect(
            DisconnectReason::MapMismatch {
                expected: expected_fingerprint,
                actual: map_fingerprint,
            },
            events,
        );
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if manifest.content_revision() != context.content_revision() {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::GeneratorMismatch, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if manifest.generator_digest()
        != minimium_world::world::GeneratorDigest::legacy_map_fingerprint(expected_fingerprint)
        && manifest.generator_digest()
            != minimium_procgen::generator_digest(manifest.topology(), manifest.generation())
    {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::GeneratorMismatch, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if let Err(reason) = session.install_initial_environment(*manifest, clock_sample, environment) {
        session.disconnect(reason, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    session.world_context = Some(context);
    session.pending_transition = None;
    session.ready_transition = None;
    session.state = SessionState::Connected;
    session.state_since = Instant::now();
    session.last_heartbeat_at = session.state_since;
    DispatchResult::Emit
}

fn handle_transition_prepare(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    preparation: TransitionPreparation<'_>,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> DispatchResult {
    let TransitionPreparation {
        id: transition_id,
        source: source_context,
        target: target_context,
        map_fingerprint,
        manifest,
        clock_sample,
        environment,
    } = preparation;
    if session.state != SessionState::Connected {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::UnexpectedMessage, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if Some(source_context) != session.world_context {
        return DispatchResult::Skip;
    }
    let expected_fingerprint = session.expected_fingerprint(target_context.instance(), manifest);
    if map_fingerprint != expected_fingerprint {
        session.disconnect(
            DisconnectReason::MapMismatch {
                expected: expected_fingerprint,
                actual: map_fingerprint,
            },
            events,
        );
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if manifest.content_revision() != target_context.content_revision()
        || !manifest_matches_generator(manifest)
    {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::GeneratorMismatch, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    let transition = (transition_id, target_context);
    if session
        .pending_transition
        .is_some_and(|current| current != transition)
    {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::UnexpectedMessage, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if let Err(reason) = session.prepare_environment(
        transition_id,
        target_context,
        *manifest,
        clock_sample,
        environment,
    ) {
        session.disconnect(reason, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    session.pending_transition = Some(transition);
    session.ready_transition = None;
    DispatchResult::Emit
}

fn handle_transition_committed(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    commit: TransitionCommit<'_>,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> DispatchResult {
    let TransitionCommit {
        id: transition_id,
        context,
        map_fingerprint,
        manifest,
        clock_sample,
        environment,
    } = commit;
    let expected_fingerprint = session.expected_fingerprint(context.instance(), manifest);
    if map_fingerprint != expected_fingerprint {
        session.disconnect(
            DisconnectReason::MapMismatch {
                expected: expected_fingerprint,
                actual: map_fingerprint,
            },
            events,
        );
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if manifest.content_revision() != context.content_revision()
        || !manifest_matches_generator(manifest)
    {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::GeneratorMismatch, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    if session.pending_transition != Some((transition_id, context)) {
        return DispatchResult::Skip;
    }
    if let Err(reason) =
        session.commit_environment(transition_id, context, *manifest, clock_sample, environment)
    {
        session.disconnect(reason, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    session.world_context = Some(context);
    session.pending_transition = None;
    session.ready_transition = None;
    // Keep queued bytes: a partially sent frame must be completed. The server
    // rejects stale-context inputs; heartbeat and clock probes still apply.
    DispatchResult::Emit
}

fn handle_transition_cancelled(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    transition_id: TransitionId,
    context: WorldContext,
) -> DispatchResult {
    if !session
        .pending_transition
        .is_some_and(|(pending, _)| pending == transition_id)
        || Some(context) != session.world_context
    {
        return DispatchResult::Skip;
    }
    session.pending_transition = None;
    session.ready_transition = None;
    session.cancel_pending_environment(transition_id);
    DispatchResult::Emit
}

fn handle_environment_sync(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    context: WorldContext,
    clock_sample: ClockSample,
    environment: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> DispatchResult {
    if session.state != SessionState::Connected {
        session.disconnect(DisconnectReason::UnexpectedMessage, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    match session.apply_environment_sync(context, clock_sample, environment) {
        Ok(true) => DispatchResult::Emit,
        Ok(false) => DispatchResult::Skip,
        Err(reason) => {
            session.disconnect(reason, events);
            DispatchResult::Stop
        }
    }
}

fn handle_time_probe_reply(
    session: &mut ClientSession,
    message: &ServerMessage,
    decoded_at_ms: u64,
    events: &mut Vec<SessionEvent>,
) -> DispatchResult {
    let ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply {
        seq,
        echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms,
        server_receive_monotonic_ms,
        server_send_monotonic_ms,
        session_nonce,
    } = message
    else {
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    };
    if let Err(reason) = session.validate_probe_nonce(*session_nonce) {
        session.disconnect(reason, events);
        return DispatchResult::Stop;
    }
    session.clock.accept_probe_reply(
        *seq,
        *echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms,
        *server_receive_monotonic_ms,
        *server_send_monotonic_ms,
        decoded_at_ms,
    );
    DispatchResult::Emit
}
