<<<FILE path="crates/client-runtime/src/snapshots.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="154" bytes="5780" original_lines="154" original_bytes="5780" minified="false" sha256="795ee6ed1de531ad7944fe065e4b5649ae398a199d7f0864f1af95f85190fedb">>>
//! Bounded network snapshot reconciliation and remote-player interpolation.
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_protocol::{RemotePlayerIds, RemotePlayers, MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

const TELEPORT_THRESHOLD_MM: f64 = 100_000.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct RemotePlayerTrack {
    pub id: PlayerId,
    pub previous_position_mm: [i64; 3],
    pub current_position_mm: [i64; 3],
    pub displayed_position_mm: [i64; 3],
    previous_time_ms: u64,
    current_time_ms: u64,
    displayed_time_ms: u64,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct SnapshotReconciler {
    tracks: [Option<RemotePlayerTrack>; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS],
    last_server_time_ms: Option<u64>,
    last_received_at: Option<Instant>,
    geometry_dirty: bool,
}

impl SnapshotReconciler {
    pub fn apply_remote_snapshot(
        &mut self,
        server_time_ms: u64,
        full_snapshot: bool,
        players: &RemotePlayers,
        removed_players: &RemotePlayerIds,
    ) -> bool {
        let server_time_ms = self
            .last_server_time_ms
            .map_or(server_time_ms, |previous| previous.max(server_time_ms));
        self.last_server_time_ms = Some(server_time_ms);
        self.last_received_at = Some(Instant::now());
        if full_snapshot {
            self.tracks = [None; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS];
        }
        for id in removed_players.iter() {
            if let Some(slot) = self
                .tracks
                .iter_mut()
                .find(|slot| slot.is_some_and(|track| track.id == *id))
            {
                *slot = None;
            }
        }
        for player in players.iter() {
            let existing_slot = self
                .tracks
                .iter()
                .position(|slot| slot.is_some_and(|track| track.id == player.id));
            let slot = existing_slot.or_else(|| self.tracks.iter().position(Option::is_none));
            let Some(slot) = slot else {
                return false;
            };
            let existing = self.tracks[slot];
            let mut previous_position_mm = existing
                .map(|track| track.current_position_mm)
                .unwrap_or(player.position_mm.0);
            let displacement_squared = previous_position_mm
                .iter()
                .zip(player.position_mm.0)
                .map(|(previous, current)| (*previous as f64 - current as f64).powi(2))
                .sum::<f64>();
            let teleported = displacement_squared > TELEPORT_THRESHOLD_MM.powi(2);
            if teleported {
                previous_position_mm = player.position_mm.0;
            }
            let mut previous_time_ms = existing
                .map(|track| track.current_time_ms.min(server_time_ms))
                .unwrap_or(server_time_ms);
            if teleported {
                previous_time_ms = server_time_ms;
            }
            self.tracks[slot] = Some(RemotePlayerTrack {
                id: player.id,
                previous_position_mm,
                current_position_mm: player.position_mm.0,
                displayed_position_mm: previous_position_mm,
                previous_time_ms,
                current_time_ms: server_time_ms,
                displayed_time_ms: previous_time_ms,
            });
        }
        self.geometry_dirty = true;
        true
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.tracks = [None; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS];
        self.last_server_time_ms = None;
        self.last_received_at = None;
        self.geometry_dirty = false;
    }

    pub fn player_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.tracks.iter().flatten().count()
    }

    pub fn tracks(&self) -> &[Option<RemotePlayerTrack>; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS] {
        &self.tracks
    }

    /// Updates and writes displayed world-space millimetre positions into a reusable host buffer.
    pub fn interpolate_positions(
        &mut self,
        now: Instant,
        delay: Duration,
        output: &mut Vec<[i64; 3]>,
    ) -> bool {
        output.clear();
        let estimated_server_time_ms = match (self.last_server_time_ms, self.last_received_at) {
            (Some(server_time_ms), Some(received_at)) => {
                let elapsed = u64::try_from(now.saturating_duration_since(received_at).as_millis())
                    .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
                server_time_ms.saturating_add(elapsed)
            }
            _ => 0,
        };
        let render_time_ms = estimated_server_time_ms
            .saturating_sub(u64::try_from(delay.as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX));
        let mut moved = false;
        for track in self.tracks.iter_mut().flatten() {
            let interval_ms = track.current_time_ms.saturating_sub(track.previous_time_ms);
            let interpolation = if interval_ms == 0 {
                1.0
            } else {
                (render_time_ms.saturating_sub(track.previous_time_ms) as f64 / interval_ms as f64)
                    .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
            };
            let position_mm = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                (track.previous_position_mm[axis] as f64 * (1.0 - interpolation)
                    + track.current_position_mm[axis] as f64 * interpolation)
                    .round() as i64
            });
            if position_mm != track.displayed_position_mm {
                track.displayed_position_mm = position_mm;
                moved = true;
            }
            track.displayed_time_ms = render_time_ms.clamp(
                track.previous_time_ms,
                track.current_time_ms.max(track.previous_time_ms),
            );
            output.push(track.displayed_position_mm);
        }
        let dirty = std::mem::take(&mut self.geometry_dirty);
        moved || dirty
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/commands/src/registry.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="81" bytes="2612" original_lines="81" original_bytes="2612" minified="false" sha256="b7701255eba15bf4210dbdbeccda3dd074dde479d47d3bb4ea018ecbc0dfc461">>>
//! Small static command metadata registry shared by interactive front ends.

/// One command declaration and its domain-owned parser.
pub struct CommandSpec<T, E> {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub alias: Option<&'static str>,
    pub usage: &'static str,
    pub parser: fn(&[&str]) -> Result<T, E>,
}

impl<T, E> Copy for CommandSpec<T, E> {}

impl<T, E> Clone for CommandSpec<T, E> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        *self
    }
}

/// Resolves the longest registered command name or alias before parsing its tail.
pub struct CommandRegistry<T, E> {
    commands: Vec<CommandSpec<T, E>>,
}

impl<T, E> Default for CommandRegistry<T, E> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            commands: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

impl<T, E> CommandRegistry<T, E> {
    pub fn register(&mut self, specs: &'static [CommandSpec<T, E>]) {
        for spec in specs {
            for name in std::iter::once(spec.name).chain(spec.alias) {
                assert!(
                    !self.commands.iter().any(|existing| {
                        std::iter::once(existing.name)
                            .chain(existing.alias)
                            .any(|registered| registered == name)
                    }),
                    "duplicate command: {name}"
                );
            }
            self.commands.push(*spec);
        }
    }

    pub fn parse(&self, input: &str, words: &[&str]) -> Option<Result<T, (&'static str, E)>> {
        self.commands
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|spec| {
                let matched = [Some(spec.name), spec.alias]
                    .into_iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .map(|name| name.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>())
                    .filter(|name| words.starts_with(name))
                    .max_by_key(Vec::len)?;
                Some((spec, matched.len()))
            })
            .max_by_key(|(_, length)| *length)
            .map(|(spec, command_length)| {
                let arguments = [spec.name, tail_after_tokens(input, command_length)];
                (spec.parser)(&arguments).map_err(|error| (spec.usage, error))
            })
    }

    pub fn commands(&self) -> &[CommandSpec<T, E>] {
        &self.commands
    }
}

fn tail_after_tokens(input: &str, count: usize) -> &str {
    let mut tail = input;
    for _ in 0..count {
        tail = tail.trim_start();
        let end = tail.find(char::is_whitespace).unwrap_or(tail.len());
        tail = &tail[end..];
    }
    tail.trim()
}

use std::io;

pub const PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES: usize = 16;
pub const MAX_PLAYER_NAME_BYTES: usize = 24;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct PlayerProfileId([u8; PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES]);

impl PlayerProfileId {
    pub fn from_bytes(bytes: [u8; PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES]) -> Self {
        Self(bytes)
    }

    pub fn from_hex(value: &str) -> io::Result<Self> {
        if value.len() != PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES * 2 {
            return Err(invalid_profile_id());
        }
        let mut bytes = [0u8; PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES];
        for (index, byte) in bytes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            let offset = index * 2;
            let high = hex_digit(value.as_bytes()[offset]).ok_or_else(invalid_profile_id)?;
            let low = hex_digit(value.as_bytes()[offset + 1]).ok_or_else(invalid_profile_id)?;
            *byte = (high << 4) | low;
        }
        Ok(Self(bytes))
    }

    pub fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8; PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES] {
        &self.0
    }

    pub fn to_hex(self) -> String {
        const HEX: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789abcdef";
        let mut output = String::with_capacity(PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES * 2);
        for byte in self.0 {
            output.push(HEX[usize::from(byte >> 4)] as char);
            output.push(HEX[usize::from(byte & 0x0f)] as char);
        }
        output
    }
}

fn hex_digit(byte: u8) -> Option<u8> {
    match byte {
        b'0'..=b'9' => Some(byte - b'0'),
        b'a'..=b'f' => Some(byte - b'a' + 10),
        b'A'..=b'F' => Some(byte - b'A' + 10),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn invalid_profile_id() -> io::Error {
    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid player profile file")
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/climate.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="155" bytes="5551" original_lines="155" original_bytes="5551" minified="false" sha256="3b56699c2dab9cedf761fda6d94cc81de7295845fa54ee507bbea2aa8796ed63">>>
//! Shared seasonal climate and bounded, replayable surface-cover model.
use glam::DVec3;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ClimateSample {
    pub temperature_c: f64,
    pub moisture: f64,
    pub seasonality: f64,
}

/// Coarse annual mean by angular latitude; sin(latitude)^2 overcools temperate zones.
pub fn annual_temperature_c(latitude_radians: f64) -> f64 {
    let latitude = latitude_radians / std::f64::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
    28.0 - 52.0 * latitude * latitude
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ClimateOffset {
    pub temperature_c: f64,
    pub moisture: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ClimateRegion {
    pub center: [f64; 3],
    pub radius_radians: f64,
    pub offset: ClimateOffset,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ClimateScenario {
    /// 0 uses Earth's source height; 1 fully applies additional peak exaggeration.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub relief_influence: f64,
    pub start_utc: f64,
    pub end_utc: f64,
    pub global: ClimateOffset,
    pub regions: Vec<ClimateRegion>,
}

impl ClimateScenario {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        let valid_offset = |o: ClimateOffset| {
            o.temperature_c.is_finite()
                && o.temperature_c.abs() <= 50.0
                && o.moisture.is_finite()
                && o.moisture.abs() <= 1.0
        };
        if !self.start_utc.is_finite()
            || !self.relief_influence.is_finite()
            || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&self.relief_influence)
            || !self.end_utc.is_finite()
            || self.end_utc < self.start_utc
            || !valid_offset(self.global)
            || self.regions.len() > 32
        {
            return Err("invalid climate scenario");
        }
        for region in &self.regions {
            let center = DVec3::from_array(region.center);
            if !center.is_finite()
                || center.length_squared() < 1e-12
                || !region.radius_radians.is_finite()
                || !(0.0..=std::f64::consts::PI).contains(&region.radius_radians)
                || region.radius_radians == 0.0
                || !valid_offset(region.offset)
            {
                return Err("invalid climate region");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn offset(&self, direction: DVec3, utc: f64) -> ClimateOffset {
        let progress = if self.start_utc == self.end_utc {
            f64::from(utc >= self.start_utc)
        } else {
            smooth((utc - self.start_utc) / (self.end_utc - self.start_utc))
        };
        let mut offset = self.global;
        for region in &self.regions {
            let angle = direction
                .dot(DVec3::from_array(region.center).normalize())
                .clamp(-1.0, 1.0)
                .acos();
            let weight = smooth(1.0 - angle / region.radius_radians);
            offset.temperature_c += region.offset.temperature_c * weight;
            offset.moisture += region.offset.moisture * weight;
        }
        offset.temperature_c *= progress;
        offset.moisture *= progress;
        offset
    }
}

/// Opposite seasonal phase on each hemisphere, with a stable tropical-year epoch.
pub fn seasonality(direction: DVec3, utc: f64) -> f64 {
    let year = (utc - 946_728_000.0) / (365.2425 * 86400.0);
    direction.y * (std::f64::consts::TAU * (year - 0.47)).cos()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct SurfaceCoverSample {
    pub vegetation: f32,
    pub snow: f32,
    pub wetness: f32,
}

/// One site evaluation supplies climate and replayed cover to presentation adapters.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct SurfaceState {
    pub cover: SurfaceCoverSample,
    pub climate: ClimateSample,
    pub source_elevation_m: f64,
    pub climate_elevation_m: f64,
}

/// No incremental state: reconnect and arbitrary time jumps evaluate the same history.
/// Hosts run this on a surface worker, never once per vertex per rendered frame.
pub fn surface_cover(
    utc: f64,
    mut weather: impl FnMut(f64) -> ClimateSample,
) -> SurfaceCoverSample {
    let end_hour = (utc / 3600.0).floor() as i64;
    let mut snow = 0.0_f64;
    let mut wetness = 0.0_f64;
    for hour in (end_hour - 167)..=end_hour {
        let c = weather(hour as f64 * 3600.0);
        let precipitation = ((c.moisture - 0.48) * 2.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        snow = (snow + precipitation * smooth((2.0 - c.temperature_c) / 4.0) * 0.04
            - c.temperature_c.max(0.0) * 0.002)
            .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        if hour > end_hour - 6 {
            wetness = (wetness + precipitation * smooth((c.temperature_c + 2.0) / 4.0) * 0.45
                - (0.04 + c.temperature_c.max(0.0) * 0.005))
                .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        }
    }
    let current = weather(end_hour as f64 * 3600.0);
    SurfaceCoverSample {
        vegetation: (smooth((current.temperature_c + 3.0) / 18.0)
            * smooth((current.moisture - 0.08) / 0.5)) as f32,
        snow: snow as f32,
        wetness: wetness as f32,
    }
}

fn smooth(t: f64) -> f64 {
    let t = t.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/clock_command.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="25" bytes="1301" original_lines="25" original_bytes="1301" minified="false" sha256="31cbf1d523bbeaa7e577fa670424f3761a03b6325ec31d0663b52389dabbe464">>>
//! Time-of-day command values independent of host clocks and I/O.
pub fn parse_hhmm(value: &str) -> Result<u16, String> {
    if value.len() != 4 || !value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return Err("time must have four digits HHMM (0000..2359)".into());
    }
    let value = value.parse::<u16>().map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    let (hour, minute) = (value / 100, value % 100);
    if hour > 23 || minute > 59 {
        return Err("time must have four digits HHMM (0000..2359)".into());
    }
    Ok(hour * 60 + minute)
}

/// Keeps the current local mean solar date and sets the requested minute.
/// East longitude advances local time; zero longitude selects UTC.
pub fn utc_at_time(current_ms: i64, minute: u16, longitude_rad: f64) -> Result<i64, String> {
    if minute >= 1440 || !longitude_rad.is_finite() || longitude_rad.abs() > std::f64::consts::PI {
        return Err("invalid time of day or observer longitude".into());
    }
    let offset = (longitude_rad / std::f64::consts::TAU * 86_400_000.0).round() as i64;
    let local_day = (current_ms + offset).div_euclid(86_400_000);
    let target = local_day * 86_400_000 + i64::from(minute) * 60_000 - offset;
    crate::time::WorldTimeMs::new(target).map_err(|error| format!("{error:?}"))?;
    Ok(target)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/commands.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="186" bytes="6727" original_lines="186" original_bytes="6727" minified="false" sha256="19020ee6c194cc2f10ca0d1188520670cb13bcc2fc21a2ba0a4f6e059619a0ca">>>
use crate::time::{ClockMode, OfflinePolicy, TimeScalePpm, WorldTimeMs};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum TimeCommand {
    Status,
    Mode(ClockMode),
    Set(WorldTimeMs),
    Scale(TimeScalePpm),
    Offline(OfflinePolicy),
}

impl TimeCommand {
    pub fn parse(arguments: &[&str]) -> Result<Self, String> {
        match arguments {
            ["status"] => Ok(Self::Status),
            ["mode", "real_time"] => Ok(Self::Mode(ClockMode::RealTime)),
            ["mode", "time_scale"] => Ok(Self::Mode(ClockMode::TimeScale)),
            ["set", value] => parse_world_time_utc(value).map(Self::Set),
            ["scale", value] => parse_scale_ppm(value).map(Self::Scale),
            ["offline", "pause"] => Ok(Self::Offline(OfflinePolicy::Pause)),
            ["offline", "advance"] => Ok(Self::Offline(OfflinePolicy::Advance)),
            _ => Err(String::from(TIME_USAGE)),
        }
    }
}

pub const TIME_USAGE: &str =
    "time status | time mode real_time|time_scale | time set RFC3339_UTC | time scale DECIMAL | time offline pause|advance";

/// Parses an RFC3339 UTC value with a `Z` or `+00:00` offset and up to ms precision.
pub fn parse_world_time_utc(value: &str) -> Result<WorldTimeMs, String> {
    let bytes = value.as_bytes();
    let zone_start = if value.ends_with('Z') {
        bytes.len().checked_sub(1)
    } else if value.ends_with("+00:00") {
        bytes.len().checked_sub(6)
    } else {
        None
    }
    .ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    let local = &bytes[..zone_start];
    let (date_time, fraction) = match local.iter().position(|byte| *byte == b'.') {
        Some(separator) => {
            let fraction = &local[separator + 1..];
            if fraction.is_empty() || fraction.len() > 3 || !digits(fraction) {
                return Err(invalid_utc());
            }
            (&local[..separator], fraction)
        }
        None => (local, &[][..]),
    };
    if date_time.len() != 19
        || date_time[4] != b'-'
        || date_time[7] != b'-'
        || date_time[10] != b'T'
        || date_time[13] != b':'
        || date_time[16] != b':'
    {
        return Err(invalid_utc());
    }
    let year = field(date_time, 0, 4).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)? as i64;
    let month = field(date_time, 5, 7).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    let day = field(date_time, 8, 10).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    let hour = field(date_time, 11, 13).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    let minute = field(date_time, 14, 16).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    let second = field(date_time, 17, 19).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    if year == 0
        || !(1..=12).contains(&month)
        || day == 0
        || day > days_in_month(year, month)
        || hour > 23
        || minute > 59
        || second > 59
    {
        return Err(invalid_utc());
    }
    let millis = match fraction.len() {
        0 => 0,
        1 => u32::from(fraction[0] - b'0') * 100,
        2 => u32::from(fraction[0] - b'0') * 100 + u32::from(fraction[1] - b'0') * 10,
        3 => field(fraction, 0, 3).ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?,
        _ => return Err(invalid_utc()),
    };
    let days = days_from_civil(year, month, day);
    let time_ms = i128::from(hour) * 3_600_000
        + i128::from(minute) * 60_000
        + i128::from(second) * 1_000
        + i128::from(millis);
    let timestamp = i128::from(days)
        .checked_mul(86_400_000)
        .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(time_ms))
        .ok_or_else(invalid_utc)?;
    let timestamp = i64::try_from(timestamp).map_err(|_| invalid_utc())?;
    WorldTimeMs::new(timestamp).map_err(|_| {
        String::from("UTC date must be in [2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2101-01-01T00:00:00Z)")
    })
}

/// Parses a decimal rate without floating point or silent rounding.
pub fn parse_scale_ppm(value: &str) -> Result<TimeScalePpm, String> {
    let mut parts = value.split('.');
    let whole_text = parts.next().unwrap_or_default();
    let fraction_text = parts.next();
    if parts.next().is_some()
        || whole_text.is_empty()
        || !whole_text.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
        || fraction_text.is_some_and(|fraction| {
            fraction.is_empty()
                || fraction.len() > 6
                || !fraction.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
        })
    {
        return Err(String::from(
            "rate must be 0 (pause) or a decimal from 0.1 to 1000000 with at most 6 fractional digits",
        ));
    }
    let whole = whole_text.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| invalid_scale())?;
    let mut fraction = fraction_text.unwrap_or_default().to_owned();
    while fraction.len() < 6 {
        fraction.push('0');
    }
    let fractional_ppm = if fraction.is_empty() {
        0
    } else {
        fraction.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| invalid_scale())?
    };
    let ppm = whole
        .checked_mul(1_000_000)
        .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(fractional_ppm))
        .ok_or_else(invalid_scale)?;
    if ppm != 0 && ppm < 100_000 {
        return Err(invalid_scale());
    }
    TimeScalePpm::new(ppm).map_err(|_| invalid_scale())
}

fn field(bytes: &[u8], start: usize, end: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    let value = bytes.get(start..end)?;
    if value.is_empty() || !digits(value) {
        return None;
    }
    value.iter().try_fold(0_u32, |number, digit| {
        number
            .checked_mul(10)?
            .checked_add(u32::from(*digit - b'0'))
    })
}

fn digits(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    bytes.iter().all(u8::is_ascii_digit)
}

fn leap_year(year: i64) -> bool {
    year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0)
}

fn days_in_month(year: i64, month: u32) -> u32 {
    match month {
        2 if leap_year(year) => 29,
        2 => 28,
        4 | 6 | 9 | 11 => 30,
        _ => 31,
    }
}

fn days_from_civil(year: i64, month: u32, day: u32) -> i64 {
    let year = year - i64::from(month <= 2);
    let era = year.div_euclid(400);
    let year_of_era = year - era * 400;
    let shifted_month = i64::from(month) + if month > 2 { -3 } else { 9 };
    let day_of_year = (153 * shifted_month + 2) / 5 + i64::from(day) - 1;
    let day_of_era = year_of_era * 365 + year_of_era / 4 - year_of_era / 100 + day_of_year;
    era * 146_097 + day_of_era - 719_468
}

fn invalid_utc() -> String {
    String::from(
        "date must be RFC3339 UTC (Z or +00:00), with 0–3 millisecond digits and no leap second",
    )
}

fn invalid_scale() -> String {
    String::from(
        "rate must be 0 (pause) or between 0.1 and 1000000 with at most 6 fractional digits",
    )
}

use std::fmt;

use crate::time::{ClockId, TimeError};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum EnvironmentError {
    Time(TimeError),
    InvalidProfile(u8),
    UnsupportedAstronomyModelRevision(u32),
    UnsupportedCatalogueId(u32),
    ClockMismatch { expected: u64, actual: u64 },
}

impl fmt::Display for EnvironmentError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Time(error) => fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
            Self::InvalidProfile(value) => {
                write!(formatter, "unsupported environment profile {value}")
            }
            Self::UnsupportedAstronomyModelRevision(value) => {
                write!(formatter, "unsupported astronomy model revision {value}")
            }
            Self::UnsupportedCatalogueId(value) => {
                write!(formatter, "unsupported star catalogue id {value}")
            }
            Self::ClockMismatch { expected, actual } => write!(
                formatter,
                "environment clock id {actual} does not match expected clock id {expected}"
            ),
        }
    }
}

impl From<TimeError> for EnvironmentError {
    fn from(error: TimeError) -> Self {
        Self::Time(error)
    }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum EnvironmentProfile {
    Interior = 0,
    Earth = 1,
    EarthLike = 2,
}

impl EnvironmentProfile {
    pub const fn renders_sky(self) -> bool {
        !matches!(self, Self::Interior)
    }
}

impl TryFrom<u8> for EnvironmentProfile {
    type Error = EnvironmentError;

    fn try_from(value: u8) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        match value {
            0 => Ok(Self::Interior),
            1 => Ok(Self::Earth),
            2 => Ok(Self::EarthLike),
            other => Err(EnvironmentError::InvalidProfile(other)),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub struct AstronomyModelRevision(u32);

impl AstronomyModelRevision {
    pub const CURRENT: Self = Self(1);

    pub const fn new(value: u32) -> Result<Self, EnvironmentError> {
        if value == 1 {
            Ok(Self::CURRENT)
        } else {
            Err(EnvironmentError::UnsupportedAstronomyModelRevision(value))
        }
    }

    pub const fn get(self) -> u32 {
        self.0
    }
}

impl TryFrom<u32> for AstronomyModelRevision {
    type Error = EnvironmentError;

    fn try_from(value: u32) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        Self::new(value)
    }

    pub const CURRENT: Self = Self(2);

        } else {

        self.0

/// Opaque catalogue digest; core does not interpret or fabricate asset hashes.

    pub const fn new(bytes: [u8; 32]) -> Self {
        Self(bytes)

        &self.0
    }

    astronomy_model_revision: AstronomyModelRevision,

    pub const fn new(
        clock_id: ClockId,
        profile: EnvironmentProfile,
        astronomy_model_revision: AstronomyModelRevision,
        catalogue_id: CatalogueId,

    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            clock_id,
            profile,
            astronomy_model_revision,
            catalogue_id,
            catalogue_sha256,
        }
    }

    pub fn from_codes(
        clock_id: u64,
        profile: u8,
        astronomy_model_revision: u32,

    ) -> Result<Self, EnvironmentError> {

            ClockId::try_from(clock_id)?,
            EnvironmentProfile::try_from(profile)?,
            AstronomyModelRevision::try_from(astronomy_model_revision)?,
            CatalogueId::try_from(catalogue_id)?,

        ))
    }

        self.clock_id
    }

    pub const fn profile(self) -> EnvironmentProfile {
        self.profile
    }

        self.astronomy_model_revision
    }

    pub const fn catalogue_id(self) -> CatalogueId {
        self.catalogue_id
    }

    pub const fn catalogue_sha256(self) -> CatalogueSha256 {
        self.catalogue_sha256
    }

    pub fn validate_clock(&self, expected: ClockId) -> Result<(), EnvironmentError> {
        if self.clock_id == expected {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(EnvironmentError::ClockMismatch {
                expected: expected.get(),
                actual: self.clock_id.get(),

        }

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/sky/observer.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="349" bytes="12573" original_lines="349" original_bytes="12573" minified="false" sha256="0a2ac07306f7ed8822a5c53106b99ceb9ad4e632262ba904a9a808e52da10373">>>
use std::{f64::consts::PI, fmt};

use crate::{EnvironmentDescriptor, EnvironmentProfile};
use minimium_world::world::{PlanetDefinition, Position3Mm, WorldManifest, WorldTopology};

pub const HEIGHT_REFERENCE_REVISION: u32 = 1;
pub const DEFAULT_OBSERVER_EYE_HEIGHT_MM: u32 = 1700;
pub const MAX_OBSERVER_POSITION_MM: u64 = 10_000_000_000;
pub const MAX_OBSERVER_EYE_HEIGHT_MM: u32 = 100_000;
const MIN_GAME_RADIUS_MM: u64 = 318_550_000;
const MAX_GAME_RADIUS_MM: u64 = 6_371_000_000;
const MIN_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT_M: f64 = -12_000.0;
const MAX_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT_M: f64 = 100_000.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
pub enum SkyModel {
    None,
    EarthGeoreferencedV1,
    MappedEarthSkyV1,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct GeographicObserver {
    latitude_rad: f64,
    longitude_rad: f64,
    height_m: f64,
}

impl GeographicObserver {
    fn new(latitude_rad: f64, longitude_rad: f64, height_m: f64) -> Result<Self, ObserverError> {
        if !latitude_rad.is_finite() || !longitude_rad.is_finite() || !height_m.is_finite() {
            return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
        }
        if !(-PI / 2.0..=PI / 2.0).contains(&latitude_rad)
            || !(-PI..PI).contains(&longitude_rad)
            || !(MIN_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT_M..=MAX_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT_M).contains(&height_m)
        {
            return Err(ObserverError::UnsupportedHeight);
        }
        Ok(Self {
            latitude_rad,
            longitude_rad,
            height_m,
        })
    }

    pub const fn latitude_rad(self) -> f64 {
        self.latitude_rad
    }

    pub const fn longitude_rad(self) -> f64 {
        self.longitude_rad
    }

    pub const fn height_m(self) -> f64 {
        self.height_m
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct EarthHeightReference {
    pub raw_gebco_m: f64,
    pub baseline_game_mm: i64,
    pub physical_anchor_m: f64,
}

impl EarthHeightReference {
    pub fn from_gebco(
        raw_gebco_m: f64,
        definition: PlanetDefinition,
    ) -> Result<Self, ObserverError> {
        if !raw_gebco_m.is_finite() {
            return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
        }
        if !definition.is_valid() || definition.mode != 1 {
            return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
        }
        let scale = definition.height_scale_permille;
        if !(1..=1000).contains(&scale) {
            return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
        }
        let scaled_gebco_mm = definition.earth_elevation_mm(raw_gebco_m);
        if !scaled_gebco_mm.is_finite()
            || scaled_gebco_mm < i64::MIN as f64
            || scaled_gebco_mm > i64::MAX as f64
        {
            return Err(ObserverError::UnsupportedHeight);
        }
        let baseline_game_mm = (scaled_gebco_mm.round() as i64).clamp(
            definition.sea_level_mm,
            i64::from(definition.mountain_limit_mm),
        );
        let physical_anchor_m = raw_gebco_m.max(definition.sea_level_mm as f64 / f64::from(scale));
        if !physical_anchor_m.is_finite() {
            return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
        }
        Ok(Self {
            raw_gebco_m,
            baseline_game_mm,
            physical_anchor_m,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ObserverFrame {
    pub model: SkyModel,
    pub geographic: GeographicObserver,
    pub north_world: [f64; 3],
    pub east_world: [f64; 3],
    pub up_world: [f64; 3],
    pub game_eye_world_m: [f64; 3],
    pub game_planet_radius_m: f64,
    pub height_reference_revision: u32,
}

impl ObserverFrame {
    /// Converts Astronomy Engine HOR coordinates `[north, west, up]` into game axes.
    pub fn hor_to_world(self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Result<[f64; 3], ObserverError> {
        if !direction.iter().all(|component| component.is_finite()) {
            return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
        }
        let [north, west, up] = direction;
        let world = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
            self.north_world[axis] * north - self.east_world[axis] * west + self.up_world[axis] * up
        });
        if world.iter().all(|component| component.is_finite()) {
            Ok(world)
        } else {
            Err(ObserverError::NonFinite)
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ObserverInput {
    pub feet_position_mm: Position3Mm,
    pub eye_height_mm: u32,
    pub model: SkyModel,
    pub game_radius_mm: u64,
    pub planet_definition: Option<PlanetDefinition>,
    pub height_reference: Option<EarthHeightReference>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ObserverError {
    MissingPrecisePosition,
    EnvironmentProfileMismatch,
    InvalidPlanet,
    ZeroRadiusPosition,
    PositionOutOfRange,
    MissingEarthPackage,
    PackageMismatch,
    NonFinite,
    UnsupportedHeight,
    InvalidEyeHeight,
}

impl fmt::Display for ObserverError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let message = match self {
            Self::MissingPrecisePosition => "precise observer position is unavailable",
            Self::EnvironmentProfileMismatch => "environment profile does not match the world",
            Self::InvalidPlanet => "planet definition is invalid for sky observation",
            Self::ZeroRadiusPosition => "observer position is too close to the planet center",
            Self::PositionOutOfRange => "observer position exceeds the supported range",
            Self::MissingEarthPackage => "the matching GEBCO package is not installed",
            Self::PackageMismatch => "the installed GEBCO package differs from the planet",
            Self::NonFinite => "observer data contains a non-finite value",
            Self::UnsupportedHeight => "observer height is outside the supported range",
            Self::InvalidEyeHeight => "observer eye height is outside the supported range",
        };
        formatter.write_str(message)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for ObserverError {}

pub fn resolve_sky_model(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
) -> Result<SkyModel, ObserverError> {
    match (manifest.topology(), descriptor.profile()) {
        (WorldTopology::Dungeon, EnvironmentProfile::Interior) => Ok(SkyModel::None),
        (WorldTopology::Planet, EnvironmentProfile::Earth) => {
            let definition = manifest
                .planet()
                .ok_or(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch)?;
            if !definition.is_valid() {
                return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
            }
            if definition.mode != 1 {
                return Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch);
            }
            Ok(SkyModel::EarthGeoreferencedV1)
        }
        (WorldTopology::Planet, EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike) => {
            if manifest
                .planet()
                .is_some_and(|definition| !definition.is_valid())
            {
                return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
            }
            if manifest
                .planet()
                .is_some_and(|definition| definition.mode == 1)
            {
                return Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch);
            }
            Ok(SkyModel::MappedEarthSkyV1)
        }
        _ => Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch),
    }
}

pub fn normalized_observer_direction(position: Position3Mm) -> Result<[f64; 3], ObserverError> {
    let coordinates = position.coordinates();
    if coordinates
        .iter()
        .any(|component| component.unsigned_abs() > MAX_OBSERVER_POSITION_MM)
    {
        return Err(ObserverError::PositionOutOfRange);
    }
    let vector = coordinates.map(|component| component as f64);
    let radius_mm = vector
        .iter()
        .map(|component| component * component)
        .sum::<f64>()
        .sqrt();
    if !radius_mm.is_finite() {
        return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
    }
    if radius_mm <= 1000.0 {
        return Err(ObserverError::ZeroRadiusPosition);
    }
    Ok(vector.map(|component| component / radius_mm))
}

pub fn try_observer_frame(input: ObserverInput) -> Result<Option<ObserverFrame>, ObserverError> {
    if input.model == SkyModel::None {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    if input.eye_height_mm > MAX_OBSERVER_EYE_HEIGHT_MM {
        return Err(ObserverError::InvalidEyeHeight);
    }
    if !(MIN_GAME_RADIUS_MM..=MAX_GAME_RADIUS_MM).contains(&input.game_radius_mm) {
        return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
    }
    if let Some(definition) = input.planet_definition {
        if !definition.is_valid() || definition.radius_mm != input.game_radius_mm {
            return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
        }
    }

    let direction = normalized_observer_direction(input.feet_position_mm)?;
    let position = input
        .feet_position_mm
        .coordinates()
        .map(|component| component as f64);
    let radius_position_mm = position
        .iter()
        .map(|component| component * component)
        .sum::<f64>()
        .sqrt();
    let latitude_rad = direction[1].clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
    let [x_mm, _, z_mm] = input.feet_position_mm.coordinates();
    let longitude_rad = if x_mm == 0 && z_mm == 0 {
        0.0
    } else {
        let longitude = (z_mm as f64).atan2(x_mm as f64);
        if longitude >= PI {
            longitude - 2.0 * PI
        } else {
            longitude
        }
    };

    let height_m = match input.model {
        SkyModel::None => return Ok(None),
        SkyModel::EarthGeoreferencedV1 => {
            let definition = input
                .planet_definition
                .filter(|definition| definition.mode == 1)
                .ok_or(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet)?;
            if !definition.is_valid() {
                return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
            }
            let reference = input
                .height_reference
                .ok_or(ObserverError::MissingEarthPackage)?;
            if EarthHeightReference::from_gebco(reference.raw_gebco_m, definition)? != reference {
                return Err(ObserverError::UnsupportedHeight);
            }
            let residual_eye_m = (radius_position_mm
                - input.game_radius_mm as f64
                - reference.baseline_game_mm as f64
                + f64::from(input.eye_height_mm))
                / 1000.0;
            reference.physical_anchor_m + residual_eye_m
        }
        SkyModel::MappedEarthSkyV1 => {
            if input.height_reference.is_some()
                || input
                    .planet_definition
                    .is_some_and(|definition| definition.mode == 1)
            {
                return Err(ObserverError::EnvironmentProfileMismatch);
            }
            (radius_position_mm - input.game_radius_mm as f64 + f64::from(input.eye_height_mm))
                / 1000.0
        }
    };
    let geographic = GeographicObserver::new(latitude_rad, longitude_rad, height_m)?;
    let sin_latitude = latitude_rad.sin();
    let cos_latitude = latitude_rad.cos();
    let sin_longitude = longitude_rad.sin();
    let cos_longitude = longitude_rad.cos();
    let north_world = [
        -sin_latitude * cos_longitude,
        cos_latitude,
        -sin_latitude * sin_longitude,
    ];
    let east_world = [-sin_longitude, 0.0, cos_longitude];
    let up_world = [
        cos_latitude * cos_longitude,
        sin_latitude,
        cos_latitude * sin_longitude,
    ];
    let eye_radius_m = (radius_position_mm + f64::from(input.eye_height_mm)) / 1000.0;
    let game_eye_world_m = direction.map(|component| component * eye_radius_m);
    let game_planet_radius_m = input.game_radius_mm as f64 / 1000.0;
    if !game_eye_world_m
        .iter()
        .all(|component| component.is_finite())
        || !game_planet_radius_m.is_finite()
    {
        return Err(ObserverError::NonFinite);
    }
    Ok(Some(ObserverFrame {
        model: input.model,
        geographic,
        north_world,
        east_world,
        up_world,
        game_eye_world_m,
        game_planet_radius_m,
        height_reference_revision: HEIGHT_REFERENCE_REVISION,
    }))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/time/evaluation.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="253" bytes="8203" original_lines="253" original_bytes="8203" minified="false" sha256="d5354ae4d597f6e7c6c0f50033847b72aa380f64b58a446212fec2f508d46469">>>
use super::types::{
    ClockAnchor, ClockMode, ClockSample, MonotonicMs, OfflinePolicy, SavedClockState, SessionNonce,
    TimeError, TimeScalePpm, WorldTimeMs, MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE, MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS,
};

const SCALE_DENOMINATOR: i128 = 1_000_000;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RestoredClock {
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    wall_clock_went_backwards: bool,
}

impl RestoredClock {
    pub const fn anchor(self) -> ClockAnchor {
        self.anchor
    }

    pub const fn wall_clock_went_backwards(self) -> bool {
        self.wall_clock_went_backwards
    }
}

/// Evaluate one UTC value from an immutable anchor and a session-relative timestamp.
pub fn evaluate_clock(anchor: ClockAnchor, now: MonotonicMs) -> Result<WorldTimeMs, TimeError> {
    let elapsed_ms = monotonic_delta(anchor.monotonic_ms(), now)?;
    let rate_ppm = effective_rate(anchor.mode(), anchor.rate_ppm());
    let delta_world_ms = scaled_elapsed(elapsed_ms, rate_ppm)?;
    let result = i128::from(anchor.world_utc_ms().get())
        .checked_add(delta_world_ms)
        .ok_or(TimeError::ArithmeticOverflow)?;
    world_time_from_i128(result)
}

/// Build a sample whose UTC is evaluated for exactly its monotonic timestamp.
pub fn sample_clock(
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    session_nonce: SessionNonce,
    at: MonotonicMs,
) -> Result<ClockSample, TimeError> {
    ClockSample::new(
        anchor.clock_id(),
        anchor.revision(),
        session_nonce,
        at,
        evaluate_clock(anchor, at)?,
        anchor.mode(),
        anchor.rate_ppm(),
        anchor.offline_policy(),
    )
}

/// Monotonic timestamps are comparable only when both samples name one session.
pub fn validate_sample_after(sample: ClockSample, previous: ClockSample) -> Result<(), TimeError> {
    if sample.session_nonce() == previous.session_nonce()
        && sample.server_monotonic_ms() < previous.server_monotonic_ms()
    {
        Err(TimeError::NonMonotonicSample)
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Set a date and switch to TimeScale, preserving its current rate or using 1x.
pub fn set_world_time(
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    at: MonotonicMs,
    world_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
) -> Result<ClockAnchor, TimeError> {
    let _current_time = evaluate_clock(anchor, at)?;
    let rate = match anchor.mode() {
        ClockMode::RealTime => TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
        ClockMode::TimeScale => anchor.rate_ppm(),
    };
    reanchor(
        anchor,
        ClockMode::TimeScale,
        world_utc_ms,
        at,
        rate,
        anchor.offline_policy(),
    )
}

/// Set a rate and switch to TimeScale while keeping the evaluated world date.
pub fn set_time_scale(
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    at: MonotonicMs,
    rate_ppm: TimeScalePpm,
) -> Result<ClockAnchor, TimeError> {
    let current_time = evaluate_clock(anchor, at)?;
    reanchor(
        anchor,
        ClockMode::TimeScale,
        current_time,
        at,
        rate_ppm,
        anchor.offline_policy(),
    )
}

/// Change mode without a discontinuity; RealTime requires UTC from its adapter.
pub fn set_clock_mode(
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    at: MonotonicMs,
    mode: ClockMode,
    current_utc: Option<WorldTimeMs>,
) -> Result<ClockAnchor, TimeError> {
    let evaluated_time = evaluate_clock(anchor, at)?;
    let (world_time, rate) = match mode {
        ClockMode::RealTime => (
            current_utc.ok_or(TimeError::RealtimeUtcRequired)?,
            TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
        ),
        ClockMode::TimeScale => {
            let rate = match anchor.mode() {
                ClockMode::RealTime => TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
                ClockMode::TimeScale => anchor.rate_ppm(),
            };
            (evaluated_time, rate)
        }
    };
    reanchor(anchor, mode, world_time, at, rate, anchor.offline_policy())
}

/// Change only the restart policy, preserving evaluated date and clock mode.
pub fn set_offline_policy(
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    at: MonotonicMs,
    offline_policy: OfflinePolicy,
) -> Result<ClockAnchor, TimeError> {
    let current_time = evaluate_clock(anchor, at)?;
    reanchor(
        anchor,
        anchor.mode(),
        current_time,
        at,
        anchor.rate_ppm(),
        offline_policy,
    )
}

/// Capture the clock at a save boundary without persisting process-local state.
pub fn save_clock_state(
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    at: MonotonicMs,
    wall_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
) -> Result<SavedClockState, TimeError> {
    SavedClockState::new(
        anchor.clock_id(),
        anchor.revision(),
        anchor.mode(),
        evaluate_clock(anchor, at)?,
        wall_utc_ms,
        anchor.rate_ppm(),
        anchor.offline_policy(),
    )
}

/// Restore one saved clock. The saved revision is retained; the new session nonce
/// distinguishes monotonic timestamps across process restarts.
pub fn restore_clock_state(
    saved: SavedClockState,
    now_wall_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
    process_start: MonotonicMs,
) -> Result<RestoredClock, TimeError> {
    let wall_clock_went_backwards = now_wall_utc_ms < saved.saved_wall_utc_ms();
    let world_time = match (saved.mode(), saved.offline_policy()) {
        (ClockMode::RealTime, _) => now_wall_utc_ms,
        (ClockMode::TimeScale, OfflinePolicy::Pause) => saved.saved_world_utc_ms(),
        (ClockMode::TimeScale, OfflinePolicy::Advance) if wall_clock_went_backwards => {
            saved.saved_world_utc_ms()
        }
        (ClockMode::TimeScale, OfflinePolicy::Advance) => {
            let elapsed_ms = i128::from(now_wall_utc_ms.get())
                .checked_sub(i128::from(saved.saved_wall_utc_ms().get()))
                .ok_or(TimeError::ArithmeticOverflow)?;
            let advance_ms = scaled_elapsed(elapsed_ms, saved.rate_ppm())?;
            let result = i128::from(saved.saved_world_utc_ms().get())
                .checked_add(advance_ms)
                .ok_or(TimeError::ArithmeticOverflow)?;
            world_time_from_i128(result)?
        }
    };

    let anchor = ClockAnchor::new(
        saved.clock_id(),
        saved.revision(),
        saved.mode(),
        world_time,
        process_start,
        effective_rate(saved.mode(), saved.rate_ppm()),
        saved.offline_policy(),
    )?;
    Ok(RestoredClock {
        anchor,
        wall_clock_went_backwards,
    })
}

fn reanchor(
    previous: ClockAnchor,
    mode: ClockMode,
    world_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
    monotonic_ms: MonotonicMs,
    rate_ppm: TimeScalePpm,
    offline_policy: OfflinePolicy,
) -> Result<ClockAnchor, TimeError> {
    let revision = previous.revision().checked_next()?;
    ClockAnchor::new(
        previous.clock_id(),
        revision,
        mode,
        world_utc_ms,
        monotonic_ms,
        rate_ppm,
        offline_policy,
    )
}

fn monotonic_delta(start: MonotonicMs, end: MonotonicMs) -> Result<i128, TimeError> {
    if end < start {
        return Err(TimeError::NonMonotonicSample);
    }
    i128::from(end.get())
        .checked_sub(i128::from(start.get()))
        .ok_or(TimeError::ArithmeticOverflow)
}

fn scaled_elapsed(elapsed_ms: i128, rate_ppm: TimeScalePpm) -> Result<i128, TimeError> {
    if elapsed_ms < 0 {
        return Err(TimeError::NonMonotonicSample);
    }
    elapsed_ms
        .checked_mul(i128::from(rate_ppm.get()))
        .ok_or(TimeError::ArithmeticOverflow)
        .map(|scaled| scaled / SCALE_DENOMINATOR)
}

fn effective_rate(mode: ClockMode, requested: TimeScalePpm) -> TimeScalePpm {
    match mode {
        ClockMode::RealTime => TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
        ClockMode::TimeScale => requested,
    }
}

fn world_time_from_i128(value: i128) -> Result<WorldTimeMs, TimeError> {
    if value < i128::from(MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS) || value >= i128::from(MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE) {
        return Err(TimeError::OutOfSupportedRange(value));
    }
    let value = i64::try_from(value).map_err(|_| TimeError::ArithmeticOverflow)?;
    WorldTimeMs::new(value)
}

use std::fmt;

pub const MIN_WORLD_TIME_MS: i64 = 946_684_800_000;
pub const MAX_WORLD_TIME_MS_EXCLUSIVE: i64 = 4_133_980_800_000;
pub const ONE_X_PPM: u64 = 1_000_000;
pub const MAX_TIME_SCALE_PPM: u64 = 1_000_000_000_000;
pub const SESSION_NONCE_BYTES: usize = 16;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum TimeError {
    OutOfSupportedRange(i128),
    InvalidScale(u64),
    InvalidMode(u8),
    InvalidPolicy(u8),
    UnsupportedClockId(u64),
    ZeroRevision,
    NonMonotonicSample,
    ArithmeticOverflow,
    RevisionExhausted,
    RealtimeUtcRequired,
    InvalidRealtimeScale,
}

impl fmt::Display for TimeError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::OutOfSupportedRange(value) => {
                write!(
                    formatter,
                    "world time {value} ms is outside the supported range"
                )
            }
            Self::InvalidScale(value) => write!(formatter, "unsupported time scale {value} ppm"),
            Self::InvalidMode(value) => write!(formatter, "unsupported clock mode {value}"),
            Self::InvalidPolicy(value) => write!(formatter, "unsupported offline policy {value}"),
            Self::UnsupportedClockId(value) => write!(formatter, "unsupported clock id {value}"),
            Self::ZeroRevision => formatter.write_str("clock revision must be nonzero"),
            Self::NonMonotonicSample => {
                formatter.write_str("monotonic timestamp precedes its clock anchor or sample")
            }
            Self::ArithmeticOverflow => formatter.write_str("clock arithmetic overflowed"),
            Self::RevisionExhausted => formatter.write_str("clock revision is exhausted"),
            Self::RealtimeUtcRequired => {
                formatter.write_str("switching to real time requires a current UTC value")
            }
            Self::InvalidRealtimeScale => {
                formatter.write_str("real-time mode must use an effective scale of 1x")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for TimeError {}

/// MVP clock shared by the planet and interior instances.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub struct ClockId(u64);

impl ClockId {
    pub const MVP: Self = Self(1);

    pub const fn new(value: u64) -> Result<Self, TimeError> {
        if value == 1 {
            Ok(Self::MVP)
        } else {
            Err(TimeError::UnsupportedClockId(value))
        }
    }

    pub const fn get(self) -> u64 {
        self.0
    }
}

impl TryFrom<u64> for ClockId {
    type Error = TimeError;

    fn try_from(value: u64) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        Self::new(value)
    }
}

/// Monotonically increasing revision of one clock's configuration.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub struct ClockRevision(u64);

impl ClockRevision {
    pub const INITIAL: Self = Self(1);

    pub const fn new(value: u64) -> Result<Self, TimeError> {
        if value == 0 {
            Err(TimeError::ZeroRevision)
        } else {
            Ok(Self(value))
        }
    }

    pub const fn get(self) -> u64 {
        self.0
    }

    pub const fn checked_next(self) -> Result<Self, TimeError> {
        match self.0.checked_add(1) {
            Some(value) => Ok(Self(value)),
            None => Err(TimeError::RevisionExhausted),
        }
    }
}

impl TryFrom<u64> for ClockRevision {
    type Error = TimeError;

    fn try_from(value: u64) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        Self::new(value)
    }
}

/// POSIX UTC milliseconds, bounded to the supported astronomical date range.

        self.0

}

        Self::new(value)
    }
}

/// A nonnegative multiplier in parts per million; zero pauses the world clock.

        self.0

        Self::new(value)

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum ClockMode {
    RealTime = 0,
    TimeScale = 1,
}

impl TryFrom<u8> for ClockMode {
    type Error = TimeError;

    fn try_from(value: u8) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        match value {
            0 => Ok(Self::RealTime),
            1 => Ok(Self::TimeScale),
            other => Err(TimeError::InvalidMode(other)),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum OfflinePolicy {
    #[default]
    Pause = 0,
    Advance = 1,
}

impl TryFrom<u8> for OfflinePolicy {
    type Error = TimeError;

    fn try_from(value: u8) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        match value {
            0 => Ok(Self::Pause),
            1 => Ok(Self::Advance),
            other => Err(TimeError::InvalidPolicy(other)),
        }
    }
}

/// Immutable anchor used to evaluate world time without accumulated frame deltas.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]

    mode: ClockMode,
    world_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
    monotonic_ms: MonotonicMs,
    rate_ppm: TimeScalePpm,
    offline_policy: OfflinePolicy,
}

impl ClockAnchor {
    pub const fn initial(
        mode: ClockMode,
        world_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
        monotonic_ms: MonotonicMs,
        rate_ppm: TimeScalePpm,
        offline_policy: OfflinePolicy,
    ) -> Result<Self, TimeError> {
        Self::new(
            ClockId::MVP,
            ClockRevision::INITIAL,
            mode,
            world_utc_ms,
            monotonic_ms,
            rate_ppm,
            offline_policy,
        )
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub const fn new(
        clock_id: ClockId,
        revision: ClockRevision,
        mode: ClockMode,
        world_utc_ms: WorldTimeMs,
        monotonic_ms: MonotonicMs,
        rate_ppm: TimeScalePpm,
        offline_policy: OfflinePolicy,
    ) -> Result<Self, TimeError> {
        if matches!(mode, ClockMode::RealTime) && rate_ppm.get() != ONE_X_PPM {
            return Err(TimeError::InvalidRealtimeScale);
        }
        Ok(Self {
            clock_id,
            revision,
            mode,
            world_utc_ms,
            monotonic_ms,
            rate_ppm,
            offline_policy,
        })
    }

        self.clock_id

        self.revision

        self.world_utc_ms
    }

    pub const fn monotonic_ms(self) -> MonotonicMs {
        self.monotonic_ms
    }

    pub const fn rate_ppm(self) -> TimeScalePpm {
        self.rate_ppm
    }

    pub const fn offline_policy(self) -> OfflinePolicy {
        self.offline_policy
    }

//! Lightweight solar-system definition graph. It does not simulate galaxies or
//! N-body gravitation. A body may exist without an explorable WorldDefinitionId.

    pub const fn new(value: u64) -> Option<Self> {

        }
    }

    pub const fn get(self) -> u64 {
        self.0

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BodyKind {
    Star,
    Planet,
    Moon,
    MinorBody,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Ephemeris {
    /// Position relative to parent, in metres, in J2000 EQJ axes.
    Fixed([f64; 3]),
    /// Simplified circular orbit used until a precise ephemeris provider exists.
    Circular {
        radius_m: f64,
        period_seconds: f64,
        phase_rad: f64,
    },
}
impl Ephemeris {
    fn position_at(self, time_seconds: f64) -> [f64; 3] {
        match self {
            Self::Fixed(position) => position,
            Self::Circular {
                radius_m,
                period_seconds,
                phase_rad,
            } => {
                let angle = phase_rad + 2.0 * PI * (time_seconds / period_seconds);
                [radius_m * angle.cos(), radius_m * angle.sin(), 0.0]
            }
        }
    }
    fn is_valid(self) -> bool {
        match self {
            Self::Fixed(value) => value.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()),
            Self::Circular {
                radius_m,
                period_seconds,
                phase_rad,
            } => {
                radius_m.is_finite()
                    && radius_m > 0.0
                    && period_seconds.is_finite()
                    && period_seconds > 0.0
                    && phase_rad.is_finite()
            }
        }
    }
}

pub struct UniverseCatalog {
    systems: BTreeMap<SolarSystemId, Vec<CelestialBodyId>>,
    bodies: BTreeMap<CelestialBodyId, CelestialBodyDefinition>,
}

fn sub(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]]
}
fn dot(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]
}
fn length(v: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    dot(v, v).sqrt()
}
fn normalize(v: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    let d = length(v).max(1.0e-12);
    v.map(|n| n / d)
}
fn scale_rgb(rgb: [f64; 3], factor: f64) -> [f64; 3] {
    rgb.map(|value| value * factor)
}

fn segment_intersects_sphere(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3], center: [f64; 3], radius: f64) -> bool {
    let ab = sub(b, a);
    let denominator = dot(ab, ab);
    if denominator < 1.0e-18 {
        return false;
    }
    let t = (dot(sub(center, a), ab) / denominator).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let closest = [a[0] + ab[0] * t, a[1] + ab[1] * t, a[2] + ab[2] * t];
    dot(sub(closest, center), sub(closest, center)) < radius * radius
}

impl UniverseCatalog {
    pub fn add_system(&mut self, id: SolarSystemId) -> Result<(), CatalogError> {
        if self.systems.contains_key(&id) {
            return Err(CatalogError::DuplicateSystem);
        }
        self.systems.insert(id, Vec::new());
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn register(&mut self, body: CelestialBodyDefinition) -> Result<(), CatalogError> {
        if self.bodies.contains_key(&body.id) {
            return Err(CatalogError::DuplicateBody);
        }
        if self.bodies.len() >= MAX_CELESTIAL_BODIES {
            return Err(CatalogError::BodyLimit);
        }
        if !self.systems.contains_key(&body.system) {
            return Err(CatalogError::UnknownSystem);
        }
        if body.parent == Some(body.id) {
            return Err(CatalogError::ParentCycle);
        }
        if let Some(parent) = body.parent {
            let parent_body = self
                .bodies
                .get(&parent)
                .ok_or(CatalogError::MissingParent)?;
            if parent_body.system != body.system {
                return Err(CatalogError::CrossSystemParent);
            }
        }
        if !body.radius_m.is_finite()
            || body.radius_m <= 0.0
            || !body.orbit.is_valid()
            || !body.optics.albedo.is_finite()
            || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&body.optics.albedo)
            || !body.optics.atmosphere_scattering.is_finite()
            || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&body.optics.atmosphere_scattering)
            || body.emission.is_some_and(|light| {
                !light.reference_distance_m.is_finite()
                    || light.reference_distance_m <= 0.0
                    || !light
                        .linear_rgb
                        .iter()
                        .all(|channel| channel.is_finite() && *channel >= 0.0)
            })
        {
            return Err(CatalogError::InvalidBody);
        }
        self.systems
            .get_mut(&body.system)
            .expect("system checked")
            .push(body.id);
        self.bodies.insert(body.id, body);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn body(&self, id: CelestialBodyId) -> Option<&CelestialBodyDefinition> {
        self.bodies.get(&id)
    }
    pub fn bodies_in(
        &self,
        system: SolarSystemId,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = &CelestialBodyDefinition> {
        self.systems
            .get(&system)
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter_map(|id| self.body(*id))
    }

    /// Returns system identifiers in stable numeric order.
    pub fn systems(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = SolarSystemId> + '_ {
        self.systems.keys().copied()
    }

    pub fn body_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.bodies.len()
    }

    pub fn position_at(
        &self,
        id: CelestialBodyId,
        time_seconds: f64,
    ) -> Result<[f64; 3], CatalogError> {
        if !time_seconds.is_finite() {
            return Err(CatalogError::InvalidTime);
        }
        let body = self.bodies.get(&id).ok_or(CatalogError::InvalidBody)?;
        let offset = body.orbit.position_at(time_seconds);
        let position = if let Some(parent) = body.parent {
            let center = self.position_at(parent, time_seconds)?;
            [
                center[0] + offset[0],
                center[1] + offset[1],
                center[2] + offset[2],
            ]
        } else {
            offset
        };
        if position.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
            Ok(position)
        } else {
            Err(CatalogError::InvalidBody)
        }
    }

    /// Evaluate a bounded list of sources with phase, full occlusion and a
    /// simple atmosphere-scattering estimate. Rendering handles glare/bloom.
    pub fn observe(
        &self,
        system: SolarSystemId,
        observer_m: [f64; 3],
        time_seconds: f64,
    ) -> Result<Vec<BodyObservation>, CatalogError> {
        if !observer_m.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) || !time_seconds.is_finite() {
            return Err(CatalogError::InvalidTime);
        }
        if !self.systems.contains_key(&system) {
            return Err(CatalogError::UnknownSystem);
        }
        let definitions: Vec<_> = self.bodies_in(system).copied().collect();
        let positions = definitions
            .iter()
            .map(|body| self.position_at(body.id, time_seconds))
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
        let mut observations = Vec::with_capacity(definitions.len());
        for (index, body) in definitions.iter().enumerate() {
            let target = positions[index];
            let to_body = sub(target, observer_m);
            let distance = length(to_body);
            if !distance.is_finite() {
                return Err(CatalogError::InvalidBody);
            }
            let visible = !definitions.iter().enumerate().any(|(j, occluder)| {
                j != index
                    && length(sub(positions[j], observer_m)) < distance
                    && segment_intersects_sphere(
                        observer_m,
                        target,
                        positions[j],
                        occluder.radius_m,
                    )
            });
            let emitted = body.emission.map_or([0.0; 3], |light| {
                scale_rgb(
                    light.linear_rgb,
                    (light.reference_distance_m / distance.max(1.0)).powi(2),
                )
            });
            let mut reflected = [0.0; 3];
            let mut illuminated_sum = 0.0;
            let mut illumination_weight = 0.0;
            for (j, source) in definitions.iter().enumerate() {
                let Some(light) = source.emission else {
                    continue;
                };
                if j == index {
                    continue;
                }
                let from_target = sub(positions[j], target);
                let source_distance = length(from_target);
                let occluded = definitions.iter().enumerate().any(|(k, obstacle)| {
                    k != index
                        && k != j
                        && segment_intersects_sphere(
                            target,
                            positions[j],
                            positions[k],
                            obstacle.radius_m,
                        )
                });
                if occluded {
                    continue;
                }
                let cos_phase = dot(normalize(from_target), normalize(sub(observer_m, target)))
                    .clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
                let alpha = cos_phase.acos();
                let phase = ((alpha.sin() + (PI - alpha) * alpha.cos()) / PI).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                let flux = (light.reference_distance_m / source_distance.max(1.0)).powi(2)
                    * body.optics.albedo
                    * phase;
                // An apparent-disk fraction keeps far-away reflectors dim.
                let disk_factor = (body.radius_m / distance.max(body.radius_m)).powi(2);
                let rgb = scale_rgb(light.linear_rgb, flux * disk_factor);
                for c in 0..3 {
                    reflected[c] += rgb[c];
                }
                // Geometric illuminated fraction is independent of albedo and phase brightness.
                let illumination = ((1.0 + cos_phase) * 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                let weight = (light.reference_distance_m / source_distance.max(1.0)).powi(2)
                    * light.linear_rgb.iter().sum::<f64>();
                illuminated_sum += illumination * weight;
                illumination_weight += weight;
            }
            let reflected = if visible { reflected } else { [0.0; 3] };
            let emitted = if visible { emitted } else { [0.0; 3] };
            let atmosphere_limb_rgb = scale_rgb(reflected, body.optics.atmosphere_scattering);
            if !emitted
                .iter()
                .chain(reflected.iter())
                .chain(atmosphere_limb_rgb.iter())
                .all(|value| value.is_finite())
            {
                return Err(CatalogError::InvalidBody);
            }
            let illuminated_fraction = if illumination_weight > 0.0 {
                illuminated_sum / illumination_weight
            } else {
                0.0
            };
            if !illuminated_fraction.is_finite() {
                return Err(CatalogError::InvalidBody);
            }
            observations.push(BodyObservation {
                id: body.id,
                kind: body.kind,
                direction: normalize(to_body),
                distance_m: distance,
                angular_radius_rad: (body.radius_m / distance.max(body.radius_m)).asin(),
                emitted_linear_rgb: emitted,
                reflected_linear_rgb: reflected,
                atmosphere_limb_rgb,
                illuminated_fraction,
                visible,
            });
        }
        Ok(observations)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn circular_child_position_and_nearer_occluder_are_deterministic() {
        let system = SolarSystemId::new(1).unwrap();
        let star = CelestialBodyId::new(1).unwrap();
        let occluder = CelestialBodyId::new(2).unwrap();
        let moon = CelestialBodyId::new(3).unwrap();
        let mut catalog = UniverseCatalog::default();
        catalog.add_system(system).unwrap();
        let optics = SurfaceOptics {
            albedo: 0.5,
            atmosphere_scattering: 0.0,
        };
        catalog
            .register(CelestialBodyDefinition {
                id: star,
                system,
                kind: BodyKind::Star,
                parent: None,
                orbit: Ephemeris::Fixed([10.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
                radius_m: 1.0,
                emission: Some(LightEmitter {
                    linear_rgb: [1.0; 3],
                    reference_distance_m: 10.0,
                }),
                optics,
                explorable: None,
            })
            .unwrap();
        catalog
            .register(CelestialBodyDefinition {
                id: occluder,
                system,
                kind: BodyKind::Planet,
                parent: None,
                orbit: Ephemeris::Fixed([5.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
                radius_m: 1.0,
                emission: None,
                optics,
                explorable: None,
            })
            .unwrap();
        catalog
            .register(CelestialBodyDefinition {
                id: moon,
                system,
                kind: BodyKind::Moon,
                parent: Some(star),
                orbit: Ephemeris::Circular {
                    radius_m: 2.0,
                    period_seconds: 4.0,
                    phase_rad: 0.0,
                },
                radius_m: 0.5,
                emission: None,
                optics,
                explorable: None,
            })
            .unwrap();
        let at_quarter = catalog.position_at(moon, 1.0).unwrap();
        assert!((at_quarter[0] - 10.0).abs() < 1e-12);
        assert!((at_quarter[1] - 2.0).abs() < 1e-12);
        let observations = catalog.observe(system, [0.0; 3], 0.0).unwrap();
        assert!(
            !observations
                .iter()
                .find(|body| body.id == star)
                .unwrap()
                .visible
        );
        assert!(
            observations
                .iter()
                .find(|body| body.id == occluder)
                .unwrap()
                .visible
        );
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/weather/climate.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="168" bytes="5848" original_lines="168" original_bytes="5848" minified="false" sha256="9979e07a05ee13ca8e8de893fef0cf4c9f3c939c5ae10dd948d7db9daae1540c">>>
use super::{
    random, rotate, Conditions, LayerConditions, SeasonalProfile, TerrainSampler, WeatherModel,
};
use glam::DVec3;

pub(super) fn sample<T: TerrainSampler>(model: &WeatherModel<T>, p: DVec3, utc: f64) -> Conditions {
    sample_at(model, p, utc, &site(model, p))
}

pub(super) struct Site {
    ground: f64,
    climate_ground: f64,
    ocean: bool,
    supply: f64,
    uplift: f64,
}

pub(super) fn site<T: TerrainSampler>(model: &WeatherModel<T>, p: DVec3) -> Site {
    let (ground, ocean) = model.terrain(p);
    let water = |d: DVec3| {
        let (_, ocean) = model.terrain(d);
        f64::from(ocean || (model.is_earth() && model.contains_lake(d)))
    };
    // Moisture is carried eastward from a broad, continuously sampled fetch.
    let east = DVec3::new(-p.z, 0.0, p.x).normalize_or_zero();
    let north = p.cross(east);
    let mut supply = water(p) * 0.25;
    for i in 1..=4 {
        let upstream = (p - east * (i as f64 * 0.006)).normalize();
        for side in [-1.0, 0.0, 1.0] {
            supply += water((upstream + north * side * 0.002).normalize()) * 0.0625;
        }
    }
    let climate_ground = model.climate_elevation_m(p);
    let upstream_ground = model.climate_elevation_m((p - east * 0.004).normalize());
    let uplift = ((climate_ground - upstream_ground) / 1800.0).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
    Site {
        ground,
        climate_ground,
        ocean,
        supply,
        uplift,
    }
}

pub(super) fn climate_at<T: TerrainSampler>(
    model: &WeatherModel<T>,
    p: DVec3,
    utc: f64,
    site: &Site,
) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
    let Site {
        climate_ground,
        ocean,
        supply,
        uplift,
        ..
    } = *site;
    let lat = p.y.asin();
    let lon = p.z.atan2(p.x);
    let time = utc.rem_euclid(86400.0) / 86400.0 * std::f64::consts::TAU + lon;
    let baseline = match model.profile {
        SeasonalProfile::AnnualMean | SeasonalProfile::Seasonal => {
            crate::climate::annual_temperature_c(lat)
        }
    };
    let seasonal = if model.profile == SeasonalProfile::Seasonal {
        crate::climate::seasonality(p, utc) * if ocean { 7.0 } else { 18.0 }
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    let offset = model.scenario.offset(p, utc);
    let temperature = baseline + seasonal + offset.temperature_c - 0.0065 * climate_ground.max(0.0)
        + (if ocean { 1.5 } else { 5.0 }) * (time - std::f64::consts::PI * 1.25).cos();
    let moving = rotate(
        p,
        -utc.rem_euclid(8_000_000.0) * std::f64::consts::TAU / 8_000_000.0,
    );
    let seed = model.seed();
    let weather = noise(moving * 34.0, seed) * 0.65 + noise(moving * 73.0, seed ^ 19) * 0.35;
    let dry_belt = (-((lat.abs() - 0.5) / 0.16).powi(2)).exp();
    let humidity =
        (0.28 + offset.moisture + 0.44 * supply + 0.4 * (weather - 0.5) + uplift.max(0.0) * 0.18
            - dry_belt * 0.17)
            .clamp(0.02, 0.99);
    (temperature, humidity, weather)
}

pub(super) fn sample_at<T: TerrainSampler>(
    model: &WeatherModel<T>,
    p: DVec3,
    utc: f64,
    site: &Site,
) -> Conditions {
    let (temperature, humidity, weather) = climate_at(model, p, utc, site);
    let Site {
        ground,
        supply,
        uplift,
        ..
    } = *site;
    let layers = std::array::from_fn(|layer| {
        let threshold = [0.38, 0.45, 0.5][layer];
        let thermal = if layer == 2 {
            (-temperature / 80.0).clamp(-0.2, 0.2)
        } else {
            ((temperature + 30.0) / 80.0).clamp(0.0, 0.1)
        };
        let coverage =
            ((humidity - threshold) * 2.8 + [0.0, 0.03, 0.08][layer] * weather + thermal)
                .clamp(0.0, 0.95);
        let base = match layer {
            0 => ground.max(0.0) + (500.0 + (1.0 - humidity) * 1500.0) * model.scale,
            1 => (2600.0 + (1.0 - humidity) * 1900.0) * model.scale,
            _ => (7000.0 + (temperature + 30.0).clamp(0.0, 60.0) * 45.0) * model.scale,
        };
        LayerConditions {
            coverage,
            base_m: base.max(ground + 300.0 * model.scale),
            thickness_m: [
                400.0 + 1300.0 * humidity,
                500.0 + 700.0 * humidity,
                250.0 + 400.0 * humidity,
            ][layer]
                * model.scale,
            max_base_m: match layer {
                0 => ground.max(0.0) + 2000.0 * model.scale,
                1 => 6000.0 * model.scale,
                _ => 11000.0 * model.scale,
            },
            ceiling_m: match layer {
                0 => ground.max(0.0) + 3500.0 * model.scale,
                1 => 7000.0 * model.scale,
                _ => 12000.0 * model.scale,
            },
        }
    });
    Conditions {
        temperature_c: temperature,
        humidity,
        water_supply: supply,
        uplift,
        layers,
    }
}

/// Trilinear smooth value noise in 3-D; there are no face or longitude seams.
pub(crate) fn noise(p: DVec3, seed: u64) -> f64 {
    let cell = p.floor();
    let t = p - cell;
    let t = t * t * (DVec3::splat(3.0) - t * 2.0);
    let mut value = 0.0;
    for z in 0..2 {
        for y in 0..2 {
            for x in 0..2 {
                let key = seed
                    ^ ((cell.x as i64 + x) as u64).wrapping_mul(73856093)
                    ^ ((cell.y as i64 + y) as u64).wrapping_mul(19349663)
                    ^ ((cell.z as i64 + z) as u64).wrapping_mul(83492791);
                value += random(key)
                    * (if x == 0 { 1.0 - t.x } else { t.x })
                    * (if y == 0 { 1.0 - t.y } else { t.y })
                    * (if z == 0 { 1.0 - t.z } else { t.z });
            }
        }
    }
    value
}
