<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/weather/families.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="131" bytes="4853" original_lines="131" original_bytes="4853" minified="false" sha256="44034be37e886d13d680dff607ca114720759c3889cee45fc3ed4c33543e9f80">>>
//! Phenomenological families, reference Earth dimensions and altitude envelopes.
use super::{random, Cloud, Conditions, TerrainSampler, WeatherModel};
use glam::DVec3;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum CloudKind {
    Cumulus,
    Congestus,
    Cumulonimbus,
    Stratus,
    Stratocumulus,
    Nimbostratus,
    Altocumulus,
    Altostratus,
    Lenticularis,
    Cirrus,
    Cirrocumulus,
    Cirrostratus,
}

impl CloudKind {
    pub const ALL: [Self; 12] = [
        Self::Cumulus,
        Self::Congestus,
        Self::Cumulonimbus,
        Self::Stratus,
        Self::Stratocumulus,
        Self::Nimbostratus,
        Self::Altocumulus,
        Self::Altostratus,
        Self::Lenticularis,
        Self::Cirrus,
        Self::Cirrocumulus,
        Self::Cirrostratus,
    ];

    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Cumulus => "cumulus",
            Self::Congestus => "cumulus-congestus",
            Self::Cumulonimbus => "cumulonimbus",
            Self::Stratus => "stratus",
            Self::Stratocumulus => "stratocumulus",
            Self::Nimbostratus => "nimbostratus",
            Self::Altocumulus => "altocumulus",
            Self::Altostratus => "altostratus",
            Self::Lenticularis => "lenticularis",
            Self::Cirrus => "cirrus",
            Self::Cirrocumulus => "cirrocumulus",
            Self::Cirrostratus => "cirrostratus",
        }
    }

    pub fn morph_seconds(self) -> f64 {
        match self {
            Self::Cumulus | Self::Congestus | Self::Cumulonimbus => 12.0,
            Self::Cirrus | Self::Cirrocumulus => 18.0,
            _ => 24.0,
        }
    }

    pub fn select(c: Conditions, layer: usize, id: u64) -> Self {
        let r = random(id ^ 0x63f1);
        let convection =
            ((c.temperature_c - 5.0) / 25.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) * c.humidity + c.uplift.max(0.0) * 0.4;
        match layer {
            0 if convection > 0.65 && c.humidity > 0.65 && r < 0.16 => Self::Cumulonimbus,
            0 if convection > 0.45 && r < 0.35 => Self::Congestus,
            0 if c.humidity > 0.68 && convection < 0.4 && r < 0.22 => Self::Nimbostratus,
            0 if convection < 0.3 && r < 0.5 => Self::Stratus,
            0 if r < 0.7 => Self::Stratocumulus,
            0 => Self::Cumulus,
            1 if c.uplift > 0.18 && r < 0.35 => Self::Lenticularis,
            1 if c.humidity > 0.6 && r < 0.65 => Self::Altostratus,
            1 => Self::Altocumulus,
            _ if r < 0.45 || c.layers[2].coverage < 0.3 => Self::Cirrus,
            _ if r < 0.75 => Self::Cirrocumulus,
            _ => Self::Cirrostratus,
        }
    }
}

/// Returns the allowed base/top. Convective and nimbostratus columns span floors.
pub(super) fn configure<T: TerrainSampler>(
    model: &WeatherModel<T>,
    c: Conditions,
    cloud: &mut Cloud,
) -> (f64, f64) {
    use CloudKind::*;
    let kind = CloudKind::select(c, cloud.layer, cloud.id);
    let layer = c.layers[cloud.layer];
    let r = random(cloud.id ^ 0xf37a);
    let (width, height, aspect, optical) = match kind {
        Cumulus => (2800.0, 1100.0, 0.8, 1.3),
        Congestus => (3300.0, 4300.0, 0.85, 2.2),
        Cumulonimbus => (6500.0, 8500.0, 0.85, 3.2),
        Stratus => (7000.0, 650.0, 0.85, 0.8),
        Stratocumulus => (6500.0, 1250.0, 0.85, 1.2),
        Nimbostratus => (8500.0, 3400.0, 0.9, 2.4),
        Altocumulus => (6000.0, 900.0, 0.7, 0.7),
        Altostratus => (8500.0, 1200.0, 0.85, 0.65),
        Lenticularis => (4500.0, 1100.0, 0.5, 0.9),
        Cirrus => (6500.0, 650.0, 0.35, 0.25),
        Cirrocumulus => (6500.0, 550.0, 0.7, 0.3),
        Cirrostratus => (9500.0, 700.0, 0.85, 0.22),
    };
    let ceiling = match kind {
        Congestus => (cloud.base_m + 6500.0 * model.scale).min(10000.0 * model.scale),
        Cumulonimbus => 12000.0 * model.scale,
        Nimbostratus => 7000.0 * model.scale,
        _ => layer.ceiling_m,
    };
    let width = width * (0.75 + r * 0.5);
    let height = (height * (0.75 + c.humidity * 0.5)).min((ceiling - cloud.base_m) / model.scale);
    let raw = DVec3::new(width, height.max(100.0), width * aspect) * model.scale;
    // Dyadic lattice: choose a root size and snap the support inward. At least
    // two vertical cells preserve thin layers even when detail is budget-limited.
    let root = raw.max_element();
    let min_level = ((2.0 * root / raw.min_element()).log2().ceil() as u8).clamp(2, 6);
    let cell = root / f64::from(1_u32 << min_level);
    cloud.kind = kind;
    cloud.size_m = ((raw / cell) + DVec3::splat(1e-10))
        .floor()
        .max(DVec3::splat(1.0))
        * cell;
    cloud.min_level = min_level;
    cloud.max_level = 6;
    cloud.opacity = (optical * (0.4 + layer.coverage * 0.6)) as f32;
    (layer.max_base_m, ceiling)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/weather/mod.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="286" bytes="8674" original_lines="286" original_bytes="8674" minified="false" sha256="ad3299af3fd3c5efbd73c319b2537d916b444801f5ff7116c411029eff55c7d3">>>
//! Deterministic regional weather. No camera, GPU, network or persistence state.
mod climate;
mod families;
mod population;
mod shape;
pub use families::CloudKind;
pub use shape::DensityField;
pub mod region;

use glam::DVec3;
use minimium_world::world::{WorldManifest, WorldTopology};
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub const EARTH_RADIUS: f64 = 6_371_000.0;
pub const MAX_CLOUDS: usize = 8192;
pub const MAX_CACHED_CLOUDS: usize = 16384;
pub const CORE_ANGLE: f64 = 0.034;
pub const OUTER_ANGLE: f64 = 0.055;
pub(crate) const LIFETIME: f64 = 3600.0;
pub(crate) const POPULATION_SECONDS: f64 = 1800.0;
pub(crate) const WIND: [f64; 3] = [5.0, 10.0, 20.0];

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SeasonalProfile {
    AnnualMean,
    Seasonal,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u32)]
pub enum CloudDebug {
    #[default]
    Off,
    Regions,
    Layers,
    Wind,
    Kinds,
    Detail,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct LayerConditions {
    pub coverage: f64,
    pub base_m: f64,
    pub thickness_m: f64,
    pub max_base_m: f64,
    pub ceiling_m: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Conditions {
    pub temperature_c: f64,
    pub humidity: f64,
    pub water_supply: f64,
    pub uplift: f64,
    pub layers: [LayerConditions; 3],
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Cloud {
    pub id: u64,
    pub source: region::Region,
    pub layer: usize,
    pub birth_utc: f64,
    pub direction: DVec3,
    pub base_m: f64,
    pub kind: CloudKind,
    /// Bounds include all deformation; the lattice is nested at every level.
    pub size_m: DVec3,
    pub min_level: u8,
    pub max_level: u8,
    pub opacity: f32,
}

impl Cloud {
    pub fn angular_speed(self) -> f64 {
        WIND[self.layer] / EARTH_RADIUS / (1.0 - self.direction.y.powi(2)).sqrt().max(0.03)
    }

    pub fn direction_at(self, utc: f64) -> DVec3 {
        rotate(
            self.direction,
            self.angular_speed() * (utc - self.birth_utc),
        )
    }

    pub fn extent_m(self) -> f64 {
        self.size_m.x.hypot(self.size_m.z) * 0.5
    }

    pub fn grid(self, level: u8) -> ([usize; 3], f64) {
        let cell = self.size_m.max_element() / f64::from(1_u32 << level);
        (
            self.size_m
                .to_array()
                .map(|v| (v / cell).round().max(1.0) as usize),
            cell,
        )
    }

    /// Per-cloud windows avoid a simultaneous whole-sky mesh transition.
    pub fn morph_window(self, utc: f64) -> (i64, f64, f64) {
        let step = self.kind.morph_seconds();
        let phase = random(self.id ^ 0x37a4) * step;
        let index = ((utc - self.birth_utc + phase) / step).floor() as i64;
        (index, index as f64 * step - phase, step)
    }
}

pub struct CloudSnapshot {
    pub utc: f64,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub observer: DVec3,
    pub conditions: Conditions,
    pub region: region::Region,
    pub regions: Vec<region::Region>,
    pub clouds: Vec<Cloud>,
    pub limited: bool,
}

pub struct WeatherModel<T: TerrainSampler> {
    pub manifest: WorldManifest,
    pub radius: f64,
    pub scale: f64,
    elevation_scale: f64,
    pub profile: SeasonalProfile,
    scenario: crate::climate::ClimateScenario,
    terrain: T,
    is_earth: bool,
    cache: HashMap<u64, Cloud>,
}

pub trait TerrainSampler: Send + Sync + 'static {
    fn sample(&self, direction: DVec3) -> (f64, bool);
    /// Source height above the sea datum, before any relief exaggeration.
    fn source_elevation_m(&self, _direction: DVec3) -> Option<f64> {
        None
    }
    fn contains_lake(&self, latitude_degrees: f64, longitude_degrees: f64) -> bool;
    fn earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(&self, direction: DVec3, angle: f64) -> Option<f64>;
    fn relief_bound_m(&self) -> f64;
}

impl<T: TerrainSampler> WeatherModel<T> {
    pub fn new(
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        profile: SeasonalProfile,
        radius_m: f64,
        is_earth: bool,
        terrain: T,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        if manifest.topology() != WorldTopology::Planet {
            return None;
        }
        if !radius_m.is_finite() || radius_m <= 0.0 {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self {
            manifest,
            radius: radius_m,
            scale: radius_m / EARTH_RADIUS,
            elevation_scale: manifest
                .planet()
                .filter(|planet| planet.mode == 1)
                .map_or(1.0, |planet| {
                    f64::from(planet.height_scale_permille.max(1)) / 1000.0
                }),
            profile,
            scenario: crate::climate::ClimateScenario::default(),
            terrain,
            is_earth,
            cache: HashMap::with_capacity(MAX_CACHED_CLOUDS),
        })
    }

    pub fn sample(&self, direction: DVec3, utc: f64) -> Conditions {
        climate::sample(self, direction.normalize(), utc)
    }

    pub fn set_scenario(
        &mut self,
        scenario: crate::climate::ClimateScenario,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        scenario.validate()?;
        if self.scenario == scenario {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.scenario = scenario;
        self.cache.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn surface_cover(&self, direction: DVec3, utc: f64) -> crate::climate::SurfaceCoverSample {
        self.surface_state(direction, utc).cover
    }

    pub fn surface_state(&self, direction: DVec3, utc: f64) -> crate::climate::SurfaceState {
        let direction = direction.normalize();
        let site = climate::site(self, direction);
        let at = |time| {
            let (temperature_c, humidity, _) = climate::climate_at(self, direction, time, &site);
            crate::climate::ClimateSample {
                temperature_c,
                moisture: humidity,
                seasonality: crate::climate::seasonality(direction, time),
            }
        };
        crate::climate::SurfaceState {
            cover: crate::climate::surface_cover(utc, at),
            climate: at(utc),
            source_elevation_m: self.ground_elevation_m(direction),
            climate_elevation_m: self.climate_elevation_m(direction),
        }
    }

    /// Physical source elevation for presentation weather, without GPU or I/O.
    pub fn ground_elevation_m(&self, direction: DVec3) -> f64 {
        if let Some(p) = self.manifest.planet().filter(|p| p.peak_relief.enabled()) {
            let direction = direction.normalize();
            return self
                .terrain
                .source_elevation_m(direction)
                .map(|h| h.max(0.0))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| p.source_height_above_sea_m(self.terrain(direction).0));
        }
        self.terrain(direction.normalize()).0 / self.elevation_scale
    }

    /// Rendered ground expressed in the linear optical atmosphere coordinate scale.
    pub fn atmospheric_ground_height_m(&self, direction: DVec3) -> f64 {
        self.terrain(direction.normalize()).0 / self.elevation_scale
    }

    pub fn climate_elevation_m(&self, direction: DVec3) -> f64 {
        let source = self.ground_elevation_m(direction);
        let influence = self.scenario.relief_influence;
        if influence == 0.0 {
            source
        } else {
            source + (self.atmospheric_ground_height_m(direction) - source) * influence
        }
    }

    fn seed(&self) -> u64 {
        let seed = self.manifest.generation().seed().get();
        hash(seed as u64) ^ hash((seed >> 64) as u64).rotate_left(17)
    }

    pub fn terrain(&self, direction: DVec3) -> (f64, bool) {
        self.terrain.sample(direction)
    }

    pub fn contains_lake(&self, direction: DVec3) -> bool {
        self.terrain.contains_lake(
            direction.y.asin().to_degrees(),
            direction.z.atan2(direction.x).to_degrees(),
        )
    }

    pub const fn is_earth(&self) -> bool {
        self.is_earth
    }

    pub fn query(&mut self, observer: DVec3, utc: f64, revision: u64) -> CloudSnapshot {
        population::query(self, observer.normalize(), utc, revision)
    }
}

pub fn surface_key(direction: DVec3) -> minimium_world::world::CubeSampleKey {
    region::surface_key(direction)
}

pub(crate) fn rotate(p: DVec3, angle: f64) -> DVec3 {
    let (s, c) = angle.rem_euclid(std::f64::consts::TAU).sin_cos();
    DVec3::new(c * p.x - s * p.z, p.y, s * p.x + c * p.z)
}

pub(crate) fn hash(mut x: u64) -> u64 {
    x = (x ^ (x >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9);
    x = (x ^ (x >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94d049bb133111eb);
    x ^ (x >> 31)
}

pub(crate) fn random(seed: u64) -> f64 {
    (hash(seed) >> 11) as f64 / (1_u64 << 53) as f64
}

use super::*;

pub(super) fn query<T: TerrainSampler>(
    model: &mut WeatherModel<T>,
    observer: DVec3,
    utc: f64,
    revision: u64,
) -> CloudSnapshot {
    // A cap expanded by lifetime * fastest wind includes every incoming source,
    // including paths across cube faces. Region size is never a weather boundary.
    let sources = region::intersecting(
        observer,
        OUTER_ANGLE + WIND[2] * LIFETIME / EARTH_RADIUS + 0.006,
    );
    let epoch = (utc / POPULATION_SECONDS).floor() as i64;
    model.cache.retain(|_, cloud| {
        utc >= cloud.birth_utc - POPULATION_SECONDS && utc <= cloud.birth_utc + LIFETIME
    });
    let mut clouds = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    let mut limited = false;
    for source in &sources {
        for layer in 0..3 {
            for population in epoch - 2..=epoch {
                for slot in 0..4 {
                    let id = hash(
                        model.seed()
                            ^ region::address(*source).wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)
                            ^ (layer as u64 * 17 + slot).wrapping_mul(0xd6e8feb86659fd93)
                            ^ hash(population as u64),
                    );
                    let birth = population as f64 * POPULATION_SECONDS
                        + random(id ^ 1) * POPULATION_SECONDS;
                    if utc < birth || utc > birth + LIFETIME {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let cloud = if let Some(cloud) = model.cache.get(&id) {
                        *cloud
                    } else {
                        let direction = region::point(*source, random(id ^ 2), random(id ^ 3));
                        let conditions = model.sample(direction, birth);
                        let mut cloud = Cloud {
                            id,
                            source: *source,
                            layer,
                            birth_utc: birth,
                            direction,
                            base_m: conditions.layers[layer].base_m,
                            kind: CloudKind::Cumulus,
                            size_m: DVec3::ONE,
                            min_level: 2,
                            max_level: 6,
                            opacity: 0.0,
                        };
                        let (max_base, ceiling) =
                            families::configure(model, conditions, &mut cloud);
                        // Coverage controls occurrence as well as optical thickness.
                        if random(id ^ 0x18b7) < conditions.layers[layer].coverage * 0.65 {
                            cloud.base_m = cloud.base_m.max(trajectory_floor(model, cloud));
                            if cloud.base_m > max_base || cloud.base_m + cloud.size_m.y > ceiling {
                                cloud.opacity = 0.0;
                            }
                        } else {
                            cloud.opacity = 0.0;
                        }
                        if model.cache.len() < MAX_CACHED_CLOUDS {
                            model.cache.insert(id, cloud);
                        }
                        cloud
                    };
                    if cloud.opacity > 0.005
                        && cloud.direction_at(utc).dot(observer)
                            >= (OUTER_ANGLE + cloud.extent_m() / model.radius).cos()
                    {
                        if clouds.len() < MAX_CLOUDS {
                            clouds.insert(cloud.id, cloud);
                        } else {
                            limited = true;
                            if clouds
                                .last_key_value()
                                .is_some_and(|(id, _)| cloud.id < *id)
                            {
                                clouds.pop_last();
                                clouds.insert(cloud.id, cloud);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // A fixed ID order makes budget degradation reproducible and independent of view.
    let clouds = clouds.into_values().collect();
    CloudSnapshot {
        utc,
        revision,
        observer,
        conditions: model.sample(observer, utc),
        region: region::at(observer),
        regions: region::intersecting(observer, OUTER_ANGLE),
        clouds,
        limited,
    }
}

fn trajectory_floor<T: TerrainSampler>(model: &WeatherModel<T>, cloud: Cloud) -> f64 {
    // Bound the entire advected footprint, not only sampled terrain points.
    let midpoint = cloud.direction_at(cloud.birth_utc + LIFETIME * 0.5);
    let angle = cloud.extent_m() / model.radius + WIND[cloud.layer] * LIFETIME * 0.5 / EARTH_RADIUS;
    let floor = if let Some(p) = model.manifest.planet() {
        let limit = f64::from(p.mountain_limit_mm) / 1000.0;
        if p.mode == 1 {
            model
                .terrain
                .earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(midpoint, angle)
                .map(|height| {
                    (p.earth_elevation_mm(height) / 1000.0
                        + f64::from(p.detail_strength_mm) / 1000.0)
                        .max(p.sea_level_mm as f64 / 1000.0)
                        .min(limit)
                })
                .unwrap_or(limit)
        } else {
            limit
        }
    } else {
        model.terrain.relief_bound_m()
    };
    floor.max(0.0) + 500.0 * model.scale
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/weather/region.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="73" bytes="2752" original_lines="73" original_bytes="2752" minified="false" sha256="e6dd253dfc81f9af6b0da5d301a7ea28d2d6e20a20c10c4e8cb35732f5474f88">>>
//! Weather addresses deliberately use 128 cells per face, not terrain sectors.
use glam::DVec3;
use minimium_world::world::{
    CubeSampleKey, PlanetFace, PlanetSectorKey, PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE,
};
use std::collections::{BTreeSet, VecDeque};

pub(crate) const COUNT: u16 = 128;
// Maximum centre-to-corner angle of any weather region.
const BOUND: f64 = 0.012;
pub type Region = PlanetSectorKey;

pub(crate) fn at(direction: DVec3) -> Region {
    Region::from_direction_with_count(direction.as_vec3().to_array(), COUNT)
}

pub(crate) fn point(region: Region, u: f64, v: f64) -> DVec3 {
    let (x, y) = region.coordinates();
    let u = (f64::from(x) + u) * 2.0 / f64::from(COUNT) - 1.0;
    let v = (f64::from(y) + v) * 2.0 / f64::from(COUNT) - 1.0;
    match region.face() {
        PlanetFace::PositiveX => DVec3::new(1.0, u, v),
        PlanetFace::NegativeX => DVec3::new(-1.0, u, v),
        PlanetFace::PositiveY => DVec3::new(u, 1.0, v),
        PlanetFace::NegativeY => DVec3::new(u, -1.0, v),
        PlanetFace::PositiveZ => DVec3::new(u, v, 1.0),
        PlanetFace::NegativeZ => DVec3::new(u, v, -1.0),
    }
    .normalize()
}

pub(crate) fn surface_key(direction: DVec3) -> CubeSampleKey {
    let region = at(direction);
    let p = direction / direction.abs().max_element();
    let (u, v) = match region.face() {
        PlanetFace::PositiveX | PlanetFace::NegativeX => (p.y, p.z),
        PlanetFace::PositiveY | PlanetFace::NegativeY => (p.x, p.z),
        PlanetFace::PositiveZ | PlanetFace::NegativeZ => (p.x, p.y),
    };
    let coordinate =
        |x: f64| (x.clamp(-1.0, 1.0) * f64::from(PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE)).round() as i32;
    region
        .face()
        .cube_sample(coordinate(u), coordinate(v))
        .expect("normalized cube sample")
}

/// Conservative cap intersection includes neighbouring faces and pole regions.
pub(crate) fn intersecting(center: DVec3, angle: f64) -> Vec<Region> {
    let first = at(center);
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::from([first]);
    let mut pending = VecDeque::from([first]);
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    while let Some(region) = pending.pop_front() {
        if point(region, 0.5, 0.5).dot(center) < (angle + BOUND).cos() {
            continue;
        }
        result.push(region);
        for next in region.neighbors_with_count(COUNT) {
            if seen.insert(next) {
                pending.push_back(next);
            }
        }
    }
    result.sort();
    result
}

pub fn address(region: Region) -> u64 {
    let (u, v) = region.coordinates();
    (u64::from(region.face().index()) * u64::from(COUNT) + u64::from(u)) * u64::from(COUNT)
        + u64::from(v)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/environment/src/weather/shape.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="195" bytes="7769" original_lines="195" original_bytes="7769" minified="false" sha256="ecbc3c474a5873de8782211eac17d46130f9808576f3cbf8ded6dddd958a2ae5">>>
//! Continuous, bounded morphology. The same field is sampled by every voxel LOD.
use super::{climate::noise, hash, random, Cloud, CloudKind};
use glam::DVec3;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct Lobe {
    center: DVec3,
    radius: DVec3,
}

pub struct DensityField {
    cloud: Cloud,
    lobes: [Lobe; 31],
    count: usize,
    phase: DVec3,
    drift: DVec3,
}

impl DensityField {
    pub fn new(cloud: Cloud, age: f64) -> Self {
        let phase = DVec3::new(
            random(cloud.id),
            random(cloud.id ^ 61),
            random(cloud.id ^ 93),
        ) * std::f64::consts::TAU;
        let evolution = match cloud.kind {
            CloudKind::Congestus | CloudKind::Cumulonimbus => 260.0,
            CloudKind::Cumulus => 360.0,
            CloudKind::Cirrus | CloudKind::Cirrocumulus => 500.0,
            CloudKind::Stratocumulus | CloudKind::Altocumulus => 600.0,
            _ => 900.0,
        };
        let time = age / evolution;
        let mut field = Self {
            cloud,
            lobes: [Lobe::default(); 31],
            count: 0,
            phase: phase + DVec3::new(time, time * 0.73, time * 0.47),
            drift: DVec3::new(
                (random(cloud.id ^ 0x3ab1) - 0.5) * 0.22,
                (random(cloud.id ^ 0x3ab2) - 0.5) * 0.10,
                (random(cloud.id ^ 0x3ab3) - 0.5) * 0.22,
            ) * time,
        };
        if matches!(
            cloud.kind,
            CloudKind::Cumulus | CloudKind::Congestus | CloudKind::Cumulonimbus
        ) {
            field.branch(
                DVec3::new(0.0, 0.33, 0.0),
                DVec3::new(0.56, 0.29, 0.56),
                0,
                cloud.id,
            );
        }
        field
    }

    fn branch(&mut self, center: DVec3, radius: DVec3, depth: u8, seed: u64) {
        let phase = random(seed) * std::f64::consts::TAU;
        let movement = DVec3::new(
            (self.phase.x + phase).sin(),
            (self.phase.y + phase).sin() * 0.4,
            (self.phase.z - phase).cos(),
        ) * radius
            * 0.16;
        let center = center + movement;
        self.lobes[self.count] = Lobe { center, radius };
        self.count += 1;
        if depth == 4 {
            return;
        }
        for child in 0..2 {
            let seed = hash(seed ^ ((child + 1) * 0x9e3779b9));
            let angle = random(seed ^ 7) * std::f64::consts::TAU;
            let offset = DVec3::new(
                angle.cos() * 0.75,
                0.6 + random(seed ^ 11) * 0.4,
                angle.sin() * 0.75,
            );
            self.branch(
                center + offset * radius,
                radius * (0.52 + random(seed ^ 19) * 0.15),
                depth + 1,
                seed,
            );
        }
    }

    /// Local metres, y measured above the cloud base. No state or frame delta.
    pub fn sample(&self, local: DVec3) -> f64 {
        let p = local / self.cloud.size_m * DVec3::new(2.0, 1.0, 2.0);
        if p.x.abs() >= 1.0 || p.z.abs() >= 1.0 || p.y <= 0.0 || p.y >= 1.0 {
            return 0.0;
        }
        // Bounded coherent domain deformation, not a fluid integration. Features
        // share the large-scale motion; independent phases prevent synchronized breathing.
        let q = p + DVec3::new(
            (p.z * 3.0 + p.y * 2.0 + self.phase.x).sin() * 0.07,
            (p.x * 2.4 + self.phase.y).sin() * 0.035,
            (p.x * 2.8 - p.y + self.phase.z).cos() * 0.06,
        );
        let coarse = noise(q * DVec3::new(3.5, 5.0, 3.5) + self.drift, self.cloud.id);
        let fine = noise(q * 11.0 + self.drift * 1.7, self.cloud.id ^ 0xaa37);
        let envelope = (1.0 - p.x.powi(4) - p.z.powi(4))
            .min(p.y * 12.0)
            .min((1.0 - p.y) * 12.0);
        use CloudKind::*;
        let shape = match self.cloud.kind {
            Cumulus | Congestus | Cumulonimbus => self.cumulus(q),
            Stratocumulus => self.cells(q, 2.6, 0.38) + 0.17,
            Altocumulus => self.cells(q, 3.7, 0.35),
            Cirrocumulus => self.cells(q, 5.5, 0.29),
            Lenticularis => self.lens(q),
            Cirrus => self.filaments(q),
            Stratus | Altostratus | Nimbostratus | Cirrostratus => {
                let half = if self.cloud.kind == Nimbostratus {
                    0.37
                } else {
                    0.24
                };
                let height = q.y - 0.5 - (q.x * 4.0 + self.phase.x * 0.3).sin() * 0.055;
                half - height.abs() - (0.38 - coarse).max(0.0) * 0.4
            }
        };
        let erosion = (coarse - 0.5) * 0.13 + (fine - 0.5) * 0.045;
        smooth(-0.035, 0.09, (shape + erosion).min(envelope - 0.05))
    }

    fn cumulus(&self, q: DVec3) -> f64 {
        let mut field: f64 = -1.0;
        for lobe in &self.lobes[..self.count] {
            field = field.max((1.0 - ((q - lobe.center) / lobe.radius).length_squared()) * 0.2);
        }
        if self.cloud.kind == CloudKind::Cumulonimbus {
            let anvil = DVec3::new((q.x - 0.12) / 0.83, (q.y - 0.82) / 0.15, q.z / 0.7);
            field = field.max((1.0 - anvil.length_squared()) * 0.16);
        }
        field.min((q.y - 0.09) * 2.0)
    }

    fn cells(&self, q: DVec3, frequency: f64, height: f64) -> f64 {
        let frequency = frequency * (0.85 + random(self.cloud.id ^ 0xc18a) * 0.3);
        let x = q.x * frequency;
        let z = q.z * frequency;
        let ix = x.round() as i64;
        let iz = z.round() as i64;
        // Neighbour kernels overlap continuously; nearest-cell-only noise would
        // jump whenever the deformation crosses a cell address boundary.
        let mut value: f64 = -1.0;
        for j in iz - 1..=iz + 1 {
            for i in ix - 1..=ix + 1 {
                let seed = self.cloud.id
                    ^ (i as u64).wrapping_mul(73856093)
                    ^ (j as u64).wrapping_mul(19349663);
                let dx = x - i as f64 - (random(seed) - 0.5) * 0.25;
                let dz = z - j as f64 - (random(seed ^ 3) - 0.5) * 0.25;
                let dy = (q.y - 0.45 - random(seed ^ 7) * 0.1) / height;
                value = value.max(
                    (0.65 + random(seed ^ 5) * 0.2 - dx * dx * 2.0 - dz * dz * 2.0 - dy * dy)
                        * 0.18,
                );
            }
        }
        value
    }

    fn lens(&self, q: DVec3) -> f64 {
        let layers = 2.0 + (random(self.cloud.id ^ 0xc18b) * 3.0).floor();
        let layer = (q.y * layers).fract() - 0.5;
        let radius = 1.0 - (q.y - 0.45).abs() * 0.8;
        (radius - q.x * q.x - q.z * q.z - layer.powi(2) * 8.0) * 0.18
    }

    fn filaments(&self, q: DVec3) -> f64 {
        let mut field: f64 = -1.0;
        let count = 3 + (random(self.cloud.id ^ 0xc18c) * 3.0) as u64;
        for i in 0..count {
            let phase = random(self.cloud.id ^ (i + 13)) * 4.0;
            let center = (i as f64 - (count - 1) as f64 * 0.5) * (1.4 / count as f64)
                + (q.x * 2.5 + self.phase.z * 0.35 + phase).sin() * 0.15;
            let y = 0.45 + (q.x * 3.0 + phase + self.phase.y * 0.2).sin() * 0.13;
            let taper = (1.0 - q.x.abs()).max(0.0);
            let width = 0.065 + taper * 0.09;
            let distance = ((q.z - center) / width).powi(2) + ((q.y - y) / 0.19).powi(2);
            field = field.max((1.0 - distance) * 0.15);
        }
        field
    }
}

fn smooth(low: f64, high: f64, value: f64) -> f64 {
    let t = ((value - low) / (high - low)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/platform/src/admin_client.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="331" bytes="13139" original_lines="331" original_bytes="13139" minified="false" sha256="7ee76574b40d55f47a22904f69bc478fca6e7276d0befe59aa1662a374e60c22">>>
use crate::{endpoint::ServerEndpoint, server_lock::ServerDataLock};
use std::{
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    net::{TcpStream, ToSocketAddrs},
    path::Path,
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
pub const SHUTDOWN_FILE: &str = "server.shutdown";
pub const SHUTDOWN_OWNER_FILE: &str = "server.shutdown.owner";
const RESPONSE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
const STOP_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);
const MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;

/// Sends one authenticated administrative command and returns the complete response.
pub fn request(endpoint: &ServerEndpoint, command: &str) -> io::Result<String> {
    request_until(
        endpoint,
        command,
        Instant::now() + CONNECT_TIMEOUT + RESPONSE_TIMEOUT,
    )
}

/// Sends an authenticated command without exceeding the caller's overall deadline.
pub fn request_until(
    endpoint: &ServerEndpoint,
    command: &str,
    deadline: Instant,
) -> io::Result<String> {
    if command.len() > 512
        || endpoint.token.len() != 64
        || !endpoint.token.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "invalid admin request",
        ));
    }
    if command.chars().any(char::is_control) {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "invalid admin request",
        ));
    }
    let connect_remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
    if connect_remaining.is_zero() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
            "admin request deadline expired",
        ));
    }
    let address = ("127.0.0.1", endpoint.admin_port)
        .to_socket_addrs()?
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::AddrNotAvailable,
                "admin endpoint unavailable",
            )
        })?;
    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&address, CONNECT_TIMEOUT.min(connect_remaining))?;
    let response_deadline =
        Instant::now() + RESPONSE_TIMEOUT.min(deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now()));
    let request = format!("AUTH {}\n{}\n", endpoint.token, command);
    write_before_deadline(&mut stream, request.as_bytes(), response_deadline)?;

    let mut response = Vec::with_capacity(1024);
    let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
    loop {
        let remaining = response_deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        if remaining.is_zero() {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "admin response timed out",
            ));
        }
        stream.set_read_timeout(Some(remaining))?;
        match stream.read(&mut chunk) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(count) => {
                if response.len() + count > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                        "admin response exceeds 64 KiB",
                    ));
                }
                response.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..count]);
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
    let response = String::from_utf8(response)
        .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "admin response is not UTF-8"))?;
    let response = response.trim();
    if let Some(payload) = response.strip_prefix("OK ") {
        return Ok(payload.to_owned());
    }
    if response == "OK" {
        return Ok(String::new());
    }
    if let Some(message) = response.strip_prefix("ERR ") {
        return Err(io::Error::other(message.to_owned()));
    }
    Err(io::Error::new(
        io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
        "server returned an invalid response",
    ))
}

/// Confirms a successful shutdown record for this endpoint while holding the released data lock.
pub fn shutdown_completed(data_dir: &Path, endpoint: &ServerEndpoint) -> io::Result<bool> {
    if !data_dir.is_dir() {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let status_path = data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_FILE);
    let Some(status) = read_shutdown_status(&status_path)? else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    if !successful_shutdown_status(&status, endpoint.admin_port) {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let lock = match ServerDataLock::acquire(data_dir) {
        Ok(lock) => lock,
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => return Ok(false),
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    };
    let owner = read_shutdown_status(&data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_OWNER_FILE))?;
    if owner.as_deref().map(str::trim_end) != Some(endpoint.token.as_str()) {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
            "shutdown result belongs to another instance",
        ));
    }
    let confirmed_status = read_shutdown_status(&status_path)?;
    if confirmed_status.as_deref() != Some(status.as_str()) {
        drop(lock);
        return Ok(false);
    }
    match ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
        Ok(_) => {
            drop(lock);
            return Ok(false);
        }
        Err(error) => {
            drop(lock);
            return Err(error);
        }
    }
    drop(lock);
    Ok(true)
}

fn write_before_deadline(
    stream: &mut TcpStream,
    mut bytes: &[u8],
    deadline: Instant,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    while !bytes.is_empty() {
        let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        if remaining.is_zero() {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "admin request timed out",
            ));
        }
        stream.set_write_timeout(Some(remaining))?;
        match stream.write(bytes) {
            Ok(0) => {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::WriteZero,
                    "admin request write failed",
                ))
            }
            Ok(count) => bytes = &bytes[count..],
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
    stream.flush()
}

/// Waits for the captured server instance to report successful shutdown and release its data lock.
pub fn stop_and_wait(data_dir: &Path, endpoint: &ServerEndpoint) -> io::Result<()> {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + STOP_TIMEOUT;
    let status_path = data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_FILE);
    if !data_dir.is_dir() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::NotFound,
            "server data directory disappeared during shutdown",
        ));
    }
    ensure_endpoint_matches(data_dir, endpoint)?;
    if request(endpoint, "stop")? != "stopping" {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "server returned an unexpected stop response",
        ));
    }
    loop {
        ensure_endpoint_matches_or_absent(data_dir, endpoint)?;
        let status = read_shutdown_status(&status_path)?;
        if let Some(status) = status {
            let mut fields = status.trim_end().split('\t');
            let expected_port = endpoint.admin_port.to_string();
            if fields.next() == Some(expected_port.as_str()) {
                match fields.next() {
                    Some("OK") if fields.next().is_none() => {
                        match ServerDataLock::acquire(data_dir) {
                            Ok(lock) => {
                                let owner =
                                    read_shutdown_status(&data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_OWNER_FILE))?;
                                if owner.as_deref().map(str::trim_end)
                                    != Some(endpoint.token.as_str())
                                {
                                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                                        io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
                                        "shutdown result belongs to another instance",
                                    ));
                                }
                                let confirmed_status = read_shutdown_status(&status_path)?;
                                if confirmed_status.as_deref() != Some(status.as_str()) {
                                    drop(lock);
                                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                                        io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
                                        "shutdown status changed during verification",
                                    ));
                                }
                                match ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
                                    Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
                                    Ok(_) => {
                                        drop(lock);
                                        return Err(io::Error::new(
                                            io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
                                            "server endpoint still exists after shutdown",
                                        ));
                                    }
                                    Err(error) => {
                                        drop(lock);
                                        return Err(error);
                                    }
                                }
                                drop(lock);
                                return Ok(());
                            }
                            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
                            Err(error) => return Err(error),
                        }
                    }
                    Some("ERR") => {
                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                            "server shutdown failed: {}",
                            fields.next().unwrap_or("unknown error")
                        )))
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(io::Error::new(
                            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                            "server wrote an invalid shutdown status",
                        ))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "server did not finish shutting down within 120 seconds",
            ));
        }
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
    }
}

fn ensure_endpoint_matches(data_dir: &Path, expected: &ServerEndpoint) -> io::Result<()> {
    match ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
        Ok(current) if same_endpoint(&current, expected) => Ok(()),
        Ok(_) => Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
            "server endpoint changed before shutdown",
        )),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

fn ensure_endpoint_matches_or_absent(data_dir: &Path, expected: &ServerEndpoint) -> io::Result<()> {
    match ServerEndpoint::read(data_dir) {
        Ok(current) if same_endpoint(&current, expected) => Ok(()),
        Ok(_) => Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::Interrupted,
            "server instance was replaced during shutdown",
        )),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

fn same_endpoint(left: &ServerEndpoint, right: &ServerEndpoint) -> bool {
    left.game_port == right.game_port
        && left.admin_port == right.admin_port
        && left.token == right.token
}

fn successful_shutdown_status(status: &str, admin_port: u16) -> bool {
    let mut fields = status.trim_end().split('\t');
    fields.next() == Some(admin_port.to_string().as_str())
        && fields.next() == Some("OK")
        && fields.next().is_none()
}

fn read_shutdown_status(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Option<String>> {
    let file = match std::fs::File::open(path) {
        Ok(file) => file,
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    };
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(256);
    file.take(4097).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
    if bytes.len() > 4096 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "shutdown status exceeds 4096 bytes",
        ));
    }
    String::from_utf8(bytes)
        .map(Some)
        .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "shutdown status is not UTF-8"))
}

use std::{
    fmt,
    fs::{self, File, OpenOptions},
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},
};

const MAX_ENDPOINT_BYTES: usize = 256;
static NEXT_TEMP_FILE_ID: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct ServerEndpoint {
    pub game_port: u16,
    pub admin_port: u16,
    pub token: String,
}

impl fmt::Debug for ServerEndpoint {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter
            .debug_struct("ServerEndpoint")
            .field("game_port", &self.game_port)
            .field("admin_port", &self.admin_port)
            .field("token", &"[REDACTED]")
            .finish()
    }
}

impl ServerEndpoint {
    pub fn file_path(data_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
        data_dir.join("server.endpoint")
    }

    pub fn write(data_dir: &Path, endpoint: &Self) -> io::Result<()> {
        if !valid_token(&endpoint.token) {
            return Err(invalid_endpoint());
        }
        fs::create_dir_all(data_dir)?;
        let destination = Self::file_path(data_dir);
        let (temporary_path, mut file) = create_temporary_endpoint_file(data_dir)?;
        let mut temporary_file = TemporaryEndpointFile::new(temporary_path);

        writeln!(file, "{}", endpoint.game_port)?;
        writeln!(file, "{}", endpoint.admin_port)?;
        writeln!(file, "{}", endpoint.token)?;
        file.sync_all()?;
        drop(file);

        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
            fs::set_permissions(&temporary_file.path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))?;
        }

        crate::files::atomic_replace_file(&temporary_file.path, &destination)?;
        temporary_file.disarm();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn read(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(MAX_ENDPOINT_BYTES + 1);
        File::open(Self::file_path(data_dir))?
            .take((MAX_ENDPOINT_BYTES + 1) as u64)
            .read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
        if bytes.len() > MAX_ENDPOINT_BYTES {
            return Err(invalid_endpoint());
        }
        let content = String::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| invalid_endpoint())?;
        let mut lines = content.lines();
        let game_port = lines
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(invalid_endpoint)?
            .parse()
            .map_err(|_| invalid_endpoint())?;
        let admin_port = lines
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(invalid_endpoint)?
            .parse()
            .map_err(|_| invalid_endpoint())?;
        let token = lines.next().ok_or_else(invalid_endpoint)?.to_string();
        if lines.next().is_some() || !valid_token(&token) {
            return Err(invalid_endpoint());
        }
        Ok(Self {
            game_port,
            admin_port,
            token,
        })
    }

    pub fn remove_if_owned(&self, data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
        let path = Self::file_path(data_dir);
        let current = match Self::read(data_dir) {
            Ok(current) => current,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::InvalidData => return Ok(()),
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        };
        if current.game_port == self.game_port
            && current.admin_port == self.admin_port
            && current.token == self.token
        {
            match fs::remove_file(path) {
                Ok(()) => Ok(()),
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),
                Err(error) => Err(error),
            }
        } else {
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

struct TemporaryEndpointFile {
    path: PathBuf,
    armed: bool,
}

impl TemporaryEndpointFile {
    fn new(path: PathBuf) -> Self {
        Self { path, armed: true }
    }

    fn disarm(&mut self) {
        self.armed = false;
    }
}

impl Drop for TemporaryEndpointFile {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.armed {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
        }
    }
}

fn create_temporary_endpoint_file(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<(PathBuf, File)> {
    loop {
        let id = NEXT_TEMP_FILE_ID.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let path = data_dir.join(format!(
            ".server.endpoint.{}.{}.tmp",
            std::process::id(),
            id
        ));
        let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
        options.write(true).create_new(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            options.mode(0o600);
        }
        match options.open(&path) {
            Ok(file) => return Ok((path, file)),
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
}

fn invalid_endpoint() -> io::Error {
    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid server endpoint file")
}

fn valid_token(token: &str) -> bool {
    token.len() == 64 && token.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
}

pub fn new_admin_token() -> io::Result<String> {
    let bytes = new_random_bytes::<32>()?;
    Ok(bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect())
}

pub fn new_random_bytes<const N: usize>() -> io::Result<[u8; N]> {
    let mut bytes = [0u8; N];
    #[cfg(unix)]
    File::open("/dev/urandom")?.read_exact(&mut bytes)?;
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        #[link(name = "bcrypt")]
        unsafe extern "system" {
            fn BCryptGenRandom(
                algorithm: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
                buffer: *mut u8,
                length: u32,
                flags: u32,
            ) -> i32;
        }
        const BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG: u32 = 0x00000002;
        let result = unsafe {
            BCryptGenRandom(
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
                bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
                bytes.len() as u32,
                BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG,
            )
        };
        if result < 0 {
            return Err(io::Error::other("operating system random generator failed"));
        }
    }
    #[cfg(not(any(unix, windows)))]
    return Err(io::Error::new(
        io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
        "secure random source unavailable on this platform",
    ));
    Ok(bytes)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/platform/src/files.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="94" bytes="2746" original_lines="94" original_bytes="2746" minified="false" sha256="f97e8dd1105b213fa58504320827ab9cb52d4c5073155adeb004793b21203740">>>
#[cfg(not(windows))]
use std::fs;
use std::{
    fs::File,
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    path::Path,
};

/// Default server data directory used by the server and its control client.
pub const DEFAULT_SERVER_DATA_DIR: &str = ".minimium";

/// Reads a persistent file and rejects its contents when they exceed the limit.
pub fn read_bounded_file(path: &Path, maximum_bytes: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let limit = u64::try_from(maximum_bytes)
        .unwrap_or(u64::MAX)
        .saturating_add(1);
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(maximum_bytes.min(4096));
    File::open(path)?.take(limit).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
    if bytes.len() > maximum_bytes {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "file exceeds size limit",
        ));
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

/// Writes a payload and atomically replaces its destination on success.
pub fn atomic_write_file(
    temporary_path: &Path,
    destination: &Path,
    bytes: &[u8],
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let result = (|| {
        let mut file = File::create(temporary_path)?;
        file.write_all(bytes)?;
        file.sync_all()?;
        atomic_replace_file(temporary_path, destination)?;
        #[cfg(unix)]
        File::open(
            destination
                .parent()
                .filter(|parent| !parent.as_os_str().is_empty())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(".")),
        )?
        .sync_all()?;
        Ok(())
    })();
    if result.is_err() {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(temporary_path);
    }
    result
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub fn atomic_replace_file(
    source: &std::path::Path,
    destination: &std::path::Path,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt;

    #[link(name = "kernel32")]
    unsafe extern "system" {
        fn MoveFileExW(source: *const u16, destination: *const u16, flags: u32) -> i32;
    }

    const MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING: u32 = 0x1;
    const MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH: u32 = 0x8;
    let source: Vec<u16> = source.as_os_str().encode_wide().chain([0]).collect();
    let destination: Vec<u16> = destination.as_os_str().encode_wide().chain([0]).collect();
    let result = unsafe {
        MoveFileExW(
            source.as_ptr(),
            destination.as_ptr(),
            MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH,
        )
    };
    if result == 0 {
        Err(io::Error::last_os_error())
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(not(windows))]
pub fn atomic_replace_file(
    source: &std::path::Path,
    destination: &std::path::Path,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    fs::rename(source, destination)
}

#[test]
fn bounded_reads_accept_the_limit_and_reject_one_byte_over() {
    let directory = temporary_directory();
    let path = directory.join("snapshot");
    fs::write(&path, b"1234").unwrap();

        std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData

}

fn atomic_write_replaces_successfully_and_preserves_old_data_on_failure() {

use crate::endpoint::new_random_bytes;
use minimium_core::identity::PlayerProfileId;
use std::{
    fs::{self, File, OpenOptions},
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},

static NEXT_TEMP_FILE_ID: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

pub fn load_or_create(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<PlayerProfileId> {
    fs::create_dir_all(data_dir)?;
    let path = file_path(data_dir);
    match read(&path) {
        Ok(identity) => return Ok(identity),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    }

    // Serialize first-time creation while leaving the profile path absent
    // until a complete file is ready to publish.
    let lock = OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .write(true)
        .create(true)
        .truncate(false)
        .open(data_dir.join("player.profile.lock"))?;
    lock.lock()?;
    match read(&path) {
        Ok(identity) => return Ok(identity),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    }

    let identity = PlayerProfileId::from_bytes(new_random_bytes()?);
    let (temporary_path, mut file) = create_temporary_profile_file(data_dir)?;
    let mut temporary_file = TemporaryProfileFile::new(temporary_path);
    writeln!(file, "MINIMIUM_PLAYER 1")?;
    writeln!(file, "{}", identity.to_hex())?;
    file.sync_all()?;
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        fs::set_permissions(&temporary_file.path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))?;
    }
    drop(file);

    crate::files::atomic_replace_file(&temporary_file.path, &path)?;
    temporary_file.disarm();
    Ok(identity)
}

fn file_path(data_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    data_dir.join("player.profile")
}

fn read(path: &Path) -> io::Result<PlayerProfileId> {
    let mut content = String::new();
    File::open(path)?.take(129).read_to_string(&mut content)?;
    if content.len() > 128 {
        return Err(invalid_profile_id());
    }
    let mut lines = content.lines();
    if lines.next() != Some("MINIMIUM_PLAYER 1") {
        return Err(invalid_profile_id());
    }
    let identity = PlayerProfileId::from_hex(lines.next().ok_or_else(invalid_profile_id)?)?;
    if lines.next().is_some() {
        return Err(invalid_profile_id());
    }
    Ok(identity)
}
struct TemporaryProfileFile {
    path: PathBuf,
    armed: bool,
}

impl TemporaryProfileFile {
    fn new(path: PathBuf) -> Self {
        Self { path, armed: true }
    }

    fn disarm(&mut self) {
        self.armed = false;
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
    }
}

impl Drop for TemporaryProfileFile {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.armed {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
        }
    }
}

fn create_temporary_profile_file(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<(PathBuf, File)> {
    loop {
        let id = NEXT_TEMP_FILE_ID.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let path = data_dir.join(format!(".player.profile.{}.{}.tmp", std::process::id(), id));
        let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
        options.write(true).create_new(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            options.mode(0o600);
        }
        match options.open(&path) {
            Ok(file) => return Ok((path, file)),
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
}

fn invalid_profile_id() -> io::Error {
    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid player profile file")
}

<<<FILE path="crates/platform/src/server_lock.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="55" bytes="1751" original_lines="55" original_bytes="1751" minified="false" sha256="de5d36c2ee47db9da5d181192755945733f2527d332e0be238dcaa3f761ecb23">>>
use std::{
    fs::{self, File, OpenOptions},
    io,
    path::Path,
};

const LOCK_FILE: &str = "server.lock";

/// Holds the exclusive lock for a server data directory for its lifetime.
///
/// The lock file is deliberately left in place when the handle is dropped;
/// operating-system file locking releases ownership automatically.
pub struct ServerDataLock {
    _file: File,
}

impl ServerDataLock {
    pub fn acquire(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
        fs::create_dir_all(data_dir)?;
        let file = open_lock_file(data_dir)?;
        match file.try_lock() {
            Ok(()) => Ok(Self { _file: file }),
            Err(std::fs::TryLockError::WouldBlock) => Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
                "server data directory is already locked",
            )),
            Err(std::fs::TryLockError::Error(error)) => Err(error),
        }
    }
}

/// Reports whether a server currently holds the data directory's exclusive lock.
///
/// This is an instantaneous observation; a server may acquire or release the
/// lock immediately after this function returns.
pub fn is_locked(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {
    let file = OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .write(true)
        .open(data_dir.join(LOCK_FILE))?;
    match file.try_lock() {
        Ok(()) => Ok(false),
        Err(std::fs::TryLockError::WouldBlock) => Ok(true),
        Err(std::fs::TryLockError::Error(error)) => Err(error),
    }
}

fn open_lock_file(data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<File> {
    OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .write(true)
        .create(true)
        .truncate(false)
        .open(data_dir.join(LOCK_FILE))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/dungeon.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="322" bytes="10220" original_lines="322" original_bytes="10220" minified="false" sha256="91f58f4d62cd40edfdf876678961b2fb128e2cdb5d02c69f1614da4afabbcfd3">>>
use crate::{sector_neighborhood::DUNGEON_SECTOR_EDGE, AddressedRandom, GenerationChannel};
use minimium_world::world::{
    DungeonBlueprint, DungeonRoom, DungeonSectorKey, DungeonTile, GenerationSpec, SectorKey,
};

const MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION: u16 = 128;
const MAX_MINIMUM_ROOM_EDGE: u16 = 40;
const MAX_DUNGEON_ROOMS: u8 = 32;
const MAX_BSP_DEPTH: u8 = 8;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DungeonSpec {
    width: u16,
    height: u16,
    minimum_room_edge: u16,
    maximum_rooms: u8,
    corridor_width: u8,
}

impl DungeonSpec {
    pub fn new(
        width: u16,
        height: u16,
        minimum_room_edge: u16,
        maximum_rooms: u8,
        corridor_width: u8,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        if !(3..=MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION).contains(&width)
            || !(3..=MAX_DUNGEON_DIMENSION).contains(&height)
            || !(3..=MAX_MINIMUM_ROOM_EDGE).contains(&minimum_room_edge)
            || width < minimum_room_edge + 4
            || height < minimum_room_edge + 4
            || (width - 2 < (minimum_room_edge + 2) * 3 && height - 2 < (minimum_room_edge + 2) * 3)
            || !(3..=MAX_DUNGEON_ROOMS).contains(&maximum_rooms)
            || !(corridor_width == 1 || corridor_width == 3)
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self {
            width,
            height,
            minimum_room_edge,
            maximum_rooms,
            corridor_width,
        })
    }
}

struct DungeonBuilder {
    width: u16,
    height: u16,
    tiles: Vec<DungeonTile>,
    rooms: Vec<DungeonRoom>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct DungeonSector {
    pub key: DungeonSectorKey,
    pub edge: u16,
    tiles: Vec<DungeonTile>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Rect {
    x: u16,
    y: u16,
    width: u16,
    height: u16,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Point {
    x: u16,
    y: u16,
}

/// Builds a bounded BSP floor plan and carves one corridor across every split.
pub fn generate_dungeon(generation: GenerationSpec, spec: DungeonSpec) -> DungeonBlueprint {
    let mut builder = DungeonBuilder {
        width: spec.width,
        height: spec.height,
        tiles: vec![DungeonTile::Void; usize::from(spec.width) * usize::from(spec.height)],
        rooms: Vec::with_capacity(usize::from(spec.maximum_rooms)),
    };
    let root = Rect {
        x: 1,
        y: 1,
        width: spec.width - 2,
        height: spec.height - 2,
    };
    carve_partition(
        generation,
        spec,
        root,
        0,
        0,
        spec.maximum_rooms,
        &mut builder,
    );
    DungeonBlueprint::from_parts(builder.width, builder.height, builder.tiles, builder.rooms)
        .expect("procedural dungeon builder produces a valid connected layout")
}

pub fn materialize_dungeon_sector(
    blueprint: &DungeonBlueprint,
    key: DungeonSectorKey,
) -> Option<DungeonSector> {
    let edge = DUNGEON_SECTOR_EDGE;
    let mut tiles = vec![DungeonTile::Void; usize::from(edge) * usize::from(edge)];
    let (sector_x, sector_y, sector_z) = key.coordinates();
    if sector_y == 0 {
        for local_z in 0..edge {
            for local_x in 0..edge {
                let global_x = i64::from(sector_x) * i64::from(edge) + i64::from(local_x);
                let global_z = i64::from(sector_z) * i64::from(edge) + i64::from(local_z);
                if global_x >= 0
                    && global_z >= 0
                    && global_x < i64::from(blueprint.dimensions().0)
                    && global_z < i64::from(blueprint.dimensions().1)
                {
                    if let Some(tile) = blueprint.tile(global_x as u16, global_z as u16) {
                        let index = usize::from(local_z) * usize::from(edge) + usize::from(local_x);
                        tiles[index] = tile;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Some(DungeonSector { key, edge, tiles })
}

impl DungeonSector {
    pub fn tile(&self, x: u16, z: u16) -> Option<DungeonTile> {
        if x >= self.edge || z >= self.edge {
            return None;
        }
        Some(self.tiles[usize::from(z) * usize::from(self.edge) + usize::from(x)])
    }
}

fn carve_partition(
    generation: GenerationSpec,
    spec: DungeonSpec,
    bounds: Rect,
    depth: u8,
    path: u64,
    budget: u8,
    blueprint: &mut DungeonBuilder,
) -> Point {
    let key = node_key(depth, path);
    let random = AddressedRandom::new(generation, GenerationChannel::DungeonLayout, key);
    let minimum_partition = spec.minimum_room_edge + 2;
    let can_split_x = bounds.width >= minimum_partition * 2;
    let can_split_y = bounds.height >= minimum_partition * 2;
    let can_three_x = bounds.width >= minimum_partition * 3;
    let can_three_y = bounds.height >= minimum_partition * 3;
    if budget <= 1 || depth >= MAX_BSP_DEPTH || (!can_split_x && !can_split_y) {
        return carve_room(random, bounds, spec.minimum_room_edge, blueprint);
    }

    let split_vertical = match (budget >= 3 && can_three_x, budget >= 3 && can_three_y) {
        (true, false) => true,
        (false, true) => false,
        (true, true) if bounds.width > bounds.height * 5 / 4 => true,
        (true, true) if bounds.height > bounds.width * 5 / 4 => false,
        (true, true) => random.sample_u32(0) & 1 == 0,
        _ => match (can_split_x, can_split_y) {
            (true, false) => true,
            (false, true) => false,
            (true, true) if bounds.width > bounds.height * 5 / 4 => true,
            (true, true) if bounds.height > bounds.width * 5 / 4 => false,
            (true, true) => random.sample_u32(0) & 1 == 0,
            _ => return carve_room(random, bounds, spec.minimum_room_edge, blueprint),
        },
    };

    let extent = if split_vertical {
        bounds.width
    } else {
        bounds.height
    };
    let preserve_split = budget >= 3
        && if split_vertical {
            can_three_x
        } else {
            can_three_y
        };
    let maximum_first = if preserve_split {
        extent - minimum_partition * 2
    } else {
        extent - minimum_partition
    };
    let first_min = minimum_partition;
    let split_count = maximum_first - minimum_partition + 1;
    let split = first_min + (random.sample_u32(1) % u32::from(split_count)) as u16;
    let (first, second) = if split_vertical {
        (
            Rect {
                width: split,
                ..bounds
            },
            Rect {
                x: bounds.x + split,
                width: bounds.width - split,
                ..bounds
            },
        )
    } else {
        (
            Rect {
                height: split,
                ..bounds
            },
            Rect {
                y: bounds.y + split,
                height: bounds.height - split,
                ..bounds
            },
        )
    };
    let first_budget = budget / 2;
    let first_point = carve_partition(
        generation,
        spec,
        first,
        depth + 1,
        path << 1,
        first_budget,
        blueprint,
    );
    let second_point = carve_partition(
        generation,
        spec,
        second,
        depth + 1,
        path << 1 | 1,
        budget - first_budget,
        blueprint,
    );
    carve_corridor(blueprint, first_point, second_point, spec.corridor_width);
    first_point
}

fn carve_room(
    random: AddressedRandom,
    bounds: Rect,
    minimum_edge: u16,
    blueprint: &mut DungeonBuilder,
) -> Point {
    let available_width = bounds.width - 2;
    let available_height = bounds.height - 2;
    let width = minimum_edge
        + (random.sample_u32(0) % u32::from(available_width - minimum_edge + 1)) as u16;
    let height = minimum_edge
        + (random.sample_u32(1) % u32::from(available_height - minimum_edge + 1)) as u16;
    let x_range = bounds.width - width - 1;
    let y_range = bounds.height - height - 1;
    let x = bounds.x + 1 + (random.sample_u32(2) % u32::from(x_range)) as u16;
    let y = bounds.y + 1 + (random.sample_u32(3) % u32::from(y_range)) as u16;
    let center = Point {
        x: x + width / 2,
        y: y + height / 2,
    };
    let origin_id = random.object_origin(0);
    let room = DungeonRoom {
        origin_id,
        x,
        y,
        width,
        height,
        center: [center.x, center.y],
    };
    for row in y..y + height {
        for col in x..x + width {
            set_tile(blueprint, col, row, DungeonTile::Room);
        }
    }
    blueprint.rooms.push(room);
    center
}

fn carve_corridor(blueprint: &mut DungeonBuilder, from: Point, to: Point, width: u8) {
    let radius = i32::from(width) / 2;
    let horizontal_start = from.x.min(to.x);
    let horizontal_end = from.x.max(to.x);
    for x in horizontal_start..=horizontal_end {
        for offset in -radius..=radius {
            let y = i32::from(from.y) + offset;
            if y >= 0 {
                set_tile(blueprint, x, y as u16, DungeonTile::Corridor);
            }
        }
    }
    let vertical_start = from.y.min(to.y);
    let vertical_end = from.y.max(to.y);
    for y in vertical_start..=vertical_end {
        for offset in -radius..=radius {
            let x = i32::from(to.x) + offset;
            if x >= 0 {
                set_tile(blueprint, x as u16, y, DungeonTile::Corridor);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn set_tile(blueprint: &mut DungeonBuilder, x: u16, y: u16, tile: DungeonTile) {
    if x >= blueprint.width || y >= blueprint.height {
        return;
    }
    let index = usize::from(y) * usize::from(blueprint.width) + usize::from(x);
    if blueprint.tiles[index] == DungeonTile::Void || tile == DungeonTile::Room {
        blueprint.tiles[index] = tile;
    }
}

fn node_key(depth: u8, path: u64) -> SectorKey {
    SectorKey::dungeon(
        path as u32 as i32,
        (path >> 32) as u32 as i32,
        i32::from(depth),
    )
}

use minimium_environment::sky::{
    normalized_observer_direction, EarthHeightReference, ObserverError,
};
use minimium_world::world::{PlanetDefinition, Position3Mm};

use crate::{EarthSampleError, PreparedGeography};

pub fn earth_height_reference(
    position_mm: Position3Mm,
    definition: PlanetDefinition,
    geography: Option<&dyn PreparedGeography>,
) -> Result<EarthHeightReference, ObserverError> {
    if !definition.is_valid() || definition.mode != 1 {
        return Err(ObserverError::InvalidPlanet);
    }
    let direction = normalized_observer_direction(position_mm)?;
    let geography = geography.ok_or(ObserverError::MissingEarthPackage)?;
    if geography.package_digest() != definition.package_digest {
        return Err(ObserverError::PackageMismatch);
    }
    let elevation_m = geography.elevation_m(direction).map_err(map_sample_error)?;
    EarthHeightReference::from_gebco(elevation_m, definition)
}

fn map_sample_error(error: EarthSampleError) -> ObserverError {
    match error {
        EarthSampleError::PackageUnavailable => ObserverError::MissingEarthPackage,
        EarthSampleError::PackageMismatch => ObserverError::PackageMismatch,
        EarthSampleError::InvalidDirection => ObserverError::NonFinite,
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/generator_contract.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="58" bytes="2307" original_lines="58" original_bytes="2307" minified="false" sha256="98020ca15270ec9b3f7b55a987caadfca3990af8a7812f625ce1440f5ed00a6b">>>
use minimium_world::world::{GenerationSpec, GeneratorDigest, WorldManifest, WorldTopology};

/// Checks the generator contract before a supplied manifest enters a runtime.
pub fn validate_world_manifest(manifest: WorldManifest) -> Result<(), String> {
    if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|p| {
        !p.is_valid() || (p.peak_relief.enabled() && manifest.generation().revision().get() != 5)
    }) {
        return Err("peak relief requires a valid Earth generator v5 definition".into());
    }
    if manifest.generator_digest() == generator_digest(manifest.topology(), manifest.generation()) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("digest does not match the world generator contract".into())
    }
}

/// Digest of the code contract for one topology and generator revision.
pub fn generator_digest(topology: WorldTopology, generation: GenerationSpec) -> GeneratorDigest {
    let revision = generation.revision().get();
    let label = if revision == 1 {
        b"minimium-procgen/philox4x32-10/v1".as_slice()
    } else if revision >= 5 {
        b"minimium-procgen/philox4x32-10/planet-sectors/v5".as_slice()
    } else if revision >= 4 {
        b"minimium-procgen/philox4x32-10/planet-sectors/v4".as_slice()
    } else if revision >= 3 {
        b"minimium-procgen/philox4x32-10/planet-sectors/v3".as_slice()
    } else {
        b"minimium-procgen/philox4x32-10/planet-sectors/v2".as_slice()
    };
    digest_with_label(label, topology, generation)
}

fn digest_with_label(
    label: &[u8],
    topology: WorldTopology,
    generation: GenerationSpec,
) -> GeneratorDigest {
    let mut hash = 0xcbf29ce484222325_u64;
    let mut feed = |bytes: &[u8]| {
        for byte in bytes {
            hash = (hash ^ u64::from(*byte)).wrapping_mul(0x100000001b3);
        }
    };
    feed(label);
    feed(&[match topology {
        WorldTopology::Planet => 0,
        WorldTopology::Dungeon => 1,
    }]);
    feed(&generation.revision().get().to_le_bytes());
    feed(&generation.position_quantum_mm().to_le_bytes());
    let mut bytes = [0_u8; 32];
    for (index, chunk) in bytes.as_chunks_mut::<8>().0.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let value = hash.rotate_left((index * 11) as u32) ^ index as u64;
        chunk.copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }
    GeneratorDigest::new(bytes)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum EarthSampleError {
    PackageUnavailable,
    PackageMismatch,
    InvalidDirection,

impl fmt::Display for EarthSampleError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {

            Self::PackageUnavailable => "GEBCO package is not prepared",
            Self::PackageMismatch => "prepared GEBCO package does not match the planet",
            Self::InvalidDirection => "Earth sample direction is zero or non-finite",

    }
