<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/materialize.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="263" bytes="10113" original_lines="263" original_bytes="10113" minified="false" sha256="cd023af7fd049af2ef9384f3b8160528b0b902d9c544962a611cf1d461fbeed3">>>
use crate::terrain_color::{mostly_ocean, terrain_color};
use crate::{DungeonBlueprint, DungeonTile, PlanetLandmarks, PlanetTerrain};
use minimium_world::world::{
    MapBox, MapTriangle, PlanetFace, WorldMap, PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE,
};

const TERRAIN_COLOR: [f32; 3] = [0.18, 0.42, 0.19];
const ROOM_COLOR: [f32; 3] = [0.34, 0.32, 0.28];
const WALL_COLOR: [f32; 3] = [0.28, 0.30, 0.33];
const PLANET_SPAWN_CLEARANCE_MM: i64 = 2_000;

/// Bounded visual overview of all six faces.
pub fn materialize_planet_overview(terrain: PlanetTerrain) -> Vec<MapTriangle> {
    let steps: usize = if terrain.is_earth() { 96 } else { 24 };
    let scale = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
    let mut triangles = Vec::with_capacity(6 * steps * steps * 2);
    for face in PlanetFace::ALL {
        let mut points = Vec::with_capacity((steps + 1) * (steps + 1));
        let mut ocean = Vec::with_capacity((steps + 1) * (steps + 1));
        let mut heights = Vec::with_capacity((steps + 1) * (steps + 1));
        for v in 0..=steps {
            for u in 0..=steps {
                let sample = face
                    .cube_sample(
                        -scale + 2 * scale * u as i32 / steps as i32,
                        -scale + 2 * scale * v as i32 / steps as i32,
                    )
                    .expect("overview samples lie on a cube face");
                let point = terrain.sample(sample);
                points.push(millimeters_to_world(point.position_mm.coordinates()));
                ocean.push(point.ocean);
                heights.push(
                    point.height_mm as i64 - terrain.radius_mm() as i64 - terrain.sea_level_mm(),
                );
            }
        }
        for v in 0..steps {
            for u in 0..steps {
                let a = v * (steps + 1) + u;
                let b = (v + 1) * (steps + 1) + u;
                let c = a + 1;
                let d = b + 1;
                for indices in [[a, b, c], [c, b, d]] {
                    let mut vertices = indices.map(|index| points[index]);
                    let water = mostly_ocean(indices.map(|index| ocean[index]));
                    let average_height =
                        indices.map(|index| heights[index]).into_iter().sum::<i64>() / 3;
                    let color = terrain_color(average_height, water);
                    let a = vertices[0];
                    let b = vertices[1];
                    let c = vertices[2];
                    let ab = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]];
                    let ac = [c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2]];
                    let normal = [
                        ab[1] * ac[2] - ab[2] * ac[1],
                        ab[2] * ac[0] - ab[0] * ac[2],
                        ab[0] * ac[1] - ab[1] * ac[0],
                    ];
                    if normal[0] * a[0] + normal[1] * a[1] + normal[2] * a[2] < 0.0 {
                        vertices.swap(1, 2);
                    }
                    triangles.push(MapTriangle {
                        vertices,
                        precise_vertices: None,
                        color,
                        solid: false,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    triangles
}

/// Produces the landing marker. Terrain is generated per sector on demand.
pub fn materialize_planet_map(
    terrain: PlanetTerrain,
    landmarks: PlanetLandmarks,
) -> Result<WorldMap, String> {
    let _ = terrain;
    let spawn_mm = radial_clearance(
        landmarks.spawn.position_mm.coordinates(),
        PLANET_SPAWN_CLEARANCE_MM,
    );
    let spawn = millimeters_to_world(spawn_mm);
    let entrance = millimeters_to_world(landmarks.entrance.position_mm.coordinates());
    let marker = MapBox {
        center: [entrance[0], entrance[1] + 0.6, entrance[2]],
        size: [0.65, 1.2, 0.65],
        color: [0.86, 0.53, 0.16],
        solid: false,
    };
    WorldMap::from_parts(spawn, vec![marker], Vec::new())
        .map(|map| map.with_spawn_position_mm(minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(spawn_mm)))
}

/// The v1 landing mesh is retained solely for reading its saved fingerprint.
pub fn materialize_legacy_planet_map(
    terrain: PlanetTerrain,
    landmarks: PlanetLandmarks,
) -> Result<WorldMap, String> {
    let u_steps = 16_usize;
    let v_steps = 36_usize;
    let scale = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
    let half_u = scale / 32;
    let v_start = -(scale / 8 + scale / 64);
    let v_span = scale / 4 + scale / 32;
    let mut points = Vec::with_capacity((u_steps + 1) * (v_steps + 1));
    for v_index in 0..=v_steps {
        let v = v_start + v_span * v_index as i32 / v_steps as i32;
        for u_index in 0..=u_steps {
            let u = -half_u + 2 * half_u * u_index as i32 / u_steps as i32;
            let sample = PlanetFace::PositiveY
                .cube_sample(u, v)
                .ok_or_else(|| String::from("legacy planet sample is outside face bounds"))?;
            points.push(millimeters_to_world(
                terrain.sample(sample).position_mm.coordinates(),
            ));
        }
    }
    let mut triangles = Vec::with_capacity(u_steps * v_steps * 2);
    for v_index in 0..v_steps {
        for u_index in 0..u_steps {
            let lower_left = v_index * (u_steps + 1) + u_index;
            let lower_right = lower_left + 1;
            let upper_left = lower_left + u_steps + 1;
            let upper_right = upper_left + 1;
            triangles.push(MapTriangle {
                vertices: [points[lower_left], points[upper_left], points[lower_right]],
                precise_vertices: None,
                color: TERRAIN_COLOR,
                solid: true,
            });
            triangles.push(MapTriangle {
                vertices: [points[lower_right], points[upper_left], points[upper_right]],
                precise_vertices: None,
                color: TERRAIN_COLOR,
                solid: true,
            });
        }
    }
    let spawn = millimeters_to_world(radial_clearance(
        landmarks.spawn.position_mm.coordinates(),
        PLANET_SPAWN_CLEARANCE_MM,
    ));
    let entrance = millimeters_to_world(landmarks.entrance.position_mm.coordinates());
    let marker = MapBox {
        center: [entrance[0], entrance[1] + 0.6, entrance[2]],
        size: [0.65, 1.2, 0.65],
        color: [0.86, 0.53, 0.16],
        solid: false,
    };
    WorldMap::from_parts(spawn, vec![marker], triangles)
}

/// Turns a connected dungeon floor plan into shared render and collision geometry.
pub fn materialize_dungeon_map(blueprint: &DungeonBlueprint) -> Result<WorldMap, String> {
    let (width, height) = blueprint.dimensions();
    let mut triangles = Vec::new();
    let mut walls = Vec::new();
    for y in 0..height {
        for x in 0..width {
            let center = [f32::from(x) + 0.5, 0.0, f32::from(y) + 0.5];
            match blueprint.tile(x, y) {
                Some(DungeonTile::Room | DungeonTile::Corridor) => {
                    let color = if blueprint.tile(x, y) == Some(DungeonTile::Room) {
                        ROOM_COLOR
                    } else {
                        [0.27, 0.29, 0.25]
                    };
                    triangles.extend(floor_triangles(x, y, color));
                }
                Some(DungeonTile::Void) => walls.push(MapBox {
                    center: [center[0], 1.5, center[2]],
                    size: [1.0, 3.0, 1.0],
                    color: WALL_COLOR,
                    solid: true,
                }),
                None => {
                    return Err(String::from(
                        "dungeon blueprint dimensions are inconsistent",
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let spawn_cell = blueprint.spawn();
    let spawn = [
        f32::from(spawn_cell[0]) + 0.5,
        0.0,
        f32::from(spawn_cell[1]) + 0.5,
    ];
    let entrance_cell = blueprint.entrance();
    let entrance = [
        f32::from(entrance_cell[0]) + 0.5,
        0.0,
        f32::from(entrance_cell[1]) + 0.5,
    ];
    walls.push(MapBox {
        center: [entrance[0], 0.08, entrance[2]],
        size: [1.4, 0.16, 1.4],
        color: [0.86, 0.53, 0.16],
        solid: false,
    });
    WorldMap::from_parts(spawn, walls, triangles)
}

fn floor_triangles(x: u16, y: u16, color: [f32; 3]) -> [MapTriangle; 2] {
    let x = f32::from(x);
    let z = f32::from(y);
    [
        MapTriangle {
            vertices: [[x, 0.0, z], [x, 0.0, z + 1.0], [x + 1.0, 0.0, z]],
            precise_vertices: None,
            color,
            solid: true,
        },
        MapTriangle {
            vertices: [
                [x, 0.0, z + 1.0],
                [x + 1.0, 0.0, z + 1.0],
                [x + 1.0, 0.0, z],
            ],
            precise_vertices: None,
            color,
            solid: true,
        },
    ]
}

fn millimeters_to_world(position: [i64; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    position.map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0)
}

fn radial_clearance(position: [i64; 3], distance_mm: i64) -> [i64; 3] {
    let length_squared = position
        .into_iter()
        .map(|coordinate| (coordinate * coordinate) as u64)
        .sum::<u64>();
    let length = integer_sqrt(length_squared) as i64;
    position.map(|coordinate| {
        let numerator = coordinate * distance_mm;
        let offset = if numerator < 0 {
            -((-numerator + length / 2) / length)
        } else {
            (numerator + length / 2) / length
        };
        coordinate + offset
    })
}

fn integer_sqrt(value: u64) -> u64 {
    if value < 2 {
        return value;
    }
    let mut current = value;
    let mut next = current.div_ceil(2);
    while next < current {
        current = next;
        next = (current + value / current) / 2;
    }
    current
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/philox.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="28" bytes="1103" original_lines="28" original_bytes="1103" minified="false" sha256="fb12e7c395db0f0e9e31c2ba6d603e02a754e984564db70faa8b3e5ba7c9fc3d">>>
//! Philox4x32-10 constants and round function from the Random123 reference.

const MULTIPLIER_0: u32 = 0xD251_1F53;
const MULTIPLIER_1: u32 = 0xCD9E_8D57;
const WEYL_0: u32 = 0x9E37_79B9;
const WEYL_1: u32 = 0xBB67_AE85;

/// Maps a 64-bit key and 128-bit counter to four deterministic 32-bit words.
///
/// The counter is interpreted in the supplied word order. All operations are
/// wrapping integer arithmetic, so output does not depend on platform floats.
pub fn philox4x32_10(mut key: [u32; 2], mut counter: [u32; 4]) -> [u32; 4] {
    for round in 0..10 {
        let product_0 = u64::from(MULTIPLIER_0) * u64::from(counter[0]);
        let product_1 = u64::from(MULTIPLIER_1) * u64::from(counter[2]);
        counter = [
            (product_1 >> 32) as u32 ^ counter[1] ^ key[0],
            product_1 as u32,
            (product_0 >> 32) as u32 ^ counter[3] ^ key[1],
            product_0 as u32,
        ];
        if round != 9 {
            key[0] = key[0].wrapping_add(WEYL_0);
            key[1] = key[1].wrapping_add(WEYL_1);
        }
    }
    counter
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/planet.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="400" bytes="14452" original_lines="400" original_bytes="14452" minified="false" sha256="30cce7a36b27b6ab5a8207ef8e9962ac5682760809c89c4e42da813017be20a4">>>
use crate::{AddressedRandom, GenerationChannel};
use minimium_world::world::{
    CubeSampleKey, GenerationSpec, PlanetDefinition, PlanetFace, Position3Mm, SectorKey,
};
use std::sync::Arc;

const MAX_RADIUS_MM: u64 = 6_371_000_000;
const MIN_RADIUS_MM: u64 = 5_000;
const NOISE_Q16: i64 = 65_536;
const NOISE_LATTICE_STEP: i32 = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE / 8;

use minimium_world::world::PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct PlanetSurfaceSpec {
    radius_mm: u64,
    relief_mm: u64,
}

impl PlanetSurfaceSpec {
    /// The displacement remains small relative to the planet radius.
    pub fn new(radius_mm: u64, relief_mm: u64) -> Option<Self> {
        if !(MIN_RADIUS_MM..=MAX_RADIUS_MM).contains(&radius_mm)
            || relief_mm > (radius_mm / 50).min(5_000_000)
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self {
            radius_mm,
            relief_mm,
        })
    }

    pub const fn radius_mm(self) -> u64 {
        self.radius_mm
    }

    pub const fn relief_mm(self) -> u64 {
        self.relief_mm
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct PlanetPoint {
    pub cube_sample: CubeSampleKey,
    pub height_mm: u64,
    pub position_mm: Position3Mm,
    pub ocean: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct PlanetLandmarks {
    pub spawn: PlanetPoint,
    pub entrance: PlanetPoint,
    pub approach: [PlanetPoint; 9],
}

/// Fixed-point value-noise surface. The cube sample key makes face borders share
/// the same lattice coordinates; output positions are integral millimeters.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct PlanetTerrain {
    generation: GenerationSpec,
    surface: PlanetSurfaceSpec,
    definition: Option<PlanetDefinition>,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>>,
    pub(crate) surface_recipe: crate::surface_habitat::SurfaceRecipe,
}

impl PlanetTerrain {
    pub fn new(generation: GenerationSpec, surface: PlanetSurfaceSpec) -> Option<Self> {
        if u64::from(generation.position_quantum_mm()) > surface.radius_mm() / 1024 {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self {
            generation,
            surface,
            definition: None,
            geography: None,
            surface_recipe: Default::default(),
        })
    }

    pub fn with_surface_recipe(
        mut self,
        recipe: crate::surface_habitat::SurfaceRecipe,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        if !recipe.valid() {
            return None;
        }
        self.surface_recipe = recipe;
        Some(self)
    }

    pub fn with_geography(mut self, geography: Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>) -> Self {
        self.geography = Some(geography);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_definition(mut self, definition: PlanetDefinition) -> Self {
        self.definition = Some(definition);
        self
    }

    pub const fn radius_mm(&self) -> u64 {
        self.surface.radius_mm()
    }

    pub fn sea_level_mm(&self) -> i64 {
        self.definition
            .map_or(0, |definition| definition.sea_level_mm)
    }

    pub fn is_earth(&self) -> bool {
        self.definition
            .is_some_and(|definition| definition.mode == 1)
    }

    pub(crate) fn land_cover(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 6]> {
        if self.is_earth() {
            self.geography.as_ref()?.land_cover(direction)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    /// Presentation-only conversion from scaled terrain metres to source metres.
    pub fn presentation_height_scale(&self) -> f32 {
        self.definition.map_or(1.0, |definition| {
            if definition.mode == 1 {
                definition.height_scale_permille.max(1) as f32 / 1000.0
            } else {
                1.0
            }
        })
    }

    pub fn sample(&self, cube_sample: CubeSampleKey) -> PlanetPoint {
        self.sample_surface(cube_sample, true)
    }

    /// Presentation ground retains Earth bathymetry beneath the separate ocean.
    /// The authoritative sample remains sea-clamped for saves and collision.
    pub fn ground_sample(&self, cube_sample: CubeSampleKey) -> PlanetPoint {
        self.sample_surface(cube_sample, false)
    }

    /// Canonical sea-level vertex, with the same quantization as planet ground.
    pub fn sea_position(&self, cube_sample: CubeSampleKey) -> Position3Mm {
        let radius = (self.radius_mm() as i64 + self.sea_level_mm()).max(1) as u64;
        self.position_at(cube_sample, radius)
    }

    fn sample_surface(&self, cube_sample: CubeSampleKey, sea_clamped: bool) -> PlanetPoint {
        let (offset, ocean) = if let Some(definition) =
            self.definition.filter(|definition| definition.mode == 1)
        {
            let direction = cube_sample.coordinates().map(f64::from);
            let elevation_m = self
                .geography
                .as_ref()
                .map(|geography| geography.elevation_m(direction))
                .unwrap_or(Err(crate::EarthSampleError::PackageUnavailable))
                .expect("Earth generation requires its prepared geography");
            let elevation = definition.earth_elevation_mm(elevation_m).round() as i64;
            let ocean = elevation < definition.sea_level_mm;
            let detail = if ocean {
                0
            } else {
                let step = ((u64::from(definition.detail_wavelength_mm)
                    * PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE as u64
                    / self.surface.radius_mm)
                    .max(1)) as i32;
                interpolate_noise_at(
                    self.generation,
                    cube_sample,
                    step,
                    GenerationChannel::TerrainDetail,
                ) * i64::from(definition.detail_strength_mm)
                    / 32_768
            };
            let ground = (elevation + detail).min(i64::from(definition.mountain_limit_mm));
            let offset = if sea_clamped {
                (elevation + detail)
                    .max(definition.sea_level_mm)
                    .min(i64::from(definition.mountain_limit_mm))
            } else {
                ground.max(1 - self.radius_mm() as i64)
            };
            (offset, ocean)
        } else if let Some(definition) = self.definition {
            let band_step = (PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE
                / definition.mountain_band_frequency.max(1) as i32)
                .max(1);
            let band = interpolate_noise_at(
                self.generation,
                cube_sample,
                band_step,
                GenerationChannel::TerrainBands,
            )
            .abs();
            let mountains = (band - 20_000).max(0) * self.surface.relief_mm as i64 / 12_768;
            let detail_step = ((u64::from(definition.detail_wavelength_mm)
                * PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE as u64
                / self.surface.radius_mm)
                .max(1)) as i32;
            let detail = interpolate_noise_at(
                self.generation,
                cube_sample,
                detail_step,
                GenerationChannel::TerrainDetail,
            ) * i64::from(definition.detail_strength_mm)
                / 32_768;
            let [x, y, z] = cube_sample.coordinates();
            let clearance = if y == PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE {
                let distance = x.abs().max(z.abs());
                let inner = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE / 256;
                let outer = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE / 64;
                i64::from((distance - inner).clamp(0, outer - inner)) * 1000
                    / i64::from(outer - inner)
            } else {
                1000
            };
            (
                ((mountains + detail) * i64::from(definition.height_scale_permille) * clearance
                    / 1_000_000)
                    .clamp(
                        -i64::from(definition.detail_strength_mm),
                        i64::from(definition.mountain_limit_mm),
                    ),
                false,
            )
        } else {
            (
                interpolate_noise(self.generation, cube_sample) * self.surface.relief_mm as i64
                    / 32_768,
                false,
            )
        };
        let height_mm = (self.surface.radius_mm as i64 + offset) as u64;
        let position_mm = self.position_at(cube_sample, height_mm);
        PlanetPoint {
            cube_sample,
            height_mm,
            position_mm,
            ocean,
        }
    }

    pub fn earth_elevation_upper_bound_m(
        &self,
        direction: [f64; 3],
        angle: f64,
    ) -> Result<f64, crate::EarthSampleError> {
        self.geography.as_ref().map_or(
            Err(crate::EarthSampleError::PackageUnavailable),
            |geography| geography.elevation_upper_bound_m(direction, angle),
        )
    }

    /// Unexaggerated source metres above the configured sea datum for climate.
    pub fn source_elevation_m(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> Option<f64> {
        let definition = self.definition.filter(|p| p.mode == 1)?;
        let raw = self.geography.as_ref()?.elevation_m(direction).ok()?;
        Some(raw - definition.sea_level_mm as f64 / f64::from(definition.height_scale_permille))
    }

    pub fn has_peak_relief(&self) -> bool {
        self.definition.is_some_and(|p| p.peak_relief.enabled())
    }

    /// Safe deterministic spawn and entrance on one face, joined by sampled
    /// approach points. The relief bound keeps the route traversable.
    pub fn landmarks(&self) -> PlanetLandmarks {
        let scale = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
        let (u, start, step) = if self.is_earth() && self.generation.revision().get() >= 4 {
            // Near Bergen: 60.4 N, 5.3 E. This cube coordinate samples the
            // same GEBCO surface used by collision and sector rendering.
            let step = scale / 8192;
            (
                (i64::from(scale) * 566 / 1000) as i32,
                (i64::from(scale) * 527 / 10_000) as i32,
                step,
            )
        } else if self
            .definition
            .is_some_and(|definition| definition.mode == 1)
        {
            let jitter =
                (self.generation.seed().get() as i32).rem_euclid(scale / 1024) - scale / 2048;
            let step = scale / 4096;
            (
                scale / 1000 * 811 + jitter,
                scale / 1000 * 217 - 4 * step + jitter,
                step,
            )
        } else if self.generation.revision().get() >= 2 {
            (0, -(scale / 512), scale / 2048)
        } else {
            (0, -(scale / 8), scale / 32)
        };
        let approach = std::array::from_fn(|index| {
            let sample = PlanetFace::PositiveY
                .cube_sample(u, start + index as i32 * step)
                .expect("fixed planet route samples lie inside the face");
            self.sample(sample)
        });
        PlanetLandmarks {
            spawn: approach[0],
            entrance: approach[8],
            approach,
        }
    }

    fn position_at(&self, sample: CubeSampleKey, radius_mm: u64) -> Position3Mm {
        let [x, y, z] = sample.coordinates().map(i64::from);
        let length_squared = (x * x + y * y + z * z) as u64;
        let length = integer_sqrt(length_squared) as i64;
        let quantum = i64::from(self.generation.position_quantum_mm());
        let radius = radius_mm as i64;
        let quantize = |coordinate: i64| {
            let numerator = coordinate * radius;
            let rounded = divide_round_nearest(numerator, length);
            divide_round_nearest(rounded, quantum) * quantum
        };
        Position3Mm::new(quantize(x), quantize(y), quantize(z))
    }
}

fn interpolate_noise(generation: GenerationSpec, sample: CubeSampleKey) -> i64 {
    interpolate_noise_at(
        generation,
        sample,
        NOISE_LATTICE_STEP,
        GenerationChannel::Terrain,
    )
}

fn interpolate_noise_at(
    generation: GenerationSpec,
    sample: CubeSampleKey,
    step: i32,
    channel: GenerationChannel,
) -> i64 {
    let [x, y, z] = sample.coordinates();
    let (x0, tx) = lattice_coordinate(x, step);
    let (y0, ty) = lattice_coordinate(y, step);
    let (z0, tz) = lattice_coordinate(z, step);
    let values = std::array::from_fn::<_, 8, _>(|index| {
        let dx = (index & 1) as i32;
        let dy = ((index >> 1) & 1) as i32;
        let dz = ((index >> 2) & 1) as i32;
        let cell = SectorKey::dungeon(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz);
        let word = AddressedRandom::new(generation, channel, cell).sample_u32(0);
        i64::from((word >> 16) as u16) - 32_768
    });
    let x00 = lerp(values[0], values[1], tx);
    let x10 = lerp(values[2], values[3], tx);
    let x01 = lerp(values[4], values[5], tx);
    let x11 = lerp(values[6], values[7], tx);
    let y0 = lerp(x00, x10, ty);
    let y1 = lerp(x01, x11, ty);
    lerp(y0, y1, tz)
}

fn lattice_coordinate(coordinate: i32, step: i32) -> (i32, i64) {
    let cell = coordinate.div_euclid(step);
    let remainder = coordinate.rem_euclid(step);
    let fraction = i64::from(remainder) * NOISE_Q16 / i64::from(step);
    (cell, smoothstep(fraction))
}

fn smoothstep(value: i64) -> i64 {
    let square = value * value / NOISE_Q16;
    square * (3 * NOISE_Q16 - 2 * value) / NOISE_Q16
}

fn lerp(start: i64, end: i64, amount_q16: i64) -> i64 {
    start + (end - start) * amount_q16 / NOISE_Q16
}

fn divide_round_nearest(numerator: i64, denominator: i64) -> i64 {
    if numerator < 0 {
        -((-numerator + denominator / 2) / denominator)
    } else {
        (numerator + denominator / 2) / denominator
    }
}

fn integer_sqrt(value: u64) -> u64 {
    if value < 2 {
        return value;
    }
    let mut current = value;
    let mut next = current.div_ceil(2);
    while next < current {
        current = next;
        next = (current + value / current) / 2;
    }
    current
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/planet_sector.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="399" bytes="15148" original_lines="399" original_bytes="15148" minified="false" sha256="825bc087df5a8d4dc368f096bd4420f4a092f84e126d073c7111e064c3d04432">>>
use crate::terrain_color::terrain_color;
use crate::{PlanetSurfaceSpec, PlanetTerrain, SectorGeometry};
use minimium_world::world::{
    MapTriangle, PlanetFace, PlanetSectorKey, WorldManifest, PLANET_DENSE_SECTORS_PER_FACE,
    PLANET_SECTORS_PER_FACE,
};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// The collision lattice is fixed independently of the renderer's patch detail.
/// Neighboring sectors, including those on different cube faces, sample the
/// same canonical cube points at their shared border.
pub const PLANET_COLLISION_SUBDIVISIONS: u32 = 16;
/// Presentation lattice shared with coast probes and coarse/fine edge conformance.
pub const PLANET_RENDER_BLOCK_SUBDIVISIONS: u32 = 16;
pub const PLANET_RADIUS_MM: u64 = 10_000_000;
pub const PLANET_RELIEF_MM: u64 = 30_000;

pub fn planet_surface() -> PlanetSurfaceSpec {
    PlanetSurfaceSpec::new(PLANET_RADIUS_MM, PLANET_RELIEF_MM)
        .expect("the fixed planet surface is valid")
}

pub fn planet_surface_for(manifest: WorldManifest) -> PlanetSurfaceSpec {
    if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet() {
        PlanetSurfaceSpec::new(
            definition.radius_mm,
            u64::from(definition.mountain_limit_mm),
        )
        .expect("validated planet definition has a valid surface")
    } else {
        planet_surface()
    }
}

pub fn planet_sector_count(manifest: WorldManifest) -> u16 {
    if manifest.planet().is_some() {
        PLANET_DENSE_SECTORS_PER_FACE
    } else {
        PLANET_SECTORS_PER_FACE
    }
}

/// Resolve an arbitrary globe click through the same terrain definition as
/// streamed sectors. The caller decides whether ocean is a valid destination.
pub fn planet_point_at_direction(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    direction: [f32; 3],
) -> Option<crate::PlanetPoint> {
    planet_point_at_direction_with_geography(manifest, direction, None)
}

pub fn planet_point_at_direction_with_geography(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    direction: [f32; 3],
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> Option<crate::PlanetPoint> {
    if manifest.topology() != minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet
        || !direction.iter().all(|component| component.is_finite())
    {
        return None;
    }
    let [x, y, z] = direction.map(f64::from);
    let dominant = x.abs().max(y.abs()).max(z.abs());
    if dominant < 0.5 {
        return None;
    }
    let (face, u, v) = if x.abs() == dominant {
        (
            if x > 0.0 {
                PlanetFace::PositiveX
            } else {
                PlanetFace::NegativeX
            },
            y / dominant,
            z / dominant,
        )
    } else if y.abs() == dominant {
        (
            if y > 0.0 {
                PlanetFace::PositiveY
            } else {
                PlanetFace::NegativeY
            },
            x / dominant,
            z / dominant,
        )
    } else {
        (
            if z > 0.0 {
                PlanetFace::PositiveZ
            } else {
                PlanetFace::NegativeZ
            },
            x / dominant,
            y / dominant,
        )
    };
    let scale = f64::from(minimium_world::world::PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE);
    let sample = face.cube_sample((u * scale).round() as i32, (v * scale).round() as i32)?;
    let mut terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(manifest.generation(), planet_surface_for(manifest))?;
    if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet() {
        terrain = terrain.with_definition(definition);
    }
    if let Some(geography) = geography {
        terrain = terrain.with_geography(geography);
    }
    Some(terrain.sample(sample))
}

pub fn generate_planet_sector(manifest: WorldManifest, key: PlanetSectorKey) -> SectorGeometry {
    generate_planet_sector_with_geography(manifest, key, None)
}

pub fn generate_planet_sector_with_geography(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    key: PlanetSectorKey,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    let mut terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(manifest.generation(), planet_surface_for(manifest))
        .expect("the planet generation quantum fits the surface");
    if let Some(geography) = geography {
        terrain = terrain.with_geography(geography);
    }
    if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet() {
        terrain = terrain.with_definition(definition);
    }
    let subdivisions = if manifest.planet().is_some() {
        32
    } else {
        PLANET_COLLISION_SUBDIVISIONS
    };
    let count = planet_sector_count(manifest);
    let edge = subdivisions as usize;
    let mut points = Vec::with_capacity((edge + 1) * (edge + 1));
    let mut ocean = Vec::with_capacity((edge + 1) * (edge + 1));
    for v in 0..=subdivisions {
        for u in 0..=subdivisions {
            let sample = key
                .cube_sample_with_count(u, v, subdivisions, count)
                .expect("sector lattice point is valid");
            let point = terrain.sample(sample);
            points.push(point.position_mm.coordinates());
            ocean.push(point.ocean);
        }
    }
    let mut triangles = Vec::with_capacity(edge * edge * 2);
    for v in 0..edge {
        for u in 0..edge {
            let a = points[v * (edge + 1) + u];
            let b = points[(v + 1) * (edge + 1) + u];
            let c = points[v * (edge + 1) + u + 1];
            let d = points[(v + 1) * (edge + 1) + u + 1];
            for (vertices, water) in [
                (
                    [a, b, c],
                    ocean[v * (edge + 1) + u]
                        || ocean[(v + 1) * (edge + 1) + u]
                        || ocean[v * (edge + 1) + u + 1],
                ),
                (
                    [c, b, d],
                    ocean[v * (edge + 1) + u + 1]
                        || ocean[(v + 1) * (edge + 1) + u]
                        || ocean[(v + 1) * (edge + 1) + u + 1],
                ),
            ] {
                add_precise_triangle(&mut triangles, vertices, water, true);
            }
        }
    }
    SectorGeometry {
        boxes: Vec::new(),
        triangles,
    }
}

/// Render-only fan mesh. Every outer edge uses the same 16 canonical samples
/// regardless of interior detail, so adjacent detail levels meet exactly.
pub fn generate_planet_render_patch(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    key: PlanetSectorKey,
    subdivisions: u32,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    generate_planet_render_patch_with_geography(manifest, key, subdivisions, None)
}

pub fn generate_planet_render_patch_with_geography(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    key: PlanetSectorKey,
    subdivisions: u32,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    assert!(subdivisions.is_power_of_two() && (1..=16).contains(&subdivisions));
    let mut terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(manifest.generation(), planet_surface_for(manifest))
        .expect("the planet generation quantum fits the surface");
    if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet() {
        terrain = terrain.with_definition(definition);
    }
    if let Some(geography) = geography {
        terrain = terrain.with_geography(geography);
    }
    let count = planet_sector_count(manifest);
    let mut triangles = Vec::new();
    let edge_step = 16 / subdivisions;
    let point = |u: u32, v: u32| {
        let sample = key
            .cube_sample_with_count(u, v, 16, count)
            .expect("render edge sample is valid");
        terrain.ground_sample(sample)
    };
    for cell_v in 0..subdivisions {
        for cell_u in 0..subdivisions {
            let u0 = cell_u * edge_step;
            let v0 = cell_v * edge_step;
            let u1 = u0 + edge_step;
            let v1 = v0 + edge_step;
            let center_sample = key
                .cube_sample_with_count(cell_u * 2 + 1, cell_v * 2 + 1, subdivisions * 2, count)
                .expect("render cell center is valid");
            let center = terrain.ground_sample(center_sample);
            let mut border = Vec::with_capacity(4 * edge_step as usize);
            let edges = [
                ((u0, v0), (u1, v0), v0 == 0),
                ((u1, v0), (u1, v1), u1 == 16),
                ((u1, v1), (u0, v1), v1 == 16),
                ((u0, v1), (u0, v0), u0 == 0),
            ];
            for ((from_u, from_v), (to_u, to_v), outer) in edges {
                let steps = if outer { edge_step } else { 1 };
                for index in 0..steps {
                    let fraction = index as f32 / steps as f32;
                    let u =
                        (from_u as f32 + (to_u as f32 - from_u as f32) * fraction).round() as u32;
                    let v =
                        (from_v as f32 + (to_v as f32 - from_v as f32) * fraction).round() as u32;
                    border.push(point(u, v));
                }
            }
            for index in 0..border.len() {
                let next = border[(index + 1) % border.len()];
                let current = border[index];
                add_ground_triangle(&mut triangles, [center, current, next]);
            }
        }
    }
    SectorGeometry {
        boxes: Vec::new(),
        triangles,
    }
}

/// A coarse quadtree leaf spanning `span` fine sectors. Edge skirts conceal
/// the different sampling density at neighboring quadtree levels.
pub fn generate_planet_render_block(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    face: PlanetFace,
    u: u16,
    v: u16,
    span: u16,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    generate_planet_render_block_with_geography(manifest, face, u, v, span, None)
}

pub fn generate_planet_render_block_with_geography(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    face: PlanetFace,
    u: u16,
    v: u16,
    span: u16,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    const STEPS: usize = PLANET_RENDER_BLOCK_SUBDIVISIONS as usize;
    let count = u32::from(planet_sector_count(manifest));
    let scale = minimium_world::world::PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
    let mut terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(manifest.generation(), planet_surface_for(manifest))
        .expect("the planet generation quantum fits the surface");
    if let Some(definition) = manifest.planet() {
        terrain = terrain.with_definition(definition);
    }
    if let Some(geography) = geography {
        terrain = terrain.with_geography(geography);
    }
    let mut samples = Vec::with_capacity((STEPS + 1) * (STEPS + 1));
    let mut points = Vec::with_capacity((STEPS + 1) * (STEPS + 1));
    let mut ocean = Vec::with_capacity((STEPS + 1) * (STEPS + 1));
    let mut heights = Vec::with_capacity((STEPS + 1) * (STEPS + 1));
    for row in 0..=STEPS {
        for column in 0..=STEPS {
            let grid_u = u32::from(u) * STEPS as u32 + u32::from(span) * column as u32;
            let grid_v = u32::from(v) * STEPS as u32 + u32::from(span) * row as u32;
            let cube_u = -scale
                + (2_i64 * i64::from(scale) * i64::from(grid_u) / (i64::from(count) * STEPS as i64))
                    as i32;
            let cube_v = -scale
                + (2_i64 * i64::from(scale) * i64::from(grid_v) / (i64::from(count) * STEPS as i64))
                    as i32;
            let sample = face
                .cube_sample(cube_u, cube_v)
                .expect("block lies on face");
            let point = terrain.ground_sample(sample);
            samples.push(point);
            points.push(point.position_mm.coordinates());
            ocean.push(point.ocean);
            heights
                .push(point.height_mm as i64 - terrain.radius_mm() as i64 - terrain.sea_level_mm());
        }
    }
    let mut triangles = Vec::with_capacity(STEPS * STEPS * 2 + STEPS * 8);
    for row in 0..STEPS {
        for column in 0..STEPS {
            let ia = row * (STEPS + 1) + column;
            let ib = (row + 1) * (STEPS + 1) + column;
            let ic = ia + 1;
            let id = ib + 1;
            for indices in [[ia, ib, ic], [ic, ib, id]] {
                add_ground_triangle(&mut triangles, indices.map(|i| samples[i]));
            }
        }
    }
    let mut add = |vertices: [[i64; 3]; 3], color: [f32; 3]| {
        add_precise_triangle(&mut triangles, vertices, false, false);
        triangles.last_mut().expect("triangle was added").color = color;
    };
    let skirt_depth = manifest
        .planet()
        .map(|definition| definition.mountain_limit_mm as f32 / 1000.0 + 10.0)
        .unwrap_or(5.0);
    let lowered = |point: [i64; 3]| {
        let length = point
            .iter()
            .map(|component| (*component as f64).powi(2))
            .sum::<f64>()
            .sqrt();
        point.map(|component| {
            (component as f64 * (1.0 - f64::from(skirt_depth) * 1000.0 / length)).round() as i64
        })
    };
    for edge in 0..4 {
        for index in 0..STEPS {
            let (ia, ib) = match edge {
                0 => (index, index + 1),
                1 => (
                    index * (STEPS + 1) + STEPS,
                    (index + 1) * (STEPS + 1) + STEPS,
                ),
                2 => (STEPS * (STEPS + 1) + index, STEPS * (STEPS + 1) + index + 1),
                _ => (index * (STEPS + 1), (index + 1) * (STEPS + 1)),
            };
            let (a, b) = (points[ia], points[ib]);
            let color = terrain_color((heights[ia] + heights[ib]) / 2, ocean[ia] && ocean[ib]);
            add([a, lowered(a), b], color);
            add([b, lowered(a), lowered(b)], color);
        }
    }
    SectorGeometry {
        boxes: Vec::new(),
        triangles,
    }
}

fn add_ground_triangle(triangles: &mut Vec<MapTriangle>, points: [crate::PlanetPoint; 3]) {
    add_precise_triangle(
        triangles,
        points.map(|p| p.position_mm.coordinates()),
        points.iter().all(|p| p.ocean),
        false,
    );
}

pub(crate) fn add_precise_triangle(
    triangles: &mut Vec<MapTriangle>,
    mut vertices: [[i64; 3]; 3],
    water: bool,
    solid: bool,
) {
    let a = vertices[0].map(|x| x as f64);
    let b = vertices[1].map(|x| x as f64);
    let c = vertices[2].map(|x| x as f64);
    let ab: [f64; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|axis| b[axis] - a[axis]);
    let ac: [f64; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|axis| c[axis] - a[axis]);
    let normal = [
        ab[1] * ac[2] - ab[2] * ac[1],
        ab[2] * ac[0] - ab[0] * ac[2],
        ab[0] * ac[1] - ab[1] * ac[0],
    ];
    if normal.iter().zip(a).map(|(n, p)| n * p).sum::<f64>() < 0.0 {
        vertices.swap(1, 2);
    }
    triangles.push(MapTriangle {
        vertices: vertices.map(|point| point.map(|x| x as f32 / 1000.0)),
        precise_vertices: Some(vertices),
        color: if water {
            [0.08, 0.24, 0.48]
        } else {
            [0.18, 0.42, 0.19]
        },
        solid,
    });
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/planet_teleport.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="71" bytes="2642" original_lines="71" original_bytes="2642" minified="false" sha256="ba0b5ffe27aa620cbb2d1f75ebe0895c2e614d337710dcca8441aba74b9ec633">>>
use crate::{generate_planet_sector_with_geography, planet_sector_count, PreparedGeography};
use minimium_world::world::{PlanetSectorKey, WorldManifest};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Intersect a globe click with the same triangles used for collision.
/// The sampled elevation alone can sit below a triangle on steep slopes.
pub fn planet_collision_position_at_direction(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    direction: [f32; 3],
) -> Option<[i64; 3]> {
    planet_collision_position_at_direction_with_geography(manifest, direction, None)
}

pub fn planet_collision_position_at_direction_with_geography(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    direction: [f32; 3],
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn PreparedGeography>>,
) -> Option<[i64; 3]> {
    let key = PlanetSectorKey::from_direction_with_count(direction, planet_sector_count(manifest));
    let geometry = generate_planet_sector_with_geography(manifest, key, geography);
    let d = direction.map(f64::from);
    for triangle in &geometry.triangles {
        let vertices = triangle.precise_vertices?;
        let a = vertices[0].map(|value| value as f64);
        let b = vertices[1].map(|value| value as f64);
        let c = vertices[2].map(|value| value as f64);
        let ab = sub(b, a);
        let ac = sub(c, a);
        let normal = cross(ab, ac);
        let denominator = dot(normal, d);
        if denominator.abs() < 1.0e-9 {
            continue;
        }
        let distance = dot(normal, a) / denominator;
        if distance <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let relative = sub(d.map(|value| value * distance), a);
        let ab_ab = dot(ab, ab);
        let ab_ac = dot(ab, ac);
        let ac_ac = dot(ac, ac);
        let rel_ab = dot(relative, ab);
        let rel_ac = dot(relative, ac);
        let determinant = ab_ab * ac_ac - ab_ac * ab_ac;
        if determinant.abs() < 1.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let u = (rel_ab * ac_ac - rel_ac * ab_ac) / determinant;
        let v = (rel_ac * ab_ab - rel_ab * ab_ac) / determinant;
        if u >= -1.0e-5 && v >= -1.0e-5 && u + v <= 1.0 + 1.0e-5 {
            return Some(d.map(|value| (value * distance).round() as i64));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn sub(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|axis| a[axis] - b[axis])
}

fn dot(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    a.into_iter().zip(b).map(|(left, right)| left * right).sum()
}

fn cross(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [
        a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
        a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
        a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
    ]
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/random_address.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="126" bytes="4265" original_lines="126" original_bytes="4265" minified="false" sha256="534fc49adc82c2c6e51685da53a728e5f73ee5eb866fae3efa6ee6183ab53359">>>
use crate::philox::philox4x32_10;
use minimium_world::world::{GenerationSpec, ObjectOriginId, SectorKey};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum GenerationChannel {
    Terrain = 1,
    Objects = 2,
    DungeonLayout = 3,
    TerrainDetail = 4,
    TerrainBands = 5,
}

/// A seekable random source whose address includes generation revision, channel
/// and logical sector. Calling samples in any order produces the same values.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct AddressedRandom {
    key: [u32; 2],
    base_counter: [u32; 4],
}

impl AddressedRandom {
    pub fn new(spec: GenerationSpec, channel: GenerationChannel, sector: SectorKey) -> Self {
        let seed = spec.seed().get();
        let key = [seed as u32, (seed >> 32) as u32];
        let mut address = StableAddressHash::new();
        address.feed(b"MINIMIUM_PROCGEN_PHILOX4X32_10_V1");
        address.feed(&((seed >> 64) as u64).to_le_bytes());
        address.feed(&spec.revision().get().to_le_bytes());
        address.feed(&spec.position_quantum_mm().to_le_bytes());
        address.feed(&[channel as u8]);
        encode_sector(&mut address, sector);
        Self {
            key,
            base_counter: address.finish(),
        }
    }

    pub fn sample_u32(self, draw_index: u64) -> u32 {
        let output = philox4x32_10(self.key, self.counter_for_block(draw_index / 4));
        output[(draw_index % 4) as usize]
    }

    /// Maps a local generated-object ordinal to a stable, nonzero origin ID.
    pub fn object_origin(self, local_ordinal: u64) -> ObjectOriginId {
        let output = philox4x32_10(self.key, self.counter_for_block(local_ordinal));
        let value = u128::from(output[0])
            | (u128::from(output[1]) << 32)
            | (u128::from(output[2]) << 64)
            | (u128::from(output[3]) << 96);
        ObjectOriginId::new(value)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| ObjectOriginId::new(1).expect("one is a nonzero object origin"))
    }

    fn counter_for_block(self, block: u64) -> [u32; 4] {
        let low = u64::from(self.base_counter[0]) | (u64::from(self.base_counter[1]) << 32);
        let high = u64::from(self.base_counter[2]) | (u64::from(self.base_counter[3]) << 32);
        let value = ((u128::from(high) << 64) | u128::from(low)).wrapping_add(u128::from(block));
        [
            value as u32,
            (value >> 32) as u32,
            (value >> 64) as u32,
            (value >> 96) as u32,
        ]
    }
}

fn encode_sector(hash: &mut StableAddressHash, sector: SectorKey) {
    match sector {
        SectorKey::Planet(key) => {
            hash.feed(&[0, key.face().index()]);
            let (u, v) = key.coordinates();
            hash.feed(&u.to_le_bytes());
            hash.feed(&v.to_le_bytes());
        }
        SectorKey::Dungeon(key) => {
            hash.feed(&[1]);
            let (x, y, z) = key.coordinates();
            hash.feed(&x.to_le_bytes());
            hash.feed(&y.to_le_bytes());
            hash.feed(&z.to_le_bytes());
        }
    }
}

struct StableAddressHash {
    first: u64,
    second: u64,
}

impl StableAddressHash {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            first: 0xCBF2_9CE4_8422_2325,
            second: 0x8422_2325_CBF2_9CE4,
        }
    }

    fn feed(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        for byte in bytes {
            self.first = (self.first ^ u64::from(*byte)).wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01B3);
            self.second = (self.second ^ u64::from(*byte ^ 0xA5))
                .rotate_left(13)
                .wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B1_85EB_CA87);
        }
    }

    fn finish(self) -> [u32; 4] {
        let first = avalanche(self.first);
        let second = avalanche(self.second ^ first.rotate_left(17));
        [
            first as u32,
            (first >> 32) as u32,
            second as u32,
            (second >> 32) as u32,
        ]
    }
}

fn avalanche(mut value: u64) -> u64 {
    value ^= value >> 30;
    value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
    value ^= value >> 27;
    value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
    value ^ (value >> 31)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/sector_geometry.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="203" bytes="7100" original_lines="203" original_bytes="7100" minified="false" sha256="db03e21f8222c0eb1e432b387afc0e65c7746ddb63c3394fb18eb8b2967e634c">>>
use crate::sector_neighborhood::DUNGEON_SECTOR_EDGE;
use minimium_world::world::{
    MapBox, MapTriangle, PlanetFace, PlanetSectorKey, SectorKey, WorldMap, WorldTopology,
    PLANET_SECTORS_PER_FACE,
};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct SectorGeometry {
    pub boxes: Vec<MapBox>,
    pub triangles: Vec<MapTriangle>,
}

/// Slices render and collision geometry using the shared planet or dungeon
/// sector address contract.
pub fn slice_sector_geometry(
    map: &WorldMap,
    topology: WorldTopology,
    key: SectorKey,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    slice_sector_geometry_with_count(map, topology, key, PLANET_SECTORS_PER_FACE)
}

fn slice_sector_geometry_with_count(
    map: &WorldMap,
    topology: WorldTopology,
    key: SectorKey,
    count: u16,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    let mut geometry = SectorGeometry::default();
    for map_box in map.boxes() {
        let included = match (topology, key) {
            (WorldTopology::Planet, SectorKey::Planet(sector)) => {
                planet_box_touches(*map_box, sector, count)
            }
            (WorldTopology::Dungeon, SectorKey::Dungeon(sector)) => {
                dungeon_box_overlaps(*map_box, sector.coordinates())
            }
            _ => false,
        };
        if included {
            geometry.boxes.push(*map_box);
        }
    }
    for triangle in map.triangles() {
        let included = match (topology, key) {
            (WorldTopology::Planet, SectorKey::Planet(sector)) => {
                planet_triangle_touches(*triangle, sector, count)
            }
            (WorldTopology::Dungeon, SectorKey::Dungeon(sector)) => {
                dungeon_triangle_touches(*triangle, sector.coordinates())
            }
            _ => false,
        };
        if included {
            geometry.triangles.push(*triangle);
        }
    }
    geometry
}

/// Shared server/client source for the current manifest's sector geometry.
pub fn materialize_world_sector(
    map: &WorldMap,
    manifest: minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    key: SectorKey,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    materialize_world_sector_with_geography(map, manifest, key, None)
}

pub fn materialize_world_sector_with_geography(
    map: &WorldMap,
    manifest: minimium_world::world::WorldManifest,
    key: SectorKey,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn crate::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    let mut geometry = slice_sector_geometry_with_count(
        map,
        manifest.topology(),
        key,
        crate::planet_sector_count(manifest),
    );
    if let (WorldTopology::Planet, SectorKey::Planet(planet)) = (manifest.topology(), key) {
        geometry.triangles.extend(
            crate::generate_planet_sector_with_geography(manifest, planet, geography).triangles,
        );
    }
    geometry
}

fn planet_box_touches(map_box: MapBox, sector: PlanetSectorKey, count: u16) -> bool {
    let half = map_box.size.map(|value| value.abs() * 0.5);
    let mut directions = Vec::with_capacity(9);
    directions.push(map_box.center);
    for x in [-half[0], half[0]] {
        for y in [-half[1], half[1]] {
            for z in [-half[2], half[2]] {
                directions.push([
                    map_box.center[0] + x,
                    map_box.center[1] + y,
                    map_box.center[2] + z,
                ]);
            }
        }
    }
    directions.into_iter().any(|direction| {
        let sample = PlanetSectorKey::from_direction_with_count(direction, count);
        sample == sector || sample.neighbors_with_count(count).contains(&sector)
    })
}

fn planet_triangle_touches(triangle: MapTriangle, sector: PlanetSectorKey, count: u16) -> bool {
    let centroid = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
        triangle
            .vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|point| point[axis])
            .sum::<f32>()
            / 3.0
    });
    let face = PlanetSectorKey::from_direction_with_count(centroid, count).face();
    if sector.face() != face {
        return false;
    }

    let (normal, u_axis, v_axis) = planet_face_basis(face);
    let component = |point: [f32; 3], axis: [i8; 3]| {
        point[0] * f32::from(axis[0])
            + point[1] * f32::from(axis[1])
            + point[2] * f32::from(axis[2])
    };
    let mut minimum = [f32::INFINITY; 2];
    let mut maximum = [f32::NEG_INFINITY; 2];
    for point in triangle.vertices {
        let denominator = component(point, normal);
        if denominator <= f32::EPSILON {
            return false;
        }
        for (axis, basis) in [u_axis, v_axis].into_iter().enumerate() {
            let coordinate = component(point, basis) / denominator;
            minimum[axis] = minimum[axis].min(coordinate);
            maximum[axis] = maximum[axis].max(coordinate);
        }
    }
    let (u, v) = sector.coordinates();
    overlaps_planet_interval(minimum[0], maximum[0], u, count)
        && overlaps_planet_interval(minimum[1], maximum[1], v, count)
}

fn planet_face_basis(face: PlanetFace) -> ([i8; 3], [i8; 3], [i8; 3]) {
    match face {
        PlanetFace::PositiveX => ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]),
        PlanetFace::NegativeX => ([-1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]),
        PlanetFace::PositiveY => ([0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1]),
        PlanetFace::NegativeY => ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1]),
        PlanetFace::PositiveZ => ([0, 0, 1], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
        PlanetFace::NegativeZ => ([0, 0, -1], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
    }
}

fn overlaps_planet_interval(minimum: f32, maximum: f32, sector: u16, count: u16) -> bool {
    let count = f32::from(count);
    let start = -1.0 + 2.0 * f32::from(sector) / count;
    let end = start + 2.0 / count;
    minimum <= end && maximum >= start
}

fn dungeon_box_overlaps(map_box: MapBox, (sector_x, sector_y, sector_z): (i32, i32, i32)) -> bool {
    let half = map_box.size.map(|value| value * 0.5);
    let center = map_box.center;
    overlaps_interval(center[0] - half[0], center[0] + half[0], sector_x)
        && overlaps_interval(center[1] - half[1], center[1] + half[1], sector_y)
        && overlaps_interval(center[2] - half[2], center[2] + half[2], sector_z)
}

fn dungeon_triangle_touches(
    triangle: MapTriangle,
    (sector_x, sector_y, sector_z): (i32, i32, i32),
) -> bool {
    let minimum = std::array::from_fn::<_, 3, _>(|axis| {
        triangle
            .vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|point| point[axis])
            .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min)
    });
    let maximum = std::array::from_fn::<_, 3, _>(|axis| {
        triangle
            .vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|point| point[axis])
            .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max)
    });
    overlaps_interval(minimum[0], maximum[0], sector_x)
        && overlaps_interval(minimum[1], maximum[1], sector_y)
        && overlaps_interval(minimum[2], maximum[2], sector_z)
}

fn overlaps_interval(minimum: f32, maximum: f32, sector: i32) -> bool {
    let edge = f32::from(DUNGEON_SECTOR_EDGE);
    let start = sector as f32 * edge;
    minimum <= start + edge && maximum >= start
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/sector_neighborhood.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="55" bytes="2175" original_lines="55" original_bytes="2175" minified="false" sha256="c40d77bfb1a223ffce43fc4e554a30258cbfe093fa5b2e38cbb93e0909d9f707">>>
use minimium_world::world::{
    PlanetSectorKey, SectorKey, WorldManifest, WorldTopology, PLANET_SECTORS_PER_FACE,
};

pub const DUNGEON_SECTOR_EDGE: u16 = 16;

/// Returns the server/client collision neighborhood for a topology.
pub fn sector_neighborhood(topology: WorldTopology, position: [f32; 3]) -> Vec<SectorKey> {
    neighborhood(topology, position, PLANET_SECTORS_PER_FACE)
}

pub fn sector_neighborhood_for(manifest: WorldManifest, position: [f32; 3]) -> Vec<SectorKey> {
    neighborhood(
        manifest.topology(),
        position,
        crate::planet_sector_count(manifest),
    )
}

fn neighborhood(topology: WorldTopology, position: [f32; 3], count: u16) -> Vec<SectorKey> {
    match topology {
        WorldTopology::Planet => {
            let center = PlanetSectorKey::from_direction_with_count(position, count);
            let sector_key = |sector: PlanetSectorKey| {
                let (u, v) = sector.coordinates();
                SectorKey::planet(sector.face(), u, v).expect("neighbor sector is valid")
            };
            let mut keys = Vec::with_capacity(21);
            for key in std::iter::once(center).chain(center.neighbors_with_count(count)) {
                if !keys.contains(&sector_key(key)) {
                    keys.push(sector_key(key));
                }
                for neighbor in key.neighbors_with_count(count) {
                    if !keys.contains(&sector_key(neighbor)) {
                        keys.push(sector_key(neighbor));
                    }
                }
            }
            keys
        }
        WorldTopology::Dungeon => {
            let edge = f32::from(DUNGEON_SECTOR_EDGE);
            let x = (position[0] / edge).floor() as i32;
            let y = (position[1] / edge).floor() as i32;
            let z = (position[2] / edge).floor() as i32;
            let mut keys = Vec::with_capacity(9);
            for offset_x in -1..=1 {
                for offset_z in -1..=1 {
                    keys.push(SectorKey::dungeon(x + offset_x, y, z + offset_z));
                }
            }
            keys
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/surface_habitat.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="50" bytes="1661" original_lines="50" original_bytes="1661" minified="false" sha256="de40286f5d4fda50a2adb5d610d7f1d230a65901d774f20b570012dc6fb8370f">>>
//! Presentation landforms. No erosion simulation, mutable state or geometry edits.
pub const SURFACE_RECIPE_REVISION: u32 = 2;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct SurfaceRecipe {
    pub landform_radius_m: f64,
    pub retention_strength: f32,
    pub exposure_strength: f32,
}

impl Default for SurfaceRecipe {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            landform_radius_m: 256.0,
            retention_strength: 0.65,
            exposure_strength: 0.45,
        }
    }
}

impl SurfaceRecipe {
    pub fn valid(self) -> bool {
        self.landform_radius_m.is_finite()
            && (4.0..=4096.0).contains(&self.landform_radius_m)
            && (0.0..=1.0).contains(&self.retention_strength)
            && (0.0..=1.0).contains(&self.exposure_strength)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Landform {
    pub retention: f32,
    pub exposure: f32,
}

impl Landform {
    pub fn from_heights(center: f64, ring: [f64; 4], slope: f32, recipe: SurfaceRecipe) -> Self {
        let average = ring.iter().sum::<f64>() * 0.25;
        let range = ring.iter().copied().fold(center, f64::max)
            - ring.iter().copied().fold(center, f64::min);
        // The minimum relief suppresses quantisation in almost flat source data.
        let concavity = ((average - center) / range.max(2.0)).clamp(-1.0, 1.0) as f32;
        let steep = (slope / 0.25).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        Self {
            retention: (0.45 + concavity * recipe.retention_strength - steep * 0.35)
                .clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            exposure: (0.2 - concavity * recipe.exposure_strength + steep * 0.65).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/terrain_color.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="31" bytes="1043" original_lines="31" original_bytes="1043" minified="false" sha256="75968c699673f6ac7573d1013847eb61b4493812a9661e9181d79f63f57ee2dd">>>
/// Broad terrain palette; elevation is measured above the configured sea level.
pub(crate) fn terrain_color(elevation_mm: i64, ocean: bool) -> [f32; 3] {
    if ocean {
        return [0.055, 0.20, 0.43];
    }
    let metres = elevation_mm as f32 / 1000.0;
    let stops = [
        (0.0, [0.53, 0.49, 0.31]),
        (20.0, [0.20, 0.43, 0.19]),
        (70.0, [0.28, 0.39, 0.21]),
        (130.0, [0.45, 0.41, 0.34]),
        (220.0, [0.65, 0.64, 0.61]),
        (320.0, [0.92, 0.92, 0.90]),
    ];
    if metres <= stops[0].0 {
        return stops[0].1;
    }
    for pair in stops.windows(2) {
        if metres <= pair[1].0 {
            let blend = (metres - pair[0].0) / (pair[1].0 - pair[0].0);
            return std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                pair[0].1[axis] * (1.0 - blend) + pair[1].1[axis] * blend
            });
        }
    }
    stops[stops.len() - 1].1
}

pub(crate) fn mostly_ocean(samples: [bool; 3]) -> bool {
    samples.into_iter().filter(|sample| *sample).count() >= 2
}

<<<FILE path="crates/procgen/src/terrain_surface.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="176" bytes="6497" original_lines="176" original_bytes="6497" minified="false" sha256="9cf3202f9d38d2eb93ebaedadeff5d7300507b13297a9dc7bd77b97805c99021">>>
//! Presentation sampling; does not alter generated geometry or fingerprints.
use crate::PlanetTerrain;
use minimium_world::world::{CubeSampleKey, PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE};

/// Sand, soil, grass, litter, rock, snow. These are fractions, never RGB labels.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TerrainSurfaceSample {
    pub elevation_m: f32,
    /// Physical source metres, independently of the displayed planet radius.
    pub source_elevation_m: f32,
    pub landform: crate::surface_habitat::Landform,
    pub mapped_coverage: bool,
    pub slope: f32,
    pub water: f32,
    pub normal: [f32; 3],
    pub coverage: [f32; 6],
}

impl PlanetTerrain {
    pub fn surface_sample(&self, direction: [f64; 3]) -> TerrainSurfaceSample {
        let n = normalize(direction);
        let east = normalize(if n[1].abs() < 0.9 {
            cross([0.0, 1.0, 0.0], n)
        } else {
            cross([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], n)
        });
        let north = cross(n, east);
        // Constant world-space derivative radius shared by every sector and LOD.
        let epsilon =
            (2000.0 / self.radius_mm() as f64).max(4.0 / f64::from(PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE));
        let point = self.ground_sample(key(n));
        let height = |d| self.ground_sample(key(d)).height_mm as f64 / 1000.0;
        let derivative = |axis: [f64; 3]| {
            let plus = normalize(std::array::from_fn(|i| n[i] + axis[i] * epsilon));
            let minus = normalize(std::array::from_fn(|i| n[i] - axis[i] * epsilon));
            (height(plus) - height(minus)) / (2.0 * epsilon * self.radius_mm() as f64 / 1000.0)
        };
        let de = derivative(east);
        let dn = derivative(north);
        let normal = normalize(std::array::from_fn(|i| n[i] - east[i] * de - north[i] * dn));
        let slope = (1.0 - dot(normal, n)).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
        let elevation_m = (point.height_mm as i64 - self.radius_mm() as i64 - self.sea_level_mm())
            as f32
            / 1000.0;
        let radius_m = self.radius_mm() as f64 / 1000.0;
        let angle = (self.surface_recipe.landform_radius_m / radius_m).min(0.05);
        let offset = |axis: [f64; 3], sign: f64| {
            height(normalize(std::array::from_fn(|i| {
                n[i] + axis[i] * angle * sign
            })))
        };
        let landform = crate::surface_habitat::Landform::from_heights(
            point.height_mm as f64 / 1000.0,
            [
                offset(east, 1.0),
                offset(east, -1.0),
                offset(north, 1.0),
                offset(north, -1.0),
            ],
            slope,
            self.surface_recipe,
        );
        let sand = (-elevation_m.max(0.0) / 8.0).exp() * (1.0 - slope);
        let rock = ((slope - 0.08) / 0.35).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        // Broad fallback when WorldCover is absent: arid belts and alpine terrain
        // must not inherit the same grass fraction as humid lowlands.
        let latitude = n[1].asin().abs() as f32;
        let dry_belt = (-((latitude - 0.5) / 0.18).powi(2)).exp();
        let physical_height = if self.has_peak_relief() {
            self.source_elevation_m(n)
                .expect("prepared Earth source elevation") as f32
        } else {
            elevation_m / self.presentation_height_scale()
        };
        let temperature = minimium_environment::climate::annual_temperature_c(n[1].asin()) as f32
            - physical_height.max(0.0) * 0.0065;
        let vegetation = ((temperature + 5.0) / 24.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - dry_belt * 0.9);
        let mut coverage = [
            sand + dry_belt * 0.65,
            0.22 + (1.0 - vegetation) * 0.45,
            vegetation * 0.65,
            vegetation * 0.25,
            rock * 3.0 + ((physical_height - 1800.0) / 1800.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 0.5,
            0.0,
        ];
        let mapped = self.land_cover(n);
        if let Some(base) = mapped {
            coverage = base;
            for weight in &mut coverage {
                *weight *= 1.0 - rock;
            }
            coverage[4] += rock;
            coverage[0] += sand * 0.2;
        }
        // Loose material is retained in hollows; exposed convex ground shows rock.
        let exposed = landform.exposure * 0.35;
        let loose = coverage[0] + coverage[1];
        let deposit = coverage[0] * landform.retention * 0.25;
        coverage[0] -= deposit;
        coverage[1] += deposit;
        for weight in &mut coverage[..4] {
            *weight *= 1.0 - exposed;
        }
        coverage[4] += loose * exposed;
        let total: f32 = coverage.iter().sum();
        for weight in &mut coverage {
            *weight /= total;
        }
        TerrainSurfaceSample {
            elevation_m,
            source_elevation_m: physical_height,
            landform,
            mapped_coverage: mapped.is_some(),
            slope,
            water: f32::from(point.ocean),
            normal: normal.map(|v| v as f32),
            coverage,
        }
    }
}

pub fn key(direction: [f64; 3]) -> CubeSampleKey {
    let maximum = direction.iter().map(|v| v.abs()).fold(0.0_f64, f64::max);
    let coordinates =
        direction.map(|v| (v / maximum * f64::from(PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE)).round() as i32);
    use minimium_world::world::PlanetFace;
    let [x, y, z] = coordinates;
    let scale = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
    let (face, u, v) = if x.abs() == scale {
        (
            if x > 0 {
                PlanetFace::PositiveX
            } else {
                PlanetFace::NegativeX
            },
            y,
            z,
        )
    } else if y.abs() == scale {
        (
            if y > 0 {
                PlanetFace::PositiveY
            } else {
                PlanetFace::NegativeY
            },
            x,
            z,
        )
    } else {
        (
            if z > 0 {
                PlanetFace::PositiveZ
            } else {
                PlanetFace::NegativeZ
            },
            x,
            y,
        )
    };
    face.cube_sample(u, v).expect("normalized cube surface")
}

fn normalize(p: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    let length = dot(p, p).sqrt().max(1e-20);
    p.map(|v| v / length)
}
fn dot(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    a.iter().zip(b).map(|(a, b)| a * b).sum()
}
fn cross(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [
        a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
        a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
        a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
    ]
}

#[test]
fn philox_matches_the_reference_zero_vector() {
    assert_eq!(
        philox4x32_10([0, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0]),
        [0x6627_e8d5, 0xe169_c58d, 0xbc57_ac4c, 0x9b00_dbd8]

#[test]
fn addressed_samples_are_seekable_and_separated_by_channel() {
    let spec = generation(0x1234_5678_9abc_def0);
    let key = SectorKey::planet(PlanetFace::PositiveY, 17, 23).unwrap();
    let terrain = AddressedRandom::new(spec, GenerationChannel::Terrain, key);
    let objects = AddressedRandom::new(spec, GenerationChannel::Objects, key);
    let forward = [0, 1, 2, 3, 9, 24].map(|index| terrain.sample_u32(index));
    let reverse = [24, 9, 3, 2, 1, 0]
        .map(|index| terrain.sample_u32(index))
        .into_iter()
        .rev()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    assert_eq!(forward.as_slice(), reverse);
    assert_ne!(forward[0], objects.sample_u32(0));
    assert_eq!(
        terrain.object_origin(5),
        AddressedRandom::new(spec, GenerationChannel::Terrain, key).object_origin(5)
    );
}

#[test]
fn every_cube_face_edge_has_matching_canonical_samples() {
    let edges = [
        (PlanetEdge::UNegative, 0_u16, 100_u16, 0_u32),
        (PlanetEdge::UPositive, 255, 100, 8),
        (PlanetEdge::VNegative, 100, 0, 1),
        (PlanetEdge::VPositive, 100, 255, 1),
    ];
    for face in PlanetFace::ALL {
        for (edge, u, v, local_edge) in edges {
            let key = PlanetSectorKey::new(face, u, v).unwrap();
            let neighbor = key.neighbor(edge);
            let reciprocal = [
                PlanetEdge::UNegative,
                PlanetEdge::UPositive,
                PlanetEdge::VNegative,
                PlanetEdge::VPositive,
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .find(|candidate| neighbor.neighbor(*candidate) == key)
            .expect("cube face edge has a reciprocal neighbor");
            let samples = |sector: PlanetSectorKey, edge: PlanetEdge| {
                (0..=8)
                    .map(|step| match edge {
                        PlanetEdge::UNegative => sector.cube_sample(0, step, 8),
                        PlanetEdge::UPositive => sector.cube_sample(8, step, 8),
                        PlanetEdge::VNegative => sector.cube_sample(step, 0, 8),
                        PlanetEdge::VPositive => sector.cube_sample(step, 8, 8),
                    })
                    .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
                    .unwrap()
            };
            let own_edge = match edge {
                PlanetEdge::UNegative | PlanetEdge::UPositive => {
                    if local_edge == 0 {
                        PlanetEdge::UNegative
                    } else {
                        PlanetEdge::UPositive
                    }
                }
                PlanetEdge::VNegative | PlanetEdge::VPositive => {
                    if v == 0 {
                        PlanetEdge::VNegative
                    } else {
                        PlanetEdge::VPositive
                    }
                }
            };
            let own = samples(key, own_edge).into_iter().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
            let other = samples(neighbor, reciprocal)
                .into_iter()
                .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
            assert_eq!(own, other, "{face:?} {edge:?}");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn planet_route_is_quantized_traversable_and_has_bounded_height_steps() {
    let surface = PlanetSurfaceSpec::new(100_000, 300).unwrap();
    let terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(generation(42), surface).unwrap();
    let landmarks = terrain.landmarks();
    let map = materialize_planet_map(terrain, landmarks).unwrap();
    assert!(
        map.can_place_player_with_gravity(
            map.spawn(),
            CharacterGravity::Radial { center: [0.0; 3] },
        )
    );

    for point in landmarks.approach {
        assert!(point
            .position_mm
            .coordinates()
            .iter()
            .all(|value| *value % 10 == 0));
        assert!((99_700..=100_300).contains(&point.height_mm));
    }
    for pair in landmarks.approach.windows(2) {
        let height_step = pair[1].height_mm.abs_diff(pair[0].height_mm);
        assert!(
            height_step <= surface.relief_mm() / 2,
            "height step was {height_step}mm"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn dungeon_materialization_preserves_tiles_across_sector_boundaries() {
    let spec = DungeonSpec::new(48, 40, 4, 5, 1).unwrap();
    let blueprint = generate_dungeon(generation(77), spec);
    let repeated = generate_dungeon(generation(77), spec);
    assert_eq!(blueprint.dimensions(), (48, 40));
    assert!(blueprint.rooms().len() >= 3);
    assert_eq!(blueprint.spawn(), repeated.spawn());
    assert_eq!(blueprint.entrance(), repeated.entrance());

    for z in 0..40_u16 {
        for x in 0..48_u16 {
            let key = minimium_world::world::DungeonSectorKey::new(
                i32::from(x / 16),
                0,
                i32::from(z / 16),
            );
            let sector = materialize_dungeon_sector(&blueprint, key).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                sector.tile(x % 16, z % 16),
                blueprint.tile(x, z),
                "tile {x},{z}"
            );
            assert_eq!(blueprint.tile(x, z), repeated.tile(x, z));
        }
    }
}

use minimium_world::world::{PlanetKind, Position3Mm, WorldManifest, WorldTopology};

/// Applies the shared surface movement policy for a world manifest.
///
/// Worlds without an explicit Earth definition keep their existing movement
/// rules. Millimetre positions are converted to metres only at the adapter
/// boundary required by the existing Earth elevation function.
pub fn can_traverse_surface(
    manifest: WorldManifest,
    position_mm: Position3Mm,
    geography: Option<&dyn crate::PreparedGeography>,
) -> bool {
    let Some(planet) = manifest.planet() else {
        return true;
    };
    if manifest.topology() != WorldTopology::Planet || planet.kind() != PlanetKind::Earth {
        return true;
    }
    let position_m = position_mm.0.map(|value| (value as f64 / 1000.0) as f32);
    geography
        .and_then(|geography| geography.elevation_m(position_m.map(f64::from)).ok())
        .is_some_and(|elevation_m| {
            planet.earth_elevation_mm(elevation_m).round() as i64 >= planet.sea_level_mm
        })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/content_codec.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="65" bytes="2054" original_lines="65" original_bytes="2054" minified="false" sha256="531af1cd458e4dba9aa9f156f1e55479bf8fa26ccf27d3778ad063ce917500c9">>>
use crate::{reading::Reader, ProtocolError};
use minimium_environment::climate::{ClimateOffset, ClimateRegion, ClimateScenario};

pub(crate) fn write(scenario: &ClimateScenario, out: &mut Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    scenario
        .validate()
        .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    for value in [
        scenario.start_utc,
        scenario.end_utc,
        scenario.global.temperature_c,
        scenario.global.moisture,
        scenario.relief_influence,
    ] {
        out.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }
    out.push(scenario.regions.len() as u8);
    for region in &scenario.regions {
        for value in [
            region.center[0],
            region.center[1],
            region.center[2],
            region.radius_radians,
            region.offset.temperature_c,
            region.offset.moisture,
        ] {
            out.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn read(reader: &mut Reader<'_>) -> Result<ClimateScenario, ProtocolError> {
    let float = |reader: &mut Reader<'_>| -> Result<f64, ProtocolError> {
        Ok(f64::from_le_bytes(reader.fixed()?))
    };
    let mut scenario = ClimateScenario {
        start_utc: float(reader)?,
        end_utc: float(reader)?,
        global: ClimateOffset {
            temperature_c: float(reader)?,
            moisture: float(reader)?,
        },
        relief_influence: float(reader)?,
        regions: Vec::new(),
    };
    let count = reader.byte()?;
    if count > 32 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    for _ in 0..count {
        scenario.regions.push(ClimateRegion {
            center: [float(reader)?, float(reader)?, float(reader)?],
            radius_radians: float(reader)?,
            offset: ClimateOffset {
                temperature_c: float(reader)?,
                moisture: float(reader)?,
            },
        });
    }
    scenario
        .validate()
        .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    Ok(scenario)
}
