<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/decoding/client.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="87" bytes="3833" original_lines="87" original_bytes="3833" minified="false" sha256="629df9b8a0c9c5d1285a20d552ed35b9f62ba44b7c059b3dd0bf0845294f14cb">>>
use crate::{
    framing::decode_frame,
    kinds::ClientKind,
    models::{ClientMessage, ClientWorldInput, ProtocolError},
    reading::Reader,
    validation::is_unit_direction,
};

pub fn decode_client(input: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<(ClientMessage, usize)>, ProtocolError> {
    let Some((kind, payload, frame_bytes)) = decode_frame(input)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let mut reader = Reader::new(payload);
    let message = match ClientKind::try_from(kind)? {
        ClientKind::Presentation => ClientMessage::Presentation(match reader.byte()? {
            0 => None,
            1 => Some(true),
            2 => Some(false),
            _ => return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload),
        }),
        ClientKind::ContentReady => ClientMessage::ContentReady(reader.fixed()?),
        ClientKind::Identify => ClientMessage::Identify(reader.profile_id()?),
        ClientKind::Ping => ClientMessage::Ping,
        ClientKind::SetName => ClientMessage::SetName(reader.name()?),
        ClientKind::Move => ClientMessage::Move {
            direction: reader.direction()?,
            jump: reader.boolean()?,
        },
        ClientKind::Fire => {
            let direction = reader.vector()?;
            if !is_unit_direction(direction) {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            ClientMessage::Fire { direction }
        }
        ClientKind::Chat => ClientMessage::Chat(reader.chat_text()?.to_owned()),
        ClientKind::WorldInput => {
            let context = reader.world_context()?;
            let input = match reader.byte()? {
                1 => ClientWorldInput::SetName(reader.name()?),
                2 => ClientWorldInput::Move {
                    direction: reader.direction()?,
                    jump: reader.boolean()?,
                },
                3 => {
                    let direction = reader.vector()?;
                    if !is_unit_direction(direction) {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                    }
                    ClientWorldInput::Fire { direction }
                }
                4 => ClientWorldInput::Chat(reader.chat_text()?.to_owned()),
                5 => ClientWorldInput::UsePortal,
                6 => {
                    let direction = reader.vector()?;
                    if !is_unit_direction(direction) {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                    }
                    ClientWorldInput::MapTeleport { direction }
                }
                8 => {
                    let km = f32::from_le_bytes(reader.fixed()?);
                    if !km.is_finite() || !(0.0..=10000.0).contains(&km) {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                    }
                    ClientWorldInput::SetAltitude { km }
                }
                7 => ClientWorldInput::Motion(crate::movement_codec::read(&mut reader)?),
                _ => return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload),
            };
            ClientMessage::WorldInput { context, input }
        }
        ClientKind::TransitionReady => ClientMessage::TransitionReady {
            transition_id: reader.transition_id()?,
            target_context: reader.world_context()?,
        },
        ClientKind::UsePortal => ClientMessage::UsePortal,
        ClientKind::CancelTransition => ClientMessage::CancelTransition(reader.transition_id()?),
        ClientKind::TimeProbe => ClientMessage::TimeProbe {
            seq: reader.u32()?,
            client_send_monotonic_ms: reader.u64()?,
        },
        ClientKind::Quit => ClientMessage::Quit,
    };
    reader.finish()?;
    Ok(Some((message, frame_bytes)))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/decoding/server.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="246" bytes="9646" original_lines="246" original_bytes="9646" minified="false" sha256="eed6c17b56883da217cae5884e28c60c637614bcdbf2ac2f63bf3f2dc4af10b0">>>
use crate::{
    environment_codec,
    framing::decode_frame,
    kinds::ServerKind,
    limits::*,
    models::{ProtocolError, RemotePlayer, RemotePlayerIds, RemotePlayers, ServerMessage},
    reading::Reader,
};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;

pub fn decode_server(input: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<(ServerMessage, usize)>, ProtocolError> {
    let Some((kind, payload, frame_bytes)) = decode_frame(input)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let mut reader = Reader::new(payload);
    let message = match ServerKind::try_from(kind)? {
        ServerKind::ContentOffer => ServerMessage::ContentOffer {
            material_hash: reader.fixed()?,
            http_port: reader.u16()?,
            climate: crate::content_codec::read(&mut reader)?,
        },
        ServerKind::Welcome => {
            let id = PlayerId::new(reader.u64()?);
            let map_fingerprint = reader.u64()?;
            let health = reader.u16()?;
            let position_mm = reader.position_mm()?;
            let position = position_mm.0.map(|coordinate| coordinate as f32 / 1000.0);
            if health > 100 {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            let context = reader.world_context()?;
            let manifest = reader.world_manifest()?;
            let transition_id = if reader.boolean()? {
                Some(reader.transition_id()?)
            } else {
                None
            };
            let (clock_sample, environment) = environment_codec::read_pair(&mut reader)?;
            ServerMessage::Welcome {
                id,
                map_fingerprint,
                health,
                position,
                position_mm,
                context,
                manifest,
                transition_id,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::AltitudeResult => {
            let context = reader.world_context()?;
            let position_mm = if reader.boolean()? {
                Some(reader.position_mm()?)
            } else {
                None
            };
            ServerMessage::AltitudeResult {
                context,
                position_mm,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::Pong => ServerMessage::Pong,
        ServerKind::MapTeleportResult => {
            let position_mm = if reader.boolean()? {
                Some(reader.position_mm()?)
            } else {
                None
            };
            ServerMessage::MapTeleportResult { position_mm }
        }
        ServerKind::Accepted => ServerMessage::Accepted,
        ServerKind::Bye => ServerMessage::Bye,
        ServerKind::Error => ServerMessage::Error(reader.byte()?.into()),
        ServerKind::ShotResult => {
            let hit = reader.boolean()?;
            let (target_id, remaining_health) = if hit {
                let id = PlayerId::new(reader.u64()?);
                let health = reader.u16()?;
                if health > 100 {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                (Some(id), Some(health))
            } else {
                (None, None)
            };
            let killed = reader.boolean()?;
            if killed && !hit {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            ServerMessage::ShotResult {
                target_id,
                remaining_health,
                killed,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::HealthUpdate => {
            let health = reader.u16()?;
            if health > 100 {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            ServerMessage::HealthUpdate(health)
        }
        ServerKind::Chat => ServerMessage::Chat {
            sender_id: PlayerId::new(reader.u64()?),
            sender_name: reader.name()?,
            text: reader.chat_text()?.to_owned(),
        },
        ServerKind::Snapshot => {
            let server_time_ms = reader.u64()?;
            let context = reader.world_context()?;
            let self_position_mm = reader.position_mm()?;
            let self_position = self_position_mm
                .0
                .map(|coordinate| coordinate as f32 / 1000.0);
            let self_velocity = reader.vector()?;
            let self_grounded = reader.boolean()?;
            let full_snapshot = reader.boolean()?;
            let count = reader.byte()? as usize;
            let removed_count = reader.byte()? as usize;
            if count > MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS
                || removed_count > MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS
                || (full_snapshot && removed_count > 0)
            {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            let mut players = RemotePlayers::default();
            for _ in 0..count {
                let id = PlayerId::new(reader.u64()?);
                let name = reader.shared_name()?;
                let position_mm = reader.position_mm()?;
                if !players.push(RemotePlayer {
                    id,
                    name,
                    position: position_mm.0.map(|coordinate| coordinate as f32 / 1000.0),
                    position_mm,
                }) {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
            }
            let mut removed_players = RemotePlayerIds::default();
            for _ in 0..removed_count {
                if !removed_players.push(PlayerId::new(reader.u64()?)) {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
            }
            if players
                .iter()
                .any(|player| removed_players.contains(player.id))
            {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            ServerMessage::Snapshot {
                server_time_ms,
                context,
                full_snapshot,
                self_position,
                self_position_mm,
                self_velocity,
                self_grounded,
                players: Box::new(players),
                removed_players,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::TransitionPrepare => {
            let transition_id = reader.transition_id()?;
            let source_context = reader.world_context()?;
            let target_context = reader.world_context()?;
            let map_fingerprint = reader.u64()?;
            let destination_mm = reader.position_mm()?;
            let manifest = reader.world_manifest()?;
            let (clock_sample, environment) = environment_codec::read_pair(&mut reader)?;
            ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare {
                transition_id,
                source_context,
                target_context,
                map_fingerprint,
                destination: destination_mm
                    .0
                    .map(|coordinate| coordinate as f32 / 1000.0),
                destination_mm,
                manifest,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::TransitionCommitted => {
            let transition_id = reader.transition_id()?;
            let context = reader.world_context()?;
            let map_fingerprint = reader.u64()?;
            let destination_mm = reader.position_mm()?;
            let destination = destination_mm
                .0
                .map(|coordinate| coordinate as f32 / 1000.0);
            let health = reader.u16()?;
            if health > 100 {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            let manifest = reader.world_manifest()?;
            let (clock_sample, environment) = environment_codec::read_pair(&mut reader)?;
            ServerMessage::TransitionCommitted {
                transition_id,
                context,
                map_fingerprint,
                destination,
                destination_mm,
                health,
                manifest,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::EnvironmentSync => {
            let context = reader.world_context()?;
            let (clock_sample, environment) = environment_codec::read_pair(&mut reader)?;
            ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync {
                context,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            }
        }
        ServerKind::TimeProbeReply => {
            let seq = reader.u32()?;
            let echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms = reader.u64()?;
            let server_receive_monotonic_ms = reader.u64()?;
            let server_send_monotonic_ms = reader.u64()?;
            if server_send_monotonic_ms < server_receive_monotonic_ms {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
            ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply {
                seq,
                echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms,
                server_receive_monotonic_ms,
                server_send_monotonic_ms,
                session_nonce: minimium_environment::time::SessionNonce::new(reader.fixed()?),
            }
        }
        ServerKind::TransitionCancelled => ServerMessage::TransitionCancelled {
            transition_id: reader.transition_id()?,
            context: reader.world_context()?,
        },
    };
    reader.finish()?;
    Ok(Some((message, frame_bytes)))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/encoding/client.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="136" bytes="5247" original_lines="136" original_bytes="5247" minified="false" sha256="c8e015205a0a670b23bfe7c01c8eb7fef6ce7d31481dc3530336f530c49f615d">>>
use super::common::{write_chat_text, write_name, write_vector, write_world_context};
use crate::{
    framing::encode_frame,
    kinds::ClientKind,
    models::{ClientMessage, ClientWorldInput, ProtocolError},
    validation::{is_unit_direction, valid_direction_component},
};

pub fn encode_client(message: &ClientMessage) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ProtocolError> {
    let mut payload = Vec::with_capacity(16);
    let kind = match message {
        ClientMessage::Presentation(presentation) => {
            payload.push(match presentation {
                None => 0,
                Some(true) => 1,
                Some(false) => 2,
            });
            ClientKind::Presentation
        }
        ClientMessage::ContentReady(hash) => {
            payload.extend_from_slice(hash);
            ClientKind::ContentReady
        }
        ClientMessage::Identify(profile_id) => {
            payload.extend_from_slice(profile_id.as_bytes());
            ClientKind::Identify
        }
        ClientMessage::Motion(_) => return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload),
        ClientMessage::Ping => ClientKind::Ping,
        ClientMessage::SetName(name) => {
            write_name(name, &mut payload)?;
            ClientKind::SetName
        }
        ClientMessage::Move { direction, jump } => {
            write_direction(*direction, &mut payload)?;
            payload.push(u8::from(*jump));
            ClientKind::Move
        }
        ClientMessage::Fire { direction } => {
            write_unit_direction(*direction, &mut payload)?;
            ClientKind::Fire
        }
        ClientMessage::SetAltitude { .. } | ClientMessage::MapTeleport { .. } => {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)
        }
        ClientMessage::Chat(text) => {
            write_chat_text(text, &mut payload)?;
            ClientKind::Chat
        }
        ClientMessage::WorldInput { context, input } => {
            write_world_context(*context, &mut payload);
            match input {
                ClientWorldInput::Motion(input) => {
                    payload.push(7);
                    crate::movement_codec::write(*input, &mut payload)?;
                }
                ClientWorldInput::SetName(name) => {
                    payload.push(1);
                    write_name(name, &mut payload)?;
                }
                ClientWorldInput::Move { direction, jump } => {
                    payload.push(2);
                    write_direction(*direction, &mut payload)?;
                    payload.push(u8::from(*jump));
                }
                ClientWorldInput::Fire { direction } => {
                    payload.push(3);
                    write_unit_direction(*direction, &mut payload)?;
                }
                ClientWorldInput::Chat(text) => {
                    payload.push(4);
                    write_chat_text(text, &mut payload)?;
                }
                ClientWorldInput::SetAltitude { km } => {
                    if !km.is_finite() || !(0.0..=10000.0).contains(km) {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                    }
                    payload.push(8);
                    payload.extend_from_slice(&km.to_le_bytes());
                }
                ClientWorldInput::UsePortal => payload.push(5),
                ClientWorldInput::MapTeleport { direction } => {
                    payload.push(6);
                    write_unit_direction(*direction, &mut payload)?;
                }
            }
            ClientKind::WorldInput
        }
        ClientMessage::TransitionReady {
            transition_id,
            target_context,
        } => {
            payload.extend_from_slice(&transition_id.get().to_le_bytes());
            write_world_context(*target_context, &mut payload);
            ClientKind::TransitionReady
        }
        ClientMessage::UsePortal => ClientKind::UsePortal,
        ClientMessage::CancelTransition(transition_id) => {
            payload.extend_from_slice(&transition_id.get().to_le_bytes());
            ClientKind::CancelTransition
        }
        ClientMessage::TimeProbe {
            seq,
            client_send_monotonic_ms,
        } => {
            payload.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());
            payload.extend_from_slice(&client_send_monotonic_ms.to_le_bytes());
            ClientKind::TimeProbe
        }
        ClientMessage::Quit => ClientKind::Quit,
    };
    encode_frame(kind.into(), &payload)
}

pub(crate) fn write_direction(
    direction: [f32; 2],
    output: &mut Vec<u8>,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !direction
        .iter()
        .all(|value| valid_direction_component(*value))
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    for value in direction {
        output.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_unit_direction(direction: [f32; 3], output: &mut Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !is_unit_direction(direction) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    write_vector(direction, output)
}

use crate::{
    models::ProtocolError,
    validation::{valid_chat, valid_name},

pub(crate) fn write_name(name: &str, output: &mut Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !valid_name(name) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidName);
    }
    output.push(name.len() as u8);
    output.extend_from_slice(name.as_bytes());
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn write_world_context(
    context: crate::world_context::WorldContext,
    output: &mut Vec<u8>,
) {
    output.extend_from_slice(&context.instance().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&context.content_revision().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&context.membership_epoch().get().to_le_bytes());
}

pub(crate) fn write_chat_text(text: &str, output: &mut Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !valid_chat(text) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    output.push(text.len() as u8);
    output.extend_from_slice(text.as_bytes());
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn write_vector(vector: [f32; 3], output: &mut Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !vector.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    for value in vector {
        output.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/encoding/server.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="301" bytes="12725" original_lines="301" original_bytes="12725" minified="false" sha256="d1c8e86464ff03e7c84a22d26bf8b3e8e4a2c46bdae019fb8f4e69e8135b8cad">>>
use super::common::{write_chat_text, write_name, write_vector, write_world_context};
use crate::{
    content_codec, environment_codec,
    kinds::ServerKind,
    limits::*,
    models::{ProtocolError, ServerMessage},
};

pub fn encode_server(message: &ServerMessage) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ProtocolError> {
    let mut frame = Vec::with_capacity(128);
    encode_server_into(&mut frame, message)?;
    Ok(frame)
}

pub fn encode_server_into(
    frame: &mut Vec<u8>,
    message: &ServerMessage,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let frame_start = frame.len();
    frame.extend_from_slice(&[0; HEADER_BYTES]);
    let payload_start = frame.len();
    let encoded = (|| {
        let kind = match message {
            ServerMessage::ContentOffer {
                material_hash,
                http_port,
                climate,
            } => {
                frame.extend_from_slice(material_hash);
                frame.extend_from_slice(&http_port.to_le_bytes());
                content_codec::write(climate, frame)?;
                ServerKind::ContentOffer
            }
            ServerMessage::Welcome {
                id,
                map_fingerprint,
                health,
                position,
                position_mm,
                context,
                manifest,
                transition_id,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            } => {
                if *health > 100 {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                frame.extend_from_slice(&id.get().to_le_bytes());
                frame.extend_from_slice(&map_fingerprint.to_le_bytes());
                frame.extend_from_slice(&health.to_le_bytes());
                let _ = position;
                write_position_mm(*position_mm, frame);
                write_world_context(*context, frame);
                write_world_manifest(*manifest, frame);
                frame.push(u8::from(transition_id.is_some()));
                if let Some(transition_id) = transition_id {
                    frame.extend_from_slice(&transition_id.get().to_le_bytes());
                }
                environment_codec::write_pair(*clock_sample, *environment, frame)?;
                ServerKind::Welcome
            }
            ServerMessage::AltitudeResult {
                context,
                position_mm,
            } => {
                write_world_context(*context, frame);
                frame.push(u8::from(position_mm.is_some()));
                if let Some(position) = position_mm {
                    write_position_mm(*position, frame);
                }
                ServerKind::AltitudeResult
            }
            ServerMessage::Pong => ServerKind::Pong,
            ServerMessage::MapTeleportResult { position_mm } => {
                frame.push(u8::from(position_mm.is_some()));
                if let Some(position_mm) = position_mm {
                    write_position_mm(*position_mm, frame);
                }
                ServerKind::MapTeleportResult
            }
            ServerMessage::Accepted => ServerKind::Accepted,
            ServerMessage::Bye => ServerKind::Bye,
            ServerMessage::Error(code) => {
                frame.push((*code).into());
                ServerKind::Error
            }
            ServerMessage::ShotResult {
                target_id,
                remaining_health,
                killed,
            } => {
                if target_id.is_some() != remaining_health.is_some()
                    || (*killed && target_id.is_none())
                {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                frame.push(u8::from(target_id.is_some()));
                if let (Some(id), Some(health)) = (target_id, remaining_health) {
                    frame.extend_from_slice(&id.get().to_le_bytes());
                    frame.extend_from_slice(&health.to_le_bytes());
                }
                frame.push(u8::from(*killed));
                ServerKind::ShotResult
            }
            ServerMessage::HealthUpdate(health) => {
                if *health > 100 {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                frame.extend_from_slice(&health.to_le_bytes());
                ServerKind::HealthUpdate
            }
            ServerMessage::Chat {
                sender_id,
                sender_name,
                text,
            } => {
                frame.extend_from_slice(&sender_id.get().to_le_bytes());
                write_name(sender_name, frame)?;
                write_chat_text(text, frame)?;
                ServerKind::Chat
            }
            ServerMessage::Snapshot {
                server_time_ms,
                context,
                full_snapshot,
                self_position,
                self_position_mm,
                self_velocity,
                self_grounded,
                players,
                removed_players,
            } => {
                if (*full_snapshot && !removed_players.is_empty())
                    || players
                        .iter()
                        .any(|player| removed_players.contains(player.id))
                {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                frame.extend_from_slice(&server_time_ms.to_le_bytes());
                write_world_context(*context, frame);
                let _ = self_position;
                write_position_mm(*self_position_mm, frame);
                write_vector(*self_velocity, frame)?;
                frame.push(u8::from(*self_grounded));
                frame.push(u8::from(*full_snapshot));
                frame.push(players.len() as u8);
                frame.push(removed_players.len() as u8);
                for player in players.iter() {
                    frame.extend_from_slice(&player.id.get().to_le_bytes());
                    write_name(&player.name, frame)?;
                    write_position_mm(player.position_mm, frame);
                }
                for id in removed_players.iter() {
                    frame.extend_from_slice(&id.get().to_le_bytes());
                }
                ServerKind::Snapshot
            }
            ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare {
                transition_id,
                source_context,
                target_context,
                map_fingerprint,
                destination,
                destination_mm,
                manifest,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            } => {
                frame.extend_from_slice(&transition_id.get().to_le_bytes());
                write_world_context(*source_context, frame);
                write_world_context(*target_context, frame);
                frame.extend_from_slice(&map_fingerprint.to_le_bytes());
                let _ = destination;
                write_position_mm(*destination_mm, frame);
                write_world_manifest(*manifest, frame);
                environment_codec::write_pair(*clock_sample, *environment, frame)?;
                ServerKind::TransitionPrepare
            }
            ServerMessage::TransitionCommitted {
                transition_id,
                context,
                map_fingerprint,
                destination,
                destination_mm,
                health,
                manifest,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            } => {
                if *health > 100 {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                frame.extend_from_slice(&transition_id.get().to_le_bytes());
                write_world_context(*context, frame);
                frame.extend_from_slice(&map_fingerprint.to_le_bytes());
                let _ = destination;
                write_position_mm(*destination_mm, frame);
                frame.extend_from_slice(&health.to_le_bytes());
                write_world_manifest(*manifest, frame);
                environment_codec::write_pair(*clock_sample, *environment, frame)?;
                ServerKind::TransitionCommitted
            }
            ServerMessage::TransitionCancelled {
                transition_id,
                context,
            } => {
                frame.extend_from_slice(&transition_id.get().to_le_bytes());
                write_world_context(*context, frame);
                ServerKind::TransitionCancelled
            }
            ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync {
                context,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            } => {
                write_world_context(*context, frame);
                environment_codec::write_pair(*clock_sample, *environment, frame)?;
                ServerKind::EnvironmentSync
            }
            ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply {
                seq,
                echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms,
                server_receive_monotonic_ms,
                server_send_monotonic_ms,
                session_nonce,
            } => {
                if server_send_monotonic_ms < server_receive_monotonic_ms {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                frame.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());
                frame.extend_from_slice(&echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms.to_le_bytes());
                frame.extend_from_slice(&server_receive_monotonic_ms.to_le_bytes());
                frame.extend_from_slice(&server_send_monotonic_ms.to_le_bytes());
                frame.extend_from_slice(session_nonce.as_bytes());
                ServerKind::TimeProbeReply
            }
        };
        Ok(kind)
    })();

    let kind = match encoded {
        Ok(kind) => kind,
        Err(error) => {
            frame.truncate(frame_start);
            return Err(error);
        }
    };
    let payload_bytes = frame.len() - payload_start;
    if payload_bytes > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES || payload_bytes > u16::MAX as usize {
        frame.truncate(frame_start);
        return Err(ProtocolError::PayloadTooLarge);
    }
    frame[frame_start] = PROTOCOL_VERSION;
    frame[frame_start + 1] = kind.into();
    frame[frame_start + 2..frame_start + HEADER_BYTES]
        .copy_from_slice(&(payload_bytes as u16).to_le_bytes());
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn write_position_mm(
    position: minimium_world::world::Position3Mm,
    output: &mut Vec<u8>,
) {
    for coordinate in position.0 {
        output.extend_from_slice(&coordinate.to_le_bytes());
    }
}

fn write_world_manifest(manifest: minimium_world::world::WorldManifest, output: &mut Vec<u8>) {
    output.extend_from_slice(&manifest.definition_id().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.push(match manifest.topology() {
        minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet => 0,
        minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Dungeon => 1,
    });
    let generation = manifest.generation();
    output.extend_from_slice(&generation.seed().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&generation.revision().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&generation.position_quantum_mm().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&manifest.content_revision().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(manifest.generator_digest().as_bytes());
    if let Some(planet) = manifest.planet() {
        output.push(1);
        output.push(planet.mode);
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.radius_mm.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.height_scale_permille.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.sea_level_mm.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.mountain_limit_mm.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.detail_strength_mm.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.detail_wavelength_mm.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.mountain_band_frequency.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.package_digest);
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.peak_relief.start_m.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.peak_relief.full_m.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.peak_relief.multiplier_permille.to_le_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(&planet.peak_relief.exponent.to_le_bytes());
    } else {
        output.push(0);
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/environment_codec.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="73" bytes="3217" original_lines="73" original_bytes="3217" minified="false" sha256="f95f5ce2cd2757e4c992d614a75f184b53dde1a52dd2da473729e2682ee6ef82">>>
use crate::{models::ProtocolError, reading::Reader};
use minimium_environment::{
    time::{
        ClockId, ClockMode, ClockRevision, ClockSample, MonotonicMs, OfflinePolicy, SessionNonce,
        TimeScalePpm, WorldTimeMs,
    },
    EnvironmentDescriptor,
};

pub(crate) const CLOCK_SAMPLE_BYTES: usize = 58;
pub(crate) const ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES: usize = 49;
pub(crate) const ENVIRONMENT_SUFFIX_BYTES: usize =
    CLOCK_SAMPLE_BYTES + ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES;

pub(crate) fn write_pair(
    sample: ClockSample,
    descriptor: EnvironmentDescriptor,
    output: &mut Vec<u8>,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if descriptor.clock_id() != sample.clock_id() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedEnvironment);
    }
    let start = output.len();
    output.extend_from_slice(&sample.clock_id().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&sample.revision().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(sample.session_nonce().as_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&sample.server_monotonic_ms().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&sample.world_utc_ms().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.push(sample.mode() as u8);
    output.extend_from_slice(&sample.rate_ppm().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.push(sample.offline_policy() as u8);

    output.extend_from_slice(&descriptor.clock_id().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.push(descriptor.profile() as u8);
    output.extend_from_slice(&descriptor.astronomy_model_revision().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(&descriptor.catalogue_id().get().to_le_bytes());
    output.extend_from_slice(descriptor.catalogue_sha256().as_bytes());
    debug_assert_eq!(output.len() - start, ENVIRONMENT_SUFFIX_BYTES);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn read_pair(
    reader: &mut Reader<'_>,
) -> Result<(ClockSample, EnvironmentDescriptor), ProtocolError> {
    let clock_id = ClockId::try_from(reader.u64()?).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    let revision =
        ClockRevision::try_from(reader.u64()?).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    let nonce = SessionNonce::new(reader.fixed()?);
    let monotonic = MonotonicMs::new(reader.u64()?);
    let world_time =
        WorldTimeMs::try_from(reader.i64()?).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    let mode = ClockMode::try_from(reader.byte()?).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    let rate = TimeScalePpm::try_from(reader.u64()?).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    let offline =
        OfflinePolicy::try_from(reader.byte()?).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
    let sample = ClockSample::new(
        clock_id, revision, nonce, monotonic, world_time, mode, rate, offline,
    )
    .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;

    let descriptor = EnvironmentDescriptor::from_codes(
        reader.u64()?,
        reader.byte()?,
        reader.u32()?,
        reader.u32()?,
        reader.fixed()?,
    )
    .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::UnsupportedEnvironment)?;
    if descriptor.validate_clock(clock_id).is_err() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedEnvironment);
    }
    Ok((sample, descriptor))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/error_code.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="33" bytes="888" original_lines="33" original_bytes="888" minified="false" sha256="ad78d025b9c726b745a0d6d78a1b04dc1a3128fe7f268df936d8cb5cc61d73f8">>>
/// A v8 error code. Unknown bytes are retained for forward compatibility.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ServerErrorCode {
    Protocol,
    Busy,
    ServerFull,
    RateLimit,
    Unknown(u8),
}

impl From<u8> for ServerErrorCode {
    fn from(value: u8) -> Self {
        match value {
            1 => Self::Protocol,
            2 => Self::Busy,
            3 => Self::ServerFull,
            4 => Self::RateLimit,
            other => Self::Unknown(other),
        }
    }
}

impl From<ServerErrorCode> for u8 {
    fn from(code: ServerErrorCode) -> Self {
        match code {
            ServerErrorCode::Protocol => 1,
            ServerErrorCode::Busy => 2,
            ServerErrorCode::ServerFull => 3,
            ServerErrorCode::RateLimit => 4,
            ServerErrorCode::Unknown(value) => value,
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/framing.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="40" bytes="1343" original_lines="40" original_bytes="1343" minified="false" sha256="b5e0e1eb13d3d15490f9ce0f62daeb65eb0d8053031463b9a68f30700d27bf58">>>
use super::{
    limits::{HEADER_BYTES, MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES, PROTOCOL_VERSION},
    models::ProtocolError,
};

pub(crate) fn encode_frame(kind: u8, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ProtocolError> {
    if payload.len() > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES || payload.len() > u16::MAX as usize {
        return Err(ProtocolError::PayloadTooLarge);
    }
    let mut frame = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER_BYTES + payload.len());
    frame.push(PROTOCOL_VERSION);
    frame.push(kind);
    frame.extend_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u16).to_le_bytes());
    frame.extend_from_slice(payload);
    Ok(frame)
}

type DecodedFrame<'a> = (u8, &'a [u8], usize);

pub(crate) fn decode_frame(input: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<DecodedFrame<'_>>, ProtocolError> {
    if input.len() < HEADER_BYTES {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    if input[0] != PROTOCOL_VERSION {
        return Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedVersion(input[0]));
    }
    let payload_bytes = u16::from_le_bytes([input[2], input[3]]) as usize;
    if payload_bytes > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES {
        return Err(ProtocolError::PayloadTooLarge);
    }
    let frame_bytes = HEADER_BYTES + payload_bytes;
    if input.len() < frame_bytes {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    Ok(Some((
        input[1],
        &input[HEADER_BYTES..frame_bytes],
        frame_bytes,
    )))
}

use crate::ProtocolError;

macro_rules! kinds {
    ($name:ident { $($variant:ident = $value:expr),+ $(,)? }) => {
        #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
        pub(crate) enum $name { $($variant = $value),+ }

        impl TryFrom<u8> for $name {
            type Error = ProtocolError;

            fn try_from(value: u8) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
                match value {
                    $($value => Ok(Self::$variant),)+
                    other => Err(ProtocolError::UnknownMessage(other)),
                }
            }
        }

        impl From<$name> for u8 {
            fn from(kind: $name) -> Self { kind as u8 }
        }
    };
}

kinds!(ClientKind {
    Ping = 1, SetName = 2, Move = 3, Quit = 4, Identify = 5, Fire = 6, Chat = 7,
    WorldInput = 8, TransitionReady = 9, UsePortal = 10, CancelTransition = 11,

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct RemotePlayers {
    entries: [Option<RemotePlayer>; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS],
    len: usize,
}

impl Default for RemotePlayers {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            entries: std::array::from_fn(|_| None),
            len: 0,
        }
    }
}

impl RemotePlayers {
    pub fn push(&mut self, player: RemotePlayer) -> bool {
        if self.len == MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS || self.get(player.id).is_some() {
            return false;
        }
        self.entries[self.len] = Some(player);
        self.len += 1;
        true
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.len
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len == 0
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: PlayerId) -> Option<&RemotePlayer> {
        self.iter().find(|player| player.id == id)
    }

    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &RemotePlayer> {
        self.entries[..self.len].iter().filter_map(Option::as_ref)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct RemotePlayerIds {
    entries: [Option<PlayerId>; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS],
    len: usize,
}

impl Default for RemotePlayerIds {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            entries: [None; MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS],
            len: 0,
        }
    }
}

impl RemotePlayerIds {
    pub fn push(&mut self, id: PlayerId) -> bool {
        if self.len == MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS || self.contains(id) {
            return false;
        }
        self.entries[self.len] = Some(id);
        self.len += 1;
        true
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.len
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len == 0
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, id: PlayerId) -> bool {
        self.iter().any(|candidate| *candidate == id)
    }

    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &PlayerId> {
        self.entries[..self.len].iter().filter_map(Option::as_ref)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ProtocolError {
    UnsupportedVersion(u8),
    UnknownMessage(u8),
    PayloadTooLarge,
    InvalidPayload,
    InvalidName,
    UnsupportedEnvironment,
}

impl fmt::Display for ProtocolError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::UnsupportedVersion(version) => {
                write!(formatter, "unsupported protocol version {version}")
            }
            Self::UnknownMessage(kind) => write!(formatter, "unknown message type {kind}"),
            Self::PayloadTooLarge => formatter.write_str("protocol payload exceeds limit"),
            Self::InvalidPayload => formatter.write_str("invalid protocol payload"),
            Self::InvalidName => formatter.write_str("invalid player name"),
            Self::UnsupportedEnvironment => {
                formatter.write_str("peer environment model or catalogue is unsupported")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Error for ProtocolError {}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/movement_codec.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="34" bytes="1340" original_lines="34" original_bytes="1340" minified="false" sha256="0e0c163a4cfc77d6aa05b12234d64465da548866a3678bc7dfa10dc3e49a31e0">>>
use super::{reading::Reader, ProtocolError};
use minimium_simulation::{CharacterInput, MovementSettings};

pub(crate) fn write(input: CharacterInput, bytes: &mut Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !input.movement.valid() || !input.vertical.is_finite() || input.vertical.abs() > 1.0 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    super::encoding::write_direction(input.direction, bytes)?;
    bytes.push(u8::from(input.jump));
    bytes.push(u8::from(input.movement.fly));
    for value in [input.vertical, input.movement.speed, input.movement.accel] {
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn read(reader: &mut Reader<'_>) -> Result<CharacterInput, ProtocolError> {
    let direction = reader.direction()?;
    let jump = reader.boolean()?;
    let fly = reader.boolean()?;
    let vertical = f32::from_le_bytes(reader.fixed()?);
    let speed = f32::from_le_bytes(reader.fixed()?);
    let accel = f32::from_le_bytes(reader.fixed()?);
    let movement = MovementSettings { fly, speed, accel };
    if !movement.valid() || !vertical.is_finite() || vertical.abs() > 1.0 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
    }
    Ok(CharacterInput {
        direction,
        jump,
        vertical,
        movement,
    })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/protocol/src/reading.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="243" bytes="9074" original_lines="243" original_bytes="9074" minified="false" sha256="31056cbad69fa7f78f86e177e208162092bb25aeb277501206b2e5f55a9870d9">>>
use super::world_context::WorldContext;
use super::{
    limits::{MAX_CHAT_BYTES, PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES},
    models::ProtocolError,
    validation::{valid_chat, valid_direction_component, valid_name},
};
use minimium_core::identity::PlayerProfileId;
use minimium_world::world::{
    GenerationRevision, GenerationSpec, GeneratorDigest, MembershipEpoch, Position3Mm,
    TransitionId, WorldContentRevision, WorldDefinitionId, WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest,
    WorldSeed, WorldTopology,
};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub(crate) struct Reader<'a> {
    payload: &'a [u8],
    offset: usize,
}

impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn new(payload: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        Self { payload, offset: 0 }
    }

    fn take(&mut self, count: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], ProtocolError> {
        let end = self
            .offset
            .checked_add(count)
            .filter(|end| *end <= self.payload.len())
            .ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let bytes = &self.payload[self.offset..end];
        self.offset = end;
        Ok(bytes)
    }

    pub(crate) fn byte(&mut self) -> Result<u8, ProtocolError> {
        Ok(self.take(1)?[0])
    }

    pub(crate) fn boolean(&mut self) -> Result<bool, ProtocolError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(false),
            1 => Ok(true),
            _ => Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, ProtocolError> {
        let bytes: [u8; 8] = self
            .take(8)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(bytes))
    }

    pub(crate) fn i64(&mut self) -> Result<i64, ProtocolError> {
        let bytes: [u8; 8] = self
            .take(8)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        Ok(i64::from_le_bytes(bytes))
    }

    pub(crate) fn u128(&mut self) -> Result<u128, ProtocolError> {
        let bytes: [u8; 16] = self
            .take(16)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        Ok(u128::from_le_bytes(bytes))
    }

    pub(crate) fn u32(&mut self) -> Result<u32, ProtocolError> {
        let bytes: [u8; 4] = self
            .take(4)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(bytes))
    }

    pub(crate) fn fixed<const N: usize>(&mut self) -> Result<[u8; N], ProtocolError> {
        self.take(N)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)
    }

    pub(crate) fn world_context(&mut self) -> Result<WorldContext, ProtocolError> {
        let instance = WorldInstanceId::new(self.u128()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let content =
            WorldContentRevision::new(self.u64()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let epoch = MembershipEpoch::new(self.u64()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        Ok(WorldContext::new(instance, content, epoch))
    }

    pub(crate) fn world_manifest(&mut self) -> Result<WorldManifest, ProtocolError> {
        let definition =
            WorldDefinitionId::new(self.u128()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let topology = match self.byte()? {
            0 => WorldTopology::Planet,
            1 => WorldTopology::Dungeon,
            _ => return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload),
        };
        let seed = WorldSeed::new(self.u128()?);
        let revision = GenerationRevision::new(self.u32()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let quantum = self.u32()?;
        let generation =
            GenerationSpec::new(seed, revision, quantum).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let content =
            WorldContentRevision::new(self.u64()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let digest = GeneratorDigest::new(self.fixed::<32>()?);
        let mut manifest = WorldManifest::new(definition, topology, generation, content, digest);
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => {}
            1 => {
                let planet = minimium_world::world::PlanetDefinition {
                    mode: self.byte()?,
                    radius_mm: self.u64()?,
                    height_scale_permille: self.u32()?,
                    sea_level_mm: self.u64()? as i64,
                    mountain_limit_mm: self.u32()?,
                    detail_strength_mm: self.u32()?,
                    detail_wavelength_mm: self.u32()?,
                    mountain_band_frequency: self.u32()?,
                    package_digest: self.fixed::<32>()?,
                    peak_relief: minimium_world::world::PeakRelief {
                        start_m: self.u32()?,
                        full_m: self.u32()?,
                        multiplier_permille: self.u32()?,
                        exponent: self.u32()?,
                    },
                };
                if !planet.is_valid() || (planet.peak_relief.enabled() && revision.get() != 5) {
                    return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
                }
                manifest = manifest.with_planet(planet);
            }
            _ => return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload),
        }
        Ok(manifest)
    }

    pub(crate) fn transition_id(&mut self) -> Result<TransitionId, ProtocolError> {
        TransitionId::new(self.u128()?).ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)
    }

    pub(crate) fn u16(&mut self) -> Result<u16, ProtocolError> {
        let bytes: [u8; 2] = self
            .take(2)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        Ok(u16::from_le_bytes(bytes))
    }

    pub(crate) fn vector(&mut self) -> Result<[f32; 3], ProtocolError> {
        let mut vector = [0.0; 3];
        for value in &mut vector {
            let bytes: [u8; 4] = self
                .take(4)?
                .try_into()
                .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
            *value = f32::from_le_bytes(bytes);
        }
        if !vector.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        Ok(vector)
    }

    pub(crate) fn position_mm(&mut self) -> Result<Position3Mm, ProtocolError> {
        let mut position = [0_i64; 3];
        for coordinate in &mut position {
            *coordinate = i64::from_le_bytes(
                self.take(8)?
                    .try_into()
                    .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?,
            );
            if coordinate.unsigned_abs() > 7_000_000_000 {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
        }
        Ok(Position3Mm(position))
    }

    pub(crate) fn direction(&mut self) -> Result<[f32; 2], ProtocolError> {
        let mut direction = [0.0; 2];
        for value in &mut direction {
            let bytes: [u8; 4] = self
                .take(4)?
                .try_into()
                .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
            *value = f32::from_le_bytes(bytes);
            if !valid_direction_component(*value) {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
            }
        }
        Ok(direction)
    }

    pub(crate) fn profile_id(&mut self) -> Result<PlayerProfileId, ProtocolError> {
        self.take(PLAYER_PROFILE_ID_BYTES)?
            .try_into()
            .map(PlayerProfileId::from_bytes)
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)
    }

    pub(crate) fn name(&mut self) -> Result<String, ProtocolError> {
        Ok(self.name_text()?.to_owned())
    }

    pub(crate) fn shared_name(&mut self) -> Result<Arc<str>, ProtocolError> {
        Ok(Arc::from(self.name_text()?))
    }

    pub(crate) fn name_text(&mut self) -> Result<&'a str, ProtocolError> {
        let byte_count = self.byte()? as usize;
        let bytes = self.take(byte_count)?;
        let name = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidName)?;
        if !valid_name(name) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidName);
        }
        Ok(name)
    }

    pub(crate) fn chat_text(&mut self) -> Result<&'a str, ProtocolError> {
        let byte_count = self.byte()? as usize;
        if byte_count == 0 || byte_count > MAX_CHAT_BYTES {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        let bytes = self.take(byte_count)?;
        let text = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)?;
        if !valid_chat(text) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        Ok(text)
    }

    pub(crate) fn finish(&self) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
        if self.offset == self.payload.len() {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPayload)
        }
    }
}

    );
    (sample, descriptor)
}

fn manifest(topology: WorldTopology) -> WorldManifest {
    let generation = GenerationSpec::new(
        WorldSeed::new(0x1234),
        GenerationRevision::new(2).unwrap(),
        10,
    )
    .unwrap();
    WorldManifest::new(
        WorldDefinitionId::new(5).unwrap(),
        topology,
        generation,
        WorldContentRevision::new(4).unwrap(),
        GeneratorDigest::new([0x5a; 32]),
    )
}

fn context(instance: u128, epoch: u64) -> WorldContext {
    WorldContext::new(
        WorldInstanceId::new(instance).unwrap(),
        WorldContentRevision::new(4).unwrap(),
        MembershipEpoch::new(epoch).unwrap(),
    )
}

#[test]
fn welcome_and_transition_frames_round_trip_full_world_context() {
    let (clock_sample, environment) = environment_fixture(EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike, 10);
    let welcome = ServerMessage::Welcome {
        id: PlayerId::new(42),
        map_fingerprint: 0x1234,
        health: 77,
        position: [1.25, 8.5, -3.0],
        position_mm: minimium_world::world::Position3Mm([1250, 8500, -3000]),
        context: context(1, 9),
        manifest: manifest(WorldTopology::Planet),
        transition_id: None,
        clock_sample,
        environment,
    };
    let frame = encode_server(&welcome).unwrap();
    let (decoded, consumed) = decode_server(&frame).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded, welcome);
    assert_eq!(consumed, frame.len());

    let (clock_sample, environment) = environment_fixture(EnvironmentProfile::Interior, 11);
    let transition = ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare {
        transition_id: TransitionId::new(17).unwrap(),
        source_context: context(1, 9),
        target_context: context(2, 10),
        map_fingerprint: 0x9876,
        destination: [3.0, 0.0, 5.0],
        destination_mm: minimium_world::world::Position3Mm([3000, 0, 5000]),
        manifest: manifest(WorldTopology::Dungeon),
        clock_sample,
        environment,
    };
    let frame = encode_server(&transition).unwrap();
    let (decoded, consumed) = decode_server(&frame).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded, transition);
    assert_eq!(consumed, frame.len());
}

#[test]
fn client_world_inputs_and_transition_acknowledgements_keep_their_epoch() {
    let movement = ClientMessage::WorldInput {
        context: context(2, 10),
        input: ClientWorldInput::Move {
            direction: [0.25, -1.0],
            jump: true,
        },
    };
    let frame = encode_client(&movement).unwrap();
    let (decoded, consumed) = decode_client(&frame).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded, movement);
    assert_eq!(consumed, frame.len());

    let acknowledgement = ClientMessage::TransitionReady {
        transition_id: TransitionId::new(17).unwrap(),
        target_context: context(2, 10),
    };
    let frame = encode_client(&acknowledgement).unwrap();
    let (decoded, consumed) = decode_client(&frame).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded, acknowledgement);
    assert_eq!(consumed, frame.len());
}

use crate::limits::{MAX_CHAT_BYTES, MAX_PLAYER_NAME_BYTES};

pub(crate) fn valid_name(name: &str) -> bool {
    !name.is_empty()
        && name.len() <= MAX_PLAYER_NAME_BYTES
        && name
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'_')
}

pub(crate) fn valid_chat(text: &str) -> bool {
    !text.is_empty() && text.len() <= MAX_CHAT_BYTES && !text.chars().any(char::is_control)
}

pub(crate) fn valid_direction_component(value: f32) -> bool {
    value.is_finite() && (-1.0..=1.0).contains(&value)
}

pub(crate) fn is_unit_direction(direction: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
    if direction.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite()) {
        return false;
    }
    let length_squared = direction.iter().map(|value| value * value).sum::<f32>();
    (0.99..=1.01).contains(&length_squared)
}

//! Fixed clear-air optical constants used by the Earth atmosphere renderer.

/// Spherical Earth atmosphere model inputs for render-time LUT construction.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Optics {
    pub radius_m: f64,
    pub atmospheric_top_m: f64,
    pub rayleigh_scale_height_m: f64,
    pub aerosol_scale_height_m: f64,
    pub rayleigh_rgb_m_inv: [f64; 3],

    pub ozone_rgb_m_inv: [f64; 3],
    pub mie_anisotropy: f64,
    pub ozone_peak_height_m: f64,
    pub ozone_half_width_m: f64,
}

pub const EARTH: Optics = Optics {
    radius_m: 6_371_000.0,
    atmospheric_top_m: 100_000.0,
    rayleigh_scale_height_m: 8000.0,
    aerosol_scale_height_m: 1200.0,
    rayleigh_rgb_m_inv: [5.802e-6, 13.558e-6, 33.1e-6],
    mie_m_inv: 4.44e-6,
    ozone_rgb_m_inv: [0.650e-6, 1.881e-6, 0.085e-6],
    mie_anisotropy: 0.76,
    ozone_peak_height_m: 25_000.0,
    ozone_half_width_m: 15_000.0,
};

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/atmosphere_gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="316" bytes="12090" original_lines="316" original_bytes="12090" minified="false" sha256="9a3ae427c79054a3e7df24d82c3ab9f17871799ce3c77eb35dbc926ae20d0676">>>
//! Shared atmosphere LUT owner and linear HDR composition.
use crate::{
    atmosphere_pipeline as pipeline, atmosphere_resources::AtmosphereResources, RenderViewFrame,
};
pub struct AtmosphereGpu {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub depth_bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub resources: AtmosphereResources,
    depth_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    scratch: wgpu::Texture,
    compute: Vec<wgpu::ComputePipeline>,
    outputs: Vec<wgpu::BindGroup>,
    active: bool,
    standard: bool,
    last_radius: f64,
    dirty: std::cell::Cell<bool>,
    weather: Option<crate::atmosphere_view::WeatherEndpoints>,
    pub debug: u32,
    timing: Option<crate::atmosphere_timing::AtmosphereTiming>,
    last_view: crate::AtmosphereUniform,
    needs_lut: std::cell::Cell<bool>,
    computed: std::cell::Cell<bool>,
    light_key: std::cell::Cell<Option<[[f32; 4]; 5]>>,
}
impl AtmosphereGpu {
    pub const BYTES: u64 = AtmosphereResources::BYTES;
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        frame: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
        resources: AtmosphereResources,
    ) -> Self {
        let depth_layout = pipeline::scene_layout(device);
        let scratch = Self::scratch(device, depth.texture().size(), format);
        let depth_bind_group = pipeline::depth_group(
            device,
            &depth_layout,
            depth,
            &scratch.create_view(&Default::default()),
        );
        let render = pipeline::create(device, frame, &depth_layout, format);
        let (compute, outputs) = if resources.physical {
            let out2 = pipeline::outputs(device, wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2);
            let out3 = pipeline::outputs(device, wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D3);
            let output = |a, b, layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout| {
                device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                    label: Some("atmosphere output textures"),
                    layout,
                    entries: &[
                        wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                            binding: 0,
                            resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&resources.stages[a]),
                        },
                        wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                            binding: 1,
                            resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&resources.stages[b]),
                        },
                    ],
                })
            };
            let outputs = vec![
                output(4, 1, &out2),
                output(0, 1, &out2),
                output(2, 3, &out3),
            ];
            let compute = vec![
                pipeline::compute(device, frame, &out2, "multi"),
                pipeline::compute(device, frame, &out2, "sky"),
                pipeline::compute(device, frame, &out3, "aerial"),
            ];
            (compute, outputs)
        } else {
            (Vec::new(), Vec::new())
        };
        Self {
            pipeline: render,
            depth_bind_group,
            resources,
            depth_layout,
            scratch,
            compute,
            outputs,
            active: false,
            standard: true,
            last_radius: 0.0,
            dirty: std::cell::Cell::new(true),
            weather: None,
            debug: 0,
            timing: crate::atmosphere_timing::AtmosphereTiming::new(device, queue),
            last_view: Default::default(),
            needs_lut: std::cell::Cell::new(true),
            computed: std::cell::Cell::new(false),
            light_key: std::cell::Cell::new(None),
        }
    }
    fn scratch(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        size: wgpu::Extent3d,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> wgpu::Texture {
        device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("atmosphere scene snapshot"),
            size,
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        })
    }
    pub fn bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.resources.bytes()
            + if self.timing.is_some() { 512 } else { 0 }
            + self.scratch.size().width as u64
                * self.scratch.size().height as u64
                * if self.scratch.format() == wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float {
                    8
                } else {
                    4
                }
    }
    pub fn is_active(&self) -> bool {
        self.active
    }
    pub fn high_stars(&self) -> bool {
        self.last_view.config[0] > 0.0 && self.last_view.up_height[3] > 12000.0
    }
    pub fn set_weather(&mut self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, grid: &crate::surface_cover::CoverGrid) {
        self.weather = Some(crate::atmosphere_view::WeatherEndpoints::from_grid(grid));
        self.needs_lut.set(true);
        queue.write_texture(
            self.resources.fog.as_image_copy(),
            bytemuck::cast_slice(&grid.fog_pixels),
            wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
                offset: 0,
                bytes_per_row: Some(9 * 8),
                rows_per_image: Some(9),
            },
            self.resources.fog.size(),
        );
    }
    pub fn clear_weather(&mut self) {
        self.weather = None;
    }
    pub fn upload(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        view: RenderViewFrame,
        radius: f64,
        scale: f64,
        standard: bool,
        utc: f64,
    ) {
        if let Some(timing) = &self.timing {
            timing.poll(device);
        }
        self.standard = standard;
        self.active = radius > 0.0 && self.resources.physical;
        let value = crate::atmosphere_view::prepare(
            view,
            radius,
            scale,
            standard,
            utc,
            self.weather.as_ref(),
            self.debug,
            self.active,
        );
        if self.active && (self.last_radius - value.radii[0] as f64).abs() > 0.1 {
            self.last_radius = value.radii[0] as f64;
            let mut profile = crate::atmosphere::EARTH;
            profile.radius_m = self.last_radius.max(1.0);
            crate::atmosphere_table::update(queue, self.resources.optical.texture(), profile);
            self.dirty.set(true);
        }
        queue.write_buffer(&self.resources.uniform, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&value));
        if bytemuck::bytes_of(&value) != bytemuck::bytes_of(&self.last_view) {
            self.needs_lut.set(true);
        }
        self.last_view = value;
    }
    pub fn resize(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, depth: &wgpu::TextureView) {
        self.scratch = Self::scratch(device, depth.texture().size(), self.scratch.format());
        self.depth_bind_group = pipeline::depth_group(
            device,
            &self.depth_layout,
            depth,
            &self.scratch.create_view(&Default::default()),
        );
    }
    pub fn prepare(&self, encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, frame: &wgpu::BindGroup) {
        self.computed.set(false);
        if !self.active {
            return;
        }
        if !self.needs_lut.replace(false) {
            return;
        }
        self.computed.set(true);
        // Separate sampled and storage textures avoid read/write aliasing in bind groups.
        let dirty = self.dirty.replace(false);
        for i in 0..3 {
            if i == 0 && !dirty {
                continue;
            }
            {
                let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("atmosphere LUT update"),
                    timestamp_writes: if i > 0 {
                        self.timing.as_ref().map(|t| t.compute((i - 1) as u32))
                    } else {
                        None
                    },
                });
                pass.set_pipeline(&self.compute[i]);
                pass.set_bind_group(0, frame, &[]);
                pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.outputs[i], &[]);
                match i {
                    0 => pass.dispatch_workgroups(4, 4, 1),
                    1 => {
                        if self.standard {
                            pass.dispatch_workgroups(24, 14, 1)
                        } else {
                            pass.dispatch_workgroups(16, 8, 1)
                        }
                    }
                    _ => {
                        if self.standard {
                            pass.dispatch_workgroups(8, 8, 8)
                        } else {
                            pass.dispatch_workgroups(4, 4, 8)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            match i {
                0 => self.resources.publish(encoder, 4..5),
                1 => self.resources.publish(encoder, 0..2),
                _ => self.resources.publish(encoder, 2..4),
            }
        }
    }
    pub fn encode(
        &self,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        scene: &wgpu::TextureView,
        camera: &wgpu::BindGroup,
        source: Option<&wgpu::Texture>,
        enabled: bool,
    ) -> u32 {
        if !enabled || !self.active {
            return 0;
        }
        let Some(source) = source else {
            return 0;
        };
        encoder.copy_texture_to_texture(
            source.as_image_copy(),
            self.scratch.as_image_copy(),
            self.scratch.size(),
        );
        let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("atmosphere RGB composite"),
            color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                view: scene,
                depth_slice: None,
                resolve_target: None,
                ops: wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                },
            })],
            depth_stencil_attachment: None,
            timestamp_writes: self.timing.as_ref().map(|t| t.render()),
            occlusion_query_set: None,
            multiview_mask: None,
        });
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, camera, &[]);
        pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.depth_bind_group, &[]);
        pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        drop(pass);
        if let Some(timing) = &self.timing {
            timing.resolve(encoder, self.computed.get());
        }
        1
    }
    pub fn after_submit(&self) {
        if let Some(timing) = &self.timing {
            timing.after_submit();
        }
    }
    pub fn mark_environment(&self, environment: &crate::gpu_frame::EnvironmentUniform) {
        let key = [
            environment.global_sun_direction,
            environment.global_sun_rgb,
            environment.moon_orbit_world,
            environment.moon_disk_radiance,
            environment.ambient_rgb_exposure,
        ];
        if self.light_key.get() != Some(key) {
            self.light_key.set(Some(key));
            self.needs_lut.set(true);
        }
    }
    pub fn status(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        vec![format!("atmosphere={} quality={} height={:.0}m optical_radius={:.0}km memory={:.2}MiB debug={}",
            if self.active {"physical HDR"} else {"analytic fallback"},if self.standard {"standard"} else {"low"},
            self.last_view.up_height[3],self.last_view.radii[0]/1000.0,self.bytes() as f64/1048576.0,self.debug),
            self.timing.as_ref().map_or("GPU timestamp queries unsupported".into(),|t|t.status())]
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/atmosphere_pipeline.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="135" bytes="4764" original_lines="135" original_bytes="4764" minified="false" sha256="2d15ab76c147d132bfb091f7754a052185a6ee4c6c12ff71f41c2bc2d667007a">>>
//! Atmosphere compute and RGB scene-composition pipelines.
pub fn depth_entry() -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding: 0,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
            multisampled: false,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}
pub fn scene_layout(device: &wgpu::Device) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
    device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere scene input"),
        entries: &[
            depth_entry(),
            wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 1,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                    sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                    view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                    multisampled: false,
                },
                count: None,
            },
        ],
    })
}
pub fn depth_group(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
    scene: &wgpu::TextureView,
) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
    device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere HDR input"),
        layout,
        entries: &[
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(depth),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 1,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(scene),
            },
        ],
    })
}
pub fn create(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    frame: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    scene: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere RGB composite"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame), Some(scene)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere RGB composite"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::shader_source::atmosphere().into()),
    });
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere RGB composite"),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            buffers: &[],
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("fs_atmosphere"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format,
                blend: None,
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
        }),
        primitive: Default::default(),
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview_mask: None,
        cache: None,
    })
}
pub fn outputs(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension,
) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
    device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere compute outputs"),
        entries: &[0, 1].map(|binding| wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
            binding,
            visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
            ty: wgpu::BindingType::StorageTexture {
                access: wgpu::StorageTextureAccess::WriteOnly,
                format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
                view_dimension: dimension,
            },
            count: None,
        }),
    })
}
pub fn compute(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    frame: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    output: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    kind: &str,
) -> wgpu::ComputePipeline {
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("atmosphere compute layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame), Some(output)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some(kind),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::shader_source::atmosphere_compute(kind).into()),
    });
    device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some(kind),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        module: &shader,
        entry_point: Some("cs_main"),
        compilation_options: Default::default(),
        cache: None,
    })
}
