//! Bounded atmosphere textures shared by all scene pipelines through group zero.
use crate::AtmosphereUniform;
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

pub struct AtmosphereResources {
    pub uniform: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub physical: bool,
    pub optical: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
    pub textures: Vec<wgpu::Texture>,
    pub views: Vec<wgpu::TextureView>,
    pub staging: Vec<wgpu::Texture>,
    pub stages: Vec<wgpu::TextureView>,
    pub fog: wgpu::Texture,
    pub fog_view: wgpu::TextureView,
}

impl AtmosphereResources {
    pub const SIZES: [[u32; 3]; 5] = [
        [192, 108, 1],
        [192, 108, 1],
        [32, 32, 32],
        [32, 32, 32],
        [32, 32, 1],
    ];
    pub const BYTES: u64 = crate::atmosphere_table::BYTES
        + 256
        + 9 * 9 * 2 * 8
        + 2 * (192 * 108 * 16 + 32 * 32 * 32 * 16 + 32 * 32 * 8);

    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue, physical: bool) -> Self {
        let uniform = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
            label: Some("atmosphere view and optics"),
            contents: bytemuck::bytes_of(&AtmosphereUniform::default()),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        });
        let optical = crate::atmosphere_table::create(device, queue, crate::atmosphere::EARTH);
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("atmosphere linear clamp"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let make = |size: [u32; 3], usage| {
            device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
                label: Some("bounded atmosphere LUT"),
                size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                    width: size[0],
                    height: size[1],
                    depth_or_array_layers: size[2],
                },
                mip_level_count: 1,
                sample_count: 1,
                dimension: if size[2] > 1 {
                    wgpu::TextureDimension::D3
                } else {
                    wgpu::TextureDimension::D2
                },
                format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
                usage,
                view_formats: &[],
            })
        };
        let textures: Vec<_> = Self::SIZES
            .map(|s| {
                make(
                    s,
                    wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
                )
            })
            .into();
        let staging: Vec<_> = if physical {
            Self::SIZES
                .map(|s| {
                    make(
                        s,
                        wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_SRC,
                    )
                })
                .into()
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        };
        let views = textures
            .iter()
            .map(|t| t.create_view(&Default::default()))
            .collect();
        let stages = staging
            .iter()
            .map(|t| t.create_view(&Default::default()))
            .collect();
        let fog = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("regional fog endpoints"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: 9,
                height: 9,
                depth_or_array_layers: 2,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let fog_view = fog.create_view(&Default::default());
        Self {
            physical,
            uniform,
            optical,
            sampler,
            textures,
            views,
            staging,
            stages,
            fog,
            fog_view,
        }
    }

    pub fn entries(&self) -> Vec<wgpu::BindGroupEntry<'_>> {
        let mut entries = vec![
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 2,
                resource: self.uniform.as_entire_binding(),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 3,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&self.optical),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 4,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
            },
        ];
        entries.extend(
            self.views
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, v)| wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 5 + i as u32,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(v),
                }),
        );
        entries.push(wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
            binding: 10,
            resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&self.fog_view),
        });
        entries
    }

    pub fn layout_entries() -> Vec<wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry> {
        let visibility = wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT | wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE;
        let mut entries = vec![
            wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 2,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT | wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(256),
                },
                count: None,
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 4,
                visibility,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                count: None,
            },
        ];
        for binding in [3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10] {
            entries.push(wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding,
                visibility,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                    sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                    view_dimension: if binding == 10 {
                        wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array
                    } else if binding == 7 || binding == 8 {
                        wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D3
                    } else {
                        wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2
                    },
                    multisampled: false,
                },
                count: None,
            });
        }
        entries
    }

    pub fn bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        crate::atmosphere_table::BYTES
            + self.uniform.size()
            + 9 * 9 * 2 * 8
            + self
                .textures
                .iter()
                .chain(self.staging.iter())
                .map(|t| {
                    let s = t.size();
                    s.width as u64 * s.height as u64 * s.depth_or_array_layers as u64 * 8
                })
                .sum::<u64>()
    }

    pub fn publish(&self, encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, range: std::ops::Range<usize>) {
        for i in range {
            encoder.copy_texture_to_texture(
                self.staging[i].as_image_copy(),
                self.textures[i].as_image_copy(),
                self.textures[i].size(),
            );
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/atmosphere_table.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="98" bytes="3802" original_lines="98" original_bytes="3802" minified="false" sha256="a172e1e51512041e432440be51891998c7d18e7a406bfa8061c2ee56164099f4">>>
//! Camera-independent optical depth table; rebuilt only with the GPU resources.
//! Metres and coefficients here match atmosphere_common.wgsl, regardless of game scale.
use crate::atmosphere::Optics;
use glam::DVec3;

const WIDTH: u32 = 128;
const HEIGHT: u32 = 64;
pub const BYTES: u64 = WIDTH as u64 * HEIGHT as u64 * 8;

pub fn entry() -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding: 1,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
            multisampled: false,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

pub fn create(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue, profile: Optics) -> wgpu::TextureView {
    let pixels = pixels(profile);
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("spherical atmosphere optical depth"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: WIDTH,
            height: HEIGHT,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    queue.write_texture(
        texture.as_image_copy(),
        bytemuck::cast_slice(&pixels),
        wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(WIDTH * 8),
            rows_per_image: Some(HEIGHT),
        },
        texture.size(),
    );
    texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default())
}

fn pixels(profile: Optics) -> Vec<u16> {
    let radius = profile.radius_m;
    let top = profile.atmospheric_top_m;
    let mut pixels = Vec::with_capacity((WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4) as usize);
    for y in 0..HEIGHT {
        let altitude = (f64::from(y) / f64::from(HEIGHT - 1)).powi(2) * top;
        let r = radius + altitude;
        let horizon = -(1.0 - (radius / r).powi(2)).max(0.0).sqrt();
        for x in 0..WIDTH {
            // Allocate most samples near the geometric horizon, including twilight aloft.
            let u = f64::from(x) / f64::from(WIDTH - 1);
            let mu = horizon + (1.0 - horizon) * u * u;
            let length = -r * mu + ((r * mu).powi(2) + (radius + top).powi(2) - r * r).sqrt();
            let mut optical = DVec3::ZERO;
            for step in 0..64 {
                let d = length * (f64::from(step) + 0.5) / 64.0;
                let h = (r * r + d * d + 2.0 * r * mu * d).sqrt() - radius;
                let rayleigh = (-h / profile.rayleigh_scale_height_m).exp();
                let mie = (-h / profile.aerosol_scale_height_m).exp();
                let ozone = (1.0
                    - (h - profile.ozone_peak_height_m).abs() / profile.ozone_half_width_m)
                    .max(0.0);
                optical += (DVec3::from_array(profile.rayleigh_rgb_m_inv) * rayleigh
                    + DVec3::splat(profile.mie_m_inv) * mie
                    + DVec3::from_array(profile.ozone_rgb_m_inv) * ozone)
                    * (length / 64.0);
            }
            pixels.extend(optical.to_array().map(|v| half::f16::from_f64(v).to_bits()));
            pixels.push(0);
        }
    }
    pixels
}

pub fn update(queue: &wgpu::Queue, texture: &wgpu::Texture, profile: Optics) {
    let data = pixels(profile);
    queue.write_texture(
        texture.as_image_copy(),
        bytemuck::cast_slice(&data),
        wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(WIDTH * 8),
            rows_per_image: Some(HEIGHT),
        },
        texture.size(),
    );
}

//! Optional nonblocking GPU timing; no queue waits or synchronous readbacks.
use std::{
    cell::{Cell, RefCell},
    collections::VecDeque,
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicU8, Ordering},
        Arc,
    },
};
pub struct AtmosphereTiming {
    queries: wgpu::QuerySet,
    resolve: wgpu::Buffer,
    readback: wgpu::Buffer,
    period: f32,
    pending: Cell<bool>,
    encoded: Cell<bool>,
    ready: Arc<AtomicU8>,
    history: RefCell<VecDeque<[f64; 3]>>,
    sampled_lut: Cell<bool>,
}
impl AtmosphereTiming {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue) -> Option<Self> {
        if !device.features().contains(wgpu::Features::TIMESTAMP_QUERY) {
            return None;
        }
        let queries = device.create_query_set(&wgpu::QuerySetDescriptor {
            label: Some("atmosphere timestamps"),
            ty: wgpu::QueryType::Timestamp,
            count: 6,
        });
        let make = |usage| {
            device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("atmosphere timestamp buffer"),
                size: 256,
                usage,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            })
        };
        Some(Self {
            queries,
            resolve: make(wgpu::BufferUsages::QUERY_RESOLVE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_SRC),
            readback: make(wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST | wgpu::BufferUsages::MAP_READ),
            period: queue.get_timestamp_period(),
            pending: Cell::new(false),
            encoded: Cell::new(false),
            ready: Arc::new(AtomicU8::new(0)),
            history: RefCell::new(VecDeque::with_capacity(120)),
            sampled_lut: Cell::new(true),
        })
    }
    pub fn compute(&self, index: u32) -> wgpu::ComputePassTimestampWrites<'_> {
        wgpu::ComputePassTimestampWrites {
            query_set: &self.queries,
            beginning_of_pass_write_index: Some(index * 2),
            end_of_pass_write_index: Some(index * 2 + 1),
        }
    }
    pub fn render(&self) -> wgpu::RenderPassTimestampWrites<'_> {
        wgpu::RenderPassTimestampWrites {
            query_set: &self.queries,
            beginning_of_pass_write_index: Some(4),
            end_of_pass_write_index: Some(5),
        }
    }
    pub fn resolve(&self, encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, lut_updated: bool) {
        if self.pending.get() {
            return;
        }
        self.sampled_lut.set(lut_updated);
        encoder.resolve_query_set(&self.queries, 0..6, &self.resolve, 0);
        encoder.copy_buffer_to_buffer(&self.resolve, 0, &self.readback, 0, 48);
        self.encoded.set(true);
    }
    pub fn after_submit(&self) {
        if !self.encoded.replace(false) {
            return;
        }
        self.pending.set(true);
        let ready = self.ready.clone();
        self.readback
            .slice(0..48)
            .map_async(wgpu::MapMode::Read, move |result| {
                ready.store(if result.is_ok() { 1 } else { 2 }, Ordering::Release);
            });
    }
    pub fn poll(&self, device: &wgpu::Device) {
        if !self.pending.get() {
            return;
        }
        let _ = device.poll(wgpu::PollType::Poll);
        let state = self.ready.swap(0, Ordering::AcqRel);
        if state == 0 {
            return;
        }
        if state == 1 {
            if let Ok(bytes) = self.readback.slice(0..48).get_mapped_range() {
                let times: Vec<_> = bytes
                    .chunks_exact(8)
                    .map(|b| u64::from_le_bytes(b.try_into().unwrap()))
                    .collect();
                let values = std::array::from_fn(|i| {
                    if i < 2 && !self.sampled_lut.get() {
                        0.0
                    } else {
                        times[i * 2 + 1].saturating_sub(times[i * 2]) as f64 * self.period as f64
                            / 1e6
                    }
                });
                let mut history = self.history.borrow_mut();
                if history.len() == 120 {
                    history.pop_front();
                }
                history.push_back(values);
            }
            self.readback.unmap();
        }
        self.pending.set(false);
    }
    pub fn status(&self) -> String {
        let history = self.history.borrow();
        if history.is_empty() {
            return "GPU timings: preparing asynchronous samples".into();
        }
        let mut totals: Vec<_> = history.iter().map(|s| s.iter().sum::<f64>()).collect();
        totals.sort_by(f64::total_cmp);
        format!("atmosphere GPU median={:.3}ms p95={:.3}ms samples={} (sky LUT + aerial LUT + composite)",
            totals[totals.len()/2],totals[((totals.len()-1) as f64*0.95).ceil() as usize],totals.len())
    }
}

//! Pure camera/optical-scale preparation, independent of the player observer.
use crate::{AtmosphereUniform, RenderViewFrame};
use glam::DVec3;
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct WeatherEndpoints {
    pub utc: f64,
    pub center: DVec3,
    pub values: [[f32; 4]; 2],
    pub basis: [[f32; 4]; 3],
    pub has_fog: bool,
}
impl WeatherEndpoints {
    pub fn from_grid(grid: &crate::surface_cover::CoverGrid) -> Self {
        Self {
            utc: grid.start_utc,
            center: DVec3::new(
                grid.center[0] as f64,
                grid.center[1] as f64,
                grid.center[2] as f64,
            ),
            values: grid.atmosphere_weather,
            basis: [grid.center, grid.east, grid.north],
            has_fog: grid
                .fog_pixels
                .iter()
                .any(|p| p[0].to_f32() + p[3].to_f32() > 1e-8),
        }
    }
}
pub fn prepare(
    view: RenderViewFrame,
    radius: f64,
    length_scale: f64,
    standard: bool,
    utc: f64,
    weather: Option<&WeatherEndpoints>,
    debug: u32,
    enabled: bool,
) -> AtmosphereUniform {
    let p = crate::atmosphere::EARTH;
    let scale = 1.0 / length_scale.clamp(0.001, 1.0);
    let eye = DVec3::from_array(view.camera_eye_world_m);
    let up = eye.normalize_or_zero();
    let h = ((eye.length() - radius) * scale).max(-12000.0);
    let optical_radius = (radius * scale).max(1.0);
    let relative = eye - DVec3::from_array(view.render_origin_m);
    let mut basis = [[0.0; 4]; 3];
    let mut fog_time = [0.0; 4];
    if let Some(w) = weather {
        basis = w.basis;
        let phase = ((utc - w.utc) / 3600.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
        let age = ((utc - w.utc - 3600.0) / 3600.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
        fog_time = [
            phase,
            if utc >= w.utc {
                1.0 - age * age * (3.0 - 2.0 * age)
            } else {
                0.0
            },
            f32::from(w.has_fog),
            0.0,
        ];
    }
    AtmosphereUniform {
        radii: [
            optical_radius as f32,
            p.atmospheric_top_m as f32,
            p.rayleigh_scale_height_m as f32,
            p.aerosol_scale_height_m as f32,
        ],
        rayleigh: [
            p.rayleigh_rgb_m_inv[0] as f32,
            p.rayleigh_rgb_m_inv[1] as f32,
            p.rayleigh_rgb_m_inv[2] as f32,
            0.0,
        ],
        mie: [
            p.mie_m_inv as f32,
            p.mie_anisotropy as f32,
            p.ozone_half_width_m as f32,
            0.0,
        ],
        ozone: [
            p.ozone_rgb_m_inv[0] as f32,
            p.ozone_rgb_m_inv[1] as f32,
            p.ozone_rgb_m_inv[2] as f32,
            p.ozone_peak_height_m as f32,
        ],
        config: [
            radius as f32,
            scale as f32,
            f32::from(standard),
            f32::from(enabled),
        ],
        up_height: up.as_vec3().extend(h as f32).to_array(),
        eye_relative: relative
            .as_vec3()
            .extend(
                (300000.0_f64.max(2.0 * (2.0 * optical_radius * h.max(0.0)).sqrt())).min(3e7)
                    as f32,
            )
            .to_array(),
        weather: [0.0, 100.0, 0.0, debug as f32],
        fog_center: basis[0],
        fog_east: basis[1],
        fog_north: basis[2],
        fog_time,
        inverse_view_projection: glam::Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&view.view_projection)
            .inverse()
            .to_cols_array_2d(),
    }
}

/// Transforms a world-space observer position into the catalogue epoch frame.
pub fn observer_epoch_position(sky: &SkyState, observer_world_m: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|column| {
        (0..3)

use std::borrow::Cow;

pub struct CelestialHaloGpu {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
}

impl CelestialHaloGpu {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        frame_layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> Self {
        let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("celestial-halo-frame-layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame_layout)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("celestial-halo-shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(Cow::Owned(crate::shader_source::celestial_halo())),
        });
        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("celestial-halo-pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                buffers: &[],
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState {
                        color: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                            src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                            dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                            operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
                        },
                        alpha: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                            src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::Zero,
                            dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                            operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
                        },
                    }),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                cull_mode: None,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
                depth_write_enabled: Some(false),
                depth_compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::Always),
                stencil: Default::default(),
                bias: Default::default(),
            }),
            multisample: Default::default(),
            multiview_mask: None,
            cache: None,
        });
        Self { pipeline }
    }

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/cloud_gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="217" bytes="7832" original_lines="217" original_bytes="7832" minified="false" sha256="78c04538cce2f38cd703030d6f9f6c409fc407297217cb8e828b69b242a475df">>>
use crate::{
    cloud_face::{CloudFace as Face, MAX_CLOUD_FACES},
    cloud_pipeline,
    cloud_targets::CloudTargets,
    cloud_uniform::{CloudRecord, CloudUniform},
};
use minimium_environment::weather::MAX_CLOUDS;

const _: () = assert!(std::mem::size_of::<Face>() == 48);

pub struct CloudGpu {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub debug_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub composite_pipeline: Option<wgpu::RenderPipeline>,
    pub group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub targets: Option<CloudTargets>,
    pub uniform: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub records: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub faces: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub count: u32,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub debug: bool,
    pub oit: bool,
    layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    composite_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl CloudGpu {
    pub const BUFFER_BYTES: u64 = (MAX_CLOUD_FACES * 48 + MAX_CLOUDS * 80 + 256) as u64;

    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        adapter: &wgpu::Adapter,
        frame: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
        size: [u32; 2],
    ) -> Self {
        let oit = [
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
        ]
        .iter()
        .all(|format| {
            let f = adapter.get_texture_format_features(*format);
            f.allowed_usages.contains(
                wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            ) && f.flags.contains(wgpu::TextureFormatFeatureFlags::BLENDABLE)
        }) && device.limits().max_color_attachment_bytes_per_sample >= 10;
        let buffer = |label, size, usage| {
            device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some(label),
                size,
                usage: usage | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            })
        };
        let uniform = buffer("cloud uniform", 256, wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM);
        let records = buffer(
            "cloud transforms",
            (MAX_CLOUDS * 80) as u64,
            wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE,
        );
        let faces = buffer(
            "bounded greedy cloud faces",
            (MAX_CLOUD_FACES * 48) as u64,
            wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX,
        );
        let layout = cloud_pipeline::layout(device);
        let composite_layout = crate::cloud_targets::layout(device);
        let group = cloud_pipeline::group(device, &layout, &uniform, &records, depth);
        let pipeline = cloud_pipeline::create(device, frame, &layout, format, oit, false);
        let debug_pipeline = cloud_pipeline::create(device, frame, &layout, format, false, true);
        let composite_pipeline =
            oit.then(|| cloud_pipeline::composite(device, &composite_layout, format));
        let targets = oit.then(|| CloudTargets::new(device, &composite_layout, [size[0], size[1]]));
        Self {
            pipeline,
            debug_pipeline,
            composite_pipeline,
            group,
            targets,
            uniform,
            records,
            faces,
            count: 0,
            revision: 0,
            debug: false,
            oit,
            layout,
            composite_layout,
        }
    }

    pub fn update_faces(&mut self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, faces: &[Face], revision: u64) {
        if self.revision == revision {
            return;
        }
        if !faces.is_empty() {
            queue.write_buffer(&self.faces, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(faces));
        }
        self.count = faces.len() as u32;
        self.revision = revision;
    }

    pub fn upload_frame(
        &self,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        records: &[CloudRecord],
        uniform: &CloudUniform,
    ) {
        if !records.is_empty() {
            queue.write_buffer(&self.records, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(records));
        }
        queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(uniform));
    }

    /// Encodes the cloud face, transparency composite and optional debug passes.
    pub fn encode(
        &self,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        scene: &wgpu::TextureView,
        camera: &wgpu::BindGroup,
        scene_visible: bool,
    ) -> u32 {
        if !scene_visible || (self.count == 0 && !self.debug) {
            return 0;
        }
        let mut draws = 0;
        if self.count > 0 {
            let attachments = if let Some(targets) = &self.targets {
                vec![
                    color_attachment(
                        &targets.accum,
                        wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),
                    ),
                    color_attachment(&targets.reveal, wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::WHITE)),
                ]
            } else {
                vec![color_attachment(scene, wgpu::LoadOp::Load)]
            };
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("regional cube clouds"),
                color_attachments: &attachments,
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
                multiview_mask: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, camera, &[]);
            pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.group, &[]);
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.faces.slice(..));
            pass.draw(0..6, 0..self.count);
            draws += 1;
        }
        if self.count > 0 {
            if let (Some(pipeline), Some(targets)) = (&self.composite_pipeline, &self.targets) {
                let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("cloud transparency composite"),
                    color_attachments: &[color_attachment(scene, wgpu::LoadOp::Load)],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                    multiview_mask: None,
                });
                pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
                pass.set_bind_group(0, &targets.group, &[]);
                pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
                draws += 1;
            }
        }
        if self.debug {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("weather regions and wind"),
                color_attachments: &[color_attachment(scene, wgpu::LoadOp::Load)],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
                multiview_mask: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.debug_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, camera, &[]);
            pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.group, &[]);
            pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            draws += 1;
        }
        draws
    }

    pub fn resize(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, depth: &wgpu::TextureView, size: [u32; 2]) {
        self.group =
            cloud_pipeline::group(device, &self.layout, &self.uniform, &self.records, depth);
        self.targets = self
            .oit
            .then(|| CloudTargets::new(device, &self.composite_layout, [size[0], size[1]]));
    }

    pub fn bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        Self::BUFFER_BYTES + self.targets.as_ref().map_or(0, |t| t.bytes)
    }
}

fn color_attachment(
    view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    load: wgpu::LoadOp<wgpu::Color>,
) -> Option<wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment<'_>> {
    Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
        view,
        depth_slice: None,
        resolve_target: None,
        ops: wgpu::Operations {
            load,
            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
        },
    })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/cloud_mesh.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="120" bytes="4822" original_lines="120" original_bytes="4822" minified="false" sha256="5a2d19eb681f551dba0c056bf751a9f2c4570ae9f893a0a3f07a2cede7d021ff">>>
use crate::{
    cloud_voxels::{Voxels, COVERAGE},
    CloudFace as Face,
};
use minimium_environment::weather::Cloud;

/// Signed endpoint differences expose a face as its neighbour disappears.
/// The shader interpolates before clamping, including sign changes in a window.
pub fn build(cloud: Cloud, cells: &Voxels, limit: usize) -> Option<Vec<Face>> {
    let mut faces = Vec::new();
    let dims = cells.dims;
    for axis in 0..3 {
        let u = (axis + 1) % 3;
        let v = (axis + 2) % 3;
        for slice in 0..=dims[axis] {
            for sign in [-1, 1] {
                let mut mask = vec![[0_i8; 2]; dims[u] * dims[v]];
                for j in 0..dims[v] {
                    for i in 0..dims[u] {
                        let mut p = [0; 3];
                        p[u] = i;
                        p[v] = j;
                        p[axis] = slice.saturating_sub(1);
                        let a = if slice > 0 { cells.at(p) } else { [0; 2] };
                        p[axis] = slice.min(dims[axis] - 1);
                        let b = if slice < dims[axis] {
                            cells.at(p)
                        } else {
                            [0; 2]
                        };
                        let delta = std::array::from_fn(|t| (a[t] as i8 - b[t] as i8) * sign);
                        if delta.iter().any(|d| *d > 0) {
                            mask[j * dims[u] + i] = delta;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for j in 0..dims[v] {
                    let mut i = 0;
                    while i < dims[u] {
                        let value = mask[j * dims[u] + i];
                        if value == [0; 2] {
                            i += 1;
                            continue;
                        }
                        let mut width = 1;
                        while i + width < dims[u] && mask[j * dims[u] + i + width] == value {
                            width += 1;
                        }
                        let mut height = 1;
                        while j + height < dims[v]
                            && (0..width).all(|k| mask[(j + height) * dims[u] + i + k] == value)
                        {
                            height += 1;
                        }
                        if faces.len() >= limit {
                            return None;
                        }
                        let mut center = [0.0; 4];
                        center[axis] = slice as f32;
                        center[u] = i as f32 + width as f32 * 0.5;
                        center[v] = j as f32 + height as f32 * 0.5;
                        for coordinate in &mut center[..3] {
                            *coordinate *= cells.cell as f32;
                        }
                        center[0] -= cloud.size_m.x as f32 * 0.5;
                        center[2] -= cloud.size_m.z as f32 * 0.5;
                        let mut du = [0.0; 4];
                        let mut dv = [0.0; 4];
                        du[u] = width as f32 * cells.cell as f32 * 0.5 * f32::from(sign);
                        dv[v] = height as f32 * cells.cell as f32 * 0.5;
                        du[3] = f32::from(value[0]) / COVERAGE;
                        dv[3] = f32::from(value[1]) / COVERAGE;
                        faces.push(Face {
                            center,
                            u: du,
                            v: dv,
                        });
                        for row in j..j + height {
                            for col in i..i + width {
                                mask[row * dims[u] + col] = [0; 2];
                            }
                        }
                        i += width;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Some(faces)
}

/// Emergency six-face representation of the same bounded volume. Coverage is
/// derived from its sampled field, never from a new seed or a new population.
pub fn envelope(cloud: Cloud, coverage: [f32; 2]) -> Vec<Face> {
    let mut faces = Vec::with_capacity(6);
    if coverage == [0.0; 2] {
        return faces;
    }
    let size = cloud.size_m.as_vec3().to_array();
    for axis in 0..3 {
        let u = (axis + 1) % 3;
        let v = (axis + 2) % 3;
        for sign in [-1.0, 1.0] {
            let mut center = [0.0, size[1] * 0.5, 0.0, 0.0];
            center[axis] += size[axis] * 0.5 * sign;
            let mut du = [0.0; 4];
            let mut dv = [0.0; 4];
            du[u] = size[u] * 0.5 * sign;
            dv[v] = size[v] * 0.5;
            du[3] = coverage[0];
            dv[3] = coverage[1];
            faces.push(Face {
                center,
                u: du,
                v: dv,
            });
        }
    }
    faces
}

use crate::CloudFace;

pub fn layout(device: &wgpu::Device) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
    let buffer = |binding, ty, size| wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty,
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(size),
        },
        count: None,
    };
    device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("regional cloud resources"),
        entries: &[
            buffer(0, wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, 256),
            buffer(1, wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true }, 80),
            wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 2,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                    sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                    view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                    multisampled: false,
                },
                count: None,
            },
        ],
    })
}

pub fn group(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    uniform: &wgpu::Buffer,
    records: &wgpu::Buffer,
    depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
    device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
        label: Some("regional cloud frame"),
        layout,
        entries: &[
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: uniform.as_entire_binding(),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 1,
                resource: records.as_entire_binding(),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 2,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(depth),
            },
        ],
    })
}

pub fn create(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    frame: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    cloud: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    oit: bool,
    debug: bool,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("cloud pipeline layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame), Some(cloud)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("cube cloud shader"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::shader_source::clouds().into()),
    });
    let additive = wgpu::BlendComponent {
        src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
        dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
        operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
    };
    let reveal = wgpu::BlendComponent {
        src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::Zero,
        dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::OneMinusSrc,
        operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
    };
    let target = |format, blend| {
        Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
            format,
            blend: Some(blend),
            write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
        })
    };
    let targets = if oit {
        vec![
            target(
                wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
                wgpu::BlendState {
                    color: additive,
                    alpha: additive,
                },
            ),
            target(
                wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
                wgpu::BlendState {
                    color: reveal,
                    alpha: reveal,
                },
            ),
        ]
    } else {
        vec![target(format, wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING)]
    };
    let buffers = [Some(wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
        array_stride: std::mem::size_of::<CloudFace>() as u64,
        step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Instance,
        attributes: &wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x4, 1 => Float32x4, 2 => Float32x4],
    })];
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("cube clouds"),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some(if debug { "vs_debug" } else { "vs_cloud" }),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            buffers: if debug { &[] } else { &buffers },
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some(if debug {
                "fs_debug"
            } else if oit {
                "fs_oit"
            } else {
                "fs_alpha"
            }),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            targets: &targets,
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            cull_mode: None,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview_mask: None,
        cache: None,
    })
}

pub fn composite(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    textures: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("cloud composite layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(textures)],
        immediate_size: 0,

        label: Some("cloud composite shader"),

    });
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("cloud OIT resolve"),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            buffers: &[],
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
        }),
        primitive: Default::default(),
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview_mask: None,
        cache: None,
    })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/cloud_targets.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="84" bytes="3136" original_lines="84" original_bytes="3136" minified="false" sha256="b6b98e283b9b22ce4509096b2532a4f59c93e7dec7a5b82bccb86a1dae7c17ca">>>
pub const MAX_TARGET_BYTES: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

pub struct CloudTargets {
    pub accum: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub reveal: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub bytes: u64,
    pub size: [u32; 2],
}

pub fn layout(device: &wgpu::Device) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
    let entries: Vec<_> = (0..2)
        .map(|binding| wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
            binding,
            visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
            ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                multisampled: false,
            },
            count: None,
        })
        .collect();
    device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("cloud OIT composition"),
        entries: &entries,
    })
}

impl CloudTargets {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout, size: [u32; 2]) -> Self {
        // Only target resolution degrades; cloud identity and voxel population do not.
        let factor = ((size[0] as f64 * size[1] as f64 * 10.0 / MAX_TARGET_BYTES as f64).sqrt())
            .max(size[0].max(size[1]) as f64 / device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d as f64)
            .max(1.0);
        let width = (size[0] as f64 / factor).floor().max(1.0) as u32;
        let height = (size[1] as f64 / factor).floor().max(1.0) as u32;
        let texture = |label, format| {
            device
                .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
                    label: Some(label),
                    size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                        width,
                        height,
                        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
                    },
                    mip_level_count: 1,
                    sample_count: 1,
                    dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
                    format,
                    usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
                        | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
                    view_formats: &[],
                })
                .create_view(&Default::default())
        };
        let accum = texture(
            "cloud weighted accumulation",
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
        );
        let reveal = texture("cloud revealage", wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float);
        let group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("cloud OIT textures"),
            layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&accum),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&reveal),
                },
            ],
        });
        Self {
            accum,
            reveal,
            group,
            bytes: u64::from(width) * u64::from(height) * 10,
            size: [width, height],
        }
    }

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/cloud_voxels.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="139" bytes="6083" original_lines="139" original_bytes="6083" minified="false" sha256="7c6e505a91a95640d7e248f81823cf6ca4a6524c6a7869de2ab335fbbeb62dd8">>>
//! Sparse 8^3 bricks. Uniform dyadic level within a cloud avoids LOD seams.
use glam::DVec3;
use minimium_environment::weather::{Cloud, DensityField};

const SIDE: usize = 8;
const CELLS: usize = SIDE * SIDE * SIDE;
pub const COVERAGE: f32 = 15.0;
pub type Pair = [u8; 2];

pub struct Voxels {
    pub dims: [usize; 3],
    pub cell: f64,
    pub bricks: usize,
    pub mean: [f32; 2],
    blocks: Vec<Option<Box<[Pair; CELLS]>>>,
    counts: [usize; 3],
}

impl Voxels {
    pub fn build(cloud: Cloud, level: u8, start: f64, step: f64) -> Self {
        let (dims, cell) = cloud.grid(level);
        let counts = dims.map(|n| n.div_ceil(SIDE));
        let mut result = Self {
            dims,
            cell,
            bricks: 0,
            mean: [0.0; 2],
            blocks: vec![None; counts.iter().product()],
            counts,
        };
        let fields = [
            DensityField::new(cloud, start),
            DensityField::new(cloud, start + step),
        ];
        for bz in 0..counts[2] {
            for by in 0..counts[1] {
                for bx in 0..counts[0] {
                    let mut data = [[0; 2]; CELLS];
                    let mut active = false;
                    for z in 0..SIDE {
                        for y in 0..SIDE {
                            for x in 0..SIDE {
                                let p = [bx * SIDE + x, by * SIDE + y, bz * SIDE + z];
                                if (0..3).any(|i| p[i] >= dims[i]) {
                                    continue;
                                }
                                let local = DVec3::new(
                                    p[0] as f64 + 0.5,
                                    p[1] as f64 + 0.5,
                                    p[2] as f64 + 0.5,
                                ) * cell
                                    - cloud.size_m * DVec3::new(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
                                let pair = std::array::from_fn(|t| {
                                    let density = if level == cloud.min_level {
                                        // Area samples preserve narrow filaments on the coarsest grid.
                                        let mut sum = 0.0;
                                        for dz in [-0.25, 0.25] {
                                            for dx in [-0.25, 0.25] {
                                                sum += fields[t]
                                                    .sample(local + DVec3::new(dx, 0.0, dz) * cell);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        sum * 0.25
                                    } else {
                                        fields[t].sample(local)
                                    };
                                    (density * f64::from(COVERAGE)).round() as u8
                                });
                                result.mean[0] += f32::from(pair[0]);
                                result.mean[1] += f32::from(pair[1]);
                                active |= pair != [0; 2];
                                data[(z * SIDE + y) * SIDE + x] = pair;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if active {
                        let index = (bz * counts[1] + by) * counts[0] + bx;
                        result.blocks[index] = Some(Box::new(data));
                        result.bricks += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let denominator = dims.iter().product::<usize>() as f32 * COVERAGE;
        result.mean = result.mean.map(|v| v / denominator);
        result
    }

    pub fn at(&self, p: [usize; 3]) -> Pair {
        let b = p.map(|n| n / SIDE);
        let index = (b[2] * self.counts[1] + b[1]) * self.counts[0] + b[0];
        self.blocks[index].as_ref().map_or([0; 2], |data| {
            data[((p[2] % SIDE) * SIDE + p[1] % SIDE) * SIDE + p[0] % SIDE]
        })
    }

    /// Aggregate dyadic blocks of the original lattice; keep physical bounds,
    /// mean coverage and IDs. No sampling or generation of replacement clouds.
    pub fn simplify(&mut self, stride: usize) {
        for z in (0..self.dims[2]).step_by(stride) {
            for y in (0..self.dims[1]).step_by(stride) {
                for x in (0..self.dims[0]).step_by(stride) {
                    let end = [x, y, z].map(|n| n + stride);
                    let end = std::array::from_fn::<_, 3, _>(|i| end[i].min(self.dims[i]));
                    let mut sum = [0_u32; 2];
                    let count = (end[0] - x) * (end[1] - y) * (end[2] - z);
                    for k in z..end[2] {
                        for j in y..end[1] {
                            for i in x..end[0] {
                                let value = self.at([i, j, k]);
                                for t in 0..2 {
                                    sum[t] += u32::from(value[t]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    let value = sum.map(|v| ((v as f64 / count as f64).round()) as u8);
                    for k in z..end[2] {
                        for j in y..end[1] {
                            for i in x..end[0] {
                                self.set([i, j, k], value);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn set(&mut self, p: [usize; 3], value: Pair) {
        let b = p.map(|n| n / SIDE);
        let index = (b[2] * self.counts[1] + b[1]) * self.counts[0] + b[0];
        if self.blocks[index].is_none() && value == [0; 2] {
            return;
        }
        let data = self.blocks[index].get_or_insert_with(|| Box::new([[0; 2]; CELLS]));
        data[((p[2] % SIDE) * SIDE + p[1] % SIDE) * SIDE + p[0] % SIDE] = value;
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/coast_probe.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="79" bytes="2608" original_lines="79" original_bytes="2608" minified="false" sha256="ad04154a64d2bf25a23b6e258f05101684f5d9e02b22eaac229f448ba0e129c0">>>
//! Cached presentation classification on the same lattice as dense render blocks.
//! Five corner/centre samples alone can miss whole islands or narrow channels.
use minimium_procgen::PlanetTerrain;
use minimium_world::world::{PlanetFace, PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE};
use std::collections::HashMap;

const MAX_PROBES: usize = 2048;
const STEPS: i64 = minimium_procgen::PLANET_RENDER_BLOCK_SUBDIVISIONS as i64;
type Key = (PlanetFace, u16, u16, u16);

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) enum SurfaceClass {
    Land,
    Ocean,
    Coast,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct CoastProbeCache {
    entries: HashMap<Key, (u64, SurfaceClass)>,
    tick: u64,
}

impl CoastProbeCache {
    pub fn classify(&mut self, terrain: &PlanetTerrain, key: Key, count: u16) -> SurfaceClass {
        self.tick = self.tick.wrapping_add(1);
        if let Some((age, class)) = self.entries.get_mut(&key) {
            *age = self.tick;
            return *class;
        }
        let class = classify(terrain, key, count);
        if self.entries.len() >= MAX_PROBES {
            if let Some(oldest) = self
                .entries
                .iter()
                .min_by_key(|(_, v)| v.0)
                .map(|(k, _)| *k)
            {
                self.entries.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        self.entries.insert(key, (self.tick, class));
        class
    }
}

fn classify(terrain: &PlanetTerrain, (face, u, v, span): Key, count: u16) -> SurfaceClass {
    let scale = i64::from(PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE);
    let coordinate = |start: u16, step: i64| {
        (-scale
            + 2 * scale * (i64::from(start) * STEPS + i64::from(span) * step)
                / (i64::from(count) * STEPS)) as i32
    };
    let mut land = false;
    let mut ocean = false;
    for y in 0..=STEPS {
        for x in 0..=STEPS {
            let key = face
                .cube_sample(coordinate(u, x), coordinate(v, y))
                .expect("valid render block lattice");
            // Coast identity is independent of peak exaggeration and tiny relief.
            // Direct source sampling avoids full material/normal/noise evaluation.
            let water = terrain
                .source_elevation_m(key.coordinates().map(f64::from))
                .expect("Earth coast probes require prepared geography")
                < 0.0;
            ocean |= water;
            land |= !water;
            if land && ocean {
                return SurfaceClass::Coast;
            }
        }
    }
    if land {
        SurfaceClass::Land
    } else {
        SurfaceClass::Ocean
    }
}

use crate::geometry::Vertex;

pub struct EnvironmentPipelines {
    pub sky: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub sun: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub marker: wgpu::RenderPipeline,

struct PipelineConfig {
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    label: &'static str,
    vertex_layout: Option<wgpu::VertexBufferLayout<'static>>,
    depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction,
    depth_write: bool,
    blend: Option<wgpu::BlendState>,
}

impl EnvironmentPipelines {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        frame_layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        milky_way_layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> Self {
        let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("environment-frame-pipeline-layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame_layout)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let sky_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("sky-with-milky-way-pipeline-layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame_layout), Some(milky_way_layout)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let sky = create_pipeline(
            device,
            &sky_layout,
            Cow::Owned(crate::shader_source::sky()),
            PipelineConfig {
                format,
                label: "clear-sky-pipeline",
                vertex_layout: None,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::Always,
                depth_write: false,
                blend: None,
            },
        );
        let sun = create_pipeline(
            device,
            &layout,
            Cow::Owned(crate::shader_source::sun()),
            PipelineConfig {
                format,
                label: "sun-disk-pipeline",
                vertex_layout: None,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::Always,
                depth_write: false,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
            },
        );
        let marker = create_pipeline(
            device,
            &layout,
            Cow::Owned(crate::shader_source::marker()),
            PipelineConfig {
                format,
                label: "overview-marker-pipeline",
                vertex_layout: Some(Vertex::layout()),
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                depth_write: true,
                blend: None,
            },
        );
        Self { sky, sun, marker }
    }
}

fn create_pipeline(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::PipelineLayout,
    source: Cow<'static, str>,
    config: PipelineConfig,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some(config.label),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(source),
    });
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some(config.label),
        layout: Some(layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            buffers: &[config.vertex_layout],
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format: config.format,
                blend: config.blend,
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
            cull_mode: None,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
            depth_write_enabled: Some(config.depth_write),
            depth_compare: Some(config.depth_compare),
            stencil: Default::default(),
            bias: Default::default(),
        }),
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview_mask: None,
        cache: None,
    })
}

//! Final presentation passes shared by client render adapters.

use crate::{
    cloud_gpu::CloudGpu,
    scene_encoder::{self, MainScenePass, SceneDrawStats},
    ShadowGpu,
};
use minimium_world::world::{SectorKey, WorldInstanceId};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// GPU handles for the UI and output passes of one prepared frame.
pub struct FinalPasses<'a> {
    pub scene_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub surface_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub ui_pipeline: &'a wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub ui_output_pipeline: Option<&'a wgpu::RenderPipeline>,
    pub ui_bind_group: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub ui_vertex_buffer: &'a wgpu::Buffer,
    pub ui_vertex_count: u32,
    pub output: Option<&'a crate::OutputEncoder>,
}

/// Client-selected shadow caster buffers passed to the renderer encoder.
pub struct ShadowPass<'a> {
    pub gpu: &'a ShadowGpu,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub instance: WorldInstanceId,
    pub keys: &'a [(SectorKey, u8)],
    pub world_vertices: &'a HashMap<(WorldInstanceId, SectorKey, u8), (wgpu::Buffer, u32)>,
    pub map: Option<(&'a wgpu::Buffer, u32)>,
    pub player: Option<(&'a wgpu::Buffer, u32)>,
}

/// Inputs for encoding all renderer passes for one frame in their stable order.
pub struct FramePasses<'a> {
    pub shadow: ShadowPass<'a>,
    pub scene: MainScenePass<'a>,
    pub clouds: &'a CloudGpu,
    pub final_passes: FinalPasses<'a>,
}

/// Encoded pass draw counts used by the client diagnostics adapter.
pub struct FrameDrawStats {
    pub shadow: u32,
    pub scene: SceneDrawStats,
    pub atmosphere: u32,
    pub clouds: u32,
    pub final_passes: u32,
}

/// Encodes shadow, scene, atmosphere, cloud, overlay and output passes in order.
pub fn encode_frame(encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, frame: FramePasses<'_>) -> FrameDrawStats {
    let shadow_casters = frame.shadow.keys.iter().filter_map(|(key, lod)| {
        frame
            .shadow
            .world_vertices
            .get(&(frame.shadow.instance, *key, *lod))
            .map(|(buffer, count)| (buffer, *count))
    });
    let shadow_draws = frame.shadow.gpu.encode_depth_pass(
        encoder,
        shadow_casters
            .chain(frame.shadow.map.into_iter())
            .chain(frame.shadow.player.into_iter()),
        frame.shadow.enabled,
    );
    if frame.scene.scene_visible {
        frame.scene.atmosphere.prepare(encoder, frame.scene.camera);
    }
    let scene = scene_encoder::encode_main_scene_pass(encoder, frame.scene);
    let atmosphere = frame.scene.atmosphere.encode(
        encoder,
        frame.scene.color_view,
        frame.scene.camera,
        frame.final_passes.output.map(|o| o.texture()),
        frame.scene.scene_visible && frame.scene.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug[0] == 0,
    );
    let clouds = frame.clouds.encode(
        encoder,
        frame.scene.color_view,
        frame.scene.camera,
        frame.scene.scene_visible
            && frame.scene.terrain_gpu.uniform.debug[0] == 0
            && frame.scene.atmosphere.debug == 0,
    );
    let final_passes = encode_final_passes(encoder, frame.final_passes);
    FrameDrawStats {
        shadow: shadow_draws,
        scene,
        atmosphere,
        clouds,
        final_passes,
    }
}

/// Encodes overlay, scene-output and surface-overlay passes in their stable order.
pub fn encode_final_passes(encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, frame: FinalPasses<'_>) -> u32 {
    let mut draws = 0;
    if frame.ui_vertex_count > 0 && frame.ui_output_pipeline.is_none() {
        let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("minimium-console-ui-pass"),
            color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                view: frame.scene_view,
                depth_slice: None,
                resolve_target: None,
                ops: wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                },
            })],
            depth_stencil_attachment: None,
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
            multiview_mask: None,
        });
        pass.set_pipeline(frame.ui_pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, frame.ui_bind_group, &[]);
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, frame.ui_vertex_buffer.slice(..));
        pass.draw(0..frame.ui_vertex_count, 0..1);
        draws += 1;
    }
    if let Some(output) = frame.output {
        let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("linear-output-srgb-encode-pass"),
            color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                view: frame.surface_view,
                depth_slice: None,
                resolve_target: None,
                ops: wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                },
            })],
            depth_stencil_attachment: None,
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
            multiview_mask: None,
        });
        pass.set_pipeline(output.pipeline());
        pass.set_bind_group(0, output.bind_group(), &[]);
        pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        draws += 1;
    }
    if frame.ui_vertex_count > 0 {
        if let Some(pipeline) = frame.ui_output_pipeline {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("minimium-console-ui-output-pass"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: frame.surface_view,
                    depth_slice: None,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
                multiview_mask: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, frame.ui_bind_group, &[]);
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, frame.ui_vertex_buffer.slice(..));
            pass.draw(0..frame.ui_vertex_count, 0..1);
            draws += 1;
        }
    }
    draws
}

use minimium_world::world::{MapBox, MapTriangle};

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct Vertex {
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub color: [f32; 3],
    pub normal: [f32; 3],
}

impl Vertex {
    const ATTRIBUTES: [wgpu::VertexAttribute; 3] =
        wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x3, 1 => Float32x3, 2 => Float32x3];
    pub fn layout() -> wgpu::VertexBufferLayout<'static> {
        wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
            array_stride: std::mem::size_of::<Self>() as wgpu::BufferAddress,
            step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex,
            attributes: &Self::ATTRIBUTES,
        }
    }
}

pub fn sector_geometry(geometry: &minimium_procgen::SectorGeometry) -> Vec<Vertex> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(geometry.boxes.len() * 36 + geometry.triangles.len() * 3);
    append_geometry(&mut out, &geometry.boxes, &geometry.triangles);
    out
}

pub fn sector_geometry_relative(
    geometry: &minimium_procgen::SectorGeometry,
    origin: [f32; 3],
) -> Vec<Vertex> {
    let mut vertices = sector_geometry(geometry);
    for vertex in &mut vertices {
        for (coordinate, origin) in vertex.position.iter_mut().zip(origin) {
            *coordinate = (f64::from(*coordinate) - f64::from(origin)) as f32;
        }
    }
    for (triangle, rendered) in geometry.triangles.iter().zip(
        vertices[geometry.boxes.len() * 36..]
            .as_chunks_mut::<3>()
            .0
            .iter_mut(),
    ) {
        if let Some(precise) = triangle.precise_vertices {
            for (point, vertex) in precise.iter().zip(rendered.iter_mut()) {
                vertex.position = std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
                    (point[axis] as f64 / 1000.0 - f64::from(origin[axis])) as f32
                });
            }
        }
    }
    vertices
}

fn append_geometry(out: &mut Vec<Vertex>, boxes: &[MapBox], triangles: &[MapTriangle]) {
    for map_box in boxes {
        cube(out, map_box.center, map_box.size, map_box.color);
    }
    // Preserve source triangle winding: procedural planet surfaces already face outward,
    // while authored and dungeon surfaces use their own upward/side-face semantics.
    for triangle in triangles {
        let points = triangle
            .precise_vertices
            .map(|vertices| vertices.map(|point| point.map(|value| value as f64 / 1000.0)))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| triangle.vertices.map(|point| point.map(f64::from)));
        let a = glam::DVec3::from_array(points[0]);
        let b = glam::DVec3::from_array(points[1]);
        let c = glam::DVec3::from_array(points[2]);
        let normal = (b - a)
            .cross(c - a)
            .normalize_or_zero()
            .as_vec3()
            .to_array();
        for position in triangle.vertices {
            out.push(Vertex {
                position,
                color: triangle.color,
                normal,
            });
        }
    }
}

pub fn cube(out: &mut Vec<Vertex>, center: [f32; 3], size: [f32; 3], color: [f32; 3]) {
    let [cx, cy, cz] = center;
    let [sx, sy, sz] = [size[0] * 0.5, size[1] * 0.5, size[2] * 0.5];
    let p = [
        [cx - sx, cy - sy, cz - sz],
        [cx + sx, cy - sy, cz - sz],
        [cx + sx, cy + sy, cz - sz],
        [cx - sx, cy + sy, cz - sz],
        [cx - sx, cy - sy, cz + sz],
        [cx + sx, cy - sy, cz + sz],
        [cx + sx, cy + sy, cz + sz],
        [cx - sx, cy + sy, cz + sz],
    ];
    for face in [
        [0, 2, 1, 0, 3, 2],
        [5, 7, 4, 5, 6, 7],
        [4, 3, 0, 4, 7, 3],
        [1, 6, 5, 1, 2, 6],
        [3, 6, 2, 3, 7, 6],
        [4, 1, 5, 4, 0, 1],
    ] {
        let a = glam::Vec3::from_array(p[face[0]]);
        let b = glam::Vec3::from_array(p[face[1]]);
        let c = glam::Vec3::from_array(p[face[2]]);
        let normal = (b - a).cross(c - a).normalize_or_zero().to_array();
        for index in face {
            out.push(Vertex {
                position: p[index],
                color,
                normal,
            });
        }
    }
}

//! Reusable dynamic vertex buffer owned by the renderer.
use crate::geometry::Vertex;
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

pub struct StaticVertexBuffer {
    buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    vertex_count: u32,
}

impl StaticVertexBuffer {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, vertices: &[Vertex]) -> Self {
        let buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
            label: Some(label),
            contents: bytemuck::cast_slice(vertices),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX,
        });
        Self {
            buffer,
            vertex_count: vertices.len() as u32,
        }
    }

    pub fn buffer(&self) -> &wgpu::Buffer {
        &self.buffer
    }

    pub fn vertex_count(&self) -> u32 {
        self.vertex_count
    }

    pub fn size_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.buffer.size()
    }
}
pub struct DynamicVertexBuffer {
    buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    vertex_count: u32,
}

impl DynamicVertexBuffer {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, capacity: usize) -> Self {
        let buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some(label),
            size: (capacity * std::mem::size_of::<Vertex>()) as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        Self {
            buffer,
            vertex_count: 0,
        }
    }

    pub fn upload(&mut self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, vertices: &[Vertex]) {
        self.vertex_count = vertices.len() as u32;
        if !vertices.is_empty() {
            queue.write_buffer(&self.buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(vertices));
        }
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.vertex_count = 0;
    }

    pub fn buffer(&self) -> &wgpu::Buffer {
        &self.buffer
    }

    pub fn vertex_count(&self) -> u32 {
        self.vertex_count
    }

    pub fn size_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.buffer.size()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/geometry_rebase.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="86" bytes="3457" original_lines="86" original_bytes="3457" minified="false" sha256="f66e33201a9c22caf09c84e169c4a78325e3656ecd7cf3c8ba5f191279d26636">>>
//! Rare floating-origin shifts update resident vertices without rebuilding meshes.
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;
const STRIDES: [u32; 3] = [9, 28, 6];
pub struct GeometryRebase {
    pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    parameters: [wgpu::Buffer; STRIDES.len()],
}
impl GeometryRebase {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("geometry rebase"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(include_str!("shaders/geometry_rebase.wgsl").into()),
        });
        let pipeline = device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("geometry rebase"),
            layout: None,
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            cache: None,
        });
        let parameters = std::array::from_fn(|_| {
            device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                label: Some("geometry rebase delta"),
                contents: &[0; 16],
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            })
        });
        Self {
            pipeline,
            parameters,
        }
    }
    pub fn apply<'a>(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        delta: [f32; 3],
        buffers: impl Iterator<Item = (&'a wgpu::Buffer, u32)>,
    ) {
        for (i, stride) in STRIDES.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let words = [
                delta[0].to_bits(),
                delta[1].to_bits(),
                delta[2].to_bits(),
                stride,
            ];
            queue.write_buffer(&self.parameters[i], 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&words));
        }
        let layout = self.pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0);
        let groups: Vec<_> = buffers
            .filter(|(b, s)| b.size() >= u64::from(*s) * 4)
            .map(|(buffer, stride)| {
                let index = STRIDES
                    .iter()
                    .position(|s| *s == stride)
                    .expect("supported render vertex layout");
                let group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                    label: Some("geometry rebase buffer"),
                    layout: &layout,
                    entries: &[
                        wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                            binding: 0,
                            resource: buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                        },
                        wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                            binding: 1,
                            resource: self.parameters[index].as_entire_binding(),
                        },
                    ],
                });
                (group, (buffer.size() / u64::from(stride) / 4) as u32)
            })
            .collect();
        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&Default::default());
        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&Default::default());
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
            for (group, count) in &groups {
                pass.set_bind_group(0, group, &[]);
                pass.dispatch_workgroups(count.div_ceil(64), 1, 1);
            }
        }
        queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/gpu_bindings.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="77" bytes="3033" original_lines="77" original_bytes="3033" minified="false" sha256="434f7be295e75d2a268b1d850f7ce8f3478c65e232e7fadb2dd2dda22db4d2c5">>>
//! Shared GPU buffers and bind group for frame camera/environment uniforms.

use crate::gpu_frame::{CameraUniform, EnvironmentUniform};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

/// Device resources backing the shared world-frame uniform bindings.
pub struct EnvironmentGpuBindings {
    /// Bind-group layout used by world, sky and globe pipelines.
    pub layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    /// Camera uniform buffer.
    pub camera_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    /// Environment uniform buffer.
    pub environment_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    /// Bind group containing both uniform buffers.
    pub bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
}

impl EnvironmentGpuBindings {
    /// Creates the shared camera/environment buffers and bind group.
    pub fn create(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        atmosphere: &crate::atmosphere_resources::AtmosphereResources,
    ) -> Self {
        let camera_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
            label: Some("camera-uniform"),
            contents: bytemuck::bytes_of(&CameraUniform::default()),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        });
        let environment_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
            label: Some("environment-uniform"),
            contents: bytemuck::bytes_of(&EnvironmentUniform::default()),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        });
        let mut entries = vec![
            uniform_entry(0, std::mem::size_of::<CameraUniform>() as u64),
            uniform_entry(1, std::mem::size_of::<EnvironmentUniform>() as u64),
        ];
        entries.extend(crate::atmosphere_resources::AtmosphereResources::layout_entries());
        let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("world-frame-layout"),
            entries: &entries,
        });
        let mut resources = atmosphere.entries();
        resources.push(wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
            binding: 0,
            resource: camera_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
        });
        resources.push(wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
            binding: 1,
            resource: environment_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
        });
        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("world-frame-bind-group"),
            layout: &layout,
            entries: &resources,
        });
        Self {
            layout,
            camera_buffer,
            environment_buffer,
            bind_group,
        }
    }
}

fn uniform_entry(binding: u32, size: u64) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT | wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(size),
        },
        count: None,
    }
}
