<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/celestial_halo.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="99" bytes="4306" original_lines="99" original_bytes="4306" minified="false" sha256="3aef5acbe81dc09a64166f2722066de2e03682f5224d644c93a59dc38bc53f7c">>>
struct HaloVertex {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) @interpolate(flat) body: u32,
};

fn halo_source(body: u32) -> HaloSource {
    return environment.halo_sources[body];
}

fn halo_direction(body: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
    return normalize(halo_source(body).direction_extent.xyz);
}

fn finite_scalar(value: f32) -> bool {
    return abs(value) <= 3.402823e38;
}

fn finite_vec3(value: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
    return all(abs(value) <= vec3<f32>(3.402823e38));
}

@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32, @builtin(instance_index) body: u32) -> HaloVertex {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0),
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0),
    );
    let source = halo_source(body);
    let center = halo_direction(body);
    let extent = max(source.direction_extent.w, 0.00001);
    let reference = select(vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), abs(center.y) > 0.95);
    let right = normalize(cross(reference, center));
    let up = normalize(cross(center, right));
    let ray = normalize(center + (right * corners[index].x + up * corners[index].y) * tan(extent));
    let clip = camera.sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ray, 0.0);
    var output: HaloVertex;
    output.body = body;
    if clip.w <= 0.00001 || body >= environment.halo_count.x {
        output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);
    } else {
        output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(clip.xy, clip.w, clip.w);
    }
    return output;
}

@fragment fn fs_main(input: HaloVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    if input.body >= min(environment.halo_count.x, 8u) {
        discard;
    }
    let source = halo_source(input.body);
    let extent = source.direction_extent.w;
    let visibility = source.linear_rgb_visibility.w;
    if !finite_scalar(extent) || !finite_scalar(visibility)
        || !finite_vec3(source.direction_extent.xyz)
        || !finite_vec3(source.linear_rgb_visibility.xyz)
        || !finite_vec3(source.source_direction.xyz)
        || extent <= 0.0 || visibility <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(
        input.clip_position.x * camera.viewport.z * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - input.clip_position.y * camera.viewport.w * 2.0,
    );
    let far_point = camera.inverse_sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let ray = normalize(far_point.xyz / max(abs(far_point.w), 0.000001));
    let center = halo_direction(input.body);
    let angle = acos(clamp(dot(ray, center), -1.0, 1.0));
    let horizon = horizon_visibility(ray);
    if horizon <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let shape = u32(source.parameters.x);
    var envelope = exp(-angle / max(extent * 0.25, 0.0001))
        * (1.0 - smoothstep(extent * 0.875, extent, angle));
    var radiance = source.linear_rgb_visibility.xyz * envelope;
    if shape == 0u {
        envelope = exp(-angle / radians(1.7))
            * (1.0 - smoothstep(extent * 0.875, extent, angle));
        radiance = source.linear_rgb_visibility.xyz * envelope;
    } else if shape == 1u {
        let phase = clamp(source.parameters.y, 0.0, 1.0);
        let sun = normalize(source.source_direction.xyz);
        let tangent = sun - center * dot(sun, center);
        let limb = ray - center * dot(ray, center);
        let facing = dot(normalize(tangent + vec3<f32>(0.000001)), normalize(limb + vec3<f32>(0.000001)));
        let orientation = 1.0 + 0.45 * (1.0 - phase) * facing;
        envelope = exp(-angle / radians(0.9))
            * (1.0 - smoothstep(extent * 0.875, extent, angle));
        radiance = source.linear_rgb_visibility.xyz * envelope * pow(phase, 1.4) * orientation;
    } else if shape == 3u {
        let source_direction = normalize(source.source_direction.xyz);
        let phase = clamp(source.parameters.y, 0.0, 1.0);
        let facing = max(dot(center, source_direction), 0.0);
        radiance *= phase * mix(0.35, 1.0, facing);
    } else if shape == 4u {
        radiance *= 1.25;
    }
    if physical_atmosphere() && (shape == 0u || shape == 1u) { discard; }
    return vec4<f32>(tone_map_display(radiance * visibility * horizon), 0.0);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/clouds.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="184" bytes="8421" original_lines="184" original_bytes="8421" minified="false" sha256="91f0df285dcf1fa663976b6fe4a25d465e7b4f5eadf6724ef414910fdd73bbcd">>>
struct CloudUniform {
    projection: mat4x4<f32>,
    scene_projection: mat4x4<f32>,
    inverse_projection: mat4x4<f32>,
    origin_radius: vec4<f32>,
    eye: vec4<f32>,
    observer: vec4<f32>,
    config: vec4<u32>,
};
struct CloudRecord {
    center_age: vec4<f32>,
    east_opacity: vec4<f32>,
    up_layer: vec4<f32>,
    north_region: vec4<f32>,
    morph: vec4<f32>,
};
@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> cloud_frame: CloudUniform;
@group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read> clusters: array<CloudRecord>;
@group(1) @binding(2) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;

struct CloudVertex {
    @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) local: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) @interpolate(flat) parameters: vec4<f32>,
    @location(3) @interpolate(flat) detail: vec2<f32>,
};

fn basis(c: CloudRecord, p: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return c.east_opacity.xyz * p.x + c.up_layer.xyz * p.y + c.north_region.xyz * p.z;
}

@vertex
fn vs_cloud(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32, @location(0) center: vec4<f32>,
    @location(1) u: vec4<f32>, @location(2) v: vec4<f32>) -> CloudVertex {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(vec2(-1.0,-1.0), vec2(1.0,-1.0), vec2(1.0,1.0),
        vec2(-1.0,-1.0), vec2(1.0,1.0), vec2(-1.0,1.0));
    let c = clusters[u32(center.w)];
    let local = c.center_age.xyz + basis(c, center.xyz + u.xyz * corners[index].x + v.xyz * corners[index].y);
    var out: CloudVertex;
    out.position = cloud_frame.projection * vec4(local, 1.0);
    out.local = local;
    out.normal = basis(c, normalize(cross(u.xyz, v.xyz)));
    let phase = clamp((c.center_age.w - c.morph.x) / c.morph.y, 0.0, 1.0);
    let coverage = max(mix(u.w, v.w, phase), 0.0);
    out.parameters = vec4(c.center_age.w, c.east_opacity.w * coverage, c.up_layer.w, c.north_region.w);
    out.detail = c.morph.zw;
    return out;
}

fn hidden(local: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
    let clip = cloud_frame.scene_projection * vec4(local, 1.0);
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let uv = ndc.xy * vec2(0.5, -0.5) + vec2(0.5);
    let size = textureDimensions(scene_depth);
    let pixel = clamp(vec2<i32>(uv * vec2<f32>(size)), vec2(0), vec2<i32>(size) - vec2(1));
    let depth = textureLoad(scene_depth, pixel, 0);
    if depth < 1.0 && ndc.z > depth + 0.0000001 { return true; }
    // Physical planet occlusion also works beyond the terrain's short far plane.
    let eye = cloud_frame.eye.xyz + cloud_frame.origin_radius.xyz;
    let delta = local - cloud_frame.eye.xyz;
    let distance = length(delta);
    let ray = delta / max(distance, 0.000001);
    let radius = cloud_frame.origin_radius.w;
    let eye_radius = length(eye);
    let b = dot(eye, ray);
    let discriminant = b * b - (eye_radius - radius) * (eye_radius + radius);
    if discriminant >= 0.0 && eye_radius >= radius {
        let hit = -b - sqrt(discriminant);
        if hit > 0.0 && hit < distance - max(radius * 0.0000001, 0.01) { return true; }
    }
    return false;
}

fn region_uv(direction: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let a = abs(direction);
    if a.x >= a.y && a.x >= a.z { return direction.yz / a.x * 0.5 + vec2(0.5); }
    if a.y >= a.z { return direction.xz / a.y * 0.5 + vec2(0.5); }
    return direction.xy / a.z * 0.5 + vec2(0.5);
}

fn edge_fade(direction: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let angle = acos(clamp(dot(direction, cloud_frame.observer.xyz), -1.0, 1.0));
    return 1.0 - smoothstep(cloud_frame.eye.w, cloud_frame.observer.w, angle);
}

fn cloud_color(input: CloudVertex) -> vec4<f32> {
    if hidden(input.local) { discard; }
    let up = normalize(input.local + cloud_frame.origin_radius.xyz);
    let age = input.parameters.x;
    let fade = smoothstep(0.0, 420.0, age) * (1.0 - smoothstep(2800.0, 3600.0, age));
    let alpha = (1.0 - exp(-input.parameters.y)) * fade * edge_fade(up);
    if alpha < 0.0001 { discard; }
    let n = normalize(input.normal);
    let sun = environment.global_sun_direction.xyz;
    let sun_visibility = smoothstep(-0.03, 0.03, dot(up, sun));
    let moon_visibility = smoothstep(-0.03, 0.03, dot(up, environment.moon_apparent_world.xyz));
    var direct = environment.global_sun_rgb.xyz * sun_visibility * (0.24 + 0.76 * max(dot(n, sun), 0.0));
    var lunar = environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.xyz * moon_visibility
        * (0.3 + 0.7 * max(dot(n, environment.moon_apparent_world.xyz), 0.0));
    var ambient=environment.ambient_rgb_exposure.xyz;
    if physical_atmosphere() {
        direct=physical_sun(input.local)*(0.24+0.76*max(dot(n,sun),0.0));
        lunar=physical_moon(input.local)*(0.3+0.7*max(dot(n,surface_moon_direction()),0.0));
        ambient=physical_ambient(input.local);
    }
    var color = ambient * (0.55 + 0.45 * max(dot(n, up), 0.0)) + direct + lunar;
    if cloud_frame.config.x == 2u {
        let colors = array<vec3<f32>,3>(vec3(0.3,0.8,1.0), vec3(1.0,0.65,0.2), vec3(0.8,0.4,1.0));
        color = colors[u32(input.parameters.z)];
    }
    if cloud_frame.config.x == 4u {
        let colors = array<vec3<f32>,12>(vec3(0.9,0.9,0.9), vec3(1.0,0.6,0.2),
            vec3(1.0,0.2,0.2), vec3(0.3,0.6,0.8), vec3(0.2,0.9,0.5), vec3(0.4,0.4,0.7),
            vec3(0.9,0.8,0.2), vec3(0.8,0.4,0.2), vec3(1.0,0.3,0.8), vec3(0.6,0.9,1.0),
            vec3(0.5,0.3,1.0), vec3(0.8,0.6,1.0));
        color = colors[u32(input.detail.x)];
    }
    if cloud_frame.config.x == 5u {
        color = mix(vec3(0.15,0.3,1.0), vec3(1.0,0.2,0.1), input.detail.y / 6.0);
    }
    if physical_atmosphere() && cloud_frame.config.x == 0u {
        let path=sample_aerial(input.local);
        color=color*path.transmission+path.scattering;
    }
    if cloud_frame.config.x != 0u {return vec4(tone_map_display(color),alpha);}
    return vec4(tone_map_linear(color), alpha);
}

struct WeightedOutput {
    @location(0) accumulation: vec4<f32>,
    @location(1) revealage: f32,
};

@fragment fn fs_oit(input: CloudVertex) -> WeightedOutput {
    let c = cloud_color(input);
    let distance = length(input.local - cloud_frame.eye.xyz) / max(cloud_frame.origin_radius.w * 0.06, 1.0);
    let weight = clamp((0.2 + c.a * 3.0) / (0.2 + distance * distance), 0.05, 12.0);
    return WeightedOutput(vec4(c.rgb * c.a, c.a) * weight, c.a);
}
@fragment fn fs_alpha(input: CloudVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> { return cloud_color(input); }

struct DebugVertex {
    @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) ndc: vec2<f32>,
};
@vertex fn vs_debug(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32) -> DebugVertex {
    let p = array<vec2<f32>,3>(vec2(-1.0,-1.0), vec2(3.0,-1.0), vec2(-1.0,3.0))[index];
    return DebugVertex(vec4(p, 0.0, 1.0), p);
}
@fragment fn fs_debug(input: DebugVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    if cloud_frame.config.x == 2u || cloud_frame.config.x >= 4u { discard; }
    let projected = cloud_frame.inverse_projection * vec4(input.ndc, 0.5, 1.0);
    let ray = normalize(projected.xyz / projected.w - cloud_frame.eye.xyz);
    let eye = cloud_frame.eye.xyz + cloud_frame.origin_radius.xyz;
    let radius = cloud_frame.origin_radius.w * (1.0 + 1800.0 / 6371000.0);
    let b = dot(eye, ray);
    let c = (length(eye) - radius) * (length(eye) + radius);
    let d = b * b - c;
    if d < 0.0 { discard; }
    var hit = -b - sqrt(d);
    if hit < 0.0 { hit = -b + sqrt(d); }
    if hit < 0.0 { discard; }
    let local = cloud_frame.eye.xyz + ray * hit;
    if hidden(local) { discard; }
    let up = normalize(eye + ray * hit);
    let fade = edge_fade(up);
    if fade <= 0.0 { discard; }
    if cloud_frame.config.x == 1u {
        let grid = region_uv(up) * 128.0;
        let width = max(fwidth(grid), vec2(0.008));
        let line = min(fract(grid), 1.0 - fract(grid)) / width;
        let alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.5, 1.5, min(line.x, line.y));
        return vec4(0.1, 0.95, 0.75, alpha * fade * 0.8);
    }
    // East-facing arrows on a spherical shell, including cloud-free regions.
    let lon = atan2(up.z, up.x);
    let lat = asin(up.y);
    let p = fract(vec2(lon * cos(lat), lat) * 700.0) - vec2(0.5);
    let shaft = abs(p.y) < 0.035 && abs(p.x) < 0.3;
    let head = abs(abs(p.y) - (0.3 - p.x)) < 0.045 && p.x > 0.05 && p.x < 0.34;
    if !shaft && !head { discard; }
    return vec4(1.0, 0.8, 0.15, fade * 0.7);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/geometry_rebase.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="11" bytes="506" original_lines="11" original_bytes="506" minified="false" sha256="1abc041ded74ae6bd63487d510894905b0e2576f3c8c95f19733702d1f7fdcb5">>>
struct Parameters { delta: vec3<f32>, stride: u32 }

@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> parameters: Parameters;
@compute @workgroup_size(64)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    let i = id.x*parameters.stride;
    if (id.x >= arrayLength(&vertices)/parameters.stride) { return; }
    vertices[i] += parameters.delta.x;
    vertices[i+1u] += parameters.delta.y;
    vertices[i+2u] += parameters.delta.z;
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/moon.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="109" bytes="4928" original_lines="109" original_bytes="4928" minified="false" sha256="ba84012afd7b60e2bd4d7d9371ff8f8ac67e737697897f28faaddc0ecaeb92da">>>
struct MoonVertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) local_position: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) moon_direction: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) disk_up: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) disk_right: vec3<f32>,
    @location(4) moon_to_sun: vec3<f32>,
};

struct MoonDiskBasis {
    right: vec3<f32>,
    up: vec3<f32>,
};

// Display calibration only; phase and relative flux come from geometry and mV.
const FULL_MOON_DISK_GAIN = 0.08;

fn moon_disk_basis(direction: vec3<f32>, pole: vec3<f32>) -> MoonDiskBasis {
    let projected_pole = pole - direction * dot(pole, direction);
    let reference = select(
        vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0),
        vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        abs(direction.y) > 0.9,
    );
    let fallback = reference - direction * dot(reference, direction);
    let up = normalize(select(fallback, projected_pole, dot(projected_pole, projected_pole) > 1.0e-10));
    let right = normalize(cross(direction, up));
    return MoonDiskBasis(right, up);
}

@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> MoonVertexOutput {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0),
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0),
    );
    let corner = corners[vertex_index];
    let direction = visual_moon_direction();
    let basis = moon_disk_basis(direction, normalize(environment.moon_pole_world.xyz));
    let radius = max(environment.moon_apparent_world.w, 0.0);
    let disk_direction = normalize(
        direction + (basis.right * corner.x + basis.up * corner.y) * tan(radius),
    );
    var clip = camera.sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(disk_direction, 0.0);
    if clip.w <= 0.00001 {
        clip = vec4<f32>(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);
    } else {
        clip = vec4<f32>(clip.xy, clip.w, clip.w);
    }
    var output: MoonVertexOutput;
    output.clip_position = clip;
    output.local_position = corner;
    output.moon_direction = direction;
    output.disk_up = basis.up;
    output.disk_right = basis.right;
    output.moon_to_sun = normalize(environment.moon_light_world_phase.xyz);
    return output;
}

fn lambert_phase_fraction(cos_phase: f32) -> f32 {
    let phase_angle = acos(clamp(cos_phase, -1.0, 1.0));
    return max((sin(phase_angle) + (3.14159265 - phase_angle) * cos_phase) / 3.14159265, 0.000001);
}

@fragment fn fs_main(input: MoonVertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let radius_squared = dot(input.local_position, input.local_position);
    let edge_width = max(fwidth(radius_squared), 0.00001);
    let coverage = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0 - edge_width, 1.0 + edge_width, radius_squared);
    if coverage <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(
        input.clip_position.x * camera.viewport.z * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - input.clip_position.y * camera.viewport.w * 2.0,
    );
    let far_point = camera.inverse_sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let ray_world = normalize(far_point.xyz / max(abs(far_point.w), 0.000001));
    let horizon = horizon_visibility(ray_world);
    if horizon <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let z = sqrt(max(1.0 - radius_squared, 0.0));
    let surface_normal = normalize(
        input.disk_right * input.local_position.x
            + input.disk_up * input.local_position.y
            - input.moon_direction * z,
    );
    let lambert = max(dot(surface_normal, input.moon_to_sun), 0.0);
    let moon_to_observer = -input.moon_direction;
    let phase_fraction = lambert_phase_fraction(dot(input.moon_to_sun, moon_to_observer));
    // Near opposition, the Moon's illuminated limb remains visible rather
    // than fading into a grey sphere. Keep the terminator geometry intact.
    let fullness = smoothstep(0.90, 0.995, environment.moon_light_world_phase.w);
    let lit_surface = select(0.0, mix(lambert, max(lambert, 0.45), fullness), lambert > 0.0);
    let normalized_lambert = lit_surface / phase_fraction;
    let disk_color = environment.moon_disk_radiance.xyz;
    let relative_flux = environment.moon_disk_radiance.w;
    // The overview has a black space background, so use a separate display
    // calibration while preserving the astronomical flux, phase and disk size.
    let display_gain = select(FULL_MOON_DISK_GAIN, 2.0, environment.flags.y == 1u);
    let lunar_radiance = disk_color * relative_flux * display_gain * normalized_lambert;
    var linear_color = lunar_radiance;
    if environment.flags.y == 0u && !physical_atmosphere() {
        let atmosphere = sample_clear_sky(ray_world);
        linear_color = atmosphere.scattering_rgb + atmosphere.transmittance * lunar_radiance;
    }
    let alpha = coverage * horizon;
    let output_color = tone_map_display(linear_color);
    return vec4<f32>(output_color * alpha, alpha);
}

@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32) -> MoonSphereVertex {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0),
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0),
    );
    let offset = environment.moon_orbit_world.xyz - camera.eye_world.xyz;
    let distance = length(offset);
    let direction = offset / max(distance, 0.000001);
    let angular_radius = asin(clamp(environment.moon_orbit_world.w / distance, 0.0, 0.999));
    let reference = select(vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), abs(direction.y) > 0.95);
    let right = normalize(cross(reference, direction));
    let up = normalize(cross(direction, right));
    let ray = normalize(direction + (right * corners[index].x + up * corners[index].y) * tan(angular_radius));
    let clip = camera.sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ray, 0.0);
    var output: MoonSphereVertex;
    if clip.w <= 0.00001 {
        output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);
    } else {
        output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(clip.xy, clip.w, clip.w);
    }
    return output;
}

@fragment fn fs_main(input: MoonSphereVertex) -> MoonSphereFragment {
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(
        input.clip_position.x * camera.viewport.z * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - input.clip_position.y * camera.viewport.w * 2.0,
    );
    let far_point = camera.inverse_sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let ray = normalize(far_point.xyz / max(abs(far_point.w), 0.000001));
    let center = environment.moon_orbit_world.xyz;
    let radius = environment.moon_orbit_world.w;
    let to_center = center - camera.eye_world.xyz;
    let along_ray = dot(to_center, ray);
    let closest_offset = to_center - ray * along_ray;
    let discriminant = radius * radius - dot(closest_offset, closest_offset);
    if discriminant <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let distance = along_ray - sqrt(discriminant);
    if distance <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let hit = camera.eye_world.xyz + ray * distance;
    let normal = normalize(hit - center);
    let sun = normalize(environment.moon_light_world_phase.xyz);
    let illumination = max(dot(normal, sun), 0.0);
    let albedo = vec3<f32>(0.72, 0.73, 0.75);
    let linear = albedo * (0.015 + 1.8 * illumination);
    let projected = camera.view_projection * vec4<f32>(hit, 1.0);
    if projected.w <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    var output: MoonSphereFragment;
    output.color = vec4<f32>(tone_map_display(linear), 1.0);
    output.depth = clamp(projected.z / projected.w, 0.0, 1.0);
    return output;
}

    @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,

@vertex fn vs_ocean(@location(0) position: vec3<f32>, @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>) -> OceanOutput {
    return OceanOutput(camera.view_projection*vec4<f32>(position,1.0),position,normal);
}

@fragment fn fs_ocean(input: OceanOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let n = normalize(input.normal);
    let v = normalize(terrain.eye_relative.xyz-input.position);
    let albedo = select(vec3<f32>(0.007,0.027,0.042),vec3<f32>(0.5),terrain.debug.x == 1u);
    // Calm water with a broad, filtered highlight; no wave textures or temporal noise.
    let variance = min(0.15,0.5*max(dot(dpdx(n),dpdx(n)),dot(dpdy(n),dpdy(n))));
    // Both Earth cameras may reverse winding. World-space facing remains stable.
    if dot(n,v) <= 0.0 { discard; }
    let roughness = pow(min(1.0,pow(0.22,4.0)+variance),0.25);
    var direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var visibility = 1.0;
    if length(environment.sun_geometric_world.xyz) > 1e-8 {
        let l = normalize(select(environment.sun_geometric_world.xyz,environment.global_sun_direction.xyz,physical_atmosphere()));
        if shadow.flags.y == 1u { visibility = shadow_visibility(input.position,n,l); }
        var irradiance = environment.local_sun_rgb_visibility.xyz;
        if physical_atmosphere() { irradiance = physical_sun(input.position); }
        direct += surface_light(n,v,l,albedo,roughness,0.02)*irradiance*visibility;
    }
    if length(environment.moon_geometric_world.xyz) > 1e-8 {
        let l = normalize(select(environment.moon_geometric_world.xyz,surface_moon_direction(),physical_atmosphere()));
        var moon_visibility = 1.0;
        if shadow.flags.y == 2u { moon_visibility = shadow_visibility(input.position,n,l); visibility = moon_visibility; }
        var irradiance = environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.xyz;
        if physical_atmosphere() { irradiance = physical_moon(input.position); }
        direct += surface_light(n,v,l,albedo,roughness,0.02)*irradiance*moon_visibility;
    }
    if terrain.debug.x == 2u { return vec4<f32>(n*0.5+0.5,1.0); }
    if terrain.debug.x == 3u { return vec4<f32>(vec3<f32>(input.clip.z),1.0); }
    if terrain.debug.x == 4u { return vec4<f32>(vec3<f32>(visibility),1.0); }
    if terrain.debug.x >= 5u { return vec4<f32>(albedo,1.0); }
    var ambient = environment.ambient_rgb_exposure.xyz;
    var daylight = 1.0;
    if physical_atmosphere() {
        ambient = physical_ambient(input.position);
        daylight = smoothstep(-0.12,0.12,dot(n,normalize(environment.global_sun_direction.xyz)));
    }
    let sky_height = sqrt(clamp(dot(reflect(-v,n),n),0.0,1.0));
    var sky = mix(environment.sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility.xyz,
        environment.sky_zenith_rgb_sun_altitude.xyz,sky_height)*daylight;
    if physical_atmosphere() {sky=ambient*mix(1.4,2.2,sky_height);}
    let fresnel = 0.02+0.98*pow(1.0-max(dot(n,v),0.0),5.0);
    let reflected = mix(ambient*0.08,sky,0.8)*fresnel;
    return vec4<f32>(tone_map_linear(albedo*ambient*(1.0-fresnel)+reflected+direct),1.0);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/output_color.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="20" bytes="878" original_lines="20" original_bytes="878" minified="false" sha256="302bb54e3993ef9168d288e69953aaf98f0ca59a071d41836ab0688d6439f785">>>
fn tone_map_color(linear: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let value = max(linear, vec3<f32>(0.0));
    let numerator = value * (value * 2.51 + vec3<f32>(0.03));
    let denominator = value * (value * 2.43 + vec3<f32>(0.59)) + vec3<f32>(0.14);
    return clamp(numerator / denominator, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0));
}

fn srgb_to_linear(srgb: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let value = clamp(srgb, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0));
    let low = value / 12.92;
    let high = pow((value + vec3<f32>(0.055)) / 1.055, vec3<f32>(2.4));
    return select(high, low, value <= vec3<f32>(0.04045));
}

fn linear_to_srgb(linear: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let value = max(linear, vec3<f32>(0.0));
    let low = value * 12.92;
    let high = 1.055 * pow(value, vec3<f32>(1.0 / 2.4)) - vec3<f32>(0.055);
    return select(high, low, value <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/shadow_sampling.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="84" bytes="3978" original_lines="84" original_bytes="3978" minified="false" sha256="72a16e766514a11d20aa44d471cb94de7aa35a821f624b6b84fdf998f4f80c9b">>>
struct ShadowUniform {
    light_view_projection: mat4x4<f32>,
    receiver_center_relative_radius: vec4<f32>,
    texel_depth_range: vec4<f32>,
    bias_fade: vec4<f32>,
    flags: vec4<u32>,
};

@group(2) @binding(0) var shadow_depth: texture_depth_2d;
@group(2) @binding(1) var shadow_sampler: sampler_comparison;
@group(2) @binding(2) var<uniform> shadow: ShadowUniform;

// Orthographic shadow projection has orthogonal scaled rows. Inverting each
// row gives world displacement per UV/depth unit; intersect with the triangle
// plane analytically. No subtraction of nearly equal screen-space depth values.
fn receiver_depth_gradient(normal: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let m = shadow.light_view_projection;
    let u = vec3<f32>(m[0][0],m[1][0],m[2][0])*0.5;
    let v = vec3<f32>(m[0][1],m[1][1],m[2][1])*(-0.5);
    let z = vec3<f32>(m[0][2],m[1][2],m[2][2]);
    // A light-tangent plane is not a single-valued function of shadow UV.
    if abs(dot(normal,normalize(z))) < 0.0001 { return vec2<f32>(0.0); }
    let nz = dot(normal,z)/max(dot(z,z),1e-20);
    return -vec2<f32>(dot(normal,u)/max(dot(u,u),1e-20),
        dot(normal,v)/max(dot(v,v),1e-20))/nz;
}

fn shadow_visibility(world_position: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>, light_direction: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    if shadow.flags.x == 0u || shadow.flags.y == 0u {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let receiver_offset = world_position - shadow.receiver_center_relative_radius.xyz;
    let receiver_distance = length(receiver_offset);
    let receiver_radius = max(shadow.receiver_center_relative_radius.w, 0.0);
    if receiver_distance >= receiver_radius {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let clip = shadow.light_view_projection * vec4<f32>(world_position, 1.0);
    if clip.w <= 0.000001 {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    if ndc.x < -1.0 || ndc.x > 1.0 || ndc.y < -1.0 || ndc.y > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0 {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
    let slope = 1.0 - clamp(dot(normalize(normal), normalize(light_direction)), 0.0, 1.0);
    let bias_m = min(shadow.bias_fade.z, shadow.bias_fade.x + shadow.bias_fade.y * slope);
    let depth_range_m = max(shadow.texel_depth_range.w - shadow.texel_depth_range.z, 0.000001);
    let reference_depth = ndc.z - bias_m / depth_range_m;
    let depth_gradient = receiver_depth_gradient(normal);
    let dimensions = vec2<i32>(textureDimensions(shadow_depth));
    let receiver_texel = vec2<i32>(floor(uv * vec2<f32>(dimensions)));
    var pcf_sum = 0.0;
    var sample_count = 0.0;
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y = y + 1) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x = x + 1) {
            let sample_texel = receiver_texel + vec2<i32>(x, y);
            // Continuous tent weights: entering/leaving taps have zero weight.
            let delta = abs(vec2<f32>(sample_texel)+0.5-uv*vec2<f32>(dimensions));
            let tent = max(vec2<f32>(1.5)-delta,vec2<f32>(0.0));
            let weight = tent.x*tent.y;
            if any(sample_texel < vec2<i32>(0)) || any(sample_texel >= dimensions) {
                pcf_sum += weight;
            } else {
                // Compare against the same texel center where rasterization stored depth.
                // Correcting at an unsnapped UV leaves a sawtooth error inside every texel.
                let center_uv = (vec2<f32>(sample_texel) + 0.5) / vec2<f32>(dimensions);
                let plane_depth = reference_depth + dot(depth_gradient, center_uv - uv);
                let stored_depth = textureLoad(shadow_depth, sample_texel, 0);
                pcf_sum += select(0.0, weight, plane_depth <= stored_depth);
            }
            sample_count += weight;
        }
    }

    let pcf_visibility = pcf_sum / max(sample_count, 1.0);
    let fade_start = min(shadow.bias_fade.w, receiver_radius);
    let fade = 1.0 - smoothstep(fade_start, receiver_radius, receiver_distance);
    return mix(1.0, pcf_visibility, fade);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/sky.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="66" bytes="3125" original_lines="66" original_bytes="3125" minified="false" sha256="e75ab47c4fd7d4b397f95a8d834ca443c6142f51cf0e437cfaecc833c7985998">>>
struct SkyVertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
};

@group(1) @binding(0) var milky_way_map: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(1) var milky_way_sampler: sampler;

// The embedded plate's luminance median is ~0.014 and its 90th percentile
// ~0.062. Gains of 0.02/0.03 put most of it below two 8-bit display levels
// after the shared filmic tone map. Keep diffuse galactic contrast in linear
// scene space; daylight, moonlight, extinction and cloud occlusion still apply.
const MILKY_WAY_SURFACE_GAIN: f32 = 0.16;
const MILKY_WAY_ORBIT_GAIN: f32 = 0.24;

fn milky_way_radiance(ray_world: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let eqj = normalize((transpose(environment.eqj_to_world) * vec4<f32>(ray_world, 0.0)).xyz);
    // NASA SVS celestial plate carree: RA 0 at the centre, RA increases left.
    let u = fract(0.5 - atan2(eqj.y, eqj.x) / 6.2831853);
    let v = 0.5 - asin(clamp(eqj.z, -1.0, 1.0)) / 3.14159265;
    let source = textureSample(milky_way_map, milky_way_sampler, vec2<f32>(u, v)).rgb;
    let luminance = dot(source, vec3<f32>(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    // Dark-adapted vision sees little colour in diffuse galactic light.
    return mix(vec3<f32>(luminance), source, 0.35);
}

@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32) -> SkyVertexOutput {
    let positions = array<vec2<f32>, 3>(
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0),
        vec2<f32>(3.0, -1.0),
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, 3.0),
    );
    var output: SkyVertexOutput;
    output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(positions[index], 1.0, 1.0);
    return output;
}

@fragment fn fs_main(@builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(
        position.x * camera.viewport.z * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - position.y * camera.viewport.w * 2.0,
    );
    let far_point = camera.inverse_sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let ray_world = normalize(far_point.xyz / max(abs(far_point.w), 1.0e-6));
    if physical_atmosphere() {
        if celestial_contrast()<=0.0 {return vec4<f32>(0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0);}
        return vec4<f32>(milky_way_radiance(ray_world)*MILKY_WAY_ORBIT_GAIN*horizon_visibility(ray_world)*celestial_contrast(),1.0);
    }
    if environment.flags.y == 1u {
        return vec4<f32>(tone_map_linear(milky_way_radiance(ray_world) * MILKY_WAY_ORBIT_GAIN), 1.0);
    }
    let sample = sample_clear_sky(ray_world);
    let moon_flux = max(environment.moon_disk_radiance.w, 0.0)
        * environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.w;
    let moon_contrast = 1.0 / (1.0 + 8.0 * moon_flux);
    let galactic_visibility = sample.transmittance
        * celestial_contrast() * moon_contrast;
    var galactic_light = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    if celestial_contrast() > 0.0 {
        galactic_light = milky_way_radiance(ray_world);
    }
    let sky = tone_map_linear(sample.scattering_rgb
        + galactic_light * MILKY_WAY_SURFACE_GAIN * galactic_visibility);
    let ground = HORIZON_OCCLUSION_RGB;
    let visibility = horizon_visibility(ray_world);
    return vec4<f32>(mix(ground, sky, visibility), 1.0);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/sky_common.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="65" bytes="3196" original_lines="65" original_bytes="3196" minified="false" sha256="5d17c8dc6fe65a32861ec4f87ca5b9b1c006c9c7b07a0cd15c7dcb9824fdc55d">>>
struct SkySample {
    scattering_rgb: vec3<f32>,
    transmittance: f32,
};

const SOLAR_DISK_RADIANCE = vec3<f32>(8.0, 6.5, 4.2);
const SOLAR_HALO_FACTOR = 0.12;
const HORIZON_OCCLUSION_RGB = vec3<f32>(0.008, 0.010, 0.014);
const CLEAR_AIR_EXTINCTION = 0.08;

fn tone_map_linear(rgb: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    if environment.flags.w != 0u {
        return min(rgb*scene_exposure(),vec3<f32>(65000.0));
    }
    return tone_map_color(rgb * environment.ambient_rgb_exposure.w);
}

// Existing celestial sprites/marker colors are calibrated for display, unlike
// irradiance on surfaces. Do not amplify those authored colors by night gain.
fn tone_map_display(rgb: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    if environment.flags.w != 0u {return rgb;}
    return tone_map_color(rgb);
}

fn horizon_visibility(ray_world: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let up = normalize(environment.observer_up_horizon_cos.xyz);
    let cosine = dot(up, normalize(ray_world));
    let horizon = environment.observer_up_horizon_cos.w;
    return smoothstep(horizon - 0.0015, horizon + 0.0015, cosine);
}

fn clear_air_transmittance(altitude: f32) -> f32 {
    let zenith_degrees = clamp(90.0 - degrees(max(altitude, radians(-1.0))), 0.0, 90.0);
    let correction = 0.50572 * pow(max(96.07995 - zenith_degrees, 1.0), -1.6364);
    let air_mass = clamp(1.0 / max(sin(altitude) + correction, 0.025), 1.0, 40.0);
    return exp(-CLEAR_AIR_EXTINCTION * air_mass);
}

fn sample_clear_sky(ray_world: vec3<f32>) -> SkySample {
    let ray = normalize(ray_world);
    let up = normalize(environment.observer_up_horizon_cos.xyz);
    let altitude = asin(clamp(dot(up, ray), -1.0, 1.0));
    let horizon_weight = pow(clamp(1.0 - max(sin(altitude), 0.0), 0.0, 1.0), 1.35);
    let zenith = environment.sky_zenith_rgb_sun_altitude.xyz;
    let horizon = environment.sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility.xyz;
    let sun_altitude = environment.sky_zenith_rgb_sun_altitude.w;
    let day_factor = smoothstep(radians(-18.0), radians(4.0), sun_altitude);
    let sun_direction = normalize(environment.sun_apparent_world.xyz);
    let sun_angle = acos(clamp(dot(ray, sun_direction), -1.0, 1.0));
    let horizon_glow = exp(-sun_angle * 7.0) * day_factor;
    var scattering = mix(zenith, horizon, horizon_weight)
        + vec3<f32>(0.34, 0.16, 0.055) * horizon_glow * 0.28;
    let moon_direction = environment.moon_apparent_world.xyz;
    if environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.w > 0.0 && length(moon_direction) > 1.0e-8 {
        let moon_angle = acos(clamp(dot(ray, normalize(moon_direction)), -1.0, 1.0));
        let halo_width = max(radians(7.0), environment.moon_apparent_world.w * 16.0);
        let moon_halo = exp(-moon_angle / halo_width);
        let moon_scatter = environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.xyz
            * (vec3<f32>(18.0, 24.0, 42.0) + vec3<f32>(44.0, 58.0, 86.0) * moon_halo);
        scattering += moon_scatter * clear_air_transmittance(altitude);
    }
    var density=1.0;
    if atmosphere.config.x>0.0 {density=exp(-max(atmosphere.up_height.w,0.0)/8000.0);}
    return SkySample(scattering*density, pow(clear_air_transmittance(altitude),density));
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/stars.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="129" bytes="5708" original_lines="129" original_bytes="5708" minified="false" sha256="d6279277120924a3fa171b7e7518118057de15b681851792691a7c18df86d9aa">>>
struct StarInput {
    @location(0) direction_eqj: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) visual_magnitude: f32,
    @location(2) color_linear: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) catalog_star_id: u32,
};

struct StarVertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) local_position: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) visual_magnitude: f32,
    @location(2) color_linear: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) @interpolate(flat) catalog_star_id: u32,
};

const STAR_REFERENCE_MAGNITUDE = 1.0;
const STAR_RADIANCE_SCALE = 3.0;

fn star_prominence(visual_magnitude: f32) -> f32 {
    return clamp((5.0 - visual_magnitude) / 6.5, 0.0, 1.0);
}

fn star_core_radius_pixels(visual_magnitude: f32) -> f32 {
    return mix(1.4, 6.5, pow(star_prominence(visual_magnitude), 1.1));
}

fn star_radius_pixels(visual_magnitude: f32) -> f32 {
    return star_core_radius_pixels(visual_magnitude)
        + mix(1.5, 3.5, star_prominence(visual_magnitude));
}

fn star_hash(id: u32) -> f32 {
    var value = id ^ 0x9e3779b9u;
    value = (value ^ (value >> 16u)) * 0x7feb352du;
    value = (value ^ (value >> 15u)) * 0x846ca68bu;
    return f32(value ^ (value >> 16u)) / 4294967295.0;
}

@vertex fn vs_main(input: StarInput, @builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> StarVertexOutput {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0),
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0),
    );
    let corner = corners[vertex_index];
    let direction_world = normalize((environment.eqj_to_world * vec4<f32>(input.direction_eqj, 0.0)).xyz);
    var clip = camera.sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(direction_world, 0.0);
    let radius_pixels = star_radius_pixels(input.visual_magnitude);
    if clip.w <= 0.00001 {
        clip = vec4<f32>(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);
    } else {
        let pixel_to_ndc = 2.0 * camera.viewport.zw;
        clip = vec4<f32>(
            clip.xy + corner * radius_pixels * pixel_to_ndc * clip.w,
            clip.w,
            clip.w,
        );
    }
    var output: StarVertexOutput;
    output.clip_position = clip;
    output.local_position = corner;
    output.visual_magnitude = input.visual_magnitude;
    output.color_linear = input.color_linear;
    output.catalog_star_id = input.catalog_star_id;
    return output;
}

@fragment fn fs_main(input: StarVertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let radius_squared = dot(input.local_position, input.local_position);
    if radius_squared >= 1.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(
        input.clip_position.x * camera.viewport.z * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - input.clip_position.y * camera.viewport.w * 2.0,
    );
    let far_point = camera.inverse_sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let ray_world = normalize(far_point.xyz / max(abs(far_point.w), 0.000001));
    let horizon = horizon_visibility(ray_world);
    let overview = environment.flags.y == 1u;
    var background = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var transmission = 1.0;
    if !overview && !physical_atmosphere() {
        let atmosphere = sample_clear_sky(ray_world);
        background = atmosphere.scattering_rgb;
        transmission = atmosphere.transmittance * celestial_contrast();
    }
    if physical_atmosphere() {transmission=celestial_contrast();}
    let visibility = horizon * transmission;
    if visibility <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    let prominence = star_prominence(input.visual_magnitude);
    let core_radius_pixels = star_core_radius_pixels(input.visual_magnitude);
    let radius_pixels = star_radius_pixels(input.visual_magnitude);
    let inner_position = input.local_position * (radius_pixels / core_radius_pixels);
    let inner_radius_squared = dot(inner_position, inner_position);
    let core = exp(-9.0 * inner_radius_squared);
    let glow = prominence * 0.34 * exp(-3.5 * inner_radius_squared);
    let glint = pow(prominence, 4.0) * 0.28
        * exp(-42.0 * min(abs(inner_position.x), abs(inner_position.y)))
        * exp(-3.0 * inner_radius_squared);
    let inner_profile = (core + glow + glint)
        * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.72, 1.0, inner_radius_squared));
    let micro_halo = 0.055 * prominence * prominence * exp(-3.0 * radius_squared)
        * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.75, 1.0, radius_squared));
    let profile = inner_profile + micro_halo;
    let area_compensation = inverseSqrt(core_radius_pixels * 0.5);
    let relative_flux = pow(10.0, -0.4 * (input.visual_magnitude - STAR_REFERENCE_MAGNITUDE));
    let seed = star_hash(input.catalog_star_id);
    let second_seed = star_hash(input.catalog_star_id ^ 0x68bc21ebu);
    let altitude = clamp(dot(normalize(environment.observer_up_horizon_cos.xyz), ray_world), 0.0, 1.0);
    var air_density=1.0;
    if atmosphere.config.x>0.0 {air_density=exp(-max(atmosphere.up_height.w,0.0)/8000.0);}
    let twinkle_strength = mix(0.28, 0.08, altitude)*air_density;
    let time = environment.star_animation.x;
    let twinkle = 1.0 + twinkle_strength * (
        0.7 * sin(time * (5.0 + 5.0 * seed) + 6.2831853 * second_seed)
        + 0.3 * sin(time * (10.0 + 7.0 * second_seed) + 6.2831853 * seed)
    );
    let base = tone_map_linear(background);
    let star_radiance = input.color_linear * relative_flux * STAR_RADIANCE_SCALE
        * area_compensation * profile * visibility * twinkle;
    if environment.flags.w != 0u {
        return vec4<f32>(star_radiance, 0.0);
    }
    let with_star = tone_map_linear(background + star_radiance);
    let linear_delta = max(with_star - base, vec3<f32>(0.0));
    return vec4<f32>(linear_delta, 0.0);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/sun.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="51" bytes="2318" original_lines="51" original_bytes="2318" minified="false" sha256="cbf7130c72bf56fa5d3000ee245c2d7f20e91e9b936fb2dd9bf718fc02341e71">>>
struct SunVertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32) -> SunVertexOutput {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0),
        vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0),
    );
    let corner = corners[index];
    let sun = normalize(environment.sun_apparent_world.xyz);
    let reference = select(vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), abs(sun.y) > 0.95);
    let right = normalize(cross(reference, sun));
    let up = normalize(cross(sun, right));
    let radius = max(environment.sun_apparent_world.w, 0.0);
    let direction = normalize(sun + (right * corner.x + up * corner.y) * tan(radius));
    var output: SunVertexOutput;
    let clip = camera.sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(direction, 0.0);
    if clip.w <= 0.00001 {
        output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);
    } else {
        output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(clip.xy, clip.w, clip.w);
    }
    return output;
}

@fragment fn fs_main(@builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(
        position.x * camera.viewport.z * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0 - position.y * camera.viewport.w * 2.0,
    );
    let far_point = camera.inverse_sky_view_projection * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let ray_world = normalize(far_point.xyz / max(abs(far_point.w), 1.0e-6));
    let sun = normalize(environment.sun_apparent_world.xyz);
    let angle = acos(clamp(dot(ray_world, sun), -1.0, 1.0));
    let radius = max(environment.sun_apparent_world.w, 1.0e-7);
    let edge = max(fwidth(angle), 1.0e-7);
    let coverage = 1.0 - smoothstep(radius - edge, radius + edge, angle);
    let visibility = horizon_visibility(ray_world);
    if coverage <= 0.0 || visibility <= 0.0 {
        discard;
    }
    var radiance = SOLAR_DISK_RADIANCE;
    if environment.flags.y == 0u && !physical_atmosphere() {
        let atmosphere = sample_clear_sky(ray_world);
        radiance = radiance * atmosphere.transmittance
            + atmosphere.scattering_rgb * SOLAR_HALO_FACTOR;
    }
    let color = tone_map_display(radiance);
    return vec4<f32>(color, coverage * visibility);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/terrain.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="131" bytes="7674" original_lines="131" original_bytes="7674" minified="false" sha256="06597d7cec1a9ae02447c2d411cdefd42c61b5da3f96244aa0caa7a2599e50e3">>>
struct TerrainInput {
    @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) high: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) low: vec3<f32>,
    @location(4) coverage_a: vec4<f32>,
    @location(5) coverage_b: vec2<f32>,
    @location(6) surface: vec4<f32>,
    @location(7) geometric_normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(8) habitat: vec3<f32>,
};
struct TerrainOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) high: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) low: vec3<f32>,
    @location(4) coverage_a: vec4<f32>,
    @location(5) coverage_b: vec2<f32>,
    @location(6) surface: vec4<f32>,
    @location(7) climate: vec2<f32>,
    @location(8) @interpolate(flat) geometric_normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(9) habitat: vec3<f32>,
};
fn macro_climate(direction: vec3<f32>, elevation: f32) -> vec2<f32> {
    let latitude = asin(clamp(direction.y, -1.0, 1.0));
    let angular_latitude = latitude/1.57079632679;
    let temperature = 28.0-52.0*angular_latitude*angular_latitude
        +18.0*direction.y*terrain.climate.x-max(elevation, 0.0)*0.0065+terrain.climate.y;
    let dry_belt = exp(-pow((abs(latitude)-0.5)/0.18, 2.0));
    return vec2<f32>(temperature, clamp(0.55-0.38*dry_belt+terrain.climate.z, 0.02, 0.99));
}
@vertex fn vs_terrain(input: TerrainInput) -> TerrainOutput {
    return TerrainOutput(camera.view_projection * vec4<f32>(input.position, 1.0),
        input.position, input.normal, input.high, input.low, input.coverage_a, input.coverage_b, input.surface,
        macro_climate(normalize(input.high+input.low), mix(input.surface.x,input.surface.w,terrain.climate.w)),input.geometric_normal,input.habitat);
}
@fragment fn fs_terrain(input: TerrainOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let dx = dpdx(input.low);
    let dy = dpdy(input.low);
    let footprint = max(length(dx), length(dy));
    let patches = patch_fields(input.high, input.low, footprint);
    let base_normal = normalize(input.normal);
    let to_eye = terrain.eye_relative.xyz-input.position;
    let distance = length(to_eye);
    let view = normalize(to_eye);
    let detail = 1.0-smoothstep(0.02, 0.4, footprint);
    let direction = normalize(input.high+input.low);
    let climate_height = mix(input.surface.x,input.surface.w,terrain.climate.w);
    let weather = surface_weather(direction,climate_height,input.climate);
    let temperature = weather.temperature;
    let moisture = weather.cover.w;
    let thermal = smoothstep(-3.0, 15.0, temperature);
    var cover = weather.cover.xyz;
    cover.x = min(cover.x, thermal);
    // Snow needs precipitation history or mapped permanent ice. Cold/humidity
    // alone must not paint a full snow layer over otherwise dry ground.
    let snow = clamp(max(cover.y,input.coverage_b.y)*(1.0-smoothstep(1.0,6.0,temperature)),0.0,1.0);
    let habitat = habitat_moisture(patches,moisture,cover.z,input.habitat.x);
    let heat_survival = 1.0-smoothstep(38.0,52.0,temperature);
    var weights = patch_coverage(array<f32, 6>(input.coverage_a.x, input.coverage_a.y,
        input.coverage_a.z, input.coverage_a.w, input.coverage_b.x, input.coverage_b.y),
        patches, cover.x*heat_survival, thermal*heat_survival, habitat, input.surface.y, footprint);
    weights[4] += weights[5]*(1.0-snow);
    weights[5] = snow;
    for (var layer = 0u; layer < 5u; layer++) { weights[layer] *= 1.0-snow; }
    if terrain.debug.x == 7u {
        return vec4<f32>(input.habitat.y, input.habitat.x, 0.1, 1.0);
    }
    if terrain.debug.x == 8u {
        return vec4<f32>(mix(vec3<f32>(0.8,0.25,0.05),vec3<f32>(0.05,0.65,0.8),input.habitat.z),1.0);
    }
    if terrain.debug.x == 6u {
        let colors = array<vec3<f32>,6>(vec3<f32>(0.8,0.6,0.2),vec3<f32>(0.35,0.16,0.06),
            vec3<f32>(0.05,0.8,0.1),vec3<f32>(0.5,0.2,0.05),vec3<f32>(0.35,0.4,0.5),vec3<f32>(1.0));
        var color = vec3<f32>(0.0);
        var total = 0.0;
        for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) { color += weights[i]*colors[i]; total += weights[i]; }
        return vec4<f32>(color/max(total,0.0001),1.0);
    }
    let greenness = smoothstep(0.12,0.5,habitat)*heat_survival;
    let sample = blend_terrain(input.high,input.low,base_normal,weights,dx,dy,detail,greenness);
    var albedo = sample.albedo;
    let packed = sample.packed;
    let normal = sample.normal;
    let macro_variation = 1.0+(patches.x-0.5)*mix(0.16,0.04,snow);
    var total_weight = 0.0;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) { total_weight += weights[i]; }
    let loose_fraction = (weights[0]+weights[1])/max(total_weight,0.0001);
    let mineral_tint = mix(vec3<f32>(0.95,0.98,1.03),vec3<f32>(1.04,1.0,0.95),patches.y);
    albedo *= mix(vec3<f32>(1.0),mineral_tint,loose_fraction);
    // Signed ground height defines a narrow damp shore; water is separate geometry.
    let shore = (1.0-smoothstep(0.05,1.2,input.surface.x))
        *(1.0-snow)*(1.0-smoothstep(0.05,0.3,input.surface.y))*input.surface.z;
    let wetness = max(cover.z,shore*0.65);
    albedo *= macro_variation * mix(1.0, 0.62, wetness);
    if terrain.debug.x == 5u { return vec4<f32>(albedo,1.0); }
    if terrain.debug.x == 1u { albedo = vec3<f32>(0.5); }
    let base_roughness = clamp(mix(packed.r, 0.16, wetness), 0.08, 1.0);
    // Broaden highlights when unresolved normal variation would otherwise sparkle.
    let normal_dx = dpdx(normal);
    let normal_dy = dpdy(normal);
    let variance = min(0.15,0.5*max(dot(normal_dx,normal_dx),dot(normal_dy,normal_dy)));
    let roughness = pow(min(1.0,pow(base_roughness,4.0)+variance),0.25);
    var visibility = 1.0;
    var direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    if length(environment.sun_geometric_world.xyz) > 1e-8 {
        let light = normalize(select(environment.sun_geometric_world.xyz,environment.global_sun_direction.xyz,physical_atmosphere()));
        if shadow.flags.y == 1u { visibility = shadow_visibility(input.position, input.geometric_normal, light); }
        var irradiance = environment.local_sun_rgb_visibility.xyz;
        if physical_atmosphere() { irradiance=physical_sun(input.position); }
        direct += surface_light(normal, view, light, albedo, roughness, packed.a) * irradiance * visibility;
    }
    if length(environment.moon_geometric_world.xyz) > 1e-8 {
        let light = normalize(select(environment.moon_geometric_world.xyz,surface_moon_direction(),physical_atmosphere()));
        var moon_visibility = 1.0;
        if shadow.flags.y == 2u { moon_visibility = shadow_visibility(input.position, input.geometric_normal, light); visibility = moon_visibility; }
        var irradiance=environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.xyz;
        if physical_atmosphere() {irradiance=physical_moon(input.position);}
        direct += surface_light(normal, view, light, albedo, roughness, packed.a) * irradiance * moon_visibility;
    }
    if terrain.debug.x == 2u { return vec4<f32>(normal*0.5+0.5, 1.0); }
    if terrain.debug.x == 3u { return vec4<f32>(vec3<f32>(input.clip.z), 1.0); }
    if terrain.debug.x == 4u { return vec4<f32>(vec3<f32>(visibility), 1.0); }
    // Cached landform concavity supplies a restrained cavity approximation.
    // It attenuates only indirect light; directional shadows remain geometric.
    let shelter=smoothstep(0.45,0.85,input.habitat.x)*(1.0-smoothstep(0.15,0.5,input.habitat.y));
    let ambient = terrain_ambient(normal,view,direction,albedo,roughness,
        packed.g*mix(1.0,0.65,shelter),packed.a,input.position);
    return vec4<f32>(tone_map_linear(ambient+direct), 1.0);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/terrain_blend.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="74" bytes="3816" original_lines="74" original_bytes="3816" minified="false" sha256="2aa5cfc80d36320d3e285fad4b31f67885fa7d2ccb2021eebf8f53b712f8e386">>>
// All cover fractions contribute mean color. Only two dominant layers add detail.
// Detail vanishes before the selected pair changes, including three-way ties.
fn blend_terrain(high: vec3<f32>, low: vec3<f32>, n: vec3<f32>,
    source_weights: array<f32,6>, dx: vec3<f32>, dy: vec3<f32>,
    detail: f32, greenness: f32) -> MaterialSample {
    var weights = source_weights;
    var total = 0.0;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) { total += weights[i]; }
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) { weights[i] /= max(total,0.00001); }
    var first = 0u;
    var second = 1u;
    if weights[second] > weights[first] { first = 1u; second = 0u; }
    for (var i = 2u; i < 6u; i++) {
        if weights[i] > weights[first] { second = first; first = i; }
        else if weights[i] > weights[second] { second = i; }
    }
    var third_weight = 0.0;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) {
        if i != first && i != second { third_weight = max(third_weight,weights[i]); }
    }
    let mean_packed = vec4<f32>(0.85,1.0,0.5,0.04);
    var result = MaterialSample(vec3<f32>(0.0),n,mean_packed);
    var perturbation = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var first_sample = MaterialSample(vec3<f32>(0.0),n,mean_packed);
    var second_sample = first_sample;
    var first_gate = 0.0;
    var second_gate = 0.0;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) {
        if weights[i] > 0.0 {
            var mean = terrain.mean_albedo[i].rgb;
            if i == 2u { mean = grass_color(mean,greenness); }
            result.albedo += mean*weights[i];
            let resolved = material_resolution(i,dx,dy);
            if (i == first || i == second) && resolved > 0.0 {
                let gate = smoothstep(0.0,max(0.03,weights[first]*0.25),weights[i]-third_weight);
                if gate > 0.0 {
                    var sample = terrain_material(high,low,n,i,dx,dy,detail);
                    if i == 2u { sample.albedo = grass_color(sample.albedo,greenness); }
                    // Microheight modulates resolved detail, without changing pair continuity.
                    let relief = mix(1.0,0.5+0.5*sample.packed.b,1.0-terrain.scales_b_blend.z);
                    let fraction = weights[i]*gate*relief*resolved;
                    if i == first {
                        first_sample = sample;
                        first_gate = gate*resolved;
                    } else {
                        second_sample = sample;
                        second_gate = gate*resolved;
                    }
                    result.albedo += (sample.albedo-mean)*fraction;
                    result.packed += (sample.packed-mean_packed)*fraction;
                    perturbation += (sample.normal-n)*fraction;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Height changes the boundary between the resolved pair. All omitted layers
    // retain their mean contribution; pair changes fade before any transfer.
    let mass = weights[first]+weights[second];
    let first_share = weights[first]/max(mass,0.00001);
    let height_bias = (first_sample.packed.b-second_sample.packed.b)
        *(1.0-terrain.scales_b_blend.z)*0.5;
    let transfer = (clamp(first_share+height_bias,0.0,1.0)*mass-weights[first])
        *min(first_gate,second_gate);
    result.albedo = max(result.albedo+(first_sample.albedo-second_sample.albedo)*transfer,vec3<f32>(0.0));
    result.packed += (first_sample.packed-second_sample.packed)*transfer;
    perturbation += (first_sample.normal-second_sample.normal)*transfer;
    result.normal = normalize(n+perturbation);
    return result;
}

fn grass_color(color: vec3<f32>, greenness: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let luminance = dot(color,vec3<f32>(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722));
    return mix(luminance*vec3<f32>(1.2,1.03,0.58),color,greenness);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/terrain_climate.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="48" bytes="2545" original_lines="48" original_bytes="2545" minified="false" sha256="b1158a2f23781a57998ed2d98b979558e769c367bb22f9f614565d4b8eb30428">>>
// Both views sample the same UTC endpoints and planet-anchored weather fields.
struct SurfaceWeather {
    cover: vec4<f32>,
    temperature: f32,
};

fn history_sample(map: texture_2d_array<f32>, uv: vec2<f32>, elevation: f32) -> SurfaceWeather {
    let phase = terrain.cover.x;
    let cover = mix(textureSampleLevel(map, material_sampler, uv, 0, 0.0),
        textureSampleLevel(map, material_sampler, uv, 2, 0.0), phase);
    let climate = mix(textureSampleLevel(map, material_sampler, uv, 1, 0.0),
        textureSampleLevel(map, material_sampler, uv, 3, 0.0), phase);
    let temperature = climate.x-(max(elevation,0.0)-max(climate.y,0.0))*0.0065;
    return SurfaceWeather(cover,temperature);
}

fn surface_weather(direction: vec3<f32>, elevation: f32, fallback: vec2<f32>) -> SurfaceWeather {
    var result = SurfaceWeather(vec4<f32>(smoothstep(-3.0,15.0,fallback.x)
        *smoothstep(0.08,0.55,fallback.y),0.0,0.0,fallback.y),fallback.x);
    let longitude = atan2(direction.z,direction.x);
    let latitude = asin(clamp(direction.y,-1.0,1.0));
    var local_influence = 0.0;
    var local_sample = result;
    if terrain.cover_center.w > 0.0 && abs(latitude) < 1.54 {
        let delta = longitude-terrain.cover_center.x;
        let dx = atan2(sin(delta),cos(delta));
        let local = vec2<f32>(dx,latitude-terrain.cover_center.y)/terrain.cover_center.w;
        let edge = max(abs(local.x*2.0-1.0),abs(local.y*2.0-1.0));
        let influence = (1.0-smoothstep(0.65,1.0,edge))*terrain.cover.y;
        local_influence = influence;
        if influence > 0.0 {
            let size = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(surface_cover));
            let uv = (clamp(local,vec2<f32>(0.0),vec2<f32>(1.0))*(size-1.0)+0.5)/size;
            local_sample = history_sample(surface_cover,uv,elevation);
        }
    }
    if terrain.cover.z > 0.0 && local_influence < 1.0 {
        let size = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(planet_cover));
        let global_uv = vec2<f32>(longitude/6.28318530718+0.5,0.5-latitude/3.14159265359);
        let uv = (global_uv*(size-1.0)+0.5)/size;
        let sample = history_sample(planet_cover,uv,elevation);
        result.cover = mix(result.cover,sample.cover,terrain.cover.y);
        result.temperature = mix(result.temperature,sample.temperature,terrain.cover.y);
    }
    result.cover = mix(result.cover,local_sample.cover,local_influence);
    result.temperature = mix(result.temperature,local_sample.temperature,local_influence);
    return result;
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/terrain_material.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="164" bytes="7682" original_lines="164" original_bytes="7682" minified="false" sha256="d5537484cc19c5308fa5c001d021537ee43fcfc62be8fcf69f352b89fc4d180a">>>
struct TerrainSettings {
    scales_a: vec4<f32>,
    scales_b_blend: vec4<f32>,
    cover: vec4<f32>,
    debug: vec4<u32>,
    cover_center: vec4<f32>,
    cover_east: vec4<f32>,
    cover_north: vec4<f32>,
    eye_relative: vec4<f32>,
    climate: vec4<f32>,
    mean_albedo: array<vec4<f32>,6>,
};
@group(1) @binding(0) var material_albedo: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(1) var material_normal: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(2) var material_packed: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(3) var material_sampler: sampler;
@group(1) @binding(4) var<uniform> terrain: TerrainSettings;
@group(1) @binding(5) var surface_cover: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(6) var planet_cover: texture_2d_array<f32>;

struct MaterialSample {
    albedo: vec3<f32>,
    normal: vec3<f32>,
    packed: vec4<f32>,
};

fn material_scale(layer: u32) -> f32 {
    if layer < 4u { return terrain.scales_a[layer]; }
    return terrain.scales_b_blend[layer - 4u];
}

fn tile_hash(p: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    var h = bitcast<vec2<u32>>(vec2<i32>(p));
    h = h ^ (h.yx*1664525u+1013904223u);
    h = h ^ (h >> vec2<u32>(16u));
    h *= 2246822519u;
    h = h ^ (h >> vec2<u32>(13u));
    return vec2<f32>(h & vec2<u32>(0x00ffffffu))/16777216.0;
}

// Blending independent offsets on a coarse lattice avoids hard random-tile edges.
struct WarpedCoordinates {
    uv: vec2<f32>,
    du: vec2<f32>,
    dv: vec2<f32>,
};

fn warped_uv(high: vec2<f32>, low: vec2<f32>, scale: f32) -> WarpedCoordinates {
    let anchor_cell = floor(high/64.0);
    let local = (high-anchor_cell*64.0+low)/64.0;
    let cell = anchor_cell+floor(local);
    let fraction = fract(local);
    let t = fraction*fraction*(3.0-2.0*fraction);
    let dt = 6.0*fraction*(1.0-fraction)/64.0;
    let a = tile_hash(cell);
    let b = tile_hash(cell + vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0));
    let c = tile_hash(cell + vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0));
    let d = tile_hash(cell + vec2<f32>(1.0));
    let warp = mix(mix(a, b, t.x), mix(c, d, t.x), t.y);
    let du = vec2<f32>(1.0/scale, 0.0) + 2.0*mix(b-a, d-c, t.y)*dt.x;
    let dv = vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0/scale) + 2.0*mix(c-a, d-b, t.x)*dt.y;
    // Integer modular arithmetic preserves millimetre tile phase on Earth-sized planets.
    let period = max(i32(round(scale*1000.0)), 1);
    let anchor = vec2<i32>(high);
    let phase = vec2<f32>((anchor % vec2<i32>(period))*1000 % vec2<i32>(period))/f32(period);
    return WarpedCoordinates(phase + low / (f32(period)/1000.0) + warp * 2.0, du, dv);
}

// Gradients are evaluated once in the fragment entry, before material selection.
fn plane_sample(high: vec2<f32>, low: vec2<f32>, layer: u32, dx: vec2<f32>, dy: vec2<f32>, detail: f32) -> MaterialSample {
    let scale = material_scale(layer);
    let coordinates = warped_uv(high, low, scale);
    let uv = coordinates.uv;
    let gradient_x = coordinates.du*dx.x + coordinates.dv*dx.y;
    let gradient_y = coordinates.du*dy.x + coordinates.dv*dy.y;
    let color = textureSampleGrad(material_albedo, material_sampler, uv, i32(layer), gradient_x, gradient_y).rgb;
    let packed = textureSampleGrad(material_packed, material_sampler, uv, i32(layer), gradient_x, gradient_y);
    var normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    if detail > 0.001 {
        let sampled = textureSampleGrad(material_normal, material_sampler, uv, i32(layer), gradient_x, gradient_y).xy*2.0-1.0;
        let texels = f32(textureDimensions(material_normal).x);
        let footprint = max(length(gradient_x),length(gradient_y))*texels;
        let resolved = 1.0-smoothstep(1.0,8.0,footprint);
        let xy = vec2<f32>(dot(coordinates.du*scale, sampled), dot(coordinates.dv*scale, sampled))*detail*resolved;
        normal = vec3<f32>(xy, sqrt(max(1.0-dot(xy, xy), 0.001)));
    }
    return MaterialSample(color, normal, packed);
}

fn material_resolution(layer: u32, dx: vec3<f32>, dy: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let footprint = max(length(dx),length(dy))/material_scale(layer);
    return 1.0-smoothstep(0.08,0.5,footprint);
}

fn terrain_material(high: vec3<f32>, low: vec3<f32>, n: vec3<f32>, layer: u32,
    dx: vec3<f32>, dy: vec3<f32>, detail: f32) -> MaterialSample {
    let p = abs(n)*abs(n)*abs(n)*abs(n);
    let raw_w = p/max(dot(p, vec3<f32>(1.0)), 0.0001);
    // A skipped projection must have zero contribution at the branch boundary.
    let w = raw_w*smoothstep(vec3<f32>(0.02),vec3<f32>(0.04),raw_w);
    var color = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var packed = vec4<f32>(0.0);
    var gradient = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var total = 0.0;
    for (var axis = 0u; axis < 3u; axis++) {
        if w[axis] > 0.0 {
            var sample: MaterialSample;
            var g = vec3<f32>(0.0);
            if axis == 0u {
                sample = plane_sample(high.yz, low.yz, layer, dx.yz, dy.yz, detail);
                g = vec3<f32>(0.0, sample.normal.x, sample.normal.y);
            } else if axis == 1u {
                sample = plane_sample(high.xz, low.xz, layer, dx.xz, dy.xz, detail);
                g = vec3<f32>(sample.normal.x, 0.0, sample.normal.y);
            } else {
                sample = plane_sample(high.xy, low.xy, layer, dx.xy, dy.xy, detail);
                g = vec3<f32>(sample.normal.x, sample.normal.y, 0.0);
            }
            color += sample.albedo*w[axis];
            packed += sample.packed*w[axis];
            gradient += g*w[axis];
            total += w[axis];
        }
    }
    var result = MaterialSample(color/total, normalize(n+gradient-n*dot(n, gradient)), packed/total);
    return result;
}

fn surface_light(n: vec3<f32>, v: vec3<f32>, l: vec3<f32>, albedo: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32, f0: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let half_vector = v+l;
    let h = half_vector/max(length(half_vector),0.00001);
    let nl = max(dot(n,l), 0.0);
    let nv = max(dot(n,v), 0.001);
    let nh = max(dot(n,h), 0.0);
    let vh = max(dot(v,h), 0.0);
    let a2 = pow(roughness, 4.0);
    let d = a2 / max(3.14159265 * pow(nh*nh*(a2-1.0)+1.0, 2.0), 0.0001);
    let k = pow(roughness+1.0, 2.0)/8.0;
    let g = nl/(nl*(1.0-k)+k) * nv/(nv*(1.0-k)+k);
    let fresnel = f0 + (1.0-f0)*pow(1.0-vh, 5.0);
    return albedo*(1.0-fresnel)*nl + vec3<f32>(d*g*fresnel/max(4.0*nv, 0.001));
}

// Low-cost hemisphere lighting and a broad sky reflection. This has no scene
// captures, visibility queries or sharp environment reflections.
fn terrain_ambient(n: vec3<f32>, v: vec3<f32>, up: vec3<f32>, albedo: vec3<f32>,
    roughness: f32, ao: f32, f0: f32, local_position: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    var ambient_light=environment.ambient_rgb_exposure.xyz;
    if physical_atmosphere() { ambient_light=physical_ambient(local_position); }
    let sky_facing = clamp(dot(n,up)*0.5+0.5,0.0,1.0);
    let diffuse_light = ambient_light*mix(0.45,1.0,sky_facing);
    let reflection = reflect(-v,n);
    let sky_weight = clamp(dot(reflection,up),0.0,1.0);
    var sky = mix(environment.sky_horizon_rgb_star_visibility.xyz,
        environment.sky_zenith_rgb_sun_altitude.xyz,sqrt(sky_weight));
    if physical_atmosphere() {sky=ambient_light*mix(1.4,2.2,sqrt(sky_weight));}
    let ground = ambient_light*albedo*0.35;
    let reflected_light = mix(ground,sky,smoothstep(-0.1,0.25,dot(reflection,up)));
    let nv = max(dot(n,v),0.0);
    let fresnel = f0+(max(1.0-roughness,f0)-f0)*pow(1.0-nv,5.0);
    // Broad lobes retain less directional contrast; keep the approximation weak.
    let specular = reflected_light*fresnel*mix(0.45,0.15,roughness);
    return (albedo*diffuse_light*(1.0-fresnel)+specular)*ao;
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/terrain_patch.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="70" bytes="3860" original_lines="70" original_bytes="3860" minified="false" sha256="36ae219fde70fdc6c666edd6c3f84c9fc48f352b98ce9e068ea9091edf8124dc">>>
// Stateless, planet-space value noise. No sector IDs, time or render origin.
fn patch_hash(cell: vec3<i32>, salt: u32) -> f32 {
    let c = bitcast<vec3<u32>>(cell);
    var h = c.x*1597334677u ^ c.y*3812015801u ^ c.z*2798796415u;
    h ^= terrain.debug.y ^ terrain.debug.z*2246822519u ^ salt;
    h = (h ^ (h >> 16u))*2246822519u;
    h = (h ^ (h >> 13u))*3266489917u;
    return f32((h ^ (h >> 16u)) & 0x00ffffffu)/16777216.0;
}

fn patch_noise(high: vec3<f32>, low: vec3<f32>, scale: f32, salt: u32) -> f32 {
    // Split before adding: preserve local precision at Earth-sized coordinates.
    let anchor = floor(high/scale);
    let local = (high-anchor*scale+low)/scale;
    let cell = vec3<i32>(anchor)+vec3<i32>(floor(local));
    let f = fract(local);
    let t = f*f*f*(f*(f*6.0-15.0)+10.0);
    let a = mix(patch_hash(cell, salt), patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(1,0,0), salt), t.x);
    let b = mix(patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(0,1,0), salt), patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(1,1,0), salt), t.x);
    let c = mix(patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(0,0,1), salt), patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(1,0,1), salt), t.x);
    let d = mix(patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(0,1,1), salt), patch_hash(cell+vec3<i32>(1,1,1), salt), t.x);
    return mix(mix(a,b,t.y), mix(c,d,t.y), t.z);
}

fn patch_fields(high: vec3<f32>, low: vec3<f32>, footprint: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    var broad = 0.5;
    var ground = 0.5;
    var tuft = 0.5;
    if (footprint < 2048.0) { broad = patch_noise(high, low, 2048.0, 1327u); }
    if (footprint < 32.0) { ground = patch_noise(high, low, 32.0, 4789u); }
    if (footprint < 4.0) { tuft = patch_noise(high, low, 4.0, 7919u); }
    // Remove unresolved variation rather than aliasing it into distant stripes.
    // Interpolation concentrates raw values near 0.5. Remap before filtering
    // so actual patches survive instead of a nearly uniform material average.
    let shaped = smoothstep(vec3<f32>(0.2),vec3<f32>(0.8),vec3<f32>(broad,ground,tuft));
    return mix(shaped, vec3<f32>(0.5),
        smoothstep(vec3<f32>(512.0,8.0,1.0), vec3<f32>(2048.0,32.0,4.0), vec3<f32>(footprint)));
}

// Measured landform dominates habitat; noise only perturbs its local boundary.
fn habitat_moisture(fields: vec3<f32>, moisture: f32, wetness: f32, retention: f32) -> f32 {
    return clamp(moisture*(0.65+retention*0.85)+wetness*0.12+(fields.x-0.5)*0.04,0.0,1.0);
}

fn patch_coverage(base: array<f32,6>, fields: vec3<f32>, vegetation: f32,
    thermal: f32, habitat: f32, slope: f32, footprint: f32) -> array<f32,6> {
    var weights = base;
    let support = thermal*smoothstep(0.10,0.36,habitat)*(1.0-smoothstep(0.08,0.3,slope));
    let frequency = mix(0.08,0.72,smoothstep(0.1,0.55,habitat));
    let threshold = 1.0-frequency;
    let resolved = 1.0-smoothstep(2.0,24.0,footprint);
    // Integrate unresolved patches towards their area fraction, not a threshold
    // applied to mean noise (which would make entire biomes disappear at a LOD).
    let local = smoothstep(threshold-0.16,threshold+0.16,fields.y*0.7+fields.z*0.3);
    let patchiness = mix(frequency,local,resolved);
    let loose = base[0]+base[1];
    let colonized = support*patchiness*0.45;
    let dry = 1.0-smoothstep(0.16,0.5,habitat);
    let sand_fraction = clamp(base[0]/max(loose,0.0001)+dry*(fields.y-0.5)*0.25,0.0,1.0);
    weights[0] = loose*(1.0-colonized)*sand_fraction;
    weights[1] = loose*(1.0-colonized)*(1.0-sand_fraction);
    let living = clamp(vegetation*mix(0.45,1.55,patchiness),0.0,1.0);
    weights[2] = base[2]*living+loose*colonized;
    weights[1] += base[2]*(1.0-living);
    weights[3] = base[3]*mix(1.15,0.8,patchiness);
    var total = 0.0;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) { total += weights[i]; }
    for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i++) { weights[i] /= max(total,0.0001); }
    return weights;
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/ui.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="24" bytes="837" original_lines="24" original_bytes="837" minified="false" sha256="5089c745095d2472e0691b6c4da76d5a26ff1144a2baa73e7f7ea8c30a51cf65">>>
struct VertexInput {
    @location(0) position: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(2) color: vec3<f32>,
};
struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) color: vec3<f32>,
};
@group(0) @binding(0) var font_atlas: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var font_sampler: sampler;
@vertex fn vs_main(input: VertexInput) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    out.clip_position = vec4<f32>(input.position, 0.0, 1.0);
    out.uv = input.uv;
    out.color = input.color;
    return out;
}
@fragment fn fs_main(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let alpha = textureSample(font_atlas, font_sampler, input.uv).r;
    let linear = srgb_to_linear(input.color);
    return vec4<f32>(linear, alpha);

struct VertexInput {
    @location(0) position: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(2) color: vec3<f32>,
};
struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) color: vec3<f32>,
};
@group(0) @binding(0) var font_atlas: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var font_sampler: sampler;
const surface_is_srgb: bool = OUTPUT_SURFACE_IS_SRGB;
@vertex fn vs_main(input: VertexInput) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    out.clip_position = vec4<f32>(input.position, 0.0, 1.0);
    out.uv = input.uv;
    out.color = input.color;
    return out;
}
@fragment fn fs_main(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let alpha = textureSample(font_atlas, font_sampler, input.uv).r;
    let linear = srgb_to_linear(input.color);
    let encoded = select(linear_to_srgb(linear), linear, surface_is_srgb);

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shaders/world.wgsl" plugin="shader" lang="wgsl" reason="extension:.wgsl" lines="51" bytes="2403" original_lines="51" original_bytes="2403" minified="false" sha256="446eed51de7caf69e620eefba01830fc8e89e5e0386ec0af04062a970878f626">>>
struct VertexInput {
    @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) color: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) normal: vec3<f32>,
};
struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) color: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) world_position: vec3<f32>,
};
@vertex fn vs_main(input: VertexInput) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    out.clip_position = camera.view_projection * vec4<f32>(input.position, 1.0);
    out.color = input.color;
    out.normal = input.normal;
    out.world_position = input.position;
    return out;
}
@fragment fn fs_main(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let normal = normalize(input.normal + vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0e-8, 0.0));
    let albedo = srgb_to_linear(input.color);
    var direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    let sun_direction = select(environment.sun_geometric_world.xyz,environment.global_sun_direction.xyz,physical_atmosphere());
    if length(sun_direction) > 1.0e-8 {
        let sun_diffuse = max(dot(normal, normalize(sun_direction)), 0.0);
        var visibility = 1.0;
        if shadow.flags.x != 0u && shadow.flags.y == 1u {
            visibility = shadow_visibility(input.world_position, normal, sun_direction);
        }
        var irradiance=environment.local_sun_rgb_visibility.xyz;
        if physical_atmosphere() { irradiance=physical_sun(input.world_position); }
        direct = irradiance * sun_diffuse
            * visibility;
    }
    let moon_direction = select(environment.moon_geometric_world.xyz,surface_moon_direction(),physical_atmosphere());
    if length(moon_direction) > 1.0e-8 {
        let moon_diffuse = max(dot(normal, normalize(moon_direction)), 0.0);
        var visibility = 1.0;
        if shadow.flags.x != 0u && shadow.flags.y == 2u {
            visibility = shadow_visibility(input.world_position, normal, moon_direction);
        }
        var irradiance=environment.local_moon_rgb_visibility.xyz;
        if physical_atmosphere() {irradiance=physical_moon(input.world_position);}
        direct += irradiance * moon_diffuse * visibility;
    }
    var ambient=environment.ambient_rgb_exposure.xyz;
    if physical_atmosphere() { ambient=physical_ambient(input.world_position); }
    let linear = albedo * (ambient + direct);
    return vec4<f32>(tone_map_linear(linear), 1.0);
}

fn combine(parts: &[&str]) -> String {
    let capacity = parts.iter().map(|part| part.len() + 1).sum();
    let mut source = String::with_capacity(capacity);
    for part in parts {
        source.push_str(part);
        source.push('\n');
    }
    source
}

pub fn atmosphere_compute(kind: &str) -> String {
    let (dimension, entry) = match kind {
        "sky" => ("2d", include_str!("shaders/atmosphere_sky_compute.wgsl")),
        "aerial" => ("3d", include_str!("shaders/atmosphere_aerial_compute.wgsl")),
        _ => ("2d", include_str!("shaders/atmosphere_multi_compute.wgsl")),
    };
    let body = include_str!("shaders/atmosphere_compute.wgsl")
        .replace("__DIM__", dimension)
        .replace("__ENTRY__", entry);
    combine(&[
        include_str!("shaders/frame.wgsl"),
        include_str!("shaders/atmosphere_frame.wgsl"),
        include_str!("shaders/atmosphere_common.wgsl"),
        &body,
    ])
}
