<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shadow_geometry.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="124" bytes="4153" original_lines="124" original_bytes="4153" minified="false" sha256="5edd21b5b90adc96a69f31d553839b4595eba1a14bec50bc4117b36663c3dfd5">>>
//! Spatial bounds and local geometry selection used by the shadow renderer.
use minimium_procgen::SectorGeometry;
use minimium_world::world::{MapBox, MapTriangle, WorldMap};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ShadowBounds {
    pub minimum: [f64; 3],
    pub maximum: [f64; 3],
}

impl ShadowBounds {
    pub fn intersects_sphere(self, center: [f64; 3], radius: f64) -> bool {
        self.distance_to(center) <= radius
    }

    pub fn distance_to(self, center: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
        let distance_squared = (0..3)
            .map(|axis| {
                let outside = if center[axis] < self.minimum[axis] {
                    self.minimum[axis] - center[axis]
                } else if center[axis] > self.maximum[axis] {
                    center[axis] - self.maximum[axis]
                } else {
                    0.0
                };
                outside * outside
            })
            .sum::<f64>();
        distance_squared.sqrt()
    }
}

pub fn geometry_bounds(geometry: &SectorGeometry) -> Option<ShadowBounds> {
    let mut bounds = EmptyBounds::new();
    for map_box in &geometry.boxes {
        let half = map_box.size.map(|value| f64::from(value.abs()) * 0.5);
        let center = map_box.center.map(f64::from);
        bounds.include(std::array::from_fn(|axis| center[axis] - half[axis]));
        bounds.include(std::array::from_fn(|axis| center[axis] + half[axis]));
    }
    for triangle in &geometry.triangles {
        let points = triangle.precise_vertices.map_or_else(
            || triangle.vertices.map(|point| point.map(f64::from)),
            |vertices| vertices.map(|point| point.map(|value| value as f64 / 1000.0)),
        );
        for point in points {
            bounds.include(point);
        }
    }
    bounds.finish()
}

struct EmptyBounds {
    minimum: [f64; 3],
    maximum: [f64; 3],
}

impl EmptyBounds {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            minimum: [f64::INFINITY; 3],
            maximum: [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 3],
        }
    }

    fn include(&mut self, point: [f64; 3]) {
        for (axis, coordinate) in point.into_iter().enumerate() {
            self.minimum[axis] = self.minimum[axis].min(coordinate);
            self.maximum[axis] = self.maximum[axis].max(coordinate);
        }
    }

    fn finish(self) -> Option<ShadowBounds> {
        (0..3)
            .all(|axis| self.minimum[axis].is_finite() && self.maximum[axis].is_finite())
            .then_some(ShadowBounds {
                minimum: self.minimum,
                maximum: self.maximum,
            })
    }
}

/// Selects authored map geometry near the current visual caster origin.
/// A 300 m cache radius leaves room for 20 m scene refresh steps around the 256 m caster range.
pub fn local_map_geometry(map: &WorldMap, center: [f64; 3], radius: f64) -> SectorGeometry {
    let boxes = map
        .boxes()
        .iter()
        .copied()
        .filter(|item| box_bounds(*item).intersects_sphere(center, radius))
        .collect();
    let triangles = map
        .triangles()
        .iter()
        .copied()
        .filter(|item| triangle_bounds(*item).intersects_sphere(center, radius))
        .collect();
    SectorGeometry { boxes, triangles }
}

fn box_bounds(item: MapBox) -> ShadowBounds {
    let half = item.size.map(|value| f64::from(value.abs()) * 0.5);
    let center = item.center.map(f64::from);
    ShadowBounds {
        minimum: std::array::from_fn(|axis| center[axis] - half[axis]),
        maximum: std::array::from_fn(|axis| center[axis] + half[axis]),
    }
}

fn triangle_bounds(item: MapTriangle) -> ShadowBounds {
    let vertices = item.precise_vertices.map_or_else(
        || item.vertices.map(|point| point.map(f64::from)),
        |points| points.map(|point| point.map(|value| value as f64 / 1000.0)),
    );
    let mut minimum = [f64::INFINITY; 3];
    let mut maximum = [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 3];
    for point in vertices {
        for axis in 0..3 {
            minimum[axis] = minimum[axis].min(point[axis]);
            maximum[axis] = maximum[axis].max(point[axis]);
        }
    }
    ShadowBounds { minimum, maximum }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shadow_gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="394" bytes="14032" original_lines="394" original_bytes="14032" minified="false" sha256="5d912e82ab132d5c6daac673c274dc3b9cb478f33888d4c9fda6a18e6eaa0679">>>
use crate::{
    geometry::Vertex,
    shadow_target::{create_target_checked, uniform_layout_entry, DEFAULT_RESOLUTION},
    shadow_uniform::ShadowUniform,
    ShadowSettings,
};
use bytemuck::Zeroable;
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

pub struct ShadowGpu {
    pub settings: ShadowSettings,
    pub fallback_reason: Option<&'static str>,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    pub depth_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub depth_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub uniform_bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub sampling_bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub empty_bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub empty_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub group2_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    map_casters: Option<wgpu::Buffer>,
    map_caster_count: u32,
    player_casters: Option<wgpu::Buffer>,
    player_caster_count: u32,
    _texture: wgpu::Texture,
    sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
    gpu_bytes: u64,
}

impl ShadowGpu {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        settings: ShadowSettings,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
        let uniform_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow-depth-uniform-layout"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(128),
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });
        let group2_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("world-shadow-sampling-layout"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Comparison),
                    count: None,
                },
                uniform_layout_entry(2, wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT),
            ],
        });
        let empty_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("world-material-reserved-layout"),
            entries: &[],
        });
        let empty_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("world-material-empty-bind-group"),
            layout: &empty_layout,
            entries: &[],
        });
        let uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
            label: Some("world-shadow-uniform"),
            contents: bytemuck::bytes_of(&ShadowUniform::zeroed()),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        });
        let uniform_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow-depth-uniform-bind-group"),
            layout: &uniform_layout,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        });
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow-comparison-sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::MipmapFilterMode::Nearest,
            compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual),
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("local-shadow-depth-shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::shaders::SHADOW_WGSL.into()),
        });
        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("local-shadow-depth-pipeline-layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&uniform_layout)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let depth_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("local-shadow-depth-pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("vs_shadow"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                buffers: &[Some(Vertex::layout())],
            },
            fragment: None,
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                cull_mode: None,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format,
                depth_write_enabled: Some(true),
                depth_compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::Less),
                stencil: Default::default(),
                bias: Default::default(),
            }),
            multisample: Default::default(),
            multiview_mask: None,
            cache: None,
        });
        let (settings, target, fallback_reason) = match create_target_checked(
            device,
            &group2_layout,
            &uniform_buffer,
            &sampler,
            settings,
            format,
        ) {
            Ok(target) => (settings, target, None),
            Err(_) if settings.enabled => {
                let fallback = ShadowSettings::for_quality(crate::quality::SkyQuality::Low);
                let target = create_target_checked(
                    device,
                    &group2_layout,
                    &uniform_buffer,
                    &sampler,
                    fallback,
                    format,
                )
                .map_err(|_| "fallback_shadow_texture_creation_failed")?;
                (
                    fallback,
                    target,
                    Some("standard_shadow_texture_allocation_refused"),
                )
            }
            Err(reason) => return Err(reason),
        };
        let (texture, depth_view, sampling_bind_group, gpu_bytes) = target;
        Ok(Self {
            settings,
            fallback_reason,
            format,
            depth_pipeline,
            depth_view,
            uniform_bind_group,
            sampling_bind_group,
            empty_bind_group,
            empty_layout,
            group2_layout,
            uniform_buffer,
            map_casters: None,
            map_caster_count: 0,
            player_casters: None,
            player_caster_count: 0,
            _texture: texture,
            sampler,
            gpu_bytes,
        })
    }

    /// Encodes the depth pass for the caster buffers selected by the world adapter.
    pub fn encode_depth_pass<'a>(
        &self,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        casters: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'a wgpu::Buffer, u32)>,
        enabled: bool,
    ) -> u32 {
        if !enabled {
            return 0;
        }
        let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("local-shadow-depth-pass"),
            color_attachments: &[],
            depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                view: &self.depth_view,
                depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                }),
                stencil_ops: None,
            }),
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
            multiview_mask: None,
        });
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.depth_pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.uniform_bind_group, &[]);
        let mut draws = 0;
        for (buffer, vertex_count) in casters {
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, buffer.slice(..));
            pass.draw(0..vertex_count, 0..1);
            draws += 1;
        }
        draws
    }

    pub fn upload_map_casters(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        vertices: &[Vertex],
        capacity_bytes: u64,
    ) -> Result<u64, ()> {
        let bytes = std::mem::size_of_val(vertices) as u64;
        if bytes > capacity_bytes {
            self.map_caster_count = 0;
            return Err(());
        }
        self.map_caster_count = vertices.len() as u32;
        if vertices.is_empty() {
            return Ok(0);
        }
        let mut allocated = 0;
        if self.map_casters.is_none() {
            self.map_casters = Some(create_caster_buffer(
                device,
                "local-shadow-map-casters",
                capacity_bytes,
            ));
            allocated = capacity_bytes;
        }
        if let Some(buffer) = &self.map_casters {
            queue.write_buffer(buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(vertices));
        }
        Ok(allocated)
    }

    pub fn map_casters(&self) -> Option<(&wgpu::Buffer, u32)> {
        (self.map_caster_count > 0)
            .then(|| {
                self.map_casters
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|buffer| (buffer, self.map_caster_count))
            })
            .flatten()
    }

    pub fn map_caster_buffer_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.map_casters.as_ref().map_or(0, wgpu::Buffer::size)
    }

    pub fn release_map_casters(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.map_caster_count = 0;
        self.map_casters.take().map_or(0, |buffer| buffer.size())
    }

    pub fn clear_map_casters(&mut self) {
        self.map_caster_count = 0;
    }

    pub fn upload_player_casters(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        vertices: &[Vertex],
        capacity_bytes: u64,
    ) -> Result<u64, ()> {
        let bytes = std::mem::size_of_val(vertices) as u64;
        if bytes > capacity_bytes {
            self.player_caster_count = 0;
            return Err(());
        }
        self.player_caster_count = vertices.len() as u32;
        if vertices.is_empty() {
            return Ok(0);
        }
        let mut allocated = 0;
        if self.player_casters.is_none() {
            self.player_casters = Some(create_caster_buffer(
                device,
                "nearby-shadow-remote-players",
                capacity_bytes,
            ));
            allocated = capacity_bytes;
        }
        if let Some(buffer) = &self.player_casters {
            queue.write_buffer(buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(vertices));
        }
        Ok(allocated)
    }

    pub fn player_casters(&self) -> Option<(&wgpu::Buffer, u32)> {
        (self.player_caster_count > 0)
            .then(|| {
                self.player_casters
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|buffer| (buffer, self.player_caster_count))
            })
            .flatten()
    }

    pub fn player_caster_buffer_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.player_casters.as_ref().map_or(0, wgpu::Buffer::size)
    }

    pub fn release_player_casters(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.player_caster_count = 0;
        self.player_casters.take().map_or(0, |buffer| buffer.size())
    }

    pub fn clear_player_casters(&mut self) {
        self.player_caster_count = 0;
    }

    pub fn write_uniform(&self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, uniform: &ShadowUniform) {
        queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(uniform));
    }

    pub fn gpu_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.gpu_bytes + self.uniform_buffer.size()
    }

    pub fn reconfigure(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        settings: ShadowSettings,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if self.settings == settings {
            self.fallback_reason = None;
            return Ok(());
        }
        if settings.enabled && self.format != wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float {
            return Err("standard_profile_requires_depth32float");
        }
        let (texture, depth_view, sampling_bind_group, gpu_bytes) = create_target_checked(
            device,
            &self.group2_layout,
            &self.uniform_buffer,
            &self.sampler,
            settings,
            self.format,
        )?;
        self._texture = texture;
        self.depth_view = depth_view;
        self.sampling_bind_group = sampling_bind_group;
        self.gpu_bytes = gpu_bytes;
        self.settings = settings;
        self.fallback_reason = None;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn texture_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        let resolution = if self.settings.enabled {
            self.settings.resolution.min(DEFAULT_RESOLUTION)
        } else {
            1
        };
        let bytes_per_pixel = if self.format == wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth16Unorm {
            2
        } else {
            4
        };
        u64::from(resolution) * u64::from(resolution) * bytes_per_pixel
    }
}

fn create_caster_buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, size: u64) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        mapped_at_creation: false,
    })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shadow_target.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="116" bytes="3837" original_lines="116" original_bytes="3837" minified="false" sha256="dfdf7ff3ee1a157c2f0faf908d036c4f335b702f6848177b7ce41d557d05e0aa">>>
use crate::ShadowSettings;

pub const DEFAULT_RESOLUTION: u32 = 1024;

pub fn supported_format(
    adapter: &wgpu::Adapter,
    usages: wgpu::TextureUsages,
) -> Option<wgpu::TextureFormat> {
    [
        wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
        wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth24Plus,
        wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth16Unorm,
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .find(|format| {
        adapter
            .get_texture_format_features(*format)
            .allowed_usages
            .contains(usages)
    })
}

pub fn create_target_checked(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    uniform: &wgpu::Buffer,
    sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    settings: ShadowSettings,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> Result<(wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView, wgpu::BindGroup, u64), &'static str> {
    let out_of_memory = device.push_error_scope(wgpu::ErrorFilter::OutOfMemory);
    let validation = device.push_error_scope(wgpu::ErrorFilter::Validation);
    let target = create_target(device, layout, uniform, sampler, settings, format);
    let validation_error = pollster::block_on(validation.pop());
    let out_of_memory_error = pollster::block_on(out_of_memory.pop());
    if validation_error.is_some() {
        drop(target);
        Err("shadow_resource_validation_failed")
    } else if out_of_memory_error.is_some() {
        drop(target);
        Err("shadow_resource_allocation_failed")
    } else {
        Ok(target)
    }
}

fn create_target(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    uniform: &wgpu::Buffer,
    sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    settings: ShadowSettings,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView, wgpu::BindGroup, u64) {
    let resolution = if settings.enabled {
        settings.resolution.clamp(1, DEFAULT_RESOLUTION)
    } else {
        1
    };
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("local-shadow-depth-map"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: resolution,
            height: resolution,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let depth_view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    let sampling_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
        label: Some("world-shadow-sampling-bind-group"),
        layout,
        entries: &[
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&depth_view),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 1,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 2,
                resource: uniform.as_entire_binding(),
            },
        ],
    });
    let bytes_per_pixel = if format == wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth16Unorm {
        2
    } else {
        4
    };
    let bytes = u64::from(resolution) * u64::from(resolution) * bytes_per_pixel;
    (texture, depth_view, sampling_bind_group, bytes)
}

pub fn uniform_layout_entry(
    binding: u32,
    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages,
) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(128),
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shadow_uniform.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="134" bytes="4718" original_lines="134" original_bytes="4718" minified="false" sha256="9eadf28e8179c1d7ce03e5a8420abe2bfb2b685759bac7c6fa3e9637002adf16">>>
//! Shader layout and deterministic directional shadow projection preparation.

use crate::ShadowSettings;

const SHADOW_SOURCE_NONE: u32 = 0;

/// Uniform shared by shadow depth and sampling passes at every viewing scale.
#[repr(C, align(16))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct ShadowUniform {
    pub light_view_projection: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    pub receiver_center_relative_radius: [f32; 4],
    pub texel_depth_range: [f32; 4],
    pub bias_fade: [f32; 4],
    pub flags: [u32; 4],
}

/// Builds a stable light-space projection for one directional shadow source.
pub fn prepare(
    direction_to_body: [f64; 3],
    center_relative: [f64; 3],
    settings: ShadowSettings,
    source_id: u32,
) -> Option<ShadowUniform> {
    prepare_at_origin(
        direction_to_body,
        center_relative,
        [0.0; 3],
        settings,
        source_id,
    )
}

/// Snap in absolute f64 light space so a floating-origin shift does not move
/// the shadow texels. Cast to f32 only after constructing the relative matrix.
pub fn prepare_at_origin(
    direction_to_body: [f64; 3],
    center_world: [f64; 3],
    render_origin: [f64; 3],
    settings: ShadowSettings,
    source_id: u32,
) -> Option<ShadowUniform> {
    let to_body = glam::DVec3::from_array(direction_to_body).normalize();
    let center = glam::DVec3::from_array(center_world);
    let origin = glam::DVec3::from_array(render_origin);
    if !to_body.is_finite()
        || !center.is_finite()
        || !origin.is_finite()
        || to_body.length_squared() < 0.99
        || settings.receiver_radius_m <= 0.0
        || settings.caster_radius_m < settings.receiver_radius_m
    {
        return None;
    }
    let view_direction = -to_body;
    let reference_up = least_parallel_axis(view_direction);
    let right = view_direction.cross(reference_up).normalize();
    let up = right.cross(view_direction).normalize();
    let half_extent = f64::from(settings.receiver_radius_m) * 1.01;
    let texel_m = half_extent * 2.0 / f64::from(settings.resolution.max(1));
    let light_x = center.dot(right);
    let light_y = center.dot(up);
    let snapped_x = (light_x / texel_m).round() * texel_m;
    let snapped_y = (light_y / texel_m).round() * texel_m;
    let snapped_center = center + right * (snapped_x - light_x) + up * (snapped_y - light_y);
    let depth_radius = f64::from(settings.caster_radius_m) * 1.01;
    let relative = snapped_center - origin;
    let eye = relative + to_body * (depth_radius + 1.0);
    let view = glam::DMat4::look_at_rh(eye, relative, up);
    let near = 1.0;
    let far = 1.0 + 2.0 * depth_radius;
    let projection = glam::DMat4::orthographic_rh(
        -half_extent,
        half_extent,
        -half_extent,
        half_extent,
        near,
        far,
    );
    let matrix = (projection * view).as_mat4();
    let center_relative = (center - origin).to_array();
    let uniform = ShadowUniform {
        light_view_projection: matrix.to_cols_array_2d(),
        receiver_center_relative_radius: [
            center_relative[0] as f32,
            center_relative[1] as f32,
            center_relative[2] as f32,
            settings.receiver_radius_m,
        ],
        texel_depth_range: [
            1.0 / settings.resolution.max(1) as f32,
            1.0 / settings.resolution.max(1) as f32,
            near as f32,
            far as f32,
        ],
        bias_fade: [
            settings.constant_bias_m,
            settings.slope_bias_m,
            settings.max_bias_m,
            settings.fade_start_m,
        ],
        flags: [1, source_id, 0, 0],
    };
    uniform
        .light_view_projection
        .iter()
        .flatten()
        .all(|value| value.is_finite())
        .then_some(uniform)
}

fn least_parallel_axis(direction: glam::DVec3) -> glam::DVec3 {
    let axes = [glam::DVec3::X, glam::DVec3::Y, glam::DVec3::Z];
    *axes
        .iter()
        .min_by(|left, right| {
            direction
                .dot(**left)
                .abs()
                .total_cmp(&direction.dot(**right).abs())
        })
        .expect("basis axes are nonempty")
}

const _: () = {
    assert!(std::mem::size_of::<ShadowUniform>() == 128);
    assert!(std::mem::align_of::<ShadowUniform>() == 16);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(ShadowUniform, light_view_projection) == 0);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(ShadowUniform, receiver_center_relative_radius) == 64);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(ShadowUniform, texel_depth_range) == 80);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(ShadowUniform, bias_fade) == 96);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(ShadowUniform, flags) == 112);
    assert!(SHADOW_SOURCE_NONE == 0);
};

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/shadow_view.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="117" bytes="4522" original_lines="117" original_bytes="4522" minified="false" sha256="2b7057f925d2cfd57592eafd77060bb21e2c20f723426b3bbb1a47905169ca11">>>
//! Bounded, camera-driven shadow coverage. No terrain sampling or GPU effects.
use crate::{RenderViewFrame, ShadowSettings};
use glam::{DMat4, DVec3};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct ShadowRegion {
    pub center_world: [f64; 3],
    pub settings: ShadowSettings,
}

impl ShadowRegion {
    /// Keep contact detail when close to resident ground. From flight/overview,
    /// fit the visible reference shell instead of a sphere around the player.
    pub fn for_view(
        view: RenderViewFrame,
        local_center: [f64; 3],
        ground_distance: f64,
        base: ShadowSettings,
        previous_radius: f32,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        if !view.is_finite() || !ground_distance.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        let minimum = f64::from(base.receiver_radius_m);
        let eye = DVec3::from_array(view.camera_eye_world_m);
        let local = DVec3::from_array(local_center);
        let blend = if view.kind == crate::EnvironmentViewKind::Overview {
            1.0
        } else {
            let t = ((ground_distance - minimum * 0.25) / minimum).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
        };
        let points = surface_footprint(view);
        let (center, radius) = if blend > 0.0 && !points.is_empty() {
            let mut low = points[0];
            let mut high = low;
            for &point in &points {
                low = low.min(point);
                high = high.max(point);
            }
            let focus = (low + high) * 0.5;
            let center = local.lerp(focus, blend);
            let extent = points.iter().map(|p| p.distance(focus)).fold(0.0, f64::max);
            // Padding accommodates relief and asynchronous terrain selection;
            // the radial fade starts outside the fitted reference footprint.
            let radius = minimum + blend * (extent * 1.25 + ground_distance * 0.05);
            (center, radius)
        } else {
            (local, minimum)
        };
        if !center.is_finite() || !eye.is_finite() || !radius.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        // Quantized extents plus shrink hysteresis avoid continuous texel scaling.
        let requested = (radius.max(minimum).log2() * 4.0).ceil() / 4.0;
        let mut radius = requested.exp2() as f32;
        if previous_radius >= radius && previous_radius <= radius * 1.3 {
            radius = previous_radius;
        }
        let ratio = radius / base.receiver_radius_m;
        let settings = ShadowSettings {
            receiver_radius_m: radius,
            caster_radius_m: base.caster_radius_m * ratio,
            fade_start_m: radius * 0.9,
            constant_bias_m: base.constant_bias_m * ratio,
            slope_bias_m: base.slope_bias_m * ratio,
            max_bias_m: base.max_bias_m * ratio,
            ..base
        };
        Some(Self {
            center_world: center.to_array(),
            settings,
        })
    }
}

/// A small fixed grid includes the limb when a ray misses the planet. Sampling
/// only ray hits would collapse coverage when the disk is smaller than the view.
pub fn surface_footprint(view: RenderViewFrame) -> Vec<DVec3> {
    let eye = DVec3::from_array(view.camera_eye_world_m);
    let radius = view.game_planet_radius_m;
    if radius <= 0.0 || eye.length() < radius {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let inverse =
        DMat4::from_cols_array_2d(&view.inverse_sky_view_projection.map(|c| c.map(f64::from)));
    let mut points = Vec::with_capacity(25);
    for y in [-1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0] {
        for x in [-1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0] {
            let ray = inverse
                .project_point3(DVec3::new(x, y, 1.0))
                .normalize_or_zero();
            if let Some(point) = shell_point(eye, ray, radius) {
                points.push(point);
            }
        }
    }
    points
}

fn shell_point(eye: DVec3, ray: DVec3, radius: f64) -> Option<DVec3> {
    let distance = eye.length();
    let b = eye.dot(ray);
    if b >= 0.0 || ray.length_squared() < 0.5 {
        return None;
    }
    let c = (distance - radius) * (distance + radius);
    let discriminant = b * b - c;
    if discriminant >= 0.0 {
        let t = c / (-b + discriminant.sqrt()).max(1e-9);
        return Some(eye + ray * t);
    }
    let up = eye / distance;
    let tangent = (ray - up * ray.dot(up)).normalize_or_zero();
    let cosine = radius / distance;
    Some((up * cosine + tangent * (1.0 - cosine * cosine).max(0.0).sqrt()) * radius)
}

//! Prepared star catalogue instances and their observation epoch identity.

use minimium_assets::{
    embedded_sky_catalog, embedded_sky_catalog_identity, embedded_star_labels, CatalogError,
    SkyCatalogIdentity, StarRecord,
};
use minimium_astronomy::{CorrectedStarDirections, StarAstrometry};
use std::{error::Error, fmt};

pub const STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT: usize = 1000;
pub const STAR_GPU_RECORD_BYTES: usize = 32;
pub const STAR_COLOR_MODEL_REVISION: u32 = 1;

const UNIT_DIRECTION_TOLERANCE: f64 = 1.0e-8;
const BV_COLOR_NODES: [(f32, [f32; 3]); 7] = [
    (-0.4, [0.60, 0.70, 1.00]),
    (0.0, [0.78, 0.85, 1.00]),
    (0.4, [0.92, 0.94, 1.00]),
    (0.65, [1.00, 0.98, 0.94]),
    (1.0, [1.00, 0.85, 0.70]),
    (1.5, [1.00, 0.69, 0.48]),
    (2.0, [1.00, 0.55, 0.34]),
];

/// One per-star GPU instance: EQJ direction/magnitude, then linear RGB/HYG ID.
#[repr(C, align(16))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct StarInstanceGpu {
    pub direction_eqj: [f32; 3],
    pub visual_magnitude: f32,
    pub color_linear: [f32; 3],
    pub catalog_star_id: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum StarPrepareError {
    InvalidRecordCount { records: usize, directions: usize },
    InvalidEpochRevision,
    RecordMismatch { index: usize },
    InvalidAstrometry { index: usize },
}

impl fmt::Display for StarPrepareError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::InvalidRecordCount {
                records,
                directions,
            } => write!(
                formatter,
                "star instance count mismatch: {records} records, {directions} directions"
            ),
            Self::InvalidEpochRevision => {
                formatter.write_str("star direction epoch revision is zero")
            }
            Self::RecordMismatch { index } => {
                write!(
                    formatter,
                    "star direction ID does not match catalogue at {index}"
                )
            }
            Self::InvalidAstrometry { index } => {
                write!(
                    formatter,
                    "star astrometry is invalid at catalogue index {index}"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Error for StarPrepareError {}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub struct StarCatalogueAdapter {
    identity: SkyCatalogIdentity,
    records: &'static [StarRecord],
    labels: &'static [&'static str],
    astrometry: Box<[StarAstrometry]>,
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
impl StarCatalogueAdapter {
    pub fn load_embedded() -> Result<Self, CatalogError> {
        let catalogue = embedded_sky_catalog()?;
        let astrometry = catalogue
            .records()
            .iter()
            .map(|record| StarAstrometry {
                id: record.hyg_id,
                position_eqj_pc: record.position_eqj_pc,
                velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear: record.velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .into_boxed_slice();
        Ok(Self {
            identity: embedded_sky_catalog_identity(),
            records: catalogue.records(),
            labels: embedded_star_labels()?,
            astrometry,
        })
    }

    pub fn identity(&self) -> SkyCatalogIdentity {
        self.identity
    }

    pub fn records(&self) -> &'static [StarRecord] {
        self.records
    }

    pub fn labels(&self) -> &'static [&'static str] {
        self.labels
    }

    pub fn astrometry(&self) -> &[StarAstrometry] {
        &self.astrometry
    }

    /// Builds the exact asset-ordered GPU batch from one matching CPU epoch.
    pub fn prepare_gpu_instances(
        &self,
        corrected: &CorrectedStarDirections,
    ) -> Result<Box<[StarInstanceGpu; STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT]>, StarPrepareError> {
        if corrected.star_epoch_revision == 0 {
            return Err(StarPrepareError::InvalidEpochRevision);
        }
        let directions = corrected.directions.as_ref();
        if self.records.len() != STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT
            || self.astrometry.len() != STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT
            || directions.len() != STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT
            || directions.len() != self.records.len()
        {
            return Err(StarPrepareError::InvalidRecordCount {
                records: self.records.len(),
                directions: directions.len(),
            });
        }
        let mut instances = Box::new([StarInstanceGpu::default(); STAR_GPU_RECORD_COUNT]);
        for (index, ((record, astrometry), direction)) in self
            .records
            .iter()
            .zip(self.astrometry.iter())
            .zip(directions.iter())
            .enumerate()
        {
            if record.hyg_id != astrometry.id || record.hyg_id != direction.id {
                return Err(StarPrepareError::RecordMismatch { index });
            }
            let norm_squared = direction
                .direction_eqj
                .iter()
                .map(|component| component * component)
                .sum::<f64>();
            if !record.apparent_v_mag.is_finite()
                || !record.color_index_bv.is_finite()
                || !astrometry
                    .position_eqj_pc
                    .iter()
                    .all(|component| component.is_finite())
                || !astrometry
                    .velocity_eqj_pc_per_jyear
                    .iter()
                    .all(|component| component.is_finite())
                || !direction
                    .direction_eqj
                    .iter()
                    .all(|component| component.is_finite())
                || !norm_squared.is_finite()
                || (norm_squared - 1.0).abs() > UNIT_DIRECTION_TOLERANCE
            {
                return Err(StarPrepareError::InvalidAstrometry { index });
            }
            let direction_eqj = direction.direction_eqj.map(|component| component as f32);
            let color_linear = color_index_to_linear_rgb(record.color_index_bv);
            if !direction_eqj.iter().all(|component| component.is_finite())
                || !color_linear.iter().all(|component| component.is_finite())
            {
                return Err(StarPrepareError::InvalidAstrometry { index });
            }
            instances[index] = StarInstanceGpu {
                direction_eqj,
                visual_magnitude: record.apparent_v_mag,
                color_linear,
                catalog_star_id: record.hyg_id,
            };
        }
        Ok(instances)
    }
}

/// Version 1 bounded B−V interpolation in sRGB followed by one linearization.
fn color_index_to_linear_rgb(color_index_bv: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
    let bounded = color_index_bv.clamp(BV_COLOR_NODES[0].0, BV_COLOR_NODES[6].0);
    let upper = BV_COLOR_NODES
        .iter()
        .position(|(index, _)| *index >= bounded)
        .unwrap_or(BV_COLOR_NODES.len() - 1);
    let srgb = if upper == 0 {
        BV_COLOR_NODES[0].1
    } else {
        let (low_index, low_rgb) = BV_COLOR_NODES[upper - 1];
        let (high_index, high_rgb) = BV_COLOR_NODES[upper];
        let amount = (bounded - low_index) / (high_index - low_index);
        std::array::from_fn(|channel| {
            low_rgb[channel] + (high_rgb[channel] - low_rgb[channel]) * amount
        })
    };
    srgb.map(srgb_channel_to_linear)
}

fn srgb_channel_to_linear(channel: f32) -> f32 {
    if channel <= 0.04045 {
        channel / 12.92
    } else {
        ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4)
    }
}

const _: () = {
    assert!(std::mem::size_of::<StarInstanceGpu>() == STAR_GPU_RECORD_BYTES);
    assert!(std::mem::align_of::<StarInstanceGpu>() == 16);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(StarInstanceGpu, direction_eqj) == 0);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(StarInstanceGpu, visual_magnitude) == 12);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(StarInstanceGpu, color_linear) == 16);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(StarInstanceGpu, catalog_star_id) == 28);
};

//! Camera-independent, bounded weather history for the whole visible planet.
use glam::DVec3;
use minimium_environment::weather::{TerrainSampler, WeatherModel};

pub const WIDTH: u32 = 65;
pub const HEIGHT: u32 = 33;
pub const LAYERS: u32 = 4;
pub const BYTES: u64 = WIDTH as u64 * HEIGHT as u64 * LAYERS as u64 * 8;

pub struct SurfaceAtlas {
    pub start_utc: f64,
    pub pixels: Vec<[half::f16; 4]>,
}

impl SurfaceAtlas {
    pub fn build<T: TerrainSampler>(
        model: &WeatherModel<T>,
        utc: f64,
        cancelled: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        let start_utc = (utc / 3600.0).floor() * 3600.0;
        let cells = (WIDTH * HEIGHT) as usize;
        let mut pixels = vec![[half::f16::ZERO; 4]; cells * LAYERS as usize];
        for hour in 0..2 {
            let time = start_utc + hour as f64 * 3600.0;
            for y in 0..HEIGHT {
                if cancelled() {
                    return None;
                }
                let latitude = (0.5 - f64::from(y) / f64::from(HEIGHT - 1)) * std::f64::consts::PI;
                for x in 0..WIDTH {
                    let index = (y * WIDTH + x) as usize;
                    // Reuse seam/pole samples exactly; no longitude-dependent polar cap.
                    if x > 0 && (x == WIDTH - 1 || y == 0 || y == HEIGHT - 1) {
                        for layer in 0..2 {
                            pixels[(hour * 2 + layer) * cells + index] =
                                pixels[(hour * 2 + layer) * cells + (y * WIDTH) as usize];
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    let longitude =
                        (f64::from(x) / f64::from(WIDTH - 1) - 0.5) * std::f64::consts::TAU;
                    let direction = direction(latitude, longitude);
                    let [cover, climate] = sample(model, direction, time);
                    pixels[hour * 2 * cells + index] = cover;
                    pixels[(hour * 2 + 1) * cells + index] = climate;
                }
            }
        }
        Some(Self { start_utc, pixels })
    }
}

pub(crate) fn direction(latitude: f64, longitude: f64) -> DVec3 {
    DVec3::new(
        latitude.cos() * longitude.cos(),
        latitude.sin(),
        latitude.cos() * longitude.sin(),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn sample<T: TerrainSampler>(
    model: &WeatherModel<T>,
    direction: DVec3,
    time: f64,
) -> [[half::f16; 4]; 2] {
    let state = model.surface_state(direction, time);
    [
        [
            state.cover.vegetation,
            state.cover.snow,
            state.cover.wetness,
            state.climate.moisture as f32,
        ],
        [
            state.climate.temperature_c as f32,
            state.climate_elevation_m as f32,
            0.0,
            0.0,
        ],
    ]
    .map(|v| v.map(half::f16::from_f32))
}

//! CPU grid published by a host worker and uploaded without history work in a frame.
use glam::DVec3;
use minimium_environment::weather::{TerrainSampler, WeatherModel};

pub const EDGE: u32 = 9;
pub const EXTENT: f64 = 0.01;

pub struct CoverGrid {
    pub start_utc: f64,
    pub region: [f32; 4],
    pub atlas: Option<std::sync::Arc<crate::surface_atlas::SurfaceAtlas>>,
    pub center: [f32; 4],
    pub east: [f32; 4],
    pub north: [f32; 4],
    pub pixels: Vec<[half::f16; 4]>,
    pub atmosphere_weather: [[f32; 4]; 2],
    pub fog_pixels: Vec<[half::f16; 4]>,
}

impl CoverGrid {
    pub fn build<T: TerrainSampler>(model: &WeatherModel<T>, observer: DVec3, utc: f64) -> Self {
        let center = (observer * 1000.0).round().normalize();
        let east = if center.y.abs() < 0.99 {
            DVec3::Y.cross(center).normalize()
        } else {
            DVec3::X.cross(center).normalize()
        };
        let north = center.cross(east);
        let start_utc = (utc / 3600.0).floor() * 3600.0;
        // Fixed angular lattice: overlapping windows evaluate identical sites.
        let step = EXTENT * 2.0 / f64::from(EDGE - 1);
        let latitude = observer.y.asin();
        let longitude = observer.z.atan2(observer.x);
        let start_lat = (latitude / step).floor() * step - EXTENT;
        let start_lon = (longitude / step).floor() * step - EXTENT;
        let cells = (EDGE * EDGE) as usize;
        let mut pixels = vec![[half::f16::ZERO; 4]; cells * 4];
        let mut atmosphere_weather = [[0.0; 4]; 2];
        let mut fog_pixels = Vec::with_capacity((EDGE * EDGE * 2) as usize);
        for hour in 0..2 {
            let time = start_utc + f64::from(hour) * 3600.0;
            for y in 0..EDGE {
                for x in 0..EDGE {
                    let u = (f64::from(x) / f64::from(EDGE - 1) * 2.0 - 1.0) * EXTENT;
                    let v = (f64::from(y) / f64::from(EDGE - 1) * 2.0 - 1.0) * EXTENT;
                    let direction = (center + east * u + north * v).normalize();
                    let sample = model.surface_cover(direction, time);
                    let conditions = model.sample(direction, time);
                    let moisture = conditions.humidity as f32;
                    let ground = model.atmospheric_ground_height_m(direction) as f32;
                    let humid = ((moisture - 0.65) / 0.3).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    let cool =
                        (1.0 - (conditions.temperature_c as f32 - 4.0) / 18.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    fog_pixels.push(
                        [
                            sample.wetness * humid * cool * 0.002,
                            100.0,
                            ground,
                            humid * 1e-5,
                        ]
                        .map(half::f16::from_f32),
                    );
                    if x == EDGE / 2 && y == EDGE / 2 {
                        atmosphere_weather[hour as usize] = [
                            moisture,
                            conditions.temperature_c as f32,
                            sample.wetness,
                            ground,
                        ];
                    }
                    let site = crate::surface_atlas::direction(
                        start_lat + f64::from(y) * step,
                        start_lon + f64::from(x) * step,
                    );
                    let [cover, climate] = crate::surface_atlas::sample(model, site, time);
                    let index = (y * EDGE + x) as usize;
                    pixels[hour as usize * 2 * cells + index] = cover;
                    pixels[(hour as usize * 2 + 1) * cells + index] = climate;
                }
            }
        }
        Self {
            start_utc,
            region: [
                start_lon as f32,
                start_lat as f32,
                step as f32,
                (EXTENT * 2.0) as f32,
            ],
            atlas: None,
            center: center.as_vec3().extend(EXTENT as f32).to_array(),
            east: east.as_vec3().extend(0.0).to_array(),
            north: north.as_vec3().extend(0.0).to_array(),
            pixels,
            atmosphere_weather,
            fog_pixels,
        }
    }
}

//! Window-independent acquisition and presentation of a WGPU surface frame.

/// One acquired surface image and its view, ready for command encoding.
pub struct SurfaceFrame {
    pub view: wgpu::TextureView,
    texture: wgpu::SurfaceTexture,
}

/// Outcome of attempting to acquire the next surface image.
pub enum SurfaceAcquire {
    Ready(SurfaceFrame),
    Skipped,
    Retry(wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture),
}

/// Acquires a surface image and handles the recoverable suboptimal state.
pub fn acquire(
    surface: &wgpu::Surface<'_>,
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    config: &wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
) -> SurfaceAcquire {
    let texture = match surface.get_current_texture() {
        wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture) => texture,
        wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => {
            surface.configure(device, config);
            texture
        }
        wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Timeout | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Occluded => {
            return SurfaceAcquire::Skipped;
        }
        error => return SurfaceAcquire::Retry(error),
    };
    let view = texture
        .texture
        .create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    SurfaceAcquire::Ready(SurfaceFrame { view, texture })
}

impl SurfaceFrame {
    /// Submits encoded commands and presents this surface image.
    pub fn submit(self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, encoder: wgpu::CommandEncoder) {
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));
        queue.present(self.texture);
    }
}

//! Texture lifetime/upload for static-coordinate weather grids; no climate rules.
use crate::{surface_atlas, surface_cover};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct TerrainCoverGpu {
    pub local: wgpu::Texture,
    pub global: wgpu::Texture,
    pub start_utc: Option<f64>,
    atlas: Option<Arc<surface_atlas::SurfaceAtlas>>,
}

impl TerrainCoverGpu {
    pub const BYTES: u64 =
        surface_cover::EDGE as u64 * surface_cover::EDGE as u64 * 32 + surface_atlas::BYTES;

    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let make = |label, width, height| {
            device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
                label: Some(label),
                size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                    width,
                    height,
                    depth_or_array_layers: 4,
                },
                mip_level_count: 1,
                sample_count: 1,
                dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
                format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
                usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
                view_formats: &[],
            })
        };
        Self {
            local: make(
                "local surface history",
                surface_cover::EDGE,
                surface_cover::EDGE,
            ),
            global: make(
                "planet surface history",
                surface_atlas::WIDTH,
                surface_atlas::HEIGHT,
            ),
            start_utc: None,
            atlas: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.start_utc = None;
        self.atlas = None;
    }

    pub fn upload(&mut self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, grid: &surface_cover::CoverGrid) -> bool {
        self.start_utc = Some(grid.start_utc);
        write(queue, &self.local, &grid.pixels);
        if let Some(atlas) = grid
            .atlas
            .as_ref()
            .filter(|a| a.start_utc == grid.start_utc)
        {
            if self
                .atlas
                .as_ref()
                .is_none_or(|old| !Arc::ptr_eq(old, atlas))
            {
                write(queue, &self.global, &atlas.pixels);
                self.atlas = Some(atlas.clone());
            }
            true
        } else {
            self.atlas = None;
            false
        }
    }
}

fn write(queue: &wgpu::Queue, texture: &wgpu::Texture, pixels: &[[half::f16; 4]]) {
    queue.write_texture(
        wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo {
            texture,
            mip_level: 0,
            origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
            aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
        },
        bytemuck::cast_slice(pixels),
        wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(texture.width() * 8),
            rows_per_image: Some(texture.height()),
        },
        texture.size(),
    );
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/terrain_edges.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="199" bytes="7506" original_lines="199" original_bytes="7506" minified="false" sha256="653ad1a6442ff4c76375424a439fe36b9251e62e1910ef13791d3a7bd05847f9">>>
//! Conform fine patch boundaries to their coarse neighbor, including cube seams.
//! Only presentation copies change; generator/collision geometry is immutable.
use crate::terrain_geometry::radial_curtain;
use minimium_procgen::{PlanetTerrain, SectorGeometry};
use minimium_world::world::{
    SectorKey, PLANET_DENSE_SECTORS_PER_FACE, PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE,
};
use std::{collections::HashMap, sync::Arc};

type Patch = (SectorKey, u8, Arc<SectorGeometry>);
type Line = (usize, [i32; 3]);
struct Entry {
    source: Arc<SectorGeometry>,
    steps: [i32; 4],
    ground: Arc<SectorGeometry>,
    ocean: Option<Arc<SectorGeometry>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Edge {
    line: Line,
    from: i32,
    to: i32,
    step: i32,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct EdgeConformance {
    entries: HashMap<(SectorKey, u8), Entry>,
}

impl EdgeConformance {
    pub fn ocean(&self, key: SectorKey, lod: u8) -> Option<&SectorGeometry> {
        self.entries.get(&(key, lod))?.ocean.as_deref()
    }

    pub fn prepare(&mut self, patches: Vec<Patch>, terrain: &PlanetTerrain) -> Vec<Patch> {
        let mut lines: HashMap<Line, Vec<Edge>> = HashMap::new();
        let edges: Vec<_> = patches
            .iter()
            .map(|(key, lod, _)| edges(*key, *lod))
            .collect();
        for edge in edges.iter().flatten().flatten() {
            lines.entry(edge.line).or_default().push(*edge);
        }
        let mut retained = HashMap::new();
        let result = patches
            .into_iter()
            .zip(edges)
            .map(|((key, lod, source), edges)| {
                let Some(edges) = edges else {
                    return (key, lod, source);
                };
                let steps = edges.map(|edge| {
                    lines[&edge.line]
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|other| other.from <= edge.from && other.to >= edge.to)
                        .map(|other| other.step)
                        .max()
                        .unwrap_or(edge.step)
                });
                let cached = self
                    .entries
                    .remove(&(key, lod))
                    .filter(|entry| Arc::ptr_eq(&entry.source, &source) && entry.steps == steps);
                let entry = cached.unwrap_or_else(|| Entry {
                    ground: Arc::new(conform(&source, edges, steps, terrain, false)),
                    ocean: terrain.is_earth().then(|| {
                        let sphere = crate::ocean_geometry::sphere_patch(&source, terrain);
                        Arc::new(conform(&sphere, edges, steps, terrain, true))
                    }),
                    source,
                    steps,
                });
                let ground = entry.ground.clone();
                retained.insert((key, lod), entry);
                (key, lod, ground)
            })
            .collect();
        self.entries = retained;
        result
    }
}

fn edges(key: SectorKey, lod: u8) -> Option<[Edge; 4]> {
    let SectorKey::Planet(key) = key else {
        return None;
    };
    if !(16..=30).contains(&lod) {
        return None;
    }
    let span = 1_i32 << (lod - 16);
    let scale = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
    let unit = 2 * scale / i32::from(PLANET_DENSE_SECTORS_PER_FACE);
    let (u, v) = key.coordinates();
    let u = -scale + i32::from(u) * unit;
    let v = -scale + i32::from(v) * unit;
    let width = span * unit;
    let point = |u, v| {
        key.face()
            .cube_sample(u, v)
            .expect("selected patch bounds")
            .coordinates()
    };
    let corners = [
        point(u, v),
        point(u + width, v),
        point(u + width, v + width),
        point(u, v + width),
    ];
    Some(std::array::from_fn(|i| {
        let a = corners[i];
        let b = corners[(i + 1) % 4];
        let axis = (0..3)
            .find(|&axis| a[axis] != b[axis])
            .expect("nonzero edge");
        let mut fixed = a;
        fixed[axis] = 0;
        Edge {
            line: (axis, fixed),
            from: a[axis].min(b[axis]),
            to: a[axis].max(b[axis]),
            step: width / minimium_procgen::PLANET_RENDER_BLOCK_SUBDIVISIONS as i32,
        }
    }))
}

fn conform(
    source: &SectorGeometry,
    edges: [Edge; 4],
    steps: [i32; 4],
    terrain: &PlanetTerrain,
    ocean: bool,
) -> SectorGeometry {
    let mut geometry = SectorGeometry {
        boxes: source.boxes.clone(),
        triangles: Vec::with_capacity(source.triangles.len()),
    };
    let tolerance = (PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE as f64 * 3.0 / terrain.radius_mm() as f64)
        .ceil()
        .max(1.0) as i32;
    let mut points = HashMap::new();
    let mut segments = HashMap::new();
    for triangle in &source.triangles {
        let Some(precise) = triangle.precise_vertices else {
            geometry.triangles.push(*triangle);
            continue;
        };
        if radial_curtain(precise.map(|p| p.map(|v| v as f64 / 1000.0))) {
            continue;
        }
        let mut next = *triangle;
        let precise = precise.map(|point| {
            *points.entry(point).or_insert_with(|| {
                let cube =
                    minimium_procgen::terrain_surface::key(point.map(|v| v as f64)).coordinates();
                for (edge, step) in edges.iter().zip(steps) {
                    let (axis, fixed) = edge.line;
                    if step <= edge.step
                        || (0..3).any(|a| a != axis && (cube[a] - fixed[a]).abs() > tolerance)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let scale = PLANET_SAMPLE_COORDINATE_SCALE;
                    // Both shells use the same canonical fraction. A projection
                    // of each displaced point would give ground and sea different
                    // fractions and could move their intersection at a LOD seam.
                    let value = (((cube[axis] + scale + edge.step / 2) / edge.step) * edge.step
                        - scale)
                        .clamp(edge.from, edge.to);
                    let cell = ((value + scale) / step * step - scale).min(scale - step);
                    let (a, b) = *segments.entry((edge.line, cell, step)).or_insert_with(|| {
                        let sample = |value| {
                            let mut c = fixed;
                            c[axis] = value;
                            let key = minimium_procgen::terrain_surface::key(c.map(f64::from));
                            let point = if ocean {
                                terrain.sea_position(key)
                            } else {
                                terrain.ground_sample(key).position_mm
                            };
                            glam::DVec3::from_array(point.coordinates().map(|v| v as f64))
                        };
                        (sample(cell), sample(cell + step))
                    });
                    // Every resulting point lies on the exact coarse triangle edge.
                    let d = b - a;
                    let t = f64::from(value - cell) / f64::from(step);
                    return (a + d * t).to_array().map(|v| v.round() as i64);
                }
                point
            })
        });
        next.precise_vertices = Some(precise);
        next.vertices = precise.map(|p| p.map(|v| v as f32 / 1000.0));
        geometry.triangles.push(next);
    }
    geometry
}

//! Typed surface presentation data, separate from authored objects and collision.
use minimium_procgen::{PlanetTerrain, SectorGeometry};

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct TerrainVertex {
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub normal: [f32; 3],
    pub planet_high: [f32; 3],
    pub planet_low: [f32; 3],
    pub coverage_a: [f32; 4],
    pub coverage_b: [f32; 2],
    /// Source height, slope, ocean presence, exaggerated height in source metres.
    pub surface: [f32; 4],
    pub geometric_normal: [f32; 3],
    pub habitat: [f32; 3],
}

impl TerrainVertex {
    const ATTRIBUTES: [wgpu::VertexAttribute; 9] = wgpu::vertex_attr_array![
        0 => Float32x3, 1 => Float32x3, 2 => Float32x3, 3 => Float32x3,
        4 => Float32x4, 5 => Float32x2, 6 => Float32x4, 7 => Float32x3, 8 => Float32x3
    ];
    pub fn layout() -> wgpu::VertexBufferLayout<'static> {
        wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
            array_stride: std::mem::size_of::<Self>() as u64,
            step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex,
            attributes: &Self::ATTRIBUTES,
        }
    }
}

const _: () = {
    assert!(std::mem::size_of::<TerrainVertex>() == 112);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(TerrainVertex, geometric_normal) == 88);
};

pub fn vertices(
    geometry: &SectorGeometry,
    terrain: &PlanetTerrain,
    origin: [f32; 3],
) -> Vec<TerrainVertex> {
    let mut samples = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(geometry.triangles.len() * 3);
    for triangle in &geometry.triangles {
        let points = triangle
            .precise_vertices
            .map(|points| points.map(|p| p.map(|v| v as f64 / 1000.0)))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| triangle.vertices.map(|p| p.map(f64::from)));
        // One anchor per primitive keeps the large component constant during interpolation.
        let high = points[0].map(|v| (v / 1024.0).floor() * 1024.0);
        // Match the actual f32 positions used in both raster passes, including
        // their origin-relative rounding; the sampled smooth normal is separate.
        let rendered = points.map(|p| {
            glam::DVec3::from_array(std::array::from_fn(|i| {
                f64::from((p[i] - f64::from(origin[i])) as f32)
            }))
        });
        let face_normal = (rendered[1] - rendered[0])
            .cross(rendered[2] - rendered[0])
            .normalize_or_zero()
            .as_vec3()
            .to_array();
        for point in points {
            let key = point.map(f64::to_bits);
            let sample = *samples
                .entry(key)
                .or_insert_with(|| terrain.surface_sample(point));
            out.push(TerrainVertex {
                position: std::array::from_fn(|i| (point[i] - f64::from(origin[i])) as f32),
                // Curtains conceal cracks; lighting them as vertical cliffs
                // exposes a dark grid over otherwise flat water/snow.
                normal: sample.normal,
                planet_high: high.map(|v| v as f32),
                planet_low: std::array::from_fn(|i| (point[i] - high[i]) as f32),
                coverage_a: sample.coverage[..4].try_into().unwrap(),
                coverage_b: sample.coverage[4..].try_into().unwrap(),
                surface: [
                    sample.source_elevation_m,
                    sample.slope,
                    f32::from(terrain.is_earth()),
                    sample.elevation_m / terrain.presentation_height_scale(),
                ],
                geometric_normal: face_normal,
                habitat: [
                    sample.landform.retention,
                    sample.landform.exposure,
                    f32::from(sample.mapped_coverage),
                ],
            });
        }
    }
    out
}

/// LOD curtains have a radial edge: two positions on the same planet ray.
/// Detect positions, never RGB or `solid` (render surfaces are also non-solid).
pub(crate) fn radial_curtain(points: [[f64; 3]; 3]) -> bool {
    (0..3).any(|i| {
        let a = glam::DVec3::from_array(points[i]);
        let b = glam::DVec3::from_array(points[(i + 1) % 3]);
        let shortest = a.length().min(b.length());
        shortest > 0.0
            && (a.length() - b.length()).abs() > 0.01
            && a.normalize().cross(b.normalize()).length() * shortest < 0.003
    })
}

/// Retain visible crack concealment, but do not cast artificial skirt shadows.
pub fn shadow_vertices(
    geometry: &SectorGeometry,
    vertices: Vec<crate::geometry::Vertex>,
) -> Vec<crate::geometry::Vertex> {
    let objects = geometry.boxes.len() * 36;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(vertices.len());
    out.extend_from_slice(&vertices[..objects]);
    for (triangle, rendered) in geometry
        .triangles
        .iter()
        .zip(vertices[objects..].chunks_exact(3))
    {
        let points = triangle
            .precise_vertices
            .map(|p| p.map(|v| v.map(|c| c as f64 / 1000.0)))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| triangle.vertices.map(|p| p.map(f64::from)));
        if !radial_curtain(points) {
            out.extend_from_slice(rendered);
        }
    }
    out
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/terrain_gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="370" bytes="14677" original_lines="370" original_bytes="14677" minified="false" sha256="0a5872aea2374a6bdd02097d101dfaa7d7a70b6e10cba676434be6e4f6916c70">>>
//! Validated material texture arrays and terrain pipeline.
use crate::terrain_geometry::TerrainVertex;
use minimium_assets::{
    ktx2::Texture,
    terrain_material::{MaterialManifest, MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES},
};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct TerrainUniform {
    pub scales_a: [f32; 4],
    pub scales_b_blend: [f32; 4],
    /// Hour interpolation, history validity, planet atlas validity, reserved.
    pub cover: [f32; 4],
    /// Debug mode, two folded words covering all 128 seed bits, reserved.
    pub debug: [u32; 4],
    pub cover_center: [f32; 4],
    pub cover_east: [f32; 4],
    pub cover_north: [f32; 4],
    pub eye_relative: [f32; 4],
    /// Seasonal phase, scenario temperature/moisture, relief influence on climate.
    pub climate: [f32; 4],
    pub mean_albedo: [[f32; 4]; 6],
}

pub use crate::terrain_debug::TerrainDebug;

pub struct TerrainGpu {
    pub valid: bool,
    textures: Vec<wgpu::Texture>,
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub ocean_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub uniform: TerrainUniform,
    pub bytes: u64,
    history: crate::terrain_cover_gpu::TerrainCoverGpu,
}

impl TerrainGpu {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        frame: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        shadow: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        color: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        manifest: &MaterialManifest,
        variant: usize,
        maps: &[Vec<u8>; 3],
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        manifest.validate()?;
        let selected = manifest
            .variants
            .get(variant)
            .ok_or("invalid material variant")?;
        let formats = if selected.compressed {
            [132, 141, 137]
        } else {
            [43, 37, 37]
        };
        // Complete validation precedes every allocation.
        let mut parsed = Vec::new();
        let mut bytes = 0;
        for (index, data) in maps.iter().enumerate() {
            let file = &selected.maps[index];
            if data.len() as u64 != file.bytes
                || minimium_assets::terrain_material::digest(data) != file.sha256
            {
                return Err("material file hash mismatch".into());
            }
            let texture = Texture::parse(data, selected.edge, formats[index])?;
            bytes += texture
                .levels
                .iter()
                .skip(base_mip(&texture))
                .map(|range| range.len() as u64)
                .sum::<u64>();
            parsed.push(texture);
        }
        if bytes > MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES
            || selected.edge > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
            || device.limits().max_texture_array_layers < 6
            || (selected.compressed
                && !device
                    .features()
                    .contains(wgpu::Features::TEXTURE_COMPRESSION_BC))
        {
            return Err("terrain materials exceed GPU capabilities or budget".into());
        }
        let textures: Vec<_> = parsed
            .iter()
            .map(|texture| upload(device, queue, texture))
            .collect();
        let views: Vec<_> = textures
            .iter()
            .map(|texture| {
                texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
                    dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array),
                    ..Default::default()
                })
            })
            .collect();
        let mut entries: Vec<_> = (0..3)
            .map(|binding| wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                    sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                    view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array,
                    multisampled: false,
                },
                count: None,
            })
            .collect();
        entries.push(wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
            binding: 3,
            visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
            ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
            count: None,
        });
        entries.push(wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
            binding: 4,
            visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
            ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                has_dynamic_offset: false,
                min_binding_size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(
                    std::mem::size_of::<TerrainUniform>() as u64
                ),
            },
            count: None,
        });
        for binding in [5, 6] {
            entries.push(wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                    sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                    view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array,
                    multisampled: false,
                },
                count: None,
            });
        }
        let history = crate::terrain_cover_gpu::TerrainCoverGpu::new(device);
        let cover_view = history.local.create_view(&Default::default());
        let atlas_view = history.global.create_view(&Default::default());
        let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain-materials"),
            entries: &entries,
        });
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain-repeat"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::MipmapFilterMode::Linear,
            anisotropy_clamp: 4,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let uniform = TerrainUniform {
            scales_a: manifest.meters_per_tile[..4].try_into().unwrap(),
            scales_b_blend: [
                manifest.meters_per_tile[4],
                manifest.meters_per_tile[5],
                manifest.height_blend,
                0.0,
            ],
            cover: [0.0; 4],
            debug: [0; 4],
            cover_center: [0.0; 4],
            cover_east: [0.0; 4],
            cover_north: [0.0; 4],
            eye_relative: [0.0; 4],
            climate: [0.0; 4],
            mean_albedo: crate::terrain_palette::colors(&parsed[0]),
        };
        let uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain-settings"),
            contents: bytemuck::bytes_of(&uniform),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        });
        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain-materials"),
            layout: &layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&views[0]),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&views[1]),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&views[2]),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 5,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&cover_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 6,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&atlas_view),
                },
            ],
        });
        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain-pipeline"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(frame), Some(&layout), Some(shadow)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::shader_source::terrain().into()),
        });
        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("terrain"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("vs_terrain"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                buffers: &[Some(TerrainVertex::layout())],
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("fs_terrain"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: color,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                cull_mode: None,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
                depth_write_enabled: Some(true),
                depth_compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::Less),
                stencil: Default::default(),
                bias: Default::default(),
            }),
            multisample: Default::default(),
            multiview_mask: None,
            cache: None,
        });
        bytes += crate::terrain_cover_gpu::TerrainCoverGpu::BYTES;
        let ocean_pipeline = crate::ocean_pipeline::create(device, &pipeline_layout, color);
        Ok(Self {
            valid: true,
            textures,
            pipeline,
            ocean_pipeline,
            bind_group,
            uniform_buffer,
            uniform,
            bytes,
            history,
        })
    }

    pub fn update(&self, queue: &wgpu::Queue) {
        queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&self.uniform));
    }

    /// Release the previous package before allocating a replacement under the GPU budget.
    pub fn release_materials(&mut self) {
        self.valid = false;
        for texture in &self.textures {
            texture.destroy();
        }
    }

    pub fn upload_cover(&mut self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, grid: &crate::surface_cover::CoverGrid) {
        self.uniform.cover[2] = f32::from(self.history.upload(queue, grid));
        self.uniform.cover_center = grid.region;
        self.update(queue);
    }

    pub fn clear_cover(&mut self) {
        self.history.clear();
        self.uniform.cover = [0.0; 4];
        self.uniform.cover_center = [0.0; 4];
    }

    pub fn set_cover_time(&mut self, utc: f64) {
        let hours = self.history.start_utc.map(|start| (utc - start) / 3600.0);
        self.uniform.cover[0] = hours.unwrap_or(0.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
        // Keep the shared endpoint while the next worker result is in flight.
        // Stale data fades over a world hour, rather than flashing to fallback.
        self.uniform.cover[1] = hours.filter(|h| *h >= 0.0).map_or(0.0, |h| {
            let t = (h - 1.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
            1.0 - t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
        });
    }
}

const _: () = {
    assert!(std::mem::size_of::<TerrainUniform>() == 240);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(TerrainUniform, mean_albedo) == 144);
};

fn upload(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue, source: &Texture<'_>) -> wgpu::Texture {
    let first_mip = base_mip(source);
    let resident_edge = source.edge >> first_mip;
    let (format, block, block_bytes) = match source.vk_format {
        132 => (wgpu::TextureFormat::Bc1RgbaUnormSrgb, 4, 8),
        137 => (wgpu::TextureFormat::Bc3RgbaUnorm, 4, 16),
        141 => (wgpu::TextureFormat::Bc5RgUnorm, 4, 16),
        43 => (wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb, 1, 4),
        _ => (wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm, 1, 4),
    };
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("terrain-array"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: resident_edge,
            height: resident_edge,
            depth_or_array_layers: 6,
        },
        mip_level_count: (source.levels.len() - first_mip) as u32,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    for (mip, range) in source.levels.iter().enumerate().skip(first_mip) {
        let edge = (source.edge >> mip).max(1);
        queue.write_texture(
            wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo {
                texture: &texture,
                mip_level: (mip - first_mip) as u32,
                origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
                aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
            },
            &source.bytes[range.clone()],
            wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
                offset: 0,
                bytes_per_row: Some(edge.div_ceil(block) * block_bytes),
                rows_per_image: Some(edge.div_ceil(block)),
            },
            wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: edge.max(block),
                height: edge.max(block),
                depth_or_array_layers: 6,
            },
        );
    }
    texture
}

fn base_mip(source: &Texture<'_>) -> usize {
    // Existing packages retain their full source detail; default residency is 2K.
    usize::from(source.edge > 2048)
}
