<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/terrain_palette.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="47" bytes="1512" original_lines="47" original_bytes="1512" minified="false" sha256="3a5c5e41133fc6a8d5167739695f140b2f50fef009941e8a8d936b52ca475247">>>
//! Decode the validated 1x1 albedo mip once, avoiding per-fragment mean reads.
use minimium_assets::ktx2::Texture;

pub fn colors(texture: &Texture<'_>) -> [[f32; 4]; 6] {
    let mip = &texture.bytes[texture.levels.last().expect("validated mip chain").clone()];
    std::array::from_fn(|layer| {
        let rgb = if texture.vk_format == 132 {
            bc1(&mip[layer * 8..layer * 8 + 8])
        } else {
            std::array::from_fn(|i| f32::from(mip[layer * 4 + i]) / 255.0)
        };
        let linear = rgb.map(|v| {
            if v <= 0.04045 {
                v / 12.92
            } else {
                ((v + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4)
            }
        });
        [linear[0], linear[1], linear[2], 1.0]
    })
}

fn bc1(block: &[u8]) -> [f32; 3] {
    let c0 = u16::from_le_bytes([block[0], block[1]]);
    let c1 = u16::from_le_bytes([block[2], block[3]]);
    let unpack = |c: u16| {
        let r = (c >> 11) & 31;
        let g = (c >> 5) & 63;
        let b = c & 31;
        [
            (r << 3) | (r >> 2),
            (g << 2) | (g >> 4),
            (b << 3) | (b >> 2),
        ]
        .map(|v| f32::from(v) / 255.0)
    };
    let a = unpack(c0);
    let b = unpack(c1);
    match block[4] & 3 {
        0 => a,
        1 => b,
        2 if c0 > c1 => std::array::from_fn(|i| (2.0 * a[i] + b[i]) / 3.0),
        3 if c0 > c1 => std::array::from_fn(|i| (a[i] + 2.0 * b[i]) / 3.0),
        2 => std::array::from_fn(|i| (a[i] + b[i]) / 2.0),
        _ => [0.0; 3],
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/terrain_view.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="80" bytes="2960" original_lines="80" original_bytes="2960" minified="false" sha256="f979836f11c7050f086c91225543a565745dff20a497c529b1d8c08bae890a9a">>>
//! Presentation interest is independent of the player's collision neighborhood.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct TerrainView {
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub projected_scale: f32,
    overview_planes: Option<[[f32; 3]; 4]>,
}

impl TerrainView {
    pub fn new(position: [f32; 3], vertical_fov: f32, height: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            // Stable requests avoid rebuilding selections for sub-cell motion.
            position: position.map(|v| (v / 20.0).round() * 20.0),
            projected_scale: height.max(1) as f32
                / (2.0 * (vertical_fov.clamp(0.2, 2.8) * 0.5).tan()),
            overview_planes: None,
        }
    }

    /// Planet-centred overview, including a guard band for asynchronous refreshes.
    /// The mirrored Earth projection has the same symmetric side planes.
    pub fn overview(position: [f32; 3], vertical_fov: f32, size: [u32; 2]) -> Self {
        let mut view = Self::new(position, vertical_fov, size[1]);
        let forward = -glam::Vec3::from_array(view.position).normalize_or_zero();
        let mut right = forward.cross(glam::Vec3::Y).normalize_or_zero();
        if right.length_squared() < 0.5 {
            right = glam::Vec3::X;
        }
        let up = right.cross(forward).normalize_or_zero();
        let vertical = (vertical_fov.clamp(0.2, 2.8) * 0.5).tan() * 1.2;
        let horizontal = vertical * size[0].max(1) as f32 / size[1].max(1) as f32;
        view.overview_planes = Some([
            (forward * horizontal + right).normalize().to_array(),
            (forward * horizontal - right).normalize().to_array(),
            (forward * vertical + up).normalize().to_array(),
            (forward * vertical - up).normalize().to_array(),
        ]);
        view
    }

    pub fn legacy(position: [f32; 3]) -> Self {
        Self {
            position,
            projected_scale: 8.0 / 0.012,
            overview_planes: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn cell_error_limit(self) -> f64 {
        8.0 / f64::from(self.projected_scale.max(1.0))
    }

    pub fn patch_budget(self) -> usize {
        if self.overview_planes.is_some() {
            512
        } else {
            256
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn intersects(self, center: [f64; 3], radius: f64) -> bool {
        self.overview_planes.is_none_or(|planes| {
            planes.iter().all(|normal| {
                (0..3)
                    .map(|i| (center[i] - f64::from(self.position[i])) * f64::from(normal[i]))
                    .sum::<f64>()
                    >= -radius
            })
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn surface_priority(self, surface: super::coast_probe::SurfaceClass) -> f64 {
        use super::coast_probe::SurfaceClass;
        match (self.overview_planes.is_some(), surface) {
            (true, SurfaceClass::Coast) => 8.0,
            (true, SurfaceClass::Land) | (false, SurfaceClass::Coast) => 2.0,
            _ => 1.0,
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/ui_pipeline.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="269" bytes="9766" original_lines="269" original_bytes="9766" minified="false" sha256="5a6d11bda874ff4aaa7b9e535c7955f0bd1921f9fdaca830d2e3a213ca5cf6e1">>>
use crate::UiVertex;
use std::borrow::Cow;

/// Font atlas, overlay pipeline and reusable UI vertex buffer.
pub struct UiGpuResources {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub output_pipeline: Option<wgpu::RenderPipeline>,
    pub bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub vertex_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    vertex_count: u32,
}

impl UiGpuResources {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        surface_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        surface_is_srgb: bool,
        hdr_enabled: bool,
        font: &[u8],
        atlas_size: [u32; 2],
        vertex_capacity: usize,
    ) -> Self {
        let (pipeline, bind_group, vertex_buffer, layout) =
            create_ui_resources(device, queue, format, font, atlas_size, vertex_capacity);
        let output_pipeline = hdr_enabled
            .then(|| create_ui_output_pipeline(device, &layout, surface_format, surface_is_srgb));
        Self {
            pipeline,
            output_pipeline,
            bind_group,
            vertex_buffer,
            vertex_count: 0,
        }
    }

    pub fn set_vertex_count(&mut self, vertex_count: u32) {
        self.vertex_count = vertex_count;
    }

    pub fn vertex_count(&self) -> u32 {
        self.vertex_count
    }
}

pub fn create_depth_view(device: &wgpu::Device, size: [u32; 2]) -> wgpu::TextureView {
    device
        .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("depth-buffer"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: size[0].max(1),
                height: size[1].max(1),
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        })
        .create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default())
}

pub fn is_srgb(format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> bool {
    matches!(
        format,
        wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb | wgpu::TextureFormat::Bgra8UnormSrgb
    )
}

pub fn create_ui_resources(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    queue: &wgpu::Queue,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    font: &[u8],
    atlas_size: [u32; 2],
    vertex_capacity: usize,
) -> (
    wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    wgpu::BindGroup,
    wgpu::Buffer,
    wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
) {
    let atlas_width = atlas_size[0] as usize;
    let atlas_height = atlas_size[1] as usize;
    let atlas = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-font-atlas"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: atlas_width as u32,
            height: atlas_height as u32,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let bytes_per_row = atlas_width.div_ceil(256) * 256;
    let mut upload = vec![0; bytes_per_row * atlas_height];
    for row in 0..atlas_height {
        let row_start = row * bytes_per_row;
        let font_start = row * atlas_width;
        upload[row_start..row_start + atlas_width]
            .copy_from_slice(&font[font_start..font_start + atlas_width]);
    }
    queue.write_texture(
        wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo {
            texture: &atlas,
            mip_level: 0,
            origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
            aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
        },
        &upload,
        wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(bytes_per_row as u32),
            rows_per_image: Some(atlas_height as u32),
        },
        wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: atlas_width as u32,
            height: atlas_height as u32,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
    );
    let atlas_view = atlas.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-font-sampler"),
        address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
        min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
        mipmap_filter: wgpu::MipmapFilterMode::Nearest,
        ..Default::default()
    });
    let bind_group_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-bind-layout"),
        entries: &[
            wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                    sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                    view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                    multisampled: false,
                },
                count: None,
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 1,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                count: None,
            },
        ],
    });
    let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-bind-group"),
        layout: &bind_group_layout,
        entries: &[
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&atlas_view),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 1,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&sampler),
            },
        ],
    });
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-shader"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(Cow::Owned(crate::shader_source::ui())),
    });
    let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-pipeline-layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&bind_group_layout)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-pipeline"),
        layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            buffers: &[Some(UiVertex::layout())],
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
            cull_mode: None,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview_mask: None,
        cache: None,
    });
    let vertex_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-vertices"),
        size: (vertex_capacity * std::mem::size_of::<UiVertex>()) as u64,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        mapped_at_creation: false,
    });
    (pipeline, bind_group, vertex_buffer, bind_group_layout)
}

pub fn create_ui_output_pipeline(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    bind_group_layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    surface_is_srgb: bool,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-output-shader"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(Cow::Owned(crate::shader_source::ui_output(
            surface_is_srgb,
        ))),
    });
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-output-layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(bind_group_layout)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("minimium-console-ui-output-pipeline"),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            buffers: &[Some(UiVertex::layout())],
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
            cull_mode: None,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: Default::default(),
        multiview_mask: None,
        cache: None,
    })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/world_geometry_gpu.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="316" bytes="11495" original_lines="316" original_bytes="11495" minified="false" sha256="83a09c83224472898c2d3c6d14307e036234d002ed53318244063b88e7f2373f">>>
//! GPU sector-geometry buffers and their shadow bounds cache.
use crate::{geometry, shadow_geometry::ShadowBounds};
use minimium_procgen::SectorGeometry;
use minimium_world::world::{GenerationRevision, SectorKey, WorldContentRevision, WorldInstanceId};
use std::{
    collections::{HashMap, HashSet},
    sync::Arc,
};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

mod prepared_upload;

type CatalogKey = (WorldInstanceId, SectorKey, u8);

/// Owns per-world sector vertex buffers and geometry bounds used by shadow selection.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct WorldGeometryGpu {
    rebase: Option<crate::geometry_rebase::GeometryRebase>,
    budget: UploadBudget,
    terrain: HashMap<CatalogKey, TerrainBuffers>,
    catalog: HashMap<CatalogKey, (wgpu::Buffer, u32)>,
    versions: HashMap<WorldInstanceId, (GenerationRevision, WorldContentRevision)>,
    bounds: HashMap<CatalogKey, ShadowBounds>,
    sources: HashMap<CatalogKey, Arc<SectorGeometry>>,
    pending: HashMap<CatalogKey, prepared_upload::PendingGeometry>,
}

struct UploadBudget {
    patches: u32,
    bytes: u64,
}
impl Default for UploadBudget {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            patches: 8,
            bytes: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
        }
    }
}
pub struct TerrainBuffers {
    pub surface: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub surface_count: u32,
    pub ocean: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub ocean_count: u32,
    pub objects: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub object_count: u32,
}

impl TerrainBuffers {
    fn bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.surface.size() + self.ocean.size() + self.objects.size()
    }
}

/// Result of reconciling visible geometry against the current GPU cache.
pub struct GeometryCacheResult {
    pub ready: bool,
    pub allocated_bytes: u64,
    pub released_bytes: u64,
}

impl WorldGeometryGpu {
    pub fn begin_frame(&mut self) {
        self.budget = UploadBudget::default();
    }
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, compute: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            rebase: compute.then(|| crate::geometry_rebase::GeometryRebase::new(device)),
            ..Self::default()
        }
    }
    pub fn rebase(&self, device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue, delta: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
        let Some(rebase) = &self.rebase else {
            return false;
        };
        let flat = self.catalog.values().map(|(b, _)| (b, 9));
        let terrain = self
            .terrain
            .values()
            .flat_map(|t| [(&t.surface, 28), (&t.ocean, 6), (&t.objects, 9)]);
        let pending_flat = self.pending.values().map(|p| (&p.shadow, 9));
        let pending_terrain = self
            .pending
            .values()
            .filter_map(|p| p.terrain.as_ref())
            .flat_map(|t| [(&t.surface, 28), (&t.ocean, 6), (&t.objects, 9)]);
        rebase.apply(
            device,
            queue,
            delta,
            flat.chain(terrain)
                .chain(pending_flat)
                .chain(pending_terrain),
        );
        true
    }
    fn usage(&self) -> wgpu::BufferUsages {
        wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX
            | if self.rebase.is_some() {
                wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE
            } else {
                wgpu::BufferUsages::empty()
            }
    }

    /// Conservative distance to resident terrain bounds, used only to improve
    /// depth precision when flying well clear of all visible geometry.
    pub fn surface_near(
        &self,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        active: &[(SectorKey, u8)],
        eye: [f64; 3],
    ) -> f32 {
        let distance = active
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(k, l)| self.bounds.get(&(instance, *k, *l)))
            .map(|b| {
                (0..3)
                    .map(|a| {
                        (b.minimum[a] - eye[a])
                            .max(eye[a] - b.maximum[a])
                            .max(0.0)
                            .powi(2)
                    })
                    .sum::<f64>()
                    .sqrt()
            })
            .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
        if distance.is_finite() {
            (distance * 0.01).clamp(0.05, 10.0) as f32
        } else {
            0.05
        }
    }
    pub fn terrain(&self) -> &HashMap<CatalogKey, TerrainBuffers> {
        &self.terrain
    }
    pub fn catalog(&self) -> &HashMap<CatalogKey, (wgpu::Buffer, u32)> {
        &self.catalog
    }

    pub fn versions(
        &self,
    ) -> &HashMap<WorldInstanceId, (GenerationRevision, WorldContentRevision)> {
        &self.versions
    }

    pub fn bounds(&self) -> &HashMap<CatalogKey, ShadowBounds> {
        &self.bounds
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, instance: WorldInstanceId, key: SectorKey, lod: u8) -> bool {
        self.catalog.contains_key(&(instance, key, lod))
    }

    pub fn cache_scene(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        generation: GenerationRevision,
        content_revision: WorldContentRevision,
        sectors: &[(SectorKey, u8, Arc<SectorGeometry>)],
        render_origin: [f32; 3],
        terrain: Option<&minimium_procgen::PlanetTerrain>,
    ) -> GeometryCacheResult {
        let mut edges = crate::terrain_edges::EdgeConformance::default();
        let conformed = terrain.map(|t| edges.prepare(sectors.to_vec(), t));
        let sectors = conformed.as_deref().unwrap_or(sectors);
        let mut released_bytes = 0_u64;
        let version = (generation, content_revision);
        if self
            .versions
            .get(&instance)
            .is_some_and(|cached| *cached != version)
        {
            released_bytes += self.release_world(instance);
        }
        self.versions.insert(instance, version);
        let required: HashSet<_> = sectors.iter().map(|(key, lod, _)| (*key, *lod)).collect();
        let mut allocated_bytes = 0_u64;
        for (key, lod, geometry) in sectors {
            let catalog_key = (instance, *key, *lod);
            if self.catalog.contains_key(&catalog_key) {
                continue;
            }
            let vertices = geometry::sector_geometry_relative(geometry, render_origin);
            if let Some(terrain) = terrain {
                let surface = crate::terrain_geometry::vertices(geometry, terrain, render_origin);
                let ocean = edges.ocean(*key, *lod).map_or_else(Vec::new, |g| {
                    crate::ocean_geometry::vertices(g, render_origin)
                });
                let object_count = geometry.boxes.len() * 36;
                let make_buffer = |label, bytes: &[u8]| {
                    device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                        label: Some(label),
                        contents: if bytes.is_empty() { &[0; 4] } else { bytes },
                        usage: self.usage(),
                    })
                };
                let buffers = TerrainBuffers {
                    surface: make_buffer("terrain-vertices", bytemuck::cast_slice(&surface)),
                    surface_count: surface.len() as u32,
                    ocean: make_buffer("ocean-vertices", bytemuck::cast_slice(&ocean)),
                    ocean_count: ocean.len() as u32,
                    objects: make_buffer(
                        "terrain-objects",
                        bytemuck::cast_slice(&vertices[..object_count]),
                    ),
                    object_count: object_count as u32,
                };
                allocated_bytes += buffers.bytes();
                self.terrain.insert(catalog_key, buffers);
            }
            let vertices = if terrain.is_some() {
                crate::terrain_geometry::shadow_vertices(geometry, vertices)
            } else {
                vertices
            };
            let empty_vertices = [0.0_f32; 9];
            let contents = if vertices.is_empty() {
                bytemuck::cast_slice(&empty_vertices)
            } else {
                bytemuck::cast_slice(&vertices)
            };
            let buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                label: Some("world-sector-geometry"),
                contents,
                usage: self.usage(),
            });
            allocated_bytes = allocated_bytes.saturating_add(buffer.size());
            self.catalog
                .insert(catalog_key, (buffer, vertices.len() as u32));
            if let Some(bounds) = crate::shadow_geometry::geometry_bounds(geometry) {
                self.bounds.insert(catalog_key, bounds);
            }
        }
        self.catalog.retain(|(owner, key, lod), (buffer, _)| {
            if *owner != instance || required.contains(&(*key, *lod)) {
                true
            } else {
                released_bytes = released_bytes.saturating_add(buffer.size());
                false
            }
        });
        self.bounds
            .retain(|(owner, key, lod), _| *owner != instance || required.contains(&(*key, *lod)));
        self.terrain.retain(|(owner, key, lod), buffers| {
            let retain = *owner != instance || required.contains(&(*key, *lod));
            if !retain {
                released_bytes += buffers.bytes();
            }
            retain
        });
        let ready = sectors
            .iter()
            .all(|(key, lod, _)| self.catalog.contains_key(&(instance, *key, *lod)));
        GeometryCacheResult {
            ready,
            allocated_bytes,
            released_bytes,
        }
    }

    pub fn release_world(&mut self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> u64 {
        let mut released_bytes = 0_u64;
        self.catalog.retain(|(owner, _, _), (buffer, _)| {
            if *owner != instance {
                true
            } else {
                released_bytes = released_bytes.saturating_add(buffer.size());
                false
            }
        });
        self.pending.retain(|(owner, _, _), pending| {
            if *owner == instance {
                released_bytes += pending.bytes();
                false
            } else {
                true
            }
        });
        self.versions.remove(&instance);
        self.sources.retain(|(owner, _, _), _| *owner != instance);
        self.bounds.retain(|(owner, _, _), _| *owner != instance);
        self.terrain.retain(|(owner, _, _), buffers| {
            if *owner != instance {
                true
            } else {
                released_bytes += buffers.bytes();
                false
            }
        });
        released_bytes
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let released_bytes = self
            .catalog
            .values()
            .map(|(buffer, _)| buffer.size())
            .sum::<u64>()
            + self
                .terrain
                .values()
                .map(TerrainBuffers::bytes)
                .sum::<u64>();
        let released_bytes = released_bytes + self.pending.values().map(|p| p.bytes()).sum::<u64>();
        self.pending.clear();
        self.sources.clear();
        self.terrain.clear();
        self.catalog.clear();
        self.versions.clear();
        self.bounds.clear();
        released_bytes
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/renderer/src/world_geometry_gpu/prepared_upload.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="169" bytes="6410" original_lines="169" original_bytes="6410" minified="false" sha256="4630674e3d5235dec8d7a457829b4cfb8d1f5d893e881ce6b71ee738609f586e">>>
//! Budgeted staging and atomic publication of a complete presentation selection.
use super::*;
use crate::prepared_sector::PreparedSector;

pub(super) struct PendingGeometry {
    pub shadow: wgpu::Buffer,
    count: u32,
    pub terrain: Option<TerrainBuffers>,
    bounds: Option<ShadowBounds>,
    source: Arc<SectorGeometry>,
}

impl PendingGeometry {
    pub fn bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.shadow.size() + self.terrain.as_ref().map_or(0, TerrainBuffers::bytes)
    }
}

impl WorldGeometryGpu {
    pub fn cache_prepared(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        generation: GenerationRevision,
        content_revision: WorldContentRevision,
        patches: &[Arc<PreparedSector>],
        active: &[(SectorKey, u8)],
    ) -> GeometryCacheResult {
        let version = (generation, content_revision);
        let mut released = if self.versions.get(&instance).is_some_and(|v| *v != version) {
            self.release_world(instance)
        } else {
            0
        };
        self.versions.insert(instance, version);
        let required: HashMap<_, _> = patches.iter().map(|p| ((p.key, p.lod), p)).collect();
        let protected: HashSet<_> = active.iter().copied().collect();
        self.pending.retain(|(owner, key, lod), p| {
            let keep = *owner != instance
                || required
                    .get(&(*key, *lod))
                    .is_some_and(|next| Arc::ptr_eq(&next.geometry, &p.source));
            if !keep {
                released += p.bytes();
            }
            keep
        });
        self.catalog.retain(|(owner, key, lod), (b, _)| {
            let keep = *owner != instance
                || required.contains_key(&(*key, *lod))
                || protected.contains(&(*key, *lod));
            if !keep {
                released += b.size();
            }
            keep
        });
        self.terrain.retain(|k, b| {
            let keep = self.catalog.contains_key(k);
            if !keep {
                released += b.bytes();
            }
            keep
        });
        self.sources.retain(|k, _| self.catalog.contains_key(k));
        self.bounds.retain(|k, _| self.catalog.contains_key(k));
        let mut allocated = 0;
        for patch in patches {
            let key = (instance, patch.key, patch.lod);
            let current = self
                .sources
                .get(&key)
                .is_some_and(|s| Arc::ptr_eq(s, &patch.geometry));
            let staged = self
                .pending
                .get(&key)
                .is_some_and(|s| Arc::ptr_eq(&s.source, &patch.geometry));
            if current || staged {
                continue;
            }
            if self.budget.patches == 0 || self.budget.bytes == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let make = |label, bytes: &[u8]| {
                device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                    label: Some(label),
                    contents: if bytes.is_empty() { &[0; 4] } else { bytes },
                    usage: self.usage(),
                })
            };
            let terrain = patch.terrain.then(|| TerrainBuffers {
                surface: make("prepared terrain", bytemuck::cast_slice(&patch.surface)),
                surface_count: patch.surface.len() as u32,
                ocean: make("prepared ocean", bytemuck::cast_slice(&patch.ocean)),
                ocean_count: patch.ocean.len() as u32,
                objects: make("prepared objects", bytemuck::cast_slice(&patch.objects)),
                object_count: patch.objects.len() as u32,
            });
            let next = PendingGeometry {
                shadow: make(
                    "prepared shadow geometry",
                    bytemuck::cast_slice(&patch.shadow),
                ),
                count: patch.shadow.len() as u32,
                terrain,
                bounds: patch.bounds,
                source: patch.geometry.clone(),
            };
            let bytes = next.bytes();
            allocated += bytes;
            self.budget.patches -= 1;
            self.budget.bytes = self.budget.bytes.saturating_sub(bytes);
            self.pending.insert(key, next);
        }
        let ready = !patches.is_empty()
            && patches.iter().all(|p| {
                let key = (instance, p.key, p.lod);
                self.sources
                    .get(&key)
                    .is_some_and(|s| Arc::ptr_eq(s, &p.geometry))
                    || self
                        .pending
                        .get(&key)
                        .is_some_and(|s| Arc::ptr_eq(&s.source, &p.geometry))
            });
        if ready {
            for patch in patches {
                let key = (instance, patch.key, patch.lod);
                let Some(next) = self.pending.remove(&key) else {
                    continue;
                };
                if let Some((old, _)) = self.catalog.insert(key, (next.shadow, next.count)) {
                    released += old.size();
                }
                if let Some(old) = self.terrain.remove(&key) {
                    released += old.bytes();
                }
                if let Some(terrain) = next.terrain {
                    self.terrain.insert(key, terrain);
                }
                self.bounds.remove(&key);
                if let Some(bounds) = next.bounds {
                    self.bounds.insert(key, bounds);
                }
                self.sources.insert(key, next.source);
            }
            self.catalog.retain(|(owner, key, lod), (b, _)| {
                let keep = *owner != instance || required.contains_key(&(*key, *lod));
                if !keep {
                    released += b.size();
                }
                keep
            });
            self.terrain.retain(|key, b| {
                let keep = self.catalog.contains_key(key);
                if !keep {
                    released += b.bytes();
                }
                keep
            });
            self.sources.retain(|key, _| self.catalog.contains_key(key));
            self.bounds.retain(|key, _| self.catalog.contains_key(key));
        }
        GeometryCacheResult {
            ready,
            allocated_bytes: allocated,
            released_bytes: released,
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/sectors/src/lib.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="352" bytes="11318" original_lines="352" original_bytes="11318" minified="false" sha256="c4aca40c7cb046c21c7e29503984e8b915ce62f3d4eb7fdd86dde4ea28dd979d">>>
//! Bounded, I/O-free sector request, ticket, readiness and cache lifecycle.

use minimium_world::world::{
    GenerationRevision, SectorKey, SectorRevision, WorldContentRevision, WorldInstanceId,
};
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque},
    sync::Arc,
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
struct SectorAddress {
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    key: SectorKey,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, PartialEq)]
pub struct SectorTicket {
    address: SectorAddress,
    generation: GenerationRevision,
    content: WorldContentRevision,
    serial: u64,
}

impl SectorTicket {
    pub const fn instance(self) -> WorldInstanceId {
        self.address.instance
    }

    pub const fn key(self) -> SectorKey {
        self.address.key
    }

    pub const fn generation(self) -> GenerationRevision {
        self.generation
    }

    pub const fn content_revision(self) -> WorldContentRevision {
        self.content
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SectorState {
    Queued,
    Generating,
    DataReady,
    Installed,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RequestError {
    InvalidCapacity,
    QueueFull,
    CacheFull,
    TicketSpaceExhausted,
    SectorInUse,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum InstallResult {
    Installed,
    Stale,
    WrongState,
}

struct SectorEntry<T> {
    ticket: SectorTicket,
    state: SectorState,
    payload: Option<Arc<T>>,
    revision: Option<SectorRevision>,
    collision_ready: bool,
    dirty: bool,
    pins: u32,
}

/// Own this manager on one mutation lane. Worker jobs receive copyable tickets
/// and immutable generation inputs; only the owner installs returned payloads.
pub struct SectorManager<T> {
    entries: BTreeMap<SectorAddress, SectorEntry<T>>,
    pending: VecDeque<SectorTicket>,
    cache_capacity: usize,
    queue_capacity: usize,
    next_serial: u64,
}

impl<T> SectorManager<T> {
    pub fn new(cache_capacity: usize, queue_capacity: usize) -> Result<Self, RequestError> {
        if cache_capacity == 0 || queue_capacity == 0 {
            return Err(RequestError::InvalidCapacity);
        }
        Ok(Self {
            entries: BTreeMap::new(),
            pending: VecDeque::with_capacity(queue_capacity),
            cache_capacity,
            queue_capacity,
            next_serial: 1,
        })
    }

    pub fn request(
        &mut self,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        key: SectorKey,
        generation: GenerationRevision,
        content: WorldContentRevision,
    ) -> Result<SectorTicket, RequestError> {
        let address = SectorAddress { instance, key };
        let existing = self.entries.get(&address);
        if let Some(existing) = existing {
            if existing.ticket.generation == generation && existing.ticket.content == content {
                return Ok(existing.ticket);
            }
            if existing.pins > 0 || existing.dirty {
                return Err(RequestError::SectorInUse);
            }
        }
        let old_queued = existing.is_some_and(|entry| entry.state == SectorState::Queued);
        let pending_after_replace = self.pending.len() - usize::from(old_queued);
        if pending_after_replace >= self.queue_capacity {
            return Err(RequestError::QueueFull);
        }
        if existing.is_none() && self.entries.len() >= self.cache_capacity {
            return Err(RequestError::CacheFull);
        }
        let serial = self.next_serial;
        self.next_serial = serial
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or(RequestError::TicketSpaceExhausted)?;
        if let Some(existing) = existing {
            // Replacing a generating entry invalidates its ticket. A worker may
            // still return later, but install_data will reject that stale result.
            self.pending.retain(|ticket| *ticket != existing.ticket);
            self.entries.remove(&address);
        }
        let ticket = SectorTicket {
            address,
            generation,
            content,
            serial,
        };
        self.entries.insert(
            address,
            SectorEntry {
                ticket,
                state: SectorState::Queued,
                payload: None,
                revision: None,
                collision_ready: false,
                dirty: false,
                pins: 0,
            },
        );
        self.pending.push_back(ticket);
        Ok(ticket)
    }

    pub fn begin_next(&mut self) -> Option<SectorTicket> {
        while let Some(ticket) = self.pending.pop_front() {
            let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
                continue;
            };
            if entry.ticket == ticket && entry.state == SectorState::Queued {
                entry.state = SectorState::Generating;
                return Some(ticket);
            }
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn install_data(
        &mut self,
        ticket: SectorTicket,
        revision: SectorRevision,
        payload: Arc<T>,
    ) -> InstallResult {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
            return InstallResult::Stale;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket {
            return InstallResult::Stale;
        }
        if entry.state != SectorState::Generating {
            return InstallResult::WrongState;
        }
        entry.payload = Some(payload);
        entry.revision = Some(revision);
        entry.state = SectorState::DataReady;
        InstallResult::Installed
    }

    pub fn install_collision(&mut self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> InstallResult {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
            return InstallResult::Stale;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket {
            return InstallResult::Stale;
        }
        if entry.state != SectorState::DataReady {
            return InstallResult::WrongState;
        }
        entry.collision_ready = true;
        entry.state = SectorState::Installed;
        InstallResult::Installed
    }

    pub fn state(&self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> Option<SectorState> {
        let entry = self.entries.get(&ticket.address)?;
        (entry.ticket == ticket).then_some(entry.state)
    }

    pub fn payload(&self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> Option<&T> {
        let entry = self.entries.get(&ticket.address)?;
        if entry.ticket == ticket {
            entry.payload.as_deref()
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    pub fn payload_arc(&self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> Option<Arc<T>> {
        let entry = self.entries.get(&ticket.address)?;
        (entry.ticket == ticket)
            .then(|| entry.payload.as_ref().map(Arc::clone))
            .flatten()
    }

    /// Iterates immutable payloads that have completed both data and collision
    /// installation. Mutation and eviction remain on the manager's owner lane.
    pub fn installed(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (SectorTicket, SectorRevision, &T)> {
        self.entries.values().filter_map(|entry| {
            if entry.state != SectorState::Installed || !entry.collision_ready {
                return None;
            }
            Some((entry.ticket, entry.revision?, entry.payload.as_deref()?))
        })
    }

    pub fn collision_ready(&self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> bool {
        self.entries
            .get(&ticket.address)
            .is_some_and(|entry| entry.ticket == ticket && entry.collision_ready)
    }

    pub fn mark_dirty(&mut self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> bool {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
            return false;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket || entry.payload.is_none() {
            return false;
        }
        entry.dirty = true;
        true
    }

    pub fn mark_saved(&mut self, ticket: SectorTicket, revision: SectorRevision) -> bool {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
            return false;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket || entry.revision != Some(revision) {
            return false;
        }
        entry.dirty = false;
        true
    }

    pub fn pin(&mut self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> bool {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
            return false;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket || entry.pins == u32::MAX {
            return false;
        }
        entry.pins += 1;
        true
    }

    pub fn unpin(&mut self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> bool {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get_mut(&ticket.address) else {
            return false;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket || entry.pins == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        entry.pins -= 1;
        true
    }

    pub fn evict(&mut self, ticket: SectorTicket) -> bool {
        let Some(entry) = self.entries.get(&ticket.address) else {
            return false;
        };
        if entry.ticket != ticket
            || entry.pins != 0
            || entry.dirty
            || entry.state == SectorState::Generating
        {
            return false;
        }
        self.pending.retain(|pending| *pending != ticket);
        self.entries.remove(&ticket.address).is_some()
    }

    /// Evicts the oldest clean, unpinned entry that is not being generated.
    pub fn evict_oldest(&mut self) -> bool {
        let candidate = self
            .entries
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, entry)| {
                entry.pins == 0 && !entry.dirty && entry.state != SectorState::Generating
            })
            .min_by_key(|(_, entry)| entry.ticket.serial)
            .map(|(address, entry)| (*address, entry.ticket));
        let Some((address, ticket)) = candidate else {
            return false;
        };
        self.pending.retain(|pending| *pending != ticket);
        self.entries.remove(&address).is_some()
    }

    /// Releases every clean, unpinned sector in an instance and leaves busy
    /// entries available for their current owners to finish or save.
    pub fn release_instance(&mut self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> usize {
        let releasable: Vec<_> = self
            .entries
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(address, entry)| {
                (address.instance == instance
                    && entry.pins == 0
                    && !entry.dirty
                    && entry.state != SectorState::Generating)
                    .then_some((*address, entry.ticket))
            })
            .collect();
        for (address, ticket) in &releasable {
            self.pending.retain(|pending| pending != ticket);
            self.entries.remove(address);
        }
        releasable.len()
    }

    pub fn pending_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.pending.len()
    }

    pub fn cached_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.entries.len()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/sectors/src/tests.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="101" bytes="4448" original_lines="101" original_bytes="4448" minified="false" sha256="d4fd4f0120e592267f10be286e9cc39f0906675a2b739101ba5c7261934f188f">>>
use super::*;
use minimium_world::world::{GenerationRevision, PlanetFace, SectorRevision, WorldContentRevision};

fn revisions(generation: u32, content: u64) -> (GenerationRevision, WorldContentRevision) {
    (
        GenerationRevision::new(generation).unwrap(),
        WorldContentRevision::new(content).unwrap(),
    )
}

#[test]
fn ticket_replacement_rejects_late_generation_and_requires_collision_ready() {
    let instance = WorldInstanceId::new(1).unwrap();
    let key = SectorKey::planet(PlanetFace::PositiveY, 4, 9).unwrap();
    let mut sectors = SectorManager::new(2, 1).unwrap();
    let (generation, content) = revisions(1, 1);
    let old = sectors.request(instance, key, generation, content).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(sectors.request(instance, key, generation, content), Ok(old));
    assert_eq!(sectors.pending_count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(sectors.begin_next(), Some(old));

    let (new_generation, _) = revisions(2, 1);
    let new = sectors
        .request(instance, key, new_generation, content)
        .unwrap();
    assert_ne!(old, new);
    assert_eq!(
        sectors.install_data(old, SectorRevision::new(1).unwrap(), Arc::new(3)),
        InstallResult::Stale
    );
    assert_eq!(sectors.begin_next(), Some(new));
    assert_eq!(
        sectors.install_data(new, SectorRevision::new(1).unwrap(), Arc::new(7)),
        InstallResult::Installed
    );
    assert_eq!(sectors.state(new), Some(SectorState::DataReady));
    assert_eq!(sectors.installed().count(), 0);
    assert_eq!(sectors.install_collision(new), InstallResult::Installed);
    assert_eq!(sectors.installed().next().unwrap().2, &7);
}

#[test]
fn cache_is_bounded_isolated_by_instance_and_evicts_only_clean_unpinned_entries() {
    let first = WorldInstanceId::new(1).unwrap();
    let second = WorldInstanceId::new(2).unwrap();
    let key = SectorKey::dungeon(0, 0, 0);
    let (generation, content) = revisions(1, 1);
    let mut sectors = SectorManager::new(2, 2).unwrap();
    let first_ticket = sectors.request(first, key, generation, content).unwrap();
    let second_ticket = sectors.request(second, key, generation, content).unwrap();
    assert_ne!(first_ticket, second_ticket);
    assert_eq!(sectors.begin_next(), Some(first_ticket));
    assert_eq!(
        sectors.install_data(first_ticket, SectorRevision::new(1).unwrap(), Arc::new(11)),
        InstallResult::Installed
    );
    sectors.install_collision(first_ticket);
    assert_eq!(sectors.begin_next(), Some(second_ticket));
    assert_eq!(
        sectors.install_data(second_ticket, SectorRevision::new(1).unwrap(), Arc::new(22)),
        InstallResult::Installed
    );
    sectors.install_collision(second_ticket);

    assert_eq!(sectors.payload(first_ticket), Some(&11));
    assert_eq!(sectors.payload(second_ticket), Some(&22));
    assert!(sectors.pin(first_ticket));
    assert!(!sectors.evict(first_ticket));
    assert!(sectors.unpin(first_ticket));
    assert!(sectors.mark_dirty(first_ticket));
    assert!(!sectors.evict(first_ticket));
    assert!(sectors.mark_saved(first_ticket, SectorRevision::new(1).unwrap()));
    assert!(sectors.evict(first_ticket));
    assert!(sectors.evict(second_ticket));

    let queued = sectors.request(first, key, generation, content).unwrap();
    let queued_second = sectors.request(second, key, generation, content).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(sectors.pending_count(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        sectors.request(WorldInstanceId::new(3).unwrap(), key, generation, content),
        Err(RequestError::QueueFull)
    );
    assert_eq!(sectors.state(queued), Some(SectorState::Queued));
    assert_eq!(sectors.state(queued_second), Some(SectorState::Queued));
}

#[test]
fn invalid_capacities_and_ticket_states_are_rejected() {
    assert!(matches!(
        SectorManager::<u8>::new(0, 1),
        Err(RequestError::InvalidCapacity)
    ));
    let instance = WorldInstanceId::new(3).unwrap();
    let key = SectorKey::dungeon(0, 0, 0);
    let (generation, content) = revisions(1, 1);
    let mut sectors = SectorManager::<u8>::new(1, 1).unwrap();
    let ticket = sectors.request(instance, key, generation, content).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(sectors.install_collision(ticket), InstallResult::WrongState);
    assert!(sectors.begin_next().is_some());
    assert_eq!(sectors.install_collision(ticket), InstallResult::WrongState);
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/accept.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="66" bytes="2506" original_lines="66" original_bytes="2506" minified="false" sha256="50c8d23cd6e36d7969fb43412c49049986817e348697ddcd35678499d9dd5ba5">>>
use crate::{connection::Client, MAX_PENDING_HANDSHAKES, MAX_PENDING_WORLD_INPUTS};
use minimium_protocol::{encode_server, ServerErrorCode, ServerMessage};
use std::{
    io::{self, Write},
    net::TcpListener,
    time::Instant,
};

const MAX_ACCEPTS_PER_POLL: usize = MAX_PENDING_HANDSHAKES;

pub(crate) fn accept_clients(
    listener: &TcpListener,
    clients: &mut Vec<Client>,
    max_client_connections: usize,
    pending_world_input_count: usize,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut accepted_this_poll = 0usize;
    loop {
        if accepted_this_poll >= MAX_ACCEPTS_PER_POLL {
            break;
        }
        match listener.accept() {
            Ok((stream, _)) => {
                accepted_this_poll += 1;
                if let Err(error) = stream.set_nonblocking(true) {
                    eprintln!("client I/O setup failed: {error}");
                    continue;
                }
                let rejection = if clients.len() >= max_client_connections
                    || pending_world_input_count + clients.len() >= MAX_PENDING_WORLD_INPUTS
                {
                    Some(ServerErrorCode::ServerFull)
                } else if clients
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|client| client.player_id().is_none())
                    .count()
                    >= MAX_PENDING_HANDSHAKES
                {
                    Some(ServerErrorCode::Busy)
                } else {
                    None
                };
                if let Some(error_code) = rejection {
                    let mut stream = stream;
                    if let Ok(frame) = encode_server(&ServerMessage::Error(error_code)) {
                        let _ = stream.write(&frame);
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if let Err(error) = stream.set_nodelay(true) {
                    eprintln!("client I/O setup failed: {error}");
                    continue;
                }
                if let Err(error) = stream.set_nonblocking(true) {
                    eprintln!("client I/O setup failed: {error}");
                    continue;
                }
                let connected_at = Instant::now();
                clients.push(Client::new(stream, connected_at));
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/admin.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="309" bytes="12024" original_lines="309" original_bytes="12024" minified="false" sha256="71248734fb7b357f06c7fd33a5be4df5881d715e2d9842f326190ca4a2632d11">>>
use crate::server_command::ServerCommand;
use std::{
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const MAX_ACTIVE_CLIENTS: usize = 8;
const MAX_ACCEPTS_PER_POLL: usize = 4;
const MAX_LINE_BYTES: usize = 512;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
const RESPONSE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
const MAX_REPLY_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
const MAX_READ_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL: usize = 1024;
const MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL: usize = 4096;

pub type RequestId = u64;

pub struct AdminRequest {
    pub id: RequestId,
    pub command: ServerCommand,
}

enum ClientPhase {
    Authentication,
    Command,
    AwaitingResponse,
    WritingResponse,
}

struct Client {
    stream: TcpStream,
    phase: ClientPhase,
    line: Vec<u8>,
    deadline: Instant,
    response_deadline: Option<Instant>,
    id: Option<RequestId>,
    output: Vec<u8>,
    output_offset: usize,
}

pub struct AdminServer {
    listener: TcpListener,
    token: String,
    clients: Vec<Client>,
    next_request_id: Option<RequestId>,
}

impl AdminServer {
    pub fn new(listener: TcpListener, token: String) -> io::Result<Self> {
        listener.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        Ok(Self {
            listener,
            token,
            clients: Vec::with_capacity(MAX_ACTIVE_CLIENTS),
            next_request_id: Some(1),
        })
    }

    pub fn poll(&mut self, now: Instant) -> io::Result<Vec<AdminRequest>> {
        let mut accepted = 0;
        while accepted < MAX_ACCEPTS_PER_POLL {
            match self.listener.accept() {
                Ok((stream, _)) => {
                    accepted += 1;
                    stream.set_nonblocking(true)?;
                    if self.clients.len() >= MAX_ACTIVE_CLIENTS {
                        drop(stream);
                        continue;
                    }
                    self.clients.push(Client {
                        stream,
                        phase: ClientPhase::Authentication,
                        line: Vec::with_capacity(128),
                        deadline: now + REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
                        response_deadline: None,
                        id: None,
                        output: Vec::new(),
                        output_offset: 0,
                    });
                }
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                Err(error) => return Err(error),
            }
        }

        let mut requests = Vec::new();
        let mut index = 0;
        while index < self.clients.len() {
            let mut keep = true;
            let client = &mut self.clients[index];
            if matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::WritingResponse)
                && client
                    .response_deadline
                    .is_some_and(|deadline| now >= deadline)
            {
                keep = false;
            } else if now >= client.deadline
                && !matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::WritingResponse)
            {
                if matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::AwaitingResponse) {
                    queue_reply(client, b"ERR request timed out\n", now);
                } else {
                    keep = false;
                }
            }

            if keep
                && matches!(
                    client.phase,
                    ClientPhase::Authentication | ClientPhase::Command
                )
            {
                let mut buffer = [0u8; MAX_READ_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL];
                let mut consumed = 0;
                let mut reached_eof = false;
                loop {
                    match client.stream.read(&mut buffer[consumed..]) {
                        Ok(0) => {
                            reached_eof = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        Ok(count) => {
                            consumed += count;
                            if consumed == buffer.len() {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                        Err(_) => {
                            keep = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for byte in buffer[..consumed].iter().copied() {
                    if !keep {
                        break;
                    }
                    if byte == b'\n' {
                        if client.line.last() == Some(&b'\r') {
                            client.line.pop();
                        }
                        let line = match std::str::from_utf8(&client.line) {
                            Ok(line) => line.to_owned(),
                            Err(_) => {
                                queue_reply(client, b"ERR invalid UTF-8\n", now);
                                client.line.clear();
                                break;
                            }
                        };
                        client.line.clear();
                        match client.phase {
                            ClientPhase::Authentication => {
                                if line == format!("AUTH {}", self.token) {
                                    client.phase = ClientPhase::Command;
                                } else {
                                    queue_reply(client, b"ERR unauthorized\n", now);
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            ClientPhase::Command => match ServerCommand::parse(line.trim()) {
                                Ok(command) => {
                                    let Some(id) = self.next_request_id else {
                                        queue_reply(client, b"ERR request IDs exhausted\n", now);
                                        break;
                                    };
                                    self.next_request_id = id.checked_add(1);
                                    client.id = Some(id);
                                    client.phase = ClientPhase::AwaitingResponse;
                                    requests.push(AdminRequest { id, command });
                                    break;
                                }
                                Err(error) => {
                                    queue_text_reply(client, format!("ERR {error}"), now);
                                    break;
                                }
                            },
                            ClientPhase::AwaitingResponse | ClientPhase::WritingResponse => break,
                        }
                    } else {
                        if client.line.len() == MAX_LINE_BYTES {
                            queue_reply(
                                client,
                                b"ERR admin request line exceeds size limit\n",
                                now,
                            );
                            break;
                        }
                        client.line.push(byte);
                    }
                }
                if reached_eof
                    && matches!(
                        client.phase,
                        ClientPhase::Authentication | ClientPhase::Command
                    )
                {
                    keep = false;
                }
            }

            if keep && matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::WritingResponse) {
                let mut written = 0;
                while client.output_offset < client.output.len()
                    && written < MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL
                {
                    let end = client
                        .output_offset
                        .saturating_add(MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL - written)
                        .min(client.output.len());
                    match client
                        .stream
                        .write(&client.output[client.output_offset..end])
                    {
                        Ok(0) => {
                            keep = false;
                            break;
                        }
                        Ok(count) => {
                            client.output_offset += count;
                            written += count;
                        }
                        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                        Err(_) => {
                            keep = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if client.output_offset == client.output.len() {
                    keep = false;
                }
            }

            if keep {
                index += 1;
            } else {
                self.clients.swap_remove(index);
            }
        }
        Ok(requests)
    }

    pub fn respond(&mut self, id: RequestId, success: bool, text: &str) {
        let Some(client) = self.clients.iter_mut().find(|client| {
            client.id == Some(id) && matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::AwaitingResponse)
        }) else {
            return;
        };
        let prefix = if success { "OK " } else { "ERR " };
        let reply_len = prefix.len().saturating_add(text.len()).saturating_add(1);
        if reply_len > MAX_REPLY_BYTES {
            queue_reply(client, b"ERR reply exceeds size limit\n", Instant::now());
            return;
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(reply_len);
        bytes.extend_from_slice(prefix.as_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(text.as_bytes());
        bytes.push(b'\n');
        queue_reply(client, &bytes, Instant::now());
    }

    /// Returns whether a request is still waiting for its dispatcher response.
    pub fn is_pending(&self, id: RequestId, now: Instant) -> bool {
        self.clients.iter().any(|client| {
            client.id == Some(id)
                && matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::AwaitingResponse)
                && now < client.deadline
        })
    }

    /// Rejects all requests that have not yet received a dispatcher response.
    pub fn reject_pending(&mut self, text: &str) {
        let ids: Vec<_> = self
            .clients
            .iter()
            .filter(|client| matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::AwaitingResponse))
            .filter_map(|client| client.id)
            .collect();
        for id in ids {
            self.respond(id, false, text);
        }
    }

    pub fn has_pending_output(&self) -> bool {
        self.clients.iter().any(|client| {
            matches!(client.phase, ClientPhase::WritingResponse)
                && client.output_offset < client.output.len()
        })
    }
}

fn queue_text_reply(client: &mut Client, text: String, now: Instant) {
    let mut bytes = text.into_bytes();
    bytes.push(b'\n');
    queue_reply(client, &bytes, now);
}

fn queue_reply(client: &mut Client, bytes: &[u8], now: Instant) {
    client.output.clear();
    client.output.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    client.output_offset = 0;
    client.response_deadline = Some(now.checked_add(RESPONSE_TIMEOUT).unwrap_or(now));
    client.phase = ClientPhase::WritingResponse;
}

mod time;
mod world;

use crate::modules::{CommandScope, ModuleRegistry};
use crate::runtime::schedule::{ScheduleDiagnostics, ServerSchedule, SystemFn};
use std::sync::OnceLock;

type ModuleHandler = fn(&mut CommandContext<'_>, &[&str]) -> CommandReply;

fn extensions() -> &'static ModuleRegistry<ModuleHandler, SystemFn> {
    static REGISTRY: OnceLock<ModuleRegistry<ModuleHandler, SystemFn>> = OnceLock::new();
    REGISTRY.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut registry = ModuleRegistry::default();
        registry
            .install(&world::WorldCommands)
            .expect("built-in world commands register without collisions");
        registry
    })
}

pub fn initialize_modules() {
    let _ = extensions();
}

pub(crate) fn build_schedule() -> ServerSchedule {
    ServerSchedule::from_systems(extensions().systems())
}

fn execute_registered(line: &str, context: &mut CommandContext<'_>) -> CommandReply {
    match extensions().resolve(line) {
        Some((command, args)) if command.definition.scope == CommandScope::ServerAdmin => {
            (command.definition.handler)(context, &args)
        }
        Some(_) => CommandReply {
            success: false,
            text: "command not permitted in the server admin console".into(),
            stop: false,
        },
        None => CommandReply {
            success: false,
            text: "unknown command; use `help`".into(),
            stop: false,
        },
    }
}

use crate::server_command::{server_help, ServerCommand};
use crate::{environment::EnvironmentClock, world_registry::WorldRegistry};
use crate::{
    metrics::RuntimeMetrics,
    storage::{PersistenceWorker, PlayerStore},
};
use minimium_environment::time::MonotonicMs;

pub struct CommandContext<'a> {
    pub worlds: &'a WorldRegistry,
    pub player_store: &'a mut PlayerStore,
    pub persistence: &'a mut PersistenceWorker,
    pub map_fingerprint: u64,
    pub lanes: usize,
    pub metrics: &'a RuntimeMetrics,
    pub environment_clock: &'a mut EnvironmentClock,
    pub monotonic_ms: MonotonicMs,
    pub schedule_diagnostics: ScheduleDiagnostics,
}

pub struct CommandReply {
    pub success: bool,
    pub text: String,
    pub stop: bool,
}

pub fn execute(command: &ServerCommand, mut context: CommandContext<'_>) -> CommandReply {
    if let ServerCommand::Registered(line) = command {
        return execute_registered(line, &mut context);
    }
    let CommandContext {
        worlds,
        player_store,
        persistence,
        map_fingerprint,
        lanes,
        metrics,
        environment_clock,
        monotonic_ms,
        schedule_diagnostics,
    } = context;
    match command {
        ServerCommand::Help => CommandReply {
            success: true,
            text: format!("{} | {}", server_help(), extensions().commands().iter()
                .map(|command| command.definition.usage).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" | ")),
            stop: false,
        },
        ServerCommand::Status => CommandReply {
            success: true,
            text: format!(
                "running players={} lanes={lanes} ticks={} clock_probe_requests={} clock_probe_accepted={} clock_probe_rejected={} environment_sync_messages={} scheduled_world_instances={} startup_system_runs={} {}",
                worlds.total_players(),
                metrics.ticks,
                metrics.clock_probe_requests,
                metrics.clock_probe_accepted,
                metrics.clock_probe_rejected,
                metrics.environment_sync_messages,
                schedule_diagnostics.world_instance_count,
                schedule_diagnostics.startup_system_runs,
                persistence.summary()
            ),
            stop: false,
        },
        ServerCommand::Players => {
            let players = worlds.player_snapshots();
            let text = if players.is_empty() {
                "no players".to_owned()
            } else {
                players
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(instance_id, player)| {
                        format!(
                            "{}:{}:world={instance_id}@{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}",
                            player.id,
                            player.name,
                            player.position[0],
                            player.position[1],
                            player.position[2]
                        )
                    })
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("; ")
            };
            CommandReply {
                success: true,
                text,
                stop: false,
            }
        }
        ServerCommand::Metrics => CommandReply {
            success: true,
            text: metrics.summary(worlds.total_players()),
            stop: false,
        },
        ServerCommand::Save => {
            let result = environment_clock
                .capture_saved_state(monotonic_ms)
                .and_then(|saved_clock| {
                    let input = worlds
                        .snapshot_for_save(map_fingerprint)
                        .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
                    persistence
                        .queue_world_save(player_store, input, saved_clock)
                        .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
                });
            match result {
                Ok(()) => CommandReply {
                    success: true,
                    text: "world save queued; use status to check completion".to_owned(),
                    stop: false,
                },
                Err(error) => CommandReply {
                    success: false,
                    text: format!("world save: {error}"),
                    stop: false,
                },
            }
        }
        ServerCommand::Stop => CommandReply {
            success: true,
            text: "stopping".to_owned(),
            stop: true,
        },
        ServerCommand::Time(command) => time::execute(*command, environment_clock, monotonic_ms),
        ServerCommand::Registered(_) => unreachable!("registered commands dispatched above"),
    }
}

use super::CommandReply;
use crate::environment::EnvironmentClock;

use minimium_environment::TimeCommand;

pub(super) fn execute(
    command: TimeCommand,
    clock: &mut EnvironmentClock,
    monotonic_ms: MonotonicMs,
) -> CommandReply {
    let result = match command {
        TimeCommand::Status => {
            return CommandReply {
                success: true,
                text: clock.status(monotonic_ms),
                stop: false,
            };
        }
        TimeCommand::Mode(mode) => clock.set_mode(monotonic_ms, mode),
        TimeCommand::Set(world_utc_ms) => clock.set_date(monotonic_ms, world_utc_ms),
        TimeCommand::Scale(rate_ppm) => clock.set_rate(monotonic_ms, rate_ppm),
        TimeCommand::Offline(policy) => clock.set_offline_policy(monotonic_ms, policy),
    };
    match result {
        Ok(_) => CommandReply {
            success: true,
            text: clock.status(monotonic_ms),
            stop: false,
        },
        Err(error) => CommandReply {
            success: false,
            text: error,
            stop: false,
        },
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/commands/world.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="142" bytes="4568" original_lines="142" original_bytes="4568" minified="false" sha256="3538645869af3fde7d6428407ea36f113d0b2e9e7681a5fd78b898f68ea3177e">>>
//! Example extension: owns the registration, validation and execution of its commands.
use super::{CommandContext, CommandReply, ModuleHandler};
use crate::modules::{
    CommandDefinition, CommandScope, EngineModule, ModuleDescriptor, ModuleError, ModuleRegistrar,
    Stage, SystemDefinition,
};
use crate::runtime::schedule::{ServerSystemContext, SystemFn};

pub(super) struct WorldCommands;

impl EngineModule<ModuleHandler, SystemFn> for WorldCommands {
    fn descriptor(&self) -> ModuleDescriptor {
        ModuleDescriptor {
            id: "world",
            version: 1,
            requires: &[],
        }
    }

    fn register(
        &self,
        registry: &mut ModuleRegistrar<'_, ModuleHandler, SystemFn>,
    ) -> Result<(), ModuleError> {
        registry.command(CommandDefinition {
            name: "world list",
            aliases: &[],
            usage: "world list",
            scope: CommandScope::ServerAdmin,
            handler: world_list,
        })?;
        registry.command(CommandDefinition {
            name: "world inspect",
            aliases: &[],
            usage: "world inspect ID",
            scope: CommandScope::ServerAdmin,
            handler: world_inspect,
        })?;
        registry.command(CommandDefinition {
            name: "entity list",
            aliases: &[],
            usage: "entity list",
            scope: CommandScope::ServerAdmin,
            handler: entity_list,
        })?;
        registry.system(SystemDefinition {
            id: "world-instance-count",
            stage: Stage::Startup,
            handler: record_instance_count,
        })
    }
}

fn record_instance_count(context: &mut ServerSystemContext<'_>) {
    debug_assert_eq!(context.stage, Stage::Startup);
    context.diagnostics.world_instance_count = context.worlds.iter().count();
    context.diagnostics.startup_system_runs =
        context.diagnostics.startup_system_runs.saturating_add(1);
}

fn success(text: String) -> CommandReply {
    CommandReply {
        success: true,
        text,
        stop: false,
    }
}

fn invalid(usage: &'static str) -> CommandReply {
    CommandReply {
        success: false,
        text: usage.into(),
        stop: false,
    }
}

fn world_list(context: &mut CommandContext<'_>, args: &[&str]) -> CommandReply {
    if !args.is_empty() {
        return invalid("usage: world list");
    }
    let rows = context
        .worlds
        .iter()
        .map(|(id, instance)| {
            format!(
                "{id}: players={} topology={:?} generation={:?}",
                instance.world.player_count(),
                instance.manifest.topology(),
                instance.manifest.generation().revision()
            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    success(rows.join("; "))
}

fn world_inspect(context: &mut CommandContext<'_>, args: &[&str]) -> CommandReply {
    let [raw] = args else {
        return invalid("usage: world inspect ID");
    };
    let Ok(value) = raw.parse::<u128>() else {
        return invalid("world ID must be a positive decimal integer");
    };
    let Some(id) = minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId::new(value) else {
        return invalid("world ID must be nonzero");
    };
    let Some(instance) = context.worlds.get(id) else {
        return invalid("world instance not found");
    };
    success(format!(
        "{id}: players={} manifest={:?}",
        instance.world.player_count(),
        instance.manifest
    ))
}

fn entity_list(context: &mut CommandContext<'_>, args: &[&str]) -> CommandReply {
    if !args.is_empty() {
        return invalid("usage: entity list");
    }
    let mut rows: Vec<_> = context
        .worlds
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|(world_id, instance)| {
            instance
                .entities
                .iter()
                .map(move |id| format!("world={world_id} entity={}", id.get()))
        })
        .collect();
    // Legacy players are not yet EntityIds; display them separately until migrated.
    rows.extend(context.worlds.iter().flat_map(|(world_id, instance)| {
        instance
            .world
            .snapshot()
            .into_iter()
            .map(move |player| format!("world={world_id} player={}:{}", player.id, player.name))
    }));
    if rows.is_empty() {
        success("no runtime entities or players".into())
    } else {
        success(rows.join("; "))
    }
}
