<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/config.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="217" bytes="8674" original_lines="217" original_bytes="8674" minified="false" sha256="f1a0d1f16975487ff051f5c7fb7b5877c84036d1cbfe59b92f549b95ee88bbd0">>>
use std::{error::Error, path::PathBuf, thread};

pub const MAX_PLAYERS: usize = 512;
pub const DEFAULT_AUTOSAVE_SECONDS: u64 = 300;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum LaneSelection {
    Fixed(usize),
    Auto,
}

impl LaneSelection {
    pub fn count(self) -> usize {
        match self {
            Self::Fixed(count) => count,
            Self::Auto => thread::available_parallelism()
                .map(usize::from)
                .unwrap_or(1)
                .min(64),
        }
    }
}

pub struct ServerConfig {
    pub material_package_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub material_http_port: u16,
    pub climate_scenario_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub climate_relief_influence: Option<f64>,
    pub seed: Option<u128>,
    pub lanes: LaneSelection,
    pub data_dir: PathBuf,
    pub map_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub world_definition_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub planet_config_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub environment_config_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub bind_address: String,
    pub game_port: u16,
    pub max_players: usize,
    pub autosave_seconds: u64,
    pub console_enabled: bool,
}

impl ServerConfig {
    pub fn parse(args: &[String]) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn Error>> {
        if !args.is_empty() && args[0] != "run" {
            return Err("expected subcommand `run` (try --help)".into());
        }
        let mut config = Self {
            seed: None,
            lanes: LaneSelection::Fixed(1),
            data_dir: PathBuf::from(minimium_platform::files::DEFAULT_SERVER_DATA_DIR),
            map_path: None,
            world_definition_path: None,
            planet_config_path: None,
            environment_config_path: None,
            material_package_path: None,
            material_http_port: 0,
            climate_scenario_path: None,
            climate_relief_influence: None,
            bind_address: String::from("127.0.0.1"),
            game_port: 0,
            max_players: MAX_PLAYERS,
            autosave_seconds: DEFAULT_AUTOSAVE_SECONDS,
            console_enabled: true,
        };
        let mut index = usize::from(!args.is_empty());
        while index < args.len() {
            match args[index].as_str() {
                "--material-package" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.material_package_path = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.get(index).ok_or("--material-package requires PATH")?,
                    ));
                }
                "--material-http-port" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.material_http_port = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--material-http-port requires PORT")?
                        .parse()?;
                }
                "--climate-scenario" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.climate_scenario_path = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.get(index).ok_or("--climate-scenario requires PATH")?,
                    ));
                }
                "--climate-relief-influence" => {
                    index += 1;
                    let value: f64 = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--climate-relief-influence requires 0..1")?
                        .parse()
                        .map_err(|_| {
                            "--climate-relief-influence requires a finite number in 0..1"
                        })?;
                    if !value.is_finite() || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&value) {
                        return Err(
                            "--climate-relief-influence requires a finite value in 0..1".into()
                        );
                    }
                    config.climate_relief_influence = Some(value);
                }
                "--seed" => {
                    index += 1;
                    let value = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--seed requires a decimal or 0x hex value")?;
                    config.seed = Some(if let Some(hex) = value.strip_prefix("0x") {
                        u128::from_str_radix(hex, 16)?
                    } else {
                        value.parse()?
                    });
                }
                "--threads" => {
                    index += 1;
                    let value = args.get(index).ok_or("--threads requires 1, 2, or auto")?;
                    config.lanes = if value == "auto" {
                        LaneSelection::Auto
                    } else {
                        let count = value
                            .parse::<usize>()
                            .map_err(|_| "--threads requires 1, 2, or auto")?;
                        if !(1..=64).contains(&count) {
                            return Err("thread lane count must be between 1 and 64".into());
                        }
                        LaneSelection::Fixed(count)
                    };
                }
                "--max-players" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.max_players = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--max-players requires a number")?
                        .parse()?;
                    if !(1..=MAX_PLAYERS).contains(&config.max_players) {
                        return Err(
                            format!("--max-players must be between 1 and {MAX_PLAYERS}").into()
                        );
                    }
                }
                "--data-dir" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.data_dir =
                        PathBuf::from(args.get(index).ok_or("--data-dir requires a path")?);
                }
                "--map" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.map_path = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.get(index).ok_or("--map requires a path")?,
                    ));
                }
                "--world-definition" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.world_definition_path = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.get(index)
                            .ok_or("--world-definition requires a path")?,
                    ));
                }
                "--planet-config" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.planet_config_path = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.get(index).ok_or("--planet-config requires a path")?,
                    ));
                }
                "--environment-config" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.environment_config_path = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.get(index)
                            .ok_or("--environment-config requires a path")?,
                    ));
                }
                "--bind" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.bind_address = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--bind requires an IP address")?
                        .clone();
                }
                "--game-port" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.game_port = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--game-port requires a port number")?
                        .parse()?;
                }
                "--autosave-seconds" => {
                    index += 1;
                    config.autosave_seconds = args
                        .get(index)
                        .ok_or("--autosave-seconds requires a number")?
                        .parse()?;
                    if config.autosave_seconds > 604_800 {
                        return Err("--autosave-seconds must be between 0 and 604800".into());
                    }
                }
                "--headless" => config.console_enabled = false,
                other => return Err(format!("unknown option `{other}` (try --help)").into()),
            }
            index += 1;
        }
        if config.map_path.is_some() && config.world_definition_path.is_some() {
            return Err("--map and --world-definition cannot be used together".into());
        }
        if config.seed.is_some()
            && (config.map_path.is_some() || config.world_definition_path.is_some())
        {
            return Err("--seed is only available for generated worlds".into());
        }
        if config.planet_config_path.is_some()
            && (config.map_path.is_some() || config.world_definition_path.is_some())
        {
            return Err("--planet-config is only available for generated worlds".into());
        }
        Ok(config)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/connection.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="382" bytes="12263" original_lines="382" original_bytes="12263" minified="false" sha256="632024958f6e820f3e212e46283745cd89178172f755b5391cb0d5c819e332c2">>>
use crate::metrics::RuntimeMetrics;
use minimium_core::identity::PlayerProfileId;
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_environment::time::ClockRevision;
use minimium_protocol::WorldContext;
use minimium_protocol::{encode_server_into, RemotePlayers, ServerMessage, MAX_SERVER_FRAME_BYTES};
use minimium_transport as network;
use std::{
    collections::VecDeque,
    net::TcpStream,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

pub(crate) const MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
pub(crate) const MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_FRAMES: usize = 256;
pub(crate) const CLIENT_CLOSE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
const TIME_PROBE_WINDOW: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) enum CloseReason {
    Quit,
    Rejected,
    PeerEof,
    HandshakeTimeout,
    IdleTimeout,
    InvalidFrame,
    ReadError,
    WriteError,
    Backpressure,
    InvalidSequence,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct Identity {
    pub(crate) player: PlayerId,
    pub(crate) profile: PlayerProfileId,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) enum ConnectionPhase {
    AwaitIdentify,
    Active(Identity),
    Draining {
        identity: Option<Identity>,
        deadline: Instant,
        reason: CloseReason,
    },
}

pub(crate) struct Client {
    pub(crate) presentation: bool,
    pub(crate) content_ready: bool,
    pub(crate) pending_profile: Option<PlayerProfileId>,
    phase: ConnectionPhase,
    pub(crate) disconnect_reason: Option<CloseReason>,
    pub(crate) stream: TcpStream,
    pub(crate) input: Vec<u8>,
    output: Vec<u8>,
    output_offset: usize,
    output_frames: VecDeque<(usize, Instant)>,
    pub(crate) bytes_in: u64,
    pub(crate) bytes_out: u64,
    pub(crate) frames_in: u64,
    pub(crate) frames_out: u64,
    pub(crate) encoding_us: u64,
    pub(crate) replicated_players: RemotePlayers,
    pub(crate) replication_initialized: bool,
    pub(crate) connected_at: Instant,
    pub(crate) last_message_at: Instant,
    pub(crate) peer_eof: bool,
    pub(crate) last_fire_at: Option<Instant>,
    pub(crate) last_chat_at: Option<Instant>,
    pub(crate) pending_health_update: Option<u16>,
    time_probe_received_at: [Option<Instant>; 2],
    pub(crate) last_environment_sync_at: Option<Instant>,
    pub(crate) last_environment_context: Option<WorldContext>,
    pub(crate) last_environment_revision: Option<ClockRevision>,
    pub(crate) last_time_probe_rejection_at: Option<Instant>,
}

impl Client {
    pub(crate) fn new(stream: TcpStream, connected_at: Instant) -> Self {
        Self {
            phase: ConnectionPhase::AwaitIdentify,
            presentation: false,
            content_ready: false,
            pending_profile: None,
            disconnect_reason: None,
            stream,
            input: Vec::with_capacity(512),
            output: Vec::new(),
            output_offset: 0,
            output_frames: VecDeque::new(),
            bytes_in: 0,
            bytes_out: 0,
            frames_in: 0,
            frames_out: 0,
            encoding_us: 0,
            replicated_players: RemotePlayers::default(),
            replication_initialized: false,
            connected_at,
            last_message_at: connected_at,
            peer_eof: false,
            last_fire_at: None,
            last_chat_at: None,
            pending_health_update: None,
            time_probe_received_at: [None; 2],
            last_environment_sync_at: None,
            last_environment_context: None,
            last_environment_revision: None,
            last_time_probe_rejection_at: None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn pending_output_bytes(&self) -> usize {
        self.output.len().saturating_sub(self.output_offset)
    }

    pub(crate) fn oldest_output_age(&self) -> Option<Duration> {
        self.output_frames.front().map(|(_, at)| at.elapsed())
    }
    pub(crate) fn identity(&self) -> Option<Identity> {
        match self.phase {
            ConnectionPhase::AwaitIdentify => None,
            ConnectionPhase::Active(identity) => Some(identity),
            ConnectionPhase::Draining { identity, .. } => identity,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn player_id(&self) -> Option<PlayerId> {
        self.identity().map(|identity| identity.player)
    }

    pub(crate) fn activate(&mut self, player: PlayerId, profile: PlayerProfileId) {
        debug_assert!(matches!(self.phase, ConnectionPhase::AwaitIdentify));
        self.phase = ConnectionPhase::Active(Identity { player, profile });
    }

    pub(crate) fn accept_time_probe(&mut self, now: Instant) -> bool {
        for received_at in &mut self.time_probe_received_at {
            if received_at.is_some_and(|at| now.saturating_duration_since(at) >= TIME_PROBE_WINDOW)
            {
                *received_at = None;
            }
        }
        if let Some(slot) = self
            .time_probe_received_at
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|received_at| received_at.is_none())
        {
            *slot = Some(now);
            true
        } else {
            false
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn mark_environment_sent(
        &mut self,
        context: WorldContext,
        revision: ClockRevision,
        now: Instant,
    ) {
        self.last_environment_sync_at = Some(now);
        self.last_environment_context = Some(context);
        self.last_environment_revision = Some(revision);
    }

    pub(crate) fn close_deadline(&self) -> Option<Instant> {
        match self.phase {
            ConnectionPhase::Draining { deadline, .. } => Some(deadline),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn begin_close(&mut self, now: Instant, reason: CloseReason) {
        if self.close_deadline().is_none() {
            self.phase = ConnectionPhase::Draining {
                identity: self.identity(),
                deadline: now + CLIENT_CLOSE_TIMEOUT,
                reason,
            };
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn reason(&self) -> Option<CloseReason> {
        self.disconnect_reason.or(match self.phase {
            ConnectionPhase::Draining { reason, .. } => Some(reason),
            _ => None,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn flush(&mut self, budget: usize) -> network::FlushResult {
        let result = network::flush(
            &mut self.stream,
            &self.output,
            &mut self.output_offset,
            budget,
        );
        account_output(self, result.written);
        result
    }
}

pub(crate) fn queue_close_response(
    client: &mut Client,
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
    message: ServerMessage,
    now: Instant,
) -> bool {
    let reason = if matches!(message, ServerMessage::Bye) {
        CloseReason::Quit
    } else {
        CloseReason::Rejected
    };
    if !queue_message(client, metrics, message) {
        metrics.dropped_messages = metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
        client.disconnect_reason = Some(CloseReason::Backpressure);
        return false;
    }
    client.begin_close(now, reason);
    true
}

pub(crate) fn mark_disconnected(
    index: usize,
    client: &mut Client,
    disconnected: &mut Vec<usize>,
    reason: Option<CloseReason>,
) {
    if let Some(reason) = reason {
        client.disconnect_reason = Some(reason);
    }
    disconnected.push(index);
}

pub(crate) fn queue_message(
    client: &mut Client,
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
    message: ServerMessage,
) -> bool {
    if client.close_deadline().is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    if client.output_frames.len() >= MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_FRAMES {
        return false;
    }
    prepare_output(client);
    if client.output.len() + MAX_SERVER_FRAME_BYTES > MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_BYTES {
        return false;
    }
    client.output.reserve_exact(MAX_SERVER_FRAME_BYTES);
    let frame_start = client.output.len();
    let encoding_started = Instant::now();
    let result = encode_server_into(&mut client.output, &message);
    let encoding_time = encoding_started.elapsed();
    metrics.encoding.record(encoding_time);
    client.encoding_us = client
        .encoding_us
        .saturating_add(encoding_time.as_micros().min(u64::MAX as u128) as u64);
    match result {
        Ok(()) if client.output.len() <= MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_BYTES => {
            client
                .output_frames
                .push_back((client.output.len() - frame_start, Instant::now()));
            client.frames_out += 1;
            metrics.frames_out += 1;
            true
        }
        Ok(()) => {
            client.output.truncate(frame_start);
            false
        }
        Err(error) => {
            client.output.truncate(frame_start);
            eprintln!("could not encode game message: {error}");
            false
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn queue_encoded_frame(
    client: &mut Client,
    frame: &[u8],
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
) -> bool {
    if client.close_deadline().is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    if client.output_frames.len() >= MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_FRAMES {
        return false;
    }
    prepare_output(client);
    if client.output.len().saturating_add(frame.len()) > MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_BYTES {
        return false;
    }
    client.output.reserve(frame.len());
    client.output.extend_from_slice(frame);
    client
        .output_frames
        .push_back((frame.len(), Instant::now()));
    client.frames_out += 1;
    metrics.frames_out += 1;
    true
}

fn prepare_output(client: &mut Client) {
    if client.output_offset > 0 {
        let pending = client.output.len() - client.output_offset;
        client.output.copy_within(client.output_offset.., 0);
        client.output.truncate(pending);
        client.output_offset = 0;
    }
}

fn account_output(client: &mut Client, mut written: usize) {
    while written > 0 {
        let Some((remaining, _)) = client.output_frames.front_mut() else {
            break;
        };
        let consumed = written.min(*remaining);
        *remaining -= consumed;
        written -= consumed;
        if *remaining == 0 {
            client.output_frames.pop_front();
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};

    fn client_without_io() -> Client {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let peer = TcpStream::connect(listener.local_addr().unwrap()).unwrap();
        let (server, _) = listener.accept().unwrap();
        drop(peer);
        Client::new(server, Instant::now())
    }

    #[test]
    fn byte_budget_rejects_before_frame_count_limit() {
        let mut client = client_without_io();
        let mut metrics = RuntimeMetrics::default();
        let frame = [0; 1024];

        for _ in 0..MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_BYTES / frame.len() {
            assert!(queue_encoded_frame(&mut client, &frame, &mut metrics));
        }

        assert_eq!(client.output_frames.len(), 64);
        assert_eq!(client.pending_output_bytes(), MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_BYTES);
        assert!(!queue_encoded_frame(&mut client, &[0], &mut metrics));
        assert!(!queue_message(
            &mut client,
            &mut metrics,
            ServerMessage::Bye
        ));
        assert_eq!(client.output_frames.len(), 64);
    }

    #[test]
    fn frame_count_limit_rejects_before_byte_budget() {
        let mut client = client_without_io();
        let mut metrics = RuntimeMetrics::default();

        for _ in 0..MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_FRAMES {
            assert!(queue_encoded_frame(&mut client, &[0], &mut metrics));
        }

        assert_eq!(client.pending_output_bytes(), MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_FRAMES);
        assert!(!queue_encoded_frame(&mut client, &[0], &mut metrics));
        assert!(!queue_message(
            &mut client,
            &mut metrics,
            ServerMessage::Bye
        ));
        assert_eq!(client.output_frames.len(), MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_FRAMES);
    }
}

//! World climate configuration and separate bounded HTTP material endpoint.
use minimium_assets::terrain_material::{digest, MaterialManifest, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES};
use minimium_environment::climate::ClimateScenario;
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    fs,
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
        Arc,
    },
    thread::JoinHandle,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

pub(crate) struct ContentServer {
    pub hash: [u8; 32],
    pub port: u16,
    pub climate: ClimateScenario,
    stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    thread: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl ContentServer {
    pub fn new(config: &crate::config::ServerConfig) -> io::Result<Self> {
        let climate_path = config.data_dir.join("world.climate.ron");
        let saved = climate_path.exists();
        let source = if saved {
            if config.climate_scenario_path.is_some() {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "--climate-scenario initializes a new world only",
                ));
            }
            minimium_asset_io::materials::read_bounded(&climate_path, 16 * 1024)
                .map_err(io::Error::other)?
        } else if let Some(path) = &config.climate_scenario_path {
            minimium_asset_io::materials::read_bounded(path, 16 * 1024).map_err(io::Error::other)?
        } else {
            ron::to_string(&ClimateScenario::default())
                .map_err(io::Error::other)?
                .into_bytes()
        };
        let mut climate: ClimateScenario =
            ron::from_str(std::str::from_utf8(&source).map_err(io::Error::other)?)
                .map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        let changed = config
            .climate_relief_influence
            .is_some_and(|v| v != climate.relief_influence);
        if let Some(value) = config.climate_relief_influence {
            climate.relief_influence = value;
        }
        climate.validate().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        if !saved || changed {
            let source = ron::to_string(&climate).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            minimium_platform::files::atomic_write_file(
                &config.data_dir.join("world.climate.tmp"),
                &climate_path,
                source.as_bytes(),
            )?;
        }
        let mut server = Self {
            hash: [0; 32],
            port: 0,
            climate,
            stop: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
            thread: None,
        };
        let Some(root) = &config.material_package_path else {
            return Ok(server);
        };
        let source = minimium_asset_io::materials::read_bounded(
            &root.join("manifest.ron"),
            MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES as u64,
        )
        .map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        let manifest = MaterialManifest::parse(&source).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        // Validate both upload variants before advertising the required package.
        for compressed in [true, false] {
            minimium_asset_io::materials::MaterialPackage::open(root, compressed)
                .map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        }
        server.hash = minimium_assets::terrain_material::decode_hash(&digest(&source))
            .map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        let mut files = HashMap::from([(
            "manifest.ron".to_owned(),
            (root.join("manifest.ron"), source.len() as u64),
        )]);
        for variant in &manifest.variants {
            for file in &variant.maps {
                files.insert(file.name.clone(), (root.join(&file.name), file.bytes));
            }
        }
        let listener =
            TcpListener::bind((config.bind_address.as_str(), config.material_http_port))?;
        listener.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        server.port = listener.local_addr()?.port();
        let stop = server.stop.clone();
        server.thread = Some(
            std::thread::Builder::new()
                .name("material-http".into())
                .spawn(move || {
                    while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                        match listener.accept() {
                            Ok((mut stream, _)) => {
                                let _ = serve(&mut stream, &files, &stop);
                            }
                            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20))
                            }
                            Err(_) => break,
                        }
                    }
                })?,
        );
        Ok(server)
    }
}

impl Drop for ContentServer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
            let _ = thread.join();
        }
    }
}

fn serve(
    stream: &mut TcpStream,
    files: &HashMap<String, (PathBuf, u64)>,
    stop: &AtomicBool,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let started = Instant::now();
    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))?;
    stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))?;
    let mut header = Vec::new();
    while !header.ends_with(b"\r\n\r\n") {
        if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) || started.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(2) {
            return Err(io::Error::other("HTTP request deadline"));
        }
        if header.len() >= 8192 {
            return Err(io::Error::other("HTTP header limit"));
        }
        let mut byte = [0];
        stream.read_exact(&mut byte)?;
        header.push(byte[0]);
    }
    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&header).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
    let line = text.lines().next().unwrap_or("");
    let name = line
        .strip_prefix("GET /")
        .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(" HTTP/1.1"));
    if let Some((path, length)) = name.and_then(|name| files.get(name)) {
        let mut input = fs::File::open(Path::new(path))?;
        if input.metadata()?.len() != *length {
            return Err(io::Error::other("material file changed"));
        }
        write!(stream, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {length}\r\nConnection: close\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n")?;
        let mut remaining = *length;
        let mut buffer = [0; 64 * 1024];
        while remaining > 0 {
            if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) || started.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(300) {
                return Err(io::Error::other("HTTP transfer cancelled or timed out"));
            }
            let count = (remaining as usize).min(buffer.len());
            input.read_exact(&mut buffer[..count])?;
            stream.write_all(&buffer[..count])?;
            remaining -= count as u64;
        }
    } else {
        stream.write_all(
            b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/environment/clock.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="389" bytes="14157" original_lines="389" original_bytes="14157" minified="false" sha256="a0aafbc4fdbd173ffa36e2411e97c426cb112bde7f12edea9969e38d1112813f">>>
use super::EnvironmentConfig;
use minimium_environment::time::{
    evaluate_clock, restore_clock_state, sample_clock, save_clock_state, set_clock_mode,
    set_offline_policy, set_time_scale, set_world_time, ClockAnchor, ClockMode, ClockRevision,
    ClockSample, MonotonicMs, OfflinePolicy, SavedClockState, SessionNonce, TimeError,
    TimeScalePpm, WorldTimeMs,
};
use std::time::{Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

const SYSTEM_CLOCK_CHECK_MS: i128 = 250;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum ClockFault {
    TimeRangeExhausted,
    RevisionExhausted,
}

impl ClockFault {
    pub(crate) const fn code(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::TimeRangeExhausted => "time_range_exhausted",
            Self::RevisionExhausted => "clock_revision_exhausted",
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct EnvironmentClock {
    anchor: ClockAnchor,
    session_nonce: SessionNonce,
    last_valid_world_time: WorldTimeMs,
    last_correction_ms: Option<i128>,
    fault: Option<ClockFault>,
    dirty_revision: Option<ClockRevision>,
}

impl EnvironmentClock {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        config: EnvironmentConfig,
        saved_clock: Option<SavedClockState>,
        server_started: Instant,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let nonce = minimium_platform::endpoint::new_random_bytes::<16>()
            .map(SessionNonce::new)
            .map_err(|error| format!("could not create server session nonce: {error}"))?;
        let monotonic_ms = u64::try_from(server_started.elapsed().as_millis())
            .map(MonotonicMs::new)
            .map_err(|_| "server monotonic time overflow".to_owned())?;
        let anchor = if let Some(saved) = saved_clock {
            let wall_utc_now = system_world_time_now()?;
            let restored = restore_clock_state(saved, wall_utc_now, monotonic_ms)
                .map_err(|error| format!("could not restore saved environment clock: {error}"))?;
            if saved.mode() == ClockMode::TimeScale
                && saved.offline_policy() == OfflinePolicy::Advance
                && restored.wall_clock_went_backwards()
            {
                eprintln!(
                    "offline time advance skipped because system UTC moved backward saved_wall_utc_ms={} current_wall_utc_ms={}",
                    saved.saved_wall_utc_ms().get(),
                    wall_utc_now.get()
                );
            }
            restored.anchor()
        } else {
            let world_time = match (config.mode, config.initial_utc) {
                (ClockMode::RealTime, _) => system_world_time_now()?,
                (ClockMode::TimeScale, Some(initial)) => initial,
                (ClockMode::TimeScale, None) => system_world_time_now()?,
            };
            ClockAnchor::initial(
                config.mode,
                world_time,
                monotonic_ms,
                config.scale_ppm,
                config.offline_policy,
            )
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
        };
        Ok(Self {
            anchor,
            session_nonce: nonce,
            last_valid_world_time: anchor.world_utc_ms(),
            last_correction_ms: None,
            fault: None,
            dirty_revision: None,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn observe(&mut self, now: MonotonicMs) -> Option<ClockFault> {
        if self.fault == Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted) {
            return None;
        }
        match evaluate_clock(self.anchor, now) {
            Ok(world_time) => {
                self.last_valid_world_time = world_time;
                None
            }
            Err(TimeError::OutOfSupportedRange(_)) => Some(self.pause_on_range_exhaustion(now)),
            Err(_) => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn check_system_clock(&mut self, now: MonotonicMs) -> Result<Option<i128>, String> {
        if self.anchor.mode() != ClockMode::RealTime
            || self.fault == Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted)
        {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let utc_now = match system_world_time_now() {
            Ok(value) => value,
            Err(_) => {
                let fault = self.pause_on_range_exhaustion(now);
                return Err(fault.code().to_owned());
            }
        };
        let expected = match evaluate_clock(self.anchor, now) {
            Ok(value) => value,
            Err(TimeError::OutOfSupportedRange(_)) => {
                let fault = self.pause_on_range_exhaustion(now);
                return Err(fault.code().to_owned());
            }
            Err(error) => return Err(error.to_string()),
        };
        let correction_ms = i128::from(utc_now.get()) - i128::from(expected.get());
        if correction_ms.abs() < SYSTEM_CLOCK_CHECK_MS {
            self.last_valid_world_time = expected;
            return Ok(None);
        }
        match set_clock_mode(self.anchor, now, ClockMode::RealTime, Some(utc_now)) {
            Ok(anchor) => {
                self.anchor = anchor;
                self.last_valid_world_time = utc_now;
                self.last_correction_ms = Some(correction_ms);
                self.dirty_revision = Some(anchor.revision());
                Ok(Some(correction_ms))
            }
            Err(TimeError::RevisionExhausted) => {
                self.fault = Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted);
                Err(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted.code().to_owned())
            }
            Err(error) => Err(error.to_string()),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn status(&self, now: MonotonicMs) -> String {
        let world_utc_ms = self
            .sample(now)
            .map(|sample| sample.world_utc_ms().get())
            .unwrap_or(self.last_valid_world_time.get());
        let fault = self.fault.map(ClockFault::code).unwrap_or_else(|| {
            if matches!(
                evaluate_clock(self.anchor, now),
                Err(TimeError::OutOfSupportedRange(_))
            ) {
                "time_range_exhausted_pending"
            } else {
                "none"
            }
        });
        let correction = self
            .last_correction_ms
            .map(format_correction)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_owned());
        let dirty = self
            .dirty_revision
            .map(|revision| revision.get().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_owned());
        format!(
            "clock_id={} revision={} session_nonce={} mode={} world_utc_ms={} rate_ppm={} rate={} offline_policy={} fault={} last_utc_correction_ms={} sync_dirty_revision={}",
            self.anchor.clock_id().get(),
            self.anchor.revision().get(),
            nonce_hex(self.session_nonce),
            mode_name(self.anchor.mode()),
            world_utc_ms,
            self.anchor.rate_ppm().get(),
            format_scale(self.anchor.rate_ppm()),
            policy_name(self.anchor.offline_policy()),
            fault,
            correction,
            dirty,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn sample(&self, now: MonotonicMs) -> Result<ClockSample, String> {
        if self.fault == Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted) {
            return Err(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted.code().to_owned());
        }
        sample_clock(self.anchor, self.session_nonce, now).map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }

    pub(crate) fn capture_saved_state(
        &mut self,
        now: MonotonicMs,
    ) -> Result<SavedClockState, String> {
        self.observe(now);
        if self.fault == Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted) {
            return Err(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted.code().to_owned());
        }
        let wall_utc = system_world_time_now()?;
        save_clock_state(self.anchor, now, wall_utc).map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_date(
        &mut self,
        now: MonotonicMs,
        value: WorldTimeMs,
    ) -> Result<ClockRevision, String> {
        self.ensure_mutable(now, true)?;
        let anchor = map_clock_error(set_world_time(self.anchor, now, value), &mut self.fault)?;
        self.replace_anchor(anchor, true);
        Ok(anchor.revision())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_rate(
        &mut self,
        now: MonotonicMs,
        value: TimeScalePpm,
    ) -> Result<ClockRevision, String> {
        self.ensure_mutable(now, false)?;
        let anchor = map_clock_error(set_time_scale(self.anchor, now, value), &mut self.fault)?;
        self.replace_anchor(anchor, false);
        Ok(anchor.revision())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_mode(
        &mut self,
        now: MonotonicMs,
        value: ClockMode,
    ) -> Result<ClockRevision, String> {
        let recover = value == ClockMode::RealTime;
        self.ensure_mutable(now, recover)?;
        let utc_now = if recover {
            Some(system_world_time_now()?)
        } else {
            None
        };
        let anchor = map_clock_error(
            set_clock_mode(self.anchor, now, value, utc_now),
            &mut self.fault,
        )?;
        self.replace_anchor(anchor, recover);
        Ok(anchor.revision())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_offline_policy(
        &mut self,
        now: MonotonicMs,
        value: OfflinePolicy,
    ) -> Result<ClockRevision, String> {
        self.ensure_mutable(now, false)?;
        let anchor = map_clock_error(set_offline_policy(self.anchor, now, value), &mut self.fault)?;
        self.replace_anchor(anchor, false);
        Ok(anchor.revision())
    }

    pub(crate) const fn dirty_revision(&self) -> Option<ClockRevision> {
        self.dirty_revision
    }

    fn ensure_mutable(
        &mut self,
        now: MonotonicMs,
        recovers_range_fault: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.observe(now);
        match self.fault {
            Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted) => {
                Err(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted.code().to_owned())
            }
            Some(ClockFault::TimeRangeExhausted) if !recovers_range_fault => Err(
                "clock is paused after time_range_exhausted; set a supported date or switch to real_time".to_owned(),
            ),
            _ => Ok(()),
        }
    }

    fn replace_anchor(&mut self, anchor: ClockAnchor, clear_fault: bool) {
        self.anchor = anchor;
        self.last_valid_world_time = anchor.world_utc_ms();
        if clear_fault {
            self.fault = None;
        }
        self.dirty_revision = Some(anchor.revision());
    }

    fn pause_on_range_exhaustion(&mut self, now: MonotonicMs) -> ClockFault {
        if let Some(fault) = self.fault {
            return fault;
        }
        let revision = match self.anchor.revision().checked_next() {
            Ok(value) => value,
            Err(_) => {
                self.fault = Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted);
                return ClockFault::RevisionExhausted;
            }
        };
        let anchor = ClockAnchor::new(
            self.anchor.clock_id(),
            revision,
            ClockMode::TimeScale,
            self.last_valid_world_time,
            now,
            TimeScalePpm::PAUSED,
            self.anchor.offline_policy(),
        );
        match anchor {
            Ok(anchor) => {
                self.anchor = anchor;
                self.fault = Some(ClockFault::TimeRangeExhausted);
                self.dirty_revision = Some(anchor.revision());
                ClockFault::TimeRangeExhausted
            }
            Err(_) => {
                self.fault = Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted);
                ClockFault::RevisionExhausted
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn initial_saved_clock_state() -> Result<SavedClockState, String> {
    let world_utc = system_world_time_now()?;
    let monotonic = MonotonicMs::new(0);
    let anchor = ClockAnchor::initial(
        ClockMode::RealTime,
        world_utc,
        monotonic,
        TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
        OfflinePolicy::Pause,
    )
    .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    save_clock_state(anchor, monotonic, world_utc).map_err(|error| error.to_string())
}

fn map_clock_error(
    result: Result<ClockAnchor, TimeError>,
    fault: &mut Option<ClockFault>,
) -> Result<ClockAnchor, String> {
    result.map_err(|error| {
        if error == TimeError::RevisionExhausted {
            *fault = Some(ClockFault::RevisionExhausted);
        }
        error.to_string()
    })
}

fn system_world_time_now() -> Result<WorldTimeMs, String> {
    let elapsed = SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map_err(|_| "system clock is before the POSIX epoch".to_owned())?;
    let millis = i128::try_from(elapsed.as_millis())
        .map_err(|_| "system UTC milliseconds overflow i128".to_owned())?;
    let millis =
        i64::try_from(millis).map_err(|_| "system UTC milliseconds overflow i64".to_owned())?;
    WorldTimeMs::new(millis)
        .map_err(|error| format!("system UTC is outside supported range: {error}"))
}

fn mode_name(mode: ClockMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        ClockMode::RealTime => "real_time",
        ClockMode::TimeScale => "time_scale",
    }
}

fn policy_name(policy: OfflinePolicy) -> &'static str {
    match policy {
        OfflinePolicy::Pause => "pause",
        OfflinePolicy::Advance => "advance",
    }
}

fn format_scale(rate: TimeScalePpm) -> String {
    let whole = rate.get() / 1_000_000;
    let fraction = rate.get() % 1_000_000;
    format!("{whole}.{fraction:06}x")
}

fn format_correction(offset_ms: i128) -> String {
    format!("{offset_ms:+}")
}

fn nonce_hex(nonce: SessionNonce) -> String {
    let mut text = String::with_capacity(32);
    for byte in nonce.as_bytes() {
        use std::fmt::Write as _;
        let _ = write!(text, "{byte:02x}");
    }
    text
}

use minimium_environment::time::{ClockMode, OfflinePolicy, TimeScalePpm, WorldTimeMs};
use serde::Deserialize;
use std::{io, path::Path};

pub(crate) const MAX_CONFIG_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct EnvironmentConfig {
    pub(crate) mode: ClockMode,
    pub(crate) initial_utc: Option<WorldTimeMs>,
    pub(crate) scale_ppm: TimeScalePpm,
    pub(crate) offline_policy: OfflinePolicy,
}

impl Default for EnvironmentConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            mode: ClockMode::RealTime,
            initial_utc: None,
            scale_ppm: TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
            offline_policy: OfflinePolicy::Pause,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct EnvironmentConfigFile {
    schema_version: u8,
    #[serde(default)]
    mode: ConfigMode,
    #[serde(default)]
    initial_utc: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_scale_ppm")]
    scale_ppm: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    offline_policy: ConfigOfflinePolicy,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
enum ConfigMode {
    #[default]
    RealTime,
    TimeScale,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
enum ConfigOfflinePolicy {
    #[default]
    Pause,
    Advance,
}

pub(crate) fn load(path: &Path) -> io::Result<EnvironmentConfig> {
    let bytes = minimium_platform::files::read_bounded_file(path, MAX_CONFIG_BYTES)?;
    let source = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes).map_err(|_| {
        io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "environment config is not UTF-8",
        )
    })?;
    let raw: EnvironmentConfigFile = ron::from_str(source).map_err(|error| {
        io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!("environment config {}: {error}", path.display()),
        )
    })?;
    if raw.schema_version != 1 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "environment config schema_version must be 1",
        ));
    }
    let scale_ppm = TimeScalePpm::new(raw.scale_ppm).map_err(|error| {
        io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!("environment config: {error}"),
        )
    })?;
    if raw.scale_ppm != 0 && raw.scale_ppm < 100_000 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "environment config scale_ppm must be 0 or at least 100000 (0.1x)",
        ));
    }
    let initial_utc = raw
        .initial_utc
        .as_deref()
        .map(minimium_environment::parse_world_time_utc)
        .transpose()
        .map_err(|error| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, error))?;
    let mode = match raw.mode {
        ConfigMode::RealTime => ClockMode::RealTime,
        ConfigMode::TimeScale => ClockMode::TimeScale,
    };
    let offline_policy = match raw.offline_policy {
        ConfigOfflinePolicy::Pause => OfflinePolicy::Pause,
        ConfigOfflinePolicy::Advance => OfflinePolicy::Advance,
    };
    if mode == ClockMode::RealTime && initial_utc.is_some() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "real_time environment config must omit initial_utc",
        ));
    }
    if mode == ClockMode::RealTime && scale_ppm != TimeScalePpm::ONE_X {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "real_time environment config requires scale_ppm=1000000",
        ));
    }
    Ok(EnvironmentConfig {
        mode,
        initial_utc,
        scale_ppm,
        offline_policy,
    })
}

const fn default_scale_ppm() -> u64 {
    1_000_000
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/environment/profiles.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="12" bytes="513" original_lines="12" original_bytes="513" minified="false" sha256="fafd8174c12ed71486cdfe872bb8654331ab7cdba96011a4ffd1b688ef052465">>>
use minimium_environment::EnvironmentProfile;
use minimium_world::world::{WorldManifest, WorldTopology};

pub(crate) fn profile_for_manifest(manifest: WorldManifest) -> EnvironmentProfile {
    match manifest.topology() {
        WorldTopology::Dungeon => EnvironmentProfile::Interior,
        WorldTopology::Planet if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| planet.mode == 1) => {
            EnvironmentProfile::Earth
        }
        WorldTopology::Planet => EnvironmentProfile::EarthLike,
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/executor.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="148" bytes="5573" original_lines="148" original_bytes="5573" minified="false" sha256="9b2fddf8066efaa75c09860f85bbe55b4bc33a8877002e535bd9554ca4958ec5">>>
use minimium_telemetry::allocations;
use std::{
    sync::{
        mpsc::{self, SyncSender},
        Arc, Mutex,
    },
    thread::{self, JoinHandle},
};

type Job = Box<dyn FnOnce() + Send + 'static>;

pub struct Executor {
    sender: Option<SyncSender<Job>>,
    workers: Vec<JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Executor {
    /// `lanes` counts the main server lane. One lane executes work inline;
    /// additional lanes are persistent worker threads.
    pub fn new(lanes: usize) -> Self {
        let worker_count = lanes.saturating_sub(1);
        if worker_count == 0 {
            return Self {
                sender: None,
                workers: Vec::new(),
            };
        }
        let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel::<Job>(worker_count.saturating_mul(2).max(1));
        let receiver = Arc::new(Mutex::new(receiver));
        let mut workers = Vec::with_capacity(worker_count);
        for index in 0..worker_count {
            let receiver = Arc::clone(&receiver);
            let thread = thread::Builder::new()
                .name(format!("minimium-worker-{index}"))
                .spawn(move || loop {
                    let job = receiver.lock().expect("worker queue poisoned").recv();
                    match job {
                        Ok(job) => job(),
                        Err(_) => break,
                    }
                })
                .expect("failed to create worker thread");
            workers.push(thread);
        }
        Self {
            sender: Some(sender),
            workers,
        }
    }

    pub fn lane_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.workers.len() + 1
    }

    pub fn map<T, R, F>(&self, items: Vec<T>, operation: F) -> Vec<R>
    where
        T: Send + 'static,
        R: Send + 'static,
        F: Fn(T) -> R + Send + Sync + 'static,
    {
        let phase = allocations::current_phase();
        let Some(sender) = &self.sender else {
            return items.into_iter().map(operation).collect();
        };
        let count = items.len();
        if count <= 1 {
            return items.into_iter().map(operation).collect();
        }
        if count <= self.lane_count() {
            let operation = Arc::new(operation);
            let (result_sender, result_receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel(count - 1);
            let mut items = items.into_iter();
            let first_item = items.next().expect("non-empty item list");
            for (index, item) in (1..count).zip(items) {
                let operation = Arc::clone(&operation);
                let result_sender = result_sender.clone();
                sender
                    .send(Box::new(move || {
                        let _phase = allocations::enter(phase);
                        let result = operation(item);
                        let _ = result_sender.send((index, result));
                    }))
                    .expect("worker pool stopped unexpectedly");
            }
            drop(result_sender);
            let mut results: Vec<Option<R>> = (0..count).map(|_| None).collect();
            results[0] = Some(operation(first_item));
            for (index, result) in result_receiver {
                results[index] = Some(result);
            }
            return results
                .into_iter()
                .map(|result| result.expect("worker omitted a result"))
                .collect();
        }

        // Schedule one batch per lane instead of allocating and dispatching one
        // boxed closure for every item. This keeps small servers from paying
        // more synchronization and allocation cost than the work itself.
        let batch_count = (self.workers.len() + 1).min(count);
        let mut batches: Vec<Vec<(usize, T)>> = (0..batch_count)
            .map(|_| Vec::with_capacity(count.div_ceil(batch_count)))
            .collect();
        for (index, item) in items.into_iter().enumerate() {
            batches[index % batch_count].push((index, item));
        }

        let operation = Arc::new(operation);
        let (result_sender, result_receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel(batch_count - 1);
        for batch in batches.drain(1..) {
            let operation = Arc::clone(&operation);
            let result_sender = result_sender.clone();
            sender
                .send(Box::new(move || {
                    let _phase = allocations::enter(phase);
                    let results: Vec<_> = batch
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|(index, item)| (index, operation(item)))
                        .collect();
                    let _ = result_sender.send(results);
                }))
                .expect("worker pool stopped unexpectedly");
        }
        drop(result_sender);
        let mut results: Vec<Option<R>> = (0..count).map(|_| None).collect();
        for (index, item) in batches[0].drain(..) {
            results[index] = Some(operation(item));
        }
        for batch in result_receiver {
            for (index, result) in batch {
                results[index] = Some(result);
            }
        }
        results
            .into_iter()
            .map(|result| result.expect("worker omitted a result"))
            .collect()
    }
}

impl Drop for Executor {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.sender.take();
        for worker in self.workers.drain(..) {
            let _ = worker.join();
        }
    }
}

/// Parses server arguments and runs the runtime with application-owned content.
pub fn run(
    args: &[String],
    composition: ServerComposition,
) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    if args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--help" || arg == "-h") {
        println!(
            "minimium-server run [--seed DECIMAL|0xHEX] [--planet-config PATH] \\
             [--environment-config PATH] [--climate-scenario PATH] [--climate-relief-influence 0..1] [--threads 1..64|auto] [--max-players N] \\
             [--material-package PATH] [--material-http-port PORT] \\
             [--bind IP] [--game-port PORT] [--data-dir PATH] \\
             [--map PATH | --world-definition PATH] [--autosave-seconds N] [--headless]\n\\
             minimium-server --version\n\\
             --max-players defaults to {MAX_PLAYERS}; --game-port 0 selects an available port (default); \\
             --autosave-seconds 0 disables periodic saves (default: {DEFAULT_AUTOSAVE_SECONDS}); \\
             --environment-config initializes clock mode/date/scale for a new world only; \\
             --headless disables stdin commands; administer with minimiumctl."
        );
        return Ok(());
    }
    if args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--version") {
        println!("minimium-server {}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
        return Ok(());
    }
    let config = config::ServerConfig::parse(args)?;
    commands::initialize_modules();
    let startup = startup::initialize(&config, composition.world_composer)?;
    runtime::ServerRuntime::new(config, startup, composition.combat)?.run()?;
    Ok(())
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/lifecycle.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="218" bytes="7236" original_lines="218" original_bytes="7236" minified="false" sha256="aa9d417bb5ba9670a02b97c77dbf4f87c21b51d5ae1d03a085387e5c7bda8da1">>>
use crate::{
    admin::AdminServer,
    connection::Client,
    environment::EnvironmentClock,
    storage::{compact_error, PersistenceWorker, PlayerStore},
    world_registry::WorldRegistry,
};
use minimium_environment::time::MonotonicMs;
use minimium_platform::{
    admin_client::{SHUTDOWN_FILE, SHUTDOWN_OWNER_FILE},
    endpoint::ServerEndpoint,
    files::atomic_replace_file,
};
use std::{
    fs::{self, File},
    io::{self, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

pub(crate) struct ShutdownContext<'a> {
    pub admin: &'a mut AdminServer,
    pub clients: &'a mut [Client],
    pub player_store: &'a mut PlayerStore,
    pub persistence: &'a mut PersistenceWorker,
    pub environment_clock: &'a mut EnvironmentClock,
    pub server_started: Instant,
    pub worlds: &'a WorldRegistry,
    pub map_fingerprint: u64,
    pub endpoint: &'a ServerEndpoint,
    pub data_dir: &'a Path,
    pub runtime_error: Option<io::Error>,
}

pub(crate) fn shutdown(mut context: ShutdownContext<'_>) -> io::Result<()> {
    drain_admin_requests(context.admin, &mut context.runtime_error);
    close_client_sockets(context.clients);
    let snapshot = capture_final_snapshot(
        context.server_started,
        context.environment_clock,
        context.worlds,
        context.map_fingerprint,
        context.player_store,
    );
    let save_result = persist_final_snapshot(context.persistence, snapshot);
    finish_shutdown(
        context.data_dir,
        context.endpoint,
        context.runtime_error,
        save_result,
    )
}

fn drain_admin_requests(admin: &mut AdminServer, runtime_error: &mut Option<io::Error>) {
    admin.reject_pending("server stopping");
    let drain_deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(2);
    while admin.has_pending_output() && Instant::now() < drain_deadline {
        match admin.poll(Instant::now()) {
            Ok(requests) => {
                for request in requests {
                    admin.respond(request.id, false, "server stopping");
                }
            }
            Err(error) => {
                runtime_error.get_or_insert(error);
                break;
            }
        }
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
}

fn close_client_sockets(clients: &mut [Client]) {
    for client in clients {
        let _ = client.stream.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Both);
    }
}

fn capture_final_snapshot(
    server_started: Instant,
    environment_clock: &mut EnvironmentClock,
    worlds: &WorldRegistry,
    map_fingerprint: u64,
    player_store: &mut PlayerStore,
) -> io::Result<crate::storage::SaveSnapshot> {
    let capture_at = Instant::now();
    let monotonic_ms = u64::try_from(
        capture_at
            .saturating_duration_since(server_started)
            .as_millis(),
    )
    .map(MonotonicMs::new)
    .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "server monotonic time overflow"));
    let snapshot = monotonic_ms
        .and_then(|at| {
            environment_clock.capture_saved_state(at).map_err(|error| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    format!("environment clock: {error}"),
                )
            })
        })
        .and_then(|saved_clock| {
            let input = worlds.snapshot_for_save(map_fingerprint)?;
            player_store.save_snapshot(input, saved_clock)
        });
    snapshot
}

fn persist_final_snapshot(
    persistence: &mut PersistenceWorker,
    snapshot: io::Result<crate::storage::SaveSnapshot>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    match snapshot {
        Ok(snapshot) => persistence.shutdown(Some(snapshot)),
        Err(error) => {
            if let Err(cleanup_error) = persistence.shutdown(None) {
                eprintln!("storage shutdown after snapshot failure: {cleanup_error}");
            }
            Err(error)
        }
    }
}

fn finish_shutdown(
    data_dir: &Path,
    endpoint: &ServerEndpoint,
    runtime_error: Option<io::Error>,
    save_result: io::Result<()>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let endpoint_result = endpoint.remove_if_owned(data_dir);
    let mut primary_error = runtime_error;
    for (operation, result) in [
        ("final save", save_result),
        ("endpoint cleanup", endpoint_result),
    ] {
        if let Err(error) = result {
            if primary_error.is_some() {
                eprintln!("{operation} also failed: {error}");
            } else {
                primary_error = Some(error);
            }
        }
    }
    let shutdown_result = primary_error.map_or(Ok(()), Err);
    let status_result = write_shutdown_status(data_dir, endpoint, &shutdown_result);
    if let Err(error) = &status_result {
        if shutdown_result.is_err() {
            eprintln!("shutdown status write also failed: {error}");
        }
    }
    shutdown_result?;
    status_result?;
    println!("server stopped cleanly");
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn remove_if_exists(path: &std::path::Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    match fs::remove_file(path) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn write_shutdown_status(
    data_dir: &std::path::Path,
    endpoint: &ServerEndpoint,
    result: &io::Result<()>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let admin_port = endpoint.admin_port;
    let path = data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_FILE);
    let temporary_path = data_dir.join("server.shutdown.tmp");
    let write_result = (|| {
        let mut file = File::create(&temporary_path)?;
        match result {
            Ok(()) => writeln!(file, "{admin_port}\tOK")?,
            Err(error) => writeln!(file, "{admin_port}\tERR\t{}", compact_error(error))?,
        }
        file.sync_all()?;
        // Keep the legacy status body; a private sidecar binds it to the full instance token.
        let owner_path = data_dir.join("server.shutdown.owner.tmp");
        let mut options = std::fs::OpenOptions::new();
        options.write(true).create(true).truncate(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            options.mode(0o600);
        }
        let mut owner = options.open(owner_path)?;
        writeln!(owner, "{}", endpoint.token)?;
        owner.sync_all()?;
        drop(owner);
        atomic_replace_file(
            &data_dir.join("server.shutdown.owner.tmp"),
            &data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_OWNER_FILE),
        )?;
        atomic_replace_file(&temporary_path, &path)?;
        Ok(())
    })();
    if write_result.is_err() {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(temporary_path);
    }
    write_result
}

pub(crate) struct EndpointGuard {
    pub(crate) data_dir: PathBuf,
    pub(crate) endpoint: ServerEndpoint,
}
impl Drop for EndpointGuard {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Err(error) = self.endpoint.remove_if_owned(&self.data_dir) {
            eprintln!("could not remove server endpoint: {error}");
        }
    }
}

impl RuntimeMetrics {
    pub(crate) fn sample_process_memory(&mut self, now: Instant) {
        if self.memory_sampled_at.is_some_and(|sampled_at| {
            now.saturating_duration_since(sampled_at) < Duration::from_secs(1)
        }) {
            return;
        }
        self.memory_sampled_at = Some(now);
        let sample = self.process_sampler.sample(now);
        self.process_cpu_time = sample.cpu_time;
        self.process_threads = sample.threads;
        self.memory_rss_bytes = sample.rss_bytes;
        self.memory_private_bytes = sample.private_bytes;
        if let Some(rss_bytes) = sample.rss_bytes {
            self.memory_samples = self.memory_samples.saturating_add(1);
            self.memory_rss_bytes = Some(rss_bytes);
            self.memory_peak_rss_bytes = Some(
                self.memory_peak_rss_bytes
                    .unwrap_or_default()
                    .max(rss_bytes),
            );
        }
        if let Some(private_bytes) = sample.private_bytes {
            self.memory_private_bytes = Some(private_bytes);
            self.memory_peak_private_bytes = Some(
                self.memory_peak_private_bytes
                    .unwrap_or_default()
                    .max(private_bytes),
            );
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_collision_queries(&mut self, stats: CollisionQueryStats) {
        self.collision_queries = self.collision_queries.saturating_add(stats.queries);
        self.collision_cell_visits = self.collision_cell_visits.saturating_add(stats.cell_visits);
        self.collision_aabb_candidates = self
            .collision_aabb_candidates
            .saturating_add(stats.aabb_candidates);
        self.collision_triangle_candidates = self
            .collision_triangle_candidates
            .saturating_add(stats.triangle_candidates);
        self.collision_fallback_queries = self
            .collision_fallback_queries
            .saturating_add(stats.fallback_queries);
        self.collision_max_cell_visits = self.collision_max_cell_visits.max(stats.max_cell_visits);
        self.collision_max_aabb_candidates = self
            .collision_max_aabb_candidates
            .max(stats.max_aabb_candidates);
        self.collision_max_triangle_candidates = self
            .collision_max_triangle_candidates
            .max(stats.max_triangle_candidates);
    }

        if batched {

            self.precise_batches = self.precise_batches.saturating_add(batches as u64);

    }

        let collision_query_count = self.collision_queries.max(1) as f64;
        let rss_average_per_player = (players > 0)
            .then(|| self.memory_rss_bytes.map(|bytes| bytes / players as u64))
            .flatten();
        let mut summary = format!(
            "ticks={} missed_ticks={} snapshots={} missed_snapshots={} players={} bytes_in={} bytes_out={} decoded_frames={} queued_frames={} dropped_messages={} dropped_snapshots={} rejected_inputs={} clock_probe_requests={} clock_probe_accepted={} clock_probe_rejected={} environment_sync_messages={} idle_timeouts={} handshake_timeouts={} shots_fired={} shots_hit={} player_kills={} tick_last_us={} tick_avg_us={} tick_p95_us={} tick_p99_us={} loop_avg_us={} loop_p95_us={} loop_p99_us={} network_avg_us={} network_p95_us={} network_p99_us={} input_avg_us={} input_p95_us={} input_p99_us={} simulation_avg_us={} simulation_p95_us={} simulation_p99_us={} snapshot_avg_us={} snapshot_p95_us={} snapshot_p99_us={} encoding_avg_us={} encoding_p95_us={} encoding_p99_us={} input_wait_avg_us={} input_wait_p95_us={} input_wait_p99_us={} oldest_output_age_us={} collision_queries={} collision_cells={} collision_cells_per_query={:.2} collision_max_cells_per_query={} collision_aabb_candidates={} collision_aabb_candidates_per_query={:.2} collision_max_aabb_candidates_per_query={} collision_triangle_candidates={} collision_triangle_candidates_per_query={:.2} collision_max_triangle_candidates_per_query={} collision_full_scan_queries={} precise_serial_steps={} precise_batched_steps={} precise_batches={} max_pending_inputs={} max_client_input_bytes={} max_client_output_bytes={} memory_samples={} memory_rss_bytes={} memory_peak_rss_bytes={} memory_private_bytes={} memory_peak_private_bytes={} memory_rss_average_per_player_bytes={} process_cpu_time_ms={} process_threads={}",
            self.ticks, self.missed_ticks, self.snapshots, self.missed_snapshots, players,

            self.dropped_messages, self.dropped_snapshots, self.rejected_inputs,

//! Static, composable registration of engine capabilities.
//! Registration is explicit at startup; neither the wire protocol nor a Rust ABI
//! is extended implicitly by installing a module.
use minimium_world::entity::ComponentDescriptor;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ModuleDescriptor {
    pub id: &'static str,
    pub version: u32,
    pub requires: &'static [&'static str],
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CommandScope {
    ClientLocal,
    ServerAdmin,
    PlayerAction,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Ord, PartialOrd)]
pub enum Stage {
    Startup,
    FixedUpdate,
    Environment,
    RenderPreparation,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ModuleError {
    DuplicateModule,
    MissingDependency,
    InvalidDescriptor,
    InvalidCommand,
    DuplicateCommand,
    DuplicateSystem,
    DuplicateComponent,
}

/// Hosts provide their own handler types. A command handler need not know the
/// resources or privileges belonging to a different host/runtime.
pub struct CommandDefinition<H> {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub aliases: &'static [&'static str],
    pub usage: &'static str,
    pub scope: CommandScope,
    pub handler: H,
}

pub struct SystemDefinition<S> {
    pub id: &'static str,
    pub stage: Stage,
    pub handler: S,
}

pub struct RegisteredCommand<H> {
    pub module: &'static str,
    pub definition: CommandDefinition<H>,
}

pub struct RegisteredSystem<S> {
    pub module: &'static str,
    pub definition: SystemDefinition<S>,
}

pub struct RegisteredComponent {
    pub module: &'static str,
    pub descriptor: ComponentDescriptor,
}

pub struct ModuleRegistry<H, S> {
    modules: BTreeMap<&'static str, ModuleDescriptor>,
    commands: Vec<RegisteredCommand<H>>,
    systems: Vec<RegisteredSystem<S>>,
    components: Vec<RegisteredComponent>,
}

impl<H, S> Default for ModuleRegistry<H, S> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            modules: BTreeMap::new(),
            commands: Vec::new(),
            systems: Vec::new(),
            components: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

pub trait EngineModule<H, S> {
    fn descriptor(&self) -> ModuleDescriptor;
    fn register(&self, registrar: &mut ModuleRegistrar<'_, H, S>) -> Result<(), ModuleError>;
}

pub struct ModuleRegistrar<'a, H, S> {
    module: &'static str,
    existing_commands: &'a [RegisteredCommand<H>],
    existing_systems: &'a [RegisteredSystem<S>],
    existing_components: &'a [RegisteredComponent],
    commands: Vec<RegisteredCommand<H>>,
    systems: Vec<RegisteredSystem<S>>,
    components: Vec<RegisteredComponent>,
}

fn valid_path(name: &str) -> bool {
    !name.is_empty()
        && name.len() <= 96
        && name.split(' ').all(|part| {
            !part.is_empty()
                && part
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|c| c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit() || c == b'_' || c == b'-')
        })
}

impl<H, S> ModuleRegistrar<'_, H, S> {
    pub fn command(&mut self, definition: CommandDefinition<H>) -> Result<(), ModuleError> {
        let names = std::iter::once(definition.name).chain(definition.aliases.iter().copied());
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for name in names {
            if !valid_path(name) {
                return Err(ModuleError::InvalidCommand);
            }
            let clash = self
                .existing_commands
                .iter()
                .chain(self.commands.iter())
                .any(|entry| {
                    std::iter::once(entry.definition.name)
                        .chain(entry.definition.aliases.iter().copied())
                        .any(|registered| registered == name)
                });
            if clash || !seen.insert(name) {
                return Err(ModuleError::DuplicateCommand);
            }
        }
        self.commands.push(RegisteredCommand {
            module: self.module,
            definition,
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn component(&mut self, descriptor: ComponentDescriptor) -> Result<(), ModuleError> {
        if self
            .existing_components
            .iter()
            .chain(self.components.iter())
            .any(|entry| {
                entry.descriptor.id == descriptor.id || entry.descriptor.name == descriptor.name
            })
        {
            return Err(ModuleError::DuplicateComponent);
        }
        self.components.push(RegisteredComponent {
            module: self.module,
            descriptor,
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn system(&mut self, definition: SystemDefinition<S>) -> Result<(), ModuleError> {
        if !valid_path(definition.id)
            || self
                .existing_systems
                .iter()
                .chain(self.systems.iter())
                .any(|entry| entry.definition.id == definition.id)
        {
            return Err(ModuleError::DuplicateSystem);
        }
        self.systems.push(RegisteredSystem {
            module: self.module,
            definition,
        });
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl<H, S> ModuleRegistry<H, S> {
    /// Installation is transactional: errors leave the live registry unchanged.
    /// Dependencies must already have been installed, establishing a DAG order.
    pub fn install<M: EngineModule<H, S>>(&mut self, module: &M) -> Result<(), ModuleError> {
        let descriptor = module.descriptor();
        if !valid_path(descriptor.id)
            || descriptor.version == 0
            || descriptor
                .requires
                .iter()
                .any(|dependency| !valid_path(dependency))
        {
            return Err(ModuleError::InvalidDescriptor);
        }
        if self.modules.contains_key(descriptor.id) {
            return Err(ModuleError::DuplicateModule);
        }
        if descriptor
            .requires
            .iter()
            .any(|dependency| !self.modules.contains_key(dependency))
        {
            return Err(ModuleError::MissingDependency);
        }
        let mut staging = ModuleRegistrar {
            module: descriptor.id,
            existing_commands: &self.commands,
            existing_systems: &self.systems,
            existing_components: &self.components,
            components: Vec::new(),
            commands: Vec::new(),
            systems: Vec::new(),
        };
        module.register(&mut staging)?;
        let ModuleRegistrar {
            commands,
            systems,
            components,
            ..
        } = staging;
        self.modules.insert(descriptor.id, descriptor);
        self.commands.extend(commands);
        self.systems.extend(systems);
        self.components.extend(components);
        self.systems.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.definition.stage);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn modules(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &ModuleDescriptor> {
        self.modules.values()
    }

    pub fn commands(&self) -> &[RegisteredCommand<H>] {
        &self.commands
    }

    pub fn components(&self) -> &[RegisteredComponent] {
        &self.components
    }

    pub fn systems(&self) -> &[RegisteredSystem<S>] {
        &self.systems
    }

    /// Longest path wins: `world inspect` takes priority over `world`.
    /// Arguments are never evaluated as code and remain caller-owned slices.
    pub fn resolve<'a>(&self, line: &'a str) -> Option<(&RegisteredCommand<H>, Vec<&'a str>)> {
        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
        self.commands
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|entry| {
                std::iter::once(entry.definition.name)
                    .chain(entry.definition.aliases.iter().copied())
                    .filter_map(|name| {
                        let command_parts: Vec<&str> = name.split_whitespace().collect();
                        (parts.starts_with(&command_parts)).then_some((entry, command_parts.len()))
                    })
                    .max_by_key(|(_, len)| *len)
            })
            .max_by_key(|(_, len)| *len)
            .map(|(entry, len)| (entry, parts[len..].to_vec()))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    struct SampleModule {
        id: &'static str,
        requires: &'static [&'static str],
        command: &'static str,
    }

    impl EngineModule<(), ()> for SampleModule {
        fn descriptor(&self) -> ModuleDescriptor {
            ModuleDescriptor {
                id: self.id,
                version: 1,
                requires: self.requires,
            }
        }

        fn register(&self, registrar: &mut ModuleRegistrar<'_, (), ()>) -> Result<(), ModuleError> {
            registrar.command(CommandDefinition {
                name: self.command,
                aliases: &[],
                usage: self.command,
                scope: CommandScope::ServerAdmin,
                handler: (),
            })
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn installation_is_transactional_and_rejects_dependency_and_name_collisions() {
        let mut registry: ModuleRegistry<(), ()> = ModuleRegistry::default();
        let first = SampleModule {
            id: "first",
            requires: &[],
            command: "world list",
        };
        let dependent = SampleModule {
            id: "second",
            requires: &["first"],
            command: "world inspect",
        };
        assert_eq!(
            registry.install(&dependent),
            Err(ModuleError::MissingDependency)
        );
        assert_eq!(registry.modules().count(), 0);
        registry.install(&first).unwrap();
        let collision = SampleModule {
            id: "third",
            requires: &[],
            command: "world list",
        };
        assert_eq!(
            registry.install(&collision),
            Err(ModuleError::DuplicateCommand)
        );
        assert_eq!(registry.modules().count(), 1);
        registry.install(&dependent).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(registry.resolve("world inspect 12").unwrap().1, vec!["12"]);
    }
}
