<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/receive.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="103" bytes="4164" original_lines="103" original_bytes="4164" minified="false" sha256="7b2a8bb4f4bcd5d1f0ccf74b1442ac168836036162a0a84b03bfa3fdd2906f2e">>>
use crate::{
    connection::{queue_close_response, Client, CloseReason},
    metrics::RuntimeMetrics,
};
use minimium_protocol::{
    decode_client, ClientMessage, ProtocolError, ServerErrorCode, ServerMessage, MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
};
use std::{
    io::{self, Read},
    time::Instant,
};

const MAX_READ_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL: usize = 1024;
const MAX_MESSAGES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL: usize = 32;

pub(crate) fn poll_clients(
    clients: &mut [Client],
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
    messages: &mut Vec<(usize, ClientMessage, Instant)>,
    disconnected: &mut Vec<usize>,
) {
    for (index, client) in clients.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        if client.close_deadline().is_some() || client.peer_eof {
            continue;
        }
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 2048];
        let mut bytes_this_poll = 0usize;
        let mut messages_this_poll = 0usize;
        loop {
            // Drain buffered frames before reading: a previous poll may have
            // yielded with complete frames still in the input buffer.
            loop {
                match decode_client(&client.input) {
                    Ok(Some((message, frame_bytes))) => {
                        client.input.drain(..frame_bytes);
                        client.last_message_at = Instant::now();
                        messages_this_poll += 1;
                        metrics.frames_in += 1;
                        client.frames_in += 1;
                        messages.push((index, message, Instant::now()));
                        if messages_this_poll >= MAX_MESSAGES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(None) => break,
                    Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedVersion(_)) => {
                        if !queue_close_response(
                            client,
                            metrics,
                            ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::Protocol),
                            Instant::now(),
                        ) {
                            disconnected.push(index);
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    Err(_) => {
                        client.disconnect_reason = Some(CloseReason::InvalidFrame);
                        disconnected.push(index);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if client.close_deadline().is_some()
                || messages_this_poll >= MAX_MESSAGES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL
                || disconnected.last() == Some(&index)
            {
                break;
            }
            if client.input.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
                client.disconnect_reason = Some(CloseReason::InvalidFrame);
                disconnected.push(index);
                break;
            }
            let available =
                (MAX_READ_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL - bytes_this_poll).min(buffer.len());
            if available == 0 {
                break;
            }
            match client.stream.read(&mut buffer[..available]) {
                Ok(0) => {
                    // TCP half-close is legal: dispatch complete frames already
                    // decoded from this stream, then drain queued replies.
                    client.peer_eof = true;
                    break;
                }
                Ok(count) => {
                    bytes_this_poll += count;
                    metrics.bytes_in += count as u64;
                    client.bytes_in += count as u64;
                    client.input.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
                }
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                Err(_) => {
                    client.disconnect_reason = Some(CloseReason::ReadError);
                    disconnected.push(index);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Reads bounded component candidates into staging metrics without creating wire messages.
#[expect(
    dead_code,
    reason = "component candidate collection awaits replication opt-in"
)]
pub(crate) fn collect_component_candidates(
    worlds: &WorldRegistry,
    registry: &ComponentRegistry,
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
) {
    for (instance, _) in worlds.iter() {
        if let Ok((candidates, filtered)) = worlds.replication_candidates(instance, registry) {
            metrics.record_component_candidates(candidates.len(), filtered);
        }
    }
}
use std::{
    collections::BTreeMap,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

pub(crate) fn advance_deadline(
    next: &mut Instant,
    interval: Duration,
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
) {
    *next += interval;
    let now = Instant::now();
    if now > *next + interval {
        let late_by = now.duration_since(*next).as_nanos();
        metrics.missed_snapshots = metrics
            .missed_snapshots
            .saturating_add((late_by / interval.as_nanos()) as u64);
        *next = now + interval;
    }
}

pub(crate) fn replicate_snapshots(
    worlds: &WorldRegistry,
    executor: &Executor,
    clients: &mut [Client],
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
    server_time_ms: u64,
) {
    let mut recipients: BTreeMap<
        WorldInstanceId,
        Vec<(usize, PlayerId, minimium_protocol::WorldContext)>,
    > = BTreeMap::new();
    for (index, client) in clients.iter().enumerate() {
        if client.close_deadline().is_some() {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(player) = client.player_id() {
            if let (Some(instance), Some(context)) = (
                worlds.instance_for_player(player),
                worlds.context_for_player(player),
            ) {
                recipients
                    .entry(instance)
                    .or_default()
                    .push((index, player, context));
            }
        }
    }
    for (instance, world_recipients) in recipients {
        let Some(world) = worlds.get(instance).map(|owner| &owner.world) else {
            continue;
        };
        let snapshot = world.network_snapshot();
        let snapshots = executor.map(world_recipients, move |(index, recipient, context)| {
            let character_state = snapshot.character_state(recipient).unwrap_or_default();
            let mut players = RemotePlayers::default();
            snapshot.visit_nearby::<MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS>(
                recipient,
                MAX_VISIBLE_PLAYERS,
                |player| {
                    let _ = players.push(RemotePlayer {
                        id: player.id,
                        name: player.name.clone(),
                        position: player.position,
                        position_mm: player.position_mm.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                            minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(
                                player
                                    .position
                                    .map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                            )
                        }),
                    });
                },
            );
            let position_mm = snapshot
                .position_mm(recipient)
                .unwrap_or(minimium_world::world::Position3Mm([0; 3]));
            (index, context, character_state, position_mm, players)
        });
        for (recipient, context, character_state, position_mm, current_players) in snapshots {
            if let Some(client) = clients.get_mut(recipient) {
                let full_snapshot = !client.replication_initialized;
                let (players, removed_players) = if full_snapshot {
                    (current_players.clone(), RemotePlayerIds::default())
                } else {
                    diff_remote_players(&client.replicated_players, &current_players)
                };
                let message = ServerMessage::Snapshot {
                    server_time_ms,
                    context,
                    full_snapshot,
                    self_position: character_state.position,
                    self_position_mm: position_mm,
                    self_velocity: character_state.velocity,
                    self_grounded: character_state.grounded,
                    players: Box::new(players),
                    removed_players,
                };
                if queue_message(client, metrics, message) {
                    client.replicated_players = current_players;
                    client.replication_initialized = true;
                } else {
                    metrics.dropped_snapshots = metrics.dropped_snapshots.saturating_add(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn diff_remote_players(
    previous: &RemotePlayers,
    current: &RemotePlayers,
) -> (RemotePlayers, RemotePlayerIds) {
    let mut changed = RemotePlayers::default();
    for player in current.iter() {
        let differs = previous
            .get(player.id)
            .is_none_or(|old| old.name != player.name || old.position_mm != player.position_mm);
        if differs {
            let _ = changed.push(player.clone());
        }
    }

    let mut removed = RemotePlayerIds::default();
    for previous_player in previous.iter() {
        if current.get(previous_player.id).is_none() {
            let _ = removed.push(previous_player.id);
        }
    }
    (changed, removed)
}

    pending_departures: HashSet<PlayerProfileId>,

    input_last_received: HashMap<PlayerId, Instant>,
    last_global_chat_at: Option<Instant>,

    clients: Vec<Client>,
    client_indices_by_player: HashMap<PlayerId, usize>,
    first_write_client: usize,
    messages: Vec<(usize, ClientMessage, Instant)>,
    disconnected: Vec<usize>,
}

pub(crate) struct ServerRuntime {
    content: crate::content::ContentServer,
    executor: Executor,
    schedule: schedule::ServerSchedule,
    game: GameState,
    environment_clock: EnvironmentClock,
    connections: ConnectionState,
    operations: OperationsState,
    scheduler: Scheduler,
    metrics: RuntimeMetrics,
    map: WorldMap,
    prepared_geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
    game_listener: TcpListener,
    game_address: SocketAddr,
    endpoint: ServerEndpoint,
    data_dir: PathBuf,
    max_players: usize,
    max_client_connections: usize,
    lanes: usize,
    combat: CombatSettings,
    shot_cooldown: Duration,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    environment_dirty_revision: Option<ClockRevision>,
    autosave_seconds: u64,
    stop: bool,
    // Endpoint must be removed while the data lock is still held.
    _endpoint_guard: EndpointGuard,
    _data_lock: ServerDataLock,
}

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        config: ServerConfig,
        startup: Startup,
        combat: ServerCombatConfig,
    ) -> io::Result<Self> {
        let content = crate::content::ContentServer::new(&config)?;
        let lanes = config.lanes.count();
        let Startup {
            map,
            worlds,
            player_store,
            persistence,
            next_player,
            game_listener,
            game_address,
            endpoint,
            endpoint_guard,
            data_lock,
            admin,
            environment_config,
            saved_clock,
            prepared_geography,
        } = startup;
        println!("Minimium server started: game={}:{} admin=127.0.0.1:{} players={} lanes={lanes} autosave={}s map={:016x}", config.bind_address, endpoint.game_port, endpoint.admin_port, config.max_players, config.autosave_seconds, map.fingerprint());
        println!(
            "Admin CLI: minimiumctl --data-dir {} status",
            config.data_dir.display()
        );
        let console_rx = if config.console_enabled {
            println!("Type `help` for server commands.");
            Some(terminal::spawn()?)
        } else {
            None
        };
        let executor = Executor::new(lanes);
        let mut worlds = worlds
            .map(WorldRegistry::try_from_world_definitions)
            .transpose()
            .map_err(|error| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    format!("generated world registry is invalid: {error:?}"),
                )
            })?
            .unwrap_or_else(|| WorldRegistry::legacy_primary(map.clone()));
        worlds
            .restore_sector_states(player_store.sector_states())
            .map_err(|error| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    format!("saved sector state is incompatible with loaded worlds: {error:?}"),
                )
            })?;
        let max_client_connections = config.max_players + MAX_PENDING_HANDSHAKES;
        let game = GameState {
            worlds,
            sectors: minimium_sectors::SectorManager::new(32_768, 32_768)
                .expect("sector cache and queue capacities are valid"),
            active_sector_tickets: HashMap::with_capacity(config.max_players),
            transfer_sector_tickets: HashMap::with_capacity(config.max_players),
            pending_world_inputs: Vec::new(),
            pending_departures: HashSet::new(),
            active_inputs: HashMap::with_capacity(config.max_players),
            input_last_received: HashMap::with_capacity(config.max_players),
            last_global_chat_at: None,
        };
        let connections = ConnectionState {
            clients: Vec::with_capacity(max_client_connections),
            client_indices_by_player: HashMap::with_capacity(config.max_players),
            first_write_client: 0,
            messages: Vec::with_capacity(max_client_connections),
            disconnected: Vec::with_capacity(max_client_connections),
        };
        let operations = OperationsState {
            admin,
            console_rx,
            command_queue: VecDeque::with_capacity(64),
            player_store,
            persistence,
            next_player,
        };
        let metrics = RuntimeMetrics::default();
        let server_started = Instant::now();
        let environment_clock =
            EnvironmentClock::new(environment_config, saved_clock, server_started).map_err(
                |error| {
                    io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                        format!("environment clock: {error}"),
                    )
                },
            )?;
        let mut schedule = crate::commands::build_schedule();
        schedule.run_stage(crate::modules::Stage::Startup, &game.worlds);
        let autosave_interval = Duration::from_secs(config.autosave_seconds);
        Ok(Self {
            game,
            content,
            schedule,
            environment_clock,
            connections,
            operations,
            scheduler: Scheduler {
                server_started,
                next_utc_check: server_started + Duration::from_secs(5),
                next_tick: server_started + TICK,
                next_snapshot: Instant::now() + SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL,
                next_autosave: (!autosave_interval.is_zero())
                    .then_some(server_started + autosave_interval),
                autosave_interval,
            },
            metrics,
            executor,
            map,
            prepared_geography,
            game_listener,
            game_address,
            endpoint,
            data_dir: config.data_dir,
            max_players: config.max_players,
            max_client_connections,
            lanes,
            combat: combat.hitscan,
            shot_cooldown: Duration::from_millis(combat.fire_cooldown_ms),
            environment_dirty_revision: None,
            autosave_seconds: config.autosave_seconds,
            stop: false,
            _endpoint_guard: endpoint_guard,
            _data_lock: data_lock,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn run(mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        let mut runtime_error = None;
        while !self.stop {
            let loop_started = match self.poll_operations() {
                Ok(started) => started,
                Err(error) => {
                    runtime_error = Some(error);
                    break;
                }
            };
            if let Err(error) = self.poll_network() {
                runtime_error = Some(error);
                break;
            }
            self.tick();
            self.schedule
                .run_stage(crate::modules::Stage::RenderPreparation, &self.game.worlds);
            self.replicate();
            self.metrics.loop_work.record(loop_started.elapsed());
            self.plan_sleep();
        }
        lifecycle::shutdown(lifecycle::ShutdownContext {
            admin: &mut self.operations.admin,
            clients: &mut self.connections.clients,
            player_store: &mut self.operations.player_store,
            persistence: &mut self.operations.persistence,
            environment_clock: &mut self.environment_clock,
            server_started: self.scheduler.server_started,
            worlds: &self.game.worlds,
            map_fingerprint: self.map.fingerprint(),
            endpoint: &self.endpoint,
            data_dir: &self.data_dir,
            runtime_error,
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn monotonic_ms(&self, now: Instant) -> io::Result<MonotonicMs> {
        let elapsed = now.saturating_duration_since(self.scheduler.server_started);
        let millis = u64::try_from(elapsed.as_millis()).map_err(|_| {
            io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "server monotonic time overflow")
        })?;
        Ok(MonotonicMs::new(millis))
    }

    fn plan_sleep(&self) {
        let poll_interval = if self.connections.clients.is_empty() {
            Duration::from_millis(50)
        } else {
            Duration::from_millis(8)
        };
        let now = Instant::now();
        let until_tick = self.scheduler.next_tick.saturating_duration_since(now);
        let until_snapshot = self.scheduler.next_snapshot.saturating_duration_since(now);
        let until_autosave = self
            .scheduler
            .next_autosave
            .map(|deadline| deadline.saturating_duration_since(now))
            .unwrap_or(Duration::MAX);
        thread::sleep(
            poll_interval
                .min(until_tick)
                .min(until_snapshot)
                .min(until_autosave),
        );
    }
}

use super::ServerRuntime;

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn admit_messages(&mut self) {
        let mut messages = std::mem::take(&mut self.connections.messages);
        for (index, message, decoded_at) in messages.drain(..) {
            if index >= self.connections.clients.len()
                || self.connections.disconnected.contains(&index)
                || self.connections.clients[index].close_deadline().is_some()
            {
                continue;
            }
            dispatch::dispatch_message(self, index, message, decoded_at);
        }
        self.connections.messages = messages;
    }
}

pub(in crate::runtime::admission) fn admit_chat(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    player: PlayerId,
    text: String,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) {
    let now = Instant::now();
    let rate_limited = runtime.connections.clients[index]
        .last_chat_at
        .is_some_and(|last_chat| now.saturating_duration_since(last_chat) < CHAT_COOLDOWN)
        || runtime.game.last_global_chat_at.is_some_and(|last_chat| {
            now.saturating_duration_since(last_chat) < GLOBAL_CHAT_COOLDOWN
        });

        runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs = runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
        if !queue_message(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Error(minimium_protocol::ServerErrorCode::RateLimit),
        ) {
            runtime.metrics.dropped_messages = runtime.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
        }
    } else if queue::try_queue(runtime, WorldInput::Chat(player, text), decoded_at) {
        runtime.connections.clients[index].last_chat_at = Some(now);
        runtime.game.last_global_chat_at = Some(now);
    } else {
        runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs = runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
        if !queue_message(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Error(minimium_protocol::ServerErrorCode::Busy),

use crate::{connection::queue_message, runtime::ServerRuntime, world_inputs::WorldInput};

pub(in crate::runtime::admission) fn admit_name(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    player: PlayerId,
    name: String,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) {
    if queue::try_queue(runtime, WorldInput::Rename(player, name), decoded_at) {
        if !queue_message(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Accepted,
        ) {
            runtime.metrics.dropped_messages = runtime.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
        }
    } else {
        runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs = runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
        let _ = queue_message(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::Busy),
        );
    }
}

pub(in crate::runtime::admission) fn admit_motion(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    player: PlayerId,
    input: CharacterInput,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) {
    if !queue::try_queue(runtime, WorldInput::Move(player, input), decoded_at) {
        let _ = queue_message(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::Busy),
        );
    }

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/admission/dispatch.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="93" bytes="3524" original_lines="93" original_bytes="3524" minified="false" sha256="619c244a7392f641c626c6fb0ce439cef21b53457fc5502611d5b1d9e6dcf63c">>>
use super::{actions, identity, routing::RoutingOutcome, technical, world_control};
use crate::{
    connection::{mark_disconnected, CloseReason},
    runtime::ServerRuntime,
};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_protocol::ClientMessage;
use std::time::Instant;

pub(super) fn dispatch_message(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    message: ClientMessage,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) {
    let player_id = runtime.connections.clients[index].player_id();
    // Routing preserves wrapper conversion and pre-dispatch effects; only continued messages reach admission below.
    let message = match identity::negotiate_content(runtime, index, message, player_id) {
        RoutingOutcome::Handled => return,
        RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(message) => message,
    };
    let message = match world_control::route_message(runtime, index, message, decoded_at, player_id)
    {
        RoutingOutcome::Handled => return,
        RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(message) => message,
    };
    let message = match runtime.route_message(index, message, player_id) {
        RoutingOutcome::Handled => return,
        RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(message) => message,
    };
    let message = match technical::handle_message(runtime, index, message, decoded_at, player_id) {
        RoutingOutcome::Handled => return,
        RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(message) => message,
    };
    handle_admitted_message(runtime, index, message, decoded_at, player_id);
}

fn handle_admitted_message(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    message: ClientMessage,
    decoded_at: Instant,
    player_id: Option<PlayerId>,
) {
    match message {
        ClientMessage::Identify(profile_id) if player_id.is_none() => {
            identity::activate_profile(runtime, index, profile_id, decoded_at);
        }
        ClientMessage::Identify(_) => {
            disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
        }
        ClientMessage::SetName(name) => {
            if let Some(player) = player_id {
                actions::movement::admit_name(runtime, index, player, name, decoded_at);
            } else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
            }
        }
        ClientMessage::Motion(input) => {
            if let Some(player) = player_id {
                actions::movement::admit_motion(runtime, index, player, input, decoded_at);
            } else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
            }
        }
        ClientMessage::Fire { direction } => {
            if let Some(player) = player_id {
                actions::combat::admit_fire(runtime, index, player, direction, decoded_at);
            } else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
            }
        }
        ClientMessage::Chat(text) => {
            if let Some(player) = player_id {
                actions::chat::admit_chat(runtime, index, player, text, decoded_at);
            } else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
            }
        }
        _ => {
            disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
        }
    }
}

fn disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime: &mut ServerRuntime, index: usize) {
    mark_disconnected(
        index,
        &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
        &mut runtime.connections.disconnected,
        Some(CloseReason::InvalidSequence),
    );
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/admission/identity.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="235" bytes="8154" original_lines="235" original_bytes="8154" minified="false" sha256="22f5c464cdc3b71ebb2089d5e99a785e2dcc6b20a252ec55db3ed5ea4daf3d2e">>>
use super::routing::RoutingOutcome;
use crate::{
    connection::{mark_disconnected, queue_close_response, queue_message, CloseReason},
    content::ContentServer,
    runtime::ServerRuntime,
    world_inputs::WorldInput,
    MAX_PENDING_WORLD_INPUTS,
};
use minimium_core::{identity::PlayerProfileId, ids::PlayerId};
use minimium_environment::time::ClockRevision;
use minimium_protocol::{ClientMessage, ServerErrorCode, ServerMessage, WorldContext};
use minimium_world::world::{Position3Mm, WorldInstanceId};
use std::time::Instant;

pub(super) fn negotiate_content(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    message: ClientMessage,
    player_id: Option<PlayerId>,
) -> RoutingOutcome {
    let message = match message {
        ClientMessage::Presentation(capability)
            if player_id.is_none()
                && runtime.connections.clients[index].pending_profile.is_none() =>
        {
            runtime.connections.clients[index].presentation = capability.is_some();
            return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
        }
        ClientMessage::Identify(profile)
            if player_id.is_none()
                && runtime.connections.clients[index].presentation
                && !runtime.connections.clients[index].content_ready =>
        {
            if runtime.connections.clients[index].pending_profile.is_some() {
                disconnect(runtime, index, None);
                return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
            }
            runtime.connections.clients[index].pending_profile = Some(profile);
            if !queue_message(
                &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                &mut runtime.metrics,
                content_offer(&runtime.content),
            ) {
                disconnect(runtime, index, None);
            }
            return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
        }
        ClientMessage::ContentReady(hash) if player_id.is_none() => {
            if hash != runtime.content.hash
                || runtime.connections.clients[index].pending_profile.is_none()
            {
                disconnect(runtime, index, None);
                return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
            }
            runtime.connections.clients[index].content_ready = true;
            ClientMessage::Identify(
                runtime.connections.clients[index]
                    .pending_profile
                    .take()
                    .unwrap(),
            )
        }
        other => other,
    };
    RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(message)
}

fn content_offer(content: &ContentServer) -> ServerMessage {
    ServerMessage::ContentOffer {
        material_hash: content.hash,
        http_port: content.port,
        climate: content.climate.clone(),
    }
}

pub(super) fn activate_profile(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    profile_id: PlayerProfileId,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) {
    if runtime.operations.player_store.active_count() >= runtime.max_players
        || runtime.game.pending_world_inputs.len() + runtime.connections.clients.len()
            >= MAX_PENDING_WORLD_INPUTS
    {
        if !queue_close_response(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::ServerFull),
            Instant::now(),
        ) {
            disconnect(runtime, index, None);
        }
        return;
    }
    if runtime.game.pending_departures.contains(&profile_id) {
        if !queue_close_response(
            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
            &mut runtime.metrics,
            ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::Busy),
            Instant::now(),
        ) {
            disconnect(runtime, index, None);
        }
        return;
    }

    let player = match runtime.operations.player_store.claim(
        profile_id,
        &mut runtime.operations.next_player,
        runtime.map.spawn(),
        runtime.map.spawn_position_mm(),
        runtime.game.worlds.primary_id(),
        runtime.game.worlds.primary().world.gravity(),
    ) {
        Ok(player) => player,
        Err(error) => {
            eprintln!("could not claim player profile: {error}");
            if !queue_close_response(
                &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                &mut runtime.metrics,
                ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::Busy),
                Instant::now(),
            ) {
                disconnect(runtime, index, None);
            }
            return;
        }
    };
    runtime.connections.clients[index].activate(player.id, profile_id);
    runtime
        .connections
        .client_indices_by_player
        .insert(player.id, index);
    let instance = player.location.instance();
    let context = match runtime.game.worlds.reserve_membership(instance, player.id) {
        Ok(context) => context,
        Err(error) => {
            eprintln!("could not reserve world membership: {error:?}");
            disconnect(runtime, index, None);
            return;
        }
    };
    runtime.game.pending_world_inputs.push((
        WorldInput::Join {
            id: player.id,
            instance,
            name: player.name.as_str().to_owned(),
            position: player.position,
            position_mm: player.location.position(),
            health: player.health,
        },
        Some(decoded_at),
    ));

    let welcome_player = WelcomePlayerData {
        id: player.id,
        health: player.health,
        position: player.position,
        position_mm: player.location.position(),
    };
    let now = Instant::now();
    let (welcome, clock_revision) =
        match build_welcome_message(runtime, welcome_player, instance, context, now) {
            Ok(welcome) => welcome,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("could not sample environment for Welcome: {error}");
                disconnect(runtime, index, Some(CloseReason::InvalidSequence));
                return;
            }
        };
    if !queue_message(
        &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
        &mut runtime.metrics,
        welcome,
    ) {
        runtime.metrics.dropped_messages = runtime.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
        disconnect(runtime, index, Some(CloseReason::Backpressure));
    } else {
        runtime.connections.clients[index].mark_environment_sent(
            context,
            clock_revision,
            Instant::now(),
        );
        println!("player {} connected", player.id);
    }
}

struct WelcomePlayerData {
    id: PlayerId,
    health: u16,
    position: [f32; 3],
    position_mm: Position3Mm,
}

fn build_welcome_message(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    player: WelcomePlayerData,
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    context: WorldContext,
    now: Instant,
) -> Result<(ServerMessage, ClockRevision), String> {
    let (clock_sample, environment) = runtime.environment_state_for_instance(instance, now)?;
    let clock_revision = clock_sample.revision();
    let welcome = ServerMessage::Welcome {
        id: player.id,
        map_fingerprint: runtime
            .game
            .worlds
            .map_fingerprint_for_instance(instance)
            .expect("reserved membership references a loaded world"),
        health: player.health,
        position: player.position,
        position_mm: player.position_mm,
        context,
        manifest: runtime
            .game
            .worlds
            .manifest_for_player(player.id)
            .expect("reserved membership has a manifest"),
        transition_id: None,
        clock_sample,
        environment,
    };
    Ok((welcome, clock_revision))
}

fn disconnect(runtime: &mut ServerRuntime, index: usize, reason: Option<CloseReason>) {
    mark_disconnected(
        index,
        &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
        &mut runtime.connections.disconnected,
        reason,
    );
}

use crate::{runtime::ServerRuntime, world_inputs::WorldInput, MAX_PENDING_WORLD_INPUTS};
use std::time::Instant;

pub(super) fn try_queue(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    input: WorldInput,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) -> bool {
    if runtime.game.pending_world_inputs.len() + runtime.connections.clients.len()
        >= MAX_PENDING_WORLD_INPUTS
    {
        return false;
    }
    runtime
        .game
        .pending_world_inputs
        .push((input, Some(decoded_at)));
    true
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/admission/routing.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="67" bytes="2625" original_lines="67" original_bytes="2625" minified="false" sha256="df3e7ca52011ac35526794cade849d46aa479d6d9b35a675ed649b40f240d30f">>>
use crate::{
    connection::{mark_disconnected, CloseReason},
    runtime::ServerRuntime,
};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_protocol::{ClientMessage, ClientWorldInput};
use minimium_simulation::CharacterInput;

pub(super) enum RoutingOutcome {
    Handled,
    ContinueWith(ClientMessage),
}

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn route_message(
        &mut self,
        index: usize,
        message: ClientMessage,
        player_id: Option<PlayerId>,
    ) -> RoutingOutcome {
        let message = match message {
            ClientMessage::WorldInput { context, input } => {
                let Some(player) = player_id else {
                    mark_disconnected(
                        index,
                        &mut self.connections.clients[index],
                        &mut self.connections.disconnected,
                        Some(CloseReason::InvalidSequence),
                    );
                    return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
                };
                if !self
                    .game
                    .worlds
                    .world_input_context_is_current(player, context)
                {
                    self.metrics.rejected_inputs = self.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
                    return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
                }
                match input {
                    ClientWorldInput::SetName(name) => ClientMessage::SetName(name),
                    ClientWorldInput::Motion(input) => ClientMessage::Motion(input),
                    ClientWorldInput::Move { direction, jump } => {
                        ClientMessage::Move { direction, jump }
                    }
                    ClientWorldInput::Fire { direction } => ClientMessage::Fire { direction },
                    ClientWorldInput::Chat(text) => ClientMessage::Chat(text),
                    ClientWorldInput::UsePortal => unreachable!("portal branch handled earlier"),
                    ClientWorldInput::SetAltitude { .. } | ClientWorldInput::MapTeleport { .. } => {
                        unreachable!("world-control branch handled earlier")
                    }
                }
            }
            other => other,
        };
        let message = match message {
            ClientMessage::Move { direction, jump } => ClientMessage::Motion(CharacterInput {
                direction,
                jump,
                ..Default::default()
            }),
            other => other,
        };

        RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(message)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/admission/technical.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="119" bytes="4533" original_lines="119" original_bytes="4533" minified="false" sha256="92e8c2bafb9411fc82bb263d56bf5fa38014e207ab8fd4e2a275416f562c9d6a">>>
use super::routing::RoutingOutcome;
use crate::{
    connection::{mark_disconnected, queue_close_response, queue_message},
    runtime::ServerRuntime,
};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_protocol::{ClientMessage, ServerErrorCode, ServerMessage};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub(super) fn handle_message(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    message: ClientMessage,
    decoded_at: Instant,
    player_id: Option<PlayerId>,
) -> RoutingOutcome {
    match message {
        ClientMessage::Ping if player_id.is_some() => {
            if !queue_message(
                &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                &mut runtime.metrics,
                ServerMessage::Pong,
            ) {
                runtime.metrics.dropped_messages =
                    runtime.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        ClientMessage::TimeProbe {
            seq,
            client_send_monotonic_ms,
        } if player_id.is_some() => {
            handle_time_probe(runtime, index, seq, client_send_monotonic_ms, decoded_at);
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        ClientMessage::Quit if player_id.is_some() => {
            if !queue_close_response(
                &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                &mut runtime.metrics,
                ServerMessage::Bye,
                Instant::now(),
            ) {
                mark_disconnected(
                    index,
                    &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                    &mut runtime.connections.disconnected,
                    None,
                );
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        other => RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(other),
    }
}

fn handle_time_probe(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    seq: u32,
    client_send_monotonic_ms: u64,
    decoded_at: Instant,
) {
    runtime.metrics.clock_probe_requests = runtime.metrics.clock_probe_requests.saturating_add(1);
    let now = Instant::now();
    if !runtime.connections.clients[index].accept_time_probe(now) {
        runtime.metrics.clock_probe_rejected =
            runtime.metrics.clock_probe_rejected.saturating_add(1);
        runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs = runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
        let may_reply = runtime.connections.clients[index]
            .last_time_probe_rejection_at
            .is_none_or(|last| now.saturating_duration_since(last) >= Duration::from_secs(1));
        if may_reply
            && queue_message(
                &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                &mut runtime.metrics,
                ServerMessage::Error(ServerErrorCode::RateLimit),
            )
        {
            runtime.connections.clients[index].last_time_probe_rejection_at = Some(now);
        }
        return;
    }
    let Ok(server_receive_monotonic_ms) = runtime.monotonic_ms(decoded_at) else {
        reject_clock_probe(runtime);
        return;
    };
    let send_at = Instant::now();
    let Ok(server_send_monotonic_ms) = runtime.monotonic_ms(send_at) else {
        reject_clock_probe(runtime);
        return;
    };
    let Ok(sample) = runtime.environment_clock.sample(server_send_monotonic_ms) else {
        reject_clock_probe(runtime);
        return;
    };
    if queue_message(
        &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
        &mut runtime.metrics,
        ServerMessage::TimeProbeReply {
            seq,
            echoed_client_send_monotonic_ms: client_send_monotonic_ms,
            server_receive_monotonic_ms: server_receive_monotonic_ms.get(),
            server_send_monotonic_ms: server_send_monotonic_ms.get(),
            session_nonce: sample.session_nonce(),
        },
    ) {
        runtime.metrics.clock_probe_accepted =
            runtime.metrics.clock_probe_accepted.saturating_add(1);
    } else {
        runtime.metrics.clock_probe_rejected =
            runtime.metrics.clock_probe_rejected.saturating_add(1);
        runtime.metrics.dropped_messages = runtime.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
    }
}

fn reject_clock_probe(runtime: &mut ServerRuntime) {
    runtime.metrics.clock_probe_rejected = runtime.metrics.clock_probe_rejected.saturating_add(1);
    runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs = runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
}

use super::{queue, routing::RoutingOutcome};
use crate::{
    connection::{mark_disconnected, queue_message, CloseReason},
    runtime::ServerRuntime,
    world_inputs::WorldInput,
};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_protocol::{ClientMessage, ClientWorldInput, ServerMessage};
use std::time::Instant;

pub(super) fn route_message(
    runtime: &mut ServerRuntime,
    index: usize,
    message: ClientMessage,
    decoded_at: Instant,
    player_id: Option<PlayerId>,
) -> RoutingOutcome {
    match message {
        ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context,
            input: ClientWorldInput::UsePortal,
        } => {
            let Some(player) = player_id else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
                return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
            };
            if runtime
                .game
                .worlds
                .world_input_context_is_current(player, context)
                && queue::try_queue(runtime, WorldInput::UsePortal(player, context), decoded_at)
            {
                // The queued portal input will be applied in the normal world-input phase.
            } else {
                reject_input(runtime);
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context,
            input: ClientWorldInput::SetAltitude { km },
        } => {
            let Some(player) = player_id else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
                return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
            };
            if !runtime
                .game
                .worlds
                .world_input_context_is_current(player, context)
                || !queue::try_queue(
                    runtime,
                    WorldInput::SetAltitude(player, context, km),
                    decoded_at,
                )
            {
                reject_input(runtime);
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        ClientMessage::WorldInput {
            context,
            input: ClientWorldInput::MapTeleport { direction },
        } => {
            let Some(player) = player_id else {
                disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime, index);
                return RoutingOutcome::Handled;
            };
            if !runtime
                .game
                .worlds
                .world_input_context_is_current(player, context)
                || !queue::try_queue(
                    runtime,
                    WorldInput::MapTeleport(player, context, direction),
                    decoded_at,
                )
            {
                reject_input(runtime);
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        ClientMessage::TransitionReady {
            transition_id,
            target_context,
        } => {
            let accepted = player_id.is_some_and(|player| {
                runtime
                    .game
                    .worlds
                    .mark_transfer_ready(player, transition_id, target_context)
            });
            if !accepted {
                reject_input(runtime);
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        ClientMessage::CancelTransition(transition_id) => {
            if let Some(player) = player_id {
                if runtime.game.worlds.cancel_transfer(player, transition_id) {
                    if let Some(context) = runtime.game.worlds.context_for_player(player) {
                        let _ = queue_message(
                            &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
                            &mut runtime.metrics,
                            ServerMessage::TransitionCancelled {
                                transition_id,
                                context,
                            },
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            RoutingOutcome::Handled
        }
        other => RoutingOutcome::ContinueWith(other),
    }
}

fn reject_input(runtime: &mut ServerRuntime) {
    runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs = runtime.metrics.rejected_inputs.saturating_add(1);
}

fn disconnect_invalid_sequence(runtime: &mut ServerRuntime, index: usize) {
    mark_disconnected(
        index,
        &mut runtime.connections.clients[index],
        &mut runtime.connections.disconnected,
        Some(CloseReason::InvalidSequence),
    );
}

use super::*;
use crate::connection::queue_message;
impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn apply_altitude(
        &mut self,
        id: PlayerId,
        context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        km: f32,
    ) {
        let position_mm = self.altitude_destination(id, context, km);
        if let Some(index) = self.connections.client_indices_by_player.get(&id).copied() {
            if let Some(client) = self.connections.clients.get_mut(index) {
                if !queue_message(
                    client,
                    &mut self.metrics,
                    minimium_protocol::ServerMessage::AltitudeResult {
                        context,
                        position_mm,
                    },
                ) {
                    client.disconnect_reason = Some(crate::connection::CloseReason::Backpressure);
                    self.connections.disconnected.push(index);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    fn altitude_destination(
        &mut self,
        id: PlayerId,
        context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        km: f32,
    ) -> Option<minimium_world::world::Position3Mm> {
        if !km.is_finite()
            || !(0.0..=10000.0).contains(&km)
            || !self.game.worlds.can_map_teleport(id, context)
            || !self.game.active_inputs.get(&id)?.movement.fly
        {
            return None;
        }
        let manifest = self.game.worlds.manifest_for_player(id)?;
        let definition = manifest.planet()?;
        let instance = self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(id)?;
        let position = self
            .game
            .worlds
            .get(instance)?
            .world
            .network_snapshot()
            .position_mm(id)?
            .0
            .map(|v| v as f64);
        let length = position.iter().map(|v| v.powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
        if length < 1.0 {
            return None;
        }
        let direction = position.map(|v| (v / length) as f32);
        let ground = minimium_procgen::planet_collision_position_at_direction_with_geography(
            manifest,
            direction,
            self.prepared_geography.clone(),
        )?;
        let radius = ground
            .iter()
            .map(|v| (*v as f64).powi(2))
            .sum::<f64>()
            .sqrt();
        // Match optical/climate elevation units on compressed Earth relief.
        let scale = if definition.mode == 1 {
            f64::from(definition.height_scale_permille) / 1000.0
        } else {
            1.0
        };
        let target_radius = radius + f64::from(km) * 1_000_000.0 * scale;
        let position_mm = minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(std::array::from_fn(|a| {
            (position[a] / length * target_radius).round() as i64
        }));
        if position_mm
            .0
            .iter()
            .any(|v| v.unsigned_abs() > 7_000_000_000)
        {
            return None;
        }
        let world = &mut self.game.worlds.get_mut(instance)?.world;
        if !world.set_position(id, position_mm.0.map(|v| v as f32 / 1000.0))
            || !world.restore_position_mm(id, position_mm)
        {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(player) = world.player(id) {
            if let Err(error) =
                self.operations
                    .player_store
                    .update_from_player(player, instance, world.gravity())
            {
                eprintln!("could not record altitude for player {id}: {error}");
            }
        }
        if let Some(input) = self.game.active_inputs.get_mut(&id) {
            input.direction = [0.0; 2];
            input.vertical = 0.0;
            input.jump = false;
        }
        self.game.input_last_received.insert(id, Instant::now());
        self.scheduler.next_snapshot = Instant::now();
        Some(position_mm)
    }
}

use super::*;
use crate::connection::{queue_message, CloseReason};
use minimium_environment::{
    time::ClockSample,
    {AstronomyModelRevision, CatalogueId, CatalogueSha256, EnvironmentDescriptor},
};
use minimium_protocol::ServerMessage;
use std::time::Instant;

const ENVIRONMENT_SYNC_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn environment_state_for_instance(
        &self,
        instance_id: minimium_world::world::WorldInstanceId,
        now: Instant,
    ) -> Result<(ClockSample, EnvironmentDescriptor), String> {
        let instance = self
            .game
            .worlds
            .get(instance_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| "environment world instance is unavailable".to_owned())?;
        let identity = minimium_assets::embedded_sky_catalog_identity();
        let catalogue_id = CatalogueId::try_from(identity.catalogue_id)
            .map_err(|error| format!("embedded sky catalogue identity: {error}"))?;
        let descriptor = EnvironmentDescriptor::new(
            instance.clock_id,
            instance.environment_profile,
            AstronomyModelRevision::CURRENT,
            catalogue_id,
            CatalogueSha256::new(identity.sha256),
        );
        let monotonic = self.monotonic_ms(now).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        let sample = self.environment_clock.sample(monotonic)?;
        descriptor
            .validate_clock(sample.clock_id())
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        Ok((sample, descriptor))
    }

    pub(super) fn replicate_environment(&mut self) {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let Ok(monotonic) = self.monotonic_ms(now) else {
            return;
        };
        let Ok(sample) = self.environment_clock.sample(monotonic) else {
            return;
        };

        for index in 0..self.connections.clients.len() {
            if self.connections.disconnected.contains(&index)
                || self.connections.clients[index].close_deadline().is_some()
            {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(player) = self.connections.clients[index].player_id() else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(context) = self.game.worlds.context_for_player(player) else {
                continue;
            };
            if self.connections.clients[index].last_environment_context != Some(context) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(instance) = self.game.worlds.get(context.instance()) else {
                continue;
            };
            let identity = minimium_assets::embedded_sky_catalog_identity();
            let Ok(catalogue_id) = CatalogueId::try_from(identity.catalogue_id) else {
                continue;
            };
            let descriptor = EnvironmentDescriptor::new(
                instance.clock_id,
                instance.environment_profile,
                AstronomyModelRevision::CURRENT,
                catalogue_id,
                CatalogueSha256::new(identity.sha256),
            );
            if descriptor.validate_clock(sample.clock_id()).is_err() {
                continue;
            }
            let client = &self.connections.clients[index];
            let revision_changed = client.last_environment_revision != Some(sample.revision());
            let periodic_due = client.last_environment_sync_at.is_some_and(|last| {
                now.saturating_duration_since(last) >= ENVIRONMENT_SYNC_INTERVAL
            });
            if !revision_changed && !periodic_due {
                continue;
            }
            if !queue_message(
                &mut self.connections.clients[index],
                &mut self.metrics,
                ServerMessage::EnvironmentSync {
                    context,
                    clock_sample: sample,
                    environment: descriptor,
                },
            ) {
                self.metrics.dropped_messages = self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                self.connections.clients[index].disconnect_reason = Some(CloseReason::Backpressure);
                self.connections.disconnected.push(index);
                continue;
            }
            self.metrics.environment_sync_messages =
                self.metrics.environment_sync_messages.saturating_add(1);
            self.connections.clients[index].mark_environment_sent(context, sample.revision(), now);
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/inputs.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="252" bytes="11181" original_lines="252" original_bytes="11181" minified="false" sha256="02fe2580bd6d5d33873c017e786766003766e06dafa913f86c5af916f3332ba2">>>
use super::*;
use crate::connection::queue_message;
use crate::world_inputs::{WorldEvent, WorldInput};

const INPUT_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_millis(250);

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn apply_inputs(&mut self) {
        // Reuse the allocation and deliver each event before the next input.
        let mut pending = std::mem::take(&mut self.game.pending_world_inputs);
        for (input, decoded_at) in pending.drain(..) {
            if let Some(decoded_at) = decoded_at {
                self.metrics
                    .input_wait
                    .record(Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(decoded_at));
            }
            if let Some(event) = self.apply_input(input) {
                self.emit_world_event(event);
            }
        }
        self.game.pending_world_inputs = pending;
        let now = Instant::now();
        for (id, last_received) in &self.game.input_last_received {
            if now.duration_since(*last_received) > INPUT_IDLE_TIMEOUT {
                if let Some(input) = self.game.active_inputs.get_mut(id) {
                    input.direction = [0.0; 2];
                    input.vertical = 0.0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn apply_input(&mut self, input: WorldInput) -> Option<WorldEvent> {
        match input {
            WorldInput::Join {
                id,
                instance,
                name,
                position,
                position_mm,
                health,
            } => {
                if let Err(error) = self.game.worlds.join_at_precise(
                    instance,
                    id,
                    name,
                    position,
                    position_mm,
                    health,
                ) {
                    eprintln!("could not add player {id} to instance {instance}: {error:?}");
                    return None;
                }
                self.game
                    .active_inputs
                    .insert(id, CharacterInput::default());
                self.game.input_last_received.insert(id, Instant::now());
            }
            WorldInput::Leave(id) => {
                if let Some(instance_id) = self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(id) {
                    if let Some(instance) = self.game.worlds.get(instance_id) {
                        let gravity = instance.world.gravity();
                        if let Some(player) = instance.world.player(id) {
                            if let Err(error) = self.operations.player_store.update_from_player(
                                player,
                                instance_id,
                                gravity,
                            ) {
                                eprintln!("could not capture player {} before leave: {error}", id);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                self.game.worlds.leave(id);
                self.game.active_inputs.remove(&id);
                self.game.input_last_received.remove(&id);
                if let Some(profile) = self.operations.player_store.profile_for_player(id) {
                    self.game.pending_departures.remove(&profile);
                }
            }
            WorldInput::Move(id, input) => {
                let current = self.game.active_inputs.entry(id).or_default();
                let jump = current.jump || input.jump;
                *current = input;
                current.jump = jump;
                self.game.input_last_received.insert(id, Instant::now());
            }
            WorldInput::SetAltitude(id, context, km) => self.apply_altitude(id, context, km),
            WorldInput::MapTeleport(id, context, direction) => {
                let position_mm = self.map_teleport(id, context, direction);
                if let Some(index) = self.connections.client_indices_by_player.get(&id).copied() {
                    if let Some(client) = self.connections.clients.get_mut(index) {
                        if !queue_message(
                            client,
                            &mut self.metrics,
                            minimium_protocol::ServerMessage::MapTeleportResult { position_mm },
                        ) {
                            self.metrics.dropped_messages =
                                self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                            client.disconnect_reason =
                                Some(crate::connection::CloseReason::Backpressure);
                            self.connections.disconnected.push(index);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            WorldInput::Fire(id, direction) => {
                self.metrics.shots_fired = self.metrics.shots_fired.saturating_add(1);
                let instance = self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(id)?;
                let world = &mut self.game.worlds.get_mut(instance)?.world;
                let outcome = world.fire_hitscan(id, direction, self.combat)?;
                let target_health = outcome
                    .target_id
                    .and_then(|target| world.player_health(target));
                if outcome.target_id.is_some() {
                    self.metrics.shots_hit = self.metrics.shots_hit.saturating_add(1);
                    if outcome.killed {
                        self.metrics.player_kills = self.metrics.player_kills.saturating_add(1);
                    }
                }
                return Some(WorldEvent::Shot {
                    instance,
                    shooter: id,
                    outcome,
                    target_health,
                });
            }
            WorldInput::Chat(id, text) => {
                if !self.operations.player_store.is_active(id) {
                    return None;
                }
                let instance = self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(id)?;
                let name = self.operations.player_store.name_for_player(id)?.to_owned();
                return Some(WorldEvent::Chat {
                    instance,
                    sender: id,
                    name,
                    text,
                });
            }
            WorldInput::Rename(id, name) => {
                self.game
                    .worlds
                    .for_player_mut(id)?
                    .world
                    .rename_player(id, name.clone());
                self.operations.player_store.rename(id, name);
            }
            WorldInput::UsePortal(id, source_context) => {
                let offer = self.game.worlds.prepare_portal_transfer(
                    id,
                    source_context,
                    self.operations.player_store.return_location_for(id),
                )?;
                let Some(index) = self.connections.client_indices_by_player.get(&id).copied()
                else {
                    self.game.worlds.cancel_transfer(id, offer.transition_id);
                    return None;
                };
                let (clock_sample, environment) = match self
                    .environment_state_for_instance(offer.target_context.instance(), Instant::now())
                {
                    Ok(state) => state,
                    Err(error) => {
                        eprintln!("could not sample target environment for transfer: {error}");
                        self.game.worlds.cancel_transfer(id, offer.transition_id);
                        return None;
                    }
                };
                if let Some(client) = self.connections.clients.get_mut(index) {
                    if !queue_message(
                        client,
                        &mut self.metrics,
                        minimium_protocol::ServerMessage::TransitionPrepare {
                            transition_id: offer.transition_id,
                            source_context: offer.source_context,
                            target_context: offer.target_context,
                            map_fingerprint: offer.map_fingerprint,
                            destination: offer.destination,
                            destination_mm: offer.destination_mm,
                            manifest: offer.manifest,
                            clock_sample,
                            environment,
                        },
                    ) {
                        self.game.worlds.cancel_transfer(id, offer.transition_id);
                        self.metrics.dropped_messages =
                            self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }

    fn map_teleport(
        &mut self,
        id: minimium_core::ids::PlayerId,
        context: minimium_protocol::WorldContext,
        direction: [f32; 3],
    ) -> Option<minimium_world::world::Position3Mm> {
        if !self.game.worlds.can_map_teleport(id, context) {
            return None;
        }
        let instance = self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(id)?;
        let manifest = self.game.worlds.manifest_for_player(id)?;
        if manifest.planet()?.mode != 1 {
            return None;
        }
        let point = minimium_procgen::planet_point_at_direction_with_geography(
            manifest,
            direction,
            self.prepared_geography.clone(),
        )?;
        if point.ocean {
            return None;
        }
        let ground = minimium_procgen::planet_collision_position_at_direction_with_geography(
            manifest,
            direction,
            self.prepared_geography.clone(),
        )?;
        let length = ground
            .iter()
            .map(|value| (*value as f64).powi(2))
            .sum::<f64>()
            .sqrt();
        let position_mm = minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(std::array::from_fn(|axis| {
            ground[axis] + (ground[axis] as f64 / length * 2_000.0).round() as i64
        }));
        let position = position_mm.0.map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0);
        let world = &mut self.game.worlds.get_mut(instance)?.world;
        if !world.set_position(id, position) || !world.restore_position_mm(id, position_mm) {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(player) = world.player(id) {
            if let Err(error) =
                self.operations
                    .player_store
                    .update_from_player(player, instance, world.gravity())
            {
                eprintln!("could not record map teleport for player {id}: {error}");
            }
        }
        self.game
            .active_inputs
            .insert(id, minimium_simulation::CharacterInput::default());
        self.game.input_last_received.insert(id, Instant::now());
        self.scheduler.next_snapshot = Instant::now();
        Some(position_mm)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/network.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="149" bytes="6594" original_lines="149" original_bytes="6594" minified="false" sha256="71689f97f1143d6dd914335ffe51bbf4efe945966cee613b0c148553cc111a46">>>
use super::*;
use crate::{
    accept,
    connection::{mark_disconnected, CloseReason},
    receive, send,
    world_inputs::WorldInput,
};
use minimium_telemetry::allocations::{self, Phase};

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn poll_network(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let network_phase = allocations::enter(Phase::Network);
        let network_started = Instant::now();
        accept::accept_clients(
            &self.game_listener,
            &mut self.connections.clients,
            self.max_client_connections,
            self.game.pending_world_inputs.len(),
        )?;

        receive::poll_clients(
            &mut self.connections.clients,
            &mut self.metrics,
            &mut self.connections.messages,
            &mut self.connections.disconnected,
        );
        self.admit_messages();
        self.close_eof_clients(Instant::now());
        self.mark_timed_out_clients(Instant::now());
        self.replicate_environment();
        send::send_clients(
            &mut self.connections.clients,
            &mut self.metrics,
            &mut self.connections.disconnected,
            &mut self.connections.first_write_client,
        );
        self.metrics.oldest_output_age = self
            .connections
            .clients
            .iter()
            .filter_map(Client::oldest_output_age)
            .max()
            .unwrap_or_default();
        self.remove_disconnected_clients();
        self.metrics.network_io.record(network_started.elapsed());
        self.metrics.max_pending_inputs = self
            .metrics
            .max_pending_inputs
            .max(self.game.pending_world_inputs.len());

        drop(network_phase);
        Ok(())
    }
    fn close_eof_clients(&mut self, eof_close_at: Instant) {
        for client in &mut self.connections.clients {
            if client.peer_eof && client.close_deadline().is_none() {
                client.begin_close(eof_close_at, CloseReason::PeerEof);
            }
        }
    }

    fn mark_timed_out_clients(&mut self, activity_check_at: Instant) {
        for (index, client) in self.connections.clients.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if client.close_deadline().is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            let handshake_timed_out = client.player_id().is_none()
                && activity_check_at.duration_since(client.connected_at)
                    >= if client.pending_profile.is_some() {
                        Duration::from_secs(300)
                    } else {
                        CLIENT_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT
                    };
            let idle_timed_out = client.player_id().is_some()
                && activity_check_at.duration_since(client.last_message_at) >= CLIENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT;
            if (handshake_timed_out || idle_timed_out)
                && !self.connections.disconnected.contains(&index)
            {
                if handshake_timed_out {
                    mark_disconnected(
                        index,
                        client,
                        &mut self.connections.disconnected,
                        Some(CloseReason::HandshakeTimeout),
                    );
                    self.metrics.handshake_timeouts =
                        self.metrics.handshake_timeouts.saturating_add(1);
                } else {
                    mark_disconnected(
                        index,
                        client,
                        &mut self.connections.disconnected,
                        Some(CloseReason::IdleTimeout),
                    );
                    self.metrics.idle_timeouts = self.metrics.idle_timeouts.saturating_add(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn remove_disconnected_clients(&mut self) {
        self.connections.disconnected.sort_unstable();
        self.connections.disconnected.dedup();
        for index in self.connections.disconnected.drain(..).rev() {
            if index < self.connections.clients.len() {
                let client = self.connections.clients.swap_remove(index);
                if let Some(identity) = client.identity() {
                    let player_id = identity.player;
                    let profile_id = identity.profile;
                    self.connections.client_indices_by_player.remove(&player_id);
                    // Release the active claim immediately, but reject a rejoin
                    // until Leave has applied all preceding queued inputs.
                    if let Some(instance_id) = self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(player_id) {
                        if let Some(instance) = self.game.worlds.get(instance_id) {
                            let gravity = instance.world.gravity();
                            if let Some(player) = instance.world.player(player_id) {
                                if let Err(error) = self.operations.player_store.update_from_player(
                                    player,
                                    instance_id,
                                    gravity,
                                ) {
                                    eprintln!("could not capture disconnect state: {error}");
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    self.game.pending_departures.insert(profile_id);
                    self.operations.player_store.release(player_id);
                    self.game
                        .pending_world_inputs
                        .push((WorldInput::Leave(player_id), None));
                    println!("player {player_id} disconnected reason={:?} bytes_in={} bytes_out={} decoded_frames={} queued_frames={} encoding_us={}", client.reason(), client.bytes_in, client.bytes_out, client.frames_in, client.frames_out, client.encoding_us);
                } else {
                    println!(
                        "unidentified client disconnected reason={:?}",
                        client.reason()
                    );
                }
                if index < self.connections.clients.len() {
                    if let Some(moved_player_id) = self.connections.clients[index].player_id() {
                        self.connections
                            .client_indices_by_player
                            .insert(moved_player_id, index);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/operations.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="100" bytes="4329" original_lines="100" original_bytes="4329" minified="false" sha256="5928c48a2798c498bd4efebd1cacbe11eb87e6946f2d9e684e923010249f8487">>>
use super::*;

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn poll_operations(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<Instant> {
        self.operations.persistence.poll_completions();
        let now = Instant::now();
        let monotonic_ms = self.monotonic_ms(now)?;
        if let Some(fault) = self.environment_clock.observe(monotonic_ms) {
            eprintln!("environment clock fault={}", fault.code());
        }
        if now >= self.scheduler.next_utc_check {
            self.scheduler.next_utc_check = now + Duration::from_secs(5);
            match self.environment_clock.check_system_clock(monotonic_ms) {
                Ok(Some(offset_ms)) => eprintln!(
                    "system UTC correction direction={} magnitude_ms={}",
                    if offset_ms >= 0 {
                        "forward"
                    } else {
                        "backward"
                    },
                    offset_ms.abs()
                ),
                Ok(None) => {}
                Err(error) => eprintln!("environment clock correction failed: {error}"),
            }
        }
        self.environment_dirty_revision = self.environment_clock.dirty_revision();
        self.poll_autosave()?;
        self.metrics.sample_process_memory(Instant::now());
        self.connections.messages.clear();
        self.connections.disconnected.clear();
        let loop_started = Instant::now();
        let admin_requests = self.operations.admin.poll(Instant::now())?;
        for request in admin_requests {
            if self.operations.command_queue.len() < 64 {
                self.operations
                    .command_queue
                    .push_back((Some(request.id), request.command));
            } else {
                self.operations
                    .admin
                    .respond(request.id, false, "command queue full");
            }
        }
        if let Some(console_rx) = &self.operations.console_rx {
            for _ in 0..64 {
                let Ok(command) = console_rx.try_recv() else {
                    break;
                };
                if self.operations.command_queue.len() < 64 {
                    self.operations.command_queue.push_back((None, command));
                } else {
                    eprintln!("ERR command queue full");
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(loop_started)
    }

    fn poll_autosave(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let autosave_check_at = Instant::now();
        if self
            .scheduler
            .next_autosave
            .is_some_and(|deadline| autosave_check_at >= deadline)
        {
            self.scheduler.next_autosave =
                Some(autosave_check_at + self.scheduler.autosave_interval);
            if !self.operations.persistence.has_pending_save() {
                let capture_at = self.monotonic_ms(Instant::now())?;
                let snapshot_clock = self.environment_clock.capture_saved_state(capture_at);
                self.environment_dirty_revision = self.environment_clock.dirty_revision();
                match snapshot_clock {
                    Ok(saved_clock) => {
                        let save_input = self.game.worlds.snapshot_for_save(self.map.fingerprint());
                        let queue_result = save_input.and_then(|input| {
                            self.operations.persistence.queue_world_save(
                                &mut self.operations.player_store,
                                input,
                                saved_clock,
                            )
                        });
                        if let Err(error) = queue_result {
                            eprintln!("could not queue automatic world save: {error}");
                        } else {
                            println!("automatic world save queued");
                        }
                    }
                    Err(error) => {
                        eprintln!("could not capture environment clock for autosave: {error}");
                    }
                }
            } else {
                eprintln!("automatic world save skipped because another save is pending");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
