use super::*;
use crate::{
    connection::{queue_encoded_frame, queue_message},
    world_inputs::WorldEvent,
};
use minimium_protocol::{encode_server, ServerMessage};

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn emit_world_event(&mut self, event: WorldEvent) {
        match event {
            WorldEvent::Shot {
                instance,
                shooter,
                outcome,
                target_health,
            } => {
                if let (Some(target), Some(health)) = (outcome.target_id, target_health) {
                    if let Some(index) = self
                        .connections
                        .client_indices_by_player
                        .get(&target)
                        .copied()
                    {
                        if let Some(client) =
                            self.connections.clients.get_mut(index).filter(|client| {
                                client.player_id() == Some(target)
                                    && self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(target)
                                        == Some(instance)
                            })
                        {
                            client.pending_health_update = Some(health);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if let Some(index) = self
                    .connections
                    .client_indices_by_player
                    .get(&shooter)
                    .copied()
                {
                    let message = ServerMessage::ShotResult {
                        target_id: outcome.target_id,
                        remaining_health: outcome.remaining_health,
                        killed: outcome.killed,
                    };
                    if let Some(client) = self.connections.clients.get_mut(index).filter(|client| {
                        client.player_id() == Some(shooter)
                            && self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(shooter) == Some(instance)
                    }) {
                        if !queue_message(client, &mut self.metrics, message) {
                            self.metrics.dropped_messages =
                                self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            WorldEvent::Chat {
                instance,
                sender,
                name,
                text,
            } => {
                let message = ServerMessage::Chat {
                    sender_id: sender,
                    sender_name: name,
                    text,
                };
                let encoding_started = Instant::now();
                let encoded = encode_server(&message);
                self.metrics.encoding.record(encoding_started.elapsed());
                let Ok(frame) = encoded else {
                    self.metrics.dropped_messages = self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                    return;
                };
                for client in &mut self.connections.clients {
                    if client.player_id().is_none_or(|player| {
                        self.game.worlds.instance_for_player(player) != Some(instance)
                    }) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if !queue_encoded_frame(client, &frame, &mut self.metrics) {
                        self.metrics.dropped_messages =
                            self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/schedule.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="67" bytes="2117" original_lines="67" original_bytes="2117" minified="false" sha256="8424c2c82e28213057cba8bcf110d0789cb12330741af95285dff5b77a0d4dc5">>>
use crate::modules::{RegisteredSystem, Stage};
use crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry;

pub(crate) type SystemFn = for<'a> fn(&mut ServerSystemContext<'a>);

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct ScheduleDiagnostics {
    pub(crate) world_instance_count: usize,
    pub(crate) startup_system_runs: usize,
}

/// Systems receive only a read-only registry view and a schedule-owned
/// diagnostic sink. FixedUpdate, Environment and RenderPreparation do not
/// grant access to simulation mutation, persistence, I/O or worker pools.
pub(crate) struct ServerSystemContext<'a> {
    pub(crate) stage: Stage,
    pub(crate) worlds: &'a WorldRegistry,
    pub(crate) diagnostics: &'a mut ScheduleDiagnostics,
}

struct ScheduledSystem {
    stage: Stage,
    handler: SystemFn,
}

pub(crate) struct ServerSchedule {
    systems: Vec<ScheduledSystem>,
    startup_ran: bool,
    diagnostics: ScheduleDiagnostics,
}

impl ServerSchedule {
    pub(crate) fn from_systems(systems: &[RegisteredSystem<SystemFn>]) -> Self {
        Self {
            systems: systems
                .iter()
                .map(|system| ScheduledSystem {
                    stage: system.definition.stage,
                    handler: system.definition.handler,
                })
                .collect(),
            startup_ran: false,
            diagnostics: ScheduleDiagnostics::default(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn run_stage(&mut self, stage: Stage, worlds: &WorldRegistry) {
        if stage == Stage::Startup {
            if self.startup_ran {
                return;
            }
            self.startup_ran = true;
        }
        let mut context = ServerSystemContext {
            stage,
            worlds,
            diagnostics: &mut self.diagnostics,
        };
        for system in self.systems.iter().filter(|system| system.stage == stage) {
            (system.handler)(&mut context);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) const fn diagnostics(&self) -> ScheduleDiagnostics {
        self.diagnostics
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/runtime/tick.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="305" bytes="13445" original_lines="305" original_bytes="13445" minified="false" sha256="73df68b06a1adb90e5019153b08a39b0c53ad45dadf4f1aa3edb74a80fa5ddd7">>>
use super::*;
use crate::{commands, replication, simulation};
use minimium_protocol::PROTOCOL_VERSION;
use minimium_telemetry::allocations::{self, Phase};

impl ServerRuntime {
    pub(super) fn tick(&mut self) {
        if Instant::now() >= self.scheduler.next_tick {
            let tick_started = Instant::now();
            self.apply_commands();
            self.apply_world_inputs();
            self.schedule
                .run_stage(crate::modules::Stage::FixedUpdate, &self.game.worlds);
            self.simulate_tick();
            self.schedule
                .run_stage(crate::modules::Stage::Environment, &self.game.worlds);
            self.metrics.ticks = self.metrics.ticks.saturating_add(1);
            self.metrics.last_tick = tick_started.elapsed();
            self.metrics.tick.record(self.metrics.last_tick);
            self.scheduler.next_tick += TICK;
            let now = Instant::now();
            if now > self.scheduler.next_tick + TICK {
                let late_by = now.duration_since(self.scheduler.next_tick).as_nanos();
                self.metrics.missed_ticks = self
                    .metrics
                    .missed_ticks
                    .saturating_add((late_by / TICK.as_nanos()) as u64);
                self.scheduler.next_tick = now + TICK;
            }
        }
    }
    fn apply_commands(&mut self) {
        let game_address = self.game_address;
        let max_players = self.max_players;
        let lanes = self.lanes;
        let autosave_seconds = self.autosave_seconds;
        let command_phase = allocations::enter(Phase::Commands);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            let Some((request_id, command)) = self.operations.command_queue.pop_front() else {
                break;
            };
            if request_id.is_some_and(|id| !self.operations.admin.is_pending(id, Instant::now())) {
                continue;
            }
            let monotonic_ms = self.monotonic_ms(Instant::now());
            let schedule_diagnostics = self.schedule.diagnostics();
            let mut reply = match monotonic_ms {
                Ok(monotonic_ms) => commands::execute(
                    &command,
                    commands::CommandContext {
                        worlds: &self.game.worlds,
                        player_store: &mut self.operations.player_store,
                        persistence: &mut self.operations.persistence,
                        map_fingerprint: self.map.fingerprint(),
                        lanes,
                        metrics: &self.metrics,
                        environment_clock: &mut self.environment_clock,
                        monotonic_ms,
                        schedule_diagnostics,
                    },
                ),
                Err(error) => commands::CommandReply {
                    success: false,
                    text: format!("monotonic clock: {error}"),
                    stop: false,
                },
            };
            self.environment_dirty_revision = self.environment_clock.dirty_revision();
            if command.is_status() {
                use std::fmt::Write as _;
                let _ = write!(reply.text, " game_address={game_address} max_players={max_players} map_fingerprint={:016x} tick_ms={} snapshot_ms={} autosave_seconds={autosave_seconds} protocol_version={PROTOCOL_VERSION} save_version={SAVE_VERSION}", self.map.fingerprint(), TICK.as_millis(), SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL.as_millis());
                reply.text.push_str(" environment_profiles=");
                reply.text.push_str(&self.game.worlds.environment_summary());
            }
            if command.is_metrics() {
                use std::fmt::Write as _;
                reply.text.push_str(" client_traffic=id:bytes_in:bytes_out:decoded_frames:queued_frames:encoding_us:connected_ms");
                for client in &self.connections.clients {
                    if let Some(id) = client.player_id() {
                        let _ = write!(
                            reply.text,
                            " {id}:{}:{}:{}:{}:{}:{}",
                            client.bytes_in,
                            client.bytes_out,
                            client.frames_in,
                            client.frames_out,
                            client.encoding_us,
                            client.connected_at.elapsed().as_millis()
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(id) = request_id {
                self.operations
                    .admin
                    .respond(id, reply.success, &reply.text);
            } else {
                println!(
                    "{} {}",
                    if reply.success { "OK" } else { "ERR" },
                    reply.text
                );
            }
            if command.is_save_or_stop() {
                println!("admin {:?}: {}", command, reply.text);
            }
            self.stop |= reply.stop;
            if self.stop {
                break;
            }
        }
        drop(command_phase);
    }
    fn apply_world_inputs(&mut self) {
        let input_phase = allocations::enter(Phase::Input);
        let input_apply_started = Instant::now();
        self.apply_inputs();
        self.metrics
            .input_apply
            .record(input_apply_started.elapsed());
        drop(input_phase);
    }

    fn commit_ready_transfers(
        &mut self,
        sector_ready: &HashSet<minimium_core::ids::PlayerId>,
    ) -> HashSet<minimium_core::ids::PlayerId> {
        let committed = self.game.worlds.commit_ready_transfers(sector_ready);
        let mut committed_players = HashSet::with_capacity(committed.len());
        if !committed.is_empty() {
            self.scheduler.next_snapshot = Instant::now();
        }
        for transfer in committed {
            committed_players.insert(transfer.player);
            self.send_transition_committed(transfer);
        }
        committed_players
    }

    fn send_transition_committed(&mut self, transfer: crate::world_registry::CommittedTransfer) {
        self.operations
            .player_store
            .set_return_location(transfer.player, transfer.source_location);
        self.game.active_inputs.insert(
            transfer.player,
            minimium_simulation::CharacterInput::default(),
        );
        self.game
            .input_last_received
            .insert(transfer.player, Instant::now());
        let Some(index) = self
            .connections
            .client_indices_by_player
            .get(&transfer.player)
            .copied()
        else {
            return;
        };
        let (clock_sample, environment) = match self
            .environment_state_for_instance(transfer.context.instance(), Instant::now())
        {
            Ok(state) => state,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("could not sample committed environment: {error}");
                if let Some(client) = self.connections.clients.get_mut(index) {
                    client.disconnect_reason =
                        Some(crate::connection::CloseReason::InvalidSequence);
                }
                self.connections.disconnected.push(index);
                return;
            }
        };
        let Some(client) = self.connections.clients.get_mut(index) else {
            return;
        };
        client.replicated_players = minimium_protocol::RemotePlayers::default();
        client.replication_initialized = false;
        let queued = crate::connection::queue_message(
            client,
            &mut self.metrics,
            minimium_protocol::ServerMessage::TransitionCommitted {
                transition_id: transfer.transition_id,
                context: transfer.context,
                map_fingerprint: transfer.map_fingerprint,
                destination: transfer.destination,
                destination_mm: transfer.destination_mm,
                health: transfer.health,
                manifest: transfer.manifest,
                clock_sample,
                environment,
            },
        );
        if !queued {
            self.metrics.dropped_messages = self.metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
            client.disconnect_reason = Some(crate::connection::CloseReason::Backpressure);
            self.connections.disconnected.push(index);
        } else {
            client.mark_environment_sent(transfer.context, clock_sample.revision(), Instant::now());
        }
    }
    fn simulate_tick(&mut self) {
        let simulation_phase = allocations::enter(Phase::Simulation);
        let simulation_started = Instant::now();
        let ready_transfers = crate::sector_streaming::update_with_geography(
            &mut self.game.worlds,
            &mut self.game.sectors,
            &mut self.game.active_sector_tickets,
            &mut self.game.transfer_sector_tickets,
            self.prepared_geography.clone(),
        );
        let committed_players = self.commit_ready_transfers(&ready_transfers.transfers);
        let mut ready_players = ready_transfers.players;
        ready_players.extend(committed_players);
        ready_players.extend(
            self.game
                .active_inputs
                .iter()
                .filter(|(_, input)| input.movement.fly)
                .map(|(id, _)| *id),
        );
        let (worlds, active_inputs) = (&mut self.game.worlds, &self.game.active_inputs);
        let mut collision_stats = CollisionQueryStats::default();
        for (_, instance) in worlds.iter_mut() {
            let manifest = instance.manifest;
            let has_surface_policy = manifest.planet().is_some_and(|planet| {
                manifest.topology() == minimium_world::world::WorldTopology::Planet
                    && planet.kind() == minimium_world::world::PlanetKind::Earth
            });
            let previous = has_surface_policy.then(|| instance.world.snapshot());
            collision_stats.merge(simulation::step_ready_players(
                &mut instance.world,
                active_inputs,
                &ready_players,
                TICK.as_secs_f32(),
                &self.executor,
            ));
            if let Some((batched, batches)) = instance.world.precise_dispatch_stats() {
                self.metrics.record_precise_dispatch(batched, batches);
            }
            if let Some(previous) = previous {
                for player in previous {
                    if active_inputs
                        .get(&player.id)
                        .is_some_and(|input| input.movement.fly)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if let Some(current) = instance.world.player(player.id) {
                        let position_mm = current.position_mm.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                            minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(
                                current
                                    .position
                                    .map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                            )
                        });
                        if !minimium_procgen::can_traverse_surface(
                            manifest,
                            position_mm,
                            self.prepared_geography.as_deref(),
                        ) {
                            instance.world.set_position(player.id, player.position);
                            if let Some(position_mm) = player.position_mm {
                                instance.world.restore_position_mm(player.id, position_mm);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        self.metrics.record_collision_queries(collision_stats);
        self.metrics.simulation.record(simulation_started.elapsed());
        drop(simulation_phase);
        for input in self.game.active_inputs.values_mut() {
            input.jump = false;
        }
    }
    pub(super) fn replicate(&mut self) {
        if Instant::now() >= self.scheduler.next_snapshot {
            let _snapshot_phase = allocations::enter(Phase::Snapshot);
            let snapshot_started = Instant::now();
            let server_time_ms = self
                .scheduler
                .server_started
                .elapsed()
                .as_millis()
                .min(u64::MAX as u128) as u64;
            replication::replicate_snapshots(
                &self.game.worlds,
                &self.executor,
                &mut self.connections.clients,
                &mut self.metrics,
                server_time_ms,
            );
            self.metrics.snapshots = self.metrics.snapshots.saturating_add(1);
            self.metrics
                .snapshot_prep
                .record(snapshot_started.elapsed());
            replication::advance_deadline(
                &mut self.scheduler.next_snapshot,
                SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL,
                &mut self.metrics,
            );
        }
    }
}

use crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry;
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_sectors::{SectorManager, SectorTicket};

    complete: bool,

    player: PlayerId,
    tickets: Vec<SectorTicket>,

    client_ready: bool,

pub(crate) struct SectorReadiness {
    pub(crate) players: HashSet<PlayerId>,
    pub(crate) transfers: HashSet<PlayerId>,

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn update(
    worlds: &mut WorldRegistry,
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    active_tickets: &mut std::collections::HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    transfer_tickets: &mut std::collections::HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
) -> SectorReadiness {
    update_with_geography(worlds, sectors, active_tickets, transfer_tickets, None)
}

pub(crate) fn update_with_geography(
    worlds: &mut WorldRegistry,
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    active_tickets: &mut std::collections::HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    transfer_tickets: &mut std::collections::HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> SectorReadiness {
    let previous_active = std::mem::take(active_tickets);
    let previous_transfers = std::mem::take(transfer_tickets);
    let installed_before = collision::installed_tickets(sectors);

    let active_requests = requests::collect_active_requests(worlds);
    let active_readiness = tickets::reconcile_active_requests(
        sectors,
        active_tickets,
        previous_active,
        active_requests,
    );
    let transfer_requests = requests::collect_transfer_requests(worlds);
    let transfer_readiness = tickets::reconcile_transfer_requests(
        sectors,
        transfer_tickets,
        previous_transfers,
        transfer_requests,
        worlds,
    );

    install::install_pending(worlds, sectors, geography);
    let players = readiness::collect_ready_players(sectors, active_readiness);
    let transfers = readiness::collect_ready_transfers(sectors, transfer_readiness);

    let installed_after = collision::installed_tickets(sectors);
    let changed = collision::changed_instances(&installed_before, &installed_after);
    collision::update_changed_instances(worlds, sectors, changed);
    SectorReadiness { players, transfers }
}

use super::SectorPayload;
use crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry;
use minimium_sectors::{SectorManager, SectorTicket};
use minimium_world::world::{Aabb, MapBox, MapTriangle, WorldInstanceId};
use std::collections::HashSet;

pub(super) fn installed_tickets(sectors: &SectorManager<SectorPayload>) -> HashSet<SectorTicket> {
    sectors.installed().map(|(ticket, _, _)| ticket).collect()
}

pub(super) fn changed_instances(
    installed_before: &HashSet<SectorTicket>,
    installed_after: &HashSet<SectorTicket>,
) -> HashSet<WorldInstanceId> {
    installed_before
        .symmetric_difference(installed_after)
        .map(|ticket| ticket.instance())
        .collect()
}

pub(super) fn update_changed_instances(
    worlds: &mut WorldRegistry,
    sectors: &SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    changed: HashSet<WorldInstanceId>,
) {
    for instance in changed {
        install_instance_collision(worlds, sectors, instance);
    }
}

fn install_instance_collision(
    worlds: &mut WorldRegistry,
    sectors: &SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
) {
    let (colliders, surfaces) = prepare_collision_geometry(sectors, instance);
    if let Some(owner) = worlds.get_mut(instance) {
        owner.world.replace_streamed_collision(colliders, surfaces);
    }
}

fn prepare_collision_geometry(
    sectors: &SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
) -> (Vec<Aabb>, Vec<MapTriangle>) {
    let mut colliders = Vec::new();
    let mut seen_boxes = HashSet::new();
    let mut surfaces = Vec::new();
    let mut seen_triangles = HashSet::new();
    for (ticket, _, payload) in sectors.installed() {
        if ticket.instance() != instance {
            continue;
        }
        for map_box in &payload.boxes {
            if map_box.solid && seen_boxes.insert(box_geometry_key(*map_box)) {
                colliders.push(Aabb::from_center_size(map_box.center, map_box.size));
            }
        }
        for triangle in &payload.triangles {
            if triangle.solid && seen_triangles.insert(triangle_geometry_key(*triangle)) {
                surfaces.push(*triangle);
            }
        }
    }
    (colliders, surfaces)
}

fn box_geometry_key(map_box: MapBox) -> [u32; 6] {
    [
        map_box.center[0].to_bits(),
        map_box.center[1].to_bits(),
        map_box.center[2].to_bits(),
        map_box.size[0].to_bits(),
        map_box.size[1].to_bits(),
        map_box.size[2].to_bits(),
    ]
}

fn triangle_geometry_key(triangle: MapTriangle) -> [u32; 9] {
    let [a, b, c] = triangle.vertices;
    [
        a[0].to_bits(),
        a[1].to_bits(),
        a[2].to_bits(),
        b[0].to_bits(),
        b[1].to_bits(),
        b[2].to_bits(),
        c[0].to_bits(),
        c[1].to_bits(),
        c[2].to_bits(),
    ]
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/sector_streaming/install.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="32" bytes="1135" original_lines="32" original_bytes="1135" minified="false" sha256="7631a9bf73fd1a0ed96e6a5eb2bd6df14d1c0300e0be34bf1b5e56bc227e5de9">>>
use super::SectorPayload;
use crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry;
use minimium_sectors::{InstallResult, SectorManager};
use minimium_world::world::SectorRevision;
use std::sync::Arc;

const MAX_INSTALLS_PER_TICK: usize = 32;

pub(super) fn install_pending(
    worlds: &WorldRegistry,
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
) {
    for _ in 0..MAX_INSTALLS_PER_TICK {
        let Some(ticket) = sectors.begin_next() else {
            break;
        };
        let Some(instance) = worlds.get(ticket.instance()) else {
            continue;
        };
        let payload = Arc::new(minimium_procgen::materialize_world_sector_with_geography(
            &instance.map,
            instance.manifest,
            ticket.key(),
            geography.clone(),
        ));
        let revision = SectorRevision::new(1).expect("initial sector revision is nonzero");
        if sectors.install_data(ticket, revision, payload) == InstallResult::Installed {
            let _ = sectors.install_collision(ticket);
        }
    }
}

use super::{PlayerReadiness, SectorPayload, TransferReadiness};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_sectors::SectorManager;
use std::collections::HashSet;

pub(super) fn collect_ready_players(
    sectors: &SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    readiness: Vec<PlayerReadiness>,
) -> HashSet<PlayerId> {
    readiness
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|request| {
            (request.complete
                && request
                    .tickets
                    .iter()
                    .all(|ticket| sectors.collision_ready(*ticket)))
            .then_some(request.player)
        })
        .collect()
}

pub(super) fn collect_ready_transfers(
    sectors: &SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    readiness: Vec<TransferReadiness>,
) -> HashSet<PlayerId> {
    readiness
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|request| {
            (request.client_ready
                && request.complete
                && !request.tickets.is_empty()
                && request
                    .tickets
                    .iter()
                    .all(|ticket| sectors.collision_ready(*ticket)))
            .then_some(request.player)
        })
        .collect()
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/sector_streaming/requests.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="40" bytes="1618" original_lines="40" original_bytes="1618" minified="false" sha256="f028540886230d1768a6999b4f3636d1aff1e80c1fc30e3acfefec5357c6aeae">>>
use super::{PlayerSectorRequest, TransferSectorRequest};
use crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry;

pub(super) fn collect_active_requests(worlds: &WorldRegistry) -> Vec<PlayerSectorRequest> {
    let mut requests = Vec::new();
    for (instance_id, instance) in worlds.iter() {
        let manifest = instance.manifest;
        let mut players = instance.world.snapshot();
        players.sort_unstable_by_key(|player| player.id);
        requests.extend(players.into_iter().map(|player| PlayerSectorRequest {
            player: player.id,
            instance: instance_id,
            keys: minimium_procgen::sector_neighborhood_for(manifest, player.position),
            generation: manifest.generation().revision(),
            content: manifest.content_revision(),
        }));
    }
    requests.sort_unstable_by_key(|request| request.player);
    requests
}

pub(super) fn collect_transfer_requests(worlds: &WorldRegistry) -> Vec<TransferSectorRequest> {
    let mut requests: Vec<_> = worlds
        .pending_transfer_sector_requests()
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(player, instance, position, client_ready)| {
            let manifest = worlds.get(instance)?.manifest;
            Some(TransferSectorRequest {
                player,
                instance,
                position,
                client_ready,
                generation: manifest.generation().revision(),
                content: manifest.content_revision(),
            })
        })
        .collect();
    requests.sort_unstable_by_key(|request| request.player);
    requests
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/sector_streaming/tickets.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="161" bytes="5679" original_lines="161" original_bytes="5679" minified="false" sha256="0b55e12d933cb6e87dc51ae7bcdc26a88ea099e28df81deca4155e9142087644">>>
use super::{
    PlayerReadiness, PlayerSectorRequest, SectorPayload, TransferReadiness, TransferSectorRequest,
};
use crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry;
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_sectors::{RequestError, SectorManager, SectorTicket};
use minimium_world::world::{GenerationRevision, SectorKey, WorldContentRevision, WorldInstanceId};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

pub(super) fn reconcile_active_requests(
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    active_tickets: &mut HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    previous_active: HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    requests: Vec<PlayerSectorRequest>,
) -> Vec<PlayerReadiness> {
    let mut previous_active = previous_active;
    let mut readiness = Vec::with_capacity(requests.len());
    for request in requests {
        let previous = previous_active.remove(&request.player).unwrap_or_default();
        let (tickets, complete) = reconcile_tickets(
            sectors,
            previous,
            request.instance,
            request.keys,
            request.generation,
            request.content,
        );
        active_tickets.insert(request.player, tickets.clone());
        readiness.push(PlayerReadiness {
            player: request.player,
            tickets,
            complete,
        });
    }
    release_cached_tickets(sectors, previous_active);
    readiness
}

pub(super) fn reconcile_transfer_requests(
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    transfer_tickets: &mut HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    previous_transfers: HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
    requests: Vec<TransferSectorRequest>,
    worlds: &WorldRegistry,
) -> Vec<TransferReadiness> {
    let mut previous_transfers = previous_transfers;
    let mut readiness = Vec::with_capacity(requests.len());
    for request in requests {
        let previous = previous_transfers
            .remove(&request.player)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let manifest = worlds
            .get(request.instance)
            .map(|instance| instance.manifest);
        let Some(manifest) = manifest else {
            release_tickets(sectors, previous);
            readiness.push(TransferReadiness {
                player: request.player,
                tickets: Vec::new(),
                complete: false,
                client_ready: request.client_ready,
            });
            continue;
        };
        let (tickets, complete) = reconcile_tickets(
            sectors,
            previous,
            request.instance,
            minimium_procgen::sector_neighborhood_for(manifest, request.position),
            request.generation,
            request.content,
        );
        transfer_tickets.insert(request.player, tickets.clone());
        readiness.push(TransferReadiness {
            player: request.player,
            tickets,
            complete,
            client_ready: request.client_ready,
        });
    }
    release_cached_tickets(sectors, previous_transfers);
    readiness
}

fn reconcile_tickets(
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    previous: Vec<SectorTicket>,
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    keys: Vec<SectorKey>,
    generation: GenerationRevision,
    content: WorldContentRevision,
) -> (Vec<SectorTicket>, bool) {
    let mut seen = HashSet::with_capacity(keys.len());
    let desired: Vec<_> = keys.into_iter().filter(|key| seen.insert(*key)).collect();
    let desired_keys: HashSet<_> = desired.iter().copied().collect();
    let mut retained = HashMap::with_capacity(previous.len());
    for ticket in previous {
        let matches = ticket.instance() == instance
            && ticket.generation() == generation
            && ticket.content_revision() == content
            && desired_keys.contains(&ticket.key());
        if matches {
            if let Some(displaced) = retained.insert(ticket.key(), ticket) {
                sectors.unpin(displaced);
            }
        } else {
            sectors.unpin(ticket);
        }
    }

    let mut tickets = Vec::with_capacity(desired.len());
    let mut complete = true;
    for key in desired {
        if let Some(ticket) = retained.remove(&key) {
            tickets.push(ticket);
            continue;
        }
        let Some(ticket) = request_sector(sectors, instance, key, generation, content) else {
            complete = false;
            continue;
        };
        if sectors.pin(ticket) {
            tickets.push(ticket);
        } else {
            complete = false;
        }
    }
    complete &= tickets.len() == desired_keys.len();
    (tickets, complete)
}

fn release_cached_tickets(
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    cached: HashMap<PlayerId, Vec<SectorTicket>>,
) {
    for tickets in cached.into_values() {
        release_tickets(sectors, tickets);
    }
}

fn release_tickets(sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>, tickets: Vec<SectorTicket>) {
    for ticket in tickets {
        sectors.unpin(ticket);
    }
}

fn request_sector(
    sectors: &mut SectorManager<SectorPayload>,
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    key: SectorKey,
    generation: GenerationRevision,
    content: WorldContentRevision,
) -> Option<SectorTicket> {
    match sectors.request(instance, key, generation, content) {
        Ok(ticket) => Some(ticket),
        Err(RequestError::CacheFull) if sectors.evict_oldest() => {
            sectors.request(instance, key, generation, content).ok()
        }
        Err(_) => None,
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/send.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="55" bytes="2148" original_lines="55" original_bytes="2148" minified="false" sha256="1e868213754e4cd53e7049136b812e057c2dfae384b474c331a798b9c507caf3">>>
use crate::{
    connection::{queue_message, Client, CloseReason},
    metrics::RuntimeMetrics,
};
use minimium_protocol::ServerMessage;
use std::time::Instant;

const MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL: usize = 16 * 1024;
const MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_POLL: usize = 256 * 1024;

pub(crate) fn send_clients(
    clients: &mut [Client],
    metrics: &mut RuntimeMetrics,
    disconnected: &mut Vec<usize>,
    first_write_client: &mut usize,
) {
    let client_count = clients.len();
    let mut write_budget = MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_POLL;
    for offset in 0..client_count {
        let index = (*first_write_client + offset) % client_count;
        let client = &mut clients[index];
        if client.close_deadline().is_none() {
            if let Some(health) = client.pending_health_update {
                if !queue_message(client, metrics, ServerMessage::HealthUpdate(health)) {
                    metrics.dropped_messages = metrics.dropped_messages.saturating_add(1);
                } else {
                    client.pending_health_update = None;
                }
            }
        }
        metrics.max_client_input_bytes = metrics.max_client_input_bytes.max(client.input.len());
        metrics.max_client_output_bytes = metrics
            .max_client_output_bytes
            .max(client.pending_output_bytes());
        let flushed = client.flush(write_budget.min(MAX_WRITE_BYTES_PER_CLIENT_PER_POLL));
        write_budget -= flushed.written;
        metrics.bytes_out += flushed.written as u64;
        client.bytes_out += flushed.written as u64;
        if flushed.error.is_some() {
            client.disconnect_reason = Some(CloseReason::WriteError);
        }
        if flushed.error.is_some()
            || client.close_deadline().is_some_and(|deadline| {
                client.pending_output_bytes() == 0 || Instant::now() >= deadline
            })
        {
            disconnected.push(index);
        }
    }
    if client_count > 0 {
        *first_write_client = (*first_write_client + 1) % client_count;
    } else {
        *first_write_client = 0;
    }
}

];

static SERVER_REGISTRY: OnceLock<CommandRegistry<ServerCommand, String>> = OnceLock::new();

fn server_registry() -> &'static CommandRegistry<ServerCommand, String> {
    SERVER_REGISTRY.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut registry = CommandRegistry::default();
        registry.register(SERVER_SPECS);
        registry
    })
}

fn parse_server_spec(arguments: &[&str]) -> Result<ServerCommand, String> {
    let [command, tail] = arguments else {
        return Err(String::from("invalid command"));
    };
    if command.starts_with("time") {
        let joined = format!("{command} {tail}");
        let words = joined.split_whitespace().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        return TimeCommand::parse(&words).map(ServerCommand::Time);
    }
    if !tail.is_empty() {
        return Err(String::from("command takes no arguments"));
    }
    match *command {
        "help" => Ok(ServerCommand::Help),
        "status" => Ok(ServerCommand::Status),
        "players list" => Ok(ServerCommand::Players),
        "metrics show" => Ok(ServerCommand::Metrics),
        "world save" => Ok(ServerCommand::Save),
        "stop" => Ok(ServerCommand::Stop),
        _ => Err(String::from("invalid command")),
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ServerCommand {
    Help,
    Status,
    Players,
    Metrics,
    Save,
    Stop,
    Time(TimeCommand),
    /// A validated administrative line owned by its registering server module.
    Registered(String),
}

impl ServerCommand {
    pub fn parse(line: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let words: Vec<_> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
        if words.is_empty() {
            return Err("empty command".into());
        }
        if let Some(parsed) = server_registry().parse(line, &words) {
            match parsed {
                Ok(command) => return Ok(command),
                Err((_, error)) if words[0] == "time" => return Err(error),
                Err(_) => {}
            }
        }
        (line.len() <= 512 && line.chars().all(|c| !c.is_control()))
            .then(|| Self::Registered(line.trim().to_owned()))
            .ok_or_else(|| "invalid command; use `help`".into())
    }

    pub const fn is_status(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Status)
    }

    pub const fn is_metrics(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Metrics)
    }

    pub const fn is_save_or_stop(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Save | Self::Stop)
    }
}

pub fn server_help() -> String {
    server_registry()
        .commands()
        .iter()
        .filter(|spec| spec.name != "time")
        .map(|spec| spec.usage)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" | ")
}

use crate::executor::Executor;
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_simulation::{step_batch, CharacterInput, CollisionQueryStats, World};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn step_players(
    world: &mut World,
    inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
    delta_seconds: f32,
    executor: &Executor,
) -> CollisionQueryStats {
    world.step_players_with(
        inputs,
        delta_seconds,
        executor.lane_count(),
        |batches, geometry, delta| {
            executor.map(batches, move |batch| step_batch(batch, &geometry, delta))
        },
    )
}

pub(crate) fn step_ready_players(
    world: &mut World,
    inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
    ready_players: &HashSet<PlayerId>,
    delta_seconds: f32,
    executor: &Executor,
) -> CollisionQueryStats {
    world.step_players_with_selected(
        inputs,
        Some(ready_players),
        delta_seconds,
        executor.lane_count(),
        |batches, geometry, delta| {
            executor.map(batches, move |batch| step_batch(batch, &geometry, delta))
        },
    )
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn fixed_input_outcome(lanes: usize) -> Vec<(u64, [u32; 3], [u32; 3], bool)> {
        let mut world = World::default();
        let mut inputs = HashMap::new();
        for number in 1..=32 {
            let id = PlayerId::new(number);
            world.join_at(id, format!("Bot{number}"), [number as f32 * 4.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
            inputs.insert(
                id,
                CharacterInput {
                    direction: match number % 4 {
                        0 => [1.0, 0.0],
                        1 => [0.0, 1.0],
                        2 => [-1.0, 0.0],
                        _ => [0.0, -1.0],
                    },
                    jump: number % 3 == 0,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            );
        }
        let executor = Executor::new(lanes);
        for _ in 0..40 {
            step_players(&mut world, &inputs, 0.05, &executor);
        }
        let mut players = world.snapshot();
        players.sort_unstable_by_key(|player| player.id);
        players
            .into_iter()
            .map(|player| {
                (
                    player.id.get(),
                    player.position.map(f32::to_bits),
                    player.velocity.map(f32::to_bits),
                    player.grounded,
                )
            })
            .collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn fixed_32_player_inputs_have_identical_outcomes_for_lane_counts() {
        let baseline = fixed_input_outcome(1);
        assert_eq!(baseline, fixed_input_outcome(2));
        let auto_lanes = std::thread::available_parallelism()
            .map(usize::from)
            .unwrap_or(1)
            .clamp(1, 64);
        assert_eq!(baseline, fixed_input_outcome(auto_lanes));
    }
}

use crate::{

    composition::{WorldComposer, WorldCompositionRequest, WorldDefinition},
    config::ServerConfig,

use minimium_environment::time::SavedClockState;

use minimium_world::world::{

pub(crate) struct Startup {
    pub(crate) map: WorldMap,
    pub(crate) worlds: Option<Vec<WorldDefinition>>,
    pub(crate) player_store: PlayerStore,
    pub(crate) persistence: PersistenceWorker,

    pub(crate) game_address: std::net::SocketAddr,

    pub(crate) admin: AdminServer,

    pub(crate) saved_clock: Option<SavedClockState>,
    pub(crate) prepared_geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
}

pub(crate) fn initialize(
    config: &ServerConfig,
    world_composer: WorldComposer,
) -> Result<Startup, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let data_dir = &config.data_dir;
    let requested_seed = config.seed;
    let map_path = config.map_path.as_deref();
    let world_definition_path = config.world_definition_path.as_deref();
    let planet_config_path = config.planet_config_path.as_deref();
    let bind_address = config.bind_address.as_str();
    let game_port = config.game_port;
    let max_players = config.max_players;
    let bind_addresses: Vec<_> = (bind_address, game_port).to_socket_addrs()?.collect();
    if bind_addresses.is_empty() {
        return Err("bind address resolved to no addresses".into());
    }

    let data_lock = ServerDataLock::acquire(data_dir)?;
    if config.environment_config_path.is_some()
        && ["world.seed", "world.planet.ron", "world.snapshot"]
            .iter()
            .any(|name| data_dir.join(name).exists())
    {
        return Err("--environment-config initializes a new world only; use time commands for an existing world".into());
    }
    let environment_config = config
        .environment_config_path
        .as_deref()
        .map(environment::load_config)
        .transpose()?
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let seed_path = data_dir.join("world.seed");
    let existing_seed = match minimium_platform::files::read_bounded_file(&seed_path, 64) {
        Ok(bytes) => Some(
            std::str::from_utf8(&bytes)
                .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid world.seed"))?
                .trim()
                .parse::<u128>()
                .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid world.seed"))?,
        ),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
        Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
    };
    let composition = world_composer(WorldCompositionRequest {
        data_dir: data_dir.to_path_buf(),
        requested_seed,
        existing_seed,
        map_path: map_path.map(Path::to_path_buf),
        world_definition_path: world_definition_path.map(Path::to_path_buf),
        planet_config_path: planet_config_path.map(Path::to_path_buf),
    })?;
    let seed = composition.seed;
    let map = composition.primary_map;
    let generated_worlds = composition.worlds;
    let migration_worlds = composition.migration_worlds;
    let planet_definition = composition.planet_definition;
    let prepared_geography = composition.prepared_geography;

    remove_if_exists(&data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_FILE))?;
    remove_if_exists(&data_dir.join(SHUTDOWN_OWNER_FILE))?;
    let primary = WorldInstanceId::new(1).expect("primary instance identifier is nonzero");
    let world_maps = generated_worlds
        .as_ref()
        .map(|worlds| {
            worlds
                .iter()
                .map(|world| (world.instance, world.map.clone(), world.manifest))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        })
        .unwrap_or_else(|| vec![(primary, map.clone(), legacy_manifest(1, map.fingerprint()))]);
    if let Some(migration_worlds) = &migration_worlds {
        migrate_legacy_demo(
            data_dir,
            generated_worlds.as_ref().expect("generated worlds exist"),
            migration_worlds,
        )?;
    }
    let loaded_state = PlayerStore::load(data_dir, &world_maps)?;
    if let Some(version) = loaded_state.source_version.filter(|version| *version < 8) {
        println!("legacy world snapshot v{version}: initializing world clock as real_time");
    }
    let saved_clock = loaded_state.saved_clock;
    let mut player_store = loaded_state.player_store;
    if let Some(definition) = planet_definition {
        let resolved_path = data_dir.join("world.planet.ron");
        if !resolved_path.exists() {
            minimium_platform::files::atomic_write_file(
                &data_dir.join("world.planet.ron.tmp"),
                &resolved_path,
                &definition,
            )?;
        }
    }
    if map_path.is_none() && world_definition_path.is_none() && existing_seed.is_none() {
        minimium_platform::files::atomic_write_file(
            &data_dir.join("world.seed.tmp"),
            &seed_path,
            format!("{seed}\n").as_bytes(),
        )?;
    }
    player_store.reserve_active(max_players);
    let persistence = PersistenceWorker::spawn(data_dir.to_path_buf())?;
    let next_player = player_store.next_player_id()?;
    let game_listener = TcpListener::bind(bind_addresses.as_slice())?;
    let game_address = game_listener.local_addr()?;
    let admin_listener = TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))?;
    game_listener.set_nonblocking(true)?;
    admin_listener.set_nonblocking(true)?;
    let endpoint = ServerEndpoint {
        game_port: game_address.port(),
        admin_port: admin_listener.local_addr()?.port(),
        token: match env::var("MINIMIUM_ADMIN_TOKEN") {
            Ok(token)
                if token.len() == 64 && token.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()) =>
            {
                token
            }
            Ok(_) => return Err("invalid inherited admin token".into()),
            Err(env::VarError::NotPresent) => new_admin_token()?,
            Err(_) => return Err("invalid inherited admin token".into()),
        },
    };
    ServerEndpoint::write(data_dir, &endpoint)?;
    let endpoint_guard = EndpointGuard {
        data_dir: PathBuf::from(data_dir),
        endpoint: endpoint.clone(),
    };
    let admin = AdminServer::new(admin_listener, endpoint.token.clone())?;

    Ok(Startup {
        map,
        worlds: generated_worlds,
        player_store,
        persistence,
        next_player,
        game_listener,
        game_address,
        endpoint,
        endpoint_guard,
        data_lock,
        admin,
        environment_config,
        saved_clock,
        prepared_geography,
    })
}

fn migrate_legacy_demo(
    data_dir: &Path,
    generated_worlds: &[WorldDefinition],
    migration_worlds: &[WorldDefinition],
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let old_maps: Vec<_> = migration_worlds
        .iter()
        .map(|world| (world.instance, world.map.clone(), world.manifest))
        .collect();
    let mut players = PlayerStore::load(data_dir, &old_maps)?.player_store;
    players.migrate_legacy_planet_positions();
    let mut registry =
        crate::world_registry::WorldRegistry::try_from_world_definitions(generated_worlds.to_vec())
            .map_err(|error| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    format!("generated world registry is invalid: {error:?}"),
                )
            })?;
    registry
        .restore_sector_states(players.sector_states())
        .map_err(|error| {
            io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                format!("legacy sector state: {error:?}"),
            )
        })?;
    let saved_clock = environment::initial_saved_clock_state().map_err(|error| {
        io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!("environment clock: {error}"),
        )
    })?;
    let input = registry.snapshot_for_save(registry.primary().map.fingerprint())?;
    let snapshot = players.save_snapshot(input, saved_clock)?;
    let source = data_dir.join("world.snapshot");
    let backup = data_dir.join("world.snapshot.legacy-v1");
    if !backup.exists() {
        std::fs::copy(&source, &backup)?;
    }
    snapshot.write(data_dir)
}

fn legacy_manifest(id: u128, fingerprint: u64) -> WorldManifest {
    use minimium_world::world::{GenerationRevision, GenerationSpec, GeneratorDigest, WorldSeed};
    let generation = GenerationSpec::new(
        WorldSeed::new(0),
        GenerationRevision::new(1).expect("legacy generator revision is nonzero"),
        1,
    )
    .expect("legacy position quantum is nonzero");
    WorldManifest::new(
        WorldDefinitionId::new(id).expect("legacy definition ID is nonzero"),
        WorldTopology::Dungeon,
        generation,
        WorldContentRevision::new(1).expect("legacy content revision is nonzero"),
        GeneratorDigest::legacy_map_fingerprint(fingerprint),
    )
}

fn registry_from_sample(worlds: Vec<minimium_game_sample::GeneratedWorld>) -> WorldRegistry {
    WorldRegistry::from_world_definitions(
        worlds
            .into_iter()
            .map(|world| WorldDefinition {
                instance: world.instance,
                manifest: world.manifest,
                map: world.map,
                portal: world.portal.map(|portal| WorldPortal {
                    position: portal.position,
                    target_instance: portal.target_instance,
                    destination: portal.destination,
                }),
            })
            .collect(),
    )

fn temporary_directory(label: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let nonce = SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .unwrap()
        .as_nanos();
    let directory = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
        "minimium-epic003-{label}-{}-{nonce}",
        std::process::id()
    ));
    fs::create_dir(&directory).unwrap();
    directory
}

fn saved_clock() -> SavedClockState {
    let utc = WorldTimeMs::new(1_800_000_000_000).unwrap();
    SavedClockState::new(
        ClockId::MVP,
        ClockRevision::INITIAL,
        ClockMode::RealTime,
        utc,
        utc,
        TimeScalePpm::ONE_X,
        OfflinePolicy::Pause,
    )
    .unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn v8_save_restores_instance_position_and_portal_return_location() {
    let generated = minimium_game_sample::generate_demo_worlds().unwrap();
    let primary = generated[0].instance;
    let dungeon = generated[1].instance;
    let mut registry = registry_from_sample(generated.to_vec());
    let mut store = PlayerStore::default();
    let profile = PlayerProfileId::from_bytes([0x35; 16]);
    let mut next_id = 1;
    let claimed = store
        .claim(
            profile,
            &mut next_id,
            generated[0].map.spawn(),
            None,
            primary,
            CharacterGravity::Radial { center: [0.0; 3] },
        )
        .unwrap();
    let position = [14.25, 0.0, 6.5];
    registry
        .join_at(dungeon, claimed.id, "Traveler".into(), position, 73)
        .unwrap();
    let return_location = WorldLocation::new(
        primary,
        Position3Mm::new(0, 99_240, 12_400),
        WorldOrientationQ30::IDENTITY,
    );
    store.set_return_location(claimed.id, return_location);

    let worlds = registry
        .iter()
        .map(|(instance, owner)| (instance, (*owner.map).clone(), owner.manifest))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let input = registry
        .snapshot_for_save(generated[0].map.fingerprint())
        .unwrap();
    let snapshot = store.save_snapshot(input, saved_clock()).unwrap();
    let directory = temporary_directory("v8");
    snapshot.write(&directory).unwrap();

    let mut restored = PlayerStore::load(&directory, &worlds).unwrap().player_store;
    let mut next_id = restored.next_player_id().unwrap();
    let player = restored
        .claim(
            profile,
            &mut next_id,
            [0.0; 3],
            None,
            primary,
            CharacterGravity::Radial { center: [0.0; 3] },
        )
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(player.id, claimed.id);
    assert_eq!(player.location.instance(), dungeon);
    assert_eq!(player.location.position().coordinates(), [14_250, 0, 6_500]);
    assert_eq!(player.return_location, return_location);
    assert_eq!(player.health, 73);
    fs::remove_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn v8_roundtrip_keeps_a_live_planet_position_clear_after_quantization() {
    let generated = minimium_game_sample::generate_demo_worlds().unwrap();
    let primary = generated[0].instance;
    let gravity = CharacterGravity::Radial { center: [0.0; 3] };
    let position = [0.0, 99.43038, 10.75904];
    let mut registry = registry_from_sample(generated.to_vec());
    let mut store = PlayerStore::default();
    let profile = PlayerProfileId::from_bytes([0xa6; 16]);
    let mut next_id = 1;
    let claimed = store
        .claim(
            profile,
            &mut next_id,
            generated[0].map.spawn(),
            None,
            primary,
            gravity,
        )
        .unwrap();
    registry
        .join_at(primary, claimed.id, "Traveler".into(), position, 73)
        .unwrap();
    let live_player = registry
        .for_player(claimed.id)
        .unwrap()
        .world
        .player(claimed.id)
        .unwrap();
    store
        .update_from_player(live_player, primary, gravity)
        .unwrap();
    store.set_return_location(
        claimed.id,
        world_location::world_location(primary, position, gravity),
    );

    let worlds = registry
        .iter()
        .map(|(instance, owner)| (instance, (*owner.map).clone(), owner.manifest))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let input = registry
        .snapshot_for_save(generated[0].map.fingerprint())
        .unwrap();
    let snapshot = store.save_snapshot(input, saved_clock()).unwrap();
    let directory = temporary_directory("radial-contact");
    snapshot.write(&directory).unwrap();

    let mut restored = PlayerStore::load(&directory, &worlds).unwrap().player_store;
    let mut next_id = restored.next_player_id().unwrap();
    let player = restored
        .claim(profile, &mut next_id, [0.0; 3], None, primary, gravity)
        .unwrap();
    let restored_position = player
        .location
        .position()
        .coordinates()
        .map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0);
    assert!(generated[0]
        .map
        .can_place_player_with_gravity(restored_position, gravity));
    assert_eq!(
        world_location::world_location(primary, position, gravity).position(),
        player.location.position()
    );
    assert_eq!(player.health, 73);
    fs::remove_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn v2_and_v3_snapshots_migrate_only_to_the_matching_legacy_world() {
    let map = minimium_world::world::WorldMap::from_parts(
        [0.0; 3],
        vec![minimium_world::world::MapBox {
            center: [4.0, 4.0, 4.0],
            size: [1.0; 3],
            color: [0.5; 3],
            solid: false,
        }],
        Vec::new(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let registry = WorldRegistry::legacy_primary(map.clone());
    let (instance, owner) = registry.iter().next().unwrap();
    let worlds = vec![(instance, map.clone(), owner.manifest)];
    let profile = PlayerProfileId::from_bytes([0x71; 16]);

    for version in [2, 3] {
        let directory = temporary_directory("legacy");
        let health = if version == 2 { "" } else { "\t73" };
        let snapshot = format!(
            "MINIMIUM_WORLD\t{version}\t{:016x}\n17\t{}\tLegacy\t1.25\t2.5\t3.75{health}\n",
            map.fingerprint(),
            profile.to_hex()
        );
        fs::write(directory.join("world.snapshot"), snapshot).unwrap();
        let mut restored = PlayerStore::load(&directory, &worlds).unwrap().player_store;
        let mut next_id = restored.next_player_id().unwrap();
        let player = restored
            .claim(
                profile,
                &mut next_id,
                [0.0; 3],
                None,
                instance,
                CharacterGravity::FixedY,
            )
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(player.location.instance(), instance);
        assert_eq!(
            player.location.position().coordinates(),
            [1_250, 2_500, 3_750]
        );
        assert_eq!(player.return_location, player.location);
        assert_eq!(
            player.health,
            if version == 2 { PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH } else { 73 }
        );
        fs::remove_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/terminal.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="89" bytes="2878" original_lines="89" original_bytes="2878" minified="false" sha256="ea89de8e6777feea2cdafd26bc9a69fa7e51b8515c845d43749e649537d2203f">>>
use crate::server_command::ServerCommand;
use std::{
    io::{self, Read},
    sync::mpsc::{self, Receiver, SyncSender, TrySendError},
    thread,
};

const TERMINAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY: usize = 64;
const MAX_TERMINAL_LINE_BYTES: usize = 512;
const READ_BUFFER_BYTES: usize = 256;

pub fn spawn() -> io::Result<Receiver<ServerCommand>> {
    let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel(TERMINAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY);
    thread::Builder::new()
        .name("minimium-console-input".to_owned())
        .spawn(move || read_commands(sender))?;
    Ok(receiver)
}

fn read_commands(sender: SyncSender<ServerCommand>) {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut input = stdin.lock();
    let mut buffer = [0u8; READ_BUFFER_BYTES];
    let mut line = Vec::with_capacity(MAX_TERMINAL_LINE_BYTES);
    let mut overlong = false;

    loop {
        let count = match input.read(&mut buffer) {
            Ok(0) => {
                if !line.is_empty() || overlong {
                    submit_line(&sender, &mut line, &mut overlong);
                }
                return;
            }
            Ok(count) => count,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("ERR terminal input: {error}");
                return;
            }
        };

        for byte in buffer[..count].iter().copied() {
            if byte == b'\n' {
                submit_line(&sender, &mut line, &mut overlong);
            } else if !overlong {
                if line.len() == MAX_TERMINAL_LINE_BYTES {
                    line.clear();
                    overlong = true;
                } else {
                    line.push(byte);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn submit_line(sender: &SyncSender<ServerCommand>, line: &mut Vec<u8>, overlong: &mut bool) {
    if *overlong {
        eprintln!("ERR terminal command exceeds 512 bytes");
        line.clear();
        *overlong = false;
        return;
    }
    if line.last() == Some(&b'\r') {
        line.pop();
    }
    let command_line = match std::str::from_utf8(line) {
        Ok(command_line) => command_line,
        Err(_) => {
            eprintln!("ERR terminal command is not UTF-8");
            line.clear();
            return;
        }
    };
    if command_line.trim().is_empty() {
        line.clear();
        return;
    }
    match ServerCommand::parse(command_line) {
        Ok(command) => match sender.try_send(command) {
            Ok(()) => {}
            Err(TrySendError::Full(_)) => eprintln!("ERR command queue full; command dropped"),
            Err(TrySendError::Disconnected(_)) => eprintln!("ERR command queue closed"),
        },
        Err(error) => eprintln!("ERR command: {error}"),
    }
    line.clear();
}

<<<FILE path="crates/server-runtime/src/world_registry/accessors.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="89" bytes="3027" original_lines="89" original_bytes="3027" minified="false" sha256="95e11cff75f904d9d481a8a021b53827c5acd7fc30a77dcd3efb0d44cd320aaf">>>
use super::*;
use crate::storage::{WorldSaveEntry, WorldSaveInput};
use std::io;

impl WorldRegistry {
    pub(crate) fn snapshot_for_save(
        &self,
        expected_primary_fingerprint: u64,
    ) -> io::Result<WorldSaveInput> {
        let primary = self.primary();
        let primary_map_fingerprint = primary.map.fingerprint();
        if primary_map_fingerprint != expected_primary_fingerprint {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                "primary map fingerprint changed while saving",
            ));
        }
        let worlds = self
            .iter()
            .map(|(instance, owner)| WorldSaveEntry {
                instance,
                map_fingerprint: owner.map.fingerprint(),
                manifest: owner.manifest,
                gravity: owner.world.gravity(),
                players: owner.world.snapshot(),
            })
            .collect();
        Ok(WorldSaveInput {
            primary_instance: self.primary_id(),
            primary_map_fingerprint,
            primary_manifest: primary.manifest,
            worlds,
            sector_states: self.sector_states(),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn primary_id(&self) -> WorldInstanceId {
        self.primary
    }

    pub(crate) fn primary(&self) -> &WorldInstance {
        self.instances
            .get(&self.primary)
            .expect("primary world remains registered")
    }

    pub(crate) fn get(&self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> Option<&WorldInstance> {
        self.instances.get(&instance)
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_mut(&mut self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> Option<&mut WorldInstance> {
        self.instances.get_mut(&instance)
    }

    pub(crate) fn for_player(&self, id: PlayerId) -> Option<&WorldInstance> {
        self.instances.get(&self.instance_for_player(id)?)
    }

    pub(crate) fn for_player_mut(&mut self, id: PlayerId) -> Option<&mut WorldInstance> {
        let instance = self.instance_for_player(id)?;
        self.instances.get_mut(&instance)
    }

    pub(crate) fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (WorldInstanceId, &WorldInstance)> {
        self.instances.iter().map(|(id, world)| (*id, world))
    }

    pub(crate) fn iter_mut(
        &mut self,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (WorldInstanceId, &mut WorldInstance)> {
        self.instances.iter_mut().map(|(id, world)| (*id, world))
    }
}

impl WorldRegistry {
    pub(crate) fn manifest_for_player(&self, id: PlayerId) -> Option<WorldManifest> {
        Some(self.for_player(id)?.manifest)
    }

    pub(crate) fn map_for_instance(&self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> Option<&WorldMap> {
        self.instances
            .get(&instance)
            .map(|owner| owner.map.as_ref())
    }

    pub(crate) fn map_fingerprint_for_instance(&self, instance: WorldInstanceId) -> Option<u64> {
        self.map_for_instance(instance).map(WorldMap::fingerprint)
    }

use super::*;
use crate::environment::profile_for_manifest;

impl WorldRegistry {
    pub(crate) fn legacy_primary(map: WorldMap) -> Self {
        let definition = WorldDefinitionId::new(1).expect("legacy definition ID is nonzero");
        let instance = WorldInstanceId::new(1).expect("legacy instance ID is nonzero");
        let generation = GenerationSpec::new(
            WorldSeed::new(0),
            GenerationRevision::new(1).expect("legacy generator revision is nonzero"),
            1,
        )
        .expect("legacy position quantum is nonzero");
        let revision = WorldContentRevision::new(1).expect("legacy content revision is nonzero");
        let digest = GeneratorDigest::legacy_map_fingerprint(map.fingerprint());
        let manifest = WorldManifest::new(
            definition,
            WorldTopology::Dungeon,
            generation,
            revision,
            digest,
        );
        let mut world = World::default();
        world.load_map_streamed(&map);
        let map = Arc::new(map);
        let mut instances = BTreeMap::new();
        instances.insert(
            instance,
            WorldInstance {
                clock_id: ClockId::MVP,
                environment_profile: profile_for_manifest(manifest),
                manifest,
                map,
                world,
                entities: minimium_world::entity::EntityStore::default(),
                portal: None,
            },
        );
        Self {
            instances,
            memberships: HashMap::new(),
            primary: instance,
            next_epoch: 1,
            transfers: HashMap::new(),
            next_transition: 1,
            sector_states: BTreeMap::new(),
            persisted_totals: super::sector_state::PersistedTotals::default(),
            entity_sectors: BTreeMap::new(),
            entity_origins: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn register(
        &mut self,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        manifest: WorldManifest,
        map: WorldMap,
    ) -> Result<(), RegistryError> {
        if self.instances.contains_key(&instance) {
            return Err(RegistryError::DuplicateInstance);
        }
        let mut world = World::default();
        world.load_map_streamed(&map);
        world.set_gravity(
            minimium_world::world::GravityPolicy::for_manifest(manifest).character_gravity(),
        );
        world.set_precise_positions(manifest.planet().is_some());
        let map = Arc::new(map);
        let environment_profile = profile_for_manifest(manifest);
        self.instances.insert(
            instance,
            WorldInstance {
                clock_id: ClockId::MVP,
                environment_profile,
                manifest,
                map,
                world,
                entities: minimium_world::entity::EntityStore::default(),
                portal: None,
            },
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn try_from_world_definitions(
        worlds: Vec<WorldDefinition>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RegistryError> {
        let mut worlds = worlds.into_iter();
        let primary = worlds.next().ok_or(RegistryError::EmptyWorlds)?;
        let primary_id = primary.instance;
        let mut registry = Self::from_definition(primary);
        for world in worlds {
            registry.register_definition(world)?;
        }
        registry.primary = primary_id;
        Ok(registry)
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn from_world_definitions(worlds: Vec<WorldDefinition>) -> Self {
        Self::try_from_world_definitions(worlds)
            .expect("checked generated worlds are nonempty and have unique IDs")
    }

    fn from_definition(world: WorldDefinition) -> Self {
        let map = Arc::new(world.map);
        let mut simulation = World::default();
        simulation.load_map_streamed(&map);
        simulation.set_gravity(
            minimium_world::world::GravityPolicy::for_manifest(world.manifest).character_gravity(),
        );
        simulation.set_precise_positions(world.manifest.planet().is_some());
        let mut instances = BTreeMap::new();
        instances.insert(
            world.instance,
            WorldInstance {
                clock_id: ClockId::MVP,
                environment_profile: profile_for_manifest(world.manifest),
                manifest: world.manifest,
                map,
                world: simulation,
                entities: minimium_world::entity::EntityStore::default(),
                portal: world.portal,
            },
        );
        Self {
            instances,
            memberships: HashMap::new(),
            primary: world.instance,
            next_epoch: 1,
            transfers: HashMap::new(),
            next_transition: 1,
            sector_states: BTreeMap::new(),
            persisted_totals: super::sector_state::PersistedTotals::default(),
            entity_sectors: BTreeMap::new(),
            entity_origins: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn register_definition(&mut self, world: WorldDefinition) -> Result<(), RegistryError> {
        let instance = world.instance;
        let portal = world.portal;
        self.register(instance, world.manifest, world.map)?;
        self.instances
            .get_mut(&instance)
            .expect("newly registered instance exists")
            .portal = portal;
        Ok(())
    }
}
