    pub direction: [f32; 2],
    pub jump: bool,
    pub vertical: f32,
    pub movement: super::MovementSettings,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct CharacterState {
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub velocity: [f32; 3],
    pub grounded: bool,
    pub gravity: CharacterGravity,
}

impl CharacterState {
    pub fn at_spawn(spawn: [f32; 3]) -> Self {
        Self {
            position: spawn,
            ..Self::default()
        }
    }

    pub fn at_spawn_with_gravity(spawn: [f32; 3], gravity: CharacterGravity) -> Self {
        Self {
            gravity,
            ..Self::at_spawn(spawn)
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn step_character_once(
    state: &mut CharacterState,
    input: CharacterInput,
    colliders: &[Aabb],
    surfaces: &[MapTriangle],
    delta_seconds: f32,
) {
    if !delta_seconds.is_finite() || delta_seconds <= 0.0 {
        return;
    }
    if !input.movement.valid() || !input.vertical.is_finite() {
        return;
    }
    if input.movement.fly {
        state.velocity = super::movement::velocity(*state, input, delta_seconds);
        state.position = add(state.position, scale(state.velocity, delta_seconds));
        state.grounded = false;
        return;
    }
    if matches!(state.gravity, CharacterGravity::Radial { .. }) {
        step_radial_character(state, input, colliders, surfaces, delta_seconds);
        return;
    }

    let velocity = super::movement::velocity(*state, input, delta_seconds);
    state.velocity[0] = velocity[0];
    state.velocity[2] = velocity[2];

    let should_jump = input.jump && state.grounded;
    state.grounded = false;
    if should_jump {
        state.velocity[1] = PLAYER_JUMP_SPEED;
    }
    state.velocity[1] = (state.velocity[1] - GRAVITY * delta_seconds).max(-MAX_FALL_SPEED);

    let old_y = state.position[1];
    let mut next_y = old_y + state.velocity[1] * delta_seconds;
    if state.velocity[1] <= 0.0 {
        let mut landing_height = None::<f32>;
        for collider in colliders.iter().copied() {
            if horizontal_overlap(state.position, collider)
                && old_y >= collider.max[1] - COLLISION_EPSILON
                && next_y <= collider.max[1]
                && landing_height.is_none_or(|height| collider.max[1] > height)
            {
                landing_height = Some(collider.max[1]);
            }
        }
        for surface in surfaces {
            if let Some(height) = triangle_height_for_player(state.position, *surface) {
                if old_y >= height - COLLISION_EPSILON
                    && next_y <= height
                    && landing_height.is_none_or(|current| height > current)
                {
                    landing_height = Some(height);
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(height) = landing_height {
            next_y = height;
            state.velocity[1] = 0.0;
            state.grounded = true;
        }
    } else {
        let mut ceiling_height = None::<f32>;
        for collider in colliders.iter().copied() {
            if horizontal_overlap(state.position, collider)
                && old_y + PLAYER_HEIGHT <= collider.min[1] + COLLISION_EPSILON
                && next_y + PLAYER_HEIGHT >= collider.min[1]
                && ceiling_height.is_none_or(|height| collider.min[1] < height)
            {
                ceiling_height = Some(collider.min[1]);
            }
        }
        for surface in surfaces {
            if let Some(height) = triangle_height_for_player(state.position, *surface) {
                if old_y + PLAYER_HEIGHT <= height + COLLISION_EPSILON
                    && next_y + PLAYER_HEIGHT >= height
                    && ceiling_height.is_none_or(|current| height < current)
                {
                    ceiling_height = Some(height);
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(height) = ceiling_height {
            next_y = height - PLAYER_HEIGHT;
            state.velocity[1] = 0.0;
        }
    }
    if let Some(safe_y) = clip_vertical_motion_to_triangles(state.position, old_y, next_y, surfaces)
    {
        next_y = safe_y;
        state.velocity[1] = 0.0;
        state.grounded = false;
    }
    state.position[1] = next_y;

    for axis in [0usize, 2] {
        let change = state.velocity[axis] * delta_seconds;
        if change == 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let mut candidate = state.position[axis] + change;
        let mut proposed = state.position;
        proposed[axis] = candidate;
        let mut stepped_position = None;
        if state.grounded {
            for collider in colliders.iter().copied() {
                if !oriented_capsule_intersects(proposed, [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], collider) {
                    continue;
                }
                let step_up = collider.max[1] - state.position[1];
                if step_up <= 0.0 || step_up > MAX_STEP_UP {
                    continue;
                }
                let mut stepped = proposed;
                stepped[1] = collider.max[1];
                if colliders
                    .iter()
                    .all(|other| !oriented_capsule_intersects(stepped, [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], *other))
                    && surfaces.iter().copied().all(|surface| {
                        is_walkable_triangle(surface)
                            || !triangle_intersects_player(stepped, surface)
                    })
                {
                    stepped_position = Some(stepped);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(stepped) = stepped_position {
            state.position = stepped;
            state.velocity[1] = 0.0;
            continue;
        }

        for collider in colliders.iter().copied() {
            proposed = state.position;
            proposed[axis] = candidate;
            if oriented_capsule_intersects(proposed, [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], collider) {
                candidate = match (axis, change.is_sign_positive()) {
                    (0, true) => collider.min[0] - PLAYER_RADIUS,
                    (0, false) => collider.max[0] + PLAYER_RADIUS,
                    (2, true) => collider.min[2] - PLAYER_RADIUS,
                    (2, false) => collider.max[2] + PLAYER_RADIUS,
                    _ => candidate,
                };
            }
        }
        for surface in surfaces.iter().copied() {
            if !is_walkable_triangle(surface) {
                proposed = state.position;
                proposed[axis] = candidate;
                if triangle_intersects_player(proposed, surface) {
                    candidate = state.position[axis];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        state.position[axis] = candidate;
    }

    if state.grounded {
        if let Some(height) = highest_triangle_height_for_player(state.position, surfaces) {
            let step = height - state.position[1];
            if (-MAX_STEP_UP..=MAX_STEP_UP).contains(&step) {
                state.position[1] = height;
                state.velocity[1] = 0.0;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn step_radial_character(
    state: &mut CharacterState,
    input: CharacterInput,
    colliders: &[Aabb],
    surfaces: &[MapTriangle],
    delta_seconds: f32,
) {
    let should_jump = input.jump && state.grounded;
    state.grounded = false;
    let mut vertical_speed = dot(
        state.velocity,
        character_frame(state.gravity, state.position).0,
    );
    if should_jump {
        vertical_speed = PLAYER_JUMP_SPEED;
    }
    let steps = (input.movement.speed * delta_seconds / (PLAYER_RADIUS * 0.5))
        .ceil()
        .clamp(1.0, 8.0) as u32;
    let step_seconds = delta_seconds / steps as f32;
    let mut tangent_velocity = [0.0; 3];
    for _ in 0..steps {
        state.grounded = false;
        vertical_speed = (vertical_speed - GRAVITY * step_seconds).max(-MAX_FALL_SPEED);
        let (up, right, forward) = character_frame(state.gravity, state.position);
        let _ = (right, forward);
        tangent_velocity = super::movement::velocity(*state, input, delta_seconds);
        let old_position = state.position;
        let mut candidate = add(
            add(old_position, scale(tangent_velocity, step_seconds)),
            scale(up, vertical_speed * step_seconds),
        );
        if vertical_speed <= 0.0 {
            if let Some(distance) = nearest_surface_distance(candidate, up, surfaces) {
                if distance >= -MAX_STEP_UP
                    && distance <= input.movement.speed * step_seconds + MAX_STEP_UP
                {
                    candidate = add(candidate, scale(up, distance));
                    vertical_speed = 0.0;
                    state.grounded = true;
                }
            }
        }
        let candidate_up = character_frame(state.gravity, candidate).0;
        if colliders
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .any(|collider| oriented_capsule_intersects(candidate, candidate_up, collider))
        {
            candidate = old_position;
            tangent_velocity = [0.0; 3];
        }
        state.position = candidate;
    }
    let up = character_frame(state.gravity, state.position).0;
    state.velocity = add(tangent_velocity, scale(up, vertical_speed));
    if state.grounded {
        state.velocity = tangent_velocity;
    }
}

fn nearest_surface_distance(
    position: [f32; 3],
    up: [f32; 3],
    surfaces: &[MapTriangle],
) -> Option<f32> {
    let reference = if up[0].abs() < 0.9 {
        [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    } else {
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    };
    let forward =
        normalize(subtract(reference, scale(up, dot(reference, up)))).unwrap_or([0.0, 0.0, -1.0]);
    let right = normalize(cross(forward, up)).unwrap_or([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    let samples = [
        position,
        add(position, scale(right, PLAYER_RADIUS)),
        add(position, scale(right, -PLAYER_RADIUS)),
        add(position, scale(forward, PLAYER_RADIUS)),
        add(position, scale(forward, -PLAYER_RADIUS)),
    ];
    let mut nearest = None;
    for surface in surfaces {
        let [a, b, c] = surface.vertices;
        let normal = cross(subtract(b, a), subtract(c, a));
        let denominator = dot(normal, up);
        let normal_length = dot(normal, normal).sqrt();
        if !denominator.is_finite()
            || normal_length <= 1.0e-8
            || denominator.abs() < normal_length * 0.5
        {
            continue;
        }
        for sample in samples {
            let distance = dot(normal, subtract(a, sample)) / denominator;
            let point = add(sample, scale(up, distance));
            if point_in_triangle(point, a, b, c)
                && nearest.is_none_or(|current: f32| distance.abs() < current.abs())
            {
                nearest = Some(distance);
            }
        }
    }
    nearest
}

fn point_in_triangle(point: [f32; 3], a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3], c: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
    let v0 = subtract(c, a);
    let v1 = subtract(b, a);
    let v2 = subtract(point, a);
    let dot00 = dot(v0, v0);
    let dot01 = dot(v0, v1);
    let dot02 = dot(v0, v2);
    let dot11 = dot(v1, v1);
    let dot12 = dot(v1, v2);
    let denominator = dot00 * dot11 - dot01 * dot01;
    if denominator.abs() <= 1.0e-12 {
        return false;
    }
    let u = (dot11 * dot02 - dot01 * dot12) / denominator;
    let v = (dot00 * dot12 - dot01 * dot02) / denominator;
    u >= -1.0e-5 && v >= -1.0e-5 && u + v <= 1.00001
}

fn dot(left: [f32; 3], right: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    left[0] * right[0] + left[1] * right[1] + left[2] * right[2]
}

fn cross(left: [f32; 3], right: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    [
        left[1] * right[2] - left[2] * right[1],
        left[2] * right[0] - left[0] * right[2],
        left[0] * right[1] - left[1] * right[0],
    ]
}

fn add(left: [f32; 3], right: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    [left[0] + right[0], left[1] + right[1], left[2] + right[2]]
}

fn subtract(left: [f32; 3], right: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    [left[0] - right[0], left[1] - right[1], left[2] - right[2]]
}

fn scale(vector: [f32; 3], amount: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
    [vector[0] * amount, vector[1] * amount, vector[2] * amount]
}

fn normalize(vector: [f32; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
    let length_squared = dot(vector, vector);
    (length_squared.is_finite() && length_squared > 1.0e-12)
        .then(|| scale(vector, length_squared.sqrt().recip()))
}

pub(super) fn finite_input(value: f32) -> f32 {
    if value.is_finite() {
        value.clamp(-1.0, 1.0)
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/simulation/src/simulation/snapshot.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="214" bytes="7415" original_lines="214" original_bytes="7415" minified="false" sha256="b55bd4adf3839873fb556562b8186a81e3153e52ea304025c710ed8c8dbeec9d">>>
use super::rules::{CharacterState, Player};
use super::VISIBILITY_RADIUS;
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_world::world::CharacterGravity;
use minimium_world::world::{cell_for, Cell, Position3Mm};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt::Write as FmtWrite;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct WorldSnapshot {
    pub(super) players: Arc<HashMap<PlayerId, Player>>,
    pub(super) cells: Arc<HashMap<Cell, Vec<PlayerId>>>,
    pub(super) gravity: CharacterGravity,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct NearbyCandidate<'a> {
    pub(super) player: &'a Player,
    pub(super) distance_squared: f32,
}

impl WorldSnapshot {
    pub fn position(&self, entity: PlayerId) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
        self.players.get(&entity).map(|player| player.position)
    }

    pub fn position_mm(&self, entity: PlayerId) -> Option<Position3Mm> {
        self.players.get(&entity).map(|player| {
            player.position_mm.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                Position3Mm(
                    player
                        .position
                        .map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                )
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn character_state(&self, entity: PlayerId) -> Option<CharacterState> {
        self.players.get(&entity).map(|player| CharacterState {
            position: player.position,
            velocity: player.velocity,
            grounded: player.grounded,
            gravity: self.gravity,
        })
    }

    pub fn append_nearby(&self, recipient: PlayerId, limit: usize, output: &mut String) {
        let mut append = |player: &Player| {
            let _ = write!(
                output,
                " {} {} {:.2} {:.2} {:.2}",
                player.id, player.name, player.position[0], player.position[1], player.position[2]
            );
        };
        if limit <= 16 {
            self.visit_nearby::<16>(recipient, limit, &mut append);
        } else {
            for player in self.nearby_players(recipient, limit) {
                append(&player);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn visit_nearby<const CAPACITY: usize>(
        &self,
        recipient: PlayerId,
        limit: usize,
        mut visit: impl FnMut(&Player),
    ) {
        let selection_limit = limit.min(CAPACITY);
        if selection_limit == 0 {
            return;
        }

        let mut nearest: [Option<NearbyCandidate<'_>>; CAPACITY] = [None; CAPACITY];
        let mut nearest_count = 0;
        self.for_each_nearby_candidate(recipient, |player, distance_squared| {
            let candidate = NearbyCandidate {
                player,
                distance_squared,
            };
            let insert_at = if nearest_count < selection_limit {
                let index = nearest_count;
                nearest_count += 1;
                index
            } else {
                let last = nearest[selection_limit - 1].expect("nearest entries stay packed");
                if nearby_candidate_precedes(candidate, last) {
                    selection_limit - 1
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            };
            nearest[insert_at] = Some(candidate);
            let mut index = insert_at;
            while index > 0 {
                let previous = nearest[index - 1].expect("nearest entries stay packed");
                let current = nearest[index].expect("inserted candidate is present");
                if !nearby_candidate_precedes(current, previous) {
                    break;
                }
                nearest[index] = Some(previous);
                nearest[index - 1] = Some(current);
                index -= 1;
            }
        });

        for candidate in nearest.into_iter().take(nearest_count).flatten() {
            visit(candidate.player);
        }
    }

    pub fn nearby_players(&self, recipient: PlayerId, limit: usize) -> Vec<Player> {
        if limit == 0 {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let mut candidates = Vec::with_capacity(limit.min(self.players.len()));
        self.for_each_nearby_candidate(recipient, |player, distance_squared| {
            candidates.push((distance_squared, player.id, player));
        });
        candidates.sort_unstable_by(|left, right| {
            left.0
                .total_cmp(&right.0)
                .then_with(|| left.1.cmp(&right.1))
        });
        candidates
            .into_iter()
            .take(limit)
            .map(|(_, _, player)| player.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    fn for_each_nearby_candidate<'a>(
        &'a self,
        recipient: PlayerId,
        mut visit: impl FnMut(&'a Player, f32),
    ) {
        let Some(origin) = self.players.get(&recipient) else {
            return;
        };
        let minimum = cell_for([
            origin.position[0] - VISIBILITY_RADIUS,
            origin.position[1] - VISIBILITY_RADIUS,
            origin.position[2] - VISIBILITY_RADIUS,
        ]);
        let maximum = cell_for([
            origin.position[0] + VISIBILITY_RADIUS,
            origin.position[1] + VISIBILITY_RADIUS,
            origin.position[2] + VISIBILITY_RADIUS,
        ]);
        let radius_squared = VISIBILITY_RADIUS * VISIBILITY_RADIUS;
        let axis_cell_count = |minimum: i32, maximum: i32| {
            usize::try_from(i64::from(maximum) - i64::from(minimum) + 1).unwrap_or(usize::MAX)
        };
        let query_cell_count = axis_cell_count(minimum.0, maximum.0)
            .saturating_mul(axis_cell_count(minimum.1, maximum.1))
            .saturating_mul(axis_cell_count(minimum.2, maximum.2));
        let mut inspect_ids = |ids: &[PlayerId]| {
            for id in ids {
                if *id == recipient {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(player) = self.players.get(id) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let distance_squared = (0..3)
                    .map(|axis| {
                        let delta = player.position[axis] - origin.position[axis];
                        delta * delta
                    })
                    .sum::<f32>();
                if distance_squared <= radius_squared {
                    visit(player, distance_squared);
                }
            }
        };

        if self.cells.len() < query_cell_count {
            for (Cell(x, y, z), ids) in self.cells.iter() {
                if *x >= minimum.0
                    && *x <= maximum.0
                    && *y >= minimum.1
                    && *y <= maximum.1
                    && *z >= minimum.2
                    && *z <= maximum.2
                {
                    inspect_ids(ids);
                }
            }
        } else {
            for z in minimum.2..=maximum.2 {
                for y in minimum.1..=maximum.1 {
                    for x in minimum.0..=maximum.0 {
                        if let Some(ids) = self.cells.get(&Cell(x, y, z)) {
                            inspect_ids(ids);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn nearby_candidate_precedes(
    left: NearbyCandidate<'_>,
    right: NearbyCandidate<'_>,
) -> bool {
    left.distance_squared
        .total_cmp(&right.distance_squared)
        .then_with(|| left.player.id.cmp(&right.player.id))
        .is_lt()
}

use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_world::world::{cell_for, Cell};
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub(super) fn update_cell_index(
    cells: &mut HashMap<Cell, Vec<PlayerId>>,
    player_cells: &mut HashMap<PlayerId, Cell>,
    id: PlayerId,
    position: [f32; 3],
) {
    let new_cell = cell_for(position);
    if player_cells.get(&id).copied() == Some(new_cell) {
        return;
    }
    let old_cell = player_cells.insert(id, new_cell);
    if old_cell != Some(new_cell) {
        if let Some(old_cell) = old_cell {
            let empty = if let Some(players) = cells.get_mut(&old_cell) {
                players.retain(|player| *player != id);
                players.is_empty()
            } else {
                false
            };
            if empty {
                cells.remove(&old_cell);
            }
        }
        cells.entry(new_cell).or_default().push(id);
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/simulation/src/simulation/step_batch.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="45" bytes="1516" original_lines="45" original_bytes="1516" minified="false" sha256="4da22c04ebc58bed68affe1640cc9ecc092e1c2c0613ab5a2a5cbf2de63db9b2">>>
use super::{precise_step, world_state::PlayerStepResult};
use super::{step_character, CollisionIndex, SimulationBatch};
/// Advances a batch using immutable collision geometry; it never mutates a world.
pub fn step_batch(
    mut batch: SimulationBatch,
    collision_index: &CollisionIndex,
    delta_seconds: f32,
) -> SimulationBatch {
    for step in batch.inputs.drain(..) {
        let mut state = step.state;
        batch
            .collision_stats
            .accumulate(batch.collision_query.fill_for_speed(
                collision_index,
                state,
                delta_seconds,
                step.input.movement.speed,
            ));
        let mut position_mm = step.position_mm;
        if let Some(position_mm) = &mut position_mm {
            precise_step::step_character_mm(
                &mut state,
                position_mm,
                step.input,
                batch.collision_query.candidates(),
                batch.collision_query.surface_candidates(),
                delta_seconds,
            );
        } else {
            step_character(
                &mut state,
                step.input,
                batch.collision_query.candidates(),
                batch.collision_query.surface_candidates(),
                delta_seconds,
            );
        }
        batch.results.push(PlayerStepResult {
            id: step.id,
            state,
            position_mm,
        });
    }
    batch
}

<<<FILE path="crates/simulation/src/simulation/world_state.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="462" bytes="16793" original_lines="462" original_bytes="16793" minified="false" sha256="b3bb8b100f60ac3f8a9eefc8a676c56710c0682fba40d10f282f2c869019668d">>>
use super::collision_index::CollisionIndex;
use super::collision_queries::{CollisionQuery, CollisionQueryStats};
use super::precise_step;
use super::raycast::{MapRayQuery, PlayerRayQuery};
use super::rules::{CharacterInput, CharacterState, Player};
use super::snapshot::WorldSnapshot;
use super::spatial::update_cell_index;
use super::step_character;
use super::{
    MAX_PLAYER_NAME_CHARS, PARALLEL_SIMULATION_MIN_PLAYERS, PLAYERS_PER_SIMULATION_BATCH,
    PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH,
};
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_world::world::geometry::{intersects_player, oriented_capsule_intersects};
use minimium_world::world::{
    cell_for, character_frame, Aabb, Cell, CharacterGravity, MapTriangle, Position3Mm, WorldMap,
};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct PlayerStepInput {
    pub(super) id: PlayerId,
    pub(super) state: CharacterState,
    pub(super) position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
    pub(super) input: CharacterInput,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct PlayerStepResult {
    pub(super) id: PlayerId,
    pub(super) state: CharacterState,
    pub(super) position_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct SimulationBatch {
    pub(super) inputs: Vec<PlayerStepInput>,
    pub(super) results: Vec<PlayerStepResult>,
    pub(super) collision_query: CollisionQuery,
    pub(super) collision_stats: CollisionQueryStats,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct World {
    pub(super) players: Arc<HashMap<PlayerId, Player>>,
    pub(super) cells: Arc<HashMap<Cell, Vec<PlayerId>>>,
    pub(super) player_cells: Arc<HashMap<PlayerId, Cell>>,
    pub(super) collision_index: Arc<CollisionIndex>,
    pub(super) combat_index: Arc<CollisionIndex>,
    pub(super) collision_query: CollisionQuery,
    pub(super) combat_player_query: PlayerRayQuery,
    pub(super) combat_map_query: MapRayQuery,
    pub(super) simulation_batches: Vec<SimulationBatch>,
    pub(super) next_id: u64,
    pub(super) spawn: [f32; 3],
    pub(super) spawn_mm: Option<Position3Mm>,
    pub(super) gravity: CharacterGravity,
    pub(super) precise_positions: bool,
    last_precise_batch_count: Option<usize>,
}

impl World {
    pub fn join(&mut self, name: String) -> PlayerId {
        self.next_id += 1;
        let id = PlayerId::new(self.next_id);
        self.join_as(id, name);
        id
    }

    pub fn join_as(&mut self, id: PlayerId, name: String) {
        self.join_at(id, name, self.spawn);
    }

    pub fn join_at(&mut self, id: PlayerId, name: String, position: [f32; 3]) {
        self.join_at_with_health(id, name, position, PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH);
    }

    pub fn join_at_with_health(
        &mut self,
        id: PlayerId,
        name: String,
        position: [f32; 3],
        health: u16,
    ) {
        // Replacing an existing ID must first remove its old spatial-cell membership.
        // Otherwise one player may remain indexed in multiple cells.
        if self.players.contains_key(&id) {
            self.leave(id);
        }
        self.next_id = self.next_id.max(id.get());
        let clear_of_boxes = position.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite())
            && match self.gravity {
                CharacterGravity::Radial { .. } => {
                    let up = character_frame(self.gravity, position).0;
                    self.collision_index
                        .colliders
                        .iter()
                        .all(|collider| !oriented_capsule_intersects(position, up, *collider))
                }
                CharacterGravity::FixedY => self
                    .collision_index
                    .colliders
                    .iter()
                    .all(|collider| !intersects_player(position, *collider)),
            };
        let position = if clear_of_boxes { position } else { self.spawn };
        let player = Player {
            id,
            name: Arc::from(name),
            position,
            position_mm: self.precise_positions.then(|| {
                if position == self.spawn {
                    self.spawn_mm.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                        Position3Mm(
                            position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64),
                        )
                    })
                } else {
                    Position3Mm(position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64))
                }
            }),
            velocity: [0.0; 3],
            grounded: false,
            health: health.clamp(1, PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH),
        };
        let cell = cell_for(player.position);
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.cells)
            .entry(cell)
            .or_default()
            .push(player.id);
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.player_cells).insert(player.id, cell);
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players).insert(id, player);
    }

    pub fn leave(&mut self, id: PlayerId) {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players).remove(&id);
        if let Some(cell) = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.player_cells).remove(&id) {
            let cells = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.cells);
            let empty = if let Some(players) = cells.get_mut(&cell) {
                players.retain(|player| *player != id);
                players.is_empty()
            } else {
                false
            };
            if empty {
                cells.remove(&cell);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn step_players(
        &mut self,
        inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
        delta_seconds: f32,
    ) -> CollisionQueryStats {
        self.step_players_selected(inputs, None, delta_seconds)
    }

    /// Advances only players whose required collision sectors are installed.
    /// Other players retain position and velocity until their geometry is ready.
    pub fn step_players_selected(
        &mut self,
        inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
        selected: Option<&HashSet<PlayerId>>,
        delta_seconds: f32,
    ) -> CollisionQueryStats {
        let Self {
            players,
            cells,
            player_cells,
            collision_index,
            collision_query,
            gravity,
            ..
        } = self;
        let players = Arc::make_mut(players);
        let cells = Arc::make_mut(cells);
        let player_cells = Arc::make_mut(player_cells);
        let mut collision_stats = CollisionQueryStats::default();
        for (id, player) in players {
            if selected.is_some_and(|ids| !ids.contains(id)) {
                continue;
            }
            let mut state = CharacterState {
                position: player.position,
                velocity: player.velocity,
                grounded: player.grounded,
                gravity: *gravity,
            };
            let input = inputs.get(id).copied().unwrap_or_default();
            collision_stats.accumulate(collision_query.fill_for_speed(
                collision_index,
                state,
                delta_seconds,
                input.movement.speed,
            ));
            if let Some(position_mm) = &mut player.position_mm {
                precise_step::step_character_mm(
                    &mut state,
                    position_mm,
                    input,
                    collision_query.candidates(),
                    collision_query.surface_candidates(),
                    delta_seconds,
                );
            } else {
                step_character(
                    &mut state,
                    input,
                    collision_query.candidates(),
                    collision_query.surface_candidates(),
                    delta_seconds,
                );
            }
            player.position = state.position;
            player.velocity = state.velocity;
            player.grounded = state.grounded;
            update_cell_index(cells, player_cells, *id, player.position);
        }
        collision_stats
    }

    /// Runs movement on the authoritative owner, delegating only independent batches.
    /// The dispatcher must return every processed batch in input order.
    pub fn step_players_with(
        &mut self,
        inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
        delta_seconds: f32,
        lanes: usize,
        dispatch: impl FnOnce(Vec<SimulationBatch>, Arc<CollisionIndex>, f32) -> Vec<SimulationBatch>,
    ) -> CollisionQueryStats {
        self.step_players_with_selected(inputs, None, delta_seconds, lanes, dispatch)
    }

    /// Runs the selected players on the owner lane or in immutable worker batches.
    pub fn step_players_with_selected(
        &mut self,
        inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
        selected: Option<&HashSet<PlayerId>>,
        delta_seconds: f32,
        lanes: usize,
        dispatch: impl FnOnce(Vec<SimulationBatch>, Arc<CollisionIndex>, f32) -> Vec<SimulationBatch>,
    ) -> CollisionQueryStats {
        let Some((geometry, batches)) = self.prepare_movement_batches(inputs, selected, lanes)
        else {
            self.last_precise_batch_count = self.precise_positions.then_some(0);
            return self.step_players_selected(inputs, selected, delta_seconds);
        };
        self.last_precise_batch_count = self.precise_positions.then_some(batches.len());
        let results = dispatch(batches, geometry, delta_seconds);
        self.apply_step_results(results)
    }

    /// Returns whether precise movement used workers and how many batches were dispatched.
    pub fn precise_dispatch_stats(&self) -> Option<(bool, usize)> {
        self.last_precise_batch_count
            .map(|batches| (batches > 0, batches))
    }

    fn prepare_movement_batches(
        &mut self,
        inputs: &HashMap<PlayerId, CharacterInput>,
        selected: Option<&HashSet<PlayerId>>,
        lanes: usize,
    ) -> Option<(Arc<CollisionIndex>, Vec<SimulationBatch>)> {
        let selected_count = self
            .players
            .keys()
            .filter(|id| selected.is_none_or(|ids| ids.contains(*id)))
            .count();
        if lanes <= 1 || selected_count < PARALLEL_SIMULATION_MIN_PLAYERS {
            return None;
        }
        let players = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players);
        // Preserve the original copy-on-write timing before worker execution.
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.cells);
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.player_cells);
        let simulation_batches = &mut self.simulation_batches;
        let batch_count = lanes
            .min(selected_count.div_ceil(PLAYERS_PER_SIMULATION_BATCH))
            .max(2);
        simulation_batches.resize_with(batch_count, SimulationBatch::default);
        let inputs_per_batch = selected_count.div_ceil(batch_count);
        for batch in simulation_batches.iter_mut() {
            batch.inputs.clear();
            batch.results.clear();
            batch.collision_stats = CollisionQueryStats::default();
            if batch.inputs.capacity() < inputs_per_batch {
                batch.inputs.reserve(inputs_per_batch);
            }
            if batch.results.capacity() < inputs_per_batch {
                batch.results.reserve(inputs_per_batch);
            }
        }
        for (index, (id, player)) in players
            .iter()
            .filter(|(id, _)| selected.is_none_or(|ids| ids.contains(*id)))
            .enumerate()
        {
            let batch_index = (index / inputs_per_batch).min(batch_count - 1);
            simulation_batches[batch_index]
                .inputs
                .push(PlayerStepInput {
                    id: *id,
                    state: CharacterState {
                        position: player.position,
                        velocity: player.velocity,
                        grounded: player.grounded,
                        gravity: self.gravity,
                    },
                    position_mm: player.position_mm,
                    input: inputs.get(id).copied().unwrap_or_default(),
                });
        }

        Some((
            Arc::clone(&self.collision_index),
            std::mem::take(simulation_batches),
        ))
    }

    pub fn set_position(&mut self, id: PlayerId, position: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
        if !position.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite()) {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(player) = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players).get_mut(&id) else {
            return false;
        };
        player.position = position;
        player.position_mm = self
            .precise_positions
            .then(|| Position3Mm(position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64)));
        player.velocity = [0.0; 3];
        player.grounded = false;
        self.update_player_cell(id, position);
        true
    }

    pub fn restore_position_mm(&mut self, id: PlayerId, position: Position3Mm) -> bool {
        if !self.precise_positions
            || position
                .0
                .iter()
                .any(|value| value.unsigned_abs() > 7_000_000_000)
        {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(player) = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players).get_mut(&id) else {
            return false;
        };
        let approximate = position.0.map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0);
        if player
            .position
            .iter()
            .zip(approximate)
            .any(|(a, b)| (a - b).abs() > 1.0)
        {
            return false;
        }
        player.position_mm = Some(position);
        player.position = approximate;
        self.update_player_cell(id, approximate);
        true
    }

    pub fn player_health(&self, id: PlayerId) -> Option<u16> {
        self.players.get(&id).map(|player| player.health)
    }

    pub fn player(&self, id: PlayerId) -> Option<&Player> {
        self.players.get(&id)
    }

    fn update_player_cell(&mut self, id: PlayerId, position: [f32; 3]) {
        update_cell_index(
            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.cells),
            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.player_cells),
            id,
            position,
        );
    }

    pub fn rename_player(&mut self, id: PlayerId, name: String) -> bool {
        let Some(player) = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players).get_mut(&id) else {
            return false;
        };
        player.name = Arc::from(name.chars().take(MAX_PLAYER_NAME_CHARS).collect::<String>());
        true
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<Player> {
        self.players.values().cloned().collect()
    }

    pub fn network_snapshot(&self) -> WorldSnapshot {
        WorldSnapshot {
            players: Arc::clone(&self.players),
            cells: Arc::clone(&self.cells),
            gravity: self.gravity,
        }
    }

    pub fn player_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.players.len()
    }

    pub fn gravity(&self) -> CharacterGravity {
        self.gravity
    }

    pub fn set_precise_positions(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
        self.precise_positions = enabled;
    }

    pub fn add_collider(&mut self, collider: Aabb) {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.collision_index).add(collider);
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.combat_index).add(collider);
    }

    pub fn load_map(&mut self, map: &WorldMap) {
        self.spawn = map.spawn();
        self.spawn_mm = map.spawn_position_mm();
        let index = Arc::new(CollisionIndex::from_geometry(
            map.solid_colliders(),
            map.solid_triangles(),
        ));
        self.collision_index = Arc::clone(&index);
        self.combat_index = index;
        self.reset_collision_queries();
    }

    /// Loads map metadata while keeping movement collision dependent on the
    /// sectors installed by the owning server.
    pub fn load_map_streamed(&mut self, map: &WorldMap) {
        self.spawn = map.spawn();
        self.spawn_mm = map.spawn_position_mm();
        self.collision_index = Arc::new(CollisionIndex::default());
        self.combat_index = Arc::new(CollisionIndex::from_geometry(
            map.solid_colliders(),
            map.solid_triangles(),
        ));
        self.reset_collision_queries();
    }

    pub fn replace_streamed_collision(&mut self, colliders: Vec<Aabb>, surfaces: Vec<MapTriangle>) {
        self.collision_index = Arc::new(CollisionIndex::from_geometry(colliders, surfaces));
        self.collision_query = CollisionQuery::default();
        self.simulation_batches.clear();
    }

    fn reset_collision_queries(&mut self) {
        self.collision_query = CollisionQuery::default();
        self.combat_player_query = PlayerRayQuery::default();
        self.combat_map_query = MapRayQuery::default();
        self.simulation_batches.clear();
    }

    pub fn set_gravity(&mut self, gravity: CharacterGravity) {
        self.gravity = gravity;
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/format/clock.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="99" bytes="3441" original_lines="99" original_bytes="3441" minified="false" sha256="b7af15d87cfa141e138c8c62a46106dc293c3fe55467eb16b9027501df8a5c1c">>>
use super::*;
use minimium_environment::time::{
    ClockId, ClockMode, ClockRevision, OfflinePolicy, SavedClockState, TimeScalePpm, WorldTimeMs,
};
use std::{io, io::Write};

pub(super) fn parse_saved_clock(line: &str, source_version: u8) -> io::Result<SavedClockState> {
    let mut fields = line.split('\t');
    if fields.next() != Some("CLOCK") {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid CLOCK record"));
    }
    let clock_id = ClockId::new(parse_decimal(
        fields.next(),
        "missing clock id",
        "invalid clock id",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("unsupported clock id"))?;
    let revision = ClockRevision::new(parse_decimal(
        fields.next(),
        "missing clock revision",
        "invalid clock revision",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("clock revision must be nonzero"))?;
    let mode = ClockMode::try_from(parse_decimal::<u8>(
        fields.next(),
        "missing clock mode",
        "invalid clock mode",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("unsupported clock mode"))?;
    let world_time = WorldTimeMs::new(parse_decimal(
        fields.next(),
        "missing world UTC time",
        "invalid world UTC time",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("world UTC time is out of range"))?;
    let wall_time = WorldTimeMs::new(parse_decimal(
        fields.next(),
        "missing saved wall UTC time",
        "invalid saved wall UTC time",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("saved wall UTC time is out of range"))?;
    let rate = TimeScalePpm::new(parse_decimal(
        fields.next(),
        "missing clock rate",
        "invalid clock rate",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("clock rate is out of range"))?;
    if source_version == 8 && rate.get() > 1_440_000_000 {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("v8 clock rate is out of range"));
    }
    let offline_policy = OfflinePolicy::try_from(parse_decimal::<u8>(
        fields.next(),
        "missing offline policy",
        "invalid offline policy",
    )?)
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("unsupported offline policy"))?;
    if fields.next().is_some() {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("CLOCK record has extra fields"));
    }
    SavedClockState::new(
        clock_id,
        revision,
        mode,
        world_time,
        wall_time,
        rate,
        offline_policy,
    )
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved clock state"))
}

pub(super) fn write_saved_clock(output: &mut impl Write, state: SavedClockState) -> io::Result<()> {
    write!(
        output,
        "CLOCK\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}",
        state.clock_id().get(),
        state.revision().get(),
        state.mode() as u8,
        state.saved_world_utc_ms().get(),
        state.saved_wall_utc_ms().get(),
        state.rate_ppm().get(),
        state.offline_policy() as u8,
    )
}

fn parse_decimal<T>(
    value: Option<&str>,
    missing: &'static str,
    invalid: &'static str,
) -> io::Result<T>
where
    T: std::str::FromStr,
{
    let value = value.ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot(missing))?;
    if value.is_empty() || !value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(invalid));
    }
    value.parse().map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot(invalid))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/format/load.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="391" bytes="14379" original_lines="391" original_bytes="14379" minified="false" sha256="bc6824f1d4bd614fba106761c14ffe1de3919dbafab891a351616a3ad453d59b">>>
use super::*;

mod header;

use header::parse_snapshot_header;

pub(super) fn load(
    data_dir: &Path,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
) -> io::Result<LoadedState> {
    let path = data_dir.join("world.snapshot");
    let bytes = match minimium_platform::files::read_bounded_file(&path, MAX_WORLD_SNAPSHOT_BYTES) {
        Ok(bytes) => bytes,
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(LoadedState::empty()),
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    };
    let source = String::from_utf8(bytes)
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot is not valid UTF-8"))?;
    let mut lines = source.lines();
    let header = lines
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot is empty"))?;
    let parsed_header = parse_snapshot_header(header, worlds)?;
    let source_version = parsed_header.source_version;
    let legacy_world = parsed_header.legacy_world;

    let mut store = PlayerStore::default();
    let mut saved_world_instances = HashSet::new();
    if source_version >= 5 {
        let (primary_instance, _, _) = worlds
            .first()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("no primary world is loaded"))?;
        saved_world_instances.insert(*primary_instance);
    }
    let mut player_records_started = false;
    let mut sector_records_started = false;
    let mut sector_limits = SectorRecordLimits::default();
    let mut saved_clock = None;
    let mut lines = lines.peekable();
    while let Some(line) = lines.next() {
        if line == "CLOCK" || line.starts_with("CLOCK\t") {
            if source_version < 8 {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                    "CLOCK record is not allowed in a legacy snapshot",
                ));
            }
            if saved_clock.is_some() {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("duplicate CLOCK record"));
            }
            if player_records_started || sector_records_started {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                    "CLOCK record appears after state records",
                ));
            }
            saved_clock = Some(parse_saved_clock(line, source_version)?);
            continue;
        }
        if source_version >= 5 && line.starts_with("WORLD\t") {
            if player_records_started || sector_records_started || saved_clock.is_some() {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                    "world manifest appears after clock or state records",
                ));
            }
            parse_world_record(line, worlds, &mut saved_world_instances)?;
            continue;
        }
        if source_version >= 6 && line.starts_with("SECTOR\t") {
            if player_records_started {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                    "sector state appears after player records",
                ));
            }
            if source_version >= 8 && saved_clock.is_none() {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("missing CLOCK record in snapshot"));
            }
            sector_records_started = true;
            parse_sector_record(
                line,
                &mut lines,
                worlds,
                &saved_world_instances,
                &mut store,
                &mut sector_limits,
            )?;
            continue;
        }
        if source_version >= 8 && saved_clock.is_none() {
            return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("missing CLOCK record in snapshot"));
        }
        player_records_started = true;
        parse_player_record(
            line,
            source_version,
            legacy_world,
            worlds,
            &saved_world_instances,
            &mut store,
        )?;
    }
    if source_version >= 8 && saved_clock.is_none() {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("missing CLOCK record in snapshot"));
    }
    Ok(LoadedState::from_snapshot(
        store,
        saved_clock,
        source_version,
    ))
}

fn parse_world_record(
    line: &str,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
    saved_world_instances: &mut HashSet<WorldInstanceId>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let saved_world = parse_saved_world(line)?;
    validate_saved_world(&saved_world, worlds)?;
    if !saved_world_instances.insert(saved_world.instance) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("duplicate saved world instance"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct SectorRecordLimits {
    addresses: HashSet<(WorldInstanceId, SectorKey)>,
    object_count: usize,
    object_bytes: usize,
}

fn parse_sector_record(
    line: &str,
    lines: &mut std::iter::Peekable<std::str::Lines<'_>>,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
    saved_world_instances: &HashSet<WorldInstanceId>,
    store: &mut PlayerStore,
    limits: &mut SectorRecordLimits,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let (instance, state) = parse_saved_sector(line, lines)?;
    if !saved_world_instances.contains(&instance) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "sector state references an unrecorded world instance",
        ));
    }
    let Some((_, _, manifest)) = worlds
        .iter()
        .find(|(candidate, _, _)| *candidate == instance)
    else {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "sector state references an unloaded world instance",
        ));
    };
    let key_matches = matches!(
        (manifest.topology(), state.key()),
        (WorldTopology::Planet, SectorKey::Planet(_))
            | (WorldTopology::Dungeon, SectorKey::Dungeon(_))
    );
    if !key_matches {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "sector address does not match its world topology",
        ));
    }
    if store.sector_states.len() >= MAX_PERSISTED_WORLD_SECTORS {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "snapshot has too many sector states",
        ));
    }
    if !limits.addresses.insert((instance, state.key())) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("duplicate saved sector state"));
    }
    limits.object_count = limits.object_count.saturating_add(state.objects().len());
    limits.object_bytes = limits.object_bytes.saturating_add(
        state
            .objects()
            .iter()
            .map(|object| object.data().len())
            .sum::<usize>(),
    );
    if limits.object_count > MAX_PERSISTED_WORLD_OBJECT_STATES
        || limits.object_bytes > MAX_PERSISTED_WORLD_OBJECT_STATE_BYTES
    {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "snapshot has too much persisted sector object state",
        ));
    }
    store.sector_states.push((instance, state));
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_player_record(
    line: &str,
    source_version: u8,
    legacy_world: WorldInstanceId,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
    saved_world_instances: &HashSet<WorldInstanceId>,
    store: &mut PlayerStore,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    if store.profile_by_player.len() >= MAX_STORED_PLAYERS {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot has too many players"));
    }
    let mut fields = line.split('\t');
    let id = PlayerId::new(parse_saved_id(fields.next())?);
    let profile_id = PlayerProfileId::from_hex(
        fields
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing player profile id"))?,
    )
    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid player profile id"))?;
    let name = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing player name"))?;
    let name =
        StoredName::new(name).ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved player name"))?;
    let (location, return_location, health) =
        parse_player_locations(&mut fields, source_version, legacy_world)?;
    validate_player_world_references(
        source_version,
        location,
        return_location,
        worlds,
        saved_world_instances,
    )?;
    if fields.next().is_some() {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("player record has extra fields"));
    }
    let position = position_from_location(location);
    let current_map = map_for_world(worlds, location.instance())?;
    let current_gravity = gravity_for_world(worlds, location.instance())?;
    if !current_map.can_place_player_with_gravity(position, current_gravity) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "saved player position overlaps map geometry",
        ));
    }
    let return_map = map_for_world(worlds, return_location.instance())?;
    let return_gravity = gravity_for_world(worlds, return_location.instance())?;
    if !return_map
        .can_place_player_with_gravity(position_from_location(return_location), return_gravity)
    {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "saved return point overlaps map geometry",
        ));
    }

    let shard = usize::from(profile_id.as_bytes()[0]);
    let duplicate_profile = Arc::make_mut(&mut store.players[shard])
        .insert(
            profile_id,
            StoredPlayer {
                id,
                name,
                position,
                health,
                location,
                return_location,
            },
        )
        .is_some();
    let duplicate_player = store.profile_by_player.insert(id, profile_id).is_some();
    if duplicate_profile || duplicate_player {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("duplicate saved player identity"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_player_locations(
    fields: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>,
    source_version: u8,
    legacy_world: WorldInstanceId,
) -> io::Result<(WorldLocation, WorldLocation, u16)> {
    if source_version >= 4 {
        parse_current_player_locations(fields)
    } else {
        parse_legacy_player_location(fields, source_version, legacy_world)
    }
}

fn parse_current_player_locations(
    fields: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>,
) -> io::Result<(WorldLocation, WorldLocation, u16)> {
    let location = parse_location(fields)?;
    let health = parse_saved_health(fields.next())?;
    let return_location = parse_location(fields)?;
    Ok((location, return_location, health))
}

fn parse_legacy_player_location(
    fields: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>,
    source_version: u8,
    legacy_world: WorldInstanceId,
) -> io::Result<(WorldLocation, WorldLocation, u16)> {
    let position = [
        parse_saved_coordinate(fields.next())?,
        parse_saved_coordinate(fields.next())?,
        parse_saved_coordinate(fields.next())?,
    ];
    let health = if source_version == 3 {
        parse_saved_health(fields.next())?
    } else {
        PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH
    };
    let location = legacy_location(legacy_world, position);
    Ok((location, location, health))
}

fn validate_player_world_references(
    source_version: u8,
    location: WorldLocation,
    return_location: WorldLocation,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
    saved_world_instances: &HashSet<WorldInstanceId>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    if source_version == 4 {
        let primary_instance = worlds
            .first()
            .map(|(instance, _, _)| *instance)
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("no primary world is loaded"))?;
        if location.instance() != primary_instance || return_location.instance() != primary_instance
        {
            return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                "snapshot version 4 does not pin target world manifests",
            ));
        }
    }
    if source_version >= 5
        && (!saved_world_instances.contains(&location.instance())
            || !saved_world_instances.contains(&return_location.instance()))
    {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "player location references an unrecorded world instance",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn map_for_world(
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
) -> io::Result<&WorldMap> {
    worlds
        .iter()
        .find(|(candidate, _, _)| *candidate == instance)
        .map(|(_, map, _)| map)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot references an unloaded world instance"))
}

fn gravity_for_world(
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
) -> io::Result<minimium_world::world::CharacterGravity> {
    let manifest = worlds
        .iter()
        .find(|(candidate, _, _)| *candidate == instance)
        .map(|(_, _, manifest)| manifest)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot references an unloaded world instance"))?;
    Ok(match manifest.topology() {
        WorldTopology::Planet => {
            minimium_world::world::CharacterGravity::Radial { center: [0.0; 3] }
        }
        WorldTopology::Dungeon => minimium_world::world::CharacterGravity::FixedY,
    })
}

fn parse_saved_id(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<u64> {
    value
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing player id"))?
        .parse::<u64>()
        .ok()
        .filter(|id| *id > 0)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid player id"))
}

fn parse_saved_coordinate(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<f32> {
    let coordinate = value
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing player coordinate"))?
        .parse::<f32>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid player coordinate"))?;
    if !coordinate.is_finite() || coordinate.abs() > MAX_SAVED_COORDINATE {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("player coordinate is out of range"));
    }
    Ok(coordinate)
}

fn parse_saved_health(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<u16> {
    let health = value
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing player health"))?
        .parse::<u16>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid player health"))?;
    if !(1..=PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH).contains(&health) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("player health is out of range"));
    }
    Ok(health)
}

use crate::{format::worlds::parse_manifest, invalid_world_snapshot};
use minimium_world::world::{WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest, WorldMap};
use std::io;

pub(super) struct SnapshotHeader {
    pub(super) source_version: u8,
    pub(super) legacy_world: WorldInstanceId,
}

pub(super) fn parse_snapshot_header(
    header: &str,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
) -> io::Result<SnapshotHeader> {
    let mut fields = header.split('\t');
    let signature = fields.next();
    let version = fields.next();
    let fingerprint = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing snapshot map fingerprint"))?;
    let fingerprint = u64::from_str_radix(fingerprint, 16)
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid snapshot map fingerprint"))?;
    if signature != Some("MINIMIUM_WORLD") {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid snapshot header"));
    }
    if version == Some("1") {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot version 1 has no client profile IDs; back up or remove the old snapshot before starting"));
    }
    if !matches!(version, Some("2" | "3" | "4" | "5" | "6" | "7" | "8" | "9")) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("unsupported snapshot version"));
    }
    let source_version = version
        .and_then(|value| value.parse::<u8>().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid snapshot version"))?;
    let legacy_world = worlds
        .iter()
        .find(|(_, map, _)| map.fingerprint() == fingerprint)
        .map(|(instance, _, _)| *instance)
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            invalid_world_snapshot(
                "snapshot map fingerprint does not match any loaded legacy world",
            )
        })?;
    match version {
        Some("4" | "5" | "6" | "7" | "8" | "9") => {
            let saved_manifest = parse_manifest(&mut fields)?;
            let Some((_, primary_map, primary_manifest)) = worlds.first() else {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("no primary world is loaded"));
            };
            if fields.next().is_some()
                || primary_map.fingerprint() != fingerprint
                || *primary_manifest != saved_manifest
            {
                return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                    "snapshot primary world manifest or fingerprint does not match",
                ));
            }
        }
        Some("2" | "3") if fields.next().is_some() => {
            return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid legacy snapshot header"));
        }
        Some("2" | "3") => {}
        _ => return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid snapshot header")),
    }
    Ok(SnapshotHeader {
        source_version,
        legacy_world,
    })
}

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/format/locations.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="67" bytes="2429" original_lines="67" original_bytes="2429" minified="false" sha256="d5bef99481e35aa6f3b1c8bc2275a7f5c213f83bf33e63700e5140bdea92f80e">>>
use super::*;
use std::io::Write;

pub(super) fn parse_location(fields: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>) -> io::Result<WorldLocation> {
    let instance = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing location instance"))?
        .parse::<u128>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(WorldInstanceId::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid location instance"))?;
    let mut position = [0_i64; 3];
    for coordinate in &mut position {
        *coordinate = fields
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing quantized coordinate"))?
            .parse::<i64>()
            .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid quantized coordinate"))?;
        if coordinate.unsigned_abs() > MAX_SAVED_POSITION_MM {
            return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                "quantized coordinate is out of range",
            ));
        }
    }
    let mut orientation = [0_i32; 4];
    for component in &mut orientation {
        *component = fields
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing location orientation"))?
            .parse::<i32>()
            .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid location orientation"))?;
    }
    let orientation = WorldOrientationQ30::new(orientation)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid location orientation"))?;
    Ok(WorldLocation::new(
        instance,
        Position3Mm(position),
        orientation,
    ))
}

pub(super) fn write_location(file: &mut impl Write, location: WorldLocation) -> io::Result<()> {
    write!(file, "\t{}", location.instance().get())?;
    for coordinate in location.position().coordinates() {
        write!(file, "\t{coordinate}")?;
    }
    for component in location.orientation().components() {
        write!(file, "\t{component}")?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn legacy_location(instance: WorldInstanceId, position: [f32; 3]) -> WorldLocation {
    let millimeters = position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64);
    WorldLocation::new(
        instance,
        Position3Mm(millimeters),
        WorldOrientationQ30::IDENTITY,
    )
}

pub(super) fn position_from_location(location: WorldLocation) -> [f32; 3] {
    location
        .position()
        .coordinates()
        .map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/format/sectors.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="168" bytes="6363" original_lines="168" original_bytes="6363" minified="false" sha256="7dfcf8a00f82c1196d7e67cca90b1c379eefc06bf28a8156d3c61f0e70651680">>>
use super::*;
use minimium_world::world::{
    ObjectOriginId, PlanetFace, SectorKey, SectorRevision, WorldObjectState, WorldSectorState,
    MAX_OBJECT_STATE_BYTES, MAX_SECTOR_OBJECT_STATES,
};
use std::{io::Write, iter::Peekable, str::Lines};

pub(super) fn parse_saved_sector(
    line: &str,
    lines: &mut Peekable<Lines<'_>>,
) -> io::Result<(WorldInstanceId, WorldSectorState)> {
    let mut fields = line.split('\t');
    if fields.next() != Some("SECTOR") {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved sector record"));
    }
    let instance = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing sector instance"))?
        .parse::<u128>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(WorldInstanceId::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid sector instance"))?;
    let kind = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing sector topology"))?;
    let key = match kind {
        "P" => {
            let face = parse_planet_face(fields.next())?;
            let u = parse_u16(fields.next())?;
            let v = parse_u16(fields.next())?;
            SectorKey::planet(face, u, v)
                .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet sector key"))?
        }
        "D" => SectorKey::dungeon(
            parse_i32(fields.next())?,
            parse_i32(fields.next())?,
            parse_i32(fields.next())?,
        ),
        _ => return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved sector topology")),
    };
    let revision = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing sector revision"))?
        .parse::<u64>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(SectorRevision::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid sector revision"))?;
    let object_count = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing sector object count"))?
        .parse::<usize>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid sector object count"))?;
    if object_count > MAX_SECTOR_OBJECT_STATES || fields.next().is_some() {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "invalid sector object count or fields",
        ));
    }
    let mut objects = Vec::with_capacity(object_count);
    for _ in 0..object_count {
        let object_line = lines
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("truncated sector object records"))?;
        let mut object_fields = object_line.split('\t');
        if object_fields.next() != Some("OBJECT") {
            return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid sector object record"));
        }
        let origin = object_fields
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing object origin ID"))?
            .parse::<u128>()
            .ok()
            .and_then(ObjectOriginId::new)
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid object origin ID"))?;
        let data = decode_object_state(object_fields.next())?;
        if object_fields.next().is_some() {
            return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
                "sector object record has extra fields",
            ));
        }
        objects.push(
            WorldObjectState::new(origin, data)
                .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("object state exceeds size limit"))?,
        );
    }
    let state = WorldSectorState::new(key, revision, objects)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid or duplicate sector objects"))?;
    Ok((instance, state))
}

pub(super) fn write_saved_sector(
    file: &mut impl Write,
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    state: &WorldSectorState,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    write!(file, "SECTOR\t{instance}")?;
    match state.key() {
        SectorKey::Planet(key) => {
            let (u, v) = key.coordinates();
            write!(file, "\tP\t{}\t{u}\t{v}", key.face().index())?;
        }
        SectorKey::Dungeon(key) => {
            let (x, y, z) = key.coordinates();
            write!(file, "\tD\t{x}\t{y}\t{z}")?;
        }
    }
    writeln!(
        file,
        "\t{}\t{}",
        state.revision().get(),
        state.objects().len()
    )?;
    for object in state.objects() {
        write!(file, "OBJECT\t{}\t", object.origin())?;
        for byte in object.data() {
            write!(file, "{byte:02x}")?;
        }
        writeln!(file)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_planet_face(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<PlanetFace> {
    match value.and_then(|value| value.parse::<u8>().ok()) {
        Some(0) => Ok(PlanetFace::PositiveX),
        Some(1) => Ok(PlanetFace::NegativeX),
        Some(2) => Ok(PlanetFace::PositiveY),
        Some(3) => Ok(PlanetFace::NegativeY),
        Some(4) => Ok(PlanetFace::PositiveZ),
        Some(5) => Ok(PlanetFace::NegativeZ),
        _ => Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet face index")),
    }
}

fn parse_u16(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<u16> {
    value
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing planet sector coordinate"))?
        .parse::<u16>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet sector coordinate"))
}

fn parse_i32(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<i32> {
    value
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing dungeon sector coordinate"))?
        .parse::<i32>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid dungeon sector coordinate"))
}

fn decode_object_state(value: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let encoded = value.ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing object state"))?;
    if encoded.len() > MAX_OBJECT_STATE_BYTES * 2
        || encoded.len() % 2 != 0
        || !encoded.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
    {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid object state encoding"));
    }
    encoded
        .as_bytes()
        .as_chunks::<2>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|pair| {
            let pair = std::str::from_utf8(pair)
                .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid object state encoding"))?;
            u8::from_str_radix(pair, 16)
                .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid object state encoding"))
        })
        .collect()
}
