<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/format/worlds.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="262" bytes="10582" original_lines="262" original_bytes="10582" minified="false" sha256="a4cc598be60355df93027bed0332cea60f786fcddd990109fa48ee1c5588baf9">>>
use super::*;
use std::io::Write;

pub(super) fn parse_saved_world(line: &str) -> io::Result<SavedWorldManifest> {
    let mut fields = line.split('\t');
    if fields.next() != Some("WORLD") {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved world record"));
    }
    let instance = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved world instance"))?
        .parse::<u128>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(WorldInstanceId::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved world instance"))?;
    let map_fingerprint = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved world fingerprint"))?;
    let map_fingerprint = u64::from_str_radix(map_fingerprint, 16)
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved world fingerprint"))?;
    let manifest = parse_manifest(&mut fields)?;
    if fields.next().is_some() {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "saved world record has extra fields",
        ));
    }
    Ok(SavedWorldManifest {
        instance,
        map_fingerprint,
        manifest,
    })
}

pub(super) fn validate_saved_world(
    saved: &SavedWorldManifest,
    worlds: &[(WorldInstanceId, WorldMap, WorldManifest)],
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let Some((_, map, manifest)) = worlds
        .iter()
        .find(|(instance, _, _)| *instance == saved.instance)
    else {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "snapshot references an unloaded world instance",
        ));
    };
    if map.fingerprint() != saved.map_fingerprint || *manifest != saved.manifest {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "saved world manifest or fingerprint does not match",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn write_saved_world(
    file: &mut impl Write,
    world: &SavedWorldManifest,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    write!(
        file,
        "WORLD\t{}\t{:016x}",
        world.instance, world.map_fingerprint
    )?;
    write_manifest(file, world.manifest)
}

pub(super) fn write_manifest(file: &mut impl Write, manifest: WorldManifest) -> io::Result<()> {
    if manifest.planet().is_some_and(|p| {
        !p.is_valid() || (p.peak_relief.enabled() && manifest.generation().revision().get() != 5)
    }) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot(
            "invalid peak relief generation contract",
        ));
    }
    write!(
        file,
        "\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}",
        manifest.definition_id().get(),
        match manifest.topology() {
            WorldTopology::Planet => 0,
            WorldTopology::Dungeon => 1,
        },
        manifest.generation().seed().get(),
        manifest.generation().revision().get(),
        manifest.generation().position_quantum_mm(),
        manifest.content_revision().get(),
        hex_digest(manifest.generator_digest().as_bytes())
    )?;
    if manifest.generation().revision().get() >= 3 {
        if let Some(planet) = manifest.planet() {
            write!(
                file,
                "\t1\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}",
                planet.mode,
                planet.radius_mm,
                planet.height_scale_permille,
                planet.sea_level_mm,
                planet.mountain_limit_mm,
                planet.detail_strength_mm,
                planet.detail_wavelength_mm,
                planet.mountain_band_frequency,
                hex_digest(&planet.package_digest)
            )?;
            if manifest.generation().revision().get() >= 5 {
                let curve = planet.peak_relief;
                write!(
                    file,
                    "\t{}\t{}\t{}\t{}",
                    curve.start_m, curve.full_m, curve.multiplier_permille, curve.exponent
                )?;
            }
        } else {
            write!(file, "\t0")?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn parse_manifest(fields: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>) -> io::Result<WorldManifest> {
    let definition = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved world definition"))?
        .parse::<u128>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(WorldDefinitionId::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved world definition"))?;
    let topology = match fields.next() {
        Some("0") => WorldTopology::Planet,
        Some("1") => WorldTopology::Dungeon,
        _ => return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved world topology")),
    };
    let seed = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved world seed"))?
        .parse::<u128>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved world seed"))?;
    let revision = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved generation revision"))?
        .parse::<u32>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(GenerationRevision::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved generation revision"))?;
    let quantum = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved position quantum"))?
        .parse::<u32>()
        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved position quantum"))?;
    let generation = GenerationSpec::new(WorldSeed::new(seed), revision, quantum)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved generation settings"))?;
    let content_revision = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved content revision"))?
        .parse::<u64>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(WorldContentRevision::new)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved content revision"))?;
    let digest = fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("missing saved generator digest"))?;
    if digest.len() != 64 || !digest.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved generator digest"));
    }
    let mut digest_bytes = [0_u8; 32];
    for (byte, pair) in digest_bytes
        .iter_mut()
        .zip(digest.as_bytes().as_chunks::<2>().0.iter())
    {
        let pair = std::str::from_utf8(pair)
            .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved generator digest"))?;
        *byte = u8::from_str_radix(pair, 16)
            .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid saved generator digest"))?;
    }
    let mut manifest = WorldManifest::new(
        definition,
        topology,
        generation,
        content_revision,
        GeneratorDigest::new(digest_bytes),
    );
    if revision.get() >= 3 {
        match fields.next() {
            Some("0") => {}
            Some("1") => {
                let number = |fields: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>| -> io::Result<u64> {
                    next_planet_field(fields)?
                        .parse()
                        .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet definition"))
                };
                let mode = u8::try_from(number(fields)?)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet mode"))?;
                let radius_mm = number(fields)?;
                let height_scale_permille = u32::try_from(number(fields)?)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid height scale"))?;
                let sea_level_mm = next_planet_field(fields)?
                    .parse()
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid sea level"))?;
                let mountain_limit_mm = u32::try_from(number(fields)?)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid mountain limit"))?;
                let detail_strength_mm = u32::try_from(number(fields)?)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid detail strength"))?;
                let detail_wavelength_mm = u32::try_from(number(fields)?)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid detail wavelength"))?;
                let mountain_band_frequency = u32::try_from(number(fields)?)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid mountain frequency"))?;
                let hex = next_planet_field(fields)?;
                if hex.len() != 64 || !hex.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
                    return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet package digest"));
                }
                let mut package_digest = [0; 32];
                for (byte, pair) in package_digest
                    .iter_mut()
                    .zip(hex.as_bytes().as_chunks::<2>().0.iter())
                {
                    *byte = u8::from_str_radix(
                        std::str::from_utf8(pair)
                            .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid package digest"))?,
                        16,
                    )
                    .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid package digest"))?;
                }
                let peak_relief = if revision.get() >= 5 {
                    let value = |f: &mut std::str::Split<'_, char>| {
                        u32::try_from(number(f)?)
                            .map_err(|_| invalid_world_snapshot("invalid peak relief"))
                    };
                    minimium_world::world::PeakRelief {
                        start_m: value(fields)?,
                        full_m: value(fields)?,
                        multiplier_permille: value(fields)?,
                        exponent: value(fields)?,
                    }
                } else {
                    Default::default()
                };
                let planet = PlanetDefinition {
                    mode,
                    radius_mm,
                    height_scale_permille,
                    sea_level_mm,
                    mountain_limit_mm,
                    detail_strength_mm,
                    detail_wavelength_mm,
                    mountain_band_frequency,
                    package_digest,
                    peak_relief,
                };
                if !planet.is_valid() {
                    return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("invalid planet definition"));
                }
                manifest = manifest.with_planet(planet);
            }
            _ => return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("missing planet definition marker")),
        }
    }
    Ok(manifest)
}

fn next_planet_field<'a>(fields: &mut std::str::Split<'a, char>) -> io::Result<&'a str> {
    fields
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("incomplete planet definition"))
}

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/format/write.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="56" bytes="1974" original_lines="56" original_bytes="1974" minified="false" sha256="1e6b9f6c48e076ea5c62154854f407251b1be4405b7bae4eca765710714995f5">>>
use super::*;

pub(super) fn write(snapshot: SaveSnapshot, data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut players: Vec<_> = snapshot
        .player_shards
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|shard| {
            shard
                .iter()
                .map(|(profile_id, player)| (player.id, *profile_id, *player))
        })
        .collect();
    players.sort_unstable_by_key(|(id, _, _)| *id);
    let path = data_dir.join("world.snapshot");
    let temporary_path = data_dir.join("world.snapshot.tmp");
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    {
        write!(
            bytes,
            "MINIMIUM_WORLD\t{SAVE_VERSION}\t{:016x}",
            snapshot.map_fingerprint
        )?;
        write_manifest(&mut bytes, snapshot.manifest)?;
        writeln!(bytes)?;
        for world in snapshot
            .world_manifests
            .iter()
            .filter(|world| world.instance != snapshot.primary_instance)
        {
            write_saved_world(&mut bytes, world)?;
            writeln!(bytes)?;
        }
        write_saved_clock(&mut bytes, snapshot.saved_clock)?;
        writeln!(bytes)?;
        for (instance, state) in &snapshot.sector_states {
            write_saved_sector(&mut bytes, *instance, state)?;
        }
        for (_, profile_id, player) in players {
            write!(
                bytes,
                "{}\t{}\t{}",
                player.id,
                profile_id.to_hex(),
                player.name.as_str()
            )?;
            write_location(&mut bytes, player.location)?;
            write!(bytes, "\t{}", player.health)?;
            write_location(&mut bytes, player.return_location)?;
            writeln!(bytes)?;
        }
    }
    if bytes.len() > MAX_WORLD_SNAPSHOT_BYTES {
        return Err(invalid_world_snapshot("snapshot exceeds size limit"));
    }
    minimium_platform::files::atomic_write_file(&temporary_path, &path, &bytes)
}

        .to_string()
        .chars()
        .take(120)
        .map(|character| {
            if character.is_ascii_whitespace() {
                '_'

        && value.len() <= minimium_core::identity::MAX_PLAYER_NAME_BYTES
        && value
            .bytes()

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/persistence.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="195" bytes="6518" original_lines="195" original_bytes="6518" minified="false" sha256="e099f6b38784f5ec30ca23ae5e1c67de0d12346b8c6d26997740b436b585ba5c">>>
use super::{
    player_store::{PlayerStore, SaveSnapshot},
    WorldSaveInput,
};
use minimium_environment::time::SavedClockState;
use minimium_telemetry::allocations::{self, Phase};
use std::{io, path::PathBuf, sync::mpsc, thread};

mod status;

use status::SaveBookkeeping;

enum PersistenceRequest {
    Save(SaveSnapshot),
    Shutdown(Option<SaveSnapshot>, mpsc::SyncSender<io::Result<()>>),
    Stop,
}

pub struct PersistenceWorker {
    sender: mpsc::SyncSender<PersistenceRequest>,
    completions: mpsc::Receiver<io::Result<()>>,
    thread: Option<thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
    status: SaveBookkeeping,
}

impl PersistenceWorker {
    pub fn spawn(data_dir: PathBuf) -> io::Result<Self> {
        let (sender, requests) = mpsc::sync_channel::<PersistenceRequest>(1);
        let (completion_sender, completions) = mpsc::channel();
        let worker = thread::Builder::new()
            .name("minimium-storage".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let _storage_phase = allocations::enter(Phase::Storage);
                while let Ok(request) = requests.recv() {
                    match request {
                        PersistenceRequest::Save(snapshot) => {
                            let _ = completion_sender.send(snapshot.write(&data_dir));
                        }
                        PersistenceRequest::Shutdown(snapshot, reply) => {
                            let result =
                                snapshot.map_or(Ok(()), |snapshot| snapshot.write(&data_dir));
                            let _ = reply.send(result);
                            break;
                        }
                        PersistenceRequest::Stop => break,
                    }
                }
            })?;
        Ok(Self {
            sender,
            completions,
            thread: Some(worker),
            status: SaveBookkeeping::default(),
        })
    }

    pub fn queue_save(&mut self, snapshot: SaveSnapshot) -> io::Result<()> {
        match self.sender.try_send(PersistenceRequest::Save(snapshot)) {
            Ok(()) => {
                self.status.record_queued();
                Ok(())
            }
            Err(mpsc::TrySendError::Full(_)) => Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
                "a world save is already queued",
            )),
            Err(mpsc::TrySendError::Disconnected(_)) => {
                let error = worker_stopped();
                self.status.record_enqueue_failure(&error);
                Err(error)
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn queue_world_save(
        &mut self,
        player_store: &mut PlayerStore,
        input: WorldSaveInput,
        saved_clock: SavedClockState,
    ) -> io::Result<()> {
        if self.status.has_pending_save() {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
                "a world save is already pending",
            ));
        }
        let snapshot = player_store.save_snapshot(input, saved_clock)?;
        self.queue_save(snapshot)
    }

    pub fn poll_completions(&mut self) {
        loop {
            match self.completions.try_recv() {
                Ok(result) => {
                    self.status.record_completion(result);
                }
                Err(mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                Err(mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => {
                    self.status.record_worker_stopped();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn has_pending_save(&self) -> bool {
        self.status.has_pending_save()
    }

    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        self.status.summary()
    }

    pub fn shutdown(&mut self, snapshot: Option<SaveSnapshot>) -> io::Result<()> {
        let (reply_sender, reply_receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel(1);
        let send_result = self.send_shutdown(snapshot, reply_sender);
        let save_result = Self::receive_shutdown_result(&send_result, reply_receiver);
        let join_result = self.join_worker();
        self.poll_completions();
        Self::report_shutdown_errors(&send_result, &save_result, &join_result);
        send_result?;
        save_result?;
        join_result
    }

    fn send_shutdown(
        &self,
        snapshot: Option<SaveSnapshot>,
        reply: mpsc::SyncSender<io::Result<()>>,
    ) -> io::Result<()> {
        self.sender
            .send(PersistenceRequest::Shutdown(snapshot, reply))
            .map_err(|_| worker_stopped())
    }

    fn receive_shutdown_result(
        send_result: &io::Result<()>,
        reply: mpsc::Receiver<io::Result<()>>,
    ) -> io::Result<()> {
        if send_result.is_ok() {
            match reply.recv() {
                Ok(result) => result,
                Err(_) => Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe,
                    "world storage worker stopped before shutdown completed",
                )),
            }
        } else {
            Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe,
                "world storage worker stopped before shutdown was queued",
            ))
        }
    }

    fn report_shutdown_errors(
        send_result: &io::Result<()>,
        save_result: &io::Result<()>,
        join_result: &io::Result<()>,
    ) {
        if let Err(error) = join_result {
            if send_result.is_err() || save_result.is_err() {
                eprintln!("storage worker join also failed: {error}");
            }
        }
        if let Err(error) = save_result {
            if send_result.is_err() {
                eprintln!("final save also failed: {error}");
            }
        }
    }

    fn join_worker(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        if let Some(worker) = self.thread.take() {
            worker
                .join()
                .map_err(|_| io::Error::other("world storage worker panicked"))?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Drop for PersistenceWorker {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.thread.is_some() {
            let _ = self.sender.send(PersistenceRequest::Stop);
            let _ = self.join_worker();
            self.poll_completions();
        }
    }
}

fn worker_stopped() -> io::Error {
    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe, "world storage worker stopped")
}

use crate::compact_error;
use std::io;

enum SaveStatus {
    Never,
    Pending,
    Complete,
    Failed(String),
}

impl std::fmt::Display for SaveStatus {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Never => f.write_str("never"),
            Self::Pending => f.write_str("pending"),
            Self::Complete => f.write_str("ok"),
            Self::Failed(message) => write!(f, "error_{message}"),
        }
    }
}

pub(super) struct SaveBookkeeping {
    pending_saves: usize,
    last_save: SaveStatus,
}

impl Default for SaveBookkeeping {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            pending_saves: 0,
            last_save: SaveStatus::Never,
        }
    }
}

impl SaveBookkeeping {
    pub(super) fn record_queued(&mut self) {
        self.pending_saves = self.pending_saves.saturating_add(1);
        self.last_save = SaveStatus::Pending;
    }

    pub(super) fn record_enqueue_failure(&mut self, error: &io::Error) {
        self.last_save = SaveStatus::Failed(compact_error(error));
    }

    pub(super) fn record_completion(&mut self, result: io::Result<()>) {
        self.pending_saves = self.pending_saves.saturating_sub(1);
        match result {
            Ok(()) => {
                self.last_save = SaveStatus::Complete;
                println!("world save completed");
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.last_save = SaveStatus::Failed(compact_error(&error));
                eprintln!("world save failed: {error}");
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn record_worker_stopped(&mut self) {
        if self.pending_saves > 0 {
            self.pending_saves = 0;
            self.last_save = SaveStatus::Failed(String::from("world_storage_worker_stopped"));
            eprintln!("world storage worker stopped before completing a save");
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn has_pending_save(&self) -> bool {
        self.pending_saves != 0
    }

    pub(super) fn summary(&self) -> String {
        format!(
            "save_pending={} save_last={}",
            self.pending_saves, self.last_save
        )
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/player_store/migration.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="37" bytes="1397" original_lines="37" original_bytes="1397" minified="false" sha256="ca10ee0f4bc1833fcd11205f7c7ee5de1661a4c4e6e5be919f18f6da1ff42030">>>
use super::PlayerStore;
use minimium_world::world::WorldLocation;

impl PlayerStore {
    pub fn migrate_legacy_planet_positions(&mut self) {
        for shard in &mut self.players {
            for player in std::sync::Arc::make_mut(shard).values_mut() {
                if player.location.instance().get() == 1 {
                    player.location = remap_planet_location(player.location);
                    player.position = player
                        .location
                        .position()
                        .coordinates()
                        .map(|x| x as f32 / 1000.0);
                }
                if player.return_location.instance().get() == 1 {
                    player.return_location = remap_planet_location(player.return_location);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn remap_planet_location(location: WorldLocation) -> WorldLocation {
    let old = location.position().coordinates().map(|x| x as f64);
    let length = old.iter().map(|x| x * x).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
    if length < 1.0 {
        return location;
    }
    let radius = 10_035_000.0 + (length - 100_000.0).max(0.0);
    let position = old.map(|x| (x / length * radius).round() as i64);
    WorldLocation::new(
        location.instance(),
        minimium_world::world::Position3Mm(position),
        location.orientation(),
    )
}

use super::{PlayerStore, StoredName, StoredPlayer};
use crate::{format, invalid_world_snapshot};
use minimium_core::identity::PlayerProfileId;
use minimium_core::ids::PlayerId;
use minimium_simulation::{Player, PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH};
use minimium_world::world::{CharacterGravity, WorldInstanceId, WorldLocation};
use std::{io, sync::Arc};

fn player_store_shard(profile_id: PlayerProfileId) -> usize {
    usize::from(profile_id.as_bytes()[0])
}

impl PlayerStore {
    pub fn reserve_active(&mut self, capacity: usize) {
        self.active_players.reserve(capacity);
    }

    pub fn active_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.active_players.len()
    }

    pub fn is_active(&self, player: PlayerId) -> bool {
        self.active_players.contains(&player)
    }

    pub fn profile_for_player(&self, player: PlayerId) -> Option<PlayerProfileId> {
        self.profile_by_player.get(&player).copied()
    }

    pub fn next_player_id(&self) -> io::Result<u64> {
        self.players
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|shard| shard.values())
            .map(|player| player.id.get())
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("player id space is exhausted"))
    }

    pub fn claim(
        &mut self,
        profile_id: PlayerProfileId,
        next_id: &mut u64,
        spawn: [f32; 3],
        spawn_mm: Option<minimium_world::world::Position3Mm>,
        spawn_instance: WorldInstanceId,
        spawn_gravity: CharacterGravity,
    ) -> io::Result<StoredPlayer> {
        let shard = player_store_shard(profile_id);
        if let Some(existing) = self.players[shard].get(&profile_id) {
            if self.active_players.contains(&existing.id) {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists,
                    "player profile is already connected",
                ));
            }
        } else {
            if self.profile_by_player.len() >= format::MAX_STORED_PLAYERS {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "server has reached the saved player limit",
                ));
            }
            let id = *next_id;
            *next_id = id
                .checked_add(1)
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("player id space is exhausted"))?;
            let default_name = format!("Player{id}");
            let name = StoredName::new(&default_name)
                .or_else(|| StoredName::new(&format!("P{id}")))
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("could not create default player name"))?;
            let spawn_location =
                crate::world_location::world_location(spawn_instance, spawn, spawn_gravity);
            let spawn_location = spawn_mm.map_or(spawn_location, |position| {
                WorldLocation::new(spawn_instance, position, spawn_location.orientation())
            });
            let player = StoredPlayer {
                id: PlayerId::new(id),
                name,
                position: spawn,
                health: PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH,
                location: spawn_location,
                return_location: spawn_location,
            };
            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players[shard]).insert(profile_id, player);
            self.profile_by_player.insert(PlayerId::new(id), profile_id);
        }
        let player = self.players[shard]
            .get(&profile_id)
            .copied()
            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("player record disappeared"))?;
        if !self.active_players.insert(player.id) {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists,
                "player profile is already connected",
            ));
        }
        Ok(player)
    }

    pub fn release(&mut self, player_id: PlayerId) {
        self.active_players.remove(&player_id);
    }

    pub fn update_from_player(
        &mut self,
        player: &Player,
        instance: WorldInstanceId,
        gravity: CharacterGravity,
    ) -> io::Result<()> {
        let profile_id = self
            .profile_by_player
            .get(&player.id)
            .copied()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("active player has no profile id"))?;
        let shard = player_store_shard(profile_id);
        let stored = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players[shard])
            .get_mut(&profile_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("active player record is missing"))?;
        stored.name = StoredName::new(player.name.as_ref())
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid_world_snapshot("active player has an invalid name"))?;
        stored.position = player.position;
        stored.health = player.health;
        stored.location = crate::world_location::player_location(instance, player, gravity);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn set_return_location(&mut self, player: PlayerId, location: WorldLocation) {
        let Some(profile_id) = self.profile_by_player.get(&player).copied() else {
            return;
        };
        let shard = player_store_shard(profile_id);
        if let Some(stored) = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players[shard]).get_mut(&profile_id) {
            stored.return_location = location;
        }
    }

    pub fn return_location_for(&self, player: PlayerId) -> Option<WorldLocation> {
        let profile_id = self.profile_by_player.get(&player)?;
        let shard = player_store_shard(*profile_id);
        self.players[shard]
            .get(profile_id)
            .map(|stored| stored.return_location)
    }

    pub fn name_for_player(&self, player_id: PlayerId) -> Option<&str> {
        let profile_id = self.profile_by_player.get(&player_id)?;
        let shard = player_store_shard(*profile_id);
        self.players[shard]
            .get(profile_id)
            .map(|player| player.name.as_str())
    }

    pub fn rename(&mut self, player_id: PlayerId, name: String) {
        if let Some(profile_id) = self.profile_by_player.get(&player_id).copied() {
            let shard = player_store_shard(profile_id);
            if let Some(player) = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.players[shard]).get_mut(&profile_id) {
                if let Some(name) = StoredName::new(&name) {
                    player.name = name;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn capture(
    store: &mut PlayerStore,
    input: WorldSaveInput,
    saved_clock: SavedClockState,
) -> io::Result<SaveSnapshot> {
    let _storage_phase =
        minimium_telemetry::allocations::enter(minimium_telemetry::allocations::Phase::Storage);
    for world in &input.worlds {
        for player in &world.players {
            store.update_from_player(player, world.instance, world.gravity)?;
        }

        .worlds
        .into_iter()
        .map(|world| SavedWorldManifest {
            instance: world.instance,
            map_fingerprint: world.map_fingerprint,
            manifest: world.manifest,
        })
        .collect();
    Ok(SaveSnapshot {
        saved_clock,
        primary_instance: input.primary_instance,
        map_fingerprint: input.primary_map_fingerprint,
        manifest: input.primary_manifest,
        world_manifests,
        sector_states: input.sector_states,
        player_shards,
    })
}

    pub fn write(self, data_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {

<<<FILE path="crates/storage/src/world_location.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="64" bytes="2377" original_lines="64" original_bytes="2377" minified="false" sha256="7f548d52993db93a0f30c2ab472db9a50ba93ba29cb0536ea3caa73b485b9943">>>
use minimium_world::world::{
    CharacterGravity, Position3Mm, WorldInstanceId, WorldLocation, WorldOrientationQ30,
};

const RADIAL_SAVE_CLEARANCE: f32 = 0.01;

pub fn world_location(
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    position: [f32; 3],
    gravity: CharacterGravity,
) -> WorldLocation {
    let up = minimium_world::world::character_frame(gravity, position).0;
    // A radial location sits on a curved triangle; millimeter rounding can
    // otherwise move its capsule a few millimeters back into the surface.
    let safe_position = if matches!(gravity, CharacterGravity::Radial { .. }) {
        std::array::from_fn(|axis| position[axis] + up[axis] * RADIAL_SAVE_CLEARANCE)
    } else {
        position
    };
    let quantized = safe_position.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * 1000.0).round() as i64);
    WorldLocation::new(
        instance,
        Position3Mm(quantized),
        orientation_for_gravity(gravity, safe_position),
    )
}

pub fn player_location(
    instance: WorldInstanceId,
    player: &minimium_simulation::Player,
    gravity: CharacterGravity,
) -> WorldLocation {
    let Some(mut position_mm) = player.position_mm else {
        return world_location(instance, player.position, gravity);
    };
    if matches!(gravity, CharacterGravity::Radial { .. }) {
        let up = minimium_world::world::character_frame(gravity, player.position).0;
        for (axis, direction) in up.into_iter().enumerate() {
            position_mm.0[axis] += (f64::from(direction) * 10.0).round() as i64;
        }
    }
    WorldLocation::new(
        instance,
        position_mm,
        orientation_for_gravity(gravity, player.position),
    )
}

fn orientation_for_gravity(gravity: CharacterGravity, position: [f32; 3]) -> WorldOrientationQ30 {
    let up = minimium_world::world::character_frame(gravity, position).0;
    let denominator = (2.0 * (1.0 + up[1])).sqrt();
    let quaternion = if denominator <= 1.0e-6 {
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    } else {
        [
            ((1.0 + up[1]) * 0.5).sqrt(),
            up[2] / denominator,
            0.0,
            -up[0] / denominator,
        ]
    };
    let fixed = quaternion.map(|value| (f64::from(value) * (1_i64 << 30) as f64).round() as i32);
    WorldOrientationQ30::new(fixed).unwrap_or(WorldOrientationQ30::IDENTITY)
}

/// Phases are thread local; executor jobs inherit their submitting phase.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
#[repr(usize)]
pub enum Phase {
    Other,
    Network,
    Commands,
    Input,
    Simulation,
    Snapshot,
    Storage,
}
pub const PHASES: [Phase; 7] = [
    Phase::Other,
    Phase::Network,
    Phase::Commands,
    Phase::Input,
    Phase::Simulation,
    Phase::Snapshot,
    Phase::Storage,
];
impl Phase {
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Other => "other",
            Self::Network => "network",
            Self::Commands => "commands",
            Self::Input => "input",
            Self::Simulation => "simulation",
            Self::Snapshot => "snapshot",
            Self::Storage => "storage",
        }
    }
}
pub const ENABLED: bool = cfg!(feature = "allocation-metrics");
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct Counts {
    pub allocations: u64,
    pub reallocations: u64,
    pub bytes: u64,
}

#[cfg(feature = "allocation-metrics")]
mod enabled {
    use super::{Counts, Phase};
    use std::{
        alloc::{GlobalAlloc, Layout, System},
        cell::Cell,
        sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},
    };
    thread_local! { static PHASE: Cell<Phase> = const { Cell::new(Phase::Other) }; }
    struct Counters {
        allocations: AtomicU64,
        reallocations: AtomicU64,
        bytes: AtomicU64,
    }
    static COUNTERS: [Counters; 7] = [const {
        Counters {
            allocations: AtomicU64::new(0),
            reallocations: AtomicU64::new(0),
            bytes: AtomicU64::new(0),
        }
    }; 7];
    pub fn current_phase() -> Phase {
        PHASE.try_with(Cell::get).unwrap_or(Phase::Other)
    }
    pub struct PhaseGuard {
        previous: Phase,
    }
    pub fn enter(phase: Phase) -> PhaseGuard {
        let previous = PHASE
            .try_with(|slot| slot.replace(phase))
            .unwrap_or(Phase::Other);
        PhaseGuard { previous }
    }
    impl Drop for PhaseGuard {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let _ = PHASE.try_with(|slot| slot.set(self.previous));
        }
    }
    fn record(bytes: usize, reallocation: bool) {
        let counters = &COUNTERS[current_phase() as usize];
        if reallocation {
            counters.reallocations.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        } else {
            counters.allocations.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        counters.bytes.fetch_add(bytes as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    pub fn snapshot() -> [Counts; 7] {
        std::array::from_fn(|i| Counts {
            allocations: COUNTERS[i].allocations.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            reallocations: COUNTERS[i].reallocations.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            bytes: COUNTERS[i].bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        })
    }
    pub struct CountingAllocator;
    // SAFETY: forwards the exact pointer/layout contract to System. Counters use only
    // const TLS Cell and relaxed atomics: no allocation, logging, mutex, or unwinding.
    // Only successful allocation/reallocation is counted; deallocation is unchanged.
    unsafe impl GlobalAlloc for CountingAllocator {
        unsafe fn alloc(&self, layout: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
            let result = unsafe { System.alloc(layout) };
            if !result.is_null() {
                record(layout.size(), false);
            }
            result
        }
        unsafe fn alloc_zeroed(&self, layout: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
            let result = unsafe { System.alloc_zeroed(layout) };
            if !result.is_null() {
                record(layout.size(), false);
            }
            result
        }
        unsafe fn dealloc(&self, pointer: *mut u8, layout: Layout) {
            unsafe {
                System.dealloc(pointer, layout);
            }
        }
        unsafe fn realloc(&self, pointer: *mut u8, layout: Layout, size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
            let result = unsafe { System.realloc(pointer, layout, size) };
            if !result.is_null() {
                record(size, true);
            }
            result
        }
    }
}

    }

    }

<<<FILE path="crates/telemetry/src/duration.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="175" bytes="5948" original_lines="175" original_bytes="5948" minified="false" sha256="3d4ab199ea53c1481db8dea988182216ce133298e8b397498f8e5b5f31a5e2e5">>>
use std::time::Duration;

const TICK_BOUNDS_MICROS: &[u64] = &[50, 100, 250, 500, 1_000, 2_500, 5_000, 50_000];
// Dense boundaries preserve useful frame-time resolution around common refresh
// targets (8, 16, 20, and 33 ms).
const FRAME_BOUNDS_MICROS: &[u64] = &[
    4_000, 6_000, 8_000, 10_000, 12_000, 14_000, 16_000, 18_000, 20_000, 22_000, 25_000, 28_000,
    33_000, 40_000, 50_000,
];
const RTT_BOUNDS_MICROS: &[u64] = &[
    50, 100, 250, 500, 1_000, 2_000, 5_000, 10_000, 20_000, 50_000, 100_000, 250_000, 500_000,
    1_000_000, 2_500_000, 5_000_000,
];
const MAX_BUCKETS: usize = 17;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum BucketSet {
    Tick,
    Frame,
    Rtt,
}

impl BucketSet {
    fn bounds(self) -> &'static [u64] {
        match self {
            Self::Tick => TICK_BOUNDS_MICROS,
            Self::Frame => FRAME_BOUNDS_MICROS,
            Self::Rtt => RTT_BOUNDS_MICROS,
        }
    }
}

/// Fixed-storage duration histogram with source-specific bucket boundaries.
/// Recording and merging never allocate.
pub struct DurationStats {
    bucket_set: BucketSet,
    samples: u64,
    total_nanoseconds: u128,
    maximum_nanoseconds: u64,
    minimum_nanoseconds: Option<u64>,
    buckets: [u64; MAX_BUCKETS],
}

/// Histogram for simulation ticks and server work phases.
pub type TickDurationStats = DurationStats;
/// Histogram for redraw intervals and client render work.
pub type FrameDurationStats = DurationStats;
/// Histogram for generator-observed ping/pong round-trip time.
pub type RttDurationStats = DurationStats;

impl Default for DurationStats {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::with_bucket_set(BucketSet::Tick)
    }
}

impl DurationStats {
    pub fn ticks() -> Self {
        Self::with_bucket_set(BucketSet::Tick)
    }

    pub fn frames() -> Self {
        Self::with_bucket_set(BucketSet::Frame)
    }

    pub fn rtt() -> Self {
        Self::with_bucket_set(BucketSet::Rtt)
    }

    fn with_bucket_set(bucket_set: BucketSet) -> Self {
        Self {
            bucket_set,
            samples: 0,
            total_nanoseconds: 0,
            maximum_nanoseconds: 0,
            minimum_nanoseconds: None,
            buckets: [0; MAX_BUCKETS],
        }
    }

    pub fn record(&mut self, duration: Duration) {
        let nanoseconds = duration.as_nanos().min(u128::from(u64::MAX)) as u64;
        let bounds = self.bucket_set.bounds();
        let bucket = bounds
            .iter()
            .position(|limit| nanoseconds <= limit.saturating_mul(1_000))
            .unwrap_or(bounds.len());
        self.samples = self.samples.saturating_add(1);
        self.total_nanoseconds = self
            .total_nanoseconds
            .saturating_add(u128::from(nanoseconds));
        self.minimum_nanoseconds = Some(
            self.minimum_nanoseconds
                .unwrap_or(nanoseconds)
                .min(nanoseconds),
        );
        self.maximum_nanoseconds = self.maximum_nanoseconds.max(nanoseconds);
        self.buckets[bucket] = self.buckets[bucket].saturating_add(1);
    }

    pub fn merge(&mut self, other: &Self) {
        assert_eq!(
            self.bucket_set, other.bucket_set,
            "histogram bucket sets differ"
        );
        self.samples = self.samples.saturating_add(other.samples);
        self.total_nanoseconds = self
            .total_nanoseconds
            .saturating_add(other.total_nanoseconds);
        self.minimum_nanoseconds = match (self.minimum_nanoseconds, other.minimum_nanoseconds) {
            (Some(left), Some(right)) => Some(left.min(right)),
            (None, value) | (value, None) => value,
        };
        self.maximum_nanoseconds = self.maximum_nanoseconds.max(other.maximum_nanoseconds);
        for (total, count) in self.buckets.iter_mut().zip(other.buckets) {
            *total = total.saturating_add(count);
        }
    }

    pub fn samples(&self) -> u64 {
        self.samples
    }

    pub fn minimum_microseconds(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.minimum_nanoseconds.map(|value| value / 1_000)
    }

    pub fn average_milliseconds(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        (self.samples > 0)
            .then(|| self.total_nanoseconds as f64 / self.samples as f64 / 1_000_000.0)
    }

    pub fn percentile_milliseconds(&self, percentile: u64) -> Option<f64> {
        self.percentile_microseconds(percentile)
            .map(|value| value as f64 / 1_000.0)
    }

    pub fn minimum_milliseconds(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        self.minimum_microseconds()
            .map(|value| value as f64 / 1_000.0)
    }

    pub fn maximum_milliseconds(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        (self.samples > 0).then(|| self.maximum_nanoseconds as f64 / 1_000_000.0)
    }

    pub fn average_microseconds(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        (self.samples > 0).then(|| {
            (self.total_nanoseconds / u128::from(self.samples) / 1_000).min(u128::from(u64::MAX))
                as u64
        })
    }

    pub fn percentile_microseconds(&self, percentile: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        if self.samples == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        let percentile = percentile.clamp(1, 100);
        let rank = (u128::from(self.samples) * u128::from(percentile)).div_ceil(100) as u64;
        let mut cumulative = 0u64;
        for (index, count) in self.buckets.iter().enumerate() {
            cumulative = cumulative.saturating_add(*count);
            if cumulative >= rank {
                return Some(
                    self.bucket_set
                        .bounds()
                        .get(index)
                        .copied()
                        .unwrap_or(self.maximum_nanoseconds / 1_000),
                );
            }
        }
        Some(self.maximum_nanoseconds / 1_000)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="crates/telemetry/src/memory.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="96" bytes="3127" original_lines="96" original_bytes="3127" minified="false" sha256="949514f800aaf7765ad3c71353e1f997ad5185b860923bf0938f2e769869754c">>>
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
pub(super) fn read_proc(path: &str) -> Option<String> {
    use std::io::Read;
    const LIMIT: usize = 64 * 1024;
    let mut text = String::new();
    std::fs::File::open(path)
        .ok()?
        .take((LIMIT + 1) as u64)
        .read_to_string(&mut text)
        .ok()?;
    (text.len() <= LIMIT).then_some(text)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct ProcessMemory {
    pub(super) rss_bytes: u64,
    pub(super) private_bytes: Option<u64>,
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
pub(super) fn process_memory() -> Option<ProcessMemory> {
    fn kibibytes_field(source: &str, field: &str) -> Option<u64> {
        let line = source.lines().find(|line| line.starts_with(field))?;
        let mut values = line[field.len()..].split_whitespace();
        let value = values.next()?.parse::<u64>().ok()?;
        match values.next()? {
            "kB" => value.checked_mul(1024),
            "B" => Some(value),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    let status = read_proc("/proc/self/status")?;
    Some(ProcessMemory {
        rss_bytes: kibibytes_field(&status, "VmRSS:")?,
        private_bytes: None,
    })
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub(super) fn process_memory() -> Option<ProcessMemory> {
    use std::{ffi::c_void, mem::size_of};

    #[repr(C)]
    struct ProcessMemoryCountersEx {
        cb: u32,
        page_fault_count: u32,
        peak_working_set_size: usize,
        working_set_size: usize,
        quota_peak_paged_pool_usage: usize,
        quota_paged_pool_usage: usize,
        quota_peak_non_paged_pool_usage: usize,
        quota_non_paged_pool_usage: usize,
        pagefile_usage: usize,
        peak_pagefile_usage: usize,
        private_usage: usize,
    }

    #[link(name = "kernel32")]
    unsafe extern "system" {
        fn GetCurrentProcess() -> *mut c_void;
        fn K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(
            process: *mut c_void,
            counters: *mut ProcessMemoryCountersEx,
            size: u32,
        ) -> i32;
    }

    let size = u32::try_from(size_of::<ProcessMemoryCountersEx>()).ok()?;
    let mut counters = ProcessMemoryCountersEx {
        cb: size,
        page_fault_count: 0,
        peak_working_set_size: 0,
        working_set_size: 0,
        quota_peak_paged_pool_usage: 0,
        quota_paged_pool_usage: 0,
        quota_peak_non_paged_pool_usage: 0,
        quota_non_paged_pool_usage: 0,
        pagefile_usage: 0,
        peak_pagefile_usage: 0,
        private_usage: 0,
    };
    // SAFETY: the pseudo-handle is borrowed; a valid initialized repr(C) output
    // structure and its exact byte size are passed for the duration of the call.
    let succeeded =
        unsafe { K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), &mut counters, size) } != 0;
    succeeded.then_some(ProcessMemory {
        rss_bytes: counters.working_set_size as u64,
        private_bytes: Some(counters.private_usage as u64),
    })
}

#[cfg(not(any(target_os = "linux", windows)))]
pub(super) fn process_memory() -> Option<ProcessMemory> {
    None
}

<<<FILE path="crates/telemetry/src/process.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="171" bytes="5696" original_lines="171" original_bytes="5696" minified="false" sha256="adbe3fe097cfed50487aa7d4606605ea4f6c4779d7d9cf1cec5d4e88aa0a3d9d">>>
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// Cumulative process CPU time (all OS threads) and instantaneous process resources.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct ProcessSample {
    pub rss_bytes: Option<u64>,
    pub private_bytes: Option<u64>,
    pub cpu_time: Option<Duration>,
    pub threads: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ProcessSampler {
    sampled_at: Option<Instant>,
    sample: ProcessSample,
}

impl ProcessSampler {
    /// Cached for one second; failed measurements remain explicitly unavailable.
    pub fn sample(&mut self, now: Instant) -> ProcessSample {
        if self
            .sampled_at
            .is_none_or(|at| now.saturating_duration_since(at) >= Duration::from_secs(1))
        {
            self.sampled_at = Some(now);
            let memory = crate::memory::process_memory();
            let (cpu_time, threads) = process_execution();
            self.sample = ProcessSample {
                rss_bytes: memory.map(|value| value.rss_bytes),
                private_bytes: memory.and_then(|value| value.private_bytes),
                cpu_time,
                threads,
            };
        }
        self.sample
    }
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
fn process_execution() -> (Option<Duration>, Option<u32>) {
    use std::os::raw::{c_int, c_long};
    unsafe extern "C" {
        fn sysconf(name: c_int) -> c_long;
    }
    // Linux _SC_CLK_TCK. sysconf has no pointer arguments or ownership requirements.
    let hz = unsafe { sysconf(2) };
    let cpu = (|| {
        let stat = crate::memory::read_proc("/proc/self/stat")?;
        // comm (field 2) may contain spaces/parentheses; split after its final ')'.
        let mut fields = stat.rsplit_once(')')?.1.split_whitespace();
        let user = fields.nth(11)?.parse::<u64>().ok()?; // field 14
        let kernel = fields.next()?.parse::<u64>().ok()?; // field 15
        let hz = u64::try_from(hz).ok().filter(|hz| *hz > 0)?;
        let ticks = user.checked_add(kernel)?;
        Some(Duration::new(
            ticks / hz,
            ((ticks % hz) as u128 * 1_000_000_000 / hz as u128) as u32,
        ))
    })();
    let threads = crate::memory::read_proc("/proc/self/status").and_then(|status| {
        status
            .lines()
            .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("Threads:")?.trim().parse().ok())
    });
    (cpu, threads)
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn process_execution() -> (Option<Duration>, Option<u32>) {
    use std::{ffi::c_void, mem::size_of};
    #[repr(C)]
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct FileTime {
        low: u32,
        high: u32,
    }
    impl FileTime {
        fn ticks(&self) -> u64 {
            (u64::from(self.high) << 32) | u64::from(self.low)
        }
    }
    #[repr(C)]
    struct ProcessEntry {
        size: u32,
        usage: u32,
        process_id: u32,
        default_heap: usize,
        module_id: u32,
        threads: u32,
        parent_id: u32,
        priority: i32,
        flags: u32,
        executable: [u16; 260],
    }
    #[link(name = "kernel32")]
    unsafe extern "system" {
        fn GetCurrentProcess() -> *mut c_void;
        fn GetProcessTimes(
            process: *mut c_void,
            creation: *mut FileTime,
            exit: *mut FileTime,
            kernel: *mut FileTime,
            user: *mut FileTime,
        ) -> i32;
        fn CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(flags: u32, process_id: u32) -> *mut c_void;
        fn Process32FirstW(snapshot: *mut c_void, entry: *mut ProcessEntry) -> i32;
        fn Process32NextW(snapshot: *mut c_void, entry: *mut ProcessEntry) -> i32;
        fn CloseHandle(handle: *mut c_void) -> i32;
    }
    let (mut creation, mut exit, mut kernel, mut user) = (
        FileTime::default(),
        FileTime::default(),
        FileTime::default(),
        FileTime::default(),
    );
    // SAFETY: repr(C) FILETIME buffers are writable, disjoint, and live for the call.
    // GetCurrentProcess returns a borrowed pseudo-handle which must not be closed.
    let success = unsafe {
        GetProcessTimes(
            GetCurrentProcess(),
            &mut creation,
            &mut exit,
            &mut kernel,
            &mut user,
        )
    } != 0;
    let cpu = success.then(|| {
        Duration::from_nanos(
            kernel
                .ticks()
                .saturating_add(user.ticks())
                .saturating_mul(100),
        )
    });
    // TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS; successful snapshot handles are closed exactly once below.
    let snapshot = unsafe { CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(2, 0) };
    if snapshot as isize == -1 {
        return (cpu, None);
    }
    let mut entry = ProcessEntry {
        size: size_of::<ProcessEntry>() as u32,
        usage: 0,
        process_id: 0,
        default_heap: 0,
        module_id: 0,
        threads: 0,
        parent_id: 0,
        priority: 0,
        flags: 0,
        executable: [0; 260],
    };
    let mut threads = None;
    // SAFETY: initialized correctly sized repr(C) PROCESSENTRY32W and valid snapshot.
    let mut available = unsafe { Process32FirstW(snapshot, &mut entry) } != 0;
    while available {
        if entry.process_id == std::process::id() {
            threads = Some(entry.threads);
            break;
        }
        available = unsafe { Process32NextW(snapshot, &mut entry) } != 0;
    }
    unsafe {
        CloseHandle(snapshot);
    }
    (cpu, threads)
}

#[cfg(not(any(target_os = "linux", windows)))]
fn process_execution() -> (Option<Duration>, Option<u32>) {
    (None, None)
}

<<<FILE path="crates/transport/src/lib.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="156" bytes="4547" original_lines="156" original_bytes="4547" minified="false" sha256="9756dc00b5bc39eb4bc6011d2e28f9d2e3c55b50866ee06c27edc7d3642450c9">>>
use std::{
    io::{self, Write},
    net::TcpStream,
};

/// Result of flushing the queued bytes for one client.
pub struct FlushResult {
    pub written: usize,
    pub error: Option<io::Error>,
}

/// Writes queued output while retaining all bytes not yet sent.
pub fn flush(
    stream: &mut TcpStream,
    output: &[u8],
    offset: &mut usize,
    budget: usize,
) -> FlushResult {
    flush_writer(stream, output, offset, budget)
}

fn flush_writer(
    writer: &mut impl Write,
    output: &[u8],
    offset: &mut usize,
    budget: usize,
) -> FlushResult {
    let mut written = 0;
    if *offset > output.len() {
        return FlushResult {
            written,
            error: Some(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                "output offset exceeds queued bytes",
            )),
        };
    }

    while *offset < output.len() && written < budget {
        let end = output.len().min(offset.saturating_add(budget - written));
        match writer.write(&output[*offset..end]) {
            Ok(0) => {
                return FlushResult {
                    written,
                    error: Some(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::WriteZero,
                        "failed to write queued client output",
                    )),
                };
            }
            Ok(count) => {
                *offset += count;
                written += count;
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                return FlushResult {
                    written,
                    error: None,
                };
            }
            Err(error) => {
                return FlushResult {
                    written,
                    error: Some(error),
                };
            }
        }
    }

    FlushResult {
        written,
        error: None,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::collections::VecDeque;

    enum WriteStep {
        Bytes(usize),
        Error(io::ErrorKind),
    }

    struct ScriptedWriter {
        steps: VecDeque<WriteStep>,
        captured: Vec<u8>,
    }

    impl Write for ScriptedWriter {
        fn write(&mut self, buffer: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {
            match self
                .steps
                .pop_front()
                .unwrap_or(WriteStep::Bytes(buffer.len()))
            {
                WriteStep::Bytes(count) => {
                    let count = count.min(buffer.len());
                    self.captured.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
                    Ok(count)
                }
                WriteStep::Error(kind) => Err(io::Error::new(kind, "scripted write result")),
            }
        }

        fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn zero_byte_write_returns_write_zero_after_accounting_partial_bytes() {
        let mut writer = ScriptedWriter {
            steps: VecDeque::from([WriteStep::Bytes(2), WriteStep::Bytes(0)]),
            captured: Vec::new(),
        };
        let output = b"abcdef";
        let mut offset = 0;

        let result = flush_writer(&mut writer, output, &mut offset, output.len());

        assert_eq!(result.written, 2);
        assert_eq!(offset, 2);
        assert_eq!(
            result.error.map(|error| error.kind()),
            Some(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero)
        );
        assert_eq!(writer.captured, b"ab");
    }

    #[test]
    fn partial_write_survives_would_block_and_resumes_at_offset() {
        let mut writer = ScriptedWriter {
            steps: VecDeque::from([
                WriteStep::Bytes(2),
                WriteStep::Error(io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock),
            ]),
            captured: Vec::new(),
        };
        let output = b"abcdef";
        let mut offset = 0;

        let first = flush_writer(&mut writer, output, &mut offset, output.len());
        assert_eq!(first.written, 2);
        assert!(first.error.is_none());
        assert_eq!(offset, 2);

        let second = flush_writer(&mut writer, output, &mut offset, output.len());
        assert_eq!(second.written, 4);
        assert!(second.error.is_none());
        assert_eq!(offset, output.len());
        assert_eq!(writer.captured, output);
    }
}

        }
    }
    pub const fn get(self) -> u32 {
        self.0
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub struct SchemaVersion(u32);
impl SchemaVersion {
    pub const fn new(value: u32) -> Option<Self> {
        if value == 0 {
            None
        } else {
            Some(Self(value))
        }
    }
    pub const fn get(self) -> u32 {
        self.0
    }
}

pub type SchemaMigration = fn(SchemaVersion, &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>>;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ReplicationPolicy {
    #[default]
    ServerOnly,
    Replicated,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct ComponentDescriptor {
    pub id: ComponentTypeId,
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub schema: SchemaVersion,
    pub replication: ReplicationPolicy,
    /// Must deterministically upgrade all supported previous versions.
    pub migrate: Option<SchemaMigration>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ComponentError {
    DuplicateType,
    DuplicateEntity,
    DuplicateName,
    UnknownType,
    UnsupportedSchema,
    InvalidPayload,
    UnknownEntity,
    ExhaustedIds,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ComponentRegistry {
    types: BTreeMap<ComponentTypeId, ComponentDescriptor>,
}

impl ComponentRegistry {
    pub fn register(&mut self, descriptor: ComponentDescriptor) -> Result<(), ComponentError> {
        if self.types.contains_key(&descriptor.id) {
            return Err(ComponentError::DuplicateType);
        }
        if self
            .types
            .values()
            .any(|existing| existing.name == descriptor.name)
        {
            return Err(ComponentError::DuplicateName);
        }
        if descriptor.name.is_empty()
            || descriptor.name.len() > 96
            || !descriptor
                .name
                .bytes()
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit() || c == b'.' || c == b'_')
        {
            return Err(ComponentError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        self.types.insert(descriptor.id, descriptor);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn descriptor(&self, id: ComponentTypeId) -> Option<&ComponentDescriptor> {
        self.types.get(&id)
    }

    pub fn upgrade(
        &self,
        id: ComponentTypeId,
        schema: SchemaVersion,
        bytes: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<ComponentBlob, ComponentError> {
        let descriptor = self.descriptor(id).ok_or(ComponentError::UnknownType)?;
        if bytes.len() > MAX_COMPONENT_BYTES {
            return Err(ComponentError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        let payload = if schema == descriptor.schema {
            bytes.to_vec()
        } else if schema.get() < descriptor.schema.get() {
            let migrate = descriptor
                .migrate
                .ok_or(ComponentError::UnsupportedSchema)?;
            migrate(schema, bytes).ok_or(ComponentError::UnsupportedSchema)?
        } else {
            return Err(ComponentError::UnsupportedSchema);
        };
        ComponentBlob::new(descriptor.schema, payload).ok_or(ComponentError::InvalidPayload)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ComponentBlob {
    pub schema: SchemaVersion,
    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
}
impl ComponentBlob {
    pub fn new(schema: SchemaVersion, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Option<Self> {
        (bytes.len() <= MAX_COMPONENT_BYTES).then_some(Self { schema, bytes })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct EntityStore {
    next_id: u64,
    entities: BTreeMap<EntityId, BTreeMap<ComponentTypeId, ComponentBlob>>,
    changed: BTreeSet<(EntityId, ComponentTypeId)>,
}

impl EntityStore {
    pub fn spawn(&mut self) -> Result<EntityId, ComponentError> {
        let next = self
            .next_id
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or(ComponentError::ExhaustedIds)?;
        let id = EntityId::new(next).ok_or(ComponentError::ExhaustedIds)?;
        self.next_id = next;
        self.entities.insert(id, BTreeMap::new());
        Ok(id)
    }

    /// Rehydrate a pre-existing world-scoped ID while maintaining monotonic allocation.
    pub fn restore(&mut self, id: EntityId) -> Result<(), ComponentError> {
        if self.entities.contains_key(&id) {
            return Err(ComponentError::DuplicateEntity);
        }
        self.next_id = self.next_id.max(id.get());
        self.entities.insert(id, BTreeMap::new());
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, id: EntityId) -> bool {
        self.entities.contains_key(&id)
    }
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.entities.len()
    }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.entities.is_empty()
    }
    pub fn despawn(&mut self, id: EntityId) -> bool {
        let removed = self.entities.remove(&id).is_some();
        if removed {
            self.changed.retain(|(entity, _)| *entity != id);
        }
        removed
    }
    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = EntityId> + '_ {
        self.entities.keys().copied()
    }

    /// Iterates components in stable entity/type ID order for persistence export.
    pub fn iter_components(
        &self,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (EntityId, ComponentTypeId, &ComponentBlob)> + '_ {
        self.entities.iter().flat_map(|(entity, components)| {
            components
                .iter()
                .map(move |(kind, blob)| (*entity, *kind, blob))
        })
    }

    /// Iterates changed components in stable entity/type ID order.
    pub fn iter_changed_components(
        &self,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (EntityId, ComponentTypeId, &ComponentBlob)> + '_ {
        self.changed.iter().filter_map(|(entity, kind)| {
            self.get(*entity, *kind).map(|blob| (*entity, *kind, blob))
        })
    }

    /// Restores a component and its explicit world-scoped entity ID.
    pub fn restore_component(
        &mut self,
        registry: &ComponentRegistry,
        entity: EntityId,
        kind: ComponentTypeId,
        schema: SchemaVersion,
        bytes: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<(), ComponentError> {
        let created_entity = !self.contains(entity);
        if created_entity {
            self.restore(entity)?;
        }
        if let Err(error) = self.insert(registry, entity, kind, schema, bytes) {
            if created_entity {
                self.despawn(entity);
            }
            return Err(error);
        }
        self.changed.remove(&(entity, kind));
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn insert(
        &mut self,
        registry: &ComponentRegistry,
        entity: EntityId,
        kind: ComponentTypeId,
        schema: SchemaVersion,
        bytes: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<(), ComponentError> {
        let blob = registry.upgrade(kind, schema, bytes)?;
        self.entities
            .get_mut(&entity)
            .ok_or(ComponentError::UnknownEntity)?
            .insert(kind, blob);
        self.changed.insert((entity, kind));
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn get(&self, entity: EntityId, kind: ComponentTypeId) -> Option<&ComponentBlob> {
        self.entities.get(&entity)?.get(&kind)
    }

    /// An opt-in versioned envelope in the existing opaque object data field.
    /// This does not alter the on-disk layout nor reinterpret legacy objects.
    pub fn to_world_object(
        &self,
        origin: ObjectOriginId,
        entity: EntityId,
        kind: ComponentTypeId,
    ) -> Option<WorldObjectState> {
        let blob = self.get(entity, kind)?;
        if blob.bytes.len() + HEADER_BYTES > MAX_OBJECT_STATE_BYTES {
            return None;
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(blob.bytes.len() + HEADER_BYTES);
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&PERSISTENCE_MAGIC);
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&entity.get().to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&kind.get().to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&blob.schema.get().to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&blob.bytes);
        WorldObjectState::new(origin, bytes)
    }

    /// Returns None for a legacy blob so its previous owner may decode it.
    /// A recognized but malformed envelope is rejected instead of guessing.
    pub fn decode_world_object(
        registry: &ComponentRegistry,
        object: &WorldObjectState,
    ) -> Result<Option<(EntityId, ComponentTypeId, ComponentBlob)>, ComponentError> {
        let data = object.data();
        if !data.starts_with(&PERSISTENCE_MAGIC) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        if data.len() < HEADER_BYTES {
            return Err(ComponentError::InvalidPayload);
        }
        let entity = EntityId::new(u64::from_le_bytes(data[4..12].try_into().unwrap()))
            .ok_or(ComponentError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let kind = ComponentTypeId::new(u32::from_le_bytes(data[12..16].try_into().unwrap()))
            .ok_or(ComponentError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let schema = SchemaVersion::new(u32::from_le_bytes(data[16..20].try_into().unwrap()))
            .ok_or(ComponentError::InvalidPayload)?;
        let upgraded = registry.upgrade(kind, schema, &data[HEADER_BYTES..])?;
        Ok(Some((entity, kind, upgraded)))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn migrate(version: SchemaVersion, bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        (version.get() == 1).then(|| [bytes, &[2]].concat())
    }

    fn descriptor(id: u32, name: &'static str) -> ComponentDescriptor {
        ComponentDescriptor {
            id: ComponentTypeId::new(id).unwrap(),
            name,
            schema: SchemaVersion::new(2).unwrap(),
            replication: ReplicationPolicy::default(),
            migrate: Some(migrate),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn registry_rejects_type_and_name_collisions() {
        let mut registry = ComponentRegistry::default();
        registry.register(descriptor(1, "item.stack")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            registry.register(descriptor(1, "item.other")),
            Err(ComponentError::DuplicateType)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            registry.register(descriptor(2, "item.stack")),
            Err(ComponentError::DuplicateName)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn migrations_and_restored_components_preserve_world_scoped_ids() {
        let mut registry = ComponentRegistry::default();
        registry.register(descriptor(1, "item.stack")).unwrap();
        let kind = ComponentTypeId::new(1).unwrap();
        let old = SchemaVersion::new(1).unwrap();
        let mut store = EntityStore::default();
        let entity = EntityId::new(7).unwrap();
        store
            .restore_component(&registry, entity, kind, old, &[9])
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(store.get(entity, kind).unwrap().bytes, vec![9, 2]);
        assert_eq!(store.iter_changed_components().count(), 0);
        assert_eq!(store.spawn().unwrap().get(), 8);
        store.insert(&registry, entity, kind, old, &[8]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(store.iter_changed_components().count(), 1);
        assert!(store.despawn(entity));
        assert_eq!(store.iter_changed_components().count(), 0);
    }
}
