use minimium_world::world::{
    GenerationRevision, GenerationSpec, PlanetDefinition, WorldContentRevision, WorldDefinitionId,
    WorldInstanceId, WorldManifest, WorldMap, WorldSeed, WorldTopology,
};
use std::sync::Arc;

const CONTENT_REVISION: u64 = 1;
const GENERATION_REVISION: u32 = 2;
const POSITION_QUANTUM_MM: u32 = 10;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct DemoPortal {
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub target_instance: WorldInstanceId,
    pub destination: [f32; 3],
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct GeneratedWorld {
    pub instance: WorldInstanceId,
    pub manifest: WorldManifest,
    pub map: WorldMap,
    pub portal: Option<DemoPortal>,
}

/// Generates the default seeded planet and connected dungeon.
pub fn generate_demo_worlds() -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    generate_worlds(crate::DEFAULT_SEED)
}

/// A server seed identifies both the planet and its connected dungeon.
pub fn generate_worlds(seed: u128) -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    generate_worlds_with(
        seed,
        GENERATION_REVISION,
        minimium_procgen::planet_surface(),
        None,
        None,
    )
}

pub fn generate_worlds_with_planet(
    seed: u128,
    definition: PlanetDefinition,
) -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    generate_worlds_with_planet_revision(seed, definition, 3)
}

pub fn generate_worlds_with_planet_revision(
    seed: u128,
    definition: PlanetDefinition,
    revision: u32,
) -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    generate_worlds_with_planet_revision_and_geography(seed, definition, revision, None)
}

pub fn generate_worlds_with_planet_revision_and_geography(
    seed: u128,
    definition: PlanetDefinition,
    revision: u32,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    if !matches!(revision, 3 | 4 | 5)
        || (revision >= 4 && definition.mode != 1)
        || (definition.peak_relief.enabled() && revision != 5)
        || !definition.is_valid()
    {
        return Err("unsupported planet generator revision".into());
    }
    let surface = PlanetSurfaceSpec::new(
        definition.radius_mm,
        u64::from(definition.mountain_limit_mm),
    )
    .ok_or("invalid planet surface")?;
    generate_worlds_with(seed, revision, surface, Some(definition), geography)
}

fn generate_worlds_with(
    seed: u128,
    revision: u32,
    planet_surface: PlanetSurfaceSpec,
    planet_definition: Option<PlanetDefinition>,
    geography: Option<Arc<dyn minimium_procgen::PreparedGeography>>,
) -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    let planet_generation = generation(seed, revision)?;
    let mut terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(planet_generation, planet_surface)
        .ok_or_else(|| String::from("demo planet generation settings are invalid"))?;
    if let Some(geography) = geography {
        terrain = terrain.with_geography(geography);
    }
    if let Some(definition) = planet_definition {
        terrain = terrain.with_definition(definition);
    }
    let landmarks = terrain.landmarks();
    let planet_map = materialize_planet_map(terrain, landmarks)
        .map_err(|error| format!("demo planet map: {error}"))?;

    let dungeon_generation = generation(seed ^ 0x0030_0000_0000_0003, revision)?;
    let dungeon_spec = DungeonSpec::new(48, 40, 4, 5, 1)
        .ok_or_else(|| String::from("demo dungeon settings are invalid"))?;
    let blueprint = generate_dungeon(dungeon_generation, dungeon_spec);
    let dungeon_map = materialize_dungeon_map(&blueprint)
        .map_err(|error| format!("demo dungeon map: {error}"))?;

    let planet_instance = id(1);
    let dungeon_instance = id(2);
    let planet_entrance = point_to_world(landmarks.entrance.position_mm.coordinates());
    let dungeon_entrance = tile_to_world(blueprint.entrance());
    let planet = GeneratedWorld {
        instance: planet_instance,
        manifest: manifest(
            1,
            WorldTopology::Planet,
            planet_generation,
            planet_definition,
        ),
        portal: Some(DemoPortal {
            position: planet_entrance,
            target_instance: dungeon_instance,
            destination: dungeon_map.spawn(),
        }),
        map: planet_map,
    };
    let dungeon = GeneratedWorld {
        instance: dungeon_instance,
        manifest: manifest(
            2,
            WorldTopology::Dungeon,
            dungeon_generation,
            planet_definition,
        ),
        portal: Some(DemoPortal {
            position: dungeon_entrance,
            target_instance: planet_instance,
            destination: planet_entrance,
        }),
        map: dungeon_map,
    };
    Ok([planet, dungeon])
}

/// Frozen v1 layout, used only to recognize and migrate existing demo saves.
pub fn generate_legacy_demo_worlds() -> Result<[GeneratedWorld; 2], String> {
    let legacy_generation = |seed| {
        GenerationSpec::new(
            WorldSeed::new(seed),
            GenerationRevision::new(1).expect("legacy revision is nonzero"),
            POSITION_QUANTUM_MM,
        )
        .expect("legacy quantum is valid")
    };
    let planet_generation = legacy_generation(0x0030_0000_0000_0001);
    let terrain = PlanetTerrain::new(
        planet_generation,
        PlanetSurfaceSpec::new(100_000, 300).expect("legacy surface is valid"),
    )
    .expect("legacy terrain is valid");
    let landmarks = terrain.landmarks();
    let planet_map = materialize_legacy_planet_map(terrain, landmarks)?;
    let dungeon_generation = legacy_generation(0x0030_0000_0000_0002);
    let blueprint = generate_dungeon(
        dungeon_generation,
        DungeonSpec::new(48, 40, 4, 5, 1).expect("legacy dungeon spec is valid"),
    );
    let dungeon_map = materialize_dungeon_map(&blueprint)?;
    let entrance = point_to_world(landmarks.entrance.position_mm.coordinates());
    let old_manifest = |definition, topology, generation| {
        WorldManifest::new(
            WorldDefinitionId::new(definition).expect("legacy definition is nonzero"),
            topology,
            generation,
            WorldContentRevision::new(1).expect("legacy content is nonzero"),
            generator_digest(topology, generation),
        )
    };
    Ok([
        GeneratedWorld {
            instance: id(1),
            manifest: old_manifest(1, WorldTopology::Planet, planet_generation),
            portal: None,
            map: planet_map,
        },
        GeneratedWorld {
            instance: id(2),
            manifest: old_manifest(2, WorldTopology::Dungeon, dungeon_generation),
            portal: Some(DemoPortal {
                position: tile_to_world(blueprint.entrance()),
                target_instance: id(1),
                destination: entrance,
            }),
            map: dungeon_map,
        },
    ])
}

fn generation(seed: u128, revision: u32) -> Result<GenerationSpec, String> {
    GenerationSpec::new(
        WorldSeed::new(seed),
        GenerationRevision::new(revision)
            .ok_or_else(|| String::from("generation revision must be nonzero"))?,
        POSITION_QUANTUM_MM,
    )
    .ok_or_else(|| String::from("position quantum must be nonzero"))
}

fn manifest(
    definition: u128,
    topology: WorldTopology,
    generation: GenerationSpec,
    planet_definition: Option<PlanetDefinition>,
) -> WorldManifest {
    let manifest = WorldManifest::new(
        WorldDefinitionId::new(definition).expect("static demo definition is nonzero"),
        topology,
        generation,
        WorldContentRevision::new(if generation.revision().get() >= 3 {
            2
        } else {
            CONTENT_REVISION
        })
        .expect("static demo content revision is nonzero"),
        generator_digest(topology, generation),
    );
    if let Some(definition) = planet_definition {
        manifest.with_planet(definition)
    } else {
        manifest
    }
}

fn id(value: u128) -> WorldInstanceId {
    WorldInstanceId::new(value).expect("static demo instance is nonzero")
}

fn point_to_world(position: [i64; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    position.map(|value| value as f32 / 1000.0)
}

fn tile_to_world(tile: [u16; 2]) -> [f32; 3] {
    [f32::from(tile[0]) + 0.5, 0.0, f32::from(tile[1]) + 0.5]
}

<<<FILE path="scripts/check_architecture.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="205" bytes="8384" original_lines="205" original_bytes="8384" minified="false" sha256="2c26e7c7090459773c098185e5175429c244f079bfc1b5622353e2edf2f5f2ee">>>
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check selected Cargo dependency boundaries without running the programs."""

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib
from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path


def production_graph(metadata: dict) -> dict:
    """Keep normal/build edges, including external and target-specific crates."""
    return {
        node["id"]: [
            (dependency["pkg"], kind["kind"] or "normal")
            for dependency in node["deps"]
            for kind in dependency["dep_kinds"]
            if kind["kind"] in (None, "build")
        ]
        for node in metadata["resolve"]["nodes"]
    }


def forbidden_paths(root: str, targets: set, graph: dict, names: dict) -> list:
    pending = deque([(root, names[root])])
    seen = {root}
    violations = []
    while pending:
        package, path = pending.popleft()
        for dependency, kind in sorted(graph[package]):
            if dependency in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(dependency)
            next_path = f"{path} -[{kind}]-> {names[dependency]}"
            if names[dependency] in targets:
                violations.append(next_path)
            pending.append((dependency, next_path))
    return violations


def source_boundary_violations(repository: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Catch domain FFI/GPU references that Cargo package edges cannot express."""
    violations = []
    roots = (
        repository / "crates" / "core",
        repository / "crates" / "server-runtime",
        repository / "crates" / "client-runtime",
        repository / "apps" / "server",
    )
    forbidden = re.compile(
        r'\b(?:wgpu|winit|ash|glow)::|\bminimium_astronomy::|'
        r'\bunsafe\s+(?:extern\s+"C"|extern\s+"C")|'
        r'^\s*#\s*\[\s*link\s*\(',
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
    for root in roots:
        for source in sorted(root.rglob("*.rs")):
            if "target" in source.parts:
                continue
            text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for match in forbidden.finditer(text):
                line = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
                violations.append(f"{source.relative_to(repository).as_posix()}:{line}: forbidden FFI/GPU/astronomy source reference")
    for source in (repository / "crates/environment/src/weather").rglob("*.rs"):
        if re.search(r"\b(?:wgpu|winit|renderer|camera)::", source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
            violations.append(f"{source.relative_to(repository)}: weather model depends on rendering")
    return violations


def sample_content_violations(package_rules: dict, package_metadata: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Engine domains must not take content from the sample game directory."""
    violations = []
    forbidden = re.compile(r"games[/\\]sample|minimium-game-sample")
    for name, rule in package_rules.items():
        if rule.get("role") != "engine-domain":
            continue
        root = Path(package_metadata[name]["manifest_path"]).parent
        for source in sorted(root.rglob("*.rs")):
            text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for match in forbidden.finditer(text):
                line = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
                violations.append(
                    f"{source.relative_to(root).as_posix()}:{line}: engine domain references sample game content ({name})"
                )
    return violations


def filesystem_parser_violations(repository: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Format parsers consume supplied bytes; file access belongs to adapters."""
    violations = []
    forbidden = re.compile(r"std::fs|std::io::Read|File::open|canonicalize\(")
    root = repository / "crates" / "assets" / "src"
    for source in sorted(root.rglob("*.rs")):
        text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for match in forbidden.finditer(text):
            line = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
            violations.append(
                f"{source.relative_to(repository).as_posix()}:{line}: format parser performs filesystem access"
            )
    return violations


def main() -> int:
    try:
        output = subprocess.check_output(
            ["cargo", "metadata", "--locked", "--all-features", "--format-version", "1"],
            text=True,
        )
        metadata = json.loads(output)
        names = {package["id"]: package["name"] for package in metadata["packages"]}
        workspace = {names[package]: package for package in metadata["workspace_members"]}
        package_metadata = {
            package["name"]: package
            for package in metadata["packages"]
            if package["id"] in metadata["workspace_members"]
        }
        graph = production_graph(metadata)
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
        print(f"Cannot inspect Cargo metadata: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    repository = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    try:
        declaration = tomllib.loads((repository / "architecture.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        package_rules = {entry["name"]: entry for entry in declaration["package"]}
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
        print(f"Cannot read architecture.toml: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    required = set(package_rules)
    missing = required - workspace.keys()
    if missing:
        print(f"Missing packages: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    missing_readmes = []
    required_sections = {
        "Purpose / Non-goals",
        "Public API",
        "Dependencies",
        "Data flow",
        "Ownership and execution",
        "Invariants and errors",
        "Commands",
        "Change guide",
        "Verification",
    }
    for name, rule in package_rules.items():
        manifest = Path(package_metadata[name]["manifest_path"])
        readme = manifest.parent / "README.md"
        if not readme.is_file():
            missing_readmes.append(f"{name}: missing {readme.relative_to(repository).as_posix()}")
            continue
        headings = {
            line[3:].strip()
            for line in readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.startswith("## ")
        }
        for section in sorted(required_sections - headings):
            missing_readmes.append(
                f"{name}: {readme.relative_to(repository).as_posix()} missing '## {section}'"
            )

    tool_readme = repository / "tools/geography/README.md"
    if not tool_readme.is_file():
        missing_readmes.append("tools/geography: missing README.md")
    else:
        headings = {
            line[3:].strip()
            for line in tool_readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.startswith("## ")
        }
        for section in sorted(required_sections - headings):
            missing_readmes.append(f"tools/geography: README.md missing '## {section}'")

    forbidden = {
        package: set(rule.get("forbidden_dependencies", []))
        for package, rule in package_rules.items()
    }
    application_packages = {
        name
        for name, rule in package_rules.items()
        if rule.get("role") in ("application", "runtime")
    }
    for package, rule in package_rules.items():
        if rule.get("role") == "engine-domain":
            forbidden.setdefault(package, set()).update(application_packages)
    violations = list(missing_readmes)
    for root, targets in forbidden.items():
        violations.extend(forbidden_paths(workspace[root], targets, graph, names))
    violations.extend(source_boundary_violations(repository))
    violations.extend(sample_content_violations(package_rules, package_metadata))
    violations.extend(filesystem_parser_violations(repository))
    if violations:
        print("Architecture violations:\n" + "\n".join(violations), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("Architecture dependency check passed (full Cargo graph, all features/targets, "
          "transitive normal/build edges; dev edges excluded).")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

<<<FILE path="scripts/check_file_lengths.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="126" bytes="4999" original_lines="126" original_bytes="4999" minified="false" sha256="2f28b0cc6fe9c1418cab84f9d4e64e1a9ee7db76fb82df32021608999effc3fb">>>
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Enforce the repository's physical line limit for hand-maintained code."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
POLICY = ROOT / "docs" / "plan" / "file-length-policy.md"
MAX_LINES = 500

# Keep this list focused on source and executable configuration. Data files and
# generated artifacts are outside this check; see the policy document.
SOURCE_SUFFIXES = {
    ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".cxx", ".cs", ".css", ".fs", ".fsx", ".go",
    ".h", ".hh", ".hpp", ".htm", ".html", ".java", ".js", ".jsx", ".kt",
    ".kts", ".lua", ".m", ".mm", ".php", ".pl", ".ps1", ".py", ".rb",
    ".rs", ".scala", ".sc", ".scss", ".sh", ".sql", ".svelte", ".swift",
    ".tf", ".ts", ".tsx", ".vue", ".wgsl", ".xml", ".yaml", ".yml",
}

# Build output and local runtime/cache directories are excluded wherever they
# occur. Ordinary source directories are traversed, including untracked files.
EXCLUDED_DIRS = {
    ".git", ".hg", ".svn", ".venv", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache", ".tox", ".cache", ".local", ".runtime",
    "target", "node_modules", "vendor", "dist", "build", "coverage",
    "runtime", "local-artifacts",
}

EXCEPTION_RE = re.compile(
    r"^<!-- file-length-exception: ([^|]+?)\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*-->$"
)


def source_files() -> list[Path]:
    """Enumerate source files from disk, so tracked and untracked files count."""
    paths: list[Path] = []
    for directory, subdirectories, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
        subdirectories[:] = [name for name in subdirectories if name.lower() not in EXCLUDED_DIRS]
        for name in filenames:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            if path.suffix.lower() not in SOURCE_SUFFIXES:
                continue
            # Generated source files are excluded by explicit conventional names.
            if name.lower().endswith((".generated.rs", ".g.rs", ".designer.cs")):
                continue
            paths.append(path)
    return sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix().casefold())


def physical_line_count(path: Path) -> int:
    content = path.read_bytes()
    return content.count(b"\n") + int(bool(content) and not content.endswith(b"\n"))


def registered_exceptions() -> tuple[dict[str, str], list[str]]:
    entries: dict[str, str] = {}
    errors: list[str] = []
    if not POLICY.is_file():
        return entries, [f"missing policy document: {POLICY.relative_to(ROOT)}"]

    for line_number, line in enumerate(POLICY.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if "file-length-exception:" not in line or not stripped.startswith("<!--"):
            continue
        match = EXCEPTION_RE.fullmatch(stripped)
        if not match:
            errors.append(
                f"{POLICY.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}:{line_number}: malformed exception; "
                "use <!-- file-length-exception: path | reason -->"
            )
            continue
        name, reason = match.groups()
        name = name.strip().replace("\\", "/")
        if not reason.strip():
            errors.append(f"{POLICY.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}:{line_number}: exception needs a reason")
        elif name in entries:
            errors.append(f"{POLICY.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}:{line_number}: duplicate exception for {name}")
        else:
            entries[name] = reason.strip()
    return entries, errors


def main() -> int:
    actual: dict[str, int] = {}
    errors: list[str] = []
    files = source_files()
    included = {path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for path in files}
    for path in files:
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        try:
            count = physical_line_count(path)
        except OSError as exc:
            errors.append(f"{relative}: cannot read file: {exc}")
            continue
        if count > MAX_LINES:
            actual[relative] = count

    exceptions, registry_errors = registered_exceptions()
    errors.extend(registry_errors)
    for relative, count in sorted(actual.items()):
        if relative not in exceptions:
            errors.append(f"{relative}: {count} physical lines (limit {MAX_LINES}); split this file or document a scoped exception")
    for relative in sorted(exceptions):
        if relative not in included:
            errors.append(f"invalid exception for {relative}: path is not an included source file")
        elif relative not in actual:
            errors.append(f"stale exception for {relative}: file is missing or no longer exceeds {MAX_LINES} lines")

    if errors:
        print("File length check failed:", file=sys.stderr)
        for error in errors:
            print(f"  - {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(f"File length check passed: {len(files)} source files, maximum {MAX_LINES} physical lines.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

<<<FILE path="scripts/check_static_refactor.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="232" bytes="11249" original_lines="232" original_bytes="11249" minified="false" sha256="ba004171b7805941b2db5e50a29f1cbbaf69ccf3e84814b99397471f27656e1e">>>
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check selected static contracts for the E005 refactor without running code."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def struct_fields(source: str, name: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    match = re.search(rf"\bstruct\s+{re.escape(name)}\s*\{{(.*?)\}}\s*;?", source, re.S)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"missing struct {name}")
    fields = []
    raw_fields = []
    start = 0
    depth = 0
    for index, character in enumerate(match.group(1)):
        if character in "[<":
            depth += 1
        elif character in "]>":
            depth -= 1
        elif character == "," and depth == 0:
            raw_fields.append(match.group(1)[start:index])
            start = index + 1
    raw_fields.append(match.group(1)[start:])
    for field in raw_fields:
        field = field.strip()
        if not field:
            continue
        rust = re.fullmatch(r"(?:pub(?:\([^)]*\))?\s+)?(\w+)\s*:\s*(.+)", field, re.S)
        wgsl = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\s*:\s*(.+)", field, re.S)
        parsed = rust or wgsl
        if not parsed:
            raise ValueError(f"cannot parse {name} field: {field!r}")
        fields.append((parsed.group(1), re.sub(r"\s+", "", parsed.group(2))))
    return fields


def normalize_gpu_type(type_name: str) -> str:
    compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", type_name)
    rust_types = {
        "[f32;2]": "vec2<f32>",
        "[f32;3]": "vec3<f32>",
        "[f32;4]": "vec4<f32>",
        "[u32;4]": "vec4<u32>",
        "[[f32;4];4]": "mat4x4<f32>",
        "[HaloSource;MAX_HALO_BODIES]": "array<HaloSource,8>",
    }
    return rust_types.get(compact, compact)


def main() -> int:
    errors: list[str] = []
    rust_env_path = ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/gpu_frame.rs"
    rust_halo_path = ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/gpu_frame.rs"
    wgsl_path = ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/shaders/frame.wgsl"
    halo_shader_path = ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/shaders/celestial_halo.wgsl"
    try:
        rust = rust_env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        halo_rust = rust_halo_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        wgsl = wgsl_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        halo_shader = halo_shader_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        halo_rust_fields = struct_fields(halo_rust, "HaloSource")
        halo_wgsl_fields = struct_fields(wgsl, "HaloSource")
        halo_rust_fields = [(name, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for name, typ in halo_rust_fields]
        halo_wgsl_fields = [(name, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for name, typ in halo_wgsl_fields]
        if halo_rust_fields != halo_wgsl_fields:
            errors.append(f"HaloSource layout differs: Rust={halo_rust_fields}, WGSL={halo_wgsl_fields}")
        rust_env_fields = struct_fields(rust, "EnvironmentUniform")
        wgsl_env_fields = struct_fields(wgsl, "EnvironmentUniform")
        rust_env_fields = [(name, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for name, typ in rust_env_fields]
        wgsl_env_fields = [(name, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for name, typ in wgsl_env_fields]
        if rust_env_fields != wgsl_env_fields:
            errors.append(f"EnvironmentUniform layout differs: Rust={rust_env_fields}, WGSL={wgsl_env_fields}")
        camera_rust = (ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/gpu_frame.rs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        rust_camera = [(name, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for name, typ in struct_fields(camera_rust, "CameraUniform")]
        shader_camera = struct_fields(wgsl, "CameraUniform")
        if rust_camera != shader_camera:
            errors.append("CameraUniform layout differs between Rust and WGSL")
        atmosphere = (ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/atmosphere_uniform.rs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        shader = (ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/shaders/atmosphere_frame.wgsl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cpu = [(name, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for name, typ in struct_fields(atmosphere, "AtmosphereUniform")]
        if cpu != struct_fields(shader, "AtmosphereUniform"):
            errors.append("AtmosphereUniform layout differs between Rust and WGSL")
        clouds = (ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/cloud_uniform.rs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cloud_shader = (ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/shaders/clouds.wgsl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for name in ("CloudUniform", "CloudRecord"):
            cpu = [(field, normalize_gpu_type(typ)) for field, typ in struct_fields(clouds, name)]
            if cpu != struct_fields(cloud_shader, name):
                errors.append(f"{name} layout differs between Rust and WGSL")
        if re.search(r"\bbody\s*==\s*[01]\b", halo_shader):
            errors.append("celestial_halo.wgsl contains a body==0/1 special case")
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        errors.append(str(error))

    required_exports = {
        ROOT / "crates/core/src/lib.rs": ("pub mod identity;", "pub mod ids;"),
        ROOT / "crates/world/src/lib.rs": ("pub mod entity;", "pub mod world;"),
        ROOT / "crates/simulation/src/lib.rs": (
            "pub use simulation::{",
            "step_character_mm",
            "CombatSettings",
        ),
        ROOT / "crates/commands/src/lib.rs": ("pub use registry::{CommandRegistry, CommandSpec};",),
        ROOT / "crates/server-runtime/src/lib.rs": ("pub fn run(args: &[String])",),
        ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/lib.rs": (
            "pub mod gpu_frame;",
            "pub use render_frame::RenderFrame;",
            "pub mod gpu_bindings;",
            "pub mod geometry;",
            "pub mod geometry_gpu;",
            "pub mod globe_vertex;",
            "pub mod globe_detail;",
            "pub mod globe_gpu;",
            "pub mod render_frame;",
            "pub mod frame_encoder;",
            "pub mod scene_encoder;",
            "pub mod surface_frame;",
            "pub mod world_geometry_gpu;",
            "pub mod scene_encoder;",
            "pub mod overview_gpu;",
            "pub mod cloud_face;",
            "pub mod cloud_pipeline;",
            "pub mod cloud_targets;",
            "pub mod cloud_voxels;",
            "pub mod cloud_mesh;",
            "pub mod cloud_uniform;",
            "pub mod cloud_gpu;",
            "pub mod ui_vertex;",
            "pub mod ui_pipeline;",
            "pub mod atmosphere;",
            "pub mod atmosphere_table;",
            "pub mod atmosphere_pipeline;",
            "pub mod atmosphere_uniform;",
            "pub mod atmosphere_gpu;",
            "pub mod environment_pipelines;",
            "pub mod world_pipeline;",
            "pub mod output;",
            "pub mod stars;",
            "pub mod star_gpu;",
            "pub mod shadow_target;",
            "pub mod shadow_settings;",
            "pub mod shadow_geometry;",
            "pub mod shadow_uniform;",
            "pub mod shadow_gpu;",
            "pub mod planet_visibility;",
            "pub mod profiles;",
            "pub mod lighting;",
            "pub mod moon_lighting;",
            "pub mod shader_source;",
            "pub use celestial_halo::CelestialHaloGpu;",
            "pub use moon_disk::MoonGpu;",
            "pub use moon_sphere::MoonSphereGpu;",
        ),
        ROOT / "games/sample/src/lib.rs": ("DEFAULT_COMBAT_CONFIG", "demo_universe_catalog"),
        ROOT / "crates/client-runtime/src/lib.rs": (
            "pub mod environment;",
            "ClientSession, DisconnectReason",
            "pub use prediction::{ClientPrediction, PredictedStep};",
            "pub use snapshots::{RemotePlayerTrack, SnapshotReconciler};",
        ),
        ROOT / "crates/procgen/src/lib.rs": ("pub use geography::{EarthSampleError, PreparedGeography};",),
    }
    for path, required in required_exports.items():
        try:
            source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for symbol in required:
                if symbol not in source:
                    errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}: missing export {symbol}")
        except OSError as error:
            errors.append(str(error))

    renderer_shaders = ROOT / "crates/renderer/src/shaders"
    client_renderer = ROOT / "apps/client/src/renderer"
    if not (renderer_shaders / "frame.wgsl").is_file():
        errors.append("renderer frame shader is missing from the renderer crate")
    if list(client_renderer.glob("*.wgsl")):
        errors.append("client application still owns renderer WGSL source files")
    for launcher in ("import-gebco-lite.ps1", "import-gebco.ps1"):
        if not (ROOT / launcher).is_file():
            errors.append(f"repository-root geography launcher is missing: {launcher}")
    if not (ROOT / "tools/geography/scripts/import_gebco_lite.py").is_file():
        errors.append("compact geography importer is not under tools/geography")

    try:
        server_dependencies = server_manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if "minimium-server-runtime" not in server_dependencies:
            errors.append("server application does not depend on minimium-server-runtime")
        if "minimium-protocol" in server_dependencies or "minimium-storage" in server_dependencies:
            errors.append("server application still directly depends on runtime domains")
    except OSError as error:
        errors.append(str(error))
    client_manifest = ROOT / "apps/client/Cargo.toml"
    try:
        if "minimium-client-runtime" not in client_manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
            errors.append("client application does not depend on minimium-client-runtime")
    except OSError as error:
        errors.append(str(error))

    central_parser = ROOT / "apps/client/src/client_commands.rs"
    command_modules = (
        "connection.rs", "environment.rs", "gameplay.rs", "interface.rs", "weather.rs",
    )
    try:
        central = central_parser.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if re.search(r"if\s+\*command\s*==|match\s*\(\*command", central):
            errors.append("client_commands.rs contains command-name-specific parser branches")
        for module in command_modules:
            source = (central_parser.parent / "client_commands" / module).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if "const COMMANDS:" not in source or "fn parse(" not in source or "registry.register(COMMANDS)" not in source:
                errors.append(f"client command module lacks a local parser registration: {module}")
    except OSError as error:
        errors.append(str(error))

    if errors:
        print("Static refactor check failed:", file=sys.stderr)
        print("\n".join(f"  - {error}" for error in errors), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("Static refactor check passed: Rust/WGSL layout, exports, halo dispatch and command parser ownership.")
    return 0

COLUMNS = 16
GLYPHS = [chr(code) for code in range(127)] + list("ĄąĆćĘęŁłŃńÓóŚśŹźŻż")
WHITE_CELL = len(GLYPHS)

white_y = WHITE_CELL // COLUMNS * CELL
draw.rectangle((white_x, white_y, white_x + CELL - 1, white_y + CELL - 1), fill=255)

<<<FILE path="scripts/import_earth_lakes.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="77" bytes="3048" original_lines="77" original_bytes="3048" minified="false" sha256="78cb12469ed53bfe9985f91c084788fa1c2f164a72b57cab809ead5ead56d4f0">>>
"""Build the offline lake polygon asset from Natural Earth (public domain).

Only this explicit import command accesses the network. No Python packages needed.
The binary stores polygon rings, including holes, quantized to 1e-5 degree.
Generated geometry is exempt from the hand-maintained source line limit.
"""
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import urllib.request
import zipfile


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEST = ROOT / "assets" / "earth"
SOURCES = ["lakes", "lakes_europe", "lakes_north_america", "lakes_australia"]


def polygons(shp):
    offset = 100
    while offset < len(shp):
        _, words = struct.unpack_from(">2i", shp, offset)
        record = shp[offset + 8:offset + 8 + words * 2]
        offset += 8 + words * 2
        kind, = struct.unpack_from("<i", record)
        if kind == 0:
            continue
        if kind != 5:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected polygon, got shape {kind}")
        parts, count = struct.unpack_from("<2i", record, 36)
        starts = list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{parts}i", record, 44)) + [count]
        start = 44 + parts * 4
        points = list(struct.iter_unpack("<2d", record[start:start + count * 16]))
        rings = []
        for a, b in zip(starts, starts[1:]):
            ring = [(round(x * 100000), round(y * 100000)) for x, y in points[a:b]]
            if len(ring) >= 4:
                rings.append(ring)
        yield rings


def main():
    records, provenance = [], []
    for source in SOURCES:
        url = f"https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/10m/physical/ne_10m_{source}.zip"
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=90) as response:
            archive = response.read()
        provenance.append({"url": url, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest()})
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as z:
            records.extend(polygons(z.read(f"ne_10m_{source}.shp")))
    data = bytearray(b"MMLAKE01" + struct.pack("<I", len(records)))
    for rings in records:
        data.extend(struct.pack("<I", len(rings)))
        for ring in rings:
            data.extend(struct.pack("<I", len(ring)))
            for point in ring:
                data.extend(struct.pack("<2i", *point))
    DEST.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (DEST / "lakes.bin").write_bytes(data)
    metadata = {
        "source": "Natural Earth 1:10 million lakes and regional supplements",
        "license": "Public domain",
        "terms": "https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/",
        "scope": "Generalized cartography; excludes many small ponds and rivers.",
        "format": "MMLAKE01, LE u32 polygon count; ring count; point count; i32 lon,lat / 100000",
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        "polygons": len(records),
        "sources": provenance,
    }
    (DEST / "lakes.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Imported {len(records)} polygons, {len(data)} bytes")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert the pinned NASA SVS J2000 Milky Way EXR to linear RGB9E5."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

SOURCE_URL = "https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004800/a004851/milkyway_2020_4k.exr"
SOURCE_SHA256 = "2eb802d6e68d170b410f766c7fec07f7518619f6b6708fdc81e9302d93e74fdb"
SOURCE_WIDTH = 4096
SOURCE_HEIGHT = 2048
OUTPUT_WIDTH = 2048
OUTPUT_HEIGHT = 1024
ASSET_PATH = Path("crates/assets/data/sky/milky-way-v1.rgb9e5")
MANIFEST_PATH = Path("crates/assets/data/sky/milky-way-v1.manifest.json")


def convert(source: Path) -> bytes:
    try:
        import numpy as np
        import OpenEXR
    except ImportError as error:
        raise SystemExit("install numpy and OpenEXR to regenerate this asset") from error

    raw = source.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != SOURCE_SHA256:
        raise SystemExit("NASA SVS source SHA-256 does not match the pinned file")
    image = OpenEXR.InputFile(str(source))
    window = image.header()["dataWindow"]
    width = window.max.x - window.min.x + 1
    height = window.max.y - window.min.y + 1
    if (width, height) != (SOURCE_WIDTH, SOURCE_HEIGHT):
        raise SystemExit("NASA SVS source dimensions do not match")
    pixels = np.stack(
        [np.frombuffer(image.channel(channel), dtype="<f2") for channel in "RGB"], axis=-1
    ).astype(np.float32)
    pixels = pixels.reshape(SOURCE_HEIGHT, SOURCE_WIDTH, 3)
    if not np.isfinite(pixels).all() or (pixels < 0).any():
        raise SystemExit("NASA SVS source contains non-finite or negative radiance")
    # Average in linear light; the source is a linear half-float EXR.
    pixels = pixels.reshape(OUTPUT_HEIGHT, 2, OUTPUT_WIDTH, 2, 3).mean(axis=(1, 3))
    maximum = pixels.max(axis=2)
    exponent = np.ceil(np.log2(np.maximum(maximum, 2.0**-24) / 511.0) + 24.0)
    exponent = np.clip(exponent, 0, 31).astype(np.uint32)
    quantum = np.exp2(exponent.astype(np.float32) - 24.0)
    mantissa = np.rint(pixels / quantum[..., None]).clip(0, 511).astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (
        mantissa[..., 0]
        | (mantissa[..., 1] << 9)
        | (mantissa[..., 2] << 18)
        | (exponent << 27)
    )
    return packed.astype("<u4").tobytes()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path, help="repository root")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    asset = convert(args.input)
    if len(asset) != OUTPUT_WIDTH * OUTPUT_HEIGHT * 4:
        raise SystemExit("generated RGB9E5 asset has an invalid length")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(asset).hexdigest()
    manifest = {
        "asset": ASSET_PATH.as_posix(),
        "asset_bytes": len(asset),
        "asset_sha256": digest,
        "format": "rgb9e5ufloat",
        "height": OUTPUT_HEIGHT,
        "source_sha256": SOURCE_SHA256,
        "source_url": SOURCE_URL,
        "width": OUTPUT_WIDTH,
    }
    asset_path = args.output / ASSET_PATH
    manifest_path = args.output / MANIFEST_PATH
    asset_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    asset_path.write_bytes(asset)
    manifest_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    print(f"asset_bytes={len(asset)} asset_sha256={digest}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Stable little-endian asset, provenance files, and transactional publishing."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import shutil
import struct
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from .source import (
    MAX_STARS,
    SOURCE_COMMIT,
    SOURCE_GIT_BLOB_SHA1,
    SOURCE_LICENSE_BLOB_SHA1,
    SOURCE_LICENSE_SHA256,
    SOURCE_LICENSE_SIZE,
    SOURCE_LICENSE_NOTICE_PATH,
    SOURCE_PATH,
    SOURCE_SIZE,
    HYGStar,
    ImportFailure,
    ImportReport,
)

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
CATALOGUE_ID = 2
MAGIC = b"MNSKY1K0"
LABELS_PATH = "crates/assets/data/sky/star-labels-v1.tsv"
HEADER_BYTES = 96
RECORD_BYTES = 64
EPOCH_JYEAR = 2000.0
LICENSE_NAME = "crates/assets/data/sky/LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt"
ATTRIBUTION = """# HYG 4.1 star catalogue attribution

Source: HYG Database v4.1 by Astronexus / David Nash, archived at
<https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database>.

Pinned input: `hyg/CURRENT/hygdata_v41.csv` at commit
`c7f7f883fe678cc7680169a50ccd7dcc49b060ce`. This asset selects the 1000
valid records with the lowest apparent visual magnitude, breaking exact ties
by HYG id. It excludes the Sun, removes unused columns, and converts the
selected records to the documented little-endian `stars-v1.bin` format.
Missing color index values use the documented neutral value 0.65; missing
proper-motion vectors are zero-filled. Numeric source coordinates are retained.
The aligned label asset uses HYG proper names where printable in the bundled
font, with HIP/HR/HYG identifiers as fallbacks.

The HYG data and this derived catalogue are licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
See `LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt` for the full license text and
`HYG-LICENSE-NOTICE.txt` for the exact upstream notice. Source license notice:
<https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database/blob/c7f7f883fe678cc7680169a50ccd7dcc49b060ce/LICENSE>.
"""


def build_outputs(
    report: ImportReport, license_text: bytes, source_license_notice: bytes
) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    license_digest = hashlib.sha256(license_text).hexdigest()
    if not license_text.startswith(b"Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International"):
        raise ImportFailure("CC BY-SA 4.0 legal text is missing or unrecognized")
    source_license_digest = hashlib.sha256(source_license_notice).hexdigest()
    source_license_git_hash = hashlib.sha1(
        f"blob {len(source_license_notice)}\0".encode("ascii") + source_license_notice
    ).hexdigest()
    if (
        len(source_license_notice) != SOURCE_LICENSE_SIZE
        or source_license_digest != SOURCE_LICENSE_SHA256
        or source_license_git_hash != SOURCE_LICENSE_BLOB_SHA1
    ):
        raise ImportFailure(
            "HYG source license notice does not match its pinned digest"
        )
    payload = b"".join(_pack_record(star) for star in report.selected)
    labels = "".join(_label_line(star) for star in report.selected).encode("utf-8")
    payload_sha = hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()
    source_sha = bytes.fromhex(report.source_sha256)
    header = struct.pack(
        "<8sHHIIId32s32s",
        MAGIC,
        SCHEMA_VERSION,
        RECORD_BYTES,
        CATALOGUE_ID,
        len(report.selected),
        0,
        EPOCH_JYEAR,
        source_sha,
        payload_sha,
    )
    asset = header + payload
    asset_sha = hashlib.sha256(asset).digest()
    manifest = _manifest(report, asset, payload, labels, license_digest)
    identity = _identity_source(asset_sha, source_sha)
    _validate_products(asset, manifest, labels, identity, license_text, source_license_notice)
    return {
        "crates/assets/data/sky/stars-v1.bin": asset,
        "crates/assets/data/sky/stars-v1.manifest.json": manifest,
        LABELS_PATH: labels,
        LICENSE_NAME: license_text,
        SOURCE_LICENSE_NOTICE_PATH: source_license_notice,
        "crates/assets/data/sky/ATTRIBUTION.md": ATTRIBUTION.encode("utf-8"),
        "crates/assets/src/sky_catalog/identity.generated.rs": identity,
    }


def publish_outputs(root: Path, outputs: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise ImportFailure(f"output root does not exist: {root}")
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".hyg-stars-", dir=root))
    staged: dict[str, Path] = {}
    backups: dict[str, Path] = {}
    published: list[str] = []
    try:
        for relative, content in outputs.items():
            path = stage / "new" / relative
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(content)
            staged[relative] = path
        _validate_staged(staged)

        for relative in outputs:
            destination = root / relative
            if destination.exists() and not destination.is_file():
                raise ImportFailure(f"output path is not a regular file: {relative}")
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            backup = stage / "backup" / relative
            if destination.exists():
                backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                os.replace(destination, backup)
                backups[relative] = backup
            os.replace(staged[relative], destination)
            published.append(relative)
    except Exception:
        for relative in reversed(list(outputs)):
            destination = root / relative
            backup = backups.get(relative)
            if relative in published and destination.exists():
                destination.unlink()
            if backup is not None and backup.exists():
                destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                os.replace(backup, destination)
        raise
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)


def _pack_record(star: HYGStar) -> bytes:
    magnitude = _finite_f32(float(star.magnitude), "apparent magnitude", star.hyg_id)
    color_index = _finite_f32(star.color_index, "color index", star.hyg_id)
    values = (
        *star.position_pc,
        *star.velocity_pc_per_jyear,
    )
    if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {star.hyg_id} has non-finite astrometry")
    if math.hypot(math.hypot(values[0], values[1]), values[2]) == 0.0:
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {star.hyg_id} has a zero position vector")
    try:
        record = struct.pack(
            "<IIff6d",
            star.hyg_id,
            star.hip_id,
            magnitude,
            color_index,
            *values,
        )
    except (OverflowError, struct.error) as error:
        raise ImportFailure(
            f"HYG id {star.hyg_id} cannot be encoded in stars-v1"
        ) from error
    if len(record) != RECORD_BYTES:
        raise ImportFailure("internal record layout is not 64 bytes")
    return record


def _finite_f32(value: float, field: str, hyg_id: int) -> float:
    if not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} {field} is not finite")
    try:
        packed = struct.pack("<f", value)
    except (OverflowError, struct.error) as error:
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} {field} does not fit f32") from error
    converted = struct.unpack("<f", packed)[0]
    if not math.isfinite(converted):
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} {field} overflows f32")
    return converted


def _manifest(
    report: ImportReport, asset: bytes, payload: bytes, labels: bytes, license_digest: str
) -> bytes:
    selected = report.selected
    repeated_hip = _repeated_catalogue_ids(selected, "hip_id")
    repeated_hr = _repeated_catalogue_ids(selected, "hr_id")
    repeated_positions = _repeated_positions(selected)
    asset_sha = hashlib.sha256(asset).hexdigest()
    payload_sha = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    value = {
        "asset_sha256": asset_sha,
        "catalogue_id": CATALOGUE_ID,
        "epoch_jyear": EPOCH_JYEAR,
        "format": {
            "header_bytes": HEADER_BYTES,
            "magic": MAGIC.decode("ascii"),
            "record_bytes": RECORD_BYTES,
            "record_count": len(selected),
            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "total_bytes": len(asset),
        },
        "importer_version": 1,
        "input_audit": {
            "eligible_record_count": report.eligible_record_count,
            "rejected_required_value_count": len(report.rejected_required_value_ids),
            "rejected_required_value_ids": list(report.rejected_required_value_ids),
            "source_record_count": report.source_record_count,
            "repeated_nonempty_hip_ids": repeated_hip,
            "repeated_nonempty_hr_ids": repeated_hr,
            "identical_source_position_groups": repeated_positions,
        },
        "license": {
            "catalogue_license": "CC BY-SA 4.0",
            "full_text_path": LICENSE_NAME,
            "full_text_sha256": license_digest,
            "source_license_notice_path": SOURCE_LICENSE_NOTICE_PATH,
            "source_license_git_blob_sha1": SOURCE_LICENSE_BLOB_SHA1,
            "source_license_sha256": SOURCE_LICENSE_SHA256,
            "source_license_size": SOURCE_LICENSE_SIZE,
            "source_license_url": f"https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database/blob/{SOURCE_COMMIT}/LICENSE",
            "url": "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/",
        },
        "payload_sha256": payload_sha,
        "labels": {"path": LABELS_PATH, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(labels).hexdigest(), "count": len(selected)},
        "selection": {
            "policy_version": 1,
            "rule": "lowest Decimal(apparent visual magnitude), then ascending HYG id; exclude id 0",
            "selected_count": len(selected),
            "selected_ids": [star.hyg_id for star in selected],
            "threshold_magnitude_decimal": str(selected[-1].magnitude),
        },
        "source": {
            "commit": SOURCE_COMMIT,
            "git_blob_sha1": SOURCE_GIT_BLOB_SHA1,
            "path": SOURCE_PATH,
            "repository": "https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database",
            "sha256": report.source_sha256,
            "size_bytes": SOURCE_SIZE,
            "url": f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astronexus/HYG-Database/{SOURCE_COMMIT}/{SOURCE_PATH}",
        },
        "source_csv_sha256": report.source_sha256,
        "missing_color_ids": list(report.missing_color_ids),
        "missing_proper_motion_ids": list(report.missing_proper_motion_ids),
    }
    return (
        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


def _identity_source(asset_sha: bytes, source_sha: bytes) -> bytes:
    def rust_array(raw: bytes) -> str:
        return ", ".join(f"0x{byte:02x}" for byte in raw)

    text = (
        "// Generated by scripts/import_hyg_stars.py v1; do not edit by hand.\n"
        f"pub(super) const CATALOGUE_ID: u32 = {CATALOGUE_ID};\n"
        f"pub(super) const ASSET_SHA256: [u8; 32] = [{rust_array(asset_sha)}];\n"
        f"pub(super) const SOURCE_CSV_SHA256: [u8; 32] = [{rust_array(source_sha)}];\n"
    )
    return text.encode("utf-8")


def _label_line(star: HYGStar) -> str:
    proper = star.proper_name
    if proper and proper.isascii() and proper.isprintable() and len(proper) <= 30:
        label = proper
    elif star.hip_id:
        label = f"HIP {star.hip_id}"
    elif star.hr_id:
        label = f"HR {star.hr_id}"
    else:
        label = f"HYG {star.hyg_id}"
    return f"{star.hyg_id}\t{label}\n"


def _repeated_catalogue_ids(selected: tuple[HYGStar, ...], field: str) -> list[int]:
    counts: dict[int, int] = {}
    for star in selected:
        value = getattr(star, field)
        if value:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    return sorted(value for value, count in counts.items() if count > 1)


def _repeated_positions(selected: tuple[HYGStar, ...]) -> list[list[int]]:
    groups: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[int]] = {}
    for star in selected:
        groups.setdefault(star.source_position, []).append(star.hyg_id)
    return sorted(
        (sorted(ids) for ids in groups.values() if len(ids) > 1), key=lambda ids: ids[0]
    )


def _validate_products(
    asset: bytes,
    manifest: bytes,
    labels: bytes,
    identity: bytes,
    license_text: bytes,
    source_license_notice: bytes,
) -> None:
    if len(asset) != HEADER_BYTES + MAX_STARS * RECORD_BYTES:
        raise ImportFailure("generated asset has an invalid total length")
    header = struct.unpack("<8sHHIIId32s32s", asset[:HEADER_BYTES])
    if header[:6] != (
        MAGIC,
        SCHEMA_VERSION,
        RECORD_BYTES,
        CATALOGUE_ID,
        MAX_STARS,
        0,
    ):
        raise ImportFailure("generated binary header does not match the V1 contract")
    if header[6] != EPOCH_JYEAR:
        raise ImportFailure("generated binary epoch does not match the V1 contract")
    try:
        parsed_manifest = json.loads(manifest)
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
        raise ImportFailure(
            "generated manifest is not valid deterministic JSON"
        ) from error
    if parsed_manifest.get("asset_sha256") != hashlib.sha256(asset).hexdigest():
        raise ImportFailure("manifest asset digest does not match generated binary")
    if (
        parsed_manifest.get("payload_sha256")
        != hashlib.sha256(asset[HEADER_BYTES:]).hexdigest()
    ):
        raise ImportFailure("manifest payload digest does not match generated binary")
    if hashlib.sha256(asset[HEADER_BYTES:]).digest() != asset[64:96]:
        raise ImportFailure("binary payload digest does not match its header")
    if parsed_manifest.get("source_csv_sha256") != header[7].hex():
        raise ImportFailure("manifest source digest does not match binary header")
    label_lines = labels.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    selected_ids = parsed_manifest.get("selection", {}).get("selected_ids", [])
    if len(label_lines) != MAX_STARS or [line.split("\t", 1)[0] for line in label_lines] != [str(value) for value in selected_ids]:
        raise ImportFailure("labels do not align with selected star IDs")
    if any("\t" not in line or not line.split("\t", 1)[1] for line in label_lines):
        raise ImportFailure("a generated star label is empty")
    if parsed_manifest.get("labels") != {"path": LABELS_PATH, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(labels).hexdigest(), "count": MAX_STARS}:
        raise ImportFailure("manifest labels digest or count does not match")
    if (
        parsed_manifest.get("license", {}).get("full_text_sha256")
        != hashlib.sha256(license_text).hexdigest()
    ):
        raise ImportFailure(
            "manifest license digest does not match the included legal text"
        )
    if (
        parsed_manifest.get("license", {}).get("source_license_sha256")
        != hashlib.sha256(source_license_notice).hexdigest()
    ):
        raise ImportFailure("manifest does not match the included HYG license notice")
    notice_git_hash = hashlib.sha1(
        f"blob {len(source_license_notice)}\0".encode("ascii") + source_license_notice
    ).hexdigest()
    if parsed_manifest.get("license", {}).get(
        "source_license_git_blob_sha1"
    ) != notice_git_hash or parsed_manifest.get("license", {}).get(
        "source_license_size"
    ) != len(source_license_notice):
        raise ImportFailure("manifest does not match HYG source license blob identity")
    selected = parsed_manifest.get("selection", {})
    if (
        selected.get("selected_count") != MAX_STARS
        or len(selected.get("selected_ids", [])) != MAX_STARS
    ):
        raise ImportFailure(f"manifest does not describe exactly {MAX_STARS} selected IDs")
    expected_identity = _identity_source(hashlib.sha256(asset).digest(), asset[32:64])
    if identity != expected_identity:
        raise ImportFailure(
            "generated Rust identity does not match the generated binary"
        )


def _validate_staged(staged: dict[str, Path]) -> None:
    asset = staged["crates/assets/data/sky/stars-v1.bin"].read_bytes()
    manifest = staged["crates/assets/data/sky/stars-v1.manifest.json"].read_bytes()
    labels = staged[LABELS_PATH].read_bytes()
    identity = staged[
        "crates/assets/src/sky_catalog/identity.generated.rs"
    ].read_bytes()
    license_text = staged[LICENSE_NAME].read_bytes()
    source_license_notice = staged[SOURCE_LICENSE_NOTICE_PATH].read_bytes()
    _validate_products(asset, manifest, labels, identity, license_text, source_license_notice)

"""Pinned HYG input validation and deterministic top-1000 selection."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import hashlib
import heapq
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterator

SOURCE_COMMIT = "c7f7f883fe678cc7680169a50ccd7dcc49b060ce"
SOURCE_PATH = "hyg/CURRENT/hygdata_v41.csv"
SOURCE_SIZE = 33_932_548
SOURCE_GIT_BLOB_SHA1 = "ba2dec4eb0f6768914c7fc1051258100214ddf84"
SOURCE_SHA256 = "d9f69fd86bbf90a4e4d52b4c5c53eacfa6dfc0bfdef85bfd94f095e0bebe4ebd"
SOURCE_LICENSE_BLOB_SHA1 = "29773af75cb093d92b115bf22b6da18409c4cb62"
SOURCE_LICENSE_SHA256 = (
    "f404190403d31e0ce7223f4cb7af954485ad88077358330754dc5c892a856627"
)
SOURCE_LICENSE_SIZE = 422
SOURCE_LICENSE_NOTICE_PATH = "crates/assets/data/sky/HYG-LICENSE-NOTICE.txt"
MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_SOURCE_ROWS = 200_000
MAX_RECORD_BYTES = 16 * 1024
MAX_STARS = 1000
U32_MAX = (1 << 32) - 1

_NUMBER = re.compile(r"[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?\Z")
_REQUIRED_COLUMNS = (
    "id",
    "hip",
    "hr",
    "proper",
    "ra",
    "dec",
    "mag",
    "ci",
    "x",
    "y",
    "z",
    "vx",
    "vy",
    "vz",
)


class ImportFailure(ValueError):
    """A source or record cannot be used to produce a deterministic asset."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HYGStar:
    hyg_id: int
    hip_id: int
    hr_id: int
    proper_name: str
    magnitude: Decimal
    color_index: float
    source_position: tuple[str, str, str]
    position_pc: tuple[float, float, float]
    velocity_pc_per_jyear: tuple[float, float, float]
    missing_color: bool
    missing_proper_motion: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ImportReport:
    selected: tuple[HYGStar, ...]
    source_record_count: int
    eligible_record_count: int
    rejected_required_value_ids: tuple[int, ...]
    missing_proper_motion_ids: tuple[int, ...]
    missing_color_ids: tuple[int, ...]
    source_sha256: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _WorstFirst:
    magnitude: Decimal
    hyg_id: int

    def __lt__(self, other: _WorstFirst) -> bool:
        return (self.magnitude, self.hyg_id) > (other.magnitude, other.hyg_id)


class _BoundedUtf8Lines(Iterator[str]):
    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self._stream = path.open("rb")
        self.bytes_read = 0

    def __iter__(self) -> _BoundedUtf8Lines:
        return self

    def __next__(self) -> str:
        raw = self._stream.readline(MAX_RECORD_BYTES + 1)
        if not raw:
            raise StopIteration
        if len(raw) > MAX_RECORD_BYTES:
            raise ImportFailure("a physical CSV line exceeds 16 KiB")
        self.bytes_read += len(raw)
        try:
            return raw.decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            raise ImportFailure("source CSV is not valid UTF-8") from error

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stream.close()


def verify_source(path: Path) -> str:
    size = path.stat().st_size
    if size > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES:
        raise ImportFailure(f"source exceeds {MAX_SOURCE_BYTES} bytes")
    if size != SOURCE_SIZE:
        raise ImportFailure(f"source size is {size}, expected {SOURCE_SIZE}")
    git_hash = hashlib.sha1()
    git_hash.update(f"blob {size}\0".encode("ascii"))
    sha256 = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        while chunk := source.read(1024 * 1024):
            git_hash.update(chunk)
            sha256.update(chunk)
    actual_git = git_hash.hexdigest()
    actual_sha = sha256.hexdigest()
    if actual_git != SOURCE_GIT_BLOB_SHA1:
        raise ImportFailure(
            f"source Git blob is {actual_git}, expected {SOURCE_GIT_BLOB_SHA1}"
        )
    if actual_sha != SOURCE_SHA256:
        raise ImportFailure(f"source SHA-256 is {actual_sha}, expected {SOURCE_SHA256}")
    return actual_sha


def verify_source_license_notice(content: bytes) -> None:
    if len(content) != SOURCE_LICENSE_SIZE:
        raise ImportFailure(
            f"HYG source license notice is {len(content)} bytes, expected {SOURCE_LICENSE_SIZE}"
        )
    git_hash = hashlib.sha1()
    git_hash.update(f"blob {len(content)}\0".encode("ascii"))
    git_hash.update(content)
    if git_hash.hexdigest() != SOURCE_LICENSE_BLOB_SHA1:
        raise ImportFailure("HYG source license notice Git blob does not match the pin")
    if hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != SOURCE_LICENSE_SHA256:
        raise ImportFailure("HYG source license notice SHA-256 does not match the pin")


def load_top_stars(path: Path) -> ImportReport:
    source_sha256 = verify_source(path)
    lines = _BoundedUtf8Lines(path)
    reader = csv.reader(lines, strict=True)
    seen_ids: set[int] = set()
    rejected_ids: list[int] = []
    missing_pm: list[int] = []
    missing_color: list[int] = []
    heap: list[tuple[_WorstFirst, HYGStar]] = []
    eligible_count = 0
    row_count = 0
    try:
        before = lines.bytes_read
        header = next(reader, None)
        if header is None:
            raise ImportFailure("source CSV is empty")
        if lines.bytes_read - before > MAX_RECORD_BYTES:
            raise ImportFailure("CSV header exceeds 16 KiB")
        if len(header) != len(set(header)):
            raise ImportFailure("source CSV has duplicate column names")
        columns = {name: index for index, name in enumerate(header)}
        missing_columns = sorted(set(_REQUIRED_COLUMNS) - columns.keys())
        if missing_columns:
            raise ImportFailure(
                f"source CSV is missing columns: {', '.join(missing_columns)}"
            )

        while True:
            before = lines.bytes_read
            try:
                fields = next(reader)
            except StopIteration:
                break
            except csv.Error as error:
                raise ImportFailure(
                    f"CSV parse failed near record {row_count + 1}: {error}"
                ) from error
            row_count += 1
            if row_count > MAX_SOURCE_ROWS:
                raise ImportFailure(f"source exceeds {MAX_SOURCE_ROWS} data records")
            if lines.bytes_read - before > MAX_RECORD_BYTES:
                raise ImportFailure(f"CSV record {row_count} exceeds 16 KiB")
            if len(fields) != len(header):
                raise ImportFailure(
                    f"CSV record {row_count} has {len(fields)} fields, expected {len(header)}"
                )
            row = dict(zip(header, fields))
            hyg_id = _parse_id(row["id"], row_count)
            if hyg_id in seen_ids:
                raise ImportFailure(f"duplicate HYG id {hyg_id} at record {row_count}")
            seen_ids.add(hyg_id)
            if hyg_id == 0:
                continue

            star, rejected = _parse_star(row, hyg_id)
            if rejected:
                rejected_ids.append(hyg_id)
                continue
            assert star is not None
            eligible_count += 1
            key = _WorstFirst(star.magnitude, star.hyg_id)
            if len(heap) < MAX_STARS:
                heapq.heappush(heap, (key, star))
            elif heap[0][0] < key:
                heapq.heapreplace(heap, (key, star))

        if eligible_count < MAX_STARS:
            raise ImportFailure(
                f"only {eligible_count} eligible stars; exactly {MAX_STARS} are required"
            )
        selected = tuple(
            sorted(
                (entry[1] for entry in heap),
                key=lambda item: (item.magnitude, item.hyg_id),
            )
        )
        missing_pm = [
            star.hyg_id
            for star in (entry[1] for entry in heap)
            if star.missing_proper_motion
        ]
        missing_color = [
            star.hyg_id for star in (entry[1] for entry in heap) if star.missing_color
        ]
        return ImportReport(
            selected=selected,
            source_record_count=row_count,
            eligible_record_count=eligible_count,
            rejected_required_value_ids=tuple(sorted(rejected_ids)),
            missing_proper_motion_ids=tuple(sorted(missing_pm)),
            missing_color_ids=tuple(sorted(missing_color)),
            source_sha256=source_sha256,
        )
    finally:
        lines.close()


def _parse_id(value: str, record: int) -> int:
    text = value.strip()
    if not text or len(text) > 10 or not text.isascii() or not text.isdecimal():
        raise ImportFailure(f"record {record} has an invalid HYG id")
    result = int(text)
    if result > U32_MAX:
        raise ImportFailure(f"record {record} HYG id does not fit u32")
    return result


def _parse_star(row: dict[str, str], hyg_id: int) -> tuple[HYGStar | None, bool]:
    hip_id = _parse_optional_id(row["hip"], "Hipparcos", hyg_id)
    hr_id = _parse_optional_id(row["hr"], "HR", hyg_id)
    color_text = row["ci"].strip()
    missing_color = not color_text
    color_index = 0.65 if missing_color else _float_value(color_text, "ci", hyg_id)
    velocity_text = [row[key].strip() for key in ("vx", "vy", "vz")]
    missing_velocity = [not value for value in velocity_text]
    if all(missing_velocity):
        velocity_values = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        missing_proper_motion = True
    elif any(missing_velocity):
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} has partially missing velocity")
    else:
        velocity_values = tuple(
            _float_value(value, name, hyg_id)
            for name, value in zip(("vx", "vy", "vz"), velocity_text)
        )
        missing_proper_motion = False

    magnitude = _decimal_or_missing(row["mag"], "mag", hyg_id)
    ra = _decimal_or_missing(row["ra"], "ra", hyg_id)
    dec = _decimal_or_missing(row["dec"], "dec", hyg_id)
    position = tuple(
        _float_or_missing(row[key], key, hyg_id) for key in ("x", "y", "z")
    )
    if (
        magnitude is None
        or ra is None
        or dec is None
        or any(value is None for value in position)
    ):
        return None, True
    if not (Decimal(0) <= ra < Decimal(24) and Decimal(-90) <= dec <= Decimal(90)):
        return None, True
    position_values = tuple(float(value) for value in position if value is not None)
    if (
        math.hypot(
            math.hypot(position_values[0], position_values[1]), position_values[2]
        )
        == 0.0
    ):
        return None, True

    star = HYGStar(
        hyg_id=hyg_id,
        hip_id=hip_id,
        hr_id=hr_id,
        proper_name=row["proper"].strip(),
        magnitude=magnitude,
        color_index=color_index,
        source_position=tuple(row[key].strip() for key in ("x", "y", "z")),
        position_pc=position_values,
        velocity_pc_per_jyear=velocity_values,
        missing_color=missing_color,
        missing_proper_motion=missing_proper_motion,
    )
    return star, False


def _parse_optional_id(value: str, field: str, hyg_id: int) -> int:
    text = value.strip()
    if not text:
        return 0
    if len(text) > 10 or not text.isascii() or not text.isdecimal():
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} has an invalid {field} id")
    result = int(text)
    if result > U32_MAX:
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} {field} id does not fit u32")
    return result


def _decimal_or_missing(value: str, field: str, hyg_id: int) -> Decimal | None:
    text = value.strip()
    return None if not text else _decimal_value(text, field, hyg_id)


def _decimal_value(text: str, field: str, hyg_id: int) -> Decimal:
    if not _NUMBER.fullmatch(text):
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} has invalid {field} value {text!r}")
    try:
        value = Decimal(text)
    except InvalidOperation as error:
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} has invalid {field} value") from error
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} has non-finite {field}")
    return value


def _float_or_missing(value: str, field: str, hyg_id: int) -> float | None:
    text = value.strip()
    return None if not text else _float_value(text, field, hyg_id)


def _float_value(text: str, field: str, hyg_id: int) -> float:
    value = float(_decimal_value(text, field, hyg_id))
    if not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ImportFailure(f"HYG id {hyg_id} {field} overflows f64")
    return value

<<<FILE path="scripts/wgsl_validator/src/main.rs" plugin="rust" lang="rust" reason="extension:.rs" lines="173" bytes="6615" original_lines="173" original_bytes="6615" minified="false" sha256="50c40412aa2bd01db6a37c9e9121a1b2e2469a2197840d7ed53d3d7b832bd8ba">>>
//! Static shader compilation only: does not create an adapter or run the game.
#[path = "../../../crates/renderer/src/shader_source.rs"]
mod source;

fn main() {
    let variants = [
        (
            "geometry_rebase",
            include_str!("../../../crates/renderer/src/shaders/geometry_rebase.wgsl").to_owned(),
        ),
        ("clouds", source::clouds()),
        ("cloud_composite", source::cloud_composite()),
        ("world", source::world()),
        ("terrain", source::terrain()),
        ("ocean", source::ocean()),
        ("sky", source::sky()),
        ("sun", source::sun()),
        ("stars", source::stars()),
        ("moon", source::moon()),
        ("moon_sphere", source::moon_sphere()),
        ("celestial_halo", source::celestial_halo()),
        ("atmosphere", source::atmosphere()),
        ("atmosphere_sky_lut", source::atmosphere_compute("sky")),
        (
            "atmosphere_aerial_lut",
            source::atmosphere_compute("aerial"),
        ),
        ("atmosphere_multi_lut", source::atmosphere_compute("multi")),
        ("marker", source::marker()),
        ("ui", source::ui()),
        ("encode_output", source::encode_output()),
        ("ui_output_srgb", source::ui_output(true)),
        ("ui_output_linear", source::ui_output(false)),
    ];
    for (name, code) in variants {
        let module = naga::front::wgsl::parse_str(&code)
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{name}: {}", error.emit_to_string(&code)));
        let info = naga::valid::Validator::new(
            naga::valid::ValidationFlags::all(),
            naga::valid::Capabilities::all(),
        )
        .validate(&module)
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{name}: {}", error.emit_to_string(&code)));
        if matches!(
            name,
            "atmosphere" | "atmosphere_sky_lut" | "atmosphere_aerial_lut" | "atmosphere_multi_lut"
        ) {
            atmosphere_contract(&module, &info, name == "globe");
        }
        if name == "clouds" {
            cloud_contract(&module, &info);
        }
        if matches!(name, "terrain" | "ocean") {
            terrain_contract(&module, &info);
        }
        println!("{name}: valid");
    }
}

fn terrain_contract(module: &naga::Module, info: &naga::valid::ModuleInfo) {
    for (_, ty) in module.types.iter() {
        if ty.name.as_deref() == Some("TerrainSettings") {
            let naga::TypeInner::Struct { members, span } = &ty.inner else {
                panic!("expected terrain uniform");
            };
            assert_eq!(*span, 240);
            assert_eq!(members.len(), 10);
            for (i, member) in members.iter().enumerate() {
                assert_eq!(member.offset, i as u32 * 16);
            }
        }
    }
    for (index, entry) in module.entry_points.iter().enumerate() {
        for (handle, global) in module.global_variables.iter() {
            if info.get_entry_point(index)[handle].is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(binding) = global.binding else {
                continue;
            };
            let visible = match (binding.group, binding.binding) {
                (0, 0..=2) => true,
                (0, 3..=10) => entry.stage != naga::ShaderStage::Vertex,
                (1, 4) => true,
                (1, 0..=3) | (1, 5..=6) | (2, 0..=2) => entry.stage == naga::ShaderStage::Fragment,
                _ => false,
            };
            assert!(
                visible,
                "terrain binding {binding:?} unavailable in {:?}",
                entry.stage
            );
        }
    }
}

fn cloud_contract(module: &naga::Module, info: &naga::valid::ModuleInfo) {
    for (_, ty) in module.types.iter() {
        let (expected_span, offsets): (u32, &[u32]) = match ty.name.as_deref() {
            Some("CloudUniform") => (256, &[0, 64, 128, 192, 208, 224, 240]),
            Some("CloudRecord") => (80, &[0, 16, 32, 48, 64]),
            _ => continue,
        };
        let naga::TypeInner::Struct { members, span } = &ty.inner else {
            panic!("expected cloud struct");
        };
        assert_eq!(*span, expected_span);
        assert_eq!(
            members.iter().map(|m| m.offset).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            offsets
        );
    }
    for (index, entry) in module.entry_points.iter().enumerate() {
        for (handle, global) in module.global_variables.iter() {
            if info.get_entry_point(index)[handle].is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(binding) = global.binding else {
                continue;
            };
            let visible = match (binding.group, binding.binding) {
                (0, 0..=2) | (1, 0..=1) => true,
                (0, 3..=10) => entry.stage != naga::ShaderStage::Vertex,
                (1, 2) => entry.stage == naga::ShaderStage::Fragment,
                _ => false,
            };
            assert!(
                visible,
                "cloud binding {binding:?} unavailable in {:?}",
                entry.stage
            );
        }
    }
}

fn atmosphere_contract(module: &naga::Module, info: &naga::valid::ModuleInfo, globe: bool) {
    for (_, ty) in module.types.iter() {
        let expected = match ty.name.as_deref() {
            Some("AtmosphereUniform") => 256,
            _ => continue,
        };
        let naga::TypeInner::Struct { members, span } = &ty.inner else {
            panic!("expected struct");
        };
        assert_eq!(*span, expected);
        for (index, member) in members.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(member.offset, index as u32 * 16);
        }
    }
    for (index, entry) in module.entry_points.iter().enumerate() {
        for (handle, global) in module.global_variables.iter() {
            if info.get_entry_point(index)[handle].is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(binding) = global.binding else {
                continue;
            };
            let visible = match (binding.group, binding.binding) {
                (0, 0..=2) => true,
                (0, 3..=10) => entry.stage != naga::ShaderStage::Vertex,
                (1, 0..=1) | (2, 0) => entry.stage != naga::ShaderStage::Vertex,
                (1, 2) if !globe => entry.stage == naga::ShaderStage::Fragment,
                (2, 1..=2) if globe => entry.stage == naga::ShaderStage::Fragment,
                _ => false,
            };
            assert!(
                visible,
                "binding {:?} is unavailable in {:?}",
                binding, entry.stage
            );
        }
    }
}
