<<<FILE path="start-earth.ps1" plugin="powershell" lang="powershell" reason="extension:.ps1" lines="135" bytes="7197" original_lines="135" original_bytes="7197" minified="false" sha256="109bb89dc83b4aa91c9ab1d8bd45cfa3ff0c9e49d1867c5fc0e1b8afadb2ba12">>>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$DataDir = ([IO.Path]::Combine($env:LOCALAPPDATA, 'Minimium', 'earth')),
    [string]$PackageDir = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'third_party/gebco-2026'),
    [string]$ProfileDir,
    [string]$Seed,
    [ValidateScript({ -not [double]::IsNaN($_) -and -not [double]::IsInfinity($_) -and $_ -ge 1 -and $_ -le 3 })]
    [double]$PeakMultiplier = 1.5,
    [ValidateRange(1, 8)]
    [int]$PeakExponent = 3,
    [ValidateRange(0, 11999)]
    [int]$PeakStartMeters = 1000,
    [ValidateRange(1, 12000)]
    [int]$PeakFullMeters = 9000,
    [ValidateScript({ -not [double]::IsNaN($_) -and -not [double]::IsInfinity($_) -and $_ -ge 0 -and $_ -le 1 })]
    [double]$ClimateReliefInfluence = 0,
    [switch]$ResetWorld,
    [switch]$Windowed
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
function Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable {
    param([string]$Name, [AllowNull()][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Value)
    # Explicitly remove omitted options instead of relying on null-to-string binding.
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Value)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath "Env:$Name" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    } else {
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Name, $Value, 'Process')
    }
}

$peakRequested = @('PeakMultiplier', 'PeakExponent', 'PeakStartMeters', 'PeakFullMeters') |
    Where-Object { $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey($_) }
if ($PeakStartMeters -ge $PeakFullMeters) {
    throw 'PeakStartMeters must be lower than PeakFullMeters (source metres above sea level).'
}
$existingWorld = @('world.planet.ron', 'world.snapshot', 'world.seed') |
    Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $DataDir $_) }
if ($peakRequested -and $existingWorld -and -not $ResetWorld) {
    throw 'Peak settings define a new world. Use a new -DataDir or -ResetWorld (preserves a backup). To resume the saved world, omit the Peak parameters.'
}
$package = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($PackageDir)
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $package 'index.ron'))) {
    throw "GEBCO 2026 package is missing at $package. Run $PSScriptRoot/import-gebco-lite.ps1 -PackageDir $package for the compact 1-arcminute package, or import the full-resolution netCDF with import-gebco.ps1."
}
$projectRoot = $PSScriptRoot
& rtk cargo build --release -p minimium-server -p minimium-client --manifest-path (Join-Path $projectRoot 'Cargo.toml')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
if ($ResetWorld -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $DataDir)) {
    $worldDirectory = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($DataDir).TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
    $worldParent = [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($worldDirectory)
    if (-not $worldParent -or $worldDirectory -eq [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($worldDirectory).TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)) {
        throw 'ResetWorld requires a specific world directory, not a filesystem root.'
    }
    # Match the server's OS file lock; keep it held while preserving the old world.
    $backupDirectory = "${worldDirectory}.backup-$([DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'))-$([Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8))"
    if ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($backupDirectory)) -ne $worldParent) {
        throw 'World backup escaped its intended parent directory.'
    }
    $worldLock = [IO.FileStream]::new((Join-Path $worldDirectory 'server.lock'), [IO.FileMode]::OpenOrCreate,
        [IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite, ([IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite -bor [IO.FileShare]::Delete))
    $worldLockHeld = $false
    try {
        $worldLock.Lock(0, 1)
        $worldLockHeld = $true
        Move-Item -LiteralPath $worldDirectory -Destination $backupDirectory -ErrorAction Stop
    } finally {
        if ($worldLockHeld) { $worldLock.Unlock(0, 1) }
        $worldLock.Dispose()
    }
    Write-Host "Previous world preserved at $backupDirectory"
}
$target = if ($env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR) {
    if ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR)) { $env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR }
    else { Join-Path (Get-Location) $env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR }
} else { Join-Path $projectRoot 'target' }
$client = Join-Path $target 'release/minimium-client.exe'
$profile = if ($ProfileDir) { $ProfileDir } else { "${DataDir}-profile" }
$arguments = @('--server-data-dir', $DataDir, '--profile-dir', $profile, '--require-earth')
if ($Windowed) { $arguments += '--windowed' }
$previousPackage = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('MINIMIUM_EARTH_PACKAGE', 'Process')
$previousConfig = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('MINIMIUM_LOCAL_PLANET_CONFIG', 'Process')
$previousSeed = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('MINIMIUM_LOCAL_SEED', 'Process')
$previousClimateRelief = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('MINIMIUM_LOCAL_CLIMATE_RELIEF_INFLUENCE', 'Process')
$temporaryPreset = $null
try {
    # Ordinary resumes use the immutable saved definition, including its peak curve.
    $planetPreset = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $DataDir 'world.planet.ron')) {
        $null
    } else {
        Join-Path $projectRoot 'presets/planet/earth.ron'
    }
    if ($peakRequested) {
        $parentPreset = '"' + (Join-Path $projectRoot 'presets/planet/earth.ron').Replace('\', '\\').Replace('"', '\"') + '"'
        $multiplierPermille = [int][Math]::Round($PeakMultiplier * 1000, [MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero)
        $temporaryPreset = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("minimium-earth-peaks-{0}.ron" -f [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
        $presetText = @"
(
    extends: Some($parentPreset),
    generator_revision: Some(5),
    peak_relief: Some((
        start_m: $PeakStartMeters,
        full_m: $PeakFullMeters,
        multiplier_permille: $multiplierPermille,
        exponent: $PeakExponent,
    )),
)
"@
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporaryPreset, $presetText, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
        $planetPreset = $temporaryPreset
    }
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_EARTH_PACKAGE' (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $package).Path
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_PLANET_CONFIG' $planetPreset
    $climateValue = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('ClimateReliefInfluence')) {
        $ClimateReliefInfluence.ToString([Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
    } else { $null }
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_CLIMATE_RELIEF_INFLUENCE' $climateValue
    if ($Seed) {
        Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_SEED' $Seed
    } else {
        Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_SEED' $null
    }
    & $client @arguments
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
} finally {
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_EARTH_PACKAGE' $previousPackage
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_PLANET_CONFIG' $previousConfig
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_SEED' $previousSeed
    Set-LauncherEnvironmentVariable 'MINIMIUM_LOCAL_CLIMATE_RELIEF_INFLUENCE' $previousClimateRelief
    if ($temporaryPreset -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporaryPreset)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPreset
    }
}
if ($exitCode -eq -1073741510) { exit 0 } # Ctrl+C on Windows
exit $exitCode

<<<FILE path="tools/bake_materials.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="218" bytes="10144" original_lines="218" original_bytes="10144" minified="false" sha256="1294d2c02b54d5e92154de471ed2e30a6520e139dba306cd0c069d0ab6343b7d">>>
"""Build-time KTX2 cooker. Python + numpy; no client startup generation."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile
import zlib
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RECIPE = ROOT / "games/sample/materials/recipe.py"


def blocks(image):
    edge = image.shape[0]
    if edge < 4:
        image = np.pad(image, ((0, 4-edge), (0, 4-edge), (0, 0)), mode="edge")
        edge = 4
    return image.reshape(edge//4, 4, edge//4, 4, 4).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(-1, 16, 4)


def bc4(values):
    hi = values.max(1).astype(np.uint8)
    lo = values.min(1).astype(np.uint8)
    distance = hi.astype(np.float32) - lo
    t = np.clip(np.rint((hi[:, None].astype(np.float32) - values) * 7 / np.maximum(distance[:, None], 1)), 0, 7).astype(np.uint8)
    lookup = np.array([0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 1], np.uint8)
    indices = lookup[t].astype(np.uint64)
    packed = np.sum(indices << (np.arange(16, dtype=np.uint64) * 3), axis=1, dtype=np.uint64)
    result = np.empty((len(values), 8), np.uint8)
    result[:, 0], result[:, 1] = hi, lo
    result[:, 2:] = (packed[:, None] >> (np.arange(6, dtype=np.uint64) * 8)).astype(np.uint8)
    return result


def bc1(values):
    rgb = values[:, :, :3].astype(np.uint32)
    c565 = ((rgb[:, :, 0] >> 3) << 11) | ((rgb[:, :, 1] >> 2) << 5) | (rgb[:, :, 2] >> 3)
    # Fit along the largest component range instead of ordering packed RGB565 words.
    axis = np.ptp(rgb, axis=1).argmax(-1)
    channel = np.take_along_axis(rgb, axis[:, None, None], axis=2)[:, :, 0]
    row = np.arange(len(rgb))
    a, b = c565[row, channel.argmax(1)], c565[row, channel.argmin(1)]
    high, low = np.maximum(a, b), np.minimum(a, b)
    high = np.maximum(high, low + 1).clip(0, 65535)
    low = np.minimum(low, high - 1)
    def unpack(v):
        return np.stack(((v >> 11) * 255 / 31, ((v >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63, (v & 31) * 255 / 31), -1)
    a, b = unpack(high), unpack(low)
    palette = np.stack((a, b, (a*2+b)/3, (a+b*2)/3), 1)
    # One block row at a time limits cooker peak memory.
    error = ((rgb[:, :, None, :] - palette[:, None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1)
    indices = error.argmin(-1).astype(np.uint32)
    packed = np.sum(indices << (np.arange(16, dtype=np.uint32)*2), axis=1, dtype=np.uint32)
    result = np.empty((len(values), 8), np.uint8)
    result[:, :2] = high.astype('<u2').view(np.uint8).reshape(-1, 2)
    result[:, 2:4] = low.astype('<u2').view(np.uint8).reshape(-1, 2)
    result[:, 4:] = packed.astype('<u4').view(np.uint8).reshape(-1, 4)
    return result


def encode(image, fmt):
    values = image if image.dtype == np.uint8 else np.rint(np.clip(image, 0, 1)*255).astype(np.uint8)
    if fmt in (37, 43):
        return values.tobytes()
    out = []
    for row in range(0, len(values), 64):
        block = blocks(values[row:row+64]) if len(values) <= 64 else None
        # blocks requires a square; reshape rectangular strips explicitly.
        if block is None:
            strip = values[row:row+64]
            block = strip.reshape(16, 4, len(values)//4, 4, 4).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(-1, 16, 4)
        if fmt == 132:
            encoded = bc1(block)
        elif fmt == 141:
            encoded = np.concatenate((bc4(block[:, :, 0]), bc4(block[:, :, 1])), 1)
        else:
            encoded = np.concatenate((bc4(block[:, :, 3]), bc1(block)), 1)
        out.append(encoded.tobytes())
    return b''.join(out)


def descriptor(fmt):
    compressed = fmt not in (37, 43)
    model = {132: 128, 137: 130, 141: 132}.get(fmt, 1)
    samples = {132: [(0, 63, 0)], 137: [(0, 63, 15), (64, 63, 0)],
               141: [(0, 63, 0), (64, 63, 1)]}.get(fmt, [(i*8, 7, c) for i, c in enumerate((0, 1, 2, 15))])
    body = struct.pack('<IHH4B4B8B', 0, 2, 24+16*len(samples), model, 1,
                       2 if fmt in (43, 132) else 1, 0,
                       3 if compressed else 0, 3 if compressed else 0, 0, 0,
                       (8 if fmt == 132 else 16) if compressed else 4, *([0]*7))
    for offset, length, channel in samples:
        body += struct.pack('<HBBIII', offset, length, channel, 0, 0, 0xffffffff if compressed else 255)
    return struct.pack('<I', len(body)+4) + body


def reduce(image, srgb=False, normal=False):
    image = image.astype(np.float32)/255 if image.dtype == np.uint8 else image
    edge = len(image)//2
    if srgb:
        rgb = image[:, :, :3]
        linear = np.where(rgb <= .04045, rgb/12.92, ((rgb+.055)/1.055)**2.4)
        linear = linear.reshape(edge, 2, edge, 2, 3).mean((1, 3))
        rgb = np.where(linear <= .0031308, linear*12.92, 1.055*linear**(1/2.4)-.055)
        return np.concatenate((rgb, np.ones((edge, edge, 1), np.float32)), -1)
    mip = image.reshape(edge, 2, edge, 2, 4).mean((1, 3))
    if normal:
        vector = mip[:, :, :3]*2-1
        vector /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(vector, axis=-1, keepdims=True), 1e-8)
        mip[:, :, :3] = vector*.5+.5
    return mip


def png(path, pixels):
    pixels = np.rint(np.clip(pixels, 0, 1)*255).astype(np.uint8)
    def chunk(kind, data):
        return struct.pack('>I', len(data))+kind+data+struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(kind+data))
    raw = b''.join(b'\0'+row.tobytes() for row in pixels[:, :, :3])
    header = struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', pixels.shape[1], pixels.shape[0], 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)
    path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR', header)+chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))+chunk(b'IEND', b''))


def previews(output, name, color, normal):
    directory = output/'previews'
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    thumb = color
    while len(thumb) > 512:
        thumb = reduce(thumb, srgb=True)
    png(directory/f'{name}-albedo.png', thumb)
    start = len(color)//3
    color = color[start:start+512, start:start+512, :3]
    normal = normal[start:start+512, start:start+512, :3]*2-1
    light = np.array([.4, -.5, .76], np.float32)
    light /= np.linalg.norm(light)
    lighting = .3+.7*np.maximum((normal*light).sum(-1), 0)
    linear = np.where(color <= .04045, color/12.92, ((color+.055)/1.055)**2.4)
    linear *= lighting[:, :, None]
    png(directory/f'{name}-detail.png', np.where(linear <= .0031308, linear*12.92, 1.055*linear**(1/2.4)-.055))


def write_ktx(path, edge, fmt, layers):
    levels = edge.bit_length()
    dfd = descriptor(fmt)
    dfd_offset = 80 + levels*24
    cursor = (dfd_offset + len(dfd) + 7) & ~7
    entries = []
    payloads = []
    images = layers
    for level in range(levels):
        payload = b''.join(encode(image, fmt) for image in images)
        entries.append((cursor, len(payload), len(payload)))
        payloads.append((cursor, payload))
        cursor = (cursor + len(payload)+7) & ~7
        if level+1 < levels:
            images = [reduce(image, srgb=fmt in (43, 132), normal=fmt == 141 or path.name.startswith('normal')) for image in images]
    with path.open('wb') as out:
        # KTX2 requires physical mip payloads from smallest to largest.
        cursor = (dfd_offset + len(dfd) + 7) & ~7
        for level in reversed(range(levels)):
            payload = payloads[level][1]
            entries[level] = (cursor, len(payload), len(payload))
            payloads[level] = (cursor, payload)
            cursor = (cursor + len(payload)+7) & ~7
        out.write(b'\xabKTX 20\xbb\r\n\x1a\n')
        out.write(struct.pack('<13I2Q', fmt, 1, edge, edge, 0, 6, 1, levels, 0,
                              dfd_offset, len(dfd), 0, 0, 0, 0))
        for entry in entries:
            out.write(struct.pack('<3Q', *entry))
        out.write(dfd)
        for offset, payload in reversed(payloads):
            out.seek(offset)
            out.write(payload)


def bake(output):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recipe', RECIPE)
    recipe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recipe)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sources = Path(__file__).read_bytes()+b''.join(path.read_bytes() for path in sorted(RECIPE.parent.glob('*.py')))
    revision = hashlib.sha256(sources+np.__version__.encode()).hexdigest()
    stamp = output / 'recipe.sha256'
    if stamp.exists() and stamp.read_text() == revision and (output/'manifest.ron').exists():
        return
    variants = []
    # Generate each role once. Temporary byte maps avoid keeping six float arrays live.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.cook-', dir=output) as temporary:
        temporary = Path(temporary)
        for role, name in enumerate(recipe.ROLES):
            print(f'Baking {name}', flush=True)
            maps = recipe.maps(role, 4096)
            previews(output, name, maps[0], maps[1])
            for index, image in enumerate(maps):
                np.save(temporary/f'{role}-{index}.npy', np.rint(np.clip(image, 0, 1)*255).astype(np.uint8))
            del maps, image
        for edge, formats in ((4096, (132, 141, 137)), (2048, (43, 37, 37))):
            files = []
            for index, (name, fmt) in enumerate(zip(('albedo', 'normal', 'packed'), formats)):
                path = output/f'{name}-{edge}.ktx2'
                layers = [np.load(temporary/f'{role}-{index}.npy', mmap_mode='r') for role in range(6)]
                if edge == 2048:
                    layers = [reduce(image, srgb=index == 0, normal=index == 1) for image in layers]
                write_ktx(path, edge, fmt, layers)
                del layers
                data = path.read_bytes()
                files.append(f'(name:"{path.name}",bytes:{len(data)},sha256:"{hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}")')
            variants.append(f'(edge:{edge},compressed:{str(edge == 4096).lower()},maps:('+','.join(files)+'))')
    roles = ','.join('"'+r+'"' for r in recipe.ROLES)
    scales = ','.join(str(s) for s in recipe.SCALES)
    (output/'manifest.ron').write_text(f'(version:1,roles:({roles}),meters_per_tile:({scales}),height_blend:0.2,variants:('+','.join(variants)+'))')
    stamp.write_text(revision)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
    bake(parser.parse_args().output)

<<<FILE path="tools/geography/scripts/import_gebco_lite.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="112" bytes="4369" original_lines="112" original_bytes="4369" minified="false" sha256="ae6513b670909dd195904ee0a6744891dda5228602d5f47f1a4ea23699c1aef1">>>
"""Stream the 60-arcsecond overview of the GEBCO 2026 ice-surface COG."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request

import rasterio
from rasterio.windows import Window


SOURCE = "https://data.source.coop/ausantarctic/gebco/GEBCO_2026.tif"
WIDTH = 21_600
HEIGHT = 10_800
ROWS_PER_CHUNK = 128


def source_identity():
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        SOURCE, method="HEAD", headers={"User-Agent": "curl/8.0"}
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
        etag = response.headers.get("ETag", "")
        version = response.headers.get("x-amz-version-id", "")
    if not etag or not version:
        raise RuntimeError("GEBCO mirror did not provide a source ETag and version")
    return {"url": SOURCE, "etag": etag, "version": version}


def ron_string(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True)


def write_index(path, identity, tile_digest):
    fields = [
        "version: 2",
        'edition: "GEBCO_2026_ice_surface_60arcsec"',
        f"source_url: {ron_string(identity['url'])}",
        f"source_etag: {ron_string(identity['etag'])}",
        f"source_version: {ron_string(identity['version'])}",
        f'tile_sha256: ["{tile_digest}"]',
    ]
    (path / "index.ron").write_text("(" + ", ".join(fields) + ")\n", encoding="utf-8")


def import_grid(package):
    staging = package.with_name(package.name + ".importing")
    if package.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f"Package already exists: {package}")
    identity = source_identity()
    staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    identity_path = staging / "source.json"
    if identity_path.exists():
        previous = json.loads(identity_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if previous != identity:
            raise RuntimeError("Source changed since the partial import; remove staging data")
    else:
        identity_path.write_text(json.dumps(identity, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    output = staging / "elevation.bil"
    existing = output.stat().st_size if output.exists() else 0
    row_bytes = WIDTH * 2
    if existing % row_bytes or existing > WIDTH * HEIGHT * 2:
        raise RuntimeError("Partial elevation.bil has an invalid size")
    start_row = existing // row_bytes
    with rasterio.Env(GDAL_DISABLE_READDIR_ON_OPEN="YES"):
        with rasterio.open("/vsicurl/" + SOURCE, overview_level=1) as grid:
            if (grid.width, grid.height, grid.count, grid.dtypes[0]) != (
                WIDTH,
                HEIGHT,
                1,
                "int16",
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("GEBCO overview geometry or type changed")
            with output.open("ab") as destination:
                for row in range(start_row, HEIGHT, ROWS_PER_CHUNK):
                    count = min(ROWS_PER_CHUNK, HEIGHT - row)
                    values = grid.read(1, window=Window(0, row, WIDTH, count))
                    destination.write(values.astype("<i2", copy=False).tobytes())
                    destination.flush()
                    print(f"GEBCO 1' import: {row + count}/{HEIGHT} rows", flush=True)

    if source_identity() != identity:
        raise RuntimeError("Source changed during import; partial data remain in staging")
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with output.open("rb") as data:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: data.read(16 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    write_index(staging, identity, digest.hexdigest())
    (staging / "ATTRIBUTION.txt").write_text(
        "GEBCO Bathymetric Compilation Group 2026 (2026). "
        "The GEBCO_2026 Grid - a continuous terrain model for oceans and land "
        "at 15 arc-second intervals. doi:10.5285/4f68d5c7-45eb-f999-e063-7086abc036fa\n"
        "This package contains the 1-arcminute overview of the ice-surface "
        "grid mirrored by the Australian Antarctic Division at Source Cooperative.\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    identity_path.unlink()
    staging.replace(package)
    print(f"Imported GEBCO 2026 1' package: {package}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--package-dir", type=Path, default=Path("third_party/gebco-2026"))
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    import_grid(arguments.package_dir.resolve())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<<<FILE path="tools/import_worldcover.py" plugin="python" lang="python" reason="extension:.py" lines="93" bytes="4559" original_lines="93" original_bytes="4559" minified="false" sha256="5337f34b30eb31978bb4601ba8237bc6a60ef199ac85086cd13551e7a5f14d4d">>>
"""Aggregate local ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 GeoTIFFs to two-minute fractions.

Requires rasterio and numpy. Reads supplied tiles only; untouched cells are nodata.
Output is presentation data and never participates in geometry fingerprints.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import numpy as np
import rasterio
from rasterio.warp import reproject, Resampling
from rasterio.transform import from_origin
from rasterio.windows import from_bounds

ATTRIBUTION = ("© ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel "
               "data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium\n"
               "ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, Zanaga et al. (2022)\n"
               "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7254221\nCC BY 4.0\n")
# Unvegetated/built ground maps to soil; wetlands retain underlying vegetation.
CLASSES = {10: (0, 0, .15, .85, 0, 0), 20: (0, .2, .6, .2, 0, 0),
           30: (0, .1, .9, 0, 0, 0), 40: (0, .4, .6, 0, 0, 0),
           50: (0, .6, 0, 0, .4, 0), 60: (.25, .25, 0, 0, .5, 0),
           70: (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1), 80: (1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
           90: (0, .3, .5, .2, 0, 0), 95: (0, .1, .1, .8, 0, 0),
           100: (0, .4, .6, 0, 0, 0)}


def sha256(path):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''):
            value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('tiles', nargs='+', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = output.with_suffix('.part')
    width, height = 10800, 5400
    with temporary.open('wb') as stream:
        stream.write(b'MMWC21\0\0'+struct.pack('<II', width, height))
        stream.truncate(16+width*height*7)
    grid = np.memmap(temporary, dtype=np.uint8, mode='r+', offset=16, shape=(height, width, 7))
    sources = []
    for path in sorted(args.tiles):
        with rasterio.open(path) as src:
            if src.crs != rasterio.crs.CRS.from_epsg(4326):
                raise ValueError(f'{path}: expected WorldCover WGS84')
            left, bottom, right, top = src.bounds
            col, row = round((left+180)*30), round((90-top)*30)
            cols, rows = round((right-left)*30), round((top-bottom)*30)
            if not (0 <= col < width and 0 <= row < height and cols > 0 and rows > 0
                    and col+cols <= width and row+rows <= height):
                raise ValueError('tile outside world grid')
            if grid[row:row+rows, col:col+cols, 6].any():
                raise ValueError('overlapping input tiles')
            # Process one output row at a time; a full 3-degree source tile can be huge.
            for strip in range(rows):
                strip_top = top-strip/30
                window = from_bounds(left, strip_top-1/30, right, strip_top,
                                     src.transform).round_offsets().round_lengths()
                classes = src.read(1, window=window)
                valid = np.isin(classes, tuple(CLASSES)).astype(np.float32)
                result = np.zeros((1, cols, 7), np.float32)
                transform = from_origin(left, strip_top, 1/30, 1/30)
                # Average class indicator fields to fractions, never nearest labels.
                for channel in range(7):
                    field = valid.copy() if channel == 6 else np.zeros_like(valid)
                    if channel < 6:
                        for label, weights in CLASSES.items():
                            if weights[channel]:
                                field[classes == label] = weights[channel]
                    reproject(field, result[:, :, channel], src_transform=src.window_transform(window),
                              src_crs=src.crs, dst_transform=transform, dst_crs=src.crs,
                              resampling=Resampling.average)
                result[:, :, :6] /= np.maximum(result[:, :, 6:], 1e-8)
                grid[row+strip:row+strip+1, col:col+cols] = np.rint(result*255).clip(0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
            sources.append(f'{path.name} {sha256(path)}')
    grid.flush()
    del grid
    temporary.replace(output)
    output.with_suffix('.attribution.txt').write_text(ATTRIBUTION+'\n'+'\n'.join(sources), encoding='utf-8')
    output.with_suffix('.sha256').write_text(sha256(output))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Compose existing offline material previews for review (requires Pillow)."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('directory', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    roles = ('sand', 'soil', 'grass', 'litter', 'rock', 'snow')
    sheet = Image.new('RGB', (768, 6*284), (28, 30, 33))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for row, role in enumerate(roles):
        albedo = Image.open(args.directory/f'{role}-albedo.png').convert('RGB')
        detail = Image.open(args.directory/f'{role}-detail.png').convert('RGB')
        repeat = Image.new('RGB', (1024, 1024))
        for y in (0, 512):
            for x in (0, 512):
                repeat.paste(albedo, (x, y))
        for col, (image, label) in enumerate(((albedo, 'whole tile'), (detail, 'lit source crop'), (repeat, '2 x 2 repeat'))):
            x, y = col*256, row*284
            draw.text((x+8, y+8), f'{role}: {label}', fill='white')
            sheet.paste(image.resize((256, 256), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS), (x, y+28))
    output = args.directory/'contact-sheet.png'
    sheet.save(output)
    print(output)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
<<<END_FILE>>>

"""Copy a compiled client and its cooked offline materials into a distributable folder."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import shutil


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('executable', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    materials = root / 'target/materials/sample-v1'
    if not args.executable.is_file() or not (materials/'manifest.ron').is_file():
        parser.error('build the client first (Python + numpy required by the material cooker)')
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(args.executable, args.output/args.executable.name)
    shutil.copytree(materials, args.output/'materials/sample-v1', dirs_exist_ok=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
